private {
bool ImGuiListClipper_StepInternal(ImGuiListClipper* clipper) {
    ImGuiContext* g = clipper.Ctx;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    var data = cast(ImGuiListClipperData*, clipper.TempData);
    assert(data != null && "Called ImGuiListClipper::Step() too many times, or before ImGuiListClipper::Begin() ?");
    ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
    if table && table.IsInsideRow {
        ImGui_TableEndRow(table);
    }
    if clipper.ItemsCount == 0 || GetSkipItemForListClipping() {
        return false;
    }
    if data.StepNo == 0 && table != null && !table.IsUnfrozenRows {
        clipper.DisplayStart = data.ItemsFrozen;
        clipper.DisplayEnd = ImMin(data.ItemsFrozen + 1, clipper.ItemsCount);
        if clipper.DisplayStart < clipper.DisplayEnd {
            data.ItemsFrozen++;
        }
        return true;
    }
    bool calc_clipping = false;
    if data.StepNo == 0 {
        clipper.StartPosY = window.DC.CursorPos.y;
        if clipper.ItemsHeight <= 0.0f {
            ImVector_ImGuiListClipperRange_push_front(&data.Ranges, ImGuiListClipperRange_FromIndices(data.ItemsFrozen, data.ItemsFrozen + 1));
            clipper.DisplayStart = ImMax(data.Ranges.Data[0].Min, data.ItemsFrozen);
            clipper.DisplayEnd = ImMin(data.Ranges.Data[0].Max, clipper.ItemsCount);
            data.StepNo = 1;
            return true;
        }
        calc_clipping = true;
    }
    if clipper.ItemsHeight <= 0.0f {
        assert(data.StepNo == 1);
        bool affected_by_floating_point_precision = ImIsFloatAboveGuaranteedIntegerPrecision(cast(f32, clipper.StartPosY)) || ImIsFloatAboveGuaranteedIntegerPrecision(window.DC.CursorPos.y);
        if affected_by_floating_point_precision != 0 {
            clipper.ItemsHeight = window.DC.PrevLineSize.y + g.Style.ItemSpacing.y;
            window.DC.CursorPos.y = cast(f32, clipper.StartPosY + cast(f64, clipper.ItemsHeight));
        } else {
            clipper.ItemsHeight = cast(f32, cast(f64, window.DC.CursorPos.y) - clipper.StartPosY) / cast(f32, clipper.DisplayEnd - clipper.DisplayStart);
        }
        if clipper.ItemsHeight == 0.0f && clipper.ItemsCount == INT_MAX {
            return false;
        }
        if clipper.ItemsHeight <= 0.0f {
            while true {
                if clipper.ItemsHeight > 0.0f == 0 {
                    if ImGui_ErrorLog("ImGuiListClipper: Failed to calculate item height! First item hasn't been submitted by user code, or has not moved the cursor vertically!") != 0 {
                        assert(clipper.ItemsHeight > 0.0f && "ImGuiListClipper: Failed to calculate item height! First item hasn't been submitted by user code, or has not moved the cursor vertically!");
                    }
                }
                if !(0 != 0) { break; }
            }
            return false;
        }
        if table != null {
            assert(cast(f64, table.RowPosY1) == clipper.StartPosY && table.RowPosY2 == window.DC.CursorPos.y);
        }
        calc_clipping = true;
    }
    i32 already_submitted = clipper.DisplayEnd;
    if calc_clipping != 0 {
        clipper.StartSeekOffsetY = cast(f64, data.LossynessOffset) - cast(f64, data.ItemsFrozen) * cast(f64, clipper.ItemsHeight);
        if g.LogEnabled != 0 {
            ImVector_ImGuiListClipperRange_push_back(&data.Ranges, ImGuiListClipperRange_FromIndices(0, clipper.ItemsCount));
        } else {
            bool is_nav_request = g.NavMoveScoringItems && g.NavWindow && g.NavWindow.RootWindowForNav == window.RootWindowForNav;
            i32 nav_off_min = is_nav_request && g.NavMoveClipDir == ImGuiDir_Up ? -1 : 0;
            i32 nav_off_max = is_nav_request && g.NavMoveClipDir == ImGuiDir_Down ? 1 : 0;
            if is_nav_request != 0 {
                ImVector_ImGuiListClipperRange_push_back(&data.Ranges, ImGuiListClipperRange_FromPositions(g.NavScoringRect.Min.y, g.NavScoringRect.Max.y, nav_off_min, nav_off_max));
                if ImRect_IsInverted(&g.NavScoringNoClipRect) == 0 {
                    ImVector_ImGuiListClipperRange_push_back(&data.Ranges, ImGuiListClipperRange_FromPositions(g.NavScoringNoClipRect.Min.y, g.NavScoringNoClipRect.Max.y, nav_off_min, nav_off_max));
                }
            }
            if is_nav_request && g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_IsTabbing && g.NavTabbingDir == -1 {
                ImVector_ImGuiListClipperRange_push_back(&data.Ranges, ImGuiListClipperRange_FromIndices(clipper.ItemsCount - 1, clipper.ItemsCount));
            }
            ImRect nav_rect_abs = ImGui_WindowRectRelToAbs(window, window.NavRectRel[0]);
            if g.NavId != 0 && window.NavLastIds[0] == g.NavId {
                ImVector_ImGuiListClipperRange_push_back(&data.Ranges, ImGuiListClipperRange_FromPositions(nav_rect_abs.Min.y, nav_rect_abs.Max.y, 0, 0));
            }
            f32 min_y = window.ClipRect.Min.y;
            f32 max_y = window.ClipRect.Max.y;
            ImGuiBoxSelectState* bs = &g.BoxSelectState;
            if bs.IsActive && bs.Window == window {
                f32 pad_y = g.Style.ItemSpacing.y;
                min_y -= pad_y;
                max_y += pad_y;
                if bs.UnclipMode != 0 {
                    ImVector_ImGuiListClipperRange_push_back(&data.Ranges, ImGuiListClipperRange_FromPositions(bs.UnclipRect.Min.y - pad_y, bs.UnclipRect.Max.y + pad_y, 0, 0));
                }
            }
            ImVector_ImGuiListClipperRange_push_back(&data.Ranges, ImGuiListClipperRange_FromPositions(min_y, max_y, nav_off_min, nav_off_max));
        }
        {
            ImGuiListClipperRange* zz_rf_it_4 = ImVector_ImGuiListClipperRange_begin(&data.Ranges);
            ImGuiListClipperRange* zz_rf_end_4 = ImVector_ImGuiListClipperRange_end(&data.Ranges);
            for ; zz_rf_it_4 != zz_rf_end_4; zz_rf_it_4++ {
                ImGuiListClipperRange* range = zz_rf_it_4;
                if range.PosToIndexConvert != 0 {
                    var m1 = cast(i32, (cast(f64, range.Min) - cast(f64, window.DC.CursorPos.y) - cast(f64, data.LossynessOffset)) / cast(f64, clipper.ItemsHeight));
                    var m2 = cast(i32, (cast(f64, range.Max) - cast(f64, window.DC.CursorPos.y) - cast(f64, data.LossynessOffset)) / cast(f64, clipper.ItemsHeight) + 0.999999f);
                    range.Min = ImClamp(already_submitted + m1 + range.PosToIndexOffsetMin, already_submitted, clipper.ItemsCount - 1);
                    range.Max = ImClamp(already_submitted + m2 + range.PosToIndexOffsetMax, range.Min + 1, clipper.ItemsCount);
                    range.PosToIndexConvert = false;
                }
            }
        }
        ImGuiListClipper_SortAndFuseRanges(&data.Ranges, data.StepNo);
    }
    while data.StepNo < data.Ranges.Size {
        clipper.DisplayStart = ImMax(data.Ranges.Data[data.StepNo].Min, already_submitted);
        clipper.DisplayEnd = ImMin(data.Ranges.Data[data.StepNo].Max, clipper.ItemsCount);
        data.StepNo++;
        if clipper.DisplayStart >= clipper.DisplayEnd {
            continue;
        }
        if clipper.DisplayStart > already_submitted {
            ImGuiListClipper_SeekCursorForItem(clipper, clipper.DisplayStart);
        }
        return true;
    }
    if clipper.ItemsCount < INT_MAX {
        ImGuiListClipper_SeekCursorForItem(clipper, clipper.ItemsCount);
    }
    return false;
}

void ImGui_CalcClipRectVisibleItemsY(ImRect clip_rect, ImVec2 pos, f32 items_height, i32* out_visible_start, i32* out_visible_end) {
    *out_visible_start = ImMax(cast(i32, (clip_rect.Min.y - pos.y) / items_height), 0);

ImU32 ImGui_GetColorU32(ImU32 col, f32 alpha_mul) {
    ImGuiStyle* style = &GImGui.Style;
    alpha_mul *= style.Alpha;
    if alpha_mul >= 1.0f {
        return col;
    }
    ImU32 a = (col & 0xFF000000) >> 24;
    a = cast(ImU32, cast(f32, a) * alpha_mul);
    return col & cast(u32, ~0xFF000000) | a << 24;
}

u8* ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(u8* text, u8* text_end) {
    u8* text_display_end = text;
    if text_end == null {
        text_end = cast(u8*, -1);
    }
    while text_display_end < text_end && *text_display_end != 0 && (text_display_end[0] != 35 || text_display_end[1] != 35) {
        text_display_end++;
    }
    return text_display_end;
}

// Internal ImGui functions to render text

void ImGui_RenderText(ImVec2 pos, u8* text, u8* text_end, bool hide_text_after_hash) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    u8* text_display_end;
    if hide_text_after_hash != 0 {
        text_display_end = ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(text, text_end);
    } else {
        if text_end == null {
            text_end = text + strlen(text);
        }
        text_display_end = text_end;

    if text != text_display_end {
        ImDrawList_AddText(window.DrawList, g.Font, g.FontSize, pos, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Text), text, text_display_end, 0.0f, null);

// Default clip_rect uses (pos_min,pos_max)
// Handle clipping on CPU immediately (vs typically let the GPU clip the triangles that are overlapping the clipping rectangle edges)
// FIXME-OPT: Since we have or calculate text_size we could coarse clip whole block immediately, especially for text above draw_list->DrawList.
// Effectively as this is called from widget doing their own coarse clipping it's not very valuable presently. Next time function will take
// better advantage of the render function taking size into account for coarse clipping.
void ImGui_RenderTextClippedEx(ImDrawList* draw_list, ImVec2 pos_min, ImVec2 pos_max, u8* text, u8* text_display_end, ImVec2* text_size_if_known, ImVec2 align, ImRect* clip_rect) {
    ImVec2 pos = pos_min;
    ImVec2 text_size = text_size_if_known != null ? *text_size_if_known : ImGui_CalcTextSize(text, text_display_end, false, 0.0f);
    ImVec2* clip_min = clip_rect != null ? &clip_rect.Min : &pos_min;
    ImVec2* clip_max = clip_rect != null ? &clip_rect.Max : &pos_max;
    bool need_clipping = pos.x + text_size.x >= clip_max.x || pos.y + text_size.y >= clip_max.y;
    if clip_rect != null {
        need_clipping |= pos.x < clip_min.x || pos.y < clip_min.y;
    }
    if align.x > 0.0f {
        pos.x = ImMax(pos.x, pos.x + (pos_max.x - pos.x - text_size.x) * align.x);
    }
    if align.y > 0.0f {
        pos.y = ImMax(pos.y, pos.y + (pos_max.y - pos.y - text_size.y) * align.y);
    }
    if need_clipping != 0 {
        ImVec4 fine_clip_rect;
        ImVec4_init(&fine_clip_rect, clip_min.x, clip_min.y, clip_max.x, clip_max.y);
        ImDrawList_AddText(draw_list, null, 0.0f, pos, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Text), text, text_display_end, 0.0f, &fine_clip_rect);
    } else {
        ImDrawList_AddText(draw_list, null, 0.0f, pos, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Text), text, text_display_end, 0.0f, null);
    }
}

void ImGui_RenderTextClipped(ImVec2 pos_min, ImVec2 pos_max, u8* text, u8* text_end, ImVec2* text_size_if_known, ImVec2 align, ImRect* clip_rect) {
    u8* text_display_end = ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(text, text_end);
    var text_len = cast(i32, cast(i64, text_display_end - text));
    if text_len == 0 {
        return;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    ImGui_RenderTextClippedEx(window.DrawList, pos_min, pos_max, text, text_display_end, text_size_if_known, align, clip_rect);
    if g.LogEnabled != 0 {
        ImGui_LogRenderedText(&pos_min, text, text_display_end);
    }
}

// Another overly complex function until we reorganize everything into a nice all-in-one helper.
// This is made more complex because we have dissociated the layout rectangle (pos_min..pos_max) from 'ellipsis_max_x' which may be beyond it.
// This is because in the context of tabs we selectively hide part of the text when the Close Button appears, but we don't want the ellipsis to move.
// (BREAKING) On 2025/04/16 we removed the 'float clip_max_x' parameters which was preceding 'float ellipsis_max' and was the same value for 99% of users.
void ImGui_RenderTextEllipsis(ImDrawList* draw_list, ImVec2 pos_min, ImVec2 pos_max, f32 ellipsis_max_x, u8* text, u8* text_end_full, ImVec2* text_size_if_known) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if text_end_full == null {
        text_end_full = ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(text);
    }
    ImVec2 text_size = text_size_if_known != null ? *text_size_if_known : ImGui_CalcTextSize(text, text_end_full, false, 0.0f);
    if text_size.x > pos_max.x - pos_min.x {
        ImFont* font = draw_list._Data.Font;
        f32 font_size = draw_list._Data.FontSize;
        f32 font_scale = draw_list._Data.FontScale;
        u8* text_end_ellipsis = null;
        ImFontBaked* baked = ImFont_GetFontBaked(font, font_size, -1.0f);
        f32 ellipsis_width = ImFontBaked_GetCharAdvance(baked, font.EllipsisChar) * font_scale;
        f32 text_avail_width = ImMax(ImMax(pos_max.x, ellipsis_max_x) - ellipsis_width - pos_min.x, 1.0f);
        f32 text_size_clipped_x = ImFont_CalcTextSizeA(font, font_size, text_avail_width, 0.0f, text, text_end_full, &text_end_ellipsis).x;
        ImGui_RenderTextClippedEx(draw_list, pos_min, pos_max, text, text_end_ellipsis, &text_size, ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f});
        ImVec4 cpu_fine_clip_rect;
        ImVec4_init(&cpu_fine_clip_rect, pos_min.x, pos_min.y, pos_max.x, pos_max.y);
        ImVec2 ellipsis_pos = ImTrunc(ImVec2{pos_min.x + text_size_clipped_x, pos_min.y});
        ImFont_RenderChar(font, draw_list, font_size, ellipsis_pos, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Text), font.EllipsisChar, &cpu_fine_clip_rect);
    } else {
        ImGui_RenderTextClippedEx(draw_list, pos_min, pos_max, text, text_end_full, &text_size, ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f});
    }
    if g.LogEnabled != 0 {
        ImGui_LogRenderedText(&pos_min, text, text_end_full);
    }
}

void ImGui_RenderNavCursor(ImRect bb, ImGuiID id, ImGuiNavRenderCursorFlags flags, f32 rounding) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if id != g.NavId {
        return;
    }
    if !g.NavCursorVisible && !(flags & ImGuiNavRenderCursorFlags_AlwaysDraw) {
        return;
    }
    if id == g.LastItemData.ID && g.LastItemData.ItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_NoNav {
        return;
    }
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    if window.DC.NavHideHighlightOneFrame != 0 {
        return;
    }
    if rounding < 0.0f {
        rounding = g.Style.FrameRounding;
    }
    ImRect display_rect = bb;
    ImRect_ClipWith(&display_rect, window.ClipRect);
    f32 scale_factor = ImGui_GetScale();
    var thickness = cast(f32, cast(i32, ImMax(2.0f, 1.5f * scale_factor)));
    if (flags & ImGuiNavRenderCursorFlags_Compact) != 0 {
        ImDrawList_AddRect(window.DrawList, display_rect.Min, display_rect.Max, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_NavCursor), rounding, thickness, 0);
    } else {
        var distance = cast(f32, cast(i32, 3.0f + thickness * 0.5f));
        ImRect_Expand(&display_rect, ImVec2{distance, distance});
        bool fully_visible = ImRect_Contains(&window.ClipRect, display_rect);
        if fully_visible == 0 {
            ImDrawList_PushClipRect(window.DrawList, display_rect.Min, display_rect.Max, false);
        }
        ImDrawList_AddRect(window.DrawList, display_rect.Min, display_rect.Max, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_NavCursor), rounding, thickness, 0);
        if fully_visible == 0 {
            ImDrawList_PopClipRect(window.DrawList);
        }
    }
}

    {
        ImGuiViewportP** zz_rf_it_5 = ImVector_ImGuiViewportP_ptr_begin(&g.Viewports);
        ImGuiViewportP** zz_rf_end_5 = ImVector_ImGuiViewportP_ptr_end(&g.Viewports);
        for ; zz_rf_it_5 != zz_rf_end_5; zz_rf_it_5++ {
            ImGuiViewportP* viewport = *zz_rf_it_5;
            ImVec2 offset;
            ImVec2 size;
            ImVec2[4] uv;
            if ImFontAtlasGetMouseCursorTexData(font_atlas, mouse_cursor, &offset, &size, &uv[0], &uv[2]) == 0 {
                continue;
            }
            ImVec2 pos = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(base_pos, offset);
            f32 scale = base_scale * viewport.DpiScale;
            if ImRect_Overlaps(&ImGuiViewportP_GetMainRect(viewport), ImRect{
                pos,
                op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(pos, op_mul_ImVec2_float(ImVec2{size.x + 2.0f, size.y + 2.0f}, scale)),
            }) == 0 {
                continue;
            }
            ImDrawList* draw_list = ImGui_GetForegroundDrawList(cast(ImGuiViewport*, viewport));
            ImTextureRef tex_ref = font_atlas.TexRef;
            ImDrawList_PushTexture(draw_list, tex_ref);
            ImDrawList_AddImage(draw_list, tex_ref, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(pos, op_mul_ImVec2_float(ImVec2{1.0f, 0.0f}, scale)), op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(pos, op_mul_ImVec2_float(op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(ImVec2{1.0f, 0.0f}, size), scale)), uv[2], uv[3], col_shadow);
            ImDrawList_AddImage(draw_list, tex_ref, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(pos, op_mul_ImVec2_float(ImVec2{2.0f, 0.0f}, scale)), op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(pos, op_mul_ImVec2_float(op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(ImVec2{2.0f, 0.0f}, size), scale)), uv[2], uv[3], col_shadow);
            ImDrawList_AddImage(draw_list, tex_ref, pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(pos, op_mul_ImVec2_float(size, scale)), uv[2], uv[3], col_border);
            ImDrawList_AddImage(draw_list, tex_ref, pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(pos, op_mul_ImVec2_float(size, scale)), uv[0], uv[1], col_fill);
            if mouse_cursor == ImGuiMouseCursor_Wait || mouse_cursor == ImGuiMouseCursor_Progress {
                f32 a_min = fmod(cast(f32, g.Time) * 5.0f, 2.0f * 3.141592653589793f);
                f32 a_max = a_min + 3.141592653589793f * 1.65f;
                ImDrawList_PathArcTo(draw_list, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(pos, op_mul_ImVec2_float(ImVec2{14.0f, -1.0f}, scale)), 6.0f * scale, a_min, a_max, 0);
                ImDrawList_PathStroke(draw_list, col_fill, 3.0f * scale, 0);
            }
            ImDrawList_PopTexture(draw_list);
        }
    }

// This is provided to facilitate copying allocators from one static/DLL boundary to another (e.g. retrieve default allocator of your executable address space)

    *p_alloc_func = GImAllocatorAllocFunc;
    *p_free_func = GImAllocatorFreeFunc;
    *p_user_data = GImAllocatorUserData;
}

ImGuiContext* ImGui_CreateContext(ImFontAtlas* shared_font_atlas) {
    ImGuiContext* prev_ctx = ImGui_GetCurrentContext();
    var ctx = cast(ImGuiContext*, ImGui_MemAlloc(cast(u64, sizeof(ImGuiContext))));
    ImGuiContext_init(ctx, shared_font_atlas);
    ImGui_SetCurrentContext(ctx);
    ImGui_Initialize();
    if prev_ctx != null {
        ImGui_SetCurrentContext(prev_ctx);
    }
    return ctx;
}

void ImGui_DestroyContext(ImGuiContext* ctx) {
    ImGuiContext* prev_ctx = ImGui_GetCurrentContext();
    if ctx == null {
        ctx = prev_ctx;
    }
    ImGui_SetCurrentContext(ctx);
    ImGui_Shutdown();
    ImGui_SetCurrentContext(prev_ctx != ctx ? prev_ctx : null);
    0;
}

// Free up/compact internal window buffers, we can use this when a window becomes unused.
// Not freed:
// - ImGuiWindow, ImGuiWindowSettings, Name, StateStorage, ColumnsStorage (may hold useful data)
// This should have no noticeable visual effect. When the window reappear however, expect new allocation/buffer growth/copy cost.
// FIXME: Consider exposing of elaborating GC policy, e.g. being able to trim excessive ImDrawList gaps. (#9303)
void ImGui_GcCompactTransientWindowBuffers(ImGuiWindow* window) {
    window.MemoryCompacted = true;
    window.MemoryDrawListIdxCapacity = ImMin(cast(i32, cast(f32, window.DrawList.IdxBuffer.Size) * 1.05f), window.DrawList.IdxBuffer.Capacity);
    window.MemoryDrawListVtxCapacity = ImMin(cast(i32, cast(f32, window.DrawList.VtxBuffer.Size) * 1.05f), window.DrawList.VtxBuffer.Capacity);
    ImVector_ImGuiID_clear(&window.IDStack);
    ImDrawList__ClearFreeMemory(window.DrawList);
    ImVector_ImGuiWindow_ptr_clear(&window.DC.ChildWindows);
    ImVector_float_clear(&window.DC.ItemWidthStack);
    ImVector_float_clear(&window.DC.TextWrapPosStack);
}

void ImGui_GcAwakeTransientWindowBuffers(ImGuiWindow* window) {
    window.MemoryCompacted = false;
    ImVector_ImDrawIdx_reserve(&window.DrawList.IdxBuffer, window.MemoryDrawListIdxCapacity);
    ImVector_ImDrawVert_reserve(&window.DrawList.VtxBuffer, window.MemoryDrawListVtxCapacity);
    window.MemoryDrawListVtxCapacity = 0;
    window.MemoryDrawListIdxCapacity = window.MemoryDrawListVtxCapacity;
}

        if focused_root_window != null {
            if focused_root_window.WasActive && focused_root_window != window.RootWindowDockTree {
                bool want_inhibit = false;
                if (focused_root_window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Modal) != 0 {
                    want_inhibit = true;
                } else if focused_root_window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup && !(flags & ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenBlockedByPopup) {

                }
                if want_inhibit != 0 {
                    if ImGui_IsWindowWithinBeginStackOf(window.RootWindow, focused_root_window) == 0 {

        }
    }
    if window.Viewport != g.MouseViewport {
        if g.MovingWindow == null || window.RootWindowDockTree != g.MovingWindow.RootWindowDockTree {
            return false;
        }
    }

// This is roughly matching the behavior of internal-facing ItemHoverable()
// - we allow hovering to be true when ActiveId==window->MoveID, so that clicking on non-interactive items such as a Text() item still returns true with IsItemHovered()
// - this should work even for non-interactive items that have no ID, so we cannot use LastItemId
bool ImGui_IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    while true {
        if (flags & ~ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowedMaskForIsItemHovered) == 0 == 0 {
            if ImGui_ErrorLog("Invalid flags for IsItemHovered()!") != 0 {
                assert((flags & ~ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowedMaskForIsItemHovered) == 0 && "Invalid flags for IsItemHovered()!");
            }
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    if g.NavHighlightItemUnderNav && g.NavCursorVisible && !(flags & ImGuiHoveredFlags_NoNavOverride) {
        if ImGui_IsItemFocused() == 0 {
            return false;
        }
        if g.LastItemData.ItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_Disabled && !(flags & ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenDisabled) {
            return false;
        }
        if (flags & ImGuiHoveredFlags_ForTooltip) != 0 {
            flags = ApplyHoverFlagsForTooltip(flags, g.Style.HoverFlagsForTooltipNav);
        }
    } else {
        ImGuiItemStatusFlags status_flags = g.LastItemData.StatusFlags;
        if (status_flags & ImGuiItemStatusFlags_HoveredRect) == 0 {
            return false;
        }
        if (flags & ImGuiHoveredFlags_ForTooltip) != 0 {
            flags = ApplyHoverFlagsForTooltip(flags, g.Style.HoverFlagsForTooltipMouse);
        }
        if g.HoveredWindow != window && (status_flags & ImGuiItemStatusFlags_HoveredWindow) == 0 {
            if (flags & ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenOverlappedByWindow) == 0 {
                return false;
            }
        }
        ImGuiID id = g.LastItemData.ID;
        if (flags & ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenBlockedByActiveItem) == 0 {
            if g.ActiveId != 0 && g.ActiveId != id && !g.ActiveIdAllowOverlap && !g.ActiveIdFromShortcut {
                bool cancel_is_hovered = true;
                if g.ActiveId == window.MoveId && (id == 0 || g.ActiveIdDisabledId == id) {
                    cancel_is_hovered = false;
                }
                if g.ActiveId == window.TabId {
                    cancel_is_hovered = false;
                }
                if cancel_is_hovered != 0 {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        if !ImGui_IsWindowContentHoverable(window, flags) && !(g.LastItemData.ItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_NoWindowHoverableCheck) {
            return false;
        }
        if g.LastItemData.ItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_Disabled && !(flags & ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenDisabled) {
            return false;
        }
        if id == window.MoveId && window.WriteAccessed {
            return false;
        }
        if g.LastItemData.ItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_AllowOverlap && id != 0 {
            if (flags & ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenOverlappedByItem) == 0 {
                if g.HoveredIdPreviousFrame != g.LastItemData.ID {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    f32 delay = CalcDelayFromHoveredFlags(flags);
    if delay > 0.0f || flags & ImGuiHoveredFlags_Stationary {
        ImGuiID hover_delay_id = g.LastItemData.ID != 0 ? g.LastItemData.ID : ImGuiWindow_GetIDFromPos(window, g.LastItemData.Rect.Min);
        if flags & ImGuiHoveredFlags_NoSharedDelay && g.HoverItemDelayIdPreviousFrame != hover_delay_id {
            g.HoverItemDelayTimer = 0.0f;
        }
        g.HoverItemDelayId = hover_delay_id;
        if (flags & ImGuiHoveredFlags_Stationary) != 0 && g.HoverItemUnlockedStationaryId != hover_delay_id {
            return false;
        }
        if g.HoverItemDelayTimer < delay {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

// Internal facing ItemHoverable() used when submitting widgets. THIS IS A SUBMISSION NOT A HOVER CHECK.
// Returns whether the item was hovered, logic differs slightly from IsItemHovered().
// (this does not rely on LastItemData it can be called from a ButtonBehavior() call not following an ItemAdd() call)
// FIXME-LEGACY: the 'ImGuiItemFlags item_flags' parameter was added on 2023-06-28.
// If you used this in your legacy/custom widgets code:
// - Commonly: if your ItemHoverable() call comes after an ItemAdd() call: pass 'item_flags = g.LastItemData.ItemFlags'.
// - Rare: otherwise you may pass 'item_flags = 0' (ImGuiItemFlags_None) unless you want to benefit from special behavior handled by ItemHoverable.
bool ImGui_ItemHoverable(ImRect bb, ImGuiID id, ImGuiItemFlags item_flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    when !(defined(IMGUI_DISABLE_DEBUG_TOOLS)) {
        if id != 0 && g.HoveredIdPreviousFrame == id && (item_flags & ImGuiItemFlags_AllowDuplicateId) == 0 {
            g.HoveredIdPreviousFrameItemCount++;
            if g.DebugDrawIdConflictsId == id {
                ImDrawList_AddRect(window.DrawList, op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(bb.Min, ImVec2{1.0f, 1.0f}), op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(bb.Max, ImVec2{1.0f, 1.0f}), cast(ImU32, 255) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 0, 0.0f, 2.0f, 0);
            }
        }
    }
    if g.HoveredWindow != window {
        return false;
    }
    if ImGui_IsMouseHoveringRect(bb.Min, bb.Max) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    if g.HoveredId != 0 && g.HoveredId != id && !g.HoveredIdAllowOverlap {
        return false;
    }
    if g.ActiveId != 0 && g.ActiveId != id && !g.ActiveIdAllowOverlap {
        if g.ActiveIdFromShortcut == 0 {
            return false;
        }
    }
    if !(item_flags & ImGuiItemFlags_NoWindowHoverableCheck) && !ImGui_IsWindowContentHoverable(window, ImGuiHoveredFlags_None) {
        g.HoveredIdIsDisabled = true;
        return false;
    }
    if id != 0 {
        if g.DragDropActive && g.DragDropPayload.SourceId == id && !(g.DragDropSourceFlags & ImGuiDragDropFlags_SourceNoDisableHover) {
            return false;
        }
        ImGui_SetHoveredID(id);
        if (item_flags & ImGuiItemFlags_AllowOverlap) != 0 {
            g.HoveredIdAllowOverlap = true;
            if g.HoveredIdPreviousFrame != id {
                return false;
            }
        }
        if id == g.LastItemData.ID && g.LastItemData.StatusFlags & ImGuiItemStatusFlags_HasShortcut && g.ActiveId != id {
            if ImGui_IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_ForTooltip | ImGuiHoveredFlags_DelayNormal) != 0 {
                ImGui_SetTooltip("%s", ImGui_GetKeyChordName(g.LastItemData.Shortcut));
            }
        }
    }
    if (item_flags & ImGuiItemFlags_Disabled) != 0 {
        if g.ActiveId == id && id != 0 {
            ImGui_ClearActiveID();
        }
        g.HoveredIdIsDisabled = true;
        return false;
    }
    when !(defined(IMGUI_DISABLE_DEBUG_TOOLS)) {
        if id != 0 {
            if g.DebugItemPickerActive && g.HoveredIdPreviousFrame == id {
                ImDrawList_AddRect(ImGui_GetForegroundDrawList(), bb.Min, bb.Max, cast(ImU32, 255) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 0, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0);
            }
            if g.DebugItemPickerBreakId == id {
                assert(0);
            }
        }
    }
    if g.NavHighlightItemUnderNav && (item_flags & ImGuiItemFlags_NoNavDisableMouseHover) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

f32 ImGui_CalcWrapWidthForPos(ImVec2 pos, f32 wrap_pos_x) {
    if wrap_pos_x < 0.0f {
        return 0.0f;

    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    if wrap_pos_x == 0.0f {
        wrap_pos_x = window.WorkRect.Max.x;
    } else if wrap_pos_x > 0.0f {
        wrap_pos_x += window.Pos.x - window.Scroll.x;
    }
    return ImMax(wrap_pos_x - pos.x, 1.0f);
}

void ImGui_StartMouseMovingWindow(ImGuiWindow* window) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGui_FocusWindow(window);
    ImGui_SetActiveID(window.MoveId, window);
    if g.IO.ConfigNavCursorVisibleAuto != 0 {
        g.NavCursorVisible = false;
    }
    g.ActiveIdClickOffset = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(g.IO.MouseClickedPos[0], window.RootWindowDockTree.Pos);
    g.ActiveIdNoClearOnFocusLoss = true;
    ImGui_SetActiveIdUsingAllKeyboardKeys();
    bool can_move_window = true;
    if window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove || window.RootWindowDockTree.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove {
        can_move_window = false;
    }
    {
        ImGuiDockNode* node = window.DockNodeAsHost;
        if node != null {
            if node.VisibleWindow && node.VisibleWindow.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove {
                can_move_window = false;
            }
        }
    }
    if can_move_window != 0 {
        g.MovingWindow = window;
    }
}

// We use 'undock == false' when dragging from title bar to allow moving groups of floating nodes without undocking them.
void ImGui_StartMouseMovingWindowOrNode(ImGuiWindow* window, ImGuiDockNode* node, bool undock) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    bool can_undock_node = false;
    if undock && node != null && node.VisibleWindow && (node.VisibleWindow.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove) == 0 && (node.MergedFlags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_NoUndocking) == 0 {
        ImGuiDockNode* root_node = ImGui_DockNodeGetRootNode(node);
        if root_node.OnlyNodeWithWindows != node || root_node.CentralNode != null {
            can_undock_node = true;
        }
    }
    bool clicked = ImGui_IsMouseClicked(0);
    bool dragging = ImGui_IsMouseDragging(0);
    if can_undock_node && dragging {
        ImGui_DockContextQueueUndockNode(g, node);
    } else if !can_undock_node && (clicked || dragging) && g.MovingWindow != window {
        ImGui_StartMouseMovingWindow(window);
    }
}

// This is not 100% symmetric with StartMouseMovingWindow().
// We do NOT clear ActiveID, because:
// - It would lead to rather confusing recursive code paths. Caller can call ClearActiveID() if desired.
// - Some code intentionally cancel moving but keep the ActiveID to lock inputs (e.g. code path taken when clicking a disabled item).
void ImGui_StopMouseMovingWindow() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.MovingWindow;
    if window && window.Viewport {
        if (g.ConfigFlagsCurrFrame & ImGuiConfigFlags_ViewportsEnable) != 0 {
            ImGui_UpdateTryMergeWindowIntoHostViewport(window.RootWindowDockTree, g.MouseViewport);
        }
        if ImGui_IsDragDropPayloadBeingAccepted() == 0 {
            g.MouseViewport = window.Viewport;
        }
        bool window_can_use_inputs = (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMouseInputs && window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNavInputs) == false;
        if window_can_use_inputs != 0 {
            window.Viewport.Flags &= ~ImGuiViewportFlags_NoInputs;
        }
    }
    g.MovingWindow = null;
}

// Handle mouse moving window
// Note: moving window with the navigation keys (Square + d-pad / Ctrl+Tab + Arrows) are processed in NavUpdateWindowing()
// FIXME: We don't have strong guarantee that g.MovingWindow stay synced with g.ActiveId == g.MovingWindow->MoveId.
// This is currently enforced by the fact that BeginDragDropSource() is setting all g.ActiveIdUsingXXXX flags to inhibit navigation inputs,
// but if we should more thoroughly test cases where g.ActiveId or g.MovingWindow gets changed and not the other.
void ImGui_UpdateMouseMovingWindowNewFrame() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if g.MovingWindow != null {
        ImGui_KeepAliveID(g.ActiveId);
        assert(g.MovingWindow && g.MovingWindow.RootWindowDockTree);
        ImGuiWindow* moving_window = g.MovingWindow.RootWindowDockTree;
        bool window_disappeared = !moving_window.WasActive && !moving_window.Active;
        if g.IO.MouseDown[0] && ImGui_IsMousePosValid(&g.IO.MousePos) && !window_disappeared {
            ImVec2 pos = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(g.IO.MousePos, g.ActiveIdClickOffset);
            if moving_window.Pos.x != pos.x || moving_window.Pos.y != pos.y {
                ImGui_SetWindowPos(moving_window, pos, ImGuiCond_Always);
                if moving_window.Viewport && moving_window.ViewportOwned {
                    moving_window.Viewport.Pos = pos;
                    ImGuiViewportP_UpdateWorkRect(moving_window.Viewport);
                }
            }
            ImGui_FocusWindow(g.MovingWindow);
        } else {
            ImGui_StopMouseMovingWindow();
            ImGui_ClearActiveID();
        }
    } else {
        if g.ActiveIdWindow && g.ActiveIdWindow.MoveId == g.ActiveId {
            ImGui_KeepAliveID(g.ActiveId);
            if g.IO.MouseDown[0] == 0 {
                ImGui_ClearActiveID();
            }
        }
    }
}

// Initiate focusing and moving window when clicking on empty space or title bar.
// Initiate focusing window when clicking on a disabled item.
// Handle left-click and right-click focus.
void ImGui_UpdateMouseMovingWindowEndFrame() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if g.ActiveId != 0 || g.HoveredId != 0 && !g.HoveredIdIsDisabled {
        return;
    }
    if g.NavWindow && g.NavWindow.Appearing {
        return;
    }
    ImGuiWindow* hovered_window = g.HoveredWindow;
    if ImGui_IsMouseClicked(0, ImGuiInputFlags_None, cast(ImGuiID, -1)) != 0 {
        ImGuiWindow* hovered_root = hovered_window != null ? hovered_window.RootWindow : null;
        bool is_closed_popup = hovered_root && hovered_root.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup && !ImGui_IsPopupOpen(hovered_root.PopupId, ImGuiPopupFlags_AnyPopupLevel);
        bool is_queued_focus_request = g.NavMoveSubmitted && g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_FocusApi;
        if hovered_window != null && !is_closed_popup && !is_queued_focus_request {
            ImGui_StartMouseMovingWindow(hovered_window);
            if (hovered_window.BgClickFlags & ImGuiWindowBgClickFlags_Move) == 0 {
                if !(hovered_root.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar) || hovered_root.DockIsActive {
                    if ImRect_Contains(&ImGuiWindow_TitleBarRect(hovered_root), g.IO.MouseClickedPos[0]) == 0 {
                        g.MovingWindow = null;
                    }
                }
            }
            if g.HoveredIdIsDisabled != 0 {
                g.MovingWindow = null;
                g.ActiveIdDisabledId = g.HoveredId;
            }
        } else if hovered_window == null && g.NavWindow != null {
            ImGui_FocusWindow(null, ImGuiFocusRequestFlags_UnlessBelowModal);
        }
    }
    if g.HoveredId == 0 && ImGui_IsMouseClicked(1, ImGuiInputFlags_None, cast(ImGuiID, -1)) {
        ImGuiWindow* modal = ImGui_GetTopMostPopupModal();
        bool hovered_window_above_modal = hovered_window && (modal == null || ImGui_IsWindowAbove(hovered_window, modal));
        ImGui_ClosePopupsOverWindow(hovered_window_above_modal != 0 ? hovered_window : modal, true);
    }
}

// This is called during NewFrame()->UpdateViewportsNewFrame() only.
// Need to keep in sync with SetWindowPos()
private {
void TranslateWindow(ImGuiWindow* window, ImVec2 delta) {
    window.Pos = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.Pos, delta);
    ImRect_Translate(&window.ClipRect, delta);
    ImRect_Translate(&window.OuterRectClipped, delta);
    ImRect_Translate(&window.InnerRect, delta);
    window.DC.CursorPos = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.DC.CursorPos, delta);
    window.DC.CursorStartPos = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.DC.CursorStartPos, delta);
    window.DC.CursorMaxPos = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.DC.CursorMaxPos, delta);
    window.DC.IdealMaxPos = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.DC.IdealMaxPos, delta);
}

void ScaleWindow(ImGuiWindow* window, f32 scale) {
    ImVec2 origin = window.Viewport.Pos;
    window.Pos = ImFloor(op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(op_mul_ImVec2_float(op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.Pos, origin), scale), origin));
    window.Size = ImTrunc(op_mul_ImVec2_float(window.Size, scale));
    window.SizeFull = ImTrunc(op_mul_ImVec2_float(window.SizeFull, scale));
    window.ContentSize = ImTrunc(op_mul_ImVec2_float(window.ContentSize, scale));
}

bool IsWindowActiveAndVisible(ImGuiWindow* window) {
    return window.Active && !window.Hidden;
}

// The reason this is exposed in imgui_internal.h is: on touch-based system that don't have hovering, we want to dispatch inputs to the right target (imgui vs imgui+app)
void ImGui_UpdateHoveredWindowAndCaptureFlags(ImVec2 mouse_pos) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiIO* io = &g.IO;
    g.WindowsBorderHoverPadding = ImMax(ImMax(g.Style.TouchExtraPadding.x, g.Style.TouchExtraPadding.y), g.Style.WindowBorderHoverPadding);
    bool clear_hovered_windows = false;
    ImGui_FindHoveredWindowEx(mouse_pos, false, &g.HoveredWindow, &g.HoveredWindowUnderMovingWindow);
    assert(g.HoveredWindow == null || g.HoveredWindow == g.MovingWindow || g.HoveredWindow.Viewport == g.MouseViewport);
    g.HoveredWindowBeforeClear = g.HoveredWindow;
    ImGuiWindow* modal_window = ImGui_GetTopMostPopupModal();
    if modal_window && g.HoveredWindow && !ImGui_IsWindowWithinBeginStackOf(g.HoveredWindow.RootWindow, modal_window) {
        clear_hovered_windows = true;
    }
    if (io.ConfigFlags & ImGuiConfigFlags_NoMouse) != 0 {
        clear_hovered_windows = true;
    }
    bool has_open_popup = g.OpenPopupStack.Size > 0;
    bool has_open_modal = modal_window != null;
    i32 mouse_earliest_down = -1;
    bool mouse_any_down = false;
    for i32 i = 0; i < cast(i32, sizeof(io.MouseDown) / sizeof(*io.MouseDown)); i++ {
        if io.MouseClicked[i] != 0 {
            io.MouseDownOwned[i] = g.HoveredWindow != null || has_open_popup;
            io.MouseDownOwnedUnlessPopupClose[i] = g.HoveredWindow != null || has_open_modal;
        }
        mouse_any_down |= io.MouseDown[i];
        if io.MouseDown[i] || io.MouseReleased[i] {
            if mouse_earliest_down == -1 || io.MouseClickedTime[i] < io.MouseClickedTime[mouse_earliest_down] {
                mouse_earliest_down = i;
            }
        }
    }
    bool mouse_avail = mouse_earliest_down == -1 || io.MouseDownOwned[mouse_earliest_down];
    bool mouse_avail_unless_popup_close = mouse_earliest_down == -1 || io.MouseDownOwnedUnlessPopupClose[mouse_earliest_down];
    bool mouse_dragging_extern_payload = g.DragDropActive && (g.DragDropSourceFlags & ImGuiDragDropFlags_SourceExtern) != 0;
    if !mouse_avail && !mouse_dragging_extern_payload {
        clear_hovered_windows = true;
    }
    if clear_hovered_windows != 0 {
        g.HoveredWindowUnderMovingWindow = null;
        g.HoveredWindow = g.HoveredWindowUnderMovingWindow;
    }
    if g.WantCaptureMouseNextFrame != -1 {
        io.WantCaptureMouseUnlessPopupClose = g.WantCaptureMouseNextFrame != 0;
        io.WantCaptureMouse = io.WantCaptureMouseUnlessPopupClose;
    } else {
        io.WantCaptureMouse = mouse_avail && (g.HoveredWindow != null || mouse_any_down) || has_open_popup;
        io.WantCaptureMouseUnlessPopupClose = mouse_avail_unless_popup_close && (g.HoveredWindow != null || mouse_any_down) || has_open_modal;
    }
    io.WantCaptureKeyboard = false;
    if (io.ConfigFlags & ImGuiConfigFlags_NoKeyboard) == 0 {
        if g.ActiveId != 0 || modal_window != null {
            io.WantCaptureKeyboard = true;
        } else if io.NavActive && io.ConfigFlags & ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableKeyboard && io.ConfigNavCaptureKeyboard {
            io.WantCaptureKeyboard = true;
        }
    }
    if g.WantCaptureKeyboardNextFrame != -1 {
        io.WantCaptureKeyboard = g.WantCaptureKeyboardNextFrame != 0;
    }
    io.WantTextInput = g.WantTextInputNextFrame != -1 ? g.WantTextInputNextFrame != 0 : false;
}

void FlattenDrawDataIntoSingleLayer(ImDrawDataBuilder* builder) {
    i32 n = builder.Layers[0].Size;

    for i32 i = 1; i < cast(i32, sizeof(builder.Layers) / sizeof(*builder.Layers)); i++ {
        full_size += builder.Layers[i].Size;

    ImVector_ImDrawList_ptr_resize(builder.Layers[0], full_size);
    for i32 layer_n = 1; layer_n < cast(i32, sizeof(builder.Layers) / sizeof(*builder.Layers)); layer_n++ {
        ImVector_ImDrawList_ptr* layer = builder.Layers[layer_n];
        if ImVector_ImDrawList_ptr_empty(layer) != 0 {

        memcpy(builder.Layers[0].Data + n, layer.Data, cast(u64, layer.Size * sizeof(ImDrawList*)));

ImGuiWindow* ImGui_FindBottomMostVisibleWindowWithinBeginStack(ImGuiWindow* parent_window) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* bottom_most_visible_window = parent_window;
    for i32 i = ImGui_FindWindowDisplayIndex(parent_window); i >= 0; i-- {
        ImGuiWindow* window = g.Windows.Data[i];
        if (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow) != 0 {
            continue;

// Calculate text size. Text can be multi-line. Optionally ignore text after a ## marker.
// CalcTextSize("") should return ImVec2(0.0f, g.FontSize)
ImVec2 ImGui_CalcTextSize(u8* text, u8* text_end, bool hide_text_after_double_hash, f32 wrap_width) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    u8* text_display_end;
    if hide_text_after_double_hash != 0 {
        text_display_end = ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(text, text_end);
    } else {
        text_display_end = text_end;
    }
    ImFont* font = g.Font;
    f32 font_size = g.FontSize;
    if text == text_display_end {
        return ImVec2{0.0f, font_size};
    }
    ImVec2 text_size = ImFont_CalcTextSizeA(font, font_size, FLT_MAX, wrap_width, text, text_display_end, null);
    text_size.x = ImCeilFast(text_size.x);
    return text_size;
}

// Find window given position, search front-to-back
// - Typically write output back to g.HoveredWindow and g.HoveredWindowUnderMovingWindow.
// - FIXME: Note that we have an inconsequential lag here: OuterRectClipped is updated in Begin(), so windows moved programmatically
//   with SetWindowPos() and not SetNextWindowPos() will have that rectangle lagging by a frame at the time FindHoveredWindow() is
//   called, aka before the next Begin(). Moving window isn't affected.
// - The 'find_first_and_in_any_viewport = true' mode is only used by TestEngine. It is simpler to maintain here.
void ImGui_FindHoveredWindowEx(ImVec2 pos, bool find_first_and_in_any_viewport, ImGuiWindow** out_hovered_window, ImGuiWindow** out_hovered_window_under_moving_window) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* hovered_window = null;
    ImGuiWindow* hovered_window_under_moving_window = null;
    ImGuiViewportP* backup_moving_window_viewport = null;
    if find_first_and_in_any_viewport == false && g.MovingWindow {
        backup_moving_window_viewport = g.MovingWindow.Viewport;
        g.MovingWindow.Viewport = g.MouseViewport;
        if (g.MovingWindow.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMouseInputs) == 0 {
            hovered_window = g.MovingWindow;
        }
    }
    ImVec2 padding_regular = g.Style.TouchExtraPadding;
    ImVec2 padding_for_resize = ImMax(g.Style.TouchExtraPadding, ImVec2{
        g.Style.WindowBorderHoverPadding, g.Style.WindowBorderHoverPadding,
    });
    for i32 i = g.Windows.Size - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
        ImGuiWindow* window = g.Windows.Data[i];
        if !window.WasActive || window.Hidden {
            continue;
        }
        if (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMouseInputs) != 0 {
            continue;
        }
        assert(cast(i64, window.Viewport));
        if window.Viewport != g.MouseViewport {
            continue;
        }
        ImVec2 hit_padding = (window.Flags & (ImGuiWindowFlags_NoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize)) != 0 ? padding_regular : padding_for_resize;
        if ImRect_ContainsWithPad(&window.OuterRectClipped, pos, hit_padding) == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        if window.HitTestHoleSize.x != 0 {
            ImVec2 hole_pos;
            ImVec2_init(&hole_pos, window.Pos.x + cast(f32, window.HitTestHoleOffset.x), window.Pos.y + cast(f32, window.HitTestHoleOffset.y));
            ImVec2 hole_size;
            ImVec2_init(&hole_size, cast(f32, window.HitTestHoleSize.x), cast(f32, window.HitTestHoleSize.y));
            if ImRect_Contains(&ImRect{hole_pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(hole_pos, hole_size)}, pos) != 0 {
                continue;
            }
        }
        if find_first_and_in_any_viewport != 0 {
            hovered_window = window;
            break;
        } else {
            if hovered_window == null {
                hovered_window = window;
            }
            if hovered_window_under_moving_window == null && (!g.MovingWindow || window.RootWindowDockTree != g.MovingWindow.RootWindowDockTree) {
                hovered_window_under_moving_window = window;
            }
            if hovered_window && hovered_window_under_moving_window {
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    *out_hovered_window = hovered_window;
    if out_hovered_window_under_moving_window != null {
        *out_hovered_window_under_moving_window = hovered_window_under_moving_window;
    }
    if find_first_and_in_any_viewport == false && g.MovingWindow {
        g.MovingWindow.Viewport = backup_moving_window_viewport;
    }
}

bool ImGui_BeginChildEx(u8* name, ImGuiID id, ImVec2 size_arg, ImGuiChildFlags child_flags, ImGuiWindowFlags window_flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* parent_window = g.CurrentWindow;
    assert(id != 0);
    ImGuiChildFlags ImGuiChildFlags_SupportedMask_ = ImGuiChildFlags_Borders | ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysUseWindowPadding | ImGuiChildFlags_ResizeX | ImGuiChildFlags_ResizeY | ImGuiChildFlags_AutoResizeX | ImGuiChildFlags_AutoResizeY | ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysAutoResize | ImGuiChildFlags_FrameStyle | ImGuiChildFlags_NavFlattened;
    ignore ImGuiChildFlags_SupportedMask_;
    assert((child_flags & ~ImGuiChildFlags_SupportedMask_) == 0 && "Illegal ImGuiChildFlags value. Did you pass ImGuiWindowFlags values instead of ImGuiChildFlags?");
    assert((window_flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize) == 0 && "Cannot specify ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize for BeginChild(). Use ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysAutoResize!");
    if (child_flags & ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysAutoResize) != 0 {
        assert((child_flags & (ImGuiChildFlags_ResizeX | ImGuiChildFlags_ResizeY)) == 0 && "Cannot use ImGuiChildFlags_ResizeX or ImGuiChildFlags_ResizeY with ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysAutoResize!");
        assert((child_flags & (ImGuiChildFlags_AutoResizeX | ImGuiChildFlags_AutoResizeY)) != 0 && "Must use ImGuiChildFlags_AutoResizeX or ImGuiChildFlags_AutoResizeY with ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysAutoResize!");
    }
    if (child_flags & ImGuiChildFlags_AutoResizeX) != 0 {
        child_flags &= ~ImGuiChildFlags_ResizeX;
    }
    if (child_flags & ImGuiChildFlags_AutoResizeY) != 0 {
        child_flags &= ~ImGuiChildFlags_ResizeY;
    }
    window_flags |= ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDocking;
    window_flags |= parent_window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove;
    if (child_flags & (ImGuiChildFlags_AutoResizeX | ImGuiChildFlags_AutoResizeY | ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysAutoResize)) != 0 {
        window_flags |= ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize;
    }
    if (child_flags & (ImGuiChildFlags_ResizeX | ImGuiChildFlags_ResizeY)) == 0 {
        window_flags |= ImGuiWindowFlags_NoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings;
    }
    if (child_flags & ImGuiChildFlags_FrameStyle) != 0 {
        ImGui_PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_ChildBg, g.Style.Colors[ImGuiCol_FrameBg]);
        ImGui_PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_ChildRounding, g.Style.FrameRounding);
        ImGui_PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_ChildBorderSize, g.Style.FrameBorderSize);
        ImGui_PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, g.Style.FramePadding);
        child_flags |= ImGuiChildFlags_Borders | ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysUseWindowPadding;
        window_flags |= ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove;
    }
    ImVec2 size_avail = ImGui_GetContentRegionAvail();
    ImVec2 size_default;
    ImVec2_init(&size_default, (child_flags & ImGuiChildFlags_AutoResizeX) != 0 ? 0.0f : size_avail.x, (child_flags & ImGuiChildFlags_AutoResizeY) != 0 ? 0.0f : size_avail.y);
    ImVec2 size = ImGui_CalcItemSize(size_arg, size_default.x, size_default.y);
    if (g.NextWindowData.HasFlags & ImGuiNextWindowDataFlags_HasSize) != 0 && (g.NextWindowData.SizeCond & ImGuiCond_Always) != 0 {
        if g.NextWindowData.SizeVal.x > 0.0f {
            size.x = g.NextWindowData.SizeVal.x;
            child_flags &= ~ImGuiChildFlags_ResizeX;
        }
        if g.NextWindowData.SizeVal.y > 0.0f {
            size.y = g.NextWindowData.SizeVal.y;
            child_flags &= ~ImGuiChildFlags_ResizeY;
        }
    }
    ImGui_SetNextWindowSize(size);
    if (g.NextWindowData.HasFlags & ImGuiNextWindowDataFlags_HasChildFlags) != 0 {
        g.NextWindowData.ChildFlags |= child_flags;
    } else {
        g.NextWindowData.ChildFlags = child_flags;
    }
    g.NextWindowData.HasFlags |= ImGuiNextWindowDataFlags_HasChildFlags;
    u8* temp_window_name;
    if name != null {
        ImFormatStringToTempBuffer(&temp_window_name, null, "%s/%s_%08X", parent_window.Name, name, id);
    } else {
        ImFormatStringToTempBuffer(&temp_window_name, null, "%s/%08X", parent_window.Name, id);
    }
    f32 backup_border_size = g.Style.ChildBorderSize;
    if (child_flags & ImGuiChildFlags_Borders) == 0 {
        g.Style.ChildBorderSize = 0.0f;
    }
    bool ret = ImGui_Begin(temp_window_name, null, window_flags);
    g.Style.ChildBorderSize = backup_border_size;
    if (child_flags & ImGuiChildFlags_FrameStyle) != 0 {
        ImGui_PopStyleVar(3);
        ImGui_PopStyleColor();
    }
    ImGuiWindow* child_window = g.CurrentWindow;
    child_window.ChildId = id;
    if child_window.BeginCount == 1 {
        parent_window.DC.CursorPos = child_window.Pos;
    }
    ImGuiID temp_id_for_activation = ImHashStr("##Child", 0, id);
    if g.ActiveId == temp_id_for_activation {
        ImGui_ClearActiveID();
    }
    if g.NavActivateId == id && !(child_flags & ImGuiChildFlags_NavFlattened) && (child_window.DC.NavLayersActiveMask != 0 || child_window.DC.NavWindowHasScrollY) {
        ImGui_FocusWindow(child_window);
        ImGui_NavInitWindow(child_window, false);
        ImGui_SetActiveID(temp_id_for_activation, child_window);
        g.ActiveIdSource = g.NavInputSource;
    }
    return ret;
}

void ImGui_EndChild() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* child_window = g.CurrentWindow;
    ImGuiID backup_within_end_child_id = g.WithinEndChildID;
    assert(child_window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow);
    g.WithinEndChildID = child_window.ID;
    ImVec2 child_size = child_window.Size;
    ImGui_End();
    if child_window.BeginCount == 1 {
        ImGuiWindow* parent_window = g.CurrentWindow;
        ImRect bb;
        ImRect_init(&bb, parent_window.DC.CursorPos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(parent_window.DC.CursorPos, child_size));
        ImGui_ItemSize(child_size);
        bool nav_flattened = (child_window.ChildFlags & ImGuiChildFlags_NavFlattened) != 0;
        if (child_window.DC.NavLayersActiveMask != 0 || child_window.DC.NavWindowHasScrollY) && !nav_flattened {
            ImGui_ItemAdd(bb, child_window.ChildId);
            ImGui_RenderNavCursor(bb, child_window.ChildId);
            if child_window.DC.NavLayersActiveMask == 0 && child_window == g.NavWindow {
                ImGui_RenderNavCursor(ImRect{
                    op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(bb.Min, ImVec2{2.0f, 2.0f}),
                    op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(bb.Max, ImVec2{2.0f, 2.0f}),
                }, g.NavId, ImGuiNavRenderCursorFlags_Compact);
            }
        } else {
            ImGui_ItemAdd(bb, child_window.ChildId, null, ImGuiItemFlags_NoNav);
            if nav_flattened != 0 {
                parent_window.DC.NavLayersActiveMaskNext |= child_window.DC.NavLayersActiveMaskNext;
            }
        }
        if g.HoveredWindow == child_window {
            g.LastItemData.StatusFlags |= ImGuiItemStatusFlags_HoveredWindow;
        }
        child_window.DC.ChildItemStatusFlags = g.LastItemData.StatusFlags;
    } else {
        ImGui_SetLastItemDataForChildWindowItem(child_window, ImGuiWindow_Rect(child_window));
    }
    g.WithinEndChildID = backup_within_end_child_id;
    g.LogLinePosY = -FLT_MAX;
}

private {
void ApplyWindowSettings(ImGuiWindow* window, ImGuiWindowSettings* settings) {
    if settings != null {
        ImGuiViewport* main_viewport = ImGui_GetMainViewport();
        window.ViewportPos = main_viewport.Pos;
        if settings.ViewportId != 0 {
            window.ViewportId = settings.ViewportId;
            window.ViewportPos = ImVec2{
                cast(f32, settings.ViewportPos.x), cast(f32, settings.ViewportPos.y),
            };
        }
        window.Pos = ImTrunc(ImVec2{
            cast(f32, settings.Pos.x) + window.ViewportPos.x,
            cast(f32, settings.Pos.y) + window.ViewportPos.y,
        });
        if settings.Size.x > 0 && settings.Size.y > 0 {
            window.SizeFull = ImTrunc(ImVec2{cast(f32, settings.Size.x), cast(f32, settings.Size.y)});
            window.Size = window.SizeFull;
            window.AutoFitFramesY = 0;
            window.AutoFitFramesX = window.AutoFitFramesY;
        }
        window.Collapsed = settings.Collapsed;
        window.DockId = settings.DockId;
        window.DockOrder = settings.DockOrder;
        SetWindowConditionAllowFlags(window, ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver, false);
    }
    window.DC.IdealMaxPos = window.Pos;
    window.DC.CursorMaxPos = window.DC.IdealMaxPos;
    window.DC.CursorStartPos = window.DC.CursorMaxPos;
    if (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize) != 0 {
        window.AutoFitFramesY = 2;
        window.AutoFitFramesX = window.AutoFitFramesY;
        window.AutoFitOnlyGrows = false;
    } else {
        window.AutoFitFramesX = cast(ImS8, window.Size.x <= 0.0f ? 2 : 0);
        window.AutoFitFramesY = cast(ImS8, window.Size.y <= 0.0f ? 2 : 0);
        window.AutoFitOnlyGrows = window.AutoFitFramesX > 0 || window.AutoFitFramesY > 0;
    }
}

// Note that 'settings' may be NULL.
// Sets _Once, _Appearing, _FirstUseEver. _FirstUseEver will be cleared again if there are settings.
void InitOrLoadWindowSettings(ImGuiWindow* window, ImGuiWindowSettings* settings) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiViewport* main_viewport = ImGui_GetMainViewport();
    window.Pos = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(main_viewport.Pos, ImVec2{60.0f, 60.0f});
    window.SizeFull = ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f};
    window.Size = window.SizeFull;
    window.ViewportPos = main_viewport.Pos;
    window.SetWindowDockAllowFlags = ImGuiCond_Always | ImGuiCond_Once | ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver | ImGuiCond_Appearing;
    window.SetWindowCollapsedAllowFlags = window.SetWindowDockAllowFlags;
    window.SetWindowSizeAllowFlags = window.SetWindowCollapsedAllowFlags;
    window.SetWindowPosAllowFlags = window.SetWindowSizeAllowFlags;
    ApplyWindowSettings(window, settings);
    if settings != null {
        settings.LastUsedDate = g.SessionDate;
    }
}

    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;

        ImVector_ImGuiWindow_ptr_push_front(&g.Windows, window);

        ImVector_ImGuiWindow_ptr_push_back(&g.Windows, window);

ImVec2 CalcWindowMinSize(ImGuiWindow* window) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImVec2 size_min;
    if window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow && !(window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup) {
        size_min.x = (window.ChildFlags & ImGuiChildFlags_ResizeX) != 0 ? g.Style.WindowMinSize.x : 4.0f;
        size_min.y = (window.ChildFlags & ImGuiChildFlags_ResizeY) != 0 ? g.Style.WindowMinSize.y : 4.0f;
    } else {
        size_min.x = (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize) == 0 ? g.Style.WindowMinSize.x : 4.0f;
        size_min.y = (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize) == 0 ? g.Style.WindowMinSize.y : 4.0f;
    }
    ImGuiWindow* window_for_height = GetWindowForTitleAndMenuHeight(window);
    size_min.y = ImMax(size_min.y, window_for_height.TitleBarHeight + window_for_height.MenuBarHeight + ImMax(0.0f, g.Style.WindowRounding - 1.0f));
    return size_min;
}

ImVec2 CalcWindowSizeAfterConstraint(ImGuiWindow* window, ImVec2 size_desired) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImVec2 new_size = size_desired;
    if (g.NextWindowData.HasFlags & ImGuiNextWindowDataFlags_HasSizeConstraint) != 0 {
        ImRect cr = g.NextWindowData.SizeConstraintRect;
        new_size.x = cr.Min.x >= 0.0f && cr.Max.x >= 0.0f ? ImClamp(new_size.x, cr.Min.x, cr.Max.x) : window.SizeFull.x;
        new_size.y = cr.Min.y >= 0.0f && cr.Max.y >= 0.0f ? ImClamp(new_size.y, cr.Min.y, cr.Max.y) : window.SizeFull.y;
        if g.NextWindowData.SizeCallback != null {
            ImGuiSizeCallbackData data;
            data.UserData = g.NextWindowData.SizeCallbackUserData;
            data.Pos = window.Pos;
            data.CurrentSize = window.SizeFull;
            data.DesiredSize = new_size;
            g.NextWindowData.SizeCallback(&data);
            new_size = data.DesiredSize;
        }
        new_size.x = cast(f32, cast(i32, new_size.x));
        new_size.y = cast(f32, cast(i32, new_size.y));
    }
    ImVec2 size_min = CalcWindowMinSize(window);
    return ImMax(new_size, size_min);
}

void CalcWindowContentSizes(ImGuiWindow* window, ImVec2* content_size_current, ImVec2* content_size_ideal) {
    bool preserve_old_content_sizes = false;
    if window.Collapsed && window.AutoFitFramesX <= 0 && window.AutoFitFramesY <= 0 {
        preserve_old_content_sizes = true;
    } else if window.Hidden && window.HiddenFramesCannotSkipItems == 0 && window.HiddenFramesCanSkipItems > 0 {
        preserve_old_content_sizes = true;
    }
    if preserve_old_content_sizes != 0 {
        *content_size_current = window.ContentSize;
        *content_size_ideal = window.ContentSizeIdeal;
        return;
    }
    content_size_current.x = window.ContentSizeExplicit.x != 0.0f ? window.ContentSizeExplicit.x : ImTrunc64(window.DC.CursorMaxPos.x - window.DC.CursorStartPos.x);
    content_size_current.y = window.ContentSizeExplicit.y != 0.0f ? window.ContentSizeExplicit.y : ImTrunc64(window.DC.CursorMaxPos.y - window.DC.CursorStartPos.y);
    content_size_ideal.x = window.ContentSizeExplicit.x != 0.0f ? window.ContentSizeExplicit.x : ImTrunc64(ImMax(window.DC.CursorMaxPos.x, window.DC.IdealMaxPos.x) - window.DC.CursorStartPos.x);
    content_size_ideal.y = window.ContentSizeExplicit.y != 0.0f ? window.ContentSizeExplicit.y : ImTrunc64(ImMax(window.DC.CursorMaxPos.y, window.DC.IdealMaxPos.y) - window.DC.CursorStartPos.y);
}

ImVec2 CalcWindowAutoFitSize(ImGuiWindow* window, ImVec2 size_contents, i32 axis_mask) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiStyle* style = &g.Style;
    f32 decoration_w_without_scrollbars = window.DecoOuterSizeX1 + window.DecoOuterSizeX2 - window.ScrollbarSizes.x;
    f32 decoration_h_without_scrollbars = window.DecoOuterSizeY1 + window.DecoOuterSizeY2 - window.ScrollbarSizes.y;
    ImVec2 size_pad = op_mul_ImVec2_float(window.WindowPadding, 2.0f);
    ImVec2 size_desired;
    size_desired.x = (axis_mask & 1) != 0 ? size_contents.x + size_pad.x + decoration_w_without_scrollbars : window.Size.x;
    size_desired.y = (axis_mask & 2) != 0 ? size_contents.y + size_pad.y + decoration_h_without_scrollbars : window.Size.y;
    var size_max = ImVec2{FLT_MAX, FLT_MAX};
    if (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow) == 0 || (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup) != 0 {
        if window.ViewportOwned == 0 {
            size_max = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(ImGui_GetMainViewport().WorkSize, op_mul_ImVec2_float(style.DisplaySafeAreaPadding, 2.0f));
        }
        i32 monitor_idx = window.ViewportAllowPlatformMonitorExtend;
        if monitor_idx >= 0 && monitor_idx < g.PlatformIO.Monitors.Size {
            size_max = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(g.PlatformIO.Monitors.Data[monitor_idx].WorkSize, op_mul_ImVec2_float(style.DisplaySafeAreaPadding, 2.0f));
        }
    }
    if (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Tooltip) != 0 {
        return ImMin(size_desired, size_max);
    } else {
        ImVec2 size_min = CalcWindowMinSize(window);
        ImVec2 size_auto_fit = ImClamp(size_desired, ImMin(size_min, size_max), size_max);
        ImVec2 size_auto_fit_after_constraint = CalcWindowSizeAfterConstraint(window, size_auto_fit);
        f32 size_contents_for_scrollbar_x = (axis_mask & 1) != 0 ? size_contents.x : window.ContentSize.x;
        f32 size_contents_for_scrollbar_y = (axis_mask & 2) != 0 ? size_contents.y : window.ContentSize.y;
        bool will_have_scrollbar_x = size_auto_fit_after_constraint.x < size_contents_for_scrollbar_x + size_pad.x + decoration_w_without_scrollbars && !(window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollbar) && window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_HorizontalScrollbar || window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysHorizontalScrollbar;
        bool will_have_scrollbar_y = size_auto_fit_after_constraint.y < size_contents_for_scrollbar_y + size_pad.y + decoration_h_without_scrollbars && !(window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollbar) || window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysVerticalScrollbar;
        if will_have_scrollbar_x != 0 {
            size_auto_fit.y += style.ScrollbarSize;
        }
        if will_have_scrollbar_y != 0 {
            size_auto_fit.x += style.ScrollbarSize;
        }
        return size_auto_fit;
    }
}
}

ImVec2 ImGui_CalcWindowNextAutoFitSize(ImGuiWindow* window) {
    ImVec2 size_contents_current;
    ImVec2 size_contents_ideal;
    CalcWindowContentSizes(window, &size_contents_current, &size_contents_ideal);
    ImVec2 size_auto_fit = CalcWindowAutoFitSize(window, size_contents_ideal, ~0);
    ImVec2 size_final = CalcWindowSizeAfterConstraint(window, size_auto_fit);
    return size_final;
}

void CalcResizePosSizeFromAnyCorner(ImGuiWindow* window, ImVec2 corner_target_arg, ImVec2 corner_norm, ImVec2* out_pos, ImVec2* out_size) {
    ImVec2 corner_target = corner_target_arg;
    if (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow) != 0 {
        ImGuiWindow* parent_window = window.ParentWindow;
        ImGuiWindowFlags parent_flags = parent_window.Flags;
        ImRect limit_rect = parent_window.InnerRect;
        ImRect_Expand(&limit_rect, ImVec2{
            -ImMax(parent_window.WindowPadding.x, parent_window.WindowBorderSize),
            -ImMax(parent_window.WindowPadding.y, parent_window.WindowBorderSize),
        });
        if (parent_flags & (ImGuiWindowFlags_HorizontalScrollbar | ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysHorizontalScrollbar)) == 0 || parent_flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollbar {
            corner_target.x = ImClamp(corner_target.x, limit_rect.Min.x, limit_rect.Max.x);
        }
        if (parent_flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollbar) != 0 {
            corner_target.y = ImClamp(corner_target.y, limit_rect.Min.y, limit_rect.Max.y);
        }
    }
    ImVec2 pos_min = ImLerp(corner_target, window.Pos, corner_norm);
    ImVec2 pos_max = ImLerp(op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.Pos, window.Size), corner_target, corner_norm);
    ImVec2 size_expected = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(pos_max, pos_min);
    ImVec2 size_constrained = CalcWindowSizeAfterConstraint(window, size_expected);
    *out_pos = pos_min;
    if corner_norm.x == 0.0f {
        out_pos.x -= size_constrained.x - size_expected.x;
    }
    if corner_norm.y == 0.0f {
        out_pos.y -= size_constrained.y - size_expected.y;
    }
    *out_size = size_constrained;
}

// Handle resize for: Resize Grips, Borders, Gamepad
// Return true when using auto-fit (double-click on resize grip)
private {
i32 ImGui_UpdateWindowManualResize(ImGuiWindow* window, i32* border_hovered, i32* border_held, i32 resize_grip_count, ImU32* resize_grip_col, ImRect visibility_rect) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindowFlags flags = window.Flags;
    if flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoResize || window.AutoFitFramesX > 0 || window.AutoFitFramesY > 0 {
        return false;
    }
    if flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize && (window.ChildFlags & (ImGuiChildFlags_ResizeX | ImGuiChildFlags_ResizeY)) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    if window.WasActive == false {
        return false;
    }
    i32 ret_auto_fit_mask = 0x00;
    var grip_draw_size = cast(f32, cast(i32, ImMax(g.FontSize * 1.35f, window.WindowRounding + 1.0f + g.FontSize * 0.2f)));
    f32 grip_hover_inner_size = resize_grip_count > 0 ? cast(f32, cast(i32, grip_draw_size * 0.75f)) : 0.0f;
    f32 grip_hover_outer_size = g.WindowsBorderHoverPadding;
    ImRect clamp_rect = visibility_rect;
    bool window_move_from_title_bar = !(window.BgClickFlags & ImGuiWindowBgClickFlags_Move) && !(window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar);
    if window_move_from_title_bar != 0 {
        clamp_rect.Min.y -= window.TitleBarHeight;
    }
    ImVec2 pos_target;
    ImVec2_init(&pos_target, FLT_MAX, FLT_MAX);
    ImVec2 size_target;
    ImVec2_init(&size_target, FLT_MAX, FLT_MAX);
    bool clip_with_viewport_rect = !(g.IO.BackendFlags & ImGuiBackendFlags_HasMouseHoveredViewport) || g.IO.MouseHoveredViewport != window.ViewportId || !(window.Viewport.Flags & ImGuiViewportFlags_NoDecoration);
    if clip_with_viewport_rect != 0 {
        window.ClipRect = ImGuiViewportP_GetMainRect(window.Viewport);
    }
    window.DC.NavLayerCurrent = ImGuiNavLayer_Menu;
    ImGui_PushID("#RESIZE");
    for i32 resize_grip_n = 0; resize_grip_n < resize_grip_count; resize_grip_n++ {
        ImGuiResizeGripDef def = resize_grip_def[resize_grip_n];
        ImVec2 corner = ImLerp(window.Pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.Pos, window.Size), def.CornerPosN);
        bool hovered;
        bool held;
        ImRect resize_rect;
        ImRect_init(&resize_rect, op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(corner, op_mul_ImVec2_float(def.InnerDir, grip_hover_outer_size)), op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(corner, op_mul_ImVec2_float(def.InnerDir, grip_hover_inner_size)));
        if resize_rect.Min.x > resize_rect.Max.x {
            { var zz_sw = resize_rect.Min.x; resize_rect.Min.x = resize_rect.Max.x; resize_rect.Max.x = zz_sw; }
        }
        if resize_rect.Min.y > resize_rect.Max.y {
            { var zz_sw = resize_rect.Min.y; resize_rect.Min.y = resize_rect.Max.y; resize_rect.Max.y = zz_sw; }
        }
        ImGuiID resize_grip_id = ImGuiWindow_GetID(window, resize_grip_n);
        ImGui_ItemAdd(resize_rect, resize_grip_id, null, ImGuiItemFlags_NoNav);
        ImGui_ButtonBehavior(resize_rect, resize_grip_id, &hovered, &held, ImGuiButtonFlags_FlattenChildren | ImGuiButtonFlags_NoNavFocus);
        if hovered || held {
            ImGui_SetMouseCursor((resize_grip_n & 1) != 0 ? ImGuiMouseCursor_ResizeNESW : ImGuiMouseCursor_ResizeNWSE);
        }
        if held && g.IO.MouseDoubleClicked[0] {
            ImVec2 size_auto_fit = CalcWindowAutoFitSize(window, window.ContentSizeIdeal, ~0);
            size_target = CalcWindowSizeAfterConstraint(window, size_auto_fit);
            ret_auto_fit_mask = 0x03;
            ImGui_ClearActiveID();
        } else if held != 0 {
            var clamp_min = ImVec2{
                def.CornerPosN.x == 1.0f ? clamp_rect.Min.x : cast(f32, -FLT_MAX),
                def.CornerPosN.y == 1.0f || def.CornerPosN.y == 0.0f && window_move_from_title_bar ? clamp_rect.Min.y : cast(f32, -FLT_MAX),
            };
            var clamp_max = ImVec2{
                def.CornerPosN.x == 0.0f ? clamp_rect.Max.x : FLT_MAX,
                def.CornerPosN.y == 0.0f ? clamp_rect.Max.y : FLT_MAX,
            };
            ImVec2 corner_target = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(g.IO.MousePos, g.ActiveIdClickOffset), ImLerp(op_mul_ImVec2_float(def.InnerDir, grip_hover_outer_size), op_mul_ImVec2_float(def.InnerDir, -grip_hover_inner_size), def.CornerPosN));
            corner_target = ImClamp(corner_target, clamp_min, clamp_max);
            CalcResizePosSizeFromAnyCorner(window, corner_target, def.CornerPosN, &pos_target, &size_target);
        }
        bool resize_grip_visible = held || hovered || resize_grip_n == 0 && (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow) == 0;
        if resize_grip_visible != 0 {
            resize_grip_col[resize_grip_n] = ImGui_GetColorU32(held != 0 ? ImGuiCol_ResizeGripActive : hovered != 0 ? ImGuiCol_ResizeGripHovered : ImGuiCol_ResizeGrip);
        }
    }
    i32 resize_border_mask = 0x00;
    if (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow) != 0 {
        resize_border_mask |= ((window.ChildFlags & ImGuiChildFlags_ResizeX) != 0 ? 0x02 : 0) | ((window.ChildFlags & ImGuiChildFlags_ResizeY) != 0 ? 0x08 : 0);
    } else {
        resize_border_mask = g.IO.ConfigWindowsResizeFromEdges != 0 ? 0x0F : 0x00;
    }
    for i32 border_n = 0; border_n < 4; border_n++ {
        if (resize_border_mask & 1 << border_n) == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        ImGuiResizeBorderDef def = resize_border_def[border_n];
        ImGuiAxis axis = border_n == ImGuiDir_Left || border_n == ImGuiDir_Right ? ImGuiAxis_X : ImGuiAxis_Y;
        bool hovered;
        bool held;
        ImRect border_rect = GetResizeBorderRect(window, border_n, grip_hover_inner_size, g.WindowsBorderHoverPadding);
        ImGuiID border_id = ImGuiWindow_GetID(window, border_n + 4);
        ImGui_ItemAdd(border_rect, border_id, null, ImGuiItemFlags_NoNav);
        ImGui_ButtonBehavior(border_rect, border_id, &hovered, &held, ImGuiButtonFlags_FlattenChildren | ImGuiButtonFlags_NoNavFocus);
        if hovered && g.HoveredIdTimer <= WINDOWS_RESIZE_FROM_EDGES_FEEDBACK_TIMER {
            hovered = false;
        }
        if hovered || held {
            ImGui_SetMouseCursor(axis == ImGuiAxis_X ? ImGuiMouseCursor_ResizeEW : ImGuiMouseCursor_ResizeNS);
        }
        if held && g.IO.MouseDoubleClicked[0] {
            if border_n == 1 || border_n == 3 {
                ImVec2 size_auto_fit = CalcWindowAutoFitSize(window, window.ContentSizeIdeal, 1 << axis);
                cast(f32*, &size_target)[axis] = cast(f32*, &CalcWindowSizeAfterConstraint(window, size_auto_fit))[axis];
                ret_auto_fit_mask |= 1 << axis;
                held = false;
                hovered = held;
            }
            ImGui_ClearActiveID();
        } else if held != 0 {
            bool just_scrolled_manually_while_resizing = g.WheelingWindow != null && g.WheelingWindowScrolledFrame == g.FrameCount && ImGui_IsWindowChildOf(window, g.WheelingWindow, false, true);
            if g.ActiveIdIsJustActivated || just_scrolled_manually_while_resizing {
                g.WindowResizeBorderExpectedRect = border_rect;
                g.WindowResizeRelativeMode = false;
            }
            if window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow && memcmp(&g.WindowResizeBorderExpectedRect, &border_rect, cast(u64, sizeof(ImRect))) != 0 {
                g.WindowResizeRelativeMode = true;
            }
            ImVec2 border_curr = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.Pos, op_mul_ImVec2_ImVec2(ImMin(def.SegmentN1, def.SegmentN2), window.Size));
            f32 border_target_rel_mode_for_axis = cast(f32*, &border_curr)[axis] + cast(f32*, &g.IO.MouseDelta)[axis];
            f32 border_target_abs_mode_for_axis = cast(f32*, &g.IO.MousePos)[axis] - cast(f32*, &g.ActiveIdClickOffset)[axis] + g.WindowsBorderHoverPadding;
            ImVec2 border_target = window.Pos;
            cast(f32*, &border_target)[axis] = border_target_abs_mode_for_axis;
            bool ignore_resize = false;
            if g.WindowResizeRelativeMode != 0 {
                cast(f32*, &border_target)[axis] = border_target_rel_mode_for_axis;
                if cast(f32*, &g.IO.MouseDelta)[axis] == 0.0f || cast(f32*, &g.IO.MouseDelta)[axis] > 0.0f == border_target_rel_mode_for_axis > border_target_abs_mode_for_axis {
                    ignore_resize = true;
                }
            }
            ImVec2 clamp_min;
            ImVec2_init(&clamp_min, border_n == ImGuiDir_Right ? clamp_rect.Min.x : cast(f32, -FLT_MAX), border_n == ImGuiDir_Down || border_n == ImGuiDir_Up && window_move_from_title_bar ? clamp_rect.Min.y : cast(f32, -FLT_MAX));
            ImVec2 clamp_max;
            ImVec2_init(&clamp_max, border_n == ImGuiDir_Left ? clamp_rect.Max.x : FLT_MAX, border_n == ImGuiDir_Up ? clamp_rect.Max.y : FLT_MAX);
            border_target = ImClamp(border_target, clamp_min, clamp_max);
            if ignore_resize == 0 {
                CalcResizePosSizeFromAnyCorner(window, border_target, ImMin(def.SegmentN1, def.SegmentN2), &pos_target, &size_target);
            }
        }
        if hovered != 0 {
            *border_hovered = border_n;
        }
        if held != 0 {
            *border_held = border_n;
        }
    }
    ImGui_PopID();
    window.DC.NavLayerCurrent = ImGuiNavLayer_Main;
    if g.NavWindowingTarget && g.NavWindowingTarget.RootWindowDockTree == window {
        ImVec2 nav_resize_dir;
        if g.NavInputSource == ImGuiInputSource_Keyboard && g.IO.KeyShift {
            nav_resize_dir = ImGui_GetKeyMagnitude2d(ImGuiKey_LeftArrow, ImGuiKey_RightArrow, ImGuiKey_UpArrow, ImGuiKey_DownArrow);
        }
        if g.NavInputSource == ImGuiInputSource_Gamepad {
            nav_resize_dir = ImGui_GetKeyMagnitude2d(ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadLeft, ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadRight, ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadUp, ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadDown);
        }
        if nav_resize_dir.x != 0.0f || nav_resize_dir.y != 0.0f {
            f32 NAV_RESIZE_SPEED = 600.0f;
            f32 resize_step = NAV_RESIZE_SPEED * g.IO.DeltaTime * ImGui_GetScale();
            g.NavWindowingAccumDeltaSize = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(g.NavWindowingAccumDeltaSize, op_mul_ImVec2_float(nav_resize_dir, resize_step));
            g.NavWindowingAccumDeltaSize = ImMax(g.NavWindowingAccumDeltaSize, op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(clamp_rect.Min, window.Pos), window.Size));
            g.NavWindowingToggleLayer = false;
            g.NavHighlightItemUnderNav = true;
            resize_grip_col[0] = ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_ResizeGripActive);
            ImVec2 accum_floored = ImTrunc(g.NavWindowingAccumDeltaSize);
            if accum_floored.x != 0.0f || accum_floored.y != 0.0f {
                size_target = CalcWindowSizeAfterConstraint(window, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.SizeFull, accum_floored));
                g.NavWindowingAccumDeltaSize = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(g.NavWindowingAccumDeltaSize, accum_floored);
            }
        }
    }
    ImVec2 old_pos = window.Pos;
    ImVec2 old_size = window.SizeFull;
    if size_target.x != FLT_MAX && (window.Size.x != size_target.x || window.SizeFull.x != size_target.x) {
        window.SizeFull.x = size_target.x;
        window.Size.x = window.SizeFull.x;
    }
    if size_target.y != FLT_MAX && (window.Size.y != size_target.y || window.SizeFull.y != size_target.y) {
        window.SizeFull.y = size_target.y;
        window.Size.y = window.SizeFull.y;
    }
    if pos_target.x != FLT_MAX && window.Pos.x != ImTrunc(pos_target.x) {
        window.Pos.x = ImTrunc(pos_target.x);
    }
    if pos_target.y != FLT_MAX && window.Pos.y != ImTrunc(pos_target.y) {
        window.Pos.y = ImTrunc(pos_target.y);
    }
    if old_pos.x != window.Pos.x || old_pos.y != window.Pos.y || old_size.x != window.SizeFull.x || old_size.y != window.SizeFull.y {
        ImGui_MarkIniSettingsDirty(window);
    }
    if *border_held != -1 {
        g.WindowResizeBorderExpectedRect = GetResizeBorderRect(window, *border_held, grip_hover_inner_size, g.WindowsBorderHoverPadding);
    }
    return ret_auto_fit_mask;
}

    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
