    bool has_close_button = p_open != null;
    bool has_collapse_button = !(flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoCollapse) && style.WindowMenuButtonPosition != ImGuiDir_None;
    ImGuiItemFlags item_flags_backup = g.CurrentItemFlags;
    g.CurrentItemFlags |= ImGuiItemFlags_NoNavDefaultFocus;
    window.DC.NavLayerCurrent = ImGuiNavLayer_Menu;
    f32 pad_l = style.FramePadding.x;
    f32 pad_r = style.FramePadding.x;
    f32 button_sz = g.FontSize;
    ImVec2 close_button_pos;
    ImVec2 collapse_button_pos;
    if has_close_button != 0 {
        close_button_pos = ImVec2{
            title_bar_rect.Max.x - pad_r - button_sz, title_bar_rect.Min.y + style.FramePadding.y,
        };
        pad_r += button_sz + style.ItemInnerSpacing.x;
    }
    if has_collapse_button && style.WindowMenuButtonPosition == ImGuiDir_Right {
        collapse_button_pos = ImVec2{
            title_bar_rect.Max.x - pad_r - button_sz, title_bar_rect.Min.y + style.FramePadding.y,
        };
        pad_r += button_sz + style.ItemInnerSpacing.x;
    }
    if has_collapse_button && style.WindowMenuButtonPosition == ImGuiDir_Left {
        collapse_button_pos = ImVec2{
            title_bar_rect.Min.x + pad_l, title_bar_rect.Min.y + style.FramePadding.y,
        };
        pad_l += button_sz + style.ItemInnerSpacing.x;
    }
    if has_collapse_button != 0 {
        if ImGui_CollapseButton(ImGuiWindow_GetID(window, "#COLLAPSE", null), collapse_button_pos, null) != 0 {
            window.WantCollapseToggle = true;
        }
    }
    if has_close_button != 0 {
        ImGuiItemFlags backup_item_flags = g.CurrentItemFlags;
        g.CurrentItemFlags |= ImGuiItemFlags_NoFocus;
        if ImGui_CloseButton(ImGuiWindow_GetID(window, "#CLOSE", null), close_button_pos) != 0 {
            *p_open = false;
        }
        g.CurrentItemFlags = backup_item_flags;
    }
    window.DC.NavLayerCurrent = ImGuiNavLayer_Main;
    g.CurrentItemFlags = item_flags_backup;
    f32 marker_size_x = (flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_UnsavedDocument) != 0 ? button_sz * 0.8f : 0.0f;
    ImVec2 text_size = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(ImGui_CalcTextSize(name, null, true), ImVec2{marker_size_x, 0.0f});
    if pad_l > style.FramePadding.x {
        pad_l += g.Style.ItemInnerSpacing.x;
    }
    if pad_r > style.FramePadding.x {
        pad_r += g.Style.ItemInnerSpacing.x;
    }
    if style.WindowTitleAlign.x > 0.0f && style.WindowTitleAlign.x < 1.0f {
        f32 centerness = ImSaturate(1.0f - fabs(style.WindowTitleAlign.x - 0.5f) * 2.0f);
        f32 pad_extend = ImMin(ImMax(pad_l, pad_r), ImRect_GetWidth(&title_bar_rect) - pad_l - pad_r - text_size.x);
        pad_l = ImMax(pad_l, pad_extend * centerness);
        pad_r = ImMax(pad_r, pad_extend * centerness);
    }
    ImRect layout_r;
    ImRect_init(&layout_r, title_bar_rect.Min.x + pad_l, title_bar_rect.Min.y, title_bar_rect.Max.x - pad_r, title_bar_rect.Max.y);
    ImRect clip_r;
    ImRect_init(&clip_r, layout_r.Min.x, layout_r.Min.y, ImMin(layout_r.Max.x + g.Style.ItemInnerSpacing.x, title_bar_rect.Max.x), layout_r.Max.y);
    if (flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_UnsavedDocument) != 0 {
        ImVec2 marker_pos;
        marker_pos.x = ImClamp(layout_r.Min.x + (ImRect_GetWidth(&layout_r) - text_size.x) * style.WindowTitleAlign.x + text_size.x, layout_r.Min.x, layout_r.Max.x);
        marker_pos.y = (layout_r.Min.y + layout_r.Max.y) * 0.5f;
        if marker_pos.x > layout_r.Min.x {
            ImGui_RenderBullet(window.DrawList, marker_pos, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_UnsavedMarker));
            clip_r.Max.x = ImMin(clip_r.Max.x, marker_pos.x - cast(f32, cast(i32, marker_size_x * 0.5f)));
        }
    }
    ImGui_RenderTextClipped(layout_r.Min, layout_r.Max, name, null, &text_size, style.WindowTitleAlign, &clip_r);
}

void ImGui_UpdateWindowParentAndRootLinks(ImGuiWindow* window, ImGuiWindowFlags flags, ImGuiWindow* parent_window) {

// Push a new Dear ImGui window to add widgets to.
// - A default window called "Debug" is automatically stacked at the beginning of every frame so you can use widgets without explicitly calling a Begin/End pair.
// - Begin/End can be called multiple times during the frame with the same window name to append content.
// - The window name is used as a unique identifier to preserve window information across frames (and save rudimentary information to the .ini file).
//   You can use the "##" or "###" markers to use the same label with different id, or same id with different label. See documentation at the top of this file.
// - Return false when window is collapsed, so you can early out in your code. You always need to call ImGui::End() even if false is returned.
// - Passing 'bool* p_open' displays a Close button on the upper-right corner of the window, the pointed value will be set to false when the button is pressed.
bool ImGui_Begin(u8* name, bool* p_open, ImGuiWindowFlags flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiStyle style = g.Style;
    assert(name != null && name[0] != 0);
    assert(cast(i64, g.WithinFrameScope));
    assert(g.FrameCountEnded != g.FrameCount);
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_FindWindowByName(name);
    bool window_just_created = window == null;
    if window_just_created != 0 {
        window = CreateNewWindow(name, flags);
    }
    if g.DebugBreakInWindow == window.ID {
        assert(0);
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoInputs) == ImGuiWindowFlags_NoInputs {
        flags |= ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoResize;
    }
    i32 current_frame = g.FrameCount;
    bool first_begin_of_the_frame = window.LastFrameActive != current_frame;
    window.IsFallbackWindow = g.CurrentWindowStack.Size == 0 && g.WithinFrameScopeWithImplicitWindow;
    bool window_just_activated_by_user = window.LastFrameActive < current_frame - 1;
    if (flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup) != 0 {
        ImGuiPopupData* popup_ref = &g.OpenPopupStack.Data[g.BeginPopupStack.Size];
        window_just_activated_by_user |= window.PopupId != popup_ref.PopupId;
        window_just_activated_by_user |= window != popup_ref.Window;
    }
    bool window_was_appearing = window.Appearing;
    if first_begin_of_the_frame != 0 {
        ImGui_UpdateWindowInFocusOrderList(window, window_just_created, flags);
        window.Appearing = window_just_activated_by_user;
        if window.Appearing != 0 {
            SetWindowConditionAllowFlags(window, ImGuiCond_Appearing, true);
        }
        window.FlagsPreviousFrame = window.Flags;
        window.Flags = cast(ImGuiWindowFlags, flags);
        window.ChildFlags = (g.NextWindowData.HasFlags & ImGuiNextWindowDataFlags_HasChildFlags) != 0 ? g.NextWindowData.ChildFlags : 0;
        window.LastFrameActive = current_frame;
        window.LastTimeActive = cast(f32, g.Time);
        window.BeginOrderWithinParent = 0;
        window.BeginOrderWithinContext = cast(i16, g.WindowsActiveCount++);
    } else {
        flags = window.Flags;
    }
    assert(window.DockNode == null || window.DockNodeAsHost == null);
    if (g.NextWindowData.HasFlags & ImGuiNextWindowDataFlags_HasDock) != 0 {

void ImGui_End() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    if g.CurrentWindowStack.Size <= 1 && g.WithinFrameScopeWithImplicitWindow {
        while true {
            if g.CurrentWindowStack.Size > 1 == 0 {
                if ImGui_ErrorLog("Calling End() too many times!") != 0 {
                    assert(g.CurrentWindowStack.Size > 1 && "Calling End() too many times!");
                }
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
        return;
    }
    ImGuiWindowStackData* window_stack_data = ImVector_ImGuiWindowStackData_back(&g.CurrentWindowStack);
    if (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup) != 0 {
        while true {
            if g.WithinEndPopupID == window.ID == 0 {
                if ImGui_ErrorLog("Must call EndPopup() and not End()!") != 0 {
                    assert(g.WithinEndPopupID == window.ID && "Must call EndPopup() and not End()!");
                }
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
    }
    if window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow && !(window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_DockNodeHost) && !window.DockIsActive {
        while true {
            if g.WithinEndChildID == window.ID == 0 {
                if ImGui_ErrorLog("Must call EndChild() and not End()!") != 0 {
                    assert(g.WithinEndChildID == window.ID && "Must call EndChild() and not End()!");
                }
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
    }
    if window.DC.CurrentColumns != null {
        ImGui_EndColumns();
    }
    if !(window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_DockNodeHost) && !window.SkipRefresh {
        ImGui_PopClipRect();
    }
    ImGui_PopFocusScope();
    if window_stack_data.DisabledOverrideReenable && window.RootWindow == window {
        ImGui_EndDisabledOverrideReenable();
    }
    if window.SkipRefresh != 0 {
        assert(window.DrawList == null);
        window.DrawList = &window.DrawListInst;
    }
    if g.LogWindow == window {
        ImGui_LogFinish();
    }
    if window.DC.IsSetPos != 0 {
        ImGui_ErrorCheckUsingSetCursorPosToExtendParentBoundaries();
    }
    if window.DockNode && window.DockTabIsVisible {
        ImGuiWindow* host_window = window.DockNode.HostWindow;
        if host_window != null {
            host_window.DC.CursorMaxPos = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.DC.CursorMaxPos, window.WindowPadding), host_window.WindowPadding);
        }
    }
    g.LastItemData = window_stack_data.ParentLastItemDataBackup;
    if (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildMenu) != 0 {
        g.BeginMenuDepth--;
    }
    if (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup) != 0 {
        ImVector_ImGuiPopupData_pop_back(&g.BeginPopupStack);
    }
    if g.IO.ConfigErrorRecovery != 0 {
        ImGui_ErrorRecoveryTryToRecoverWindowState(&window_stack_data.StackSizesInBegin);
    }
    ImVector_ImGuiWindowStackData_pop_back(&g.CurrentWindowStack);
    SetCurrentWindow(g.CurrentWindowStack.Size == 0 ? null : ImVector_ImGuiWindowStackData_back(&g.CurrentWindowStack).Window);
    if g.CurrentWindow != null {
        ImGui_SetCurrentViewport(g.CurrentWindow, g.CurrentWindow.Viewport);
    }
}

// BeginDisabled()/EndDisabled()
// - Those can be nested but it cannot be used to enable an already disabled section (a single BeginDisabled(true) in the stack is enough to keep everything disabled)
// - Visually this is currently altering alpha, but it is expected that in a future styling system this would work differently.
// - Feedback welcome at https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/issues/211
// - BeginDisabled(false)/EndDisabled() essentially does nothing but is provided to facilitate use of boolean expressions.
//   (as a micro-optimization: if you have tens of thousands of BeginDisabled(false)/EndDisabled() pairs, you might want to reformulate your code to avoid making those calls)
// - Note: mixing up BeginDisabled() and PushItemFlag(ImGuiItemFlags_Disabled) is currently NOT SUPPORTED.
void ImGui_BeginDisabled(bool disabled) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    bool was_disabled = (g.CurrentItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_Disabled) != 0;
    if !was_disabled && disabled {
        g.DisabledAlphaBackup = g.Style.Alpha;
        g.Style.Alpha *= g.Style.DisabledAlpha;
    }
    if was_disabled || disabled {
        g.CurrentItemFlags |= ImGuiItemFlags_Disabled;
    }
    ImVector_ImGuiItemFlags_push_back(&g.ItemFlagsStack, g.CurrentItemFlags);
    g.DisabledStackSize++;
}

void ImGui_EndDisabled() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    while true {
        if g.DisabledStackSize > 0 == 0 {
            if ImGui_ErrorLog("Calling EndDisabled() too many times!") != 0 {
                assert(g.DisabledStackSize > 0 && "Calling EndDisabled() too many times!");
            }
            return;
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    g.DisabledStackSize--;
    bool was_disabled = (g.CurrentItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_Disabled) != 0;
    ImVector_ImGuiItemFlags_pop_back(&g.ItemFlagsStack);
    g.CurrentItemFlags = *ImVector_ImGuiItemFlags_back(&g.ItemFlagsStack);
    if was_disabled && (g.CurrentItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_Disabled) == 0 {
        g.Style.Alpha = g.DisabledAlphaBackup;
    }
}

// Could have been called BeginDisabledDisable() but it didn't want to be award nominated for most awkward function name.
// Ideally we would use a shared e.g. BeginDisabled()->BeginDisabledEx() but earlier needs to be optimal.
// The whole code for this is awkward, will reevaluate if we find a way to implement SetNextItemDisabled().
void ImGui_BeginDisabledOverrideReenable() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(g.CurrentItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_Disabled);
    ImVector_ImGuiWindowStackData_back(&g.CurrentWindowStack).DisabledOverrideReenableAlphaBackup = g.Style.Alpha;
    g.Style.Alpha = g.DisabledAlphaBackup;
    g.CurrentItemFlags &= ~ImGuiItemFlags_Disabled;
    ImVector_ImGuiItemFlags_push_back(&g.ItemFlagsStack, g.CurrentItemFlags);
    g.DisabledStackSize++;
}

void ImGui_EndDisabledOverrideReenable() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(g.DisabledStackSize > 0);
    g.DisabledStackSize--;
    ImVector_ImGuiItemFlags_pop_back(&g.ItemFlagsStack);
    g.CurrentItemFlags = *ImVector_ImGuiItemFlags_back(&g.ItemFlagsStack);
    g.Style.Alpha = ImVector_ImGuiWindowStackData_back(&g.CurrentWindowStack).DisabledOverrideReenableAlphaBackup;
}

    while last_window != window {
        last_window = window;
        window = window.RootWindow;
        if popup_hierarchy != 0 {
            window = window.RootWindowPopupTree;
        }
        if dock_hierarchy != 0 {
            window = window.RootWindowDockTree;
        }
    }
    return window;
}
}

bool ImGui_IsWindowChildOf(ImGuiWindow* window, ImGuiWindow* potential_parent, bool popup_hierarchy, bool dock_hierarchy) {
    ImGuiWindow* window_root = GetCombinedRootWindow(window, popup_hierarchy, dock_hierarchy);
    if window_root == potential_parent {
        return true;
    }
    while window != null {
        if window == potential_parent {
            return true;
        }
        if window == window_root {
            return false;
        }
        window = window.ParentWindow;
    }
    return false;
}

bool ImGui_IsWindowWithinBeginStackOf(ImGuiWindow* window, ImGuiWindow* potential_parent) {

bool ImGui_IsWindowAbove(ImGuiWindow* potential_above, ImGuiWindow* potential_below) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    i32 display_layer_delta = GetWindowDisplayLayer(potential_above) - GetWindowDisplayLayer(potential_below);
    if display_layer_delta != 0 {

// Is current window hovered and hoverable (e.g. not blocked by a popup/modal)? See ImGuiHoveredFlags_ for options.
// IMPORTANT: If you are trying to check whether your mouse should be dispatched to Dear ImGui or to your underlying app,
// you should not use this function! Use the 'io.WantCaptureMouse' boolean for that!
// Refer to FAQ entry "How can I tell whether to dispatch mouse/keyboard to Dear ImGui or my application?" for details.
bool ImGui_IsWindowHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    while true {
        if (flags & ~ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowedMaskForIsWindowHovered) == 0 == 0 {
            if ImGui_ErrorLog("Invalid flags for IsWindowHovered()!") != 0 {
                assert((flags & ~ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowedMaskForIsWindowHovered) == 0 && "Invalid flags for IsWindowHovered()!");
            }
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    ImGuiWindow* ref_window = g.HoveredWindow;
    ImGuiWindow* cur_window = g.CurrentWindow;
    if ref_window == null {
        return false;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiHoveredFlags_AnyWindow) == 0 {
        assert(cast(i64, cur_window));
        bool popup_hierarchy = (flags & ImGuiHoveredFlags_NoPopupHierarchy) == 0;
        bool dock_hierarchy = (flags & ImGuiHoveredFlags_DockHierarchy) != 0;
        if (flags & ImGuiHoveredFlags_RootWindow) != 0 {
            cur_window = GetCombinedRootWindow(cur_window, popup_hierarchy, dock_hierarchy);
        }
        bool result;
        if (flags & ImGuiHoveredFlags_ChildWindows) != 0 {
            result = ImGui_IsWindowChildOf(ref_window, cur_window, popup_hierarchy, dock_hierarchy);
        } else {
            result = ref_window == cur_window;
        }
        if result == 0 {
            return false;
        }
    }
    if ImGui_IsWindowContentHoverable(ref_window, flags) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenBlockedByActiveItem) == 0 {
        if g.ActiveId != 0 && !g.ActiveIdAllowOverlap && g.ActiveId != ref_window.MoveId {
            return false;
        }
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiHoveredFlags_ForTooltip) != 0 {
        flags = ApplyHoverFlagsForTooltip(flags, g.Style.HoverFlagsForTooltipMouse);
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiHoveredFlags_Stationary) != 0 && g.HoverWindowUnlockedStationaryId != ref_window.ID {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

// Use ImDrawList::_SetTexture(), making our shared g.FontStack[] authoritative against window-local ImDrawList.
// - Whereas ImDrawList::PushTexture()/PopTexture() is not to be used across Begin() calls.
// - Note that we don't propagate current texture id when e.g. Begin()-ing into a new window, we never really did...
//   - Some code paths never really fully worked with multiple atlas textures.
//   - The right-ish solution may be to remove _SetTexture() and make AddText/RenderText lazily call PushTexture()/PopTexture()
//     the same way AddImage() does, but then all other primitives would also need to? I don't think we should tackle this problem
//     because we have a concrete need and a test bed for multiple atlas textures.
// FIXME-NEWATLAS-V2: perhaps we can now leverage ImFontAtlasUpdateDrawListsTextures() ?
void ImGui_SetCurrentFont(ImFont* font, f32 font_size_before_scaling, f32 font_size_after_scaling) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    g.Font = font;
    g.FontSizeBase = font_size_before_scaling;
    ImGui_UpdateCurrentFontSize(font_size_after_scaling);
    if font != null {
        assert(font && ImFont_IsLoaded(font));
        ImFontAtlas* atlas = font.OwnerAtlas;
        g.DrawListSharedData.FontAtlas = atlas;
        g.DrawListSharedData.Font = font;
        ImFontAtlasUpdateDrawListsSharedData(atlas);
        if g.CurrentWindow != null {
            ImDrawList__SetTexture(g.CurrentWindow.DrawList, atlas.TexRef);
        }
    }
}

void ImGui_UpdateCurrentFontSize(f32 restore_font_size_after_scaling) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    g.Style.FontSizeBase = g.FontSizeBase;
    f32 final_size = restore_font_size_after_scaling > 0.0f ? restore_font_size_after_scaling : 0.0f;
    if final_size == 0.0f {
        final_size = g.FontSizeBase;
        final_size *= g.Style.FontScaleMain;
        final_size *= g.Style.FontScaleDpi;
        if window != null {
            final_size *= window.FontWindowScale;
        }
    }
    final_size = ImGui_GetRoundedFontSize(final_size);
    final_size = ImClamp(final_size, 1.0f, 512.0f);
    if g.Font != null && g.IO.BackendFlags & ImGuiBackendFlags_RendererHasTextures {
        g.Font.CurrentRasterizerDensity = g.FontRasterizerDensity;
    }
    g.FontSize = final_size;
    g.DrawListSharedData.FontSize = g.FontSize;
    if window != null && window.SkipItems {
        ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
        bool allow_early_out = table == null || table.CurrentColumn != -1 && table.Columns.Data[table.CurrentColumn].IsSkipItems == false;
        if allow_early_out != 0 {
            return;
        }
    }
    g.FontBaked = g.Font != null && window != null ? ImFont_GetFontBaked(g.Font, final_size, -1.0f) : null;
    g.FontBakedScale = g.FontBaked != null ? g.FontSize / g.FontBaked.Size : 0.0f;
    g.DrawListSharedData.FontScale = g.FontBakedScale;
}

// Exposed in case user may want to override setting density.

void ImGui_PushFont(ImFont* font, f32 font_size_base) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if font == null {
        font = g.Font;

    assert(font != null);

    ImVector_ImFontStackData_push_back(&g.FontStack, ImFontStackData{g.Font, g.FontSizeBase, g.FontSize});

void ImGui_PopFont() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    while true {
        if g.FontStack.Size > 0 == 0 {
            if ImGui_ErrorLog("Calling PopFont() too many times!") != 0 {
                assert(g.FontStack.Size > 0 && "Calling PopFont() too many times!");

            return;
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    ImFontStackData* font_stack_data = ImVector_ImFontStackData_back(&g.FontStack);
    ImGui_SetCurrentFont(font_stack_data.Font, font_stack_data.FontSizeBeforeScaling, font_stack_data.FontSizeAfterScaling);
    ImVector_ImFontStackData_pop_back(&g.FontStack);
}

// t0 = previous time (e.g.: g.Time - g.IO.DeltaTime)
// t1 = current time (e.g.: g.Time)
// An event is triggered at:
//  t = 0.0f     t = repeat_delay,    t = repeat_delay + repeat_rate*N
i32 ImGui_CalcTypematicRepeatAmount(f32 t0, f32 t1, f32 repeat_delay, f32 repeat_rate) {
    if t1 == 0.0f {
        return 1;
    }
    if t0 >= t1 {
        return 0;
    }
    if repeat_rate <= 0.0f {
        return t0 < repeat_delay && t1 >= repeat_delay;
    }
    i32 count_t0 = t0 < repeat_delay ? -1 : cast(i32, (t0 - repeat_delay) / repeat_rate);
    i32 count_t1 = t1 < repeat_delay ? -1 : cast(i32, (t1 - repeat_delay) / repeat_rate);
    i32 count = count_t1 - count_t0;
    return count;
}

void ImGui_GetTypematicRepeatRate(ImGuiInputFlags flags, f32* repeat_delay, f32* repeat_rate) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    switch flags & ImGuiInputFlags_RepeatRateMask_ {
        case ImGuiInputFlags_RepeatRateNavMove: {
            *repeat_delay = g.IO.KeyRepeatDelay * 0.72f;
            *repeat_rate = g.IO.KeyRepeatRate * 0.8f;
            return;
        }
        case ImGuiInputFlags_RepeatRateNavTweak: {
            *repeat_delay = g.IO.KeyRepeatDelay * 0.72f;
            *repeat_rate = g.IO.KeyRepeatRate * 0.3f;
            return;
        }
        case ImGuiInputFlags_RepeatRateDefault: {
            fallthrough;
        }
        default: {
            *repeat_delay = g.IO.KeyRepeatDelay * 1.0f;
            *repeat_rate = g.IO.KeyRepeatRate * 1.0f;
            return;
        }
    }
}

// Return value representing the number of presses in the last time period, for the given repeat rate
// (most often returns 0 or 1. The result is generally only >1 when RepeatRate is smaller than DeltaTime, aka large DeltaTime or fast RepeatRate)
i32 ImGui_GetKeyPressedAmount(ImGuiKey key, f32 repeat_delay, f32 repeat_rate) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiKeyData* key_data = ImGui_GetKeyData(key);
    if key_data.Down == 0 {
        return 0;
    }
    f32 t = key_data.DownDuration;
    return ImGui_CalcTypematicRepeatAmount(t - g.IO.DeltaTime, t, repeat_delay, repeat_rate);
}

// Return 2D vector representing the combination of four cardinal direction, with analog value support (for e.g. ImGuiKey_GamepadLStick* values).
ImVec2 ImGui_GetKeyMagnitude2d(ImGuiKey key_left, ImGuiKey key_right, ImGuiKey key_up, ImGuiKey key_down) {
    return ImVec2{
        ImGui_GetKeyData(key_right).AnalogValue - ImGui_GetKeyData(key_left).AnalogValue,
        ImGui_GetKeyData(key_down).AnalogValue - ImGui_GetKeyData(key_up).AnalogValue,
    };
}

// Rewrite routing data buffers to strip old entries + sort by key to make queries not touch scattered data.
//   Entries   D,A,B,B,A,C,B     --> A,A,B,B,B,C,D
//   Index     A:1 B:2 C:5 D:0   --> A:0 B:2 C:5 D:6
// See 'Metrics->Key Owners & Shortcut Routing' to visualize the result of that operation.
private {
void ImGui_UpdateKeyRoutingTable(ImGuiKeyRoutingTable* rt) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImVector_ImGuiKeyRoutingData_resize(&rt.EntriesNext, 0);
    for ImGuiKey key = ImGuiKey_NamedKey_BEGIN; key < ImGuiKey_NamedKey_END; key = cast(ImGuiKey, key + 1) {
        i32 new_routing_start_idx = rt.EntriesNext.Size;
        ImGuiKeyRoutingData* routing_entry;
        for i32 old_routing_idx = rt.Index[key - ImGuiKey_NamedKey_BEGIN]; old_routing_idx != -1; old_routing_idx = routing_entry.NextEntryIndex {
            routing_entry = &rt.Entries.Data[old_routing_idx];
            routing_entry.RoutingCurrScore = routing_entry.RoutingNextScore;
            routing_entry.RoutingCurr = routing_entry.RoutingNext;
            routing_entry.RoutingNext = cast(ImGuiID, -1);
            routing_entry.RoutingNextScore = 0;
            if routing_entry.RoutingCurr == cast(ImGuiID, -1) {
                continue;
            }
            ImVector_ImGuiKeyRoutingData_push_back(&rt.EntriesNext, *routing_entry);
            if cast(i32, routing_entry.Mods) == g.IO.KeyMods {
                ImGuiKeyOwnerData* owner_data = ImGui_GetKeyOwnerData(g, key);
                if owner_data.OwnerCurr == cast(ImGuiID, -1) {
                    owner_data.OwnerCurr = routing_entry.RoutingCurr;
                }
            }
        }
        rt.Index[key - ImGuiKey_NamedKey_BEGIN] = cast(ImGuiKeyRoutingIndex, new_routing_start_idx < rt.EntriesNext.Size ? new_routing_start_idx : -1);
        for i32 n = new_routing_start_idx; n < rt.EntriesNext.Size; n++ {
            rt.EntriesNext.Data[n].NextEntryIndex = cast(ImGuiKeyRoutingIndex, n + 1 < rt.EntriesNext.Size ? n + 1 : -1);
        }
    }
    ImVector_ImGuiKeyRoutingData_swap(&rt.Entries, &rt.EntriesNext);
}

// owner_id may be None/Any, but routing_id needs to be always be set, so we default to GetCurrentFocusScope().
ImGuiID GetRoutingIdFromOwnerId(ImGuiID owner_id) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    return owner_id != cast(ImGuiID, -1) && owner_id != cast(ImGuiID, 0) ? owner_id : g.CurrentFocusScopeId;
}
}

ImGuiKeyRoutingData* ImGui_GetShortcutRoutingData(ImGuiKeyChord key_chord) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiKeyRoutingTable* rt = &g.KeysRoutingTable;
    ImGuiKeyRoutingData* routing_data;
    var key = cast(ImGuiKey, key_chord & ~ImGuiMod_Mask_);
    var mods = cast(ImGuiKey, key_chord & ImGuiMod_Mask_);
    if key == ImGuiKey_None {
        key = ImGui_ConvertSingleModFlagToKey(mods);
    }
    assert(cast(i64, ImGui_IsNamedKey(key)));
    for ImGuiKeyRoutingIndex idx = rt.Index[key - ImGuiKey_NamedKey_BEGIN]; idx != -1; idx = routing_data.NextEntryIndex {
        routing_data = &rt.Entries.Data[idx];
        if cast(i32, routing_data.Mods) == mods {
            return routing_data;
        }
    }
    var routing_data_idx = cast(ImGuiKeyRoutingIndex, rt.Entries.Size);
    ImVector_ImGuiKeyRoutingData_push_back(&rt.Entries, __cxx_make_ImGuiKeyRoutingData());
    routing_data = &rt.Entries.Data[routing_data_idx];
    routing_data.Mods = cast(ImU16, mods);
    routing_data.NextEntryIndex = rt.Index[key - ImGuiKey_NamedKey_BEGIN];
    rt.Index[key - ImGuiKey_NamedKey_BEGIN] = routing_data_idx;
    return routing_data;
}

// Current score encoding
//  -        0: Never route
//  -        1: ImGuiInputFlags_RouteGlobal    (lower priority)
//  - 100..199: ImGuiInputFlags_RouteFocused   (if window in focus-stack)
//         200: ImGuiInputFlags_RouteGlobal  | ImGuiInputFlags_RouteOverFocused
//         300: ImGuiInputFlags_RouteActive or ImGuiInputFlags_RouteFocused (if item active)
//         400: ImGuiInputFlags_RouteGlobal  | ImGuiInputFlags_RouteOverActive
//  - 500..599: ImGuiInputFlags_RouteFocused | ImGuiInputFlags_RouteOverActive (if window in focus-stack) (higher priority)
// 'flags' should include an explicit routing policy
private {
i32 CalcRoutingScore(ImGuiID focus_scope_id, ImGuiID owner_id, ImGuiInputFlags flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if (flags & ImGuiInputFlags_RouteFocused) != 0 {
        if owner_id != 0 && g.ActiveId == owner_id {
            return 300;
        }
        if focus_scope_id == 0 {
            return 0;
        }
        for i32 index_in_focus_path = 0; index_in_focus_path < g.NavFocusRoute.Size; index_in_focus_path++ {
            if g.NavFocusRoute.Data[index_in_focus_path].ID == focus_scope_id {
                if (flags & ImGuiInputFlags_RouteOverActive) != 0 {
                    return 599 - index_in_focus_path;
                } else {
                    return 199 - index_in_focus_path;
                }
            }
        }
        return 0;
    } else if (flags & ImGuiInputFlags_RouteActive) != 0 {
        if owner_id != 0 && g.ActiveId == owner_id {
            return 300;
        }
        return 0;
    } else if (flags & ImGuiInputFlags_RouteGlobal) != 0 {
        if (flags & ImGuiInputFlags_RouteOverActive) != 0 {
            return 400;
        }
        if owner_id != 0 && g.ActiveId == owner_id {
            return 300;
        }
        if (flags & ImGuiInputFlags_RouteOverFocused) != 0 {
            return 200;
        }
        return 1;
    }
    assert(0);
    return 0;
}

// - We need this to filter some Shortcut() routes when an item e.g. an InputText() is active
//   e.g. ImGuiKey_G won't be considered a shortcut when item is active, but ImGuiMod|ImGuiKey_G can be.
// - This is also used by UpdateInputEvents() to avoid trickling in the most common case of e.g. pressing ImGuiKey_G also emitting a G character.
bool IsKeyChordPotentiallyCharInput(ImGuiKeyChord key_chord) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    var mods = cast(ImGuiKey, key_chord & ImGuiMod_Mask_);
    bool ignore_char_inputs = mods & ImGuiMod_Ctrl && !(mods & ImGuiMod_Alt) || g.IO.ConfigMacOSXBehaviors && mods & ImGuiMod_Ctrl;
    if ignore_char_inputs != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    var key = cast(ImGuiKey, key_chord & ~ImGuiMod_Mask_);
    if key == ImGuiKey_None {
        return false;
    }
    ignore key; return false;
}
}

// Request a desired route for an input chord (key + mods).
// Return true if the route is available this frame.
// - Routes and key ownership are attributed at the beginning of next frame based on best score and mod state.
//   (Conceptually this does a "Submit for next frame" + "Test for current frame".
//   As such, it could be called TrySetXXX or SubmitXXX, or the Submit and Test operations should be separate.)
bool ImGui_SetShortcutRouting(ImGuiKeyChord key_chord, ImGuiInputFlags flags, ImGuiID owner_id) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if (flags & ImGuiInputFlags_RouteTypeMask_) == 0 {
        flags |= ImGuiInputFlags_RouteGlobal | ImGuiInputFlags_RouteOverFocused | ImGuiInputFlags_RouteOverActive;
    } else {
        assert(cast(i64, ImIsPowerOfTwo(flags & ImGuiInputFlags_RouteTypeMask_)));
    }
    assert(owner_id != cast(ImGuiID, 0) && owner_id != cast(ImGuiID, -1));
    if (flags & (ImGuiInputFlags_RouteOverFocused | ImGuiInputFlags_RouteUnlessBgFocused)) != 0 {
        assert(flags & ImGuiInputFlags_RouteGlobal);
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiInputFlags_RouteOverActive) != 0 {
        assert(flags & (ImGuiInputFlags_RouteGlobal | ImGuiInputFlags_RouteFocused));
    }
    key_chord = ImGui_FixupKeyChord(key_chord);
    if g.DebugBreakInShortcutRouting == key_chord {
        assert(0);
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiInputFlags_RouteUnlessBgFocused) != 0 {
        if g.NavWindow == null {
            return false;
        }
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiInputFlags_RouteAlways) != 0 {
        while true {
            if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventInputRouting) != 0 {
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
        return true;
    }
    if g.ActiveId != 0 && g.ActiveId != owner_id {
        if (flags & ImGuiInputFlags_RouteActive) != 0 {
            return false;
        }
        if g.IO.WantTextInput && IsKeyChordPotentiallyCharInput(key_chord) {
            while true {
                if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventInputRouting) != 0 {
                }
                if !(0 != 0) { break; }
            }
            return false;
        }
        if (flags & ImGuiInputFlags_RouteOverActive) == 0 && g.ActiveIdUsingAllKeyboardKeys {
            var key = cast(ImGuiKey, key_chord & ~ImGuiMod_Mask_);
            if key == ImGuiKey_None {
                key = ImGui_ConvertSingleModFlagToKey(cast(ImGuiKey, key_chord & ImGuiMod_Mask_));
            }
            if key >= ImGuiKey_NamedKey_BEGIN && key < ImGuiKey_GamepadStart {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    ImGuiID focus_scope_id = g.CurrentFocusScopeId;
    if (flags & ImGuiInputFlags_RouteFromRootWindow) != 0 {
        focus_scope_id = g.CurrentWindow.RootWindow.ID;
    }
    i32 score = CalcRoutingScore(focus_scope_id, owner_id, flags);
    while true {
        if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventInputRouting) != 0 {
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    if score == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiKeyRoutingData* routing_data = ImGui_GetShortcutRoutingData(key_chord);
    if score > cast(i32, routing_data.RoutingNextScore) {
        routing_data.RoutingNext = owner_id;
        routing_data.RoutingNextScore = cast(ImU16, score);
    }
    if routing_data.RoutingCurr == owner_id {
        while true {
            if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventInputRouting) != 0 {
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
    }
    return routing_data.RoutingCurr == owner_id;
}

// Currently unused by core (but used by tests)
// Note: this cannot be turned into GetShortcutRouting() because we do the owner_id->routing_id translation, name would be more misleading.
bool ImGui_TestShortcutRouting(ImGuiKeyChord key_chord, ImGuiID owner_id) {
    ImGuiID routing_id = GetRoutingIdFromOwnerId(owner_id);
    key_chord = ImGui_FixupKeyChord(key_chord);
    ImGuiKeyRoutingData* routing_data = ImGui_GetShortcutRoutingData(key_chord);
    return routing_data.RoutingCurr == routing_id;
}

// Important: unlike legacy IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey, bool repeat=true) which DEFAULT to repeat, this requires EXPLICIT repeat.
bool ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey key, ImGuiInputFlags flags, ImGuiID owner_id) {
    ImGuiKeyData* key_data = ImGui_GetKeyData(key);
    if key_data.Down == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    f32 t = key_data.DownDuration;
    if t < 0.0f {
        return false;
    }
    assert((flags & ~ImGuiInputFlags_SupportedByIsKeyPressed) == 0);
    if (flags & (ImGuiInputFlags_RepeatRateMask_ | ImGuiInputFlags_RepeatUntilMask_)) != 0 {
        flags |= ImGuiInputFlags_Repeat;
    }
    bool pressed = t == 0.0f;
    if !pressed && (flags & ImGuiInputFlags_Repeat) != 0 {
        f32 repeat_delay;
        f32 repeat_rate;
        ImGui_GetTypematicRepeatRate(flags, &repeat_delay, &repeat_rate);
        pressed = t > repeat_delay && ImGui_GetKeyPressedAmount(key, repeat_delay, repeat_rate) > 0;
        if pressed && flags & ImGuiInputFlags_RepeatUntilMask_ {
            ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
            f64 key_pressed_time = g.Time - t + 1.0e-5f;
            if flags & ImGuiInputFlags_RepeatUntilKeyModsChange && g.LastKeyModsChangeTime > key_pressed_time {
                pressed = false;
            }
            if flags & ImGuiInputFlags_RepeatUntilKeyModsChangeFromNone && g.LastKeyModsChangeFromNoneTime > key_pressed_time {
                pressed = false;
            }
            if flags & ImGuiInputFlags_RepeatUntilOtherKeyPress && g.LastKeyboardKeyPressTime > key_pressed_time {
                pressed = false;
            }
        }
    }
    if pressed == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    if ImGui_TestKeyOwner(key, owner_id) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

bool ImGui_IsKeyReleased(ImGuiKey key) {

bool ImGui_IsKeyReleased(ImGuiKey key, ImGuiID owner_id) {

        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

// Prefer higher-level helper GetItemClickedCountWithSingleClickDelay()
// Use if you absolutely need to distinguish single-click from double-click by introducing a delay.
// Generally use with 'delay >= io.MouseDoubleClickTime' + combined with a 'io.MouseClickedLastCount == 1' test.
// This is a very rarely used UI idiom, but some apps use this: e.g. MS Explorer single click on an icon to rename.
bool ImGui_IsMouseReleasedWithDelay(ImGuiMouseButton button, f32 delay) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(button >= 0 && button < cast(i32, sizeof(g.IO.MouseDown) / sizeof(*g.IO.MouseDown)));
    if ImGui_IsMouseDown(button) != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    if delay < 0.0f {
        delay = g.IO.MouseSingleClickDelay;
    }
    var time_since_release = cast(f32, g.Time - g.IO.MouseReleasedTime[button]);
    return time_since_release - g.IO.DeltaTime < delay && time_since_release >= delay;
}

bool ImGui_IsMouseDoubleClicked(ImGuiMouseButton button) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(button >= 0 && button < cast(i32, sizeof(g.IO.MouseDown) / sizeof(*g.IO.MouseDown)));
    return g.IO.MouseClickedCount[button] == 2 && ImGui_TestKeyOwner(ImGui_MouseButtonToKey(button), cast(ImGuiID, 0));
}

bool ImGui_IsMouseDoubleClicked(ImGuiMouseButton button, ImGuiID owner_id) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(button >= 0 && button < cast(i32, sizeof(g.IO.MouseDown) / sizeof(*g.IO.MouseDown)));
    return g.IO.MouseClickedCount[button] == 2 && ImGui_TestKeyOwner(ImGui_MouseButtonToKey(button), owner_id);

    return cast(i32, g.IO.MouseClickedCount[button]);

// FIXME: This is close to what BeginDragDropSource() is doing, maybe rework.
private {
ImGuiID LastItemOverlayButtonForNullId(ImGuiMouseButton mouse_button) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(g.LastItemData.ID == 0);
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    ImGuiID id = ImGuiWindow_GetIDFromRectangle(window, g.LastItemData.Rect);
    if g.IO.MouseClicked[mouse_button] && ImGui_ItemHoverable(g.LastItemData.Rect, id, g.LastItemData.ItemFlags) {
        ImGui_SetActiveID(id, window);
        ImGui_FocusWindow(window);
    } else if g.ActiveId == id {
        ImGui_KeepAliveID(id);
        if g.IO.MouseDown[mouse_button] == 0 {
            ImGui_ClearActiveID();
        }
    }
    return id;
}
}

// [BETA] Building block for disambiguation between single-click and double-click.
// - Returns 1 on single-click but delayed by io.MouseSingleClickDelay (which is always > io.MouseDoubleClickTime) after mouse release.
// - Returns 2+ on double-click and subsequent repeated clicks.
// In order use that to replicate Windows Explorer's "click on label to rename after a delay",
// When the function returns 1 for a delayed single click, you can add with further tests:
// - If you want to test that the mouse position AT THE TIME of the click (before the delay): you can use the 'io.MouseClickedPos[mouse_button]' position.
// - If you want to test that the mouse position is still over the item at the end of delay: you can use '&& IsItemHovered()'.
// - If you want to test that the item was selected or the sole selection AT THE TIME of the click (before the delay): you can test for 'g.LastActiveIdWasSelected' or 'g.LastActiveIdWasSoleSelected'.
// e.g.
//   int click_count = ImGui::GetItemClickedCountWithSingleClickDelay(mouse_button);
//   if (click_count == 1 && ImGui::GetCurrentContext()->LastActiveIdWasSoleSelected)
//       StartRename();
//   if (click_count == 2)
//       Launch();
i32 ImGui_GetItemClickedCountWithSingleClickDelay(ImGuiMouseButton mouse_button, f32 delay) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if g.IO.MouseClickedCount[mouse_button] >= 2 && ImGui_IsItemClicked(mouse_button) {
        return cast(i32, g.IO.MouseClickedCount[mouse_button]);
    }
    ImGuiID id = g.LastItemData.ID;
    if id == 0 {
        id = LastItemOverlayButtonForNullId(mouse_button);
    }
    if g.LastActiveId == id {
        if delay >= 0.0f {
            delay = ImMax(delay, g.IO.MouseDoubleClickTime + 0.01f);
        }
        if ImGui_IsMouseReleasedWithDelay(mouse_button, delay) && g.IO.MouseClickedLastCount[mouse_button] == 1 {
            return 1;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}

// Test if mouse cursor is hovering given rectangle
// NB- Rectangle is clipped by our current clip setting
// NB- Expand the rectangle to be generous on imprecise inputs systems (g.Style.TouchExtraPadding)
bool ImGui_IsMouseHoveringRect(ImVec2 r_min, ImVec2 r_max, bool clip) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImRect rect_clipped;
    ImRect_init(&rect_clipped, r_min, r_max);
    if clip != 0 {
        ImRect_ClipWith(&rect_clipped, g.CurrentWindow.ClipRect);
    }
    if ImRect_ContainsWithPad(&rect_clipped, g.IO.MousePos, g.Style.TouchExtraPadding) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    if ImRect_Overlaps(&ImGuiViewportP_GetMainRect(g.MouseViewport), rect_clipped) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

// Return if a mouse click/drag went past the given threshold. Valid to call during the MouseReleased frame.
// [Internal] This doesn't test if the button is pressed
bool ImGui_IsMouseDragPastThreshold(ImGuiMouseButton button, f32 lock_threshold) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(button >= 0 && button < cast(i32, sizeof(g.IO.MouseDown) / sizeof(*g.IO.MouseDown)));
    if lock_threshold < 0.0f {
        lock_threshold = g.IO.MouseDragThreshold;
    }
    return g.IO.MouseDragMaxDistanceSqr[button] >= lock_threshold * lock_threshold;
}

bool ImGui_IsMouseDragging(ImGuiMouseButton button, f32 lock_threshold) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(button >= 0 && button < cast(i32, sizeof(g.IO.MouseDown) / sizeof(*g.IO.MouseDown)));
    if g.IO.MouseDown[button] == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    return ImGui_IsMouseDragPastThreshold(button, lock_threshold);
}

// This is called TeleportMousePos() and not SetMousePos() to emphasis that setting MousePosPrev will effectively clear mouse delta as well.
// It is expected you only call this if (io.BackendFlags & ImGuiBackendFlags_HasSetMousePos) is set and supported by backend.
void ImGui_TeleportMousePos(ImVec2 pos) {

    g.IO.MousePos = g.IO.MousePosPrev;

// We typically use ImVec2(-FLT_MAX,-FLT_MAX) to denote an invalid mouse position.
bool ImGui_IsMousePosValid(ImVec2* mouse_pos) {
    assert(GImGui != null);
    f32 MOUSE_INVALID = -256000.0f;
    ImVec2 p = mouse_pos != null ? *mouse_pos : GImGui.IO.MousePos;
    return p.x >= MOUSE_INVALID && p.y >= MOUSE_INVALID;
}

// [WILL OBSOLETE] This was designed for backends, but prefer having backend maintain a mask of held mouse buttons, because upcoming input queue system will make this invalid.
bool ImGui_IsAnyMouseDown() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    for i32 n = 0; n < cast(i32, sizeof(g.IO.MouseDown) / sizeof(*g.IO.MouseDown)); n++ {
        if g.IO.MouseDown[n] != 0 {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

// Return the delta from the initial clicking position while the mouse button is clicked or was just released.
// This is locked and return 0.0f until the mouse moves past a distance threshold at least once.
// NB: This is only valid if IsMousePosValid(). backends in theory should always keep mouse position valid when dragging even outside the client window.
ImVec2 ImGui_GetMouseDragDelta(ImGuiMouseButton button, f32 lock_threshold) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(button >= 0 && button < cast(i32, sizeof(g.IO.MouseDown) / sizeof(*g.IO.MouseDown)));
    if lock_threshold < 0.0f {
        lock_threshold = g.IO.MouseDragThreshold;
    }
    if g.IO.MouseDown[button] || g.IO.MouseReleased[button] {
        if g.IO.MouseDragMaxDistanceSqr[button] >= lock_threshold * lock_threshold {
            if ImGui_IsMousePosValid(&g.IO.MousePos) && ImGui_IsMousePosValid(&g.IO.MouseClickedPos[button]) {
                return op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(g.IO.MousePos, g.IO.MouseClickedPos[button]);
            }
        }
    }
    return ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f};
}

void ImGui_ResetMouseDragDelta(ImGuiMouseButton button) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(button >= 0 && button < cast(i32, sizeof(g.IO.MouseDown) / sizeof(*g.IO.MouseDown)));
    g.IO.MouseClickedPos[button] = g.IO.MousePos;
}

// Get desired mouse cursor shape.
// Important: this is meant to be used by a platform backend, it is reset in ImGui::NewFrame(),
// updated during the frame, and locked in EndFrame()/Render().
// If you use software rendering by setting io.MouseDrawCursor then Dear ImGui will render those for you
ImGuiMouseCursor ImGui_GetMouseCursor() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    return g.MouseCursor;

// We intentionally accept values of ImGuiMouseCursor that are outside our bounds, in case users needs to hack-in a custom cursor value.
// Custom cursors may be handled by custom backends. If you are using a standard backend and want to hack in a custom cursor, you may
// handle it before the backend _NewFrame() call and temporarily set ImGuiConfigFlags_NoMouseCursorChange during the backend _NewFrame() call.
void ImGui_SetMouseCursor(ImGuiMouseCursor cursor_type) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    g.MouseCursor = cursor_type;
}

private {
void UpdateAliasKey(ImGuiKey key, bool v, f32 analog_value) {
    assert(cast(i64, ImGui_IsAliasKey(key)));
    ImGuiKeyData* key_data = ImGui_GetKeyData(key);
    key_data.Down = v;
    key_data.AnalogValue = analog_value;
}

// [Internal] Do not use directly
ImGuiKeyChord GetMergedModsFromKeys() {
    ImGuiKeyChord mods = 0;
    if ImGui_GetKeyData(ImGuiMod_Ctrl).Down != 0 {
        mods |= ImGuiMod_Ctrl;
    }
    if ImGui_GetKeyData(ImGuiMod_Shift).Down != 0 {
        mods |= ImGuiMod_Shift;
    }
    if ImGui_GetKeyData(ImGuiMod_Alt).Down != 0 {
        mods |= ImGuiMod_Alt;
    }
    if ImGui_GetKeyData(ImGuiMod_Super).Down != 0 {
        mods |= ImGuiMod_Super;
    }
    return mods;
}

void ImGui_UpdateKeyboardInputs() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiIO* io = &g.IO;
    if (io.ConfigFlags & ImGuiConfigFlags_NoKeyboard) != 0 {
        ImGuiIO_ClearInputKeys(io);
    }
    for i32 n = 0; n < ImGuiMouseButton_COUNT; n++ {
        UpdateAliasKey(ImGui_MouseButtonToKey(n), io.MouseDown[n], io.MouseDown[n] != 0 ? 1.0f : 0.0f);
    }
    UpdateAliasKey(ImGuiKey_MouseWheelX, io.MouseWheelH != 0.0f, io.MouseWheelH);
    UpdateAliasKey(ImGuiKey_MouseWheelY, io.MouseWheel != 0.0f, io.MouseWheel);
    ImGuiKeyChord prev_key_mods = io.KeyMods;
    io.KeyMods = GetMergedModsFromKeys();
    io.KeyCtrl = (io.KeyMods & ImGuiMod_Ctrl) != 0;
    io.KeyShift = (io.KeyMods & ImGuiMod_Shift) != 0;
    io.KeyAlt = (io.KeyMods & ImGuiMod_Alt) != 0;
    io.KeySuper = (io.KeyMods & ImGuiMod_Super) != 0;
    if prev_key_mods != io.KeyMods {
        g.LastKeyModsChangeTime = g.Time;
    }
    if prev_key_mods != io.KeyMods && prev_key_mods == 0 {
        g.LastKeyModsChangeFromNoneTime = g.Time;
    }
    if (io.BackendFlags & ImGuiBackendFlags_HasGamepad) == 0 {
        for i32 key = ImGuiKey_GamepadStart; key < ImGuiKey_GamepadRStickDown + 1; key++ {
            io.KeysData[key - ImGuiKey_NamedKey_BEGIN].Down = false;
            io.KeysData[key - ImGuiKey_NamedKey_BEGIN].AnalogValue = 0.0f;
        }
    }
    for i32 key = ImGuiKey_NamedKey_BEGIN; key < ImGuiKey_NamedKey_END; key++ {
        ImGuiKeyData* key_data = &io.KeysData[key - ImGuiKey_NamedKey_BEGIN];
        key_data.DownDurationPrev = key_data.DownDuration;
        key_data.DownDuration = key_data.Down != 0 ? key_data.DownDuration < 0.0f ? 0.0f : key_data.DownDuration + io.DeltaTime : -1.0f;
        if key_data.DownDuration == 0.0f {
            if ImGui_IsKeyboardKey(cast(ImGuiKey, key)) != 0 {
                g.LastKeyboardKeyPressTime = g.Time;
            } else if key == ImGuiKey_ReservedForModCtrl || key == ImGuiKey_ReservedForModShift || key == ImGuiKey_ReservedForModAlt || key == ImGuiKey_ReservedForModSuper {
                g.LastKeyboardKeyPressTime = g.Time;
            }
        }
    }
    for ImGuiKey key = ImGuiKey_NamedKey_BEGIN; key < ImGuiKey_NamedKey_END; key = cast(ImGuiKey, key + 1) {
        ImGuiKeyData* key_data = &io.KeysData[key - ImGuiKey_NamedKey_BEGIN];
        ImGuiKeyOwnerData* owner_data = &g.KeysOwnerData[key - ImGuiKey_NamedKey_BEGIN];
        owner_data.OwnerCurr = owner_data.OwnerNext;
        if key_data.Down == 0 {
            owner_data.OwnerNext = cast(ImGuiID, -1);
        }
        owner_data.LockUntilRelease = owner_data.LockUntilRelease && key_data.Down;
        owner_data.LockThisFrame = owner_data.LockUntilRelease;
    }
    ImGui_UpdateKeyRoutingTable(&g.KeysRoutingTable);
}

void ImGui_UpdateMouseInputs() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiIO* io = &g.IO;
    io.MouseWheelRequestAxisSwap = io.KeyShift && !io.ConfigMacOSXBehaviors;
    if ImGui_IsMousePosValid(&io.MousePos) != 0 {
        g.MouseLastValidPos = ImFloor(io.MousePos);
        io.MousePos = g.MouseLastValidPos;
    }
    if ImGui_IsMousePosValid(&io.MousePos) && ImGui_IsMousePosValid(&io.MousePosPrev) {
        io.MouseDelta = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(io.MousePos, io.MousePosPrev);
    } else {
        io.MouseDelta = ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f};
    }
    f32 mouse_stationary_threshold = io.MouseSource == ImGuiMouseSource_Mouse ? 2.0f : 3.0f;
    bool mouse_stationary = ImLengthSqr(io.MouseDelta) <= mouse_stationary_threshold * mouse_stationary_threshold;
    g.MouseStationaryTimer = mouse_stationary != 0 ? g.MouseStationaryTimer + io.DeltaTime : 0.0f;
    if io.MouseDelta.x != 0.0f || io.MouseDelta.y != 0.0f {
        g.NavHighlightItemUnderNav = false;
    }
    for i32 i = 0; i < cast(i32, sizeof(io.MouseDown) / sizeof(*io.MouseDown)); i++ {
        io.MouseClicked[i] = io.MouseDown[i] && io.MouseDownDuration[i] < 0.0f;
        io.MouseClickedCount[i] = 0;
        io.MouseReleased[i] = !io.MouseDown[i] && io.MouseDownDuration[i] >= 0.0f;
        if io.MouseReleased[i] != 0 {
            io.MouseReleasedTime[i] = g.Time;
        }
        io.MouseDownDurationPrev[i] = io.MouseDownDuration[i];
        io.MouseDownDuration[i] = io.MouseDown[i] != 0 ? io.MouseDownDuration[i] < 0.0f ? 0.0f : io.MouseDownDuration[i] + io.DeltaTime : -1.0f;
        if io.MouseClicked[i] != 0 {
            bool is_repeated_click = false;
            if cast(f32, g.Time - io.MouseClickedTime[i]) < io.MouseDoubleClickTime {
                ImVec2 delta_from_click_pos = ImGui_IsMousePosValid(&io.MousePos) != 0 ? op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(io.MousePos, io.MouseClickedPos[i]) : ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f};
                if ImLengthSqr(delta_from_click_pos) < io.MouseDoubleClickMaxDist * io.MouseDoubleClickMaxDist {
                    is_repeated_click = true;
                }
            }
            if is_repeated_click != 0 {
                io.MouseClickedLastCount[i]++;
            } else {
                io.MouseClickedLastCount[i] = 1;
            }
            io.MouseClickedTime[i] = g.Time;
            io.MouseClickedPos[i] = io.MousePos;
            io.MouseClickedCount[i] = io.MouseClickedLastCount[i];
            io.MouseDragMaxDistanceAbs[i] = ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f};
            io.MouseDragMaxDistanceSqr[i] = 0.0f;
        } else if io.MouseDown[i] != 0 {
            ImVec2 delta_from_click_pos = ImGui_IsMousePosValid(&io.MousePos) != 0 ? op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(io.MousePos, io.MouseClickedPos[i]) : ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f};
            io.MouseDragMaxDistanceSqr[i] = ImMax(io.MouseDragMaxDistanceSqr[i], ImLengthSqr(delta_from_click_pos));
            io.MouseDragMaxDistanceAbs[i].x = ImMax(io.MouseDragMaxDistanceAbs[i].x, delta_from_click_pos.x < 0.0f ? -delta_from_click_pos.x : delta_from_click_pos.x);
            io.MouseDragMaxDistanceAbs[i].y = ImMax(io.MouseDragMaxDistanceAbs[i].y, delta_from_click_pos.y < 0.0f ? -delta_from_click_pos.y : delta_from_click_pos.y);
        }
        io.MouseDoubleClicked[i] = io.MouseClickedCount[i] == 2;
        if io.MouseClicked[i] != 0 {
            g.NavHighlightItemUnderNav = false;
        }
    }
}

void LockWheelingWindow(ImGuiWindow* window, f32 wheel_amount) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if window != null {
        g.WheelingWindowReleaseTimer = ImMin(g.WheelingWindowReleaseTimer + ImAbs(wheel_amount) * WINDOWS_MOUSE_WHEEL_SCROLL_LOCK_TIMER, WINDOWS_MOUSE_WHEEL_SCROLL_LOCK_TIMER);
    } else {
        g.WheelingWindowReleaseTimer = 0.0f;
    }
    if g.WheelingWindow == window {
        return;
    }
    while true {
        if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventIO) != 0 {
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    g.WheelingWindow = window;
    g.WheelingWindowRefMousePos = g.IO.MousePos;
    if window == null {
        g.WheelingWindowStartFrame = -1;
        g.WheelingAxisAvg = ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f};
    }
}

ImGuiWindow* FindBestWheelingWindow(ImVec2 wheel) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow*[2] windows = {null, null};
    for i32 axis = 0; axis < 2; axis++ {
        if cast(f32*, &wheel)[axis] != 0.0f {
                                    windows[axis] = g.HoveredWindow;
            for ImGuiWindow* window = windows[axis]; (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow) != 0; window = windows[axis] {
                bool has_scrolling = cast(f32*, &window.ScrollMax)[axis] != 0.0f;
                bool inputs_disabled = window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollWithMouse && !(window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMouseInputs);
                if has_scrolling && !inputs_disabled {
                    break;
                }
                windows[axis] = window.ParentWindow;
            }
        }
    }
    if windows[0] == null && windows[1] == null {
        return null;
    }
    if windows[0] == windows[1] || windows[0] == null || windows[1] == null {
        return windows[1] != null ? windows[1] : windows[0];
    }
    if g.WheelingWindowStartFrame == -1 {
        g.WheelingWindowStartFrame = g.FrameCount;
    }
    if g.WheelingWindowStartFrame == g.FrameCount && wheel.x != 0.0f && wheel.y != 0.0f || g.WheelingAxisAvg.x == g.WheelingAxisAvg.y {
        g.WheelingWindowWheelRemainder = wheel;
        return null;
    }
    return g.WheelingAxisAvg.x > g.WheelingAxisAvg.y ? windows[0] : windows[1];
}
}

// Called by NewFrame()
void ImGui_UpdateMouseWheel() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if g.WheelingWindow != null {
        g.WheelingWindowReleaseTimer -= g.IO.DeltaTime;
        if ImGui_IsMousePosValid() && ImLengthSqr(op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(g.IO.MousePos, g.WheelingWindowRefMousePos)) > g.IO.MouseDragThreshold * g.IO.MouseDragThreshold {
            g.WheelingWindowReleaseTimer = 0.0f;
        }
        if g.WheelingWindowReleaseTimer <= 0.0f {
            LockWheelingWindow(null, 0.0f);
        }
    }
    ImGuiWindow* mouse_window = g.WheelingWindow != null ? g.WheelingWindow : g.HoveredWindow;
    if !mouse_window || mouse_window.Collapsed {
        return;
    }
    ImGuiID owner_id = mouse_window.ID;
    ImVec2 wheel;
    wheel.x = ImGui_TestKeyOwner(ImGuiKey_MouseWheelX, owner_id) != 0 ? g.IO.MouseWheelH : 0.0f;
    wheel.y = ImGui_TestKeyOwner(ImGuiKey_MouseWheelY, owner_id) != 0 ? g.IO.MouseWheel : 0.0f;
    if g.WheelingWindow != null {
        ImGui_SetKeyOwner(ImGuiKey_MouseWheelX, owner_id);
        ImGui_SetKeyOwner(ImGuiKey_MouseWheelY, owner_id);
    }
    if wheel.y != 0.0f && g.IO.KeyCtrl && g.IO.FontAllowUserScaling {
        LockWheelingWindow(mouse_window, wheel.y);
        ImGuiWindow* window = mouse_window;
        f32 new_font_scale = ImClamp(window.FontWindowScale + g.IO.MouseWheel * 0.1f, 0.5f, 2.5f);
        f32 scale = new_font_scale / window.FontWindowScale;
        window.FontWindowScale = new_font_scale;
        if window == window.RootWindow {
            ImVec2 offset = op_div_ImVec2_ImVec2(op_mul_ImVec2_ImVec2(op_mul_ImVec2_float(window.Size, 1.0f - scale), op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(g.IO.MousePos, window.Pos)), window.Size);
            ImGui_SetWindowPos(window, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.Pos, offset), 0);
            window.Size = ImTrunc(op_mul_ImVec2_float(window.Size, scale));
            window.SizeFull = ImTrunc(op_mul_ImVec2_float(window.SizeFull, scale));
            ImGui_MarkIniSettingsDirty(window);
        }
        return;
    }
    if g.IO.KeyCtrl != 0 {
        return;
    }
    if g.IO.MouseWheelRequestAxisSwap != 0 {
        wheel = ImVec2{wheel.y, 0.0f};
    }
    g.WheelingAxisAvg.x = ImExponentialMovingAverage(g.WheelingAxisAvg.x, ImAbs(wheel.x), 30);
    g.WheelingAxisAvg.y = ImExponentialMovingAverage(g.WheelingAxisAvg.y, ImAbs(wheel.y), 30);
    wheel = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(wheel, g.WheelingWindowWheelRemainder);
    g.WheelingWindowWheelRemainder = ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f};
    if wheel.x == 0.0f && wheel.y == 0.0f {
        return;
    }
    {
        ImGuiWindow* window = g.WheelingWindow != null ? g.WheelingWindow : FindBestWheelingWindow(wheel);
        if window != null {
            if !(window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollWithMouse) && !(window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMouseInputs) {
                bool[2] do_scroll = {
                    wheel.x != 0.0f && window.ScrollMax.x != 0.0f,
                    wheel.y != 0.0f && window.ScrollMax.y != 0.0f,
                };
                if do_scroll[ImGuiAxis_X] && do_scroll[ImGuiAxis_Y] {
                    do_scroll[g.WheelingAxisAvg.x > g.WheelingAxisAvg.y ? ImGuiAxis_Y : ImGuiAxis_X] = false;
                }
                if do_scroll[ImGuiAxis_X] != 0 {
                    LockWheelingWindow(window, wheel.x);
                    f32 max_step = ImRect_GetWidth(&window.InnerRect) * 0.67f;
                    f32 scroll_step = ImTrunc(ImMin(2.0f * window.FontRefSize, max_step));
                    ImGui_SetScrollX(window, window.Scroll.x - wheel.x * scroll_step);
                    g.WheelingWindowScrolledFrame = g.FrameCount;
                }
                if do_scroll[ImGuiAxis_Y] != 0 {
                    LockWheelingWindow(window, wheel.y);
                    f32 max_step = ImRect_GetHeight(&window.InnerRect) * 0.67f;
                    f32 scroll_step = ImTrunc(ImMin(5.0f * window.FontRefSize, max_step));
                    ImGui_SetScrollY(window, window.Scroll.y - wheel.y * scroll_step);
                    g.WheelingWindowScrolledFrame = g.FrameCount;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// Process input queue
// We always call this with the value of 'bool g.IO.ConfigInputTrickleEventQueue'.
// - trickle_fast_inputs = false : process all events, turn into flattened input state (e.g. successive down/up/down/up will be lost)
// - trickle_fast_inputs = true  : process as many events as possible (successive down/up/down/up will be trickled over several frames so nothing is lost) (new feature in 1.87)
void ImGui_UpdateInputEvents(bool trickle_fast_inputs) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiIO* io = &g.IO;
    bool trickle_interleaved_nonchar_keys_and_text = trickle_fast_inputs && g.WantTextInputNextFrame == 1;
    bool mouse_moved = false;
    bool mouse_wheeled = false;
    bool key_changed = false;
    bool key_changed_nonchar = false;
    bool text_inputted = false;
    i32 mouse_button_changed = 0x00;
    ImBitArray_ImGuiKey_NamedKey_COUNT_0 key_changed_mask;
    i32 event_n = 0;
    for ; event_n < g.InputEventsQueue.Size; event_n++ {
        ImGuiInputEvent* e = &g.InputEventsQueue.Data[event_n];
        if e.Type == ImGuiInputEventType_MousePos {
            if g.IO.WantSetMousePos != 0 {
                continue;
            }
            ImVec2 event_pos;
            ImVec2_init(&event_pos, e.MousePos.PosX, e.MousePos.PosY);
            if trickle_fast_inputs && (mouse_button_changed != 0 || mouse_wheeled || key_changed || text_inputted) {
                break;
            }
            io.MousePos = event_pos;
            io.MouseSource = e.MousePos.MouseSource;
            mouse_moved = true;
        } else if e.Type == ImGuiInputEventType_MouseButton {
            ImGuiMouseButton button = e.MouseButton.Button;
            assert(button >= 0 && button < ImGuiMouseButton_COUNT);
            if trickle_fast_inputs && (mouse_button_changed & 1 << button || mouse_wheeled) {
                break;
            }
            if trickle_fast_inputs && e.MouseButton.MouseSource == ImGuiMouseSource_TouchScreen && mouse_moved {
                break;
            }
            io.MouseDown[button] = e.MouseButton.Down;
            io.MouseSource = e.MouseButton.MouseSource;
            mouse_button_changed |= 1 << button;
        } else if e.Type == ImGuiInputEventType_MouseWheel {
            if trickle_fast_inputs && (mouse_moved || mouse_button_changed != 0) {
                break;
            }
            io.MouseWheelH += e.MouseWheel.WheelX;
            io.MouseWheel += e.MouseWheel.WheelY;
            io.MouseSource = e.MouseWheel.MouseSource;
            mouse_wheeled = true;
        } else if e.Type == ImGuiInputEventType_MouseViewport {
            io.MouseHoveredViewport = e.MouseViewport.HoveredViewportID;
        } else if e.Type == ImGuiInputEventType_Key {
            if (io.ConfigFlags & ImGuiConfigFlags_NoKeyboard) != 0 {
                continue;
            }
            ImGuiKey key = e.Key.Key;
            assert(key != ImGuiKey_None);
            ImGuiKeyData* key_data = ImGui_GetKeyData(key);
            var key_data_index = cast(i32, key_data - g.IO.KeysData);
            if trickle_fast_inputs && key_data.Down != e.Key.Down && (ImBitArray_ImGuiKey_NamedKey_COUNT_0_TestBit(&key_changed_mask, key_data_index) || mouse_button_changed != 0) {
                break;
            }
            bool key_is_potentially_for_char_input = IsKeyChordPotentiallyCharInput(GetMergedModsFromKeys() | key);
            if trickle_interleaved_nonchar_keys_and_text && (text_inputted && !key_is_potentially_for_char_input) {
                break;
            }
            if key_data.Down != e.Key.Down {
                key_changed = true;
                ImBitArray_ImGuiKey_NamedKey_COUNT_0_SetBit(&key_changed_mask, key_data_index);
                if trickle_interleaved_nonchar_keys_and_text && !key_is_potentially_for_char_input {
                    key_changed_nonchar = true;
                }
            }
            key_data.Down = e.Key.Down;
            key_data.AnalogValue = e.Key.AnalogValue;
        } else if e.Type == ImGuiInputEventType_Text {
            if (io.ConfigFlags & ImGuiConfigFlags_NoKeyboard) != 0 {
                continue;
            }
            if trickle_fast_inputs && (mouse_button_changed != 0 || mouse_moved || mouse_wheeled) {
                break;
            }
            if trickle_interleaved_nonchar_keys_and_text && key_changed_nonchar {
                break;
            }
            u32 c = e.Text.Char;
            ImVector_ImWchar_push_back(&io.InputQueueCharacters, c <= 0xFFFF ? cast(ImWchar, c) : 0xFFFD);
            if trickle_interleaved_nonchar_keys_and_text != 0 {
                text_inputted = true;
            }
        } else if e.Type == ImGuiInputEventType_Focus {
            bool focus_lost = !e.AppFocused.Focused;
            io.AppFocusLost = focus_lost;
        } else {
            assert(0 && "Unknown event!");
        }
    }
    for i32 n = 0; n < event_n; n++ {
        ImVector_ImGuiInputEvent_push_back(&g.InputEventsTrail, g.InputEventsQueue.Data[n]);
    }
    if event_n != 0 && g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventIO {
        for i32 n = 0; n < g.InputEventsQueue.Size; n++ {
            DebugPrintInputEvent(n < event_n ? "Processed" : "Remaining", &g.InputEventsQueue.Data[n]);
        }
    }
    if event_n == g.InputEventsQueue.Size {
        ImVector_ImGuiInputEvent_resize(&g.InputEventsQueue, 0);
    } else {
        ImVector_ImGuiInputEvent_erase(&g.InputEventsQueue, g.InputEventsQueue.Data, g.InputEventsQueue.Data + event_n);
    }
    if g.IO.AppFocusLost != 0 {
        ImGuiIO_ClearInputKeys(&g.IO);
        ImGuiIO_ClearInputMouse(&g.IO);
    }
}

ImGuiID ImGui_GetKeyOwner(ImGuiKey key) {
    if ImGui_IsNamedKeyOrMod(key) == 0 {
        return cast(ImGuiID, -1);
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiKeyOwnerData* owner_data = ImGui_GetKeyOwnerData(g, key);
    ImGuiID owner_id = owner_data.OwnerCurr;
    if g.ActiveIdUsingAllKeyboardKeys && owner_id != g.ActiveId && owner_id != cast(ImGuiID, 0) {
        if key >= ImGuiKey_NamedKey_BEGIN && key < ImGuiKey_GamepadStart {
            return cast(ImGuiID, -1);
        }
    }
    return owner_id;
}

// TestKeyOwner(..., ID)   : (owner == None || owner == ID)
// TestKeyOwner(..., None) : (owner == None)
// TestKeyOwner(..., Any)  : no owner test
// All paths are also testing for key not being locked, for the rare cases that key have been locked with using ImGuiInputFlags_LockXXX flags.
bool ImGui_TestKeyOwner(ImGuiKey key, ImGuiID owner_id) {
    if ImGui_IsNamedKeyOrMod(key) == 0 {
        return true;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if g.ActiveIdUsingAllKeyboardKeys && owner_id != g.ActiveId && owner_id != cast(ImGuiID, 0) {
        if key >= ImGuiKey_NamedKey_BEGIN && key < ImGuiKey_GamepadStart {
            return false;
        }
    }
    ImGuiKeyOwnerData* owner_data = ImGui_GetKeyOwnerData(g, key);
    if owner_id == cast(ImGuiID, 0) {
        return owner_data.LockThisFrame == false;
    }
    if owner_data.OwnerCurr != owner_id {
        if owner_data.LockThisFrame != 0 {
            return false;
        }
        if owner_data.OwnerCurr != cast(ImGuiID, -1) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

// _LockXXX flags are useful to lock keys away from code which is not input-owner aware.
// When using _LockXXX flags, you can use ImGuiKeyOwner_Any to lock keys from everyone.
// - SetKeyOwner(..., None)              : clears owner
// - SetKeyOwner(..., Any, !Lock)        : illegal (assert)
// - SetKeyOwner(..., Any or None, Lock) : set lock
// Ownership is automatically released on the frame after a release, see code in UpdateKeyboardInputs().
void ImGui_SetKeyOwner(ImGuiKey key, ImGuiID owner_id, ImGuiInputFlags flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(ImGui_IsNamedKeyOrMod(key) && (owner_id != cast(ImGuiID, 0) || flags & (ImGuiInputFlags_LockThisFrame | ImGuiInputFlags_LockUntilRelease)));
    assert((flags & ~ImGuiInputFlags_SupportedBySetKeyOwner) == 0);
    ImGuiKeyOwnerData* owner_data = ImGui_GetKeyOwnerData(g, key);
    owner_data.OwnerNext = owner_id;
    owner_data.OwnerCurr = owner_data.OwnerNext;
    owner_data.LockUntilRelease = (flags & ImGuiInputFlags_LockUntilRelease) != 0;
    owner_data.LockThisFrame = (flags & ImGuiInputFlags_LockThisFrame) != 0 || owner_data.LockUntilRelease;
}

// This is more or less equivalent to a fancier version of:
//   if (IsItemHovered() || IsItemActive())
//       SetKeyOwner(key, GetItemID());
// Extensive uses of that (e.g. many calls for a single item) may want to manually perform the tests once and then call SetKeyOwner() multiple times.
// More advanced usage scenarios may want to call SetKeyOwner() manually based on different condition.
// Worth noting is that only one item can be hovered and only one item can be active, therefore this usage pattern doesn't need to bother with routing and priority.
bool ImGui_SetItemKeyOwner(ImGuiKey key, ImGuiInputFlags flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiID id = g.LastItemData.ID;
    if id == 0 || g.HoveredId != id && g.ActiveId != id {
        return false;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiInputFlags_CondMask_) == 0 {
        flags |= ImGuiInputFlags_CondDefault_;
    }
    if g.HoveredId == id && flags & ImGuiInputFlags_CondHovered || g.ActiveId == id && flags & ImGuiInputFlags_CondActive {
        assert((flags & ~ImGuiInputFlags_SupportedBySetItemKeyOwner) == 0);
        if ImGui_TestKeyOwner(key, id) == 0 {
            return false;
        }
        ImGui_SetKeyOwner(key, id, flags & ~ImGuiInputFlags_CondMask_);
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

bool ImGui_SetItemKeyOwner(ImGuiKey key) {

}

bool ImGui_Shortcut(ImGuiKeyChord key_chord, ImGuiInputFlags flags, ImGuiID owner_id) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if (flags & ImGuiInputFlags_RouteTypeMask_) == 0 {
        flags |= ImGuiInputFlags_RouteFocused;
    }
    if owner_id == cast(ImGuiID, 0) || owner_id == cast(ImGuiID, -1) {
        owner_id = GetRoutingIdFromOwnerId(owner_id);
    }
    if (g.CurrentItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_Disabled) != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    if ImGui_SetShortcutRouting(key_chord, flags, owner_id) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiInputFlags_Repeat) != 0 && (flags & ImGuiInputFlags_RepeatUntilMask_) == 0 {
        flags |= ImGuiInputFlags_RepeatUntilKeyModsChange;
    }
    if ImGui_IsKeyChordPressed(key_chord, flags, owner_id) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGui_SetKeyOwnersForKeyChord(key_chord & ImGuiMod_Mask_, owner_id);
    assert((flags & ~ImGuiInputFlags_SupportedByShortcut) == 0);
    return true;
}

// Verify ABI compatibility between caller code and compiled version of Dear ImGui. This helps detects some build issues.
// Called by IMGUI_CHECKVERSION().
// Verify that the type sizes are matching between the calling file's compilation unit and imgui.cpp's compilation unit
// If this triggers you have mismatched headers and compiled code versions.
// - It could be because of a build issue (using new headers with old compiled code)
// - It could be because of mismatched configuration #define, compilation settings, packing pragma etc.
//   THE CONFIGURATION SETTINGS MENTIONED IN imconfig.h MUST BE SET FOR ALL COMPILATION UNITS INVOLVED WITH DEAR IMGUI.
//   Which is why it is required you put them in your imconfig file (and NOT only before including imgui.h).
//   Otherwise it is possible that different compilation units would see different structure layout.
//   If you don't want to modify imconfig.h you can use the IMGUI_USER_CONFIG define to change filename.
bool ImGui_DebugCheckVersionAndDataLayout(u8* version, u64 sz_io, u64 sz_style, u64 sz_vec2, u64 sz_vec4, u64 sz_vert, u64 sz_idx) {
    return false;
}

// Until 1.89 (August 2022, IMGUI_VERSION_NUM < 18814) it was legal to use SetCursorPos()/SetCursorScreenPos()
// to extend contents size of our parent container (e.g. window contents size, which is used for auto-resizing
// windows, table column contents size used for auto-resizing columns, group size).
// This was causing issues and ambiguities and we needed to retire that.
// 2022/08/05 (1.89): extending contents size boundaries REQUIRES AN ITEM TO BE SUBMITTED. However we gated the new logic behind a '#ifndef IMGUI_DISABLE_OBSOLETE_FUNCTIONS' block.
// 2025/06/25 (1.92): removed the legacy path and turned into an assert. It was a mistake that there was a #ifndef before: our obsolescence schedule gets pushed back a bit more :(
//
//  Previously this would make the window content size ~200x200:
//    Begin(...) + SetCursorScreenPos(GetCursorScreenPos() + ImVec2(200,200)) + End();                      // NOT OK ANYMORE
//  Instead, please submit an item:
//    Begin(...) + SetCursorScreenPos(GetCursorScreenPos() + ImVec2(200,200)) + Dummy(ImVec2(0,0)) + End(); // OK
//  Alternative:
//    Begin(...) + Dummy(ImVec2(200,200)) + End(); // OK
//
// The assert below detects when the _last_ call in a window was a SetCursorPos() not followed by an Item,
// and with a position that would grow the parent contents size.
//
// Advanced:
// - For reference, old logic was causing issues because it meant that SetCursorScreenPos(GetCursorScreenPos())
//   had a side-effect on layout! In particular this caused problem to compute group boundaries.
//   e.g. BeginGroup() + SomeItem() + SetCursorScreenPos(GetCursorScreenPos()) + EndGroup() would cause the
//   group to be taller because auto-sizing generally adds padding on bottom and right side.
// - While this code is a little twisted, no-one would expect SetXXX(GetXXX()) to have a side-effect.
//   Using vertical alignment patterns would frequently trigger this sorts of issue.
// - See https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/issues/5548 for more details.
void ImGui_ErrorCheckUsingSetCursorPosToExtendParentBoundaries() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    assert(cast(i64, window.DC.IsSetPos));
    window.DC.IsSetPos = false;
    if window.DC.CursorPos.x <= window.DC.CursorMaxPos.x && window.DC.CursorPos.y <= window.DC.CursorMaxPos.y {
        return;
    }
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return;
    }
    while true {
        if 0 == 0 {
            if ImGui_ErrorLog("Code uses SetCursorPos()/SetCursorScreenPos() to extend window/parent boundaries.\nPlease submit an item e.g. Dummy() afterwards in order to grow window/parent boundaries.") != 0 {
                assert(0 && "Code uses SetCursorPos()/SetCursorScreenPos() to extend window/parent boundaries.\nPlease submit an item e.g. Dummy() afterwards in order to grow window/parent boundaries.");
            }
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
}

// Chosen name "Try to recover" over e.g. "Restore" to suggest this is not a 100% guaranteed recovery.
// Called by e.g. EndFrame() but may be called for manual recovery.
// Attempt to recover full window stack.
void ImGui_ErrorRecoveryTryToRecoverState(ImGuiErrorRecoveryState* state_in) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    while g.CurrentWindowStack.Size > state_in.SizeOfWindowStack {
        ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
        if (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow) != 0 {
            if g.CurrentTable != null && g.CurrentTable.InnerWindow == g.CurrentWindow {
                while true {
                    if 0 == 0 {
                        if ImGui_ErrorLog("Missing EndTable()") != 0 {
                            assert(0 && "Missing EndTable()");
                        }
                    }
                    if !(0 != 0) { break; }
                }
                ImGui_EndTable();
            } else {
                while true {
                    if 0 == 0 {
                        if ImGui_ErrorLog("Missing EndChild()") != 0 {
                            assert(0 && "Missing EndChild()");
                        }
                    }
                    if !(0 != 0) { break; }
                }
                ImGui_EndChild();
            }
        } else {
            while true {
                if 0 == 0 {
                    if ImGui_ErrorLog("Missing End()") != 0 {
                        assert(0 && "Missing End()");
                    }
                }
                if !(0 != 0) { break; }
            }
            ImGui_End();
        }
    }
    if g.CurrentWindowStack.Size == state_in.SizeOfWindowStack {
        ImGui_ErrorRecoveryTryToRecoverWindowState(state_in);
    }
}

// Called by e.g. End() but may be called for manual recovery.

// Attempt to recover from incorrect usage of BeginXXX/EndXXX/PushXXX/PopXXX calls.
void ImGui_ErrorRecoveryTryToRecoverWindowState(ImGuiErrorRecoveryState* state_in) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    while g.CurrentTable != null && g.CurrentTable.InnerWindow == g.CurrentWindow {
        while true {
            if 0 == 0 {

    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    while g.CurrentTabBar != null && g.CurrentTabBar.Window == window {
        while true {
            if 0 == 0 {
                if ImGui_ErrorLog("Missing EndTabBar()") != 0 {
                    assert(0 && "Missing EndTabBar()");
                }
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
        ImGui_EndTabBar();
    }
    while g.CurrentMultiSelect != null && g.CurrentMultiSelect.Storage.Window == window {
        while true {
            if 0 == 0 {
                if ImGui_ErrorLog("Missing EndMultiSelect()") != 0 {
                    assert(0 && "Missing EndMultiSelect()");
                }
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
        ImGui_EndMultiSelect();
    }
    if window.DC.MenuBarAppending != 0 {
        while true {
            if 0 == 0 {
                if ImGui_ErrorLog("Missing EndMenuBar()") != 0 {
                    assert(0 && "Missing EndMenuBar()");
                }
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
        ImGui_EndMenuBar();
    }
    while window.DC.TreeDepth > state_in.SizeOfTreeStack {
        while true {
            if 0 == 0 {
                if ImGui_ErrorLog("Missing TreePop()") != 0 {
                    assert(0 && "Missing TreePop()");
                }
            }

bool ImGui_ErrorLog(u8* msg) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    if g.IO.ConfigErrorRecoveryEnableDebugLog != 0 {
        if g.ErrorFirst != 0 {
            while true {
                if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventError) != 0 {
                } else {
                    g.DebugLogSkippedErrors++;
                }
                if !(0 != 0) { break; }
            }
        }
        while true {
            if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventError) != 0 {
            } else {
                g.DebugLogSkippedErrors++;
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
    }
    g.ErrorFirst = false;
    if g.IO.ConfigErrorRecoveryEnableTooltip != 0 {
        if g.WithinFrameScope && ImGui_BeginErrorTooltip() {
            if g.ErrorCountCurrentFrame < 20 {
                ImGui_Text("In window '%s': %s", window != null ? window.Name : "NULL", msg);
                if window && (!window.IsFallbackWindow || window.WasActive) {
                    ImDrawList_AddRect(ImGui_GetForegroundDrawList(window), window.Pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.Pos, window.Size), cast(ImU32, 255) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 0, 0.0f, 1.0f, 0);
                }
            }
            if g.ErrorCountCurrentFrame == 20 {
                ImGui_Text("(and more errors)");
            }
            ImGui_EndErrorTooltip();
        }
        g.ErrorCountCurrentFrame++;
    }
    if g.ErrorCallback != null {
        g.ErrorCallback(g, g.ErrorCallbackUserData, msg);
    }
    return g.IO.ConfigErrorRecoveryEnableAssert;
}

void ImGui_KeepAliveID(ImGuiID id) {
