// Declare item bounding box for clipping and interaction.
// Note that the size can be different than the one provided to ItemSize(). Typically, widgets that spread over available surface
// declare their minimum size requirement to ItemSize() and provide a larger region to ItemAdd() which is used drawing/interaction.
// THIS IS IN THE PERFORMANCE CRITICAL PATH (UNTIL THE CLIPPING TEST AND EARLY-RETURN)
bool ImGui_ItemAdd(ImRect bb, ImGuiID id, ImRect* nav_bb_arg, ImGuiItemFlags extra_flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    g.LastItemData.ID = id;
    g.LastItemData.Rect = bb;
    g.LastItemData.NavRect = nav_bb_arg != null ? *nav_bb_arg : bb;
    g.LastItemData.ItemFlags = g.CurrentItemFlags | g.NextItemData.ItemFlagsSet | extra_flags;
    g.LastItemData.StatusFlags = ImGuiItemStatusFlags_None;
    if id != 0 {
        ImGui_KeepAliveID(id);
        if (g.LastItemData.ItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_NoNav) == 0 {
            window.DC.NavLayersActiveMaskNext |= cast(i16, 1 << window.DC.NavLayerCurrent);
            if g.NavId == id || g.NavAnyRequest {
                if g.NavWindow.RootWindowForNav == window.RootWindowForNav {
                    if window == g.NavWindow || (window.ChildFlags | g.NavWindow.ChildFlags) & ImGuiChildFlags_NavFlattened {
                        ImGui_NavProcessItem();
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (g.NextItemData.HasFlags & ImGuiNextItemDataFlags_HasShortcut) != 0 {
            ImGui_ItemHandleShortcut(id);
        }
    }
    g.NextItemData.HasFlags = ImGuiNextItemDataFlags_None;
    g.NextItemData.ItemFlagsSet = ImGuiItemFlags_None;
    if id != 0 {
    }
    bool is_rect_visible = ImRect_Overlaps(&bb, window.ClipRect);
    if is_rect_visible == 0 {
        if id == 0 || id != g.ActiveId && id != g.ActiveIdPreviousFrame && id != g.NavId && id != g.NavActivateId {
            if g.ItemUnclipByLog == 0 {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    when !(defined(IMGUI_DISABLE_DEBUG_TOOLS)) {
        if id != 0 {
            if id == g.DebugLocateId {
                ImGui_DebugLocateItemResolveWithLastItem();
            }
            assert(id != window.ID && "Cannot have an empty ID at the root of a window. If you need an empty label, use ## and read the FAQ about how the ID Stack works!");
        }
    }
    if id != 0 && g.DeactivatedItemData.ID == id {
        g.DeactivatedItemData.ElapseFrame = g.FrameCount;
    }
    if is_rect_visible != 0 {
        g.LastItemData.StatusFlags |= ImGuiItemStatusFlags_Visible;
    }
    if ImGui_IsMouseHoveringRect(bb.Min, bb.Max) != 0 {
        g.LastItemData.StatusFlags |= ImGuiItemStatusFlags_HoveredRect;
    }
    return true;
}

// Advance cursor given item size for layout.
// Register minimum needed size so it can extend the bounding box used for auto-fit calculation.
// See comments in ItemAdd() about how/why the size provided to ItemSize() vs ItemAdd() may often different.
// THIS IS IN THE PERFORMANCE CRITICAL PATH.
void ImGui_ItemSize(ImVec2 size, f32 text_baseline_y) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return;
    }
    f32 offset_to_match_baseline_y = text_baseline_y >= 0.0f ? ImMax(0.0f, window.DC.CurrLineTextBaseOffset - text_baseline_y) : 0.0f;
    f32 line_y1 = window.DC.IsSameLine != 0 ? window.DC.CursorPosPrevLine.y : window.DC.CursorPos.y;
    f32 line_height = ImMax(window.DC.CurrLineSize.y, window.DC.CursorPos.y - line_y1 + size.y + offset_to_match_baseline_y);
    window.DC.CursorPosPrevLine.x = window.DC.CursorPos.x + size.x;
    window.DC.CursorPosPrevLine.y = line_y1;
    window.DC.CursorPos.x = cast(f32, cast(i32, window.Pos.x + window.DC.Indent.x + window.DC.ColumnsOffset.x));
    window.DC.CursorPos.y = cast(f32, cast(i32, line_y1 + line_height + g.Style.ItemSpacing.y));
    window.DC.CursorMaxPos.x = ImMax(window.DC.CursorMaxPos.x, window.DC.CursorPosPrevLine.x);
    window.DC.CursorMaxPos.y = ImMax(window.DC.CursorMaxPos.y, window.DC.CursorPos.y - g.Style.ItemSpacing.y);
    window.DC.PrevLineSize.y = line_height;
    window.DC.CurrLineSize.y = 0.0f;
    window.DC.PrevLineTextBaseOffset = ImMax(window.DC.CurrLineTextBaseOffset, text_baseline_y);
    window.DC.CurrLineTextBaseOffset = 0.0f;
    window.DC.IsSetPos = false;
    window.DC.IsSameLine = window.DC.IsSetPos;
    if window.DC.LayoutType == ImGuiLayoutType_Horizontal {
        ImGui_SameLine();
    }
}

// Gets back to previous line and continue with horizontal layout
//      offset_from_start_x == 0 : follow right after previous item
//      offset_from_start_x != 0 : align to specified x position (relative to window/group left)
//      spacing_w < 0            : use default spacing if offset_from_start_x == 0, no spacing if offset_from_start_x != 0
//      spacing_w >= 0           : enforce spacing amount
void ImGui_SameLine(f32 offset_from_start_x, f32 spacing_w) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return;
    }
    if offset_from_start_x != 0.0f {
        if spacing_w < 0.0f {
            spacing_w = 0.0f;
        }
        window.DC.CursorPos.x = window.Pos.x - window.Scroll.x + offset_from_start_x + spacing_w + window.DC.GroupOffset.x + window.DC.ColumnsOffset.x;
        window.DC.CursorPos.y = window.DC.CursorPosPrevLine.y;
    } else {
        if spacing_w < 0.0f {
            spacing_w = g.Style.ItemSpacing.x;
        }
        window.DC.CursorPos.x = window.DC.CursorPosPrevLine.x + spacing_w;
        window.DC.CursorPos.y = window.DC.CursorPosPrevLine.y;
    }
    window.DC.CurrLineSize = window.DC.PrevLineSize;
    window.DC.CurrLineTextBaseOffset = window.DC.PrevLineTextBaseOffset;
    window.DC.IsSameLine = true;
}

void ImGui_PushMultiItemsWidths(i32 components, f32 w_full) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    assert(components > 0);
    ImGuiStyle style = g.Style;
    ImVector_float_push_back(&window.DC.ItemWidthStack, window.DC.ItemWidth);
    f32 w_items = w_full - style.ItemInnerSpacing.x * cast(f32, components - 1);
    f32 prev_split = w_items;
    for i32 i = components - 1; i > 0; i-- {
        var next_split = cast(f32, cast(i32, w_items * cast(f32, i) / cast(f32, components)));
        ImVector_float_push_back(&window.DC.ItemWidthStack, ImMax(prev_split - next_split, 1.0f));
        prev_split = next_split;
    }
    window.DC.ItemWidth = ImMax(prev_split, 1.0f);
    g.NextItemData.HasFlags &= ~ImGuiNextItemDataFlags_HasWidth;
}

void ImGui_PopItemWidth() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    if window.DC.ItemWidthStack.Size <= 0 {
        while true {
            if 0 == 0 {
                if ImGui_ErrorLog("Calling PopItemWidth() too many times!") != 0 {
                    assert(0 && "Calling PopItemWidth() too many times!");
                }
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
        return;
    }
    window.DC.ItemWidth = *ImVector_float_back(&window.DC.ItemWidthStack);
    ImVector_float_pop_back(&window.DC.ItemWidthStack);
}

// Calculate default item width given value passed to PushItemWidth() or SetNextItemWidth().
// The SetNextItemWidth() data is generally cleared/consumed by ItemAdd() or NextItemData.ClearFlags()
f32 ImGui_CalcItemWidth() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    f32 w;
    if (g.NextItemData.HasFlags & ImGuiNextItemDataFlags_HasWidth) != 0 {
        w = g.NextItemData.Width;
    } else {
        w = window.DC.ItemWidth;
    }
    if w < 0.0f {
        f32 region_avail_x = ImGui_GetContentRegionAvail().x;
        w = ImMax(1.0f, region_avail_x + w);
    }
    w = cast(f32, cast(i32, w));
    return w;
}

// [Internal] Calculate full item size given user provided 'size' parameter and default width/height. Default width is often == CalcItemWidth().
// Those two functions CalcItemWidth vs CalcItemSize are awkwardly named because they are not fully symmetrical.
// Note that only CalcItemWidth() is publicly exposed.
// The 4.0f here may be changed to match CalcItemWidth() and/or BeginChild() (right now we have a mismatch which is harmless but undesirable)
ImVec2 ImGui_CalcItemSize(ImVec2 size, f32 default_w, f32 default_h) {
    ImVec2 avail;
    if size.x < 0.0f || size.y < 0.0f {
        avail = ImGui_GetContentRegionAvail();
    }
    if size.x == 0.0f {
        size.x = default_w;
    } else if size.x < 0.0f {
        size.x = ImMax(4.0f, avail.x + size.x);
    }
    if size.y == 0.0f {
        size.y = default_h;
    } else if size.y < 0.0f {
        size.y = ImMax(4.0f, avail.y + size.y);
    }
    return size;
}

// Lock horizontal starting position + capture group bounding box into one "item" (so you can use IsItemHovered() or layout primitives such as SameLine() on whole group, etc.)
// Groups are currently a mishmash of functionalities which should perhaps be clarified and separated.
// FIXME-OPT: Could we safely early out on ->SkipItems?
void ImGui_BeginGroup() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    ImVector_ImGuiGroupData_resize(&g.GroupStack, g.GroupStack.Size + 1);
    ImGuiGroupData* group_data = ImVector_ImGuiGroupData_back(&g.GroupStack);
    group_data.WindowID = window.ID;
    group_data.BackupCursorPos = window.DC.CursorPos;
    group_data.BackupCursorPosPrevLine = window.DC.CursorPosPrevLine;
    group_data.BackupCursorMaxPos = window.DC.CursorMaxPos;
    group_data.BackupIndent = window.DC.Indent;
    group_data.BackupGroupOffset = window.DC.GroupOffset;
    group_data.BackupCurrLineSize = window.DC.CurrLineSize;
    group_data.BackupCurrLineTextBaseOffset = window.DC.CurrLineTextBaseOffset;
    group_data.BackupActiveIdIsAlive = g.ActiveIdIsAlive;
    group_data.BackupHoveredIdIsAlive = g.HoveredId != 0;
    group_data.BackupIsSameLine = window.DC.IsSameLine;
    group_data.BackupAnyIdHasBeenEditedThisFrame = g.AnyIdHasBeenEditedThisFrame;
    group_data.BackupDeactivatedIdIsAlive = g.DeactivatedItemData.IsAlive;
    group_data.EmitItem = true;

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Helper to snap on edges when aiming at an item very close to the edge,
// So the difference between WindowPadding and ItemSpacing will be in the visible area after scrolling.
// When we refactor the scrolling API this may be configurable with a flag?
// Note that the effect for this won't be visible on X axis with default Style settings as WindowPadding.x == ItemSpacing.x by default.
private {
f32 CalcScrollEdgeSnap(f32 target, f32 snap_min, f32 snap_max, f32 snap_threshold, f32 center_ratio) {
    if target <= snap_min + snap_threshold {
        return ImLerp(snap_min, target, center_ratio);
    }
    if target >= snap_max - snap_threshold {
        return ImLerp(target, snap_max, center_ratio);
    }
    return target;
}

ImVec2 CalcNextScrollFromScrollTargetAndClamp(ImGuiWindow* window) {
    ImVec2 scroll = window.Scroll;
    ImVec2 decoration_size;
    ImVec2_init(&decoration_size, window.DecoOuterSizeX1 + window.DecoInnerSizeX1 + window.DecoOuterSizeX2, window.DecoOuterSizeY1 + window.DecoInnerSizeY1 + window.DecoOuterSizeY2);
    for i32 axis = 0; axis < 2; axis++ {
        if cast(f32*, &window.ScrollTarget)[axis] < FLT_MAX {
            f32 center_ratio = cast(f32*, &window.ScrollTargetCenterRatio)[axis];
            f32 scroll_target = cast(f32*, &window.ScrollTarget)[axis];
            if cast(f32*, &window.ScrollTargetEdgeSnapDist)[axis] > 0.0f {
                f32 snap_min = 0.0f;
                f32 snap_max = cast(f32*, &window.ScrollMax)[axis] + cast(f32*, &window.SizeFull)[axis] - cast(f32*, &decoration_size)[axis];
                scroll_target = CalcScrollEdgeSnap(scroll_target, snap_min, snap_max, cast(f32*, &window.ScrollTargetEdgeSnapDist)[axis], center_ratio);
            }
            cast(f32*, &scroll)[axis] = scroll_target - center_ratio * (cast(f32*, &window.SizeFull)[axis] - cast(f32*, &decoration_size)[axis]);
        }
        cast(f32*, &scroll)[axis] = ImRound64(ImMax(cast(f32*, &scroll)[axis], 0.0f));
        if !window.Collapsed && !window.SkipItems {
            cast(f32*, &scroll)[axis] = ImMin(cast(f32*, &scroll)[axis], cast(f32*, &window.ScrollMax)[axis]);
        }
    }
    return scroll;
}
}

// Scroll to keep newly navigated item fully into view
ImVec2 ImGui_ScrollToRectEx(ImGuiWindow* window, ImRect item_rect, ImGuiScrollFlags flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImRect scroll_rect;
    ImRect_init(&scroll_rect, op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.InnerRect.Min, ImVec2{1.0f, 1.0f}), op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.InnerRect.Max, ImVec2{1.0f, 1.0f}));
    scroll_rect.Min.x = ImMin(scroll_rect.Min.x + window.DecoInnerSizeX1, scroll_rect.Max.x);
    scroll_rect.Min.y = ImMin(scroll_rect.Min.y + window.DecoInnerSizeY1, scroll_rect.Max.y);
    assert((flags & ImGuiScrollFlags_MaskX_) == 0 || ImIsPowerOfTwo(flags & ImGuiScrollFlags_MaskX_));
    assert((flags & ImGuiScrollFlags_MaskY_) == 0 || ImIsPowerOfTwo(flags & ImGuiScrollFlags_MaskY_));
    ImGuiScrollFlags in_flags = flags;
    if (flags & ImGuiScrollFlags_MaskX_) == 0 && window.ScrollbarX {
        flags |= ImGuiScrollFlags_KeepVisibleEdgeX;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiScrollFlags_MaskY_) == 0 {
        flags |= window.Appearing != 0 ? ImGuiScrollFlags_AlwaysCenterY : ImGuiScrollFlags_KeepVisibleEdgeY;
    }
    bool fully_visible_x = item_rect.Min.x >= scroll_rect.Min.x && item_rect.Max.x <= scroll_rect.Max.x;
    bool fully_visible_y = item_rect.Min.y >= scroll_rect.Min.y && item_rect.Max.y <= scroll_rect.Max.y;
    bool can_be_fully_visible_x = ImRect_GetWidth(&item_rect) + g.Style.ItemSpacing.x * 2.0f <= ImRect_GetWidth(&scroll_rect) || window.AutoFitFramesX > 0 || (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize) != 0;
    bool can_be_fully_visible_y = ImRect_GetHeight(&item_rect) + g.Style.ItemSpacing.y * 2.0f <= ImRect_GetHeight(&scroll_rect) || window.AutoFitFramesY > 0 || (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize) != 0;
    if flags & ImGuiScrollFlags_KeepVisibleEdgeX && !fully_visible_x {
        if item_rect.Min.x < scroll_rect.Min.x || !can_be_fully_visible_x {
            ImGui_SetScrollFromPosX(window, item_rect.Min.x - g.Style.ItemSpacing.x - window.Pos.x, 0.0f);
        } else if item_rect.Max.x >= scroll_rect.Max.x {
            ImGui_SetScrollFromPosX(window, item_rect.Max.x + g.Style.ItemSpacing.x - window.Pos.x, 1.0f);
        }
    } else if flags & ImGuiScrollFlags_KeepVisibleCenterX && !fully_visible_x || flags & ImGuiScrollFlags_AlwaysCenterX {
        if can_be_fully_visible_x != 0 {
            ImGui_SetScrollFromPosX(window, ImTrunc((item_rect.Min.x + item_rect.Max.x) * 0.5f) - window.Pos.x, 0.5f);
        } else {
            ImGui_SetScrollFromPosX(window, item_rect.Min.x - window.Pos.x, 0.0f);
        }
    }
    if flags & ImGuiScrollFlags_KeepVisibleEdgeY && !fully_visible_y {
        if item_rect.Min.y < scroll_rect.Min.y || !can_be_fully_visible_y {
            ImGui_SetScrollFromPosY(window, item_rect.Min.y - g.Style.ItemSpacing.y - window.Pos.y, 0.0f);
        } else if item_rect.Max.y >= scroll_rect.Max.y {
            ImGui_SetScrollFromPosY(window, item_rect.Max.y + g.Style.ItemSpacing.y - window.Pos.y, 1.0f);
        }
    } else if flags & ImGuiScrollFlags_KeepVisibleCenterY && !fully_visible_y || flags & ImGuiScrollFlags_AlwaysCenterY {
        if can_be_fully_visible_y != 0 {
            ImGui_SetScrollFromPosY(window, ImTrunc((item_rect.Min.y + item_rect.Max.y) * 0.5f) - window.Pos.y, 0.5f);
        } else {
            ImGui_SetScrollFromPosY(window, item_rect.Min.y - window.Pos.y, 0.0f);
        }
    }
    ImVec2 next_scroll = CalcNextScrollFromScrollTargetAndClamp(window);
    ImVec2 delta_scroll = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(next_scroll, window.Scroll);
    if !(flags & ImGuiScrollFlags_NoScrollParent) && window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow {
        if (in_flags & (ImGuiScrollFlags_AlwaysCenterX | ImGuiScrollFlags_KeepVisibleCenterX)) != 0 {
            in_flags = in_flags & ~ImGuiScrollFlags_MaskX_ | ImGuiScrollFlags_KeepVisibleEdgeX;
        }
        if (in_flags & (ImGuiScrollFlags_AlwaysCenterY | ImGuiScrollFlags_KeepVisibleCenterY)) != 0 {
            in_flags = in_flags & ~ImGuiScrollFlags_MaskY_ | ImGuiScrollFlags_KeepVisibleEdgeY;
        }
        delta_scroll = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(delta_scroll, ImGui_ScrollToRectEx(window.ParentWindow, ImRect{
            op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(item_rect.Min, delta_scroll),
            op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(item_rect.Max, delta_scroll),
        }, in_flags));
    }
    return delta_scroll;
}

// Note that a local position will vary depending on initial scroll value,
// This is a little bit confusing so bear with us:
//  - local_pos = (absolution_pos - window->Pos)
//  - So local_x/local_y are 0.0f for a position at the upper-left corner of a window,
//    and generally local_x/local_y are >(padding+decoration) && <(size-padding-decoration) when in the visible area.
//  - They mostly exist because of legacy API.
// Following the rules above, when trying to work with scrolling code, consider that:
//  - SetScrollFromPosY(0.0f) == SetScrollY(0.0f + scroll.y) == has no effect!
//  - SetScrollFromPosY(-scroll.y) == SetScrollY(-scroll.y + scroll.y) == SetScrollY(0.0f) == reset scroll. Of course writing SetScrollY(0.0f) directly then makes more sense
// We store a target position so centering and clamping can occur on the next frame when we are guaranteed to have a known window size
void ImGui_SetScrollFromPosX(ImGuiWindow* window, f32 local_x, f32 center_x_ratio) {
    assert(center_x_ratio >= 0.0f && center_x_ratio <= 1.0f);
    window.ScrollTarget.x = cast(f32, cast(i32, local_x - window.DecoOuterSizeX1 - window.DecoInnerSizeX1 + window.Scroll.x));
    window.ScrollTargetCenterRatio.x = center_x_ratio;
    window.ScrollTargetEdgeSnapDist.x = 0.0f;
}

    assert(center_y_ratio >= 0.0f && center_y_ratio <= 1.0f);
    window.ScrollTarget.y = cast(f32, cast(i32, local_y - window.DecoOuterSizeY1 - window.DecoInnerSizeY1 + window.Scroll.y));
    window.ScrollTargetCenterRatio.y = center_y_ratio;

}

// center_x_ratio: 0.0f left of last item, 0.5f horizontal center of last item, 1.0f right of last item.
void ImGui_SetScrollHereX(f32 center_x_ratio) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    f32 spacing_x = ImMax(window.WindowPadding.x, g.Style.ItemSpacing.x);
    f32 target_pos_x = ImLerp(g.LastItemData.Rect.Min.x - spacing_x, g.LastItemData.Rect.Max.x + spacing_x, center_x_ratio);

    window.ScrollTargetEdgeSnapDist.x = ImMax(0.0f, window.WindowPadding.x - spacing_x);
}

// center_y_ratio: 0.0f top of last item, 0.5f vertical center of last item, 1.0f bottom of last item.

    ImGui_SetScrollFromPosY(window, target_pos_y - window.Pos.y, center_y_ratio);
    window.ScrollTargetEdgeSnapDist.y = ImMax(0.0f, window.WindowPadding.y - spacing_y);
}

                ImGuiPopupData* zz_rf_it_35 = ImVector_ImGuiPopupData_begin(&g.OpenPopupStack);
                ImGuiPopupData* zz_rf_end_35 = ImVector_ImGuiPopupData_end(&g.OpenPopupStack);
                for ; zz_rf_it_35 != zz_rf_end_35; zz_rf_it_35++ {
                    ImGuiPopupData* popup_data = zz_rf_it_35;
                    if popup_data.PopupId == id {

}

// When a modal popup is open, newly created windows that want focus (i.e. are not popups and do not specify ImGuiWindowFlags_NoFocusOnAppearing)
// should be positioned behind that modal window, unless the window was created inside the modal begin-stack.
// In case of multiple stacked modals newly created window honors begin stack order and does not go below its own modal parent.
// - WindowA            // FindBlockingModal() returns Modal1
//   - WindowB          //                  .. returns Modal1
//   - Modal1           //                  .. returns Modal2
//      - WindowC       //                  .. returns Modal2
//          - WindowD   //                  .. returns Modal2
//          - Modal2    //                  .. returns Modal2
//            - WindowE //                  .. returns NULL
// Notes:
// - FindBlockingModal(NULL) == NULL is generally equivalent to GetTopMostPopupModal() == NULL.
//   Only difference is here we check for ->Active/WasActive but it may be unnecessary.
ImGuiWindow* ImGui_FindBlockingModal(ImGuiWindow* window) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if g.OpenPopupStack.Size <= 0 {
        return null;
    }
    {
        ImGuiPopupData* zz_rf_it_36 = ImVector_ImGuiPopupData_begin(&g.OpenPopupStack);
        ImGuiPopupData* zz_rf_end_36 = ImVector_ImGuiPopupData_end(&g.OpenPopupStack);
        for ; zz_rf_it_36 != zz_rf_end_36; zz_rf_it_36++ {
            ImGuiPopupData* popup_data = zz_rf_it_36;
            ImGuiWindow* popup_window = popup_data.Window;
            if popup_window == null || !(popup_window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Modal) {
                continue;
            }
            if !popup_window.Active && !popup_window.WasActive {
                continue;
            }
            if window == null {
                return popup_window;
            }
            if ImGui_IsWindowWithinBeginStackOf(window, popup_window) != 0 {
                continue;
            }
            return popup_window;
        }
    }
    return null;
}

// Mark popup as open (toggle toward open state).
// - Return true when the popup is toggled open, which allows you to capture local state if needed.
//   You may also call IsWindowAppearing() inside the later BeginPopup() scope if you need to prepare/compute data for the popup.
// - Popups are closed when user click outside, or activate a pressable item, or CloseCurrentPopup() is called within a BeginPopup()/EndPopup() block.
// - Popup identifiers are relative to the current ID-stack (so OpenPopup and BeginPopup needs to be at the same level).
// - One open popup per level of the popup hierarchy (NB: when assigning we reset the Window member of ImGuiPopupRef to NULL).
bool ImGui_OpenPopupEx(ImGuiID id, ImGuiPopupFlags popup_flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* parent_window = g.CurrentWindow;
    i32 current_stack_size = g.BeginPopupStack.Size;
    if (popup_flags & ImGuiPopupFlags_NoOpenOverExistingPopup) != 0 {
        if ImGui_IsPopupOpen(cast(ImGuiID, 0), ImGuiPopupFlags_AnyPopupId) != 0 {
            return false;
        }
    }
    ImGuiPopupData popup_ref;
    popup_ref.PopupId = id;
    popup_ref.Window = null;
    popup_ref.RestoreNavWindow = g.NavWindow;
    popup_ref.OpenFrameCount = g.FrameCount;
    popup_ref.OpenParentId = *ImVector_ImGuiID_back(&parent_window.IDStack);
    popup_ref.OpenPopupPos = ImGui_NavCalcPreferredRefPos(ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup);
    popup_ref.OpenMousePos = ImGui_IsMousePosValid(&g.IO.MousePos) != 0 ? g.IO.MousePos : popup_ref.OpenPopupPos;
    while true {
        if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventPopup) != 0 {
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    if g.OpenPopupStack.Size < current_stack_size + 1 {
        ImVector_ImGuiPopupData_push_back(&g.OpenPopupStack, popup_ref);
        return true;
    } else {
        bool keep_existing = false;
        if g.OpenPopupStack.Data[current_stack_size].PopupId == id {
            if g.OpenPopupStack.Data[current_stack_size].OpenFrameCount == g.FrameCount - 1 || popup_flags & ImGuiPopupFlags_NoReopen {
                keep_existing = true;
            }
        }
        if keep_existing != 0 {
            g.OpenPopupStack.Data[current_stack_size].OpenFrameCount = popup_ref.OpenFrameCount;
        } else {
            ImGui_ClosePopupToLevel(current_stack_size, true);
            ImVector_ImGuiPopupData_push_back(&g.OpenPopupStack, popup_ref);
        }
        return !keep_existing;
    }
}

// When popups are stacked, clicking on a lower level popups puts focus back to it and close popups above it.
// This function closes any popups that are over 'ref_window'.
void ImGui_ClosePopupsOverWindow(ImGuiWindow* ref_window, bool restore_focus_to_window_under_popup) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if g.OpenPopupStack.Size == 0 {
        return;
    }
    i32 popup_count_to_keep = 0;
    if ref_window != null {
        for ; popup_count_to_keep < g.OpenPopupStack.Size; popup_count_to_keep++ {
            ImGuiPopupData* popup = &g.OpenPopupStack.Data[popup_count_to_keep];
            if popup.Window == null {
                continue;
            }
            assert((popup.Window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup) != 0);
            bool ref_window_is_descendant_of_popup = false;
            for i32 n = popup_count_to_keep; n < g.OpenPopupStack.Size; n++ {
                ImGuiWindow* popup_window = g.OpenPopupStack.Data[n].Window;
                if popup_window != null {
                    if ImGui_IsWindowWithinBeginStackOf(ref_window, popup_window) != 0 {
                        ref_window_is_descendant_of_popup = true;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
            if ref_window_is_descendant_of_popup == 0 {
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    if popup_count_to_keep < g.OpenPopupStack.Size {
        while true {
            if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventPopup) != 0 {
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
        ImGui_ClosePopupToLevel(popup_count_to_keep, restore_focus_to_window_under_popup);
    }
}

void ImGui_ClosePopupsExceptModals() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    i32 popup_count_to_keep;
    for popup_count_to_keep = g.OpenPopupStack.Size; popup_count_to_keep > 0; popup_count_to_keep-- {
        ImGuiWindow* window = g.OpenPopupStack.Data[popup_count_to_keep - 1].Window;
        if !window || window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Modal {
            break;
        }
    }
    if popup_count_to_keep < g.OpenPopupStack.Size {
        ImGui_ClosePopupToLevel(popup_count_to_keep, true);
    }
}

void ImGui_ClosePopupToLevel(i32 remaining, bool restore_focus_to_window_under_popup) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    while true {
        if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventPopup) != 0 {
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    assert(remaining >= 0 && remaining < g.OpenPopupStack.Size);
    if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventPopup) != 0 {
        for i32 n = remaining; n < g.OpenPopupStack.Size; n++ {
            while true {
                if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventPopup) != 0 {
                }
                if !(0 != 0) { break; }
            }
        }
    }
    ImGuiPopupData prev_popup = g.OpenPopupStack.Data[remaining];
    ImVector_ImGuiPopupData_resize(&g.OpenPopupStack, remaining);
    if restore_focus_to_window_under_popup && prev_popup.Window {
        ImGuiWindow* popup_window = prev_popup.Window;
        ImGuiWindow* focus_window = (popup_window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildMenu) != 0 ? popup_window.ParentWindow : prev_popup.RestoreNavWindow;
        if focus_window && !focus_window.WasActive {
            ImGui_FocusTopMostWindowUnderOne(popup_window, null, null, ImGuiFocusRequestFlags_RestoreFocusedChild);
        } else {
            ImGui_FocusWindow(focus_window, g.NavLayer == ImGuiNavLayer_Main ? ImGuiFocusRequestFlags_RestoreFocusedChild : ImGuiFocusRequestFlags_None);
        }
    }
}

// Close the popup we have begin-ed into.
void ImGui_CloseCurrentPopup() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    i32 popup_idx = g.BeginPopupStack.Size - 1;
    if popup_idx < 0 || popup_idx >= g.OpenPopupStack.Size || g.BeginPopupStack.Data[popup_idx].PopupId != g.OpenPopupStack.Data[popup_idx].PopupId {
        return;
    }
    while popup_idx > 0 {
        ImGuiWindow* popup_window = g.OpenPopupStack.Data[popup_idx].Window;
        ImGuiWindow* parent_popup_window = g.OpenPopupStack.Data[popup_idx - 1].Window;
        bool close_parent = false;
        if popup_window && popup_window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildMenu {
            if parent_popup_window && !(parent_popup_window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_MenuBar) {
                close_parent = true;
            }
        }
        if close_parent == 0 {
            break;
        }
        popup_idx--;
    }
    while true {
        if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventPopup) != 0 {
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    ImGui_ClosePopupToLevel(popup_idx, true);
    {
        ImGuiWindow* window = g.NavWindow;
        if window != null {
            window.DC.NavHideHighlightOneFrame = true;
        }
    }
}

// Attention! BeginPopup() adds default flags when calling BeginPopupEx()!
bool ImGui_BeginPopupEx(ImGuiID id, ImGuiWindowFlags extra_window_flags) {

    }

}

bool ImGui_BeginPopupMenuEx(ImGuiID id, u8* label, ImGuiWindowFlags extra_window_flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if ImGui_IsPopupOpen(id, ImGuiPopupFlags_None) == 0 {
        ImGuiNextWindowData_ClearFlags(&g.NextWindowData);
        return false;
    }
    if extra_window_flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow && extra_window_flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize {

    ImFormatString(name, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(name) / sizeof(*name))), "%s###Menu_%02d", label, g.BeginMenuDepth);

bool ImGui_BeginPopup(u8* str_id, ImGuiWindowFlags flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if g.OpenPopupStack.Size <= g.BeginPopupStack.Size {
        ImGuiNextWindowData_ClearFlags(&g.NextWindowData);
        return false;
    }
    flags |= ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings;
    ImGuiID id = ImGuiWindow_GetID(g.CurrentWindow, str_id, null);
    return ImGui_BeginPopupEx(id, flags);
}

// If 'p_open' is specified for a modal popup window, the popup will have a regular close button which will close the popup.
// Note that popup visibility status is owned by Dear ImGui (and manipulated with e.g. OpenPopup).
// - *p_open set back to false in BeginPopupModal() when popup is not open.
// - if you set *p_open to false before calling BeginPopupModal(), it will close the popup.
bool ImGui_BeginPopupModal(u8* name, bool* p_open, ImGuiWindowFlags flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    ImGuiID id = ImGuiWindow_GetID(window, name, null);
    if ImGui_IsPopupOpen(id, ImGuiPopupFlags_None) == 0 {
        ImGuiNextWindowData_ClearFlags(&g.NextWindowData);
        if p_open && *p_open {
            *p_open = false;
        }
        return false;
    }
    if (g.NextWindowData.HasFlags & ImGuiNextWindowDataFlags_HasPos) == 0 {
        var viewport = cast(ImGuiViewport*, window.WasActive != 0 ? cast(ImGuiViewport*, window.Viewport) : ImGui_GetMainViewport());
        ImGui_SetNextWindowPos(ImGuiViewport_GetCenter(viewport), ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver, ImVec2{0.5f, 0.5f});
    }
    flags |= ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup | ImGuiWindowFlags_Modal | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoCollapse | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDocking;
    bool is_open = ImGui_Begin(name, p_open, flags);
    if !is_open || p_open && !*p_open {
        ImGui_EndPopup();
        if is_open != 0 {
            ImGui_ClosePopupToLevel(g.BeginPopupStack.Size, true);
        }
        return false;
    }
    return is_open;
}

void ImGui_EndPopup() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    while true {
        if ((window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup) != 0 && g.BeginPopupStack.Size > 0) == 0 {
            if ImGui_ErrorLog("Calling EndPopup() in wrong window!") != 0 {
                assert((window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup) != 0 && g.BeginPopupStack.Size > 0 && "Calling EndPopup() in wrong window!");
            }
            return;
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    if g.NavWindow == window {
        ImGui_NavMoveRequestTryWrapping(window, ImGuiNavMoveFlags_LoopY);
    }
    ImGuiID backup_within_end_popup_id = g.WithinEndPopupID;
    ImGuiID backup_within_end_child_id = g.WithinEndChildID;
    g.WithinEndPopupID = window.ID;
    if (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow) != 0 {
        g.WithinEndChildID = window.ID;
    }
    ImGui_End();
    g.WithinEndPopupID = backup_within_end_popup_id;
    g.WithinEndChildID = backup_within_end_child_id;
}

ImGuiMouseButton ImGui_GetMouseButtonFromPopupFlags(ImGuiPopupFlags flags) {
    assert((flags & ImGuiPopupFlags_InvalidMask_) == 0);
    if (flags & ImGuiPopupFlags_MouseButtonMask_) != 0 {
        return ((flags & ImGuiPopupFlags_MouseButtonMask_) >> ImGuiPopupFlags_MouseButtonShift_) - 1;

bool ImGui_IsPopupOpenRequestForWindow(ImGuiPopupFlags popup_flags) {

// Helper to open a popup if mouse button is released over the item

// This is a helper to handle the simplest case of associating one named popup to one given widget.
// - To create a popup associated to the last item, you generally want to pass a NULL value to str_id.
// - To create a popup with a specific identifier, pass it in str_id.
//    - This is useful when using using BeginPopupContextItem() on an item which doesn't have an identifier, e.g. a Text() call.
//    - This is useful when multiple code locations may want to manipulate/open the same popup, given an explicit id.
// - You may want to handle the whole on user side if you have specific needs (e.g. tweaking IsItemHovered() parameters).
//   This is essentially the same as:
//       id = str_id ? GetID(str_id) : GetItemID();
//       OpenPopupOnItemClick(str_id, ImGuiPopupFlags_MouseButtonRight);
//       return BeginPopup(id);
//   Which is essentially the same as:
//       id = str_id ? GetID(str_id) : GetItemID();
//       if (IsItemHovered() && IsMouseReleased(ImGuiMouseButton_Right))
//           OpenPopup(id);
//       return BeginPopup(id);
//   The main difference being that this is tweaked to avoid computing the ID twice.
bool ImGui_BeginPopupContextItem(u8* str_id, ImGuiPopupFlags popup_flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiID id = str_id != null ? ImGuiWindow_GetID(window, str_id, null) : g.LastItemData.ID;
    assert(id != 0);
    if ImGui_IsPopupOpenRequestForItem(popup_flags, g.LastItemData.ID) != 0 {
        ImGui_OpenPopupEx(id, popup_flags);
    }
    return ImGui_BeginPopupEx(id, ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings);
}

// r_avoid = the rectangle to avoid (e.g. for tooltip it is a rectangle around the mouse cursor which we want to avoid. for popups it's a small point around the cursor.)
// r_outer = the visible area rectangle, minus safe area padding. If our popup size won't fit because of safe area padding we ignore it.
// (r_outer is usually equivalent to the viewport rectangle minus padding, but when multi-viewports are enabled and monitor
//  information are available, it may represent the entire platform monitor from the frame of reference of the current viewport.
//  this allows us to have tooltips/popups displayed out of the parent viewport.)
ImVec2 ImGui_FindBestWindowPosForPopupEx(ImVec2 ref_pos, ImVec2 size, ImGuiDir* last_dir, ImRect r_outer, ImRect r_avoid, ImGuiPopupPositionPolicy policy) {
    ImVec2 base_pos_clamped = ImClamp(ref_pos, r_outer.Min, op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(r_outer.Max, size));
    if policy == ImGuiPopupPositionPolicy_ComboBox {
        ImGuiDir[4] dir_preferred_order = {ImGuiDir_Down, ImGuiDir_Right, ImGuiDir_Left, ImGuiDir_Up};
        for i32 n = *last_dir != ImGuiDir_None ? -1 : 0; n < ImGuiDir_COUNT; n++ {
            ImGuiDir dir = n == -1 ? *last_dir : dir_preferred_order[n];
            if n != -1 && dir == *last_dir {
                continue;
            }
            ImVec2 pos;
            if dir == ImGuiDir_Down {
                pos = ImVec2{r_avoid.Min.x, r_avoid.Max.y};
            }
            if dir == ImGuiDir_Right {
                pos = ImVec2{r_avoid.Min.x, r_avoid.Min.y - size.y};
            }
            if dir == ImGuiDir_Left {
                pos = ImVec2{r_avoid.Max.x - size.x, r_avoid.Max.y};
            }
            if dir == ImGuiDir_Up {
                pos = ImVec2{r_avoid.Max.x - size.x, r_avoid.Min.y - size.y};
            }
            if ImRect_Contains(&r_outer, ImRect{pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(pos, size)}) == 0 {
                continue;
            }
            *last_dir = dir;
            return pos;
        }
    }
    if policy == ImGuiPopupPositionPolicy_Tooltip || policy == ImGuiPopupPositionPolicy_Default {
        ImGuiDir[4] dir_preferred_order = {ImGuiDir_Right, ImGuiDir_Down, ImGuiDir_Up, ImGuiDir_Left};
        for i32 n = *last_dir != ImGuiDir_None ? -1 : 0; n < ImGuiDir_COUNT; n++ {
            ImGuiDir dir = n == -1 ? *last_dir : dir_preferred_order[n];
            if n != -1 && dir == *last_dir {
                continue;
            }
            f32 avail_w = (dir == ImGuiDir_Left ? r_avoid.Min.x : r_outer.Max.x) - (dir == ImGuiDir_Right ? r_avoid.Max.x : r_outer.Min.x);
            f32 avail_h = (dir == ImGuiDir_Up ? r_avoid.Min.y : r_outer.Max.y) - (dir == ImGuiDir_Down ? r_avoid.Max.y : r_outer.Min.y);
            if avail_w < size.x && (dir == ImGuiDir_Left || dir == ImGuiDir_Right) {
                continue;
            }
            if avail_h < size.y && (dir == ImGuiDir_Up || dir == ImGuiDir_Down) {
                continue;
            }
            ImVec2 pos;
            pos.x = dir == ImGuiDir_Left ? r_avoid.Min.x - size.x : dir == ImGuiDir_Right ? r_avoid.Max.x : base_pos_clamped.x;
            pos.y = dir == ImGuiDir_Up ? r_avoid.Min.y - size.y : dir == ImGuiDir_Down ? r_avoid.Max.y : base_pos_clamped.y;
            pos.x = ImMax(pos.x, r_outer.Min.x);
            pos.y = ImMax(pos.y, r_outer.Min.y);
            *last_dir = dir;
            return pos;
        }
    }
    *last_dir = ImGuiDir_None;
    if policy == ImGuiPopupPositionPolicy_Tooltip {
        return op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(ref_pos, ImVec2{2.0f, 2.0f});
    }
    ImVec2 pos = ref_pos;
    pos.x = ImMax(ImMin(pos.x + size.x, r_outer.Max.x) - size.x, r_outer.Min.x);
    pos.y = ImMax(ImMin(pos.y + size.y, r_outer.Max.y) - size.y, r_outer.Min.y);
    return pos;
}

// Note that this is used for popups, which can overlap the non work-area of individual viewports.
ImRect ImGui_GetPopupAllowedExtentRect(ImGuiWindow* window) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImRect r_screen;
    if window.ViewportAllowPlatformMonitorExtend >= 0 {
        ImGuiPlatformMonitor monitor = g.PlatformIO.Monitors.Data[window.ViewportAllowPlatformMonitorExtend];
        r_screen.Min = monitor.WorkPos;
        r_screen.Max = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(monitor.WorkPos, monitor.WorkSize);
    } else {
        r_screen = ImGuiViewportP_GetMainRect(window.Viewport);
    }
    ImVec2 padding = g.Style.DisplaySafeAreaPadding;
    ImRect_Expand(&r_screen, ImVec2{
        ImRect_GetWidth(&r_screen) > padding.x * 2.0f ? -padding.x : 0.0f,
        ImRect_GetHeight(&r_screen) > padding.y * 2.0f ? -padding.y : 0.0f,
    });
    return r_screen;
}

ImVec2 ImGui_FindBestWindowPosForPopup(ImGuiWindow* window) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImRect r_outer = ImGui_GetPopupAllowedExtentRect(window);
    if (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildMenu) != 0 {
        ImGuiWindow* parent_window = window.ParentWindow;
        f32 horizontal_overlap = g.Style.ItemInnerSpacing.x;
        ImRect r_avoid;
        if parent_window.DC.MenuBarAppending != 0 {
            r_avoid = ImRect{
                ImVec2{-FLT_MAX, parent_window.ClipRect.Min.y},
                ImVec2{FLT_MAX, parent_window.ClipRect.Max.y},
            };
        } else {
            r_avoid = ImRect{
                ImVec2{parent_window.Pos.x + horizontal_overlap, -FLT_MAX},
                ImVec2{
                    parent_window.Pos.x + parent_window.Size.x - horizontal_overlap - parent_window.ScrollbarSizes.x,
                    FLT_MAX,
                },
            };
        }
        return ImGui_FindBestWindowPosForPopupEx(window.Pos, window.Size, &window.AutoPosLastDirection, r_outer, r_avoid, ImGuiPopupPositionPolicy_Default);
    }
    if (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup) != 0 {
        return ImGui_FindBestWindowPosForPopupEx(window.Pos, window.Size, &window.AutoPosLastDirection, r_outer, ImRect{window.Pos, window.Pos}, ImGuiPopupPositionPolicy_Default);
    }
    if (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Tooltip) != 0 {
        assert(g.CurrentWindow == window);
        f32 scale = g.Style.MouseCursorScale;
        ImVec2 ref_pos = ImGui_NavCalcPreferredRefPos(ImGuiWindowFlags_Tooltip);
        if g.IO.MouseSource == ImGuiMouseSource_TouchScreen && ImGui_NavCalcPreferredRefPosSource(ImGuiWindowFlags_Tooltip) == ImGuiInputSource_Mouse {
            ImVec2 tooltip_pos = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(ref_pos, op_mul_ImVec2_float(TOOLTIP_DEFAULT_OFFSET_TOUCH, scale)), op_mul_ImVec2_ImVec2(TOOLTIP_DEFAULT_PIVOT_TOUCH, window.Size));
            if ImRect_Contains(&r_outer, ImRect{
                tooltip_pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(tooltip_pos, window.Size),
            }) != 0 {
                return tooltip_pos;
            }
        }
        ImVec2 tooltip_pos = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(ref_pos, op_mul_ImVec2_float(TOOLTIP_DEFAULT_OFFSET_MOUSE, scale));
        ImRect r_avoid;
        if g.NavCursorVisible && g.NavHighlightItemUnderNav && !g.IO.ConfigNavMoveSetMousePos {
            r_avoid = ImRect{
                ImVec2{ref_pos.x - 16.0f, ref_pos.y - 8.0f},
                ImVec2{ref_pos.x + 16.0f, ref_pos.y + 8.0f},
            };
        } else {
            r_avoid = ImRect{
                ImVec2{ref_pos.x - 16.0f, ref_pos.y - 8.0f},
                ImVec2{ref_pos.x + 24.0f * scale, ref_pos.y + 24.0f * scale},
            };
        }
        return ImGui_FindBestWindowPosForPopupEx(tooltip_pos, window.Size, &window.AutoPosLastDirection, r_outer, r_avoid, ImGuiPopupPositionPolicy_Tooltip);
    }
    assert(0);
    return window.Pos;
}

// Similar to IsWindowHovered()
bool ImGui_IsWindowFocused(ImGuiFocusedFlags flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* ref_window = g.NavWindow;
    ImGuiWindow* cur_window = g.CurrentWindow;
    if ref_window == null {
        return false;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiFocusedFlags_AnyWindow) != 0 {
        return true;
    }
    assert(cast(i64, cur_window));
    bool popup_hierarchy = (flags & ImGuiFocusedFlags_NoPopupHierarchy) == 0;
    bool dock_hierarchy = (flags & ImGuiFocusedFlags_DockHierarchy) != 0;
    if (flags & ImGuiFocusedFlags_RootWindow) != 0 {
        cur_window = GetCombinedRootWindow(cur_window, popup_hierarchy, dock_hierarchy);
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiFocusedFlags_ChildWindows) != 0 {
        return ImGui_IsWindowChildOf(ref_window, cur_window, popup_hierarchy, dock_hierarchy);
    } else {
        return ref_window == cur_window;
    }
}

private {
i32 ImGui_FindWindowFocusIndex(ImGuiWindow* window) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ignore *g;
    i32 order = window.FocusOrder;
    assert(window.RootWindow == window);
    assert(g.WindowsFocusOrder.Data[order] == window);
    return order;
}

void ImGui_UpdateWindowInFocusOrderList(ImGuiWindow* window, bool just_created, ImGuiWindowFlags new_flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    bool new_is_explicit_child = (new_flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow) != 0 && ((new_flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup) == 0 || (new_flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildMenu) != 0);
    bool child_flag_changed = new_is_explicit_child != window.IsExplicitChild;
    if (just_created || child_flag_changed) && !new_is_explicit_child {
        assert(cast(i64, !ImVector_ImGuiWindow_ptr_contains(&g.WindowsFocusOrder, window)));
        ImVector_ImGuiWindow_ptr_push_back(&g.WindowsFocusOrder, window);
        window.FocusOrder = cast(i16, g.WindowsFocusOrder.Size - 1);
    } else if !just_created && child_flag_changed && new_is_explicit_child {
        assert(g.WindowsFocusOrder.Data[window.FocusOrder] == window);
        for i32 n = window.FocusOrder + 1; n < g.WindowsFocusOrder.Size; n++ {
            g.WindowsFocusOrder.Data[n].FocusOrder--;
        }
        ImVector_ImGuiWindow_ptr_erase(&g.WindowsFocusOrder, g.WindowsFocusOrder.Data + window.FocusOrder);
        window.FocusOrder = -1;
    }
    window.IsExplicitChild = new_is_explicit_child;
}
}

void ImGui_BringWindowToFocusFront(ImGuiWindow* window) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(window == window.RootWindow);
    i32 cur_order = window.FocusOrder;
    assert(g.WindowsFocusOrder.Data[cur_order] == window);
    if *ImVector_ImGuiWindow_ptr_back(&g.WindowsFocusOrder) == window {
        return;
    }
    i32 new_order = g.WindowsFocusOrder.Size - 1;
    for i32 n = cur_order; n < new_order; n++ {
        g.WindowsFocusOrder.Data[n] = g.WindowsFocusOrder.Data[n + 1];
        g.WindowsFocusOrder.Data[n].FocusOrder--;
        assert(g.WindowsFocusOrder.Data[n].FocusOrder == n);
    }
    g.WindowsFocusOrder.Data[new_order] = window;
    window.FocusOrder = cast(i16, new_order);
}

// Note technically focus related but rather adjacent and close to BringWindowToFocusFront()
// FIXME-FOCUS: Could opt-in/opt-out enable modal check like in FocusWindow().
void ImGui_BringWindowToDisplayFront(ImGuiWindow* window) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* current_front_window = *ImVector_ImGuiWindow_ptr_back(&g.Windows);
    if current_front_window == window || current_front_window.RootWindowDockTree == window {
        return;
    }
    for i32 i = g.Windows.Size - 2; i >= 0; i-- {
        if g.Windows.Data[i] == window {
            memmove(&g.Windows.Data[i], &g.Windows.Data[i + 1], cast(u64, g.Windows.Size - i - 1) * cast(u64, sizeof(ImGuiWindow*)));
            g.Windows.Data[g.Windows.Size - 1] = window;
            break;
        }
    }
}

void ImGui_BringWindowToDisplayBack(ImGuiWindow* window) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if g.Windows.Data[0] == window {
        return;
    }
    for i32 i = 0; i < g.Windows.Size; i++ {
        if g.Windows.Data[i] == window {
            memmove(&g.Windows.Data[1], &g.Windows.Data[0], cast(u64, i) * cast(u64, sizeof(ImGuiWindow*)));
            g.Windows.Data[0] = window;
            break;
        }
    }
}

void ImGui_BringWindowToDisplayBehind(ImGuiWindow* window, ImGuiWindow* behind_window) {
    assert(window != null && behind_window != null);
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    window = window.RootWindow;
    behind_window = behind_window.RootWindow;
    i32 pos_wnd = ImGui_FindWindowDisplayIndex(window);
    i32 pos_beh = ImGui_FindWindowDisplayIndex(behind_window);
    if pos_wnd < pos_beh {
        var copy_bytes = cast(u64, (pos_beh - pos_wnd - 1) * sizeof(ImGuiWindow*));
        memmove(&g.Windows.Data[pos_wnd], &g.Windows.Data[pos_wnd + 1], copy_bytes);
        g.Windows.Data[pos_beh - 1] = window;
    } else {
        var copy_bytes = cast(u64, (pos_wnd - pos_beh) * sizeof(ImGuiWindow*));
        memmove(&g.Windows.Data[pos_beh + 1], &g.Windows.Data[pos_beh], copy_bytes);
        g.Windows.Data[pos_beh] = window;
    }
}

i32 ImGui_FindWindowDisplayIndex(ImGuiWindow* window) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    return ImVector_ImGuiWindow_ptr_index_from_ptr(&g.Windows, ImVector_ImGuiWindow_ptr_find(&g.Windows, window));
}

// Moving window to front of display and set focus (which happens to be back of our sorted list)
void ImGui_FocusWindow(ImGuiWindow* window, ImGuiFocusRequestFlags flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if flags & ImGuiFocusRequestFlags_UnlessBelowModal && g.NavWindow != window {
        ImGuiWindow* blocking_modal = ImGui_FindBlockingModal(window);
        if blocking_modal != null {
            while true {
                if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventFocus) != 0 {
                }
                if !(0 != 0) { break; }
            }
            if window && window == window.RootWindow && (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoBringToFrontOnFocus) == 0 {
                ImGui_BringWindowToDisplayBehind(window, blocking_modal);
            }
            ImGui_ClosePopupsOverWindow(ImGui_GetTopMostPopupModal(), false);
            return;
        }
    }
    if flags & ImGuiFocusRequestFlags_RestoreFocusedChild && window != null {
        window = ImGui_NavRestoreLastChildNavWindow(window);
    }
    if g.NavWindow != window {
        ImGui_SetNavWindow(window);
        if window && g.NavHighlightItemUnderNav {
            g.NavMousePosDirty = true;
        }
        g.NavId = window != null ? window.NavLastIds[0] : 0;
        g.NavLayer = ImGuiNavLayer_Main;
        ImGui_SetNavFocusScope(window != null ? window.NavRootFocusScopeId : 0);
        g.NavIdIsAlive = false;
        g.NavLastValidSelectionUserData = cast(ImGuiSelectionUserData, -1);
        ImGui_ClosePopupsOverWindow(window, false);
    }
    assert(window == null || window.RootWindowDockTree != null);
    ImGuiWindow* focus_front_window = window != null ? window.RootWindow : null;
    ImGuiWindow* display_front_window = window != null ? window.RootWindowDockTree : null;
    ImGuiDockNode* dock_node = window != null ? window.DockNode : null;
    bool active_id_window_is_dock_node_host = g.ActiveIdWindow && dock_node && dock_node.HostWindow == g.ActiveIdWindow;
    if g.ActiveId != 0 && g.ActiveIdWindow && g.ActiveIdWindow.RootWindow != focus_front_window {
        if !g.ActiveIdNoClearOnFocusLoss && !active_id_window_is_dock_node_host {
            ImGui_ClearActiveID();
        }
    }
    if window == null {
        return;
    }
    window.LastFrameJustFocused = g.FrameCount;
    ImGui_BringWindowToFocusFront(focus_front_window);
    if ((window.Flags | focus_front_window.Flags | display_front_window.Flags) & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoBringToFrontOnFocus) == 0 {
        ImGui_BringWindowToDisplayFront(display_front_window);
    }
}

void ImGui_FocusTopMostWindowUnderOne(ImGuiWindow* under_this_window, ImGuiWindow* ignore_window, ImGuiViewport* filter_viewport, ImGuiFocusRequestFlags flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    i32 start_idx = g.WindowsFocusOrder.Size - 1;
    if under_this_window != null {
        i32 offset = -1;
        while (under_this_window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow) != 0 {
            under_this_window = under_this_window.ParentWindow;
            offset = 0;
        }
        start_idx = ImGui_FindWindowFocusIndex(under_this_window) + offset;
    }
    for i32 i = start_idx; i >= 0; i-- {
        ImGuiWindow* window = g.WindowsFocusOrder.Data[i];
        if window == ignore_window || !window.WasActive {
            continue;
        }
        if filter_viewport != null && cast(ImGuiViewport*, window.Viewport) != filter_viewport {
            continue;
        }
        if (window.Flags & (ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMouseInputs | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNavInputs)) != (ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMouseInputs | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNavInputs) {
            ImGui_FocusWindow(window, flags);
            return;
        }
    }
    ImGui_FocusWindow(null, flags);
}

private {
ImGuiDir ImGetDirQuadrantFromDelta(f32 dx, f32 dy) {
    if fabs(dx) > fabs(dy) {
        return dx > 0.0f ? ImGuiDir_Right : ImGuiDir_Left;
    }
    return dy > 0.0f ? ImGuiDir_Down : ImGuiDir_Up;
}

f32 NavScoreItemDistInterval(f32 cand_min, f32 cand_max, f32 curr_min, f32 curr_max) {
    if cand_max < curr_min {
        return cand_max - curr_min;
    }
    if curr_max < cand_min {
        return cand_min - curr_max;
    }
    return 0.0f;
}

// Scoring function for keyboard/gamepad directional navigation. Based on https://gist.github.com/rygorous/6981057
bool ImGui_NavScoreItem(ImGuiNavItemData* result, ImRect nav_bb) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    if g.NavLayer != window.DC.NavLayerCurrent {
        return false;
    }
    ImRect cand = nav_bb;
    ImRect curr = g.NavScoringRect;
    g.NavScoringDebugCount++;
    if window.ParentWindow == g.NavWindow {
        assert((window.ChildFlags | g.NavWindow.ChildFlags) & ImGuiChildFlags_NavFlattened);
        if ImRect_Overlaps(&window.ClipRect, cand) == 0 {
            return false;
        }
        ImRect_ClipWithFull(&cand, window.ClipRect);
    }
    f32 dbx = NavScoreItemDistInterval(cand.Min.x, cand.Max.x, curr.Min.x, curr.Max.x);
    f32 dby = NavScoreItemDistInterval(ImLerp(cand.Min.y, cand.Max.y, 0.2f), ImLerp(cand.Min.y, cand.Max.y, 0.8f), ImLerp(curr.Min.y, curr.Max.y, 0.2f), ImLerp(curr.Min.y, curr.Max.y, 0.8f));
    if dby != 0.0f && dbx != 0.0f {
        dbx = dbx / 1000.0f + (dbx > 0.0f ? 1.0f : -1.0f);
    }
    f32 dist_box = fabs(dbx) + fabs(dby);
    f32 dcx = cand.Min.x + cand.Max.x - (curr.Min.x + curr.Max.x);
    f32 dcy = cand.Min.y + cand.Max.y - (curr.Min.y + curr.Max.y);
    f32 dist_center = fabs(dcx) + fabs(dcy);
    ImGuiDir quadrant;
    f32 dax = 0.0f;
    f32 day = 0.0f;
    f32 dist_axial = 0.0f;
    if dbx != 0.0f || dby != 0.0f {
        dax = dbx;
        day = dby;
        dist_axial = dist_box;
        quadrant = ImGetDirQuadrantFromDelta(dbx, dby);
    } else if dcx != 0.0f || dcy != 0.0f {
        dax = dcx;
        day = dcy;
        dist_axial = dist_center;
        quadrant = ImGetDirQuadrantFromDelta(dcx, dcy);
    } else {
        quadrant = g.LastItemData.ID < g.NavId ? ImGuiDir_Left : ImGuiDir_Right;
    }
    ImGuiDir move_dir = g.NavMoveDir;
    bool new_best = false;
    if quadrant == move_dir {
        if dist_box < result.DistBox {
            result.DistBox = dist_box;
            result.DistCenter = dist_center;
            return true;
        }
        if dist_box == result.DistBox {
            if dist_center < result.DistCenter {
                result.DistCenter = dist_center;
                new_best = true;
            } else if dist_center == result.DistCenter {
                if (move_dir == ImGuiDir_Up || move_dir == ImGuiDir_Down ? dby : dbx) < 0.0f {
                    new_best = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if result.DistBox == FLT_MAX && dist_axial < result.DistAxial {
        if g.NavLayer == ImGuiNavLayer_Menu && !(g.NavWindow.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildMenu) {
            if move_dir == ImGuiDir_Left && dax < 0.0f || move_dir == ImGuiDir_Right && dax > 0.0f || move_dir == ImGuiDir_Up && day < 0.0f || move_dir == ImGuiDir_Down && day > 0.0f {
                result.DistAxial = dist_axial;
                new_best = true;
            }
        }
    }
    return new_best;
}

void ImGui_NavApplyItemToResult(ImGuiNavItemData* result) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;

        assert(g.NextItemData.SelectionUserData != cast(ImGuiSelectionUserData, -1));
        result.SelectionUserData = g.NextItemData.SelectionUserData;
    }
}

// We get there when either NavId == id, or when g.NavAnyRequest is set (which is updated by NavUpdateAnyRequestFlag above)
// This is called after LastItemData is set, but NextItemData is also still valid.
private {
void ImGui_NavProcessItem() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    ImGuiID id = g.LastItemData.ID;
    ImGuiItemFlags item_flags = g.LastItemData.ItemFlags;
    ImRect nav_bb = g.LastItemData.NavRect;
    if window.DC.NavIsScrollPushableX == false {
        nav_bb.Min.x = ImClamp(nav_bb.Min.x, window.ClipRect.Min.x, window.ClipRect.Max.x);
        nav_bb.Max.x = ImClamp(nav_bb.Max.x, window.ClipRect.Min.x, window.ClipRect.Max.x);
    }
    if g.NavInitRequest && g.NavLayer == window.DC.NavLayerCurrent && (item_flags & ImGuiItemFlags_Disabled) == 0 {
        bool candidate_for_nav_default_focus = (item_flags & ImGuiItemFlags_NoNavDefaultFocus) == 0;
        if candidate_for_nav_default_focus || g.NavInitResult.ID == 0 {
            ImGui_NavApplyItemToResult(&g.NavInitResult);
        }
        if candidate_for_nav_default_focus != 0 {
            g.NavInitRequest = false;
            ImGui_NavUpdateAnyRequestFlag();
        }
    }
    if g.NavMoveScoringItems && (item_flags & ImGuiItemFlags_Disabled) == 0 {
        if g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_FocusApi || (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNavInputs) == 0 {
            bool is_tabbing = (g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_IsTabbing) != 0;
            if is_tabbing != 0 {
                ImGui_NavProcessItemForTabbingRequest(id, item_flags, g.NavMoveFlags);
            } else if g.NavId != id || g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_AllowCurrentNavId {
                ImGuiNavItemData* result = window == g.NavWindow ? &g.NavMoveResultLocal : &g.NavMoveResultOther;
                if ImGui_NavScoreItem(result, nav_bb) != 0 {
                    ImGui_NavApplyItemToResult(result);
                }
                f32 VISIBLE_RATIO = 0.7f;
                if (g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_AlsoScoreVisibleSet) != 0 {
                    ImRect r = window.InnerRect;
                    if ImRect_Overlaps(&r, nav_bb) != 0 {
                        if ImClamp(nav_bb.Max.y, r.Min.y, r.Max.y) - ImClamp(nav_bb.Min.y, r.Min.y, r.Max.y) >= (nav_bb.Max.y - nav_bb.Min.y) * VISIBLE_RATIO {
                            if ImGui_NavScoreItem(&g.NavMoveResultLocalVisible, nav_bb) != 0 {
                                ImGui_NavApplyItemToResult(&g.NavMoveResultLocalVisible);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if g.NavId == id {
        if g.NavWindow != window {
            ImGui_SetNavWindow(window);
        }
        g.NavLayer = window.DC.NavLayerCurrent;
        ImGui_SetNavFocusScope(g.CurrentFocusScopeId);
        g.NavFocusScopeId = g.CurrentFocusScopeId;
        g.NavIdIsAlive = true;
        g.NavIdItemFlags = item_flags;
        if (g.LastItemData.ItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_HasSelectionUserData) != 0 {
            assert(g.NextItemData.SelectionUserData != cast(ImGuiSelectionUserData, -1));
            g.NavLastValidSelectionUserData = g.NextItemData.SelectionUserData;
        }
        window.NavRectRel[window.DC.NavLayerCurrent] = ImGui_WindowRectAbsToRel(window, nav_bb);
    }
}

// Handle "scoring" of an item for a tabbing/focusing request initiated by NavUpdateCreateTabbingRequest().
// Note that SetKeyboardFocusHere() API calls are considered tabbing requests!
// - Case 1: no nav/active id:    set result to first eligible item, stop storing.
// - Case 2: tab forward:         on ref id set counter, on counter elapse store result
// - Case 3: tab forward wrap:    set result to first eligible item (preemptively), on ref id set counter, on next frame if counter hasn't elapsed store result. // FIXME-TABBING: Could be done as a next-frame forwarded request
// - Case 4: tab backward:        store all results, on ref id pick prev, stop storing
// - Case 5: tab backward wrap:   store all results, on ref id if no result keep storing until last // FIXME-TABBING: Could be done as next-frame forwarded requested
void ImGui_NavProcessItemForTabbingRequest(ImGuiID id, ImGuiItemFlags item_flags, ImGuiNavMoveFlags move_flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if (move_flags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_FocusApi) == 0 {
        if g.NavLayer != g.CurrentWindow.DC.NavLayerCurrent {
            return;
        }
        if g.NavFocusScopeId != g.CurrentFocusScopeId {
            return;
        }
    }
    bool can_stop;
    if (move_flags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_FocusApi) != 0 {
        can_stop = true;
    } else {
        can_stop = (item_flags & ImGuiItemFlags_NoTabStop) == 0 && (g.IO.ConfigFlags & ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableKeyboard || item_flags & ImGuiItemFlags_Inputable);
    }
    ImGuiNavItemData* result = &g.NavMoveResultLocal;
    if g.NavTabbingDir == 1 {
        if can_stop && g.NavTabbingResultFirst.ID == 0 {
            ImGui_NavApplyItemToResult(&g.NavTabbingResultFirst);
        }
        if can_stop && g.NavTabbingCounter > 0 && --g.NavTabbingCounter == 0 {
            ImGui_NavMoveRequestResolveWithLastItem(result);
        } else if g.NavId == id {
            g.NavTabbingCounter = 1;
        }
    } else if g.NavTabbingDir == -1 {
        if g.NavId == id {
            if result.ID != 0 {
                g.NavMoveScoringItems = false;
                ImGui_NavUpdateAnyRequestFlag();
            }
        } else if can_stop != 0 {
            ImGui_NavApplyItemToResult(result);
        }
    } else if g.NavTabbingDir == 0 {
        if can_stop && g.NavId == id {
            ImGui_NavMoveRequestResolveWithLastItem(result);
        }
        if can_stop && g.NavTabbingResultFirst.ID == 0 {
            ImGui_NavApplyItemToResult(&g.NavTabbingResultFirst);
        }
    }
}

private {
void ImGui_NavSaveLastChildNavWindowIntoParent(ImGuiWindow* nav_window) {
    ImGuiWindow* parent = nav_window;
    while parent && parent.RootWindow != parent && (parent.Flags & (ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup | ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildMenu)) == 0 {
        parent = parent.ParentWindow;
    }
    if parent && parent != nav_window {
        parent.NavLastChildNavWindow = nav_window;

// Restore the last focused child.

    if window.NavLastChildNavWindow && window.NavLastChildNavWindow.WasActive {

    if window.DockNodeAsHost && window.DockNodeAsHost.TabBar {
        ImGuiTabItem* tab = ImGui_TabBarFindMostRecentlySelectedTabForActiveWindow(window.DockNodeAsHost.TabBar);

// This needs to be called before we submit any widget (aka in or before Begin)
void ImGui_NavInitWindow(ImGuiWindow* window, bool force_reinit) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(window == g.NavWindow);
    if (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNavInputs) != 0 {
        g.NavId = 0;
        ImGui_SetNavFocusScope(window.NavRootFocusScopeId);

    bool init_for_nav = false;
    if window == window.RootWindow || window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup || window.NavLastIds[0] == 0 || force_reinit {
        init_for_nav = true;
    }
    while true {
        if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventNav) != 0 {
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }

    if init_for_nav != 0 {
        ImGui_SetNavID(0, g.NavLayer, window.NavRootFocusScopeId, __cxx_make_ImRect());
        g.NavInitRequest = true;
        g.NavInitRequestFromMove = false;

        g.NavId = window.NavLastIds[0];
        ImGui_SetNavFocusScope(window.NavRootFocusScopeId);
    }
}

// Positioning logic altered slightly for remote activation: for Popup we want to use item rect, for Tooltip we leave things alone. (#9138)
// When calling for ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup we use LastItemData.
private {
ImGuiInputSource ImGui_NavCalcPreferredRefPosSource(ImGuiWindowFlags window_type) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.NavWindow;
    bool activated_shortcut = g.ActiveId != 0 && g.ActiveIdFromShortcut && g.ActiveId == g.LastItemData.ID;
    if window_type & ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup && activated_shortcut {
        return ImGuiInputSource_Keyboard;
    }
    if !g.NavCursorVisible || !g.NavHighlightItemUnderNav || !window {
        return ImGuiInputSource_Mouse;
    } else {
        return ImGuiInputSource_Keyboard;
    }
}

ImVec2 ImGui_NavCalcPreferredRefPos(ImGuiWindowFlags window_type) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.NavWindow;
    ImGuiInputSource source = ImGui_NavCalcPreferredRefPosSource(window_type);
    if source == ImGuiInputSource_Mouse {
        ImVec2 p = ImGui_IsMousePosValid(&g.IO.MousePos) != 0 ? g.IO.MousePos : g.MouseLastValidPos;
        return ImVec2{p.x + 1.0f, p.y};
    } else {
        bool activated_shortcut = g.ActiveId != 0 && g.ActiveIdFromShortcut && g.ActiveId == g.LastItemData.ID;
        ImRect ref_rect;
        if activated_shortcut && window_type & ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup {
            ref_rect = g.LastItemData.NavRect;
        } else if window != null {
            ref_rect = ImGui_WindowRectRelToAbs(window, window.NavRectRel[g.NavLayer]);
        }
        if window != null && window.LastFrameActive != g.FrameCount && (window.ScrollTarget.x != FLT_MAX || window.ScrollTarget.y != FLT_MAX) {
            ImVec2 next_scroll = CalcNextScrollFromScrollTargetAndClamp(window);
            ImRect_Translate(&ref_rect, op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.Scroll, next_scroll));
        }
        var pos = ImVec2{
            ref_rect.Min.x + ImMin(g.Style.FramePadding.x * 4.0f, ImRect_GetWidth(&ref_rect)),
            ref_rect.Max.y - ImMin(g.Style.FramePadding.y, ImRect_GetHeight(&ref_rect)),
        };
        if window != null {
            var viewport = cast(ImGuiViewport*, window.Viewport);
            if viewport != null {
                pos = ImClamp(pos, viewport.Pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(viewport.Pos, viewport.Size));
            }
        }
        return ImTrunc(pos);
    }
}
}

f32 ImGui_GetNavTweakPressedAmount(ImGuiAxis axis) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    f32 repeat_delay;
    f32 repeat_rate;
    ImGui_GetTypematicRepeatRate(ImGuiInputFlags_RepeatRateNavTweak, &repeat_delay, &repeat_rate);
    ImGuiKey key_less;
    ImGuiKey key_more;
    if g.NavInputSource == ImGuiInputSource_Gamepad {
        key_less = axis == ImGuiAxis_X ? ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadLeft : ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadUp;
        key_more = axis == ImGuiAxis_X ? ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadRight : ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadDown;
    } else {
        key_less = axis == ImGuiAxis_X ? ImGuiKey_LeftArrow : ImGuiKey_UpArrow;
        key_more = axis == ImGuiAxis_X ? ImGuiKey_RightArrow : ImGuiKey_DownArrow;
    }
    f32 amount = cast(f32, ImGui_GetKeyPressedAmount(key_more, repeat_delay, repeat_rate)) - cast(f32, ImGui_GetKeyPressedAmount(key_less, repeat_delay, repeat_rate));
    if amount != 0.0f && ImGui_IsKeyDown(key_less) && ImGui_IsKeyDown(key_more) {
        amount = 0.0f;
    }
    return amount;
}

        for ; zz_rf_it_38 != zz_rf_end_38; zz_rf_it_38++ {

            if ImGui_IsKeyDown(key) != 0 {
                g.NavInputSource = ImGuiInputSource_Keyboard;

    if g.NavCursorHideFrames > 0 {

    g.NavMousePosDirty = false;

        ImGui_NavSaveLastChildNavWindowIntoParent(g.NavWindow);
    }
    if g.NavWindow && g.NavWindow.NavLastChildNavWindow != null && g.NavLayer == ImGuiNavLayer_Main {
        g.NavWindow.NavLastChildNavWindow = null;

    ImGui_NavUpdateWindowing();
    io.NavActive = (nav_keyboard_active || nav_gamepad_active) && g.NavWindow && !(g.NavWindow.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNavInputs);
    io.NavVisible = io.NavActive && g.NavId != 0 && g.NavCursorVisible || g.NavWindowingTarget != null;

        bool input_pressed_keyboard = nav_keyboard_active && (ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Enter, 0, cast(ImGuiID, -1)) || ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_KeypadEnter, 0, cast(ImGuiID, -1)));
        bool input_pressed_gamepad = false;
        if activate_down && nav_gamepad_active && ImGui_IsKeyDown(g.IO.ConfigNavSwapGamepadButtons != 0 ? ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceRight : ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceDown, cast(ImGuiID, -1)) && g.NavIdItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_Inputable {
            if ImGui_GetKeyData(g.IO.ConfigNavSwapGamepadButtons != 0 ? ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceRight : ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceDown).DownDurationPrev < NAV_ACTIVATE_INPUT_WITH_GAMEPAD_DELAY && ImGui_GetKeyData(g.IO.ConfigNavSwapGamepadButtons != 0 ? ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceRight : ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceDown).DownDuration >= NAV_ACTIVATE_INPUT_WITH_GAMEPAD_DELAY {
                input_pressed_gamepad = true;
            }
        }
        if g.ActiveId == 0 && activate_pressed {
            g.NavActivateId = g.NavId;
            g.NavActivateFlags = ImGuiActivateFlags_PreferTweak;
        }
        if (g.ActiveId == 0 || g.ActiveId == g.NavId) && (input_pressed_keyboard || input_pressed_gamepad) {

            g.NavActivateFlags = ImGuiActivateFlags_PreferInput;

        if (g.ActiveId == 0 || g.ActiveId == g.NavId) && (activate_down || input_pressed_keyboard || input_pressed_gamepad) {

        }
        if (g.ActiveId == 0 || g.ActiveId == g.NavId) && (activate_pressed || input_pressed_keyboard || input_pressed_gamepad) {

            ImGui_NavHighlightActivated(g.NavId);

    if g.NavWindow && g.NavWindow.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNavInputs {

        g.NavCursorVisible = true;

        assert(g.NavActivateDownId == g.NavActivateId);

    if g.NavHighlightActivatedTimer > 0.0f {
        g.NavHighlightActivatedTimer = ImMax(0.0f, g.NavHighlightActivatedTimer - io.DeltaTime);

    if g.NavHighlightActivatedTimer == 0.0f {
        g.NavHighlightActivatedId = 0;

    if g.NavNextActivateId != 0 {
        g.NavActivatePressedId = g.NavNextActivateId;

        var scroll_speed = cast(f32, cast(i32, window.FontRefSize * 100.0f * io.DeltaTime + 0.5f));

        if window.DC.NavLayersActiveMask == 0x00 && window.DC.NavWindowHasScrollY && move_dir != ImGuiDir_None {

private {
void NavBiasScoringRect(ImRect* r, ImVec2* preferred_pos_rel, ImGuiDir move_dir, ImGuiNavMoveFlags move_flags) {
