    if (move_flags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_Forwarded) == 0 {
        if preferred_pos_rel.x == FLT_MAX {
            preferred_pos_rel.x = ImMin(r.Min.x + 1.0f, r.Max.x) - rel_to_abs_offset.x;
        }
        if preferred_pos_rel.y == FLT_MAX {
            preferred_pos_rel.y = ImRect_GetCenter(r).y - rel_to_abs_offset.y;
        }
    }
    if (move_dir == ImGuiDir_Up || move_dir == ImGuiDir_Down) && preferred_pos_rel.x != FLT_MAX {
        r.Max.x = preferred_pos_rel.x + rel_to_abs_offset.x;
        r.Min.x = r.Max.x;
    } else if (move_dir == ImGuiDir_Left || move_dir == ImGuiDir_Right) && preferred_pos_rel.y != FLT_MAX {
        r.Max.y = preferred_pos_rel.y + rel_to_abs_offset.y;
        r.Min.y = r.Max.y;
    }
}
}

void ImGui_NavUpdateCreateMoveRequest() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiIO* io = &g.IO;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.NavWindow;
    bool nav_gamepad_active = (io.ConfigFlags & ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableGamepad) != 0 && (io.BackendFlags & ImGuiBackendFlags_HasGamepad) != 0;
    bool nav_keyboard_active = (io.ConfigFlags & ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableKeyboard) != 0;
    if g.NavMoveForwardToNextFrame && window != null {
        assert(g.NavMoveDir != ImGuiDir_None && g.NavMoveClipDir != ImGuiDir_None);
        assert(g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_Forwarded);
        while true {
            if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventNav) != 0 {
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
    } else {
        g.NavMoveDir = ImGuiDir_None;
        g.NavMoveFlags = ImGuiNavMoveFlags_None;
        g.NavMoveScrollFlags = ImGuiScrollFlags_None;
        if window && !g.NavWindowingTarget && !(window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNavInputs) {
            ImGuiInputFlags repeat_mode = ImGuiInputFlags_Repeat | cast(ImGuiInputFlags, ImGuiInputFlags_RepeatRateNavMove);
            if !ImGui_IsActiveIdUsingNavDir(ImGuiDir_Left) && (nav_gamepad_active && ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadLeft, repeat_mode, cast(ImGuiID, -1)) || nav_keyboard_active && ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_LeftArrow, repeat_mode, cast(ImGuiID, -1))) {
                g.NavMoveDir = ImGuiDir_Left;
            }
            if !ImGui_IsActiveIdUsingNavDir(ImGuiDir_Right) && (nav_gamepad_active && ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadRight, repeat_mode, cast(ImGuiID, -1)) || nav_keyboard_active && ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_RightArrow, repeat_mode, cast(ImGuiID, -1))) {
                g.NavMoveDir = ImGuiDir_Right;
            }
            if !ImGui_IsActiveIdUsingNavDir(ImGuiDir_Up) && (nav_gamepad_active && ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadUp, repeat_mode, cast(ImGuiID, -1)) || nav_keyboard_active && ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_UpArrow, repeat_mode, cast(ImGuiID, -1))) {
                g.NavMoveDir = ImGuiDir_Up;
            }
            if !ImGui_IsActiveIdUsingNavDir(ImGuiDir_Down) && (nav_gamepad_active && ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadDpadDown, repeat_mode, cast(ImGuiID, -1)) || nav_keyboard_active && ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_DownArrow, repeat_mode, cast(ImGuiID, -1))) {
                g.NavMoveDir = ImGuiDir_Down;
            }
        }
        g.NavMoveClipDir = g.NavMoveDir;
        g.NavScoringNoClipRect = ImRect{ImVec2{FLT_MAX, FLT_MAX}, ImVec2{-FLT_MAX, -FLT_MAX}};
    }
    f32 scoring_page_offset_y = 0.0f;
    if window && g.NavMoveDir == ImGuiDir_None && nav_keyboard_active {
        scoring_page_offset_y = ImGui_NavUpdatePageUpPageDown();
    }
    g.NavMoveForwardToNextFrame = false;
    if g.NavMoveDir != ImGuiDir_None {
        ImGui_NavMoveRequestSubmit(g.NavMoveDir, g.NavMoveClipDir, g.NavMoveFlags, g.NavMoveScrollFlags);
    }
    if g.NavMoveSubmitted && g.NavId == 0 {
        while true {
            if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventNav) != 0 {
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
        g.NavInitRequestFromMove = true;
        g.NavInitRequest = g.NavInitRequestFromMove;
        g.NavInitResult.ID = 0;
        if g.IO.ConfigNavCursorVisibleAuto != 0 {
            g.NavCursorVisible = true;
        }
    }
    if g.NavMoveSubmitted && g.NavInputSource == ImGuiInputSource_Gamepad && g.NavLayer == ImGuiNavLayer_Main && window != null {
        bool clamp_x = (g.NavMoveFlags & (ImGuiNavMoveFlags_LoopX | ImGuiNavMoveFlags_WrapX)) == 0;
        bool clamp_y = (g.NavMoveFlags & (ImGuiNavMoveFlags_LoopY | ImGuiNavMoveFlags_WrapY)) == 0;
        ImRect inner_rect_rel = ImGui_WindowRectAbsToRel(window, ImRect{
            op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.InnerRect.Min, ImVec2{1.0f, 1.0f}),
            op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.InnerRect.Max, ImVec2{1.0f, 1.0f}),
        });
        ImRect_Translate(&inner_rect_rel, op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(CalcNextScrollFromScrollTargetAndClamp(window), window.Scroll));
        if (clamp_x || clamp_y) && !ImRect_Contains(&inner_rect_rel, window.NavRectRel[g.NavLayer]) {
            while true {
                if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventNav) != 0 {
                }
                if !(0 != 0) { break; }
            }
            f32 pad_x = ImMin(ImRect_GetWidth(&inner_rect_rel), window.FontRefSize * 0.5f);
            f32 pad_y = ImMin(ImRect_GetHeight(&inner_rect_rel), window.FontRefSize * 0.5f);
            inner_rect_rel.Min.x = clamp_x != 0 ? inner_rect_rel.Min.x + pad_x : cast(f32, -FLT_MAX);
            inner_rect_rel.Max.x = clamp_x != 0 ? inner_rect_rel.Max.x - pad_x : FLT_MAX;
            inner_rect_rel.Min.y = clamp_y != 0 ? inner_rect_rel.Min.y + pad_y : cast(f32, -FLT_MAX);
            inner_rect_rel.Max.y = clamp_y != 0 ? inner_rect_rel.Max.y - pad_y : FLT_MAX;
            ImRect_ClipWithFull(&window.NavRectRel[g.NavLayer], inner_rect_rel);
            g.NavId = 0;
        }
    }
    ImRect scoring_rect;
    if window != null {
        ImRect nav_rect_rel = ImRect_IsInverted(&window.NavRectRel[g.NavLayer]) == 0 ? window.NavRectRel[g.NavLayer] : ImRect{ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f}, ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f}};
        scoring_rect = ImGui_WindowRectRelToAbs(window, nav_rect_rel);
        if (g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_IsPageMove) != 0 {
            if ImRect_Contains(&window.InnerRect, scoring_rect) != 0 {
                g.NavMoveFlags |= ImGuiNavMoveFlags_AlsoScoreVisibleSet;
            }
            g.NavScoringNoClipRect = scoring_rect;
            ImRect_TranslateY(&scoring_rect, scoring_page_offset_y);
            ImRect_Add(&g.NavScoringNoClipRect, scoring_rect);
        }
        if g.NavMoveSubmitted != 0 {
            NavBiasScoringRect(&scoring_rect, &window.RootWindowForNav.NavPreferredScoringPosRel[g.NavLayer], g.NavMoveDir, g.NavMoveFlags);
        }
        assert(cast(i64, !ImRect_IsInverted(&scoring_rect)));
    }
    g.NavScoringRect = scoring_rect;
}

void ImGui_NavUpdateCreateTabbingRequest() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.NavWindow;
    assert(g.NavMoveDir == ImGuiDir_None);
    if window == null || g.NavWindowingTarget != null || window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNavInputs || !g.ConfigNavEnableTabbing {
        return;
    }
    bool tab_pressed = ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Tab, ImGuiInputFlags_Repeat, cast(ImGuiID, -1)) && !g.IO.KeyCtrl && !g.IO.KeyAlt;
    if tab_pressed == 0 {
        return;
    }
    bool nav_keyboard_active = (g.IO.ConfigFlags & ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableKeyboard) != 0;
    if nav_keyboard_active != 0 {
        g.NavTabbingDir = g.IO.KeyShift != 0 ? -1 : g.NavCursorVisible == false && g.ActiveId == 0 ? 0 : 1;
    } else {
        g.NavTabbingDir = g.IO.KeyShift != 0 ? -1 : g.ActiveId == 0 ? 0 : 1;
    }
    ImGuiNavMoveFlags move_flags = ImGuiNavMoveFlags_IsTabbing | ImGuiNavMoveFlags_Activate;
    ImGuiScrollFlags scroll_flags = window.Appearing != 0 ? ImGuiScrollFlags_KeepVisibleEdgeX | ImGuiScrollFlags_AlwaysCenterY : ImGuiScrollFlags_KeepVisibleEdgeX | ImGuiScrollFlags_KeepVisibleEdgeY;
    ImGuiDir clip_dir = g.NavTabbingDir < 0 ? ImGuiDir_Up : ImGuiDir_Down;
    ImGui_NavMoveRequestSubmit(ImGuiDir_None, clip_dir, move_flags, scroll_flags);
    g.NavTabbingCounter = -1;
}

// Apply result from previous frame navigation directional move request. Always called from NavUpdate()
void ImGui_NavMoveRequestApplyResult() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiNavItemData* result = g.NavMoveResultLocal.ID != 0 ? &g.NavMoveResultLocal : g.NavMoveResultOther.ID != 0 ? &g.NavMoveResultOther : null;
    if g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_IsTabbing && result == null {
        if (g.NavTabbingCounter == 1 || g.NavTabbingDir == 0) && g.NavTabbingResultFirst.ID {
            result = &g.NavTabbingResultFirst;
        }
    }
    ImGuiAxis axis = g.NavMoveDir == ImGuiDir_Up || g.NavMoveDir == ImGuiDir_Down ? ImGuiAxis_Y : ImGuiAxis_X;
    if result == null {
        if (g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_IsTabbing) != 0 {
            g.NavMoveFlags |= ImGuiNavMoveFlags_NoSetNavCursorVisible;
        }
        if g.NavId != 0 && (g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_NoSetNavCursorVisible) == 0 {
            ImGui_SetNavCursorVisibleAfterMove();
        }
        ImGui_NavClearPreferredPosForAxis(axis);
        while true {
            if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventNav) != 0 {
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
        return;
    }
    if (g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_AlsoScoreVisibleSet) != 0 {
        if g.NavMoveResultLocalVisible.ID != 0 && g.NavMoveResultLocalVisible.ID != g.NavId {
            result = &g.NavMoveResultLocalVisible;
        }
    }
    if result != &g.NavMoveResultOther && g.NavMoveResultOther.ID != 0 && g.NavMoveResultOther.Window.ParentWindow == g.NavWindow {
        if g.NavMoveResultOther.DistBox < result.DistBox || g.NavMoveResultOther.DistBox == result.DistBox && g.NavMoveResultOther.DistCenter < result.DistCenter {
            result = &g.NavMoveResultOther;
        }
    }
    assert(g.NavWindow && result.Window);
    if g.NavLayer == ImGuiNavLayer_Main {
        ImRect rect_abs = ImGui_WindowRectRelToAbs(result.Window, result.RectRel);
        ImGui_ScrollToRectEx(result.Window, rect_abs, g.NavMoveScrollFlags);
        if (g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_ScrollToEdgeY) != 0 {
            f32 scroll_target = g.NavMoveDir == ImGuiDir_Up ? result.Window.ScrollMax.y : 0.0f;
            ImGui_SetScrollY(result.Window, scroll_target);
        }
    }
    if g.NavWindow != result.Window {
        while true {
            if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventFocus) != 0 {
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
        g.NavWindow = result.Window;
        g.NavLastValidSelectionUserData = cast(ImGuiSelectionUserData, -1);
    }
    if g.ActiveId != result.ID && (g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_NoClearActiveId) == 0 {
        ImGui_ClearActiveID();
    }
    if (g.NavId != result.ID || g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_IsPageMove) && (g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_NoSelect) == 0 {
        g.NavJustMovedFromFocusScopeId = g.NavFocusScopeId;
        g.NavJustMovedToId = result.ID;
        g.NavJustMovedToFocusScopeId = result.FocusScopeId;
        g.NavJustMovedToKeyMods = g.NavMoveKeyMods;
        g.NavJustMovedToIsTabbing = (g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_IsTabbing) != 0;
        g.NavJustMovedToHasSelectionData = (result.ItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_HasSelectionUserData) != 0;
    }
    while true {
        if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventNav) != 0 {
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    ImVec2 preferred_scoring_pos_rel = g.NavWindow.RootWindowForNav.NavPreferredScoringPosRel[g.NavLayer];
    ImGui_SetNavID(result.ID, g.NavLayer, result.FocusScopeId, result.RectRel);
    if result.SelectionUserData != cast(ImGuiSelectionUserData, -1) {
        g.NavLastValidSelectionUserData = result.SelectionUserData;
    }
    if (g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_IsTabbing) == 0 {
        cast(f32*, &preferred_scoring_pos_rel)[axis] = cast(f32*, &ImRect_GetCenter(&result.RectRel))[axis];
        g.NavWindow.RootWindowForNav.NavPreferredScoringPosRel[g.NavLayer] = preferred_scoring_pos_rel;
    }
    if g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_IsTabbing && (result.ItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_Inputable) == 0 {
        g.NavMoveFlags &= ~ImGuiNavMoveFlags_Activate;
    }
    if (g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_Activate) != 0 {
        g.NavNextActivateId = result.ID;
        g.NavNextActivateFlags = ImGuiActivateFlags_None;
        if (g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_FocusApi) != 0 {
            g.NavNextActivateFlags |= ImGuiActivateFlags_FromFocusApi;
        }
        if (g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_IsTabbing) != 0 {
            g.NavNextActivateFlags |= ImGuiActivateFlags_PreferInput | ImGuiActivateFlags_TryToPreserveState | ImGuiActivateFlags_FromTabbing;
        }
    }
    if (g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_NoSetNavCursorVisible) == 0 {
        ImGui_SetNavCursorVisibleAfterMove();
    }
}

// Process Escape/NavCancel input (to close a popup, get back to parent, clear focus)
// FIXME: In order to support e.g. Escape to clear a selection we'll need:
// - either to store the equivalent of ActiveIdUsingKeyInputMask for a FocusScope and test for it.
// - either to move most/all of those tests to the epilogue/end functions of the scope they are dealing with (e.g. exit child window in EndChild()) or in EndFrame(), to allow an earlier intercept
private {
void ImGui_NavUpdateCancelRequest() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    bool nav_gamepad_active = (g.IO.ConfigFlags & ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableGamepad) != 0 && (g.IO.BackendFlags & ImGuiBackendFlags_HasGamepad) != 0;
    bool nav_keyboard_active = (g.IO.ConfigFlags & ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableKeyboard) != 0;
    if !(nav_keyboard_active && ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Escape, 0, cast(ImGuiID, -1))) && !(nav_gamepad_active && ImGui_IsKeyPressed(g.IO.ConfigNavSwapGamepadButtons != 0 ? ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceDown : ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceRight, 0, cast(ImGuiID, -1))) {
        return;
    }
    while true {
        if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventNav) != 0 {
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    if g.ActiveId != 0 {
        ImGui_ClearActiveID();
    } else if g.NavLayer != ImGuiNavLayer_Main {
        ImGui_NavRestoreLayer(ImGuiNavLayer_Main);
        ImGui_SetNavCursorVisibleAfterMove();
    } else if g.NavWindow && g.NavWindow != g.NavWindow.RootWindow && !(g.NavWindow.RootWindowForNav.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup) && g.NavWindow.RootWindowForNav.ParentWindow {
        ImGuiWindow* child_window = g.NavWindow.RootWindowForNav;
        ImGuiWindow* parent_window = child_window.ParentWindow;
        assert(child_window.ChildId != 0);
        ImGui_FocusWindow(parent_window);
        ImGui_SetNavID(child_window.ChildId, ImGuiNavLayer_Main, 0, ImGui_WindowRectAbsToRel(parent_window, ImGuiWindow_Rect(child_window)));
        ImGui_SetNavCursorVisibleAfterMove();
    } else if g.OpenPopupStack.Size > 0 && ImVector_ImGuiPopupData_back(&g.OpenPopupStack).Window != null && !(ImVector_ImGuiPopupData_back(&g.OpenPopupStack).Window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Modal) {
        ImGui_ClosePopupToLevel(g.OpenPopupStack.Size - 1, true);
    } else {
        if g.IO.ConfigNavEscapeClearFocusItem || g.IO.ConfigNavEscapeClearFocusWindow {
            if g.NavWindow && g.NavWindow.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup {
                g.NavWindow.NavLastIds[0] = 0;
            }
        }
        if g.IO.ConfigNavEscapeClearFocusItem || g.IO.ConfigNavEscapeClearFocusWindow {
            g.NavId = 0;
        }
        if g.IO.ConfigNavEscapeClearFocusWindow != 0 {
            ImGui_FocusWindow(null);
        }
    }
}

void ImGui_NavUpdateContextMenuRequest() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    g.NavOpenContextMenuWindowId = 0;
    g.NavOpenContextMenuItemId = g.NavOpenContextMenuWindowId;
    bool nav_keyboard_active = (g.IO.ConfigFlags & ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableKeyboard) != 0;
    bool nav_gamepad_active = (g.IO.ConfigFlags & ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableGamepad) != 0;
    if !nav_keyboard_active && !nav_gamepad_active || g.NavWindow == null {
        return;
    }
    bool request = false;
    request |= nav_keyboard_active && (ImGui_IsKeyReleased(ImGuiKey_Menu, cast(ImGuiID, -1)) || ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_F10, ImGuiInputFlags_None, cast(ImGuiID, -1)) && g.IO.KeyMods == ImGuiMod_Shift);
    request |= nav_gamepad_active && ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceUp, ImGuiInputFlags_None, cast(ImGuiID, -1));
    if request == 0 {
        return;
    }
    g.NavOpenContextMenuItemId = g.NavId;
    g.NavOpenContextMenuWindowId = g.NavWindow.ID;
    if g.NavId == ImGuiWindow_GetID(g.NavWindow, "#CLOSE", null) || g.NavId == ImGuiWindow_GetID(g.NavWindow, "#COLLAPSE", null) {
        g.NavOpenContextMenuItemId = g.NavWindow.MoveId;
    }
    g.NavInputSource = ImGuiInputSource_Keyboard;
    ImGui_SetNavCursorVisibleAfterMove();
}

// Handle PageUp/PageDown/Home/End keys
// Called from NavUpdateCreateMoveRequest() which will use our output to create a move request
// FIXME-NAV: This doesn't work properly with NavFlattened siblings as we use NavWindow rectangle for reference
// FIXME-NAV: how to get Home/End to aim at the beginning/end of a 2D grid?
f32 ImGui_NavUpdatePageUpPageDown() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.NavWindow;
    if window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNavInputs || g.NavWindowingTarget != null {
        return 0.0f;
    }
    bool page_up_held = ImGui_IsKeyDown(ImGuiKey_PageUp, cast(ImGuiID, -1));
    bool page_down_held = ImGui_IsKeyDown(ImGuiKey_PageDown, cast(ImGuiID, -1));
    bool home_pressed = ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Home, ImGuiInputFlags_Repeat, cast(ImGuiID, -1));
    bool end_pressed = ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_End, ImGuiInputFlags_Repeat, cast(ImGuiID, -1));
    if page_up_held == page_down_held && home_pressed == end_pressed {
        return 0.0f;
    }
    if g.NavLayer != ImGuiNavLayer_Main {
        ImGui_NavRestoreLayer(ImGuiNavLayer_Main);
    }
    if (window.DC.NavLayersActiveMask & 1 << ImGuiNavLayer_Main) == 0 && window.DC.NavWindowHasScrollY {
        if ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_PageUp, ImGuiInputFlags_Repeat, cast(ImGuiID, -1)) != 0 {
            ImGui_SetScrollY(window, window.Scroll.y - ImRect_GetHeight(&window.InnerRect));
        } else if ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_PageDown, ImGuiInputFlags_Repeat, cast(ImGuiID, -1)) != 0 {
            ImGui_SetScrollY(window, window.Scroll.y + ImRect_GetHeight(&window.InnerRect));
        } else if home_pressed != 0 {
            ImGui_SetScrollY(window, 0.0f);
        } else if end_pressed != 0 {
            ImGui_SetScrollY(window, window.ScrollMax.y);
        }
    } else {
        ImRect* nav_rect_rel = &window.NavRectRel[g.NavLayer];
        f32 page_offset_y = ImMax(0.0f, ImRect_GetHeight(&window.InnerRect) - window.FontRefSize * 1.0f + ImRect_GetHeight(nav_rect_rel));
        f32 nav_scoring_rect_offset_y = 0.0f;
        if ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_PageUp, true) != 0 {
            nav_scoring_rect_offset_y = -page_offset_y;
            g.NavMoveDir = ImGuiDir_Down;
            g.NavMoveClipDir = ImGuiDir_Up;
            g.NavMoveFlags = ImGuiNavMoveFlags_AllowCurrentNavId | ImGuiNavMoveFlags_IsPageMove;
        } else if ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_PageDown, true) != 0 {
            nav_scoring_rect_offset_y = page_offset_y;
            g.NavMoveDir = ImGuiDir_Up;
            g.NavMoveClipDir = ImGuiDir_Down;
            g.NavMoveFlags = ImGuiNavMoveFlags_AllowCurrentNavId | ImGuiNavMoveFlags_IsPageMove;
        } else if home_pressed != 0 {
            nav_rect_rel.Max.y = 0.0f;
            nav_rect_rel.Min.y = nav_rect_rel.Max.y;
            if ImRect_IsInverted(nav_rect_rel) != 0 {
                nav_rect_rel.Max.x = 0.0f;
                nav_rect_rel.Min.x = nav_rect_rel.Max.x;
            }
            g.NavMoveDir = ImGuiDir_Down;
            g.NavMoveFlags = ImGuiNavMoveFlags_AllowCurrentNavId | ImGuiNavMoveFlags_ScrollToEdgeY;
        } else if end_pressed != 0 {
            nav_rect_rel.Max.y = window.ContentSize.y;
            nav_rect_rel.Min.y = nav_rect_rel.Max.y;
            if ImRect_IsInverted(nav_rect_rel) != 0 {
                nav_rect_rel.Max.x = 0.0f;
                nav_rect_rel.Min.x = nav_rect_rel.Max.x;
            }
            g.NavMoveDir = ImGuiDir_Up;
            g.NavMoveFlags = ImGuiNavMoveFlags_AllowCurrentNavId | ImGuiNavMoveFlags_ScrollToEdgeY;
        }
        return nav_scoring_rect_offset_y;
    }
    return 0.0f;
}

void ImGui_NavEndFrame() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if g.NavWindowingTarget != null {
        ImGui_NavUpdateWindowingOverlay();
    }
    if g.NavWindow && ImGui_NavMoveRequestButNoResultYet() && g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_WrapMask_ && (g.NavMoveFlags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_Forwarded) == 0 {
        ImGui_NavUpdateCreateWrappingRequest();
    }
}

void ImGui_NavUpdateCreateWrappingRequest() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.NavWindow;
    bool do_forward = false;
    ImRect bb_rel = window.NavRectRel[g.NavLayer];
    ImGuiDir clip_dir = g.NavMoveDir;
    ImGuiNavMoveFlags move_flags = g.NavMoveFlags;
    ImVec2 wrap_size = g.NavLayer == ImGuiNavLayer_Menu ? window.Size : op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.ContentSize, window.WindowPadding);
    if g.NavMoveDir == ImGuiDir_Left && move_flags & (ImGuiNavMoveFlags_WrapX | ImGuiNavMoveFlags_LoopX) {
        bb_rel.Max.x = wrap_size.x;
        bb_rel.Min.x = bb_rel.Max.x;
        if (move_flags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_WrapX) != 0 {
            ImRect_TranslateY(&bb_rel, -ImRect_GetHeight(&bb_rel));
            clip_dir = ImGuiDir_Up;
        }
        do_forward = true;
    }
    if g.NavMoveDir == ImGuiDir_Right && move_flags & (ImGuiNavMoveFlags_WrapX | ImGuiNavMoveFlags_LoopX) {
        bb_rel.Max.x = -window.WindowPadding.x;
        bb_rel.Min.x = bb_rel.Max.x;
        if (move_flags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_WrapX) != 0 {
            ImRect_TranslateY(&bb_rel, ImRect_GetHeight(&bb_rel));
            clip_dir = ImGuiDir_Down;
        }
        do_forward = true;
    }
    if g.NavMoveDir == ImGuiDir_Up && move_flags & (ImGuiNavMoveFlags_WrapY | ImGuiNavMoveFlags_LoopY) {
        bb_rel.Max.y = wrap_size.y;
        bb_rel.Min.y = bb_rel.Max.y;
        if (move_flags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_WrapY) != 0 {
            ImRect_TranslateX(&bb_rel, -ImRect_GetWidth(&bb_rel));
            clip_dir = ImGuiDir_Left;
        }
        do_forward = true;
    }
    if g.NavMoveDir == ImGuiDir_Down && move_flags & (ImGuiNavMoveFlags_WrapY | ImGuiNavMoveFlags_LoopY) {
        bb_rel.Max.y = -window.WindowPadding.y;
        bb_rel.Min.y = bb_rel.Max.y;
        if (move_flags & ImGuiNavMoveFlags_WrapY) != 0 {
            ImRect_TranslateX(&bb_rel, ImRect_GetWidth(&bb_rel));
            clip_dir = ImGuiDir_Right;
        }
        do_forward = true;
    }
    if do_forward == 0 {
        return;
    }
    window.NavRectRel[g.NavLayer] = bb_rel;
    ImGui_NavClearPreferredPosForAxis(ImGuiAxis_X);
    ImGui_NavClearPreferredPosForAxis(ImGuiAxis_Y);
    ImGui_NavMoveRequestForward(g.NavMoveDir, clip_dir, move_flags, g.NavMoveScrollFlags);
}

// Can we focus this window with Ctrl+Tab (or PadMenu + PadFocusPrev/PadFocusNext)
// Note that NoNavFocus makes the window not reachable with Ctrl+Tab but it can still be focused with mouse or programmatically.
// If you want a window to never be focused, you may use the e.g. NoInputs flag.
bool ImGui_IsWindowNavFocusable(ImGuiWindow* window) {
    return window.WasActive && window == window.RootWindow && !(window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNavFocus);
}

private {
ImGuiWindow* FindWindowNavFocusable(i32 i_start, i32 i_stop, i32 dir) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    for i32 i = i_start; i >= 0 && i < g.WindowsFocusOrder.Size && i != i_stop; i += dir {
        if ImGui_IsWindowNavFocusable(g.WindowsFocusOrder.Data[i]) != 0 {
            return g.WindowsFocusOrder.Data[i];
        }
    }
    return null;
}

void NavUpdateWindowingTarget(i32 focus_change_dir) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(cast(i64, g.NavWindowingTarget));
    if (g.NavWindowingTarget.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Modal) != 0 {
        return;
    }
    i32 i_current = ImGui_FindWindowFocusIndex(g.NavWindowingTarget);
    ImGuiWindow* window_target = FindWindowNavFocusable(i_current + focus_change_dir, -INT_MAX, focus_change_dir);
    if window_target == null {
        window_target = FindWindowNavFocusable(focus_change_dir < 0 ? g.WindowsFocusOrder.Size - 1 : 0, i_current, focus_change_dir);
    }
    if window_target != null {
        g.NavWindowingTargetAnim = window_target;
        g.NavWindowingTarget = g.NavWindowingTargetAnim;
        g.NavWindowingAccumDeltaSize = ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f};
        g.NavWindowingAccumDeltaPos = g.NavWindowingAccumDeltaSize;
    }
    g.NavWindowingToggleLayer = false;
}

// Apply focus and close overlay
void ImGui_NavUpdateWindowingApplyFocus(ImGuiWindow* apply_focus_window) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if g.NavWindow == null || apply_focus_window != g.NavWindow.RootWindow {
        var previous_viewport = cast(ImGuiViewport*, g.NavWindow != null ? g.NavWindow.Viewport : null);
        ImGui_ClearActiveID();
        ImGui_SetNavCursorVisibleAfterMove();
        ImGui_ClosePopupsOverWindow(apply_focus_window, false);
        ImGui_FocusWindow(apply_focus_window, ImGuiFocusRequestFlags_RestoreFocusedChild);
        assert(g.NavWindow != null);
        apply_focus_window = g.NavWindow;
        if apply_focus_window.NavLastIds[0] == 0 {
            ImGui_NavInitWindow(apply_focus_window, false);
        }
        if apply_focus_window.DC.NavLayersActiveMaskNext == 1 << ImGuiNavLayer_Menu {
            g.NavLayer = ImGuiNavLayer_Menu;
        }
        if cast(ImGuiViewport*, apply_focus_window.Viewport) != previous_viewport && g.PlatformIO.Platform_SetWindowFocus {
            g.PlatformIO.Platform_SetWindowFocus(cast(ImGuiViewport*, apply_focus_window.Viewport));
        }
    }
    g.NavWindowingTarget = null;
}

// Windowing management mode
// Keyboard: Ctrl+Tab (change focus/move/resize), Alt (toggle menu layer)
// Gamepad:  Hold Menu/Square (change focus/move/resize), Tap Menu/Square (toggle menu layer)
void ImGui_NavUpdateWindowing() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiIO* io = &g.IO;
    ImGuiWindow* apply_focus_window = null;
    bool apply_toggle_layer = false;
    ImGuiWindow* modal_window = ImGui_GetTopMostPopupModal();
    bool allow_windowing = modal_window == null;
    if allow_windowing == 0 {
        g.NavWindowingTarget = null;
    }
    if g.NavWindowingTargetAnim && g.NavWindowingTarget == null {
        g.NavWindowingHighlightAlpha = ImMax(g.NavWindowingHighlightAlpha - io.DeltaTime * 10.0f, 0.0f);
        if g.DimBgRatio <= 0.0f && g.NavWindowingHighlightAlpha <= 0.0f {
            g.NavWindowingTargetAnim = null;
        }
    }
    ImGuiID owner_id = ImHashStr("##NavUpdateWindowing");
    bool nav_gamepad_active = (io.ConfigFlags & ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableGamepad) != 0 && (io.BackendFlags & ImGuiBackendFlags_HasGamepad) != 0;
    bool nav_keyboard_active = (io.ConfigFlags & ImGuiConfigFlags_NavEnableKeyboard) != 0;
    bool keyboard_next_window = allow_windowing && g.ConfigNavWindowingKeyNext && ImGui_Shortcut(g.ConfigNavWindowingKeyNext, ImGuiInputFlags_Repeat | ImGuiInputFlags_RouteAlways, owner_id);
    bool keyboard_prev_window = allow_windowing && g.ConfigNavWindowingKeyPrev && ImGui_Shortcut(g.ConfigNavWindowingKeyPrev, ImGuiInputFlags_Repeat | ImGuiInputFlags_RouteAlways, owner_id);
    bool start_toggling_with_gamepad = nav_gamepad_active && !g.NavWindowingTarget && ImGui_Shortcut(ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceLeft, ImGuiInputFlags_RouteAlways, owner_id);
    bool start_windowing_with_gamepad = allow_windowing && start_toggling_with_gamepad;
    bool start_windowing_with_keyboard = allow_windowing && !g.NavWindowingTarget && (keyboard_next_window || keyboard_prev_window);
    bool just_started_windowing_from_null_focus = false;
    if start_toggling_with_gamepad != 0 {
        g.NavWindowingToggleLayer = true;
        g.NavWindowingToggleKey = ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceLeft;
        g.NavInputSource = ImGuiInputSource_Gamepad;
        g.NavWindowingInputSource = g.NavInputSource;
    }
    if start_windowing_with_gamepad || start_windowing_with_keyboard {
        ImGuiWindow* window = g.NavWindow && ImGui_IsWindowNavFocusable(g.NavWindow) ? g.NavWindow : FindWindowNavFocusable(g.WindowsFocusOrder.Size - 1, -INT_MAX, -1);
        if window != null {
            if start_windowing_with_keyboard || g.ConfigNavWindowingWithGamepad {
                g.NavWindowingTargetAnim = window.RootWindow;
                g.NavWindowingTarget = g.NavWindowingTargetAnim;
            }
            g.NavWindowingHighlightAlpha = 0.0f;
            g.NavWindowingTimer = g.NavWindowingHighlightAlpha;
            g.NavWindowingAccumDeltaSize = ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f};
            g.NavWindowingAccumDeltaPos = g.NavWindowingAccumDeltaSize;
            g.NavInputSource = start_windowing_with_keyboard != 0 ? ImGuiInputSource_Keyboard : ImGuiInputSource_Gamepad;
            g.NavWindowingInputSource = g.NavInputSource;
            if g.NavWindow == null {
                just_started_windowing_from_null_focus = true;
            }
            if keyboard_next_window || keyboard_prev_window {
                ImGui_SetKeyOwnersForKeyChord((g.ConfigNavWindowingKeyNext | g.ConfigNavWindowingKeyPrev) & ImGuiMod_Mask_, owner_id);
            }
        }
    }
    if (g.NavWindowingTarget || g.NavWindowingToggleLayer) && g.NavWindowingInputSource == ImGuiInputSource_Gamepad {
        if g.NavWindowingTarget != null {
            g.NavWindowingTimer += io.DeltaTime;
            g.NavWindowingHighlightAlpha = ImMax(g.NavWindowingHighlightAlpha, ImSaturate((g.NavWindowingTimer - NAV_WINDOWING_HIGHLIGHT_DELAY) / 0.05f));
            i32 focus_change_dir = cast(i32, ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadL1)) - cast(i32, ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_GamepadR1));
            if focus_change_dir != 0 && !just_started_windowing_from_null_focus {
                NavUpdateWindowingTarget(focus_change_dir);
                g.NavWindowingHighlightAlpha = 1.0f;
            }
        }
        if ImGui_IsKeyDown(ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceLeft) == 0 {
            g.NavWindowingToggleLayer &= g.NavWindowingHighlightAlpha < 1.0f;
            if g.NavWindowingToggleLayer && g.NavWindow {
                apply_toggle_layer = true;
            } else if g.NavWindowingToggleLayer == 0 {
                apply_focus_window = g.NavWindowingTarget;
            }
            g.NavWindowingTarget = null;
            g.NavWindowingToggleLayer = false;
        }
    }
    if g.NavWindowingTarget && g.NavWindowingInputSource == ImGuiInputSource_Keyboard {
        ImGuiKeyChord shared_mods = (g.ConfigNavWindowingKeyNext != 0 ? g.ConfigNavWindowingKeyNext : ImGuiMod_Mask_) & (g.ConfigNavWindowingKeyPrev != 0 ? g.ConfigNavWindowingKeyPrev : ImGuiMod_Mask_) & ImGuiMod_Mask_;
        assert(shared_mods != 0);
        g.NavWindowingTimer += io.DeltaTime;
        g.NavWindowingHighlightAlpha = ImMax(g.NavWindowingHighlightAlpha, ImSaturate((g.NavWindowingTimer - NAV_WINDOWING_HIGHLIGHT_DELAY) / 0.05f));
        if (keyboard_next_window || keyboard_prev_window) && !just_started_windowing_from_null_focus {
            NavUpdateWindowingTarget(keyboard_next_window != 0 ? -1 : 1);
        } else if (io.KeyMods & shared_mods) != shared_mods {
            apply_focus_window = g.NavWindowingTarget;
        }
    }
    ImGuiKey[2] windowing_toggle_keys = {ImGuiKey_LeftAlt, ImGuiKey_RightAlt};
    bool windowing_toggle_layer_start = false;
    if g.NavWindow != null && !(g.NavWindow.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNavInputs) {
        ImGuiKey* zz_rf_it_39 = &windowing_toggle_keys[0];
        ImGuiKey* zz_rf_end_39 = &windowing_toggle_keys[0] + sizeof(windowing_toggle_keys) / sizeof(*windowing_toggle_keys);
        for ; zz_rf_it_39 != zz_rf_end_39; zz_rf_it_39++ {
            ImGuiKey windowing_toggle_key = *zz_rf_it_39;
            if nav_keyboard_active && ImGui_IsKeyPressed(windowing_toggle_key, 0, cast(ImGuiID, -1)) {
                windowing_toggle_layer_start = true;
                g.NavWindowingToggleLayer = true;
                g.NavWindowingToggleKey = windowing_toggle_key;
                g.NavInputSource = ImGuiInputSource_Keyboard;
                g.NavWindowingInputSource = g.NavInputSource;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    if g.NavWindowingToggleLayer && g.NavWindowingInputSource == ImGuiInputSource_Keyboard {
        if io.InputQueueCharacters.Size > 0 || io.KeyCtrl || io.KeyShift || io.KeySuper {
            g.NavWindowingToggleLayer = false;
        } else if windowing_toggle_layer_start == false && g.LastKeyboardKeyPressTime == g.Time {
            g.NavWindowingToggleLayer = false;
        } else if ImGui_TestKeyOwner(g.NavWindowingToggleKey, cast(ImGuiID, -1)) == false || ImGui_TestKeyOwner(ImGuiMod_Alt, cast(ImGuiID, -1)) == false {
            g.NavWindowingToggleLayer = false;
        }
        if ImGui_IsKeyReleased(g.NavWindowingToggleKey) && g.NavWindowingToggleLayer {
            if g.ActiveId == 0 || g.ActiveIdAllowOverlap {
                if ImGui_IsMousePosValid(&io.MousePos) == ImGui_IsMousePosValid(&io.MousePosPrev) {
                    apply_toggle_layer = true;
                }
            }
        }
        if ImGui_IsKeyDown(g.NavWindowingToggleKey) == 0 {
            g.NavWindowingToggleLayer = false;
        }
    }
    if g.NavWindowingTarget && !(g.NavWindowingTarget.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove) {
        ImVec2 nav_move_dir;
        if g.NavInputSource == ImGuiInputSource_Keyboard && !io.KeyShift {
            nav_move_dir = ImGui_GetKeyMagnitude2d(ImGuiKey_LeftArrow, ImGuiKey_RightArrow, ImGuiKey_UpArrow, ImGuiKey_DownArrow);
        }
        if g.NavInputSource == ImGuiInputSource_Gamepad {
            nav_move_dir = ImGui_GetKeyMagnitude2d(ImGuiKey_GamepadLStickLeft, ImGuiKey_GamepadLStickRight, ImGuiKey_GamepadLStickUp, ImGuiKey_GamepadLStickDown);
        }
        if nav_move_dir.x != 0.0f || nav_move_dir.y != 0.0f {
            f32 NAV_MOVE_SPEED = 800.0f;
            f32 move_step = NAV_MOVE_SPEED * io.DeltaTime * ImGui_GetScale();
            g.NavWindowingAccumDeltaPos = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(g.NavWindowingAccumDeltaPos, op_mul_ImVec2_float(nav_move_dir, move_step));
            g.NavHighlightItemUnderNav = true;
            ImVec2 accum_floored = ImTrunc(g.NavWindowingAccumDeltaPos);
            if accum_floored.x != 0.0f || accum_floored.y != 0.0f {
                ImGuiWindow* moving_window = g.NavWindowingTarget.RootWindowDockTree;
                ImGui_SetWindowPos(moving_window, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(moving_window.Pos, accum_floored), ImGuiCond_Always);
                g.NavWindowingAccumDeltaPos = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(g.NavWindowingAccumDeltaPos, accum_floored);
            }
        }
    }
    if apply_focus_window != null {
        ImGui_NavUpdateWindowingApplyFocus(apply_focus_window);
    }
    if apply_toggle_layer && g.NavWindow {
        ImGui_ClearActiveID();
        ImGuiWindow* new_nav_window = g.NavWindow;
        while new_nav_window.ParentWindow && (new_nav_window.DC.NavLayersActiveMask & 1 << ImGuiNavLayer_Menu) == 0 && (new_nav_window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow) != 0 && (new_nav_window.Flags & (ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup | ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildMenu)) == 0 {
            new_nav_window = new_nav_window.ParentWindow;
        }
        if new_nav_window != g.NavWindow {
            ImGuiWindow* old_nav_window = g.NavWindow;
            ImGui_FocusWindow(new_nav_window);
            new_nav_window.NavLastChildNavWindow = old_nav_window;
        }
        ImGuiNavLayer new_nav_layer = (g.NavWindow.DC.NavLayersActiveMask & 1 << ImGuiNavLayer_Menu) != 0 ? cast(ImGuiNavLayer, cast(i32, g.NavLayer) ^ 1) : ImGuiNavLayer_Main;
        if new_nav_layer != g.NavLayer {
            bool preserve_layer_1_nav_id = new_nav_window.DockNodeAsHost != null;
            if new_nav_layer == ImGuiNavLayer_Menu && !preserve_layer_1_nav_id {
                g.NavWindow.NavLastIds[new_nav_layer] = 0;
            }
            ImGui_NavRestoreLayer(new_nav_layer);
            ImGui_SetNavCursorVisibleAfterMove();
        }
    }
}

// Window has already passed the IsWindowNavFocusable()
u8* GetFallbackWindowNameForWindowingList(ImGuiWindow* window) {
    if (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup) != 0 {
        return ImGui_LocalizeGetMsg(ImGuiLocKey_WindowingPopup);
    }
    if window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_MenuBar && strcmp(window.Name, "##MainMenuBar") == 0 {
        return ImGui_LocalizeGetMsg(ImGuiLocKey_WindowingMainMenuBar);
    }
    if window.DockNodeAsHost != null {
        return "(Dock node)";
    }
    return ImGui_LocalizeGetMsg(ImGuiLocKey_WindowingUntitled);
}

// Overlay displayed when using Ctrl+Tab. Called by EndFrame().
void ImGui_NavUpdateWindowingOverlay() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(g.NavWindowingTarget != null);
    if g.NavWindowingTimer < NAV_WINDOWING_LIST_APPEAR_DELAY {
        return;
    }
    ImGuiViewport* viewport = ImGui_GetMainViewport();
    ImGui_SetNextWindowSizeConstraints(ImVec2{viewport.Size.x * 0.2f, viewport.Size.y * 0.2f}, ImVec2{FLT_MAX, FLT_MAX});
    ImGui_SetNextWindowPos(ImGuiViewport_GetCenter(viewport), ImGuiCond_Always, ImVec2{0.5f, 0.5f});
    ImGui_PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, op_mul_ImVec2_float(g.Style.WindowPadding, 2.0f));
    ImGui_Begin("##NavWindowingOverlay", null, ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoFocusOnAppearing | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoInputs | ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings);
    g.NavWindowingListWindow = g.CurrentWindow;
    if g.ContextName[0] != 0 {
        ImGui_SeparatorText(g.ContextName);
    }
    for i32 n = g.WindowsFocusOrder.Size - 1; n >= 0; n-- {
        ImGuiWindow* window = g.WindowsFocusOrder.Data[n];
        assert(window != null);
        if ImGui_IsWindowNavFocusable(window) == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        u8* label = window.Name;
        if label == ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(label) {
            label = GetFallbackWindowNameForWindowingList(window);
        }
        ImGui_Selectable(label, g.NavWindowingTarget == window, 0, ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f});
    }
    ImGui_End();
    ImGui_PopStyleVar();
}

bool ImGui_BeginTooltipHidden() {

    ImGui_SetWindowHiddenAndSkipItemsForCurrentFrame(g.CurrentWindow);

// When this returns true you need to: a) call SetDragDropPayload() exactly once, b) you may render the payload visual/description, c) call EndDragDropSource()
// If the item has an identifier:
// - This assume/require the item to be activated (typically via ButtonBehavior).
// - Therefore if you want to use this with a mouse button other than left mouse button, it is up to the item itself to activate with another button.
// - We then pull and use the mouse button that was used to activate the item and use it to carry on the drag.
// If the item has no identifier:
// - Currently always assume left mouse button.
bool ImGui_BeginDragDropSource(ImGuiDragDropFlags flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    ImGuiMouseButton mouse_button = ImGuiMouseButton_Left;
    bool source_drag_active = false;
    ImGuiID source_id = 0;
    ImGuiID source_parent_id = 0;
    if (flags & ImGuiDragDropFlags_SourceExtern) == 0 {
        source_id = g.LastItemData.ID;
        if source_id != 0 {
            if g.ActiveId != source_id {
                return false;
            }
            if g.ActiveIdMouseButton != -1 {
                mouse_button = g.ActiveIdMouseButton;
            }
            if g.IO.MouseDown[mouse_button] == false || window.SkipItems {
                return false;
            }
            g.ActiveIdAllowOverlap = false;
        } else {
            if g.IO.MouseDown[mouse_button] == false || window.SkipItems {
                return false;
            }
            if (g.LastItemData.StatusFlags & ImGuiItemStatusFlags_HoveredRect) == 0 && (g.ActiveId == 0 || g.ActiveIdWindow != window) {
                return false;
            }
            if (flags & ImGuiDragDropFlags_SourceAllowNullID) == 0 {
                assert(0);
                return false;
            }
            g.LastItemData.ID = ImGuiWindow_GetIDFromRectangle(window, g.LastItemData.Rect);
            source_id = g.LastItemData.ID;
            ImGui_KeepAliveID(source_id);
            bool is_hovered = ImGui_ItemHoverable(g.LastItemData.Rect, source_id, g.LastItemData.ItemFlags);
            if is_hovered && g.IO.MouseClicked[mouse_button] {
                ImGui_SetActiveID(source_id, window);
                ImGui_FocusWindow(window);
            }
            if g.ActiveId == source_id {
                g.ActiveIdAllowOverlap = is_hovered;
            }
        }
        if g.ActiveId != source_id {
            return false;
        }
        source_parent_id = *ImVector_ImGuiID_back(&window.IDStack);
        source_drag_active = ImGui_IsMouseDragging(mouse_button);
        ImGui_SetActiveIdUsingAllKeyboardKeys();
    } else {
        window = null;
        source_id = ImHashStr("#SourceExtern");
        source_drag_active = true;
        mouse_button = g.IO.MouseDown[0] != 0 ? 0 : -1;
        ImGui_KeepAliveID(source_id);
        ImGui_SetActiveID(source_id, null);
    }
    assert(g.DragDropWithinTarget == false);
    if source_drag_active == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    if g.DragDropActive == 0 {
        assert(source_id != 0);
        ImGui_ClearDragDrop();
        while true {
            if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventActiveId) != 0 {
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
        ImGuiPayload* payload = &g.DragDropPayload;
        payload.SourceId = source_id;
        payload.SourceParentId = source_parent_id;
        g.DragDropActive = true;
        g.DragDropSourceFlags = flags;
        g.DragDropMouseButton = mouse_button;
        if payload.SourceId == g.ActiveId {
            g.ActiveIdNoClearOnFocusLoss = true;
        }
    }
    g.DragDropSourceFrameCount = g.FrameCount;
    g.DragDropWithinSource = true;
    if (flags & ImGuiDragDropFlags_SourceNoPreviewTooltip) == 0 {
        bool ret;
        if g.DragDropAcceptIdPrev && g.DragDropAcceptFlagsPrev & ImGuiDragDropFlags_AcceptNoPreviewTooltip {
            ret = ImGui_BeginTooltipHidden();
        } else {
            ret = ImGui_BeginTooltip();
        }
        assert(cast(i64, ret));
        ignore ret;
    }
    if !(flags & ImGuiDragDropFlags_SourceNoDisableHover) && !(flags & ImGuiDragDropFlags_SourceExtern) {
        g.LastItemData.StatusFlags &= ~ImGuiItemStatusFlags_HoveredRect;
    }
    return true;
}

void ImGui_EndDragDropSource() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(cast(i64, g.DragDropActive));
    assert(g.DragDropWithinSource && "Not after a BeginDragDropSource()?");
    if (g.DragDropSourceFlags & ImGuiDragDropFlags_SourceNoPreviewTooltip) == 0 {
        ImGui_EndTooltip();
    }
    if g.DragDropPayload.DataFrameCount == -1 {
        ImGui_ClearDragDrop();
    }
    g.DragDropWithinSource = false;
}

// Use 'cond' to choose to submit payload on drag start or every frame
bool ImGui_SetDragDropPayload(u8* type, void* data, u64 data_size, ImGuiCond cond) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiPayload* payload = &g.DragDropPayload;
    if cond == 0 {
        cond = ImGuiCond_Always;
    }
    assert(type != null);
    assert(strlen(type) < cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(payload.DataType) / sizeof(*payload.DataType))) && "Payload type can be at most 32 characters long");
    assert(data != null && data_size > 0 || data == null && data_size == 0);
    assert(cond == ImGuiCond_Always || cond == ImGuiCond_Once);
    assert(payload.SourceId != 0);
    if cond == ImGuiCond_Always || payload.DataFrameCount == -1 {
        ImStrncpy(payload.DataType, type, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(payload.DataType) / sizeof(*payload.DataType))));
        ImVector_unsigned_char_resize(&g.DragDropPayloadBufHeap, 0);
        if data_size > cast(u64, sizeof(g.DragDropPayloadBufLocal)) {
            ImVector_unsigned_char_resize(&g.DragDropPayloadBufHeap, cast(i32, data_size));
            payload.Data = g.DragDropPayloadBufHeap.Data;
            memcpy(payload.Data, data, cast(u64, cast(i32, data_size)));
        } else if data_size > 0 {
            memset(&g.DragDropPayloadBufLocal, 0, cast(u64, sizeof(g.DragDropPayloadBufLocal)));
            payload.Data = g.DragDropPayloadBufLocal;
            memcpy(payload.Data, data, cast(u64, cast(i32, data_size)));
        } else {
            payload.Data = null;
        }
        payload.DataSize = cast(i32, data_size);
    }
    payload.DataFrameCount = g.FrameCount;
    return g.DragDropAcceptFrameCount == g.FrameCount || g.DragDropAcceptFrameCount == g.FrameCount - 1;
}

bool ImGui_BeginDragDropTargetCustom(ImRect bb, ImGuiID id) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if g.DragDropActive == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    ImGuiWindow* hovered_window = g.HoveredWindowUnderMovingWindow;
    if hovered_window == null || window.RootWindowDockTree != hovered_window.RootWindowDockTree {
        return false;
    }
    assert(id != 0);
    if !ImGui_IsMouseHoveringRect(bb.Min, bb.Max) || id == g.DragDropPayload.SourceId {
        return false;
    }
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    assert(g.DragDropWithinTarget == false && g.DragDropWithinSource == false);
    g.DragDropTargetRect = bb;
    g.DragDropTargetClipRect = window.ClipRect;
    g.DragDropTargetId = id;

// Typical usage would be:
//   if (!ImGui::IsWindowHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_AnyWindow | ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenBlockedByActiveItem))
//       if (ImGui::BeginDragDropTargetViewport(ImGui::GetMainViewport(), NULL))
// But we are leaving the hover test to the caller for maximum flexibility.
bool ImGui_BeginDragDropTargetViewport(ImGuiViewport* viewport, ImRect* p_bb) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if g.DragDropActive == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImRect bb = p_bb != null ? *p_bb : ImGuiViewportP_GetWorkRect(cast(ImGuiViewportP*, viewport));
    ImGuiID id = viewport.ID;
    if cast(ImGuiViewport*, g.MouseViewport) != viewport || !ImGui_IsMouseHoveringRect(bb.Min, bb.Max, false) || id == g.DragDropPayload.SourceId {
        return false;
    }
    assert(g.DragDropWithinTarget == false && g.DragDropWithinSource == false);
    g.DragDropTargetRect = bb;
    g.DragDropTargetClipRect = bb;
    g.DragDropTargetId = id;
    g.DragDropTargetFullViewport = id;
    g.DragDropWithinTarget = true;
    return true;
}

// We don't use BeginDragDropTargetCustom() and duplicate its code because:
// 1) we use LastItemData's ImGuiItemStatusFlags_HoveredRect which handles items that push a temporarily clip rectangle in their code. Calling BeginDragDropTargetCustom(LastItemRect) would not handle them.
// 2) and it's faster. as this code may be very frequently called, we want to early out as fast as we can.
// Also note how the HoveredWindow test is positioned differently in both functions (in both functions we optimize for the cheapest early out case)
bool ImGui_BeginDragDropTarget() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if g.DragDropActive == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    if (g.LastItemData.StatusFlags & ImGuiItemStatusFlags_HoveredRect) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiWindow* hovered_window = g.HoveredWindowUnderMovingWindow;
    if hovered_window == null || window.RootWindowDockTree != hovered_window.RootWindowDockTree || window.SkipItems {
        return false;
    }
    ImRect display_rect = (g.LastItemData.StatusFlags & ImGuiItemStatusFlags_HasDisplayRect) != 0 ? g.LastItemData.DisplayRect : g.LastItemData.Rect;
    ImGuiID id = g.LastItemData.ID;
    if id == 0 {
        id = ImGuiWindow_GetIDFromRectangle(window, display_rect);
        ImGui_KeepAliveID(id);
    }
    if g.DragDropPayload.SourceId == id {
        return false;
    }
    assert(g.DragDropWithinTarget == false && g.DragDropWithinSource == false);
    g.DragDropTargetRect = display_rect;
    g.DragDropTargetClipRect = (g.LastItemData.StatusFlags & ImGuiItemStatusFlags_HasClipRect) != 0 ? g.LastItemData.ClipRect : window.ClipRect;
    g.DragDropTargetId = id;
    g.DragDropWithinTarget = true;
    return true;
}

ImGuiPayload* ImGui_AcceptDragDropPayload(u8* type, ImGuiDragDropFlags flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiPayload* payload = &g.DragDropPayload;
    assert(cast(i64, g.DragDropActive));
    assert(payload.DataFrameCount != -1);
    if type != null && !ImGuiPayload_IsDataType(payload, type) {
        return null;
    }
    bool was_accepted_previously = g.DragDropAcceptIdPrev == g.DragDropTargetId;
    ImRect r = g.DragDropTargetRect;
    f32 r_surface = ImRect_GetWidth(&r) * ImRect_GetHeight(&r);
    if r_surface > g.DragDropAcceptIdCurrRectSurface {
        return null;
    }
    g.DragDropAcceptFlagsCurr = flags;
    g.DragDropAcceptIdCurr = g.DragDropTargetId;
    g.DragDropAcceptIdCurrRectSurface = r_surface;
    payload.Preview = was_accepted_previously;
    flags |= g.DragDropSourceFlags & ImGuiDragDropFlags_AcceptNoDrawDefaultRect;
    bool draw_target_rect = payload.Preview && !(flags & ImGuiDragDropFlags_AcceptNoDrawDefaultRect);
    if draw_target_rect && g.DragDropTargetFullViewport != 0 {
        ImGuiViewport* viewport = ImGui_FindViewportByID(g.DragDropTargetFullViewport);
        assert(viewport != null);
        ImRect bb = g.DragDropTargetRect;
        ImRect_Expand(&bb, -3.5f);
        ImGui_RenderDragDropTargetRectEx(ImGui_GetForegroundDrawList(viewport), bb, g.Style.DragDropTargetRounding);
    } else if draw_target_rect != 0 {
        ImGui_RenderDragDropTargetRectForItem(r);
    }
    g.DragDropAcceptFrameCount = g.FrameCount;
    if g.DragDropSourceFlags & ImGuiDragDropFlags_SourceExtern && g.DragDropMouseButton == -1 {
        payload.Delivery = was_accepted_previously && g.DragDropSourceFrameCount < g.FrameCount;
    } else {
        payload.Delivery = was_accepted_previously && !ImGui_IsMouseDown(g.DragDropMouseButton);
    }
    if !payload.Delivery && !(flags & ImGuiDragDropFlags_AcceptBeforeDelivery) {
        return null;
    }
    if payload.Delivery != 0 {
        while true {
            if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventActiveId) != 0 {
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
    }
    return payload;
}

// Internal version that takes a position to decide on newline placement and pad items according to their depth.
// We split text into individual lines to add current tree level padding
// FIXME: This code is a little complicated perhaps, considering simplifying the whole system.
void ImGui_LogRenderedText(ImVec2* ref_pos, u8* text, u8* text_end) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    u8* prefix = g.LogNextPrefix;
    u8* suffix = g.LogNextSuffix;
    g.LogNextSuffix = null;
    g.LogNextPrefix = g.LogNextSuffix;
    if text_end == null {
        text_end = ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(text, text_end);
    }
    bool log_new_line = ref_pos && ref_pos.y > g.LogLinePosY + ImMax(g.Style.FramePadding.y, g.Style.ItemSpacing.y) + 1.0f;
    if ref_pos != null {
        g.LogLinePosY = ref_pos.y;
    }
    if log_new_line != 0 {
        ImGui_LogText("\n");
        g.LogLineFirstItem = true;
    }
    if prefix != null {
        ImGui_LogRenderedText(ref_pos, prefix, prefix + strlen(prefix));
    }
    if g.LogDepthRef > window.DC.TreeDepth {
        g.LogDepthRef = window.DC.TreeDepth;
    }
    i32 tree_depth = window.DC.TreeDepth - g.LogDepthRef;
    u8* text_remaining = text;
    while true {
        u8* line_start = text_remaining;
        u8* line_end = ImStreolRange(line_start, text_end);
        bool is_last_line = line_end == text_end;
        if line_start != line_end || !is_last_line {
            var line_length = cast(i32, cast(i64, line_end - line_start));
            i32 indentation = g.LogLineFirstItem != 0 ? tree_depth * 4 : 1;
            ImGui_LogText("%*s%.*s", indentation, "", line_length, line_start);
            g.LogLineFirstItem = false;
            if *line_end == 10 {
                ImGui_LogText("\n");
                g.LogLineFirstItem = true;
            }
        }
        if is_last_line != 0 {
            break;
        }
        text_remaining = line_end + 1;
    }
    if suffix != null {
        ImGui_LogRenderedText(ref_pos, suffix, suffix + strlen(suffix));
    }
}

// Zero-tolerance, no error reporting, cheap .ini parsing
// Set ini_size==0 to let us use strlen(ini_data). Do not call this function with a 0 if your buffer is actually empty!
void ImGui_LoadIniSettingsFromMemory(u8* ini_data, u64 ini_size) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(cast(i64, g.Initialized));
    if ini_size == 0 {
        ini_size = strlen(ini_data);
    }
    ImVector_char_resize(&g.SettingsIniData.Buf, cast(i32, ini_size) + 1);
    u8* buf = g.SettingsIniData.Buf.Data;
    u8* buf_end = buf + ini_size;
    memcpy(buf, ini_data, ini_size);
    buf_end[0] = 0;
    {
        ImGuiSettingsHandler* zz_rf_it_44 = ImVector_ImGuiSettingsHandler_begin(&g.SettingsHandlers);
        ImGuiSettingsHandler* zz_rf_end_44 = ImVector_ImGuiSettingsHandler_end(&g.SettingsHandlers);
        for ; zz_rf_it_44 != zz_rf_end_44; zz_rf_it_44++ {
            ImGuiSettingsHandler* handler = zz_rf_it_44;
            if handler.ReadInitFn != null {
                handler.ReadInitFn(g, handler);
            }
        }
    }
    void* entry_data = null;
    ImGuiSettingsHandler* entry_handler = null;
    u8* line_end = null;
    for u8* line = buf; line < buf_end; line = line_end + 1 {
        while *line == 10 || *line == 13 {
            line++;
        }
        line_end = line;
        while line_end < buf_end && *line_end != 10 && *line_end != 13 {
            line_end++;
        }
        line_end[0] = 0;
        if line[0] == 59 {
            continue;
        }
        if line[0] == 91 && line_end > line && line_end[-1] == 93 {
            line_end[-1] = 0;
            u8* name_end = line_end - 1;
            u8* type_start = line + 1;
            var type_end = cast(u8*, cast(void*, ImStrchrRange(type_start, name_end, 93)));
            u8* name_start = type_end != null ? ImStrchrRange(type_end + 1, name_end, 91) : null;
            if !type_end || !name_start {
                continue;
            }
            *type_end = 0;
            name_start++;
            entry_handler = ImGui_FindSettingsHandler(type_start);
            entry_data = entry_handler != null ? entry_handler.ReadOpenFn(g, entry_handler, name_start) : null;
        } else if entry_handler != null && entry_data != null {
            entry_handler.ReadLineFn(g, entry_handler, entry_data, line);
        }
    }
    g.SettingsLoaded = true;
    memcpy(buf, ini_data, ini_size);
    ImGuiSettingsCleanupArgs cleanup_args;
    if g.IO.ConfigIniSettingsAutoDiscardMonths > 0 {
        cleanup_args.DiscardOlderThanMonths = g.IO.ConfigIniSettingsAutoDiscardMonths;
        ImGui_CleanupIniSettings(&cleanup_args);
    }
    {
        ImGuiSettingsHandler* zz_rf_it_45 = ImVector_ImGuiSettingsHandler_begin(&g.SettingsHandlers);
        ImGuiSettingsHandler* zz_rf_end_45 = ImVector_ImGuiSettingsHandler_end(&g.SettingsHandlers);
        for ; zz_rf_it_45 != zz_rf_end_45; zz_rf_it_45++ {
            ImGuiSettingsHandler* handler = zz_rf_it_45;
            if handler.ApplyAllFn != null {
                handler.ApplyAllFn(g, handler);
            }
        }
    }
}

// Heuristic, see #8948: depends on how backends handle OS-level parenting.
// Due to how parent viewport stack is layed out, note that IsViewportAbove(a,b) isn't always the same as !IsViewportAbove(b,a).
bool IsViewportAbove(ImGuiViewportP* potential_above, ImGuiViewportP* potential_below) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if (g.IO.BackendFlags & ImGuiBackendFlags_HasParentViewport) != 0 {
        for ImGuiViewport* v = cast(ImGuiViewport*, potential_above); v != null && v.ParentViewport; v = v.ParentViewport {
            if v.ParentViewport == cast(ImGuiViewport*, potential_below) {
                return true;
            }
        }
    } else {
        if potential_above.ParentViewport == cast(ImGuiViewport*, potential_below) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    if potential_above.LastFocusedStampCount > potential_below.LastFocusedStampCount {
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

bool ImGui_UpdateTryMergeWindowIntoHostViewport(ImGuiWindow* window, ImGuiViewportP* viewport_dst) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(window == window.RootWindowDockTree);
    ImGuiViewportP* viewport_src = window.Viewport;
    if viewport_src == viewport_dst {
        return false;
    }
    if (viewport_dst.Flags & ImGuiViewportFlags_CanHostOtherWindows) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    if (viewport_dst.Flags & ImGuiViewportFlags_IsMinimized) != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    if ImRect_Contains(&ImGuiViewportP_GetMainRect(viewport_dst), ImGuiWindow_Rect(window)) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    if ImGui_GetWindowAlwaysWantOwnViewport(window) != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    {
        ImGuiViewportP** zz_rf_it_51 = ImVector_ImGuiViewportP_ptr_begin(&g.Viewports);
        ImGuiViewportP** zz_rf_end_51 = ImVector_ImGuiViewportP_ptr_end(&g.Viewports);
        for ; zz_rf_it_51 != zz_rf_end_51; zz_rf_it_51++ {
            ImGuiViewportP* viewport_obstructing = *zz_rf_it_51;
            if viewport_obstructing == viewport_src || viewport_obstructing == viewport_dst || !viewport_obstructing.PlatformWindowCreated {
                continue;
            }
            if ImRect_Overlaps(&ImGuiViewportP_GetMainRect(viewport_obstructing), ImGuiWindow_Rect(window)) != 0 {
                if IsViewportAbove(viewport_obstructing, viewport_dst) != 0 {
                    if viewport_src == null || IsViewportAbove(viewport_src, viewport_obstructing) {
                        return false;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    while true {
        if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventViewport) != 0 {
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    if window.ViewportOwned != 0 {
        for i32 n = 0; n < g.Windows.Size; n++ {
            if g.Windows.Data[n].Viewport == viewport_src {
                ImGui_SetWindowViewport(g.Windows.Data[n], viewport_dst);
            }
        }
    }
    ImGui_SetWindowViewport(window, viewport_dst);
    if (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoBringToFrontOnFocus) == 0 {
        ImGui_BringWindowToDisplayFront(window);
    }
    return true;
}

        if op_ne_ImVec2_ImVec2(prev_pos, viewport.Pos) || op_ne_ImVec2_ImVec2(prev_size, viewport.Size) {

        }
    } else {
        viewport = cast(ImGuiViewportP*, ImGui_MemAlloc(cast(u64, sizeof(ImGuiViewportP))));
        ImGuiViewportP_init(viewport);
        viewport.ID = id;
        viewport.Idx = g.Viewports.Size;
        viewport.LastPos = pos;
        viewport.Pos = viewport.LastPos;
        viewport.LastSize = size;
        viewport.Size = viewport.LastSize;
        viewport.Flags = flags;
        ImGui_UpdateViewportPlatformMonitor(viewport);
        ImVector_ImGuiViewportP_ptr_push_back(&g.Viewports, viewport);
        g.ViewportCreatedCount++;
        while true {
            if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventViewport) != 0 {
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
        viewport.LastFocusedStampCount = ++g.ViewportFocusedStampCount;

        g.DrawListSharedData.ClipRectFullscreen.y = ImMin(g.DrawListSharedData.ClipRectFullscreen.y, viewport.Pos.y);
        g.DrawListSharedData.ClipRectFullscreen.z = ImMax(g.DrawListSharedData.ClipRectFullscreen.z, viewport.Pos.x + viewport.Size.x);
        g.DrawListSharedData.ClipRectFullscreen.w = ImMax(g.DrawListSharedData.ClipRectFullscreen.w, viewport.Pos.y + viewport.Size.y);
        viewport.DpiScale = ImGui_GetViewportPlatformMonitor(cast(ImGuiViewport*, viewport)).DpiScale;
    }
    viewport.Window = window;
    viewport.LastFrameActive = g.FrameCount;
    ImGuiViewportP_UpdateWorkRect(viewport);
    assert(window == null || viewport.ID == window.ID);
    if window != null {
        window.ViewportOwned = true;
    }
    return viewport;
}

            if window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_DockNodeHost && window.Viewport.LastFrameActive < g.FrameCount && will_be_visible {

// Called by user at the end of the main loop, after EndFrame()
// This will handle the creation/update of all OS windows via function defined in the ImGuiPlatformIO api.
void ImGui_UpdatePlatformWindows() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(g.FrameCountEnded == g.FrameCount && "Forgot to call Render() or EndFrame() before UpdatePlatformWindows()?");
    assert(g.FrameCountPlatformEnded < g.FrameCount);
    g.FrameCountPlatformEnded = g.FrameCount;
    if (g.ConfigFlagsCurrFrame & ImGuiConfigFlags_ViewportsEnable) == 0 {
        return;
    }
    for i32 i = 1; i < g.Viewports.Size; i++ {
        ImGuiViewportP* viewport = g.Viewports.Data[i];
        bool destroy_platform_window = false;
        destroy_platform_window |= viewport.LastFrameActive < g.FrameCount - 1;
        destroy_platform_window |= viewport.Window && !IsWindowActiveAndVisible(viewport.Window);
        if destroy_platform_window != 0 {
            ImGui_DestroyPlatformWindow(viewport);
            continue;
        }
        if viewport.LastFrameActive < g.FrameCount || viewport.Size.x <= 0.0f || viewport.Size.y <= 0.0f {
            continue;
        }
        bool is_new_platform_window = viewport.PlatformWindowCreated == false;
        if is_new_platform_window != 0 {
            while true {
                if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventViewport) != 0 {
                }
                if !(0 != 0) { break; }
            }
            g.PlatformIO.Platform_CreateWindow(cast(ImGuiViewport*, viewport));
            if g.PlatformIO.Renderer_CreateWindow != null {
                g.PlatformIO.Renderer_CreateWindow(cast(ImGuiViewport*, viewport));
            }
            g.PlatformWindowsCreatedCount++;
            viewport.LastNameHash = 0;
            viewport.LastPlatformSize = ImVec2{FLT_MAX, FLT_MAX};
            viewport.LastPlatformPos = viewport.LastPlatformSize;
            viewport.LastRendererSize = viewport.Size;
            viewport.PlatformWindowCreated = true;
        }
        if (viewport.LastPlatformPos.x != viewport.Pos.x || viewport.LastPlatformPos.y != viewport.Pos.y) && !viewport.PlatformRequestMove {
            g.PlatformIO.Platform_SetWindowPos(cast(ImGuiViewport*, viewport), viewport.Pos);
        }
        if (viewport.LastPlatformSize.x != viewport.Size.x || viewport.LastPlatformSize.y != viewport.Size.y) && !viewport.PlatformRequestResize {
            g.PlatformIO.Platform_SetWindowSize(cast(ImGuiViewport*, viewport), viewport.Size);
        }
        if (viewport.LastRendererSize.x != viewport.Size.x || viewport.LastRendererSize.y != viewport.Size.y) && g.PlatformIO.Renderer_SetWindowSize {
            g.PlatformIO.Renderer_SetWindowSize(cast(ImGuiViewport*, viewport), viewport.Size);
        }
        viewport.LastPlatformPos = viewport.Pos;
        viewport.LastRendererSize = viewport.Size;
        viewport.LastPlatformSize = viewport.LastRendererSize;
        {
            ImGuiWindow* window_for_title = GetWindowForTitleDisplay(viewport.Window);
            if window_for_title != null {
                u8* title_begin = window_for_title.Name;
                var title_end = cast(u8*, cast(i64, ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(title_begin)));
                ImGuiID title_hash = ImHashStr(title_begin, cast(u64, cast(i64, title_end - title_begin)));
                if viewport.LastNameHash != title_hash {
                    u8 title_end_backup_c = *title_end;
                    *title_end = 0;
                    g.PlatformIO.Platform_SetWindowTitle(cast(ImGuiViewport*, viewport), title_begin);
                    *title_end = title_end_backup_c;
                    viewport.LastNameHash = title_hash;
                }
            }
        }
        if viewport.LastAlpha != viewport.Alpha && g.PlatformIO.Platform_SetWindowAlpha {
            g.PlatformIO.Platform_SetWindowAlpha(cast(ImGuiViewport*, viewport), viewport.Alpha);
        }
        viewport.LastAlpha = viewport.Alpha;
        if g.PlatformIO.Platform_UpdateWindow != null {
            g.PlatformIO.Platform_UpdateWindow(cast(ImGuiViewport*, viewport));
        }
        if is_new_platform_window != 0 {
            if g.FrameCount < 3 {
                viewport.Flags |= ImGuiViewportFlags_NoFocusOnAppearing;
            }
            g.PlatformIO.Platform_ShowWindow(cast(ImGuiViewport*, viewport));

i32 ImGui_FindPlatformMonitorForPos(ImVec2 pos) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    for i32 monitor_n = 0; monitor_n < g.PlatformIO.Monitors.Size; monitor_n++ {
        ImGuiPlatformMonitor monitor = g.PlatformIO.Monitors.Data[monitor_n];
        if ImRect_Contains(&ImRect{
            monitor.MainPos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(monitor.MainPos, monitor.MainSize),
        }, pos) != 0 {
            return monitor_n;
        }
    }
    return -1;
}

// Search for the monitor with the largest intersection area with the given rectangle
// We generally try to avoid searching loops but the monitor count should be very small here
// FIXME-OPT: We could test the last monitor used for that viewport first, and early
i32 ImGui_FindPlatformMonitorForRect(ImRect rect) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    i32 monitor_count = g.PlatformIO.Monitors.Size;
    if monitor_count <= 1 {
        return monitor_count - 1;
    }
    f32 surface_threshold = ImMax(ImRect_GetWidth(&rect) * ImRect_GetHeight(&rect) * 0.5f, 1.0f);
    i32 best_monitor_n = 0;
    f32 best_monitor_surface = 0.001f;
    for i32 monitor_n = 0; monitor_n < g.PlatformIO.Monitors.Size && best_monitor_surface < surface_threshold; monitor_n++ {
        ImGuiPlatformMonitor monitor = g.PlatformIO.Monitors.Data[monitor_n];
        var monitor_rect = ImRect{
            monitor.MainPos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(monitor.MainPos, monitor.MainSize),
        };
        if ImRect_Contains(&monitor_rect, rect) != 0 {
            return monitor_n;
        }
        ImRect overlapping_rect = rect;
        ImRect_ClipWithFull(&overlapping_rect, monitor_rect);
        f32 overlapping_surface = ImRect_GetWidth(&overlapping_rect) * ImRect_GetHeight(&overlapping_rect);
        if overlapping_surface < best_monitor_surface {
            continue;
        }
        best_monitor_surface = overlapping_surface;
        best_monitor_n = monitor_n;
    }
    return best_monitor_n;
}

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Docking: ImGuiDockContext
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The lifetime model is different from the one of regular windows: we always create a ImGuiDockNode for each ImGuiDockNodeSettings,
// or we always hold the entire docking node tree. Nodes are frequently hidden, e.g. if the window(s) or child nodes they host are not active.
// At boot time only, we run a simple GC to remove nodes that have no references.
// Because dock node settings (which are small, contiguous structures) are always mirrored by their corresponding dock nodes (more complete structures),
// we can also very easily recreate the nodes from scratch given the settings data (this is what DockContextRebuild() does).
// This is convenient as docking reconfiguration can be implemented by mostly poking at the simpler settings data.
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// - DockContextInitialize()
// - DockContextShutdown()
// - DockContextClearNodes()
// - DockContextRebuildNodes()
// - DockContextNewFrameUpdateUndocking()
// - DockContextNewFrameUpdateDocking()
// - DockContextEndFrame()
// - DockContextFindNodeByID()
// - DockContextBindNodeToWindow()
// - DockContextGenNodeID()
// - DockContextAddNode()
// - DockContextRemoveNode()
// - ImGuiDockContextPruneNodeData
// - DockContextPruneUnusedSettingsNodes()
// - DockContextBuildNodesFromSettings()
// - DockContextBuildAddWindowsToNodes()
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
void ImGui_DockContextInitialize(ImGuiContext* ctx) {
    ImGuiContext* g = ctx;

        ImPool_ImGuiDockContextPruneNodeData_GetOrAddByKey(&pool, settings.ID).RootId = parent_data != null ? parent_data.RootId : settings.ID;

void ImGui_DockContextProcessDock(ImGuiContext* ctx, ImGuiDockRequest* req) {
    assert(req.Type == ImGuiDockRequestType_Dock && req.DockPayload != null || req.Type == ImGuiDockRequestType_Split && req.DockPayload == null);
    assert(req.DockTargetWindow != null || req.DockTargetNode != null);
    ImGuiContext* g = ctx;
    ignore *g;
    ImGuiWindow* payload_window = req.DockPayload;
    ImGuiWindow* target_window = req.DockTargetWindow;
    ImGuiDockNode* node = req.DockTargetNode;
    if payload_window != null {
        while true {
            if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventDocking) != 0 {
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
    } else {
        while true {
            if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventDocking) != 0 {
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
    }
    ImGuiID next_selected_id = 0;
    ImGuiDockNode* payload_node = null;
    if payload_window != null {
        payload_node = payload_window.DockNodeAsHost;
        payload_window.DockNodeAsHost = null;
        if payload_node && ImGuiDockNode_IsLeafNode(payload_node) {
            next_selected_id = payload_node.TabBar.NextSelectedTabId != 0 ? payload_node.TabBar.NextSelectedTabId : payload_node.TabBar.SelectedTabId;
        }
        if payload_node == null {
            next_selected_id = payload_window.TabId;
        }
    }
    if node != null {
        assert(node.LastFrameAlive <= g.FrameCount);
    }
    if node && target_window && node == target_window.DockNodeAsHost {
        assert(node.Windows.Size > 0 || ImGuiDockNode_IsSplitNode(node) || ImGuiDockNode_IsCentralNode(node));
    }
    if node == null {
        node = ImGui_DockContextAddNode(ctx, 0);
        node.Pos = target_window.Pos;
        node.Size = target_window.Size;
        if target_window.DockNodeAsHost == null {
            ImGui_DockNodeAddWindow(node, target_window, true);
            node.TabBar.Tabs.Data[0].Flags &= ~ImGuiTabItemFlags_Unsorted;
            target_window.DockIsActive = true;
        }
    }
    ImGuiDir split_dir = req.DockSplitDir;
    if split_dir != ImGuiDir_None {
        ImGuiAxis split_axis = split_dir == ImGuiDir_Left || split_dir == ImGuiDir_Right ? ImGuiAxis_X : ImGuiAxis_Y;
        i32 split_inheritor_child_idx = split_dir == ImGuiDir_Left || split_dir == ImGuiDir_Up ? 1 : 0;
        f32 split_ratio = req.DockSplitRatio;
        ImGui_DockNodeTreeSplit(ctx, node, split_axis, split_inheritor_child_idx, split_ratio, payload_node);
        ImGuiDockNode* new_node = node.ChildNodes[split_inheritor_child_idx ^ 1];
        new_node.HostWindow = node.HostWindow;
        node = new_node;
    }
    ImGuiDockNode_SetLocalFlags(node, node.LocalFlags & ~ImGuiDockNodeFlags_HiddenTabBar);
    if node != payload_node {
        if node.Windows.Size > 0 && node.TabBar == null {
            ImGui_DockNodeAddTabBar(node);
            for i32 n = 0; n < node.Windows.Size; n++ {
                ImGui_TabBarAddTab(node.TabBar, ImGuiTabItemFlags_None, node.Windows.Data[n]);
            }
        }
        if payload_node != null {
            if ImGuiDockNode_IsSplitNode(payload_node) != 0 {
                if node.Windows.Size > 0 {
                    assert(payload_node.OnlyNodeWithWindows != null);
                    ImGuiDockNode* visible_node = payload_node.OnlyNodeWithWindows;
                    if visible_node.TabBar != null {
                        assert(visible_node.TabBar.Tabs.Size > 0);
                    }
                    ImGui_DockNodeMoveWindows(node, visible_node);
                    ImGui_DockNodeMoveWindows(visible_node, node);
                    ImGui_DockSettingsRenameNodeReferences(node.ID, visible_node.ID);
                }
                if ImGuiDockNode_IsCentralNode(node) != 0 {
                    ImGuiDockNode* last_focused_node = ImGui_DockContextFindNodeByID(ctx, payload_node.LastFocusedNodeId);
                    assert(last_focused_node != null);
                    ImGuiDockNode* last_focused_root_node = ImGui_DockNodeGetRootNode(last_focused_node);
                    assert(last_focused_root_node == ImGui_DockNodeGetRootNode(payload_node));
                    ImGuiDockNode_SetLocalFlags(last_focused_node, last_focused_node.LocalFlags | ImGuiDockNodeFlags_CentralNode);
                    ImGuiDockNode_SetLocalFlags(node, node.LocalFlags & ~ImGuiDockNodeFlags_CentralNode);
                    last_focused_root_node.CentralNode = last_focused_node;
                }
                assert(node.Windows.Size == 0);
                ImGui_DockNodeMoveChildNodes(node, payload_node);
            } else {
                ImGuiID payload_dock_id = payload_node.ID;
                ImGui_DockNodeMoveWindows(node, payload_node);
                ImGui_DockSettingsRenameNodeReferences(payload_dock_id, node.ID);
            }
            ImGui_DockContextRemoveNode(ctx, payload_node, true);
        } else if payload_window != null {
            ImGuiID payload_dock_id = payload_window.DockId;
            node.VisibleWindow = payload_window;
            ImGui_DockNodeAddWindow(node, payload_window, true);
            if payload_dock_id != 0 {
                ImGui_DockSettingsRenameNodeReferences(payload_dock_id, node.ID);
            }
        }
    } else {
        node.WantHiddenTabBarUpdate = true;
    }
    {
        ImGuiTabBar* tab_bar = node.TabBar;
        if tab_bar != null {
            tab_bar.NextSelectedTabId = next_selected_id;
        }
    }
    ImGui_MarkIniSettingsDirty();
}

// Problem:
//   Undocking a large (~full screen) window would leave it so large that the bottom right sizing corner would more
//   than likely be off the screen and the window would be hard to resize to fit on screen. This can be particularly problematic
//   with 'ConfigWindowsMoveFromTitleBarOnly=true' and/or with 'ConfigWindowsResizeFromEdges=false' as well (the later can be
//   due to missing ImGuiBackendFlags_HasMouseCursors backend flag).
// Solution:
//   When undocking a window we currently force its maximum size to 90% of the host viewport or monitor.
// Reevaluate this when we implement preserving docked/undocked size ("docking_wip/undocked_size" branch).
private {
ImVec2 FixLargeWindowsWhenUndocking(ImVec2 size, ImGuiViewport* ref_viewport) {
    if ref_viewport == null {
        return size;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImVec2 max_size = ImTrunc(op_mul_ImVec2_float(ref_viewport.WorkSize, 0.9f));
    if (g.ConfigFlagsCurrFrame & ImGuiConfigFlags_ViewportsEnable) != 0 {
        ImGuiPlatformMonitor* monitor = ImGui_GetViewportPlatformMonitor(ref_viewport);
        max_size = ImTrunc(op_mul_ImVec2_float(monitor.WorkSize, 0.9f));
    }
    return ImMin(size, max_size);
}
}

void ImGui_DockContextProcessUndockNode(ImGuiContext* ctx, ImGuiDockNode* node) {

        node.ParentNode.ChildNodes[index_in_parent] = null;

    {

    }
    node.AuthorityForSize = cast(ImU8, ImGuiDataAuthority_DockNode);
    node.AuthorityForPos = node.AuthorityForSize;

    }
    node.LocalFlagsInWindows = ImGuiDockNodeFlags_None;
    for i32 window_n = 0; window_n < node.Windows.Size; window_n++ {
        ImGuiWindow* window = node.Windows.Data[window_n];
        assert(window.DockNode == node);
        bool node_was_active = node.LastFrameActive + 1 == g.FrameCount;
        bool remove_var = false;  // renamed from: remove
        remove_var |= node_was_active && window.WasActive == false;
        remove_var |= node_was_active && (node.WantCloseAll || node.WantCloseTabId == window.TabId) && window.HasCloseButton && !(window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_UnsavedDocument);
        remove_var |= window.DockTabWantClose;

                ImGui_DockNodeHideHostWindow(node);
                node.State = ImGuiDockNodeState_HostWindowHiddenBecauseSingleWindow;
                ImGui_DockNodeRemoveWindow(node, window, node.ID);

        node.LocalFlagsInWindows |= window.WindowClass.DockNodeFlagsOverrideSet;
    }
    ImGuiDockNode_UpdateMergedFlags(node);
    ImGuiDockNodeFlags node_flags = node.MergedFlags;
    if node.WantHiddenTabBarUpdate && node.Windows.Size == 1 && node_flags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_AutoHideTabBar && !ImGuiDockNode_IsHiddenTabBar(node) {

    } else if node.WantHiddenTabBarToggle != 0 {

    if ((node.LocalFlags ^ prev_local_flags) & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_SavedFlagsMask_) != 0 {

    node.WantHiddenTabBarToggle = false;
    ImGui_DockNodeUpdateVisibleFlag(node);
