            node.AuthorityForPos = node.AuthorityForSize;
        } else if node.ParentNode != null {
            host_window = node.ParentNode.HostWindow;
            node.HostWindow = host_window;
            node.AuthorityForViewport = cast(ImU8, ImGuiDataAuthority_Auto);
            node.AuthorityForSize = node.AuthorityForViewport;
            node.AuthorityForPos = node.AuthorityForSize;
        }
        if node.WantMouseMove && node.HostWindow {
            ImGui_DockNodeStartMouseMovingWindow(node, node.HostWindow);
        }
    }
    node.RefViewportId = 0;
    if ImGuiDockNode_IsSplitNode(node) != 0 {
        assert(node.TabBar == null);
    }
    if ImGuiDockNode_IsRootNode(node) != 0 {
        ImGuiWindow* p_window = g.NavWindow != null ? g.NavWindow.RootWindow : null;
        if p_window != null {
            while p_window != null && p_window.DockNode != null {
                ImGuiDockNode* p_node = ImGui_DockNodeGetRootNode(p_window.DockNode);
                if p_node == node {
                    node.LastFocusedNodeId = p_window.DockNode.ID;
                    break;
                }
                p_window = p_node.HostWindow != null ? p_node.HostWindow.RootWindow : null;
            }
        }
    }
    ImGuiDockNode* central_node = node.CentralNode;
    bool central_node_hole = ImGuiDockNode_IsRootNode(node) && host_window && (node_flags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_PassthruCentralNode) != 0 && central_node != null && ImGuiDockNode_IsEmpty(central_node);
    bool central_node_hole_register_hit_test_hole = central_node_hole;
    if central_node_hole != 0 {
        ImGuiPayload* payload = ImGui_GetDragDropPayload();
        if payload != null {
            if ImGuiPayload_IsDataType(payload, "_IMWINDOW") && ImGui_DockNodeIsDropAllowed(host_window, *cast(ImGuiWindow**, payload.Data)) {
                central_node_hole_register_hit_test_hole = false;
            }
        }
    }
    if central_node_hole_register_hit_test_hole != 0 {
        assert(cast(i64, ImGuiDockNode_IsDockSpace(node)));
        ImGuiDockNode* root_node = ImGui_DockNodeGetRootNode(central_node);
        ImRect root_rect;
        ImRect_init(&root_rect, root_node.Pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(root_node.Pos, root_node.Size));
        ImRect hole_rect;
        ImRect_init(&hole_rect, central_node.Pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(central_node.Pos, central_node.Size));
        if hole_rect.Min.x > root_rect.Min.x {
            hole_rect.Min.x += g.WindowsBorderHoverPadding;
        }
        if hole_rect.Max.x < root_rect.Max.x {
            hole_rect.Max.x -= g.WindowsBorderHoverPadding;
        }
        if hole_rect.Min.y > root_rect.Min.y {
            hole_rect.Min.y += g.WindowsBorderHoverPadding;
        }
        if hole_rect.Max.y < root_rect.Max.y {
            hole_rect.Max.y -= g.WindowsBorderHoverPadding;
        }
        if central_node_hole && !ImRect_IsInverted(&hole_rect) {
            ImGui_SetWindowHitTestHole(host_window, hole_rect.Min, op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(hole_rect.Max, hole_rect.Min));
            if host_window.ParentWindow != null {
                ImGui_SetWindowHitTestHole(host_window.ParentWindow, hole_rect.Min, op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(hole_rect.Max, hole_rect.Min));
            }
        }
    }
    if ImGuiDockNode_IsRootNode(node) && host_window {
        ImGui_DockNodeTreeUpdatePosSize(node, host_window.Pos, host_window.Size);
        ImGui_PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Separator, g.Style.Colors[ImGuiCol_Border]);
        ImGui_PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_SeparatorActive, g.Style.Colors[ImGuiCol_ResizeGripActive]);
        ImGui_PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_SeparatorHovered, g.Style.Colors[ImGuiCol_ResizeGripHovered]);
        ImGui_DockNodeTreeUpdateSplitter(node);
        ImGui_PopStyleColor(3);
    }
    if host_window && ImGuiDockNode_IsEmpty(node) && node.IsVisible {
        ImDrawList_ChannelsSetCurrent(host_window.DrawList, 0);
        node.LastBgColor = cast(ImU32, (node_flags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_PassthruCentralNode) != 0 ? 0 : ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_DockingEmptyBg));
        if node.LastBgColor != 0 {
            ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(host_window.DrawList, node.Pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(node.Pos, node.Size), node.LastBgColor, 0.0f, 0);
        }
        node.IsBgDrawnThisFrame = true;
    }
    bool render_dockspace_bg = ImGuiDockNode_IsRootNode(node) && host_window && (node_flags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_PassthruCentralNode) != 0;
    if render_dockspace_bg && node.IsVisible {
        ImDrawList_ChannelsSetCurrent(host_window.DrawList, 0);
        if central_node_hole != 0 {
            ImGui_RenderRectFilledWithHole(host_window.DrawList, ImGuiDockNode_Rect(node), ImGuiDockNode_Rect(central_node), ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_WindowBg), 0.0f);
        } else {
            ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(host_window.DrawList, node.Pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(node.Pos, node.Size), ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_WindowBg), 0.0f, 0);
        }
    }
    if host_window != null {
        ImDrawList_ChannelsSetCurrent(host_window.DrawList, 1);
    }
    if host_window && node.Windows.Size > 0 {
        ImGui_DockNodeUpdateTabBar(node, host_window);
    } else {
        node.WantCloseAll = false;
        node.WantCloseTabId = 0;
        node.IsFocused = false;
    }
    if node.TabBar && node.TabBar.SelectedTabId {
        node.SelectedTabId = node.TabBar.SelectedTabId;
    } else if node.Windows.Size > 0 {
        node.SelectedTabId = node.Windows.Data[0].TabId;
    }
    if host_window && node.IsVisible {
        if ImGuiDockNode_IsRootNode(node) && (g.MovingWindow == null || g.MovingWindow.RootWindowDockTree != host_window) {
            ImGui_BeginDockableDragDropTarget(host_window);
        }
    }
    node.LastFrameActive = g.FrameCount;
    if host_window != null {
        if node.ChildNodes[0] != null {
            ImGui_DockNodeUpdate(node.ChildNodes[0]);
        }
        if node.ChildNodes[1] != null {
            ImGui_DockNodeUpdate(node.ChildNodes[1]);
        }
        if ImGuiDockNode_IsRootNode(node) != 0 {
            ImGui_RenderWindowOuterBorders(host_window);
        }
    }
    if beginned_into_host_window != 0 {
        ImGui_End();
    }
}

// Compare TabItem nodes given the last known DockOrder (will persist in .ini file as hint), used to sort tabs when multiple tabs are added on the same frame.
i32 TabItemComparerByDockOrder(void* lhs, void* rhs) {
    ImGuiWindow* a = cast(ImGuiTabItem*, lhs).Window;
    ImGuiWindow* b = cast(ImGuiTabItem*, rhs).Window;
    {
        i32 d = (a.DockOrder == -1 ? INT_MAX : a.DockOrder) - (b.DockOrder == -1 ? INT_MAX : b.DockOrder);
        if d != 0 {
            return d;
        }
    }
    return a.BeginOrderWithinContext - b.BeginOrderWithinContext;
}
}

// Default handler for g.DockNodeWindowMenuHandler(): display the list of windows for a given dock-node.
// This is exceptionally stored in a function pointer to also user applications to tweak this menu (undocumented)
// Custom overrides may want to decorate, group, sort entries.
// Please note those are internal structures: if you copy this expect occasional breakage.
// (if you don't need to modify the "Tabs.Size == 1" behavior/path it is recommend you call this function in your handler)
void ImGui_DockNodeWindowMenuHandler_Default(ImGuiContext* ctx, ImGuiDockNode* node, ImGuiTabBar* tab_bar) {
    ignore ctx;
    if tab_bar.Tabs.Size == 1 {
        if ImGui_MenuItem(ImGui_LocalizeGetMsg(ImGuiLocKey_DockingHideTabBar), null, ImGuiDockNode_IsHiddenTabBar(node), true) != 0 {
            node.WantHiddenTabBarToggle = true;
        }
    } else {
        for i32 tab_n = 0; tab_n < tab_bar.Tabs.Size; tab_n++ {
            ImGuiTabItem* tab = &tab_bar.Tabs.Data[tab_n];
            if (tab.Flags & ImGuiTabItemFlags_Button) != 0 {
                continue;
            }
            if ImGui_Selectable(ImGui_TabBarGetTabName(tab_bar, tab), tab.ID == tab_bar.SelectedTabId, 0, ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f}) != 0 {
                ImGui_TabBarQueueFocus(tab_bar, tab);
            }
            ImGui_SameLine();
            ImGui_Text("   ");
        }
    }
}

private {
void ImGui_DockNodeWindowMenuUpdate(ImGuiDockNode* node, ImGuiTabBar* tab_bar) {

        ImGui_SetNextWindowPos(ImVec2{node.Pos.x, node.Pos.y + ImGui_GetFrameHeight()}, ImGuiCond_Always, ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f});

}

// User helper to append/amend into a dock node tab bar. Most commonly used to add e.g. a "+" button.
bool ImGui_DockNodeBeginAmendTabBar(ImGuiDockNode* node) {
    if node.TabBar == null || node.HostWindow == null {
        return false;
    }
    if (node.MergedFlags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_KeepAliveOnly) != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    if node.TabBar.ID == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGui_Begin(node.HostWindow.Name);
    ImGui_PushOverrideID(node.ID);
    bool ret = ImGui_BeginTabBarEx(node.TabBar, node.TabBar.BarRect, node.TabBar.Flags);
    ignore ret;
    assert(cast(i64, ret));
    return true;
}

void ImGui_DockNodeEndAmendTabBar() {
    ImGui_EndTabBar();
    ImGui_PopID();
    ImGui_End();
}

private {
bool IsDockNodeTitleBarHighlighted(ImGuiDockNode* node, ImGuiDockNode* root_node) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if g.NavWindowingTarget != null {
        return g.NavWindowingTarget.DockNode == node;
    }
    if g.NavWindow && root_node.LastFocusedNodeId == node.ID {
        ImGuiWindow* parent_window = g.NavWindow.RootWindow;
        while (parent_window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildMenu) != 0 {
            parent_window = parent_window.ParentWindow.RootWindow;
        }
        ImGuiDockNode* start_parent_node = parent_window.DockNodeAsHost != null ? parent_window.DockNodeAsHost : parent_window.DockNode;
        for ImGuiDockNode* parent_node = start_parent_node; parent_node != null; parent_node = parent_node.HostWindow != null ? parent_node.HostWindow.RootWindow.DockNode : null {
            parent_node = ImGui_DockNodeGetRootNode(parent_node);
            if parent_node == root_node {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

// Submit the tab bar corresponding to a dock node and various housekeeping details.
void ImGui_DockNodeUpdateTabBar(ImGuiDockNode* node, ImGuiWindow* host_window) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiStyle* style = &g.Style;
    bool node_was_active = node.LastFrameActive + 1 == g.FrameCount;
    node.WantCloseAll = false;
    node.WantCloseTabId = 0;
    bool is_focused = false;
    ImGuiDockNode* root_node = ImGui_DockNodeGetRootNode(node);
    if IsDockNodeTitleBarHighlighted(node, root_node) != 0 {
        is_focused = true;
    }
    if ImGuiDockNode_IsHiddenTabBar(node) || ImGuiDockNode_IsNoTabBar(node) {
        node.VisibleWindow = node.Windows.Size > 0 ? node.Windows.Data[0] : null;
        node.IsFocused = is_focused;
        if is_focused != 0 {
            node.LastFrameFocused = g.FrameCount;
        }
        if node.VisibleWindow != null {
            if is_focused || root_node.VisibleWindow == null {
                root_node.VisibleWindow = node.VisibleWindow;
            }
            if node.TabBar != null {
                node.TabBar.VisibleTabId = node.VisibleWindow.TabId;
            }
        }
        return;
    }
    bool backup_skip_item = host_window.SkipItems;
    if ImGuiDockNode_IsDockSpace(node) == 0 {
        host_window.SkipItems = false;
        host_window.DC.NavLayerCurrent = ImGuiNavLayer_Menu;
    }
    ImGui_PushOverrideID(node.ID);
    ImGuiTabBar* tab_bar = node.TabBar;
    bool tab_bar_is_recreated = tab_bar == null;
    if tab_bar == null {
        ImGui_DockNodeAddTabBar(node);
        tab_bar = node.TabBar;
    }
    ImGuiID focus_tab_id = 0;
    node.IsFocused = is_focused;
    ImGuiDockNodeFlags node_flags = node.MergedFlags;
    bool has_window_menu_button = (node_flags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_NoWindowMenuButton) == 0 && style.WindowMenuButtonPosition != ImGuiDir_None;
    if has_window_menu_button && ImGui_IsPopupOpen("#WindowMenu") {
        ImGuiID next_selected_tab_id = tab_bar.NextSelectedTabId;
        ImGui_DockNodeWindowMenuUpdate(node, tab_bar);
        if tab_bar.NextSelectedTabId != 0 && tab_bar.NextSelectedTabId != next_selected_tab_id {
            focus_tab_id = tab_bar.NextSelectedTabId;
        }
        is_focused |= node.IsFocused;
    }
    ImRect title_bar_rect;
    ImRect tab_bar_rect;
    ImVec2 window_menu_button_pos;
    ImVec2 close_button_pos;
    ImGui_DockNodeCalcTabBarLayout(node, &title_bar_rect, &tab_bar_rect, &window_menu_button_pos, &close_button_pos);
    i32 tabs_count_old = tab_bar.Tabs.Size;
    for i32 window_n = 0; window_n < node.Windows.Size; window_n++ {
        ImGuiWindow* window = node.Windows.Data[window_n];
        if ImGui_TabBarFindTabByID(tab_bar, window.TabId) == null {
            ImGui_TabBarAddTab(tab_bar, ImGuiTabItemFlags_Unsorted, window);
        }
    }
    if is_focused != 0 {
        node.LastFrameFocused = g.FrameCount;
    }
    ImU32 title_bar_col = ImGui_GetColorU32(host_window.Collapsed != 0 ? ImGuiCol_TitleBgCollapsed : is_focused != 0 ? ImGuiCol_TitleBgActive : ImGuiCol_TitleBg);
    ImDrawFlags rounding_flags = ImGui_CalcRoundingFlagsForRectInRect(title_bar_rect, ImGuiWindow_Rect(host_window), g.Style.DockingSeparatorSize);
    ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(host_window.DrawList, title_bar_rect.Min, title_bar_rect.Max, title_bar_col, host_window.WindowRounding, rounding_flags);
    if has_window_menu_button != 0 {
        if ImGui_CollapseButton(ImGuiWindow_GetID(host_window, "#COLLAPSE", null), window_menu_button_pos, node) != 0 {
            ImGui_OpenPopup("#WindowMenu");
        }
        if ImGui_IsItemActive() != 0 {
            focus_tab_id = tab_bar.SelectedTabId;
        }
        if ImGui_IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_ForTooltip | ImGuiHoveredFlags_DelayNormal) && g.HoveredIdTimer > 0.5f {
            ImGui_SetTooltip("%s", ImGui_LocalizeGetMsg(ImGuiLocKey_DockingDragToUndockOrMoveNode));
        }
    }
    i32 tabs_unsorted_start = tab_bar.Tabs.Size;
    for i32 tab_n = tab_bar.Tabs.Size - 1; tab_n >= 0 && tab_bar.Tabs.Data[tab_n].Flags & ImGuiTabItemFlags_Unsorted; tab_n-- {
        tab_bar.Tabs.Data[tab_n].Flags &= ~ImGuiTabItemFlags_Unsorted;
        tabs_unsorted_start = tab_n;
    }
    if tab_bar.Tabs.Size > tabs_unsorted_start {
        while true {
            if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventDocking) != 0 {
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
        for i32 tab_n = tabs_unsorted_start; tab_n < tab_bar.Tabs.Size; tab_n++ {
            ImGuiTabItem* tab = &tab_bar.Tabs.Data[tab_n];
            ignore tab;
            while true {
                if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventDocking) != 0 {
                }
                if !(0 != 0) { break; }
            }
        }
        while true {
            if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventDocking) != 0 {
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
        if tab_bar.Tabs.Size > tabs_unsorted_start + 1 {
            ImQsort(tab_bar.Tabs.Data + tabs_unsorted_start, cast(u64, tab_bar.Tabs.Size - tabs_unsorted_start), cast(u64, sizeof(ImGuiTabItem)), cast(fn(void*, void*): i32, TabItemComparerByDockOrder));
        }
    }
    if g.NavWindow && g.NavWindow.RootWindow.DockNode == node {
        tab_bar.SelectedTabId = g.NavWindow.RootWindow.TabId;
    }
    if tab_bar_is_recreated && ImGui_TabBarFindTabByID(tab_bar, node.SelectedTabId) != null {
        tab_bar.NextSelectedTabId = node.SelectedTabId;
        tab_bar.SelectedTabId = tab_bar.NextSelectedTabId;
    } else if tab_bar.Tabs.Size > tabs_count_old {
        tab_bar.NextSelectedTabId = ImVector_ImGuiTabItem_back(&tab_bar.Tabs).Window.TabId;
        tab_bar.SelectedTabId = tab_bar.NextSelectedTabId;
    }
    ImGuiTabBarFlags tab_bar_flags = ImGuiTabBarFlags_Reorderable | ImGuiTabBarFlags_AutoSelectNewTabs;
    tab_bar_flags |= ImGuiTabBarFlags_SaveSettings | ImGuiTabBarFlags_DockNode;
    tab_bar_flags |= ImGuiTabBarFlags_FittingPolicyMixed;
    tab_bar_flags |= ImGuiTabBarFlags_DrawSelectedOverline;
    if !host_window.Collapsed && is_focused {
        tab_bar_flags |= ImGuiTabBarFlags_IsFocused;
    }
    tab_bar.ID = node.ID;
    tab_bar.SeparatorMinX = node.Pos.x + host_window.WindowBorderSize;
    tab_bar.SeparatorMaxX = node.Pos.x + node.Size.x - host_window.WindowBorderSize;
    ImGui_BeginTabBarEx(tab_bar, tab_bar_rect, tab_bar_flags);
    ImVec4[9] backup_style_cols;
    for i32 color_n = 0; color_n < ImGuiWindowDockStyleCol_COUNT; color_n++ {
        backup_style_cols[color_n] = g.Style.Colors[GWindowDockStyleColors[color_n]];
    }
    node.VisibleWindow = null;
    for i32 window_n = 0; window_n < node.Windows.Size; window_n++ {
        ImGuiWindow* window = node.Windows.Data[window_n];
        if window.LastFrameActive + 1 < g.FrameCount && node_was_active {
            continue;
        }
        ImGuiTabItemFlags tab_item_flags = 0;
        tab_item_flags |= window.WindowClass.TabItemFlagsOverrideSet;
        if (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_UnsavedDocument) != 0 {
            tab_item_flags |= ImGuiTabItemFlags_UnsavedDocument;
        }
        if (tab_bar.Flags & ImGuiTabBarFlags_NoCloseWithMiddleMouseButton) != 0 {
            tab_item_flags |= ImGuiTabItemFlags_NoCloseWithMiddleMouseButton;
        }
        for i32 color_n = 0; color_n < ImGuiWindowDockStyleCol_COUNT; color_n++ {
            g.Style.Colors[GWindowDockStyleColors[color_n]] = ImGui_ColorConvertU32ToFloat4(window.DockStyle.Colors[color_n]);
        }
        bool tab_open = true;
        ImGui_TabItemEx(tab_bar, window.Name, window.HasCloseButton != 0 ? &tab_open : null, tab_item_flags, window);
        if tab_open == 0 {
            node.WantCloseTabId = window.TabId;
        }
        if tab_bar.VisibleTabId == window.TabId {
            node.VisibleWindow = window;
        }
        window.DC.DockTabItemStatusFlags = g.LastItemData.StatusFlags;
        window.DC.DockTabItemRect = g.LastItemData.Rect;
        if g.NavWindow && g.NavWindow.RootWindow == window && (window.DC.NavLayersActiveMask & 1 << ImGuiNavLayer_Menu) == 0 {
            host_window.NavLastIds[1] = window.TabId;
        }
    }
    for i32 color_n = 0; color_n < ImGuiWindowDockStyleCol_COUNT; color_n++ {
        g.Style.Colors[GWindowDockStyleColors[color_n]] = backup_style_cols[color_n];
    }
    if node.VisibleWindow != null {
        if is_focused || root_node.VisibleWindow == null {
            root_node.VisibleWindow = node.VisibleWindow;
        }
    }
    bool close_button_is_enabled = node.HasCloseButton && node.VisibleWindow && node.VisibleWindow.HasCloseButton;
    bool close_button_is_visible = node.HasCloseButton;
    if close_button_is_visible != 0 {
        if close_button_is_enabled == 0 {
            ImGui_PushItemFlag(ImGuiItemFlags_Disabled, true);
            ImGui_PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, op_mul_ImVec4_ImVec4(style.Colors[ImGuiCol_Text], ImVec4{1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 0.4f}));
        }
        if ImGui_CloseButton(ImGuiWindow_GetID(host_window, "#CLOSE", null), close_button_pos) != 0 {
            node.WantCloseAll = true;
            for i32 n = 0; n < tab_bar.Tabs.Size; n++ {
                ImGui_TabBarCloseTab(tab_bar, &tab_bar.Tabs.Data[n]);
            }
        }
        if close_button_is_enabled == 0 {
            ImGui_PopStyleColor();
            ImGui_PopItemFlag();
        }
    }
    ImGuiID title_bar_id = ImGuiWindow_GetID(host_window, "#TITLEBAR", null);
    if g.HoveredId == 0 || g.HoveredId == title_bar_id || g.ActiveId == title_bar_id {
        bool held;
        ImGui_KeepAliveID(title_bar_id);
        ImGui_ButtonBehavior(title_bar_rect, title_bar_id, null, &held, ImGuiButtonFlags_AllowOverlap);
        if g.HoveredId == title_bar_id {
            g.LastItemData.ID = title_bar_id;
        }
        if held != 0 {
            if ImGui_IsMouseClicked(0) != 0 {
                focus_tab_id = tab_bar.SelectedTabId;
            }
            {
                ImGuiTabItem* tab = ImGui_TabBarFindTabByID(tab_bar, tab_bar.SelectedTabId);
                if tab != null {
                    ImGui_StartMouseMovingWindowOrNode(tab.Window != null ? tab.Window : node.HostWindow, node, false);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if tab_bar.NextSelectedTabId != 0 {
        focus_tab_id = tab_bar.NextSelectedTabId;
    }
    if focus_tab_id != 0 {
        ImGuiTabItem* tab = ImGui_TabBarFindTabByID(tab_bar, focus_tab_id);
        if tab != null {
            if tab.Window != null {
                ImGui_FocusWindow(tab.Window);
                if g.NavId == 0 {
                    ImGui_NavInitWindow(tab.Window, false);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    ImGui_EndTabBar();
    ImGui_PopID();
    if ImGuiDockNode_IsDockSpace(node) == 0 {
        host_window.DC.NavLayerCurrent = ImGuiNavLayer_Main;
        host_window.SkipItems = backup_skip_item;
    }
}

bool DockNodeIsDropAllowedOne(ImGuiWindow* payload, ImGuiWindow* host_window) {
    if host_window.DockNodeAsHost && ImGuiDockNode_IsDockSpace(host_window.DockNodeAsHost) && payload.BeginOrderWithinContext < host_window.BeginOrderWithinContext {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiWindowClass* host_class = host_window.DockNodeAsHost != null ? &host_window.DockNodeAsHost.WindowClass : &host_window.WindowClass;
    ImGuiWindowClass* payload_class = &payload.WindowClass;
    if host_class.ClassId != payload_class.ClassId {
        bool pass = false;
        if host_class.ClassId != 0 && host_class.DockingAllowUnclassed && payload_class.ClassId == 0 {
            pass = true;
        }
        if payload_class.ClassId != 0 && payload_class.DockingAllowUnclassed && host_class.ClassId == 0 {
            pass = true;
        }
        if pass == 0 {
            return false;
        }
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    for i32 i = g.OpenPopupStack.Size - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
        ImGuiWindow* popup_window = g.OpenPopupStack.Data[i].Window;
        if popup_window != null {
            if ImGui_IsWindowWithinBeginStackOf(payload, popup_window) != 0 {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    return true;
}

bool ImGui_DockNodeIsDropAllowed(ImGuiWindow* host_window, ImGuiWindow* root_payload) {
    if root_payload.DockNodeAsHost && ImGuiDockNode_IsSplitNode(root_payload.DockNodeAsHost) {
        return true;
    }
    i32 payload_count = root_payload.DockNodeAsHost != null ? root_payload.DockNodeAsHost.Windows.Size : 1;
    for i32 payload_n = 0; payload_n < payload_count; payload_n++ {
        ImGuiWindow* payload = root_payload.DockNodeAsHost != null ? root_payload.DockNodeAsHost.Windows.Data[payload_n] : root_payload;
        if DockNodeIsDropAllowedOne(payload, host_window) != 0 {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

// window menu button == collapse button when not in a dock node.
// FIXME: This is similar to RenderWindowTitleBarContents(), may want to share code.
void ImGui_DockNodeCalcTabBarLayout(ImGuiDockNode* node, ImRect* out_title_rect, ImRect* out_tab_bar_rect, ImVec2* out_window_menu_button_pos, ImVec2* out_close_button_pos) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiStyle* style = &g.Style;
    var r = ImRect{
        ImVec2{node.Pos.x, node.Pos.y},
        ImVec2{node.Pos.x + node.Size.x, node.Pos.y + g.FontSize + g.Style.FramePadding.y * 2.0f},
    };
    if out_title_rect != null {
        *out_title_rect = r;
    }
    r.Min.x += style.WindowBorderSize;
    r.Max.x -= style.WindowBorderSize;
    f32 button_sz = g.FontSize;
    r.Min.x += style.FramePadding.x;
    r.Max.x -= style.FramePadding.x;
    var window_menu_button_pos = ImVec2{r.Min.x, r.Min.y + style.FramePadding.y};
    if node.HasCloseButton != 0 {
        if out_close_button_pos != null {
            *out_close_button_pos = ImVec2{r.Max.x - button_sz, r.Min.y + style.FramePadding.y};
        }
        r.Max.x -= button_sz + style.ItemInnerSpacing.x;
    }
    if node.HasWindowMenuButton && style.WindowMenuButtonPosition == ImGuiDir_Left {
        r.Min.x += button_sz + style.ItemInnerSpacing.x;
    } else if node.HasWindowMenuButton && style.WindowMenuButtonPosition == ImGuiDir_Right {
        window_menu_button_pos = ImVec2{r.Max.x - button_sz, r.Min.y + style.FramePadding.y};
        r.Max.x -= button_sz + style.ItemInnerSpacing.x;
    }
    if out_tab_bar_rect != null {
        *out_tab_bar_rect = r;
    }
    if out_window_menu_button_pos != null {
        *out_window_menu_button_pos = window_menu_button_pos;
    }
}

void ImGui_DockNodeCalcSplitRects(ImVec2* pos_old, ImVec2* size_old, ImVec2* pos_new, ImVec2* size_new, ImGuiDir dir, ImVec2 size_new_desired) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    f32 dock_spacing = g.Style.ItemInnerSpacing.x;
    ImGuiAxis axis = dir == ImGuiDir_Left || dir == ImGuiDir_Right ? ImGuiAxis_X : ImGuiAxis_Y;
    cast(f32*, &pos_new)[axis ^ 1] = cast(f32*, &pos_old)[axis ^ 1];
    cast(f32*, &size_new)[axis ^ 1] = cast(f32*, &size_old)[axis ^ 1];
    f32 w_avail = cast(f32*, &size_old)[axis] - dock_spacing;
    if cast(f32*, &size_new_desired)[axis] > 0.0f && cast(f32*, &size_new_desired)[axis] <= w_avail * 0.5f {
        cast(f32*, &size_new)[axis] = cast(f32*, &size_new_desired)[axis];
        cast(f32*, &size_old)[axis] = cast(f32, cast(i32, w_avail - cast(f32*, &size_new)[axis]));
    } else {
        cast(f32*, &size_new)[axis] = cast(f32, cast(i32, w_avail * 0.5f));
        cast(f32*, &size_old)[axis] = cast(f32, cast(i32, w_avail - cast(f32*, &size_new)[axis]));
    }
    if dir == ImGuiDir_Right || dir == ImGuiDir_Down {
        cast(f32*, &pos_new)[axis] = cast(f32*, &pos_old)[axis] + cast(f32*, &size_old)[axis] + dock_spacing;
    } else if dir == ImGuiDir_Left || dir == ImGuiDir_Up {
        cast(f32*, &pos_new)[axis] = cast(f32*, &pos_old)[axis];
        cast(f32*, &pos_old)[axis] = cast(f32*, &pos_new)[axis] + cast(f32*, &size_new)[axis] + dock_spacing;
    }
}

// Retrieve the drop rectangles for a given direction or for the center + perform hit testing.
bool ImGui_DockNodeCalcDropRectsAndTestMousePos(ImRect parent, ImGuiDir dir, ImRect* out_r, bool outer_docking, ImVec2* test_mouse_pos) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    f32 parent_smaller_axis = ImMin(ImRect_GetWidth(&parent), ImRect_GetHeight(&parent));
    f32 hs_for_central_nodes = ImMin(g.FontSize * 1.5f, ImMax(g.FontSize * 0.5f, parent_smaller_axis / 8.0f));
    f32 hs_w;
    f32 hs_h;
    ImVec2 off;
    if outer_docking != 0 {
        hs_w = ImTrunc(hs_for_central_nodes * 1.5f);
        hs_h = ImTrunc(hs_for_central_nodes * 0.8f);
        off = ImTrunc(ImVec2{
            ImRect_GetWidth(&parent) * 0.5f - hs_h, ImRect_GetHeight(&parent) * 0.5f - hs_h,
        });
    } else {
        hs_w = ImTrunc(hs_for_central_nodes);
        hs_h = ImTrunc(hs_for_central_nodes * 0.9f);
        off = ImTrunc(ImVec2{hs_w * 2.4f, hs_w * 2.4f});
    }
    ImVec2 c = ImTrunc(ImRect_GetCenter(&parent));
    if dir == ImGuiDir_None {
        *out_r = ImRect{ImVec2{c.x - hs_w, c.y - hs_w}, ImVec2{c.x + hs_w, c.y + hs_w}};
    } else if dir == ImGuiDir_Up {
        *out_r = ImRect{
            ImVec2{c.x - hs_w, c.y - off.y - hs_h},
            ImVec2{c.x + hs_w, c.y - off.y + hs_h},
        };
    } else if dir == ImGuiDir_Down {
        *out_r = ImRect{
            ImVec2{c.x - hs_w, c.y + off.y - hs_h},
            ImVec2{c.x + hs_w, c.y + off.y + hs_h},
        };
    } else if dir == ImGuiDir_Left {
        *out_r = ImRect{
            ImVec2{c.x - off.x - hs_h, c.y - hs_w},
            ImVec2{c.x - off.x + hs_h, c.y + hs_w},
        };
    } else if dir == ImGuiDir_Right {
        *out_r = ImRect{
            ImVec2{c.x + off.x - hs_h, c.y - hs_w},
            ImVec2{c.x + off.x + hs_h, c.y + hs_w},
        };
    }
    if test_mouse_pos == null {
        return false;
    }
    ImRect hit_r = *out_r;
    if outer_docking == 0 {
        ImRect_Expand(&hit_r, ImTrunc(hs_w * 0.3f));
        ImVec2 mouse_delta = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(*test_mouse_pos, c);
        f32 mouse_delta_len2 = ImLengthSqr(mouse_delta);
        f32 r_threshold_center = hs_w * 1.4f;
        f32 r_threshold_sides = hs_w * (1.4f + 1.2f);
        if mouse_delta_len2 < r_threshold_center * r_threshold_center {
            return dir == ImGuiDir_None;
        }
        if mouse_delta_len2 < r_threshold_sides * r_threshold_sides {
            return dir == ImGetDirQuadrantFromDelta(mouse_delta.x, mouse_delta.y);
        }
    }
    return ImRect_Contains(&hit_r, *test_mouse_pos);
}

// host_node may be NULL if the window doesn't have a DockNode already.

private {
void ImGui_DockNodePreviewDockSetup(ImGuiWindow* host_window, ImGuiDockNode* host_node, ImGuiWindow* payload_window, ImGuiDockNode* payload_node, ImGuiDockPreviewData* data, bool is_explicit_target, bool is_outer_docking) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if payload_node == null {
        payload_node = payload_window.DockNodeAsHost;
    }
    ImGuiDockNode* ref_node_for_rect = host_node && !host_node.IsVisible ? ImGui_DockNodeGetRootNode(host_node) : host_node;
    if ref_node_for_rect != null {
        assert(ref_node_for_rect.IsVisible == true);
    }
    ImGuiDockNodeFlags src_node_flags = payload_node != null ? payload_node.MergedFlags : payload_window.WindowClass.DockNodeFlagsOverrideSet;
    ImGuiDockNodeFlags dst_node_flags = host_node != null ? host_node.MergedFlags : host_window.WindowClass.DockNodeFlagsOverrideSet;
    data.IsCenterAvailable = true;
    if is_outer_docking != 0 {
        data.IsCenterAvailable = false;
    } else if g.IO.ConfigDockingNoDockingOver != 0 {
        data.IsCenterAvailable = false;
    } else if (dst_node_flags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_NoDockingOverMe) != 0 {
        data.IsCenterAvailable = false;
    } else if host_node && dst_node_flags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_NoDockingOverCentralNode && ImGuiDockNode_IsCentralNode(host_node) {
        data.IsCenterAvailable = false;
    } else if (!host_node || !ImGuiDockNode_IsEmpty(host_node)) && payload_node && ImGuiDockNode_IsSplitNode(payload_node) && payload_node.OnlyNodeWithWindows == null {
        data.IsCenterAvailable = false;
    } else if src_node_flags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_NoDockingOverOther && (!host_node || !ImGuiDockNode_IsEmpty(host_node)) {
        data.IsCenterAvailable = false;
    } else if src_node_flags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_NoDockingOverEmpty && host_node && ImGuiDockNode_IsEmpty(host_node) {
        data.IsCenterAvailable = false;
    }
    data.IsSidesAvailable = true;
    if dst_node_flags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_NoDockingSplit || g.IO.ConfigDockingNoSplit {
        data.IsSidesAvailable = false;
    } else if !is_outer_docking && host_node && host_node.ParentNode == null && ImGuiDockNode_IsCentralNode(host_node) {
        data.IsSidesAvailable = false;
    } else if (src_node_flags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_NoDockingSplitOther) != 0 {
        data.IsSidesAvailable = false;
    }
    data.FutureNode.HasCloseButton = (host_node != null ? host_node.HasCloseButton : host_window.HasCloseButton) || payload_window.HasCloseButton;
    data.FutureNode.HasWindowMenuButton = host_node != null ? true : (host_window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoCollapse) == 0;
    data.FutureNode.Pos = ref_node_for_rect != null ? ref_node_for_rect.Pos : host_window.Pos;
    data.FutureNode.Size = ref_node_for_rect != null ? ref_node_for_rect.Size : host_window.Size;
    assert(ImGuiDir_None == -1);
    data.SplitNode = host_node;
    data.SplitDir = ImGuiDir_None;
    data.IsSplitDirExplicit = false;
    if host_window.Collapsed == 0 {
        for i32 dir = ImGuiDir_None; dir < ImGuiDir_COUNT; dir++ {
            if dir == ImGuiDir_None && !data.IsCenterAvailable {
                continue;
            }
            if dir != ImGuiDir_None && !data.IsSidesAvailable {
                continue;
            }
            if ImGui_DockNodeCalcDropRectsAndTestMousePos(ImGuiDockNode_Rect(&data.FutureNode), cast(ImGuiDir, dir), &data.DropRectsDraw[dir + 1], is_outer_docking, &g.IO.MousePos) != 0 {
                data.SplitDir = cast(ImGuiDir, dir);
                data.IsSplitDirExplicit = true;
            }
        }
    }
    data.IsDropAllowed = data.SplitDir != ImGuiDir_None || data.IsCenterAvailable;
    if !is_explicit_target && !data.IsSplitDirExplicit && !g.IO.ConfigDockingWithShift {
        data.IsDropAllowed = false;
    }
    data.SplitRatio = 0.0f;
    if data.SplitDir != ImGuiDir_None {
        ImGuiDir split_dir = data.SplitDir;
        ImGuiAxis split_axis = split_dir == ImGuiDir_Left || split_dir == ImGuiDir_Right ? ImGuiAxis_X : ImGuiAxis_Y;
        ImVec2 pos_new;
        ImVec2 pos_old = data.FutureNode.Pos;
        ImVec2 size_new;
        ImVec2 size_old = data.FutureNode.Size;
        ImGui_DockNodeCalcSplitRects(&pos_old, &size_old, &pos_new, &size_new, split_dir, payload_window.Size);
        f32 split_ratio = ImSaturate(cast(f32*, &size_new)[split_axis] / cast(f32*, &data.FutureNode.Size)[split_axis]);
        data.FutureNode.Pos = pos_new;
        data.FutureNode.Size = size_new;
        data.SplitRatio = split_dir == ImGuiDir_Right || split_dir == ImGuiDir_Down ? 1.0f - split_ratio : split_ratio;
    }
}

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Docking: ImGuiDockNode Tree manipulation functions
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// - DockNodeTreeSplit()
// - DockNodeTreeMerge()
// - DockNodeTreeUpdatePosSize()
// - DockNodeTreeUpdateSplitterFindTouchingNode()
// - DockNodeTreeUpdateSplitter()
// - DockNodeTreeFindFallbackLeafNode()
// - DockNodeTreeFindNodeByPos()
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
void ImGui_DockNodeTreeSplit(ImGuiContext* ctx, ImGuiDockNode* parent_node, ImGuiAxis split_axis, i32 split_inheritor_child_idx, f32 split_ratio, ImGuiDockNode* new_node) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(split_axis != ImGuiAxis_None);
    ImGuiDockNode* child_0 = new_node && split_inheritor_child_idx != 0 ? new_node : ImGui_DockContextAddNode(ctx, 0);
    child_0.ParentNode = parent_node;
    ImGuiDockNode* child_1 = new_node && split_inheritor_child_idx != 1 ? new_node : ImGui_DockContextAddNode(ctx, 0);
    child_1.ParentNode = parent_node;
    ImGuiDockNode* child_inheritor = split_inheritor_child_idx == 0 ? child_0 : child_1;
    ImGui_DockNodeMoveChildNodes(child_inheritor, parent_node);
    parent_node.ChildNodes[0] = child_0;
    parent_node.ChildNodes[1] = child_1;
    parent_node.ChildNodes[split_inheritor_child_idx].VisibleWindow = parent_node.VisibleWindow;
    parent_node.SplitAxis = split_axis;
    parent_node.VisibleWindow = null;
    parent_node.AuthorityForSize = cast(ImU8, ImGuiDataAuthority_DockNode);
    parent_node.AuthorityForPos = parent_node.AuthorityForSize;
    f32 size_avail = cast(f32*, &parent_node.Size)[split_axis] - g.Style.DockingSeparatorSize;
    size_avail = ImMax(size_avail, cast(f32*, &g.Style.WindowMinSize)[split_axis] * 2.0f);
    assert(size_avail > 0.0f);
    child_1.SizeRef = parent_node.Size;
    child_0.SizeRef = child_1.SizeRef;
    cast(f32*, &child_0.SizeRef)[split_axis] = ImTrunc(size_avail * split_ratio);
    cast(f32*, &child_1.SizeRef)[split_axis] = ImTrunc(size_avail - cast(f32*, &child_0.SizeRef)[split_axis]);
    ImGui_DockNodeMoveWindows(parent_node.ChildNodes[split_inheritor_child_idx], parent_node);
    ImGui_DockSettingsRenameNodeReferences(parent_node.ID, parent_node.ChildNodes[split_inheritor_child_idx].ID);
    ImGui_DockNodeUpdateHasCentralNodeChild(ImGui_DockNodeGetRootNode(parent_node));
    ImGui_DockNodeTreeUpdatePosSize(parent_node, parent_node.Pos, parent_node.Size);
    child_0.SharedFlags = parent_node.SharedFlags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_SharedFlagsInheritMask_;
    child_1.SharedFlags = parent_node.SharedFlags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_SharedFlagsInheritMask_;
    child_inheritor.LocalFlags = parent_node.LocalFlags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_LocalFlagsTransferMask_;
    parent_node.LocalFlags &= ~ImGuiDockNodeFlags_LocalFlagsTransferMask_;
    ImGuiDockNode_UpdateMergedFlags(child_0);
    ImGuiDockNode_UpdateMergedFlags(child_1);
    ImGuiDockNode_UpdateMergedFlags(parent_node);
    if ImGuiDockNode_IsCentralNode(child_inheritor) != 0 {
        ImGui_DockNodeGetRootNode(parent_node).CentralNode = child_inheritor;
    }
}

void ImGui_DockNodeTreeMerge(ImGuiContext* ctx, ImGuiDockNode* parent_node, ImGuiDockNode* merge_lead_child) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiDockNode* child_0 = parent_node.ChildNodes[0];
    ImGuiDockNode* child_1 = parent_node.ChildNodes[1];
    assert(child_0 || child_1);
    assert(merge_lead_child == child_0 || merge_lead_child == child_1);
    if child_0 && child_0.Windows.Size > 0 || child_1 && child_1.Windows.Size > 0 {
        assert(parent_node.TabBar == null);
        assert(parent_node.Windows.Size == 0);
    }
    while true {
        if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventDocking) != 0 {
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    ImVec2 backup_last_explicit_size = parent_node.SizeRef;
    ImGui_DockNodeMoveChildNodes(parent_node, merge_lead_child);
    if child_0 != null {
        ImGui_DockNodeMoveWindows(parent_node, child_0);
        ImGui_DockSettingsRenameNodeReferences(child_0.ID, parent_node.ID);
    }
    if child_1 != null {
        ImGui_DockNodeMoveWindows(parent_node, child_1);
        ImGui_DockSettingsRenameNodeReferences(child_1.ID, parent_node.ID);
    }
    ImGui_DockNodeApplyPosSizeToWindows(parent_node);
    parent_node.AuthorityForViewport = cast(ImU8, ImGuiDataAuthority_Auto);
    parent_node.AuthorityForSize = parent_node.AuthorityForViewport;
    parent_node.AuthorityForPos = parent_node.AuthorityForSize;
    parent_node.VisibleWindow = merge_lead_child.VisibleWindow;
    parent_node.SizeRef = backup_last_explicit_size;
    parent_node.LocalFlags &= ~ImGuiDockNodeFlags_LocalFlagsTransferMask_;
    parent_node.LocalFlags |= (child_0 != null ? child_0.LocalFlags : 0) & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_LocalFlagsTransferMask_;
    parent_node.LocalFlags |= (child_1 != null ? child_1.LocalFlags : 0) & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_LocalFlagsTransferMask_;
    parent_node.LocalFlagsInWindows = (child_0 != null ? child_0.LocalFlagsInWindows : 0) | (child_1 != null ? child_1.LocalFlagsInWindows : 0);
    ImGuiDockNode_UpdateMergedFlags(parent_node);
    if child_0 != null {
        ImGui_DockContextDeleteNode(ctx, child_0);
    }
    if child_1 != null {
        ImGui_DockContextDeleteNode(ctx, child_1);
    }
}

// Update Pos/Size for a node hierarchy (don't affect child Windows yet)
// (Depth-first, Pre-Order)
void ImGui_DockNodeTreeUpdatePosSize(ImGuiDockNode* node, ImVec2 pos, ImVec2 size, ImGuiDockNode* only_write_to_single_node) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    bool write_to_node = only_write_to_single_node == null || only_write_to_single_node == node;
    if write_to_node != 0 {
        node.Pos = pos;
        node.Size = size;
    }
    if ImGuiDockNode_IsLeafNode(node) != 0 {
        return;
    }
    ImGuiDockNode* child_0 = node.ChildNodes[0];
    ImGuiDockNode* child_1 = node.ChildNodes[1];
    ImVec2 child_0_pos = pos;
    ImVec2 child_1_pos = pos;
    ImVec2 child_0_size = size;
    ImVec2 child_1_size = size;
    bool child_0_is_toward_single_node = only_write_to_single_node != null && ImGui_DockNodeIsInHierarchyOf(only_write_to_single_node, child_0);
    bool child_1_is_toward_single_node = only_write_to_single_node != null && ImGui_DockNodeIsInHierarchyOf(only_write_to_single_node, child_1);
    bool child_0_is_or_will_be_visible = child_0.IsVisible || child_0_is_toward_single_node;
    bool child_1_is_or_will_be_visible = child_1.IsVisible || child_1_is_toward_single_node;
    if child_0_is_or_will_be_visible && child_1_is_or_will_be_visible {
        f32 spacing = g.Style.DockingSeparatorSize;
        var axis = node.SplitAxis;
        f32 size_avail = ImMax(cast(f32*, &size)[axis] - spacing, 0.0f);
        f32 size_min_each = ImTrunc(ImMin(size_avail, cast(f32*, &g.Style.WindowMinSize)[axis] * 2.0f) * 0.5f);
        if child_0.WantLockSizeOnce && !child_1.WantLockSizeOnce {
            cast(f32*, &child_0.SizeRef)[axis] = ImMin(size_avail - 1.0f, cast(f32*, &child_0.Size)[axis]);
            cast(f32*, &child_0_size)[axis] = cast(f32*, &child_0.SizeRef)[axis];
            cast(f32*, &child_1.SizeRef)[axis] = size_avail - cast(f32*, &child_0_size)[axis];
            cast(f32*, &child_1_size)[axis] = cast(f32*, &child_1.SizeRef)[axis];
            assert(cast(f32*, &child_0.SizeRef)[axis] > 0.0f && cast(f32*, &child_1.SizeRef)[axis] > 0.0f);
        } else if child_1.WantLockSizeOnce && !child_0.WantLockSizeOnce {
            cast(f32*, &child_1.SizeRef)[axis] = ImMin(size_avail - 1.0f, cast(f32*, &child_1.Size)[axis]);
            cast(f32*, &child_1_size)[axis] = cast(f32*, &child_1.SizeRef)[axis];
            cast(f32*, &child_0.SizeRef)[axis] = size_avail - cast(f32*, &child_1_size)[axis];
            cast(f32*, &child_0_size)[axis] = cast(f32*, &child_0.SizeRef)[axis];
            assert(cast(f32*, &child_0.SizeRef)[axis] > 0.0f && cast(f32*, &child_1.SizeRef)[axis] > 0.0f);
        } else if child_0.WantLockSizeOnce && child_1.WantLockSizeOnce {
            f32 split_ratio = cast(f32*, &child_0_size)[axis] / (cast(f32*, &child_0_size)[axis] + cast(f32*, &child_1_size)[axis]);
            cast(f32*, &child_0.SizeRef)[axis] = ImTrunc(size_avail * split_ratio);
            cast(f32*, &child_0_size)[axis] = cast(f32*, &child_0.SizeRef)[axis];
            cast(f32*, &child_1.SizeRef)[axis] = size_avail - cast(f32*, &child_0_size)[axis];
            cast(f32*, &child_1_size)[axis] = cast(f32*, &child_1.SizeRef)[axis];
            assert(cast(f32*, &child_0.SizeRef)[axis] > 0.0f && cast(f32*, &child_1.SizeRef)[axis] > 0.0f);
        } else if cast(f32*, &child_0.SizeRef)[axis] != 0.0f && child_1.HasCentralNodeChild {
            cast(f32*, &child_0_size)[axis] = ImMin(size_avail - size_min_each, cast(f32*, &child_0.SizeRef)[axis]);
            cast(f32*, &child_1_size)[axis] = size_avail - cast(f32*, &child_0_size)[axis];
        } else if cast(f32*, &child_1.SizeRef)[axis] != 0.0f && child_0.HasCentralNodeChild {
            cast(f32*, &child_1_size)[axis] = ImMin(size_avail - size_min_each, cast(f32*, &child_1.SizeRef)[axis]);
            cast(f32*, &child_0_size)[axis] = size_avail - cast(f32*, &child_1_size)[axis];
        } else {
            f32 split_ratio = cast(f32*, &child_0.SizeRef)[axis] / (cast(f32*, &child_0.SizeRef)[axis] + cast(f32*, &child_1.SizeRef)[axis]);
            cast(f32*, &child_0_size)[axis] = ImMax(size_min_each, ImTrunc(size_avail * split_ratio + 0.5f));
            cast(f32*, &child_1_size)[axis] = size_avail - cast(f32*, &child_0_size)[axis];
        }
        cast(f32*, &child_1_pos)[axis] += spacing + cast(f32*, &child_0_size)[axis];
    }
    if only_write_to_single_node == null {
        child_1.WantLockSizeOnce = false;
        child_0.WantLockSizeOnce = child_1.WantLockSizeOnce;
    }
    bool child_0_recurse = only_write_to_single_node != null ? child_0_is_toward_single_node : child_0.IsVisible;
    bool child_1_recurse = only_write_to_single_node != null ? child_1_is_toward_single_node : child_1.IsVisible;
    if child_0_recurse != 0 {
        ImGui_DockNodeTreeUpdatePosSize(child_0, child_0_pos, child_0_size);
    }
    if child_1_recurse != 0 {
        ImGui_DockNodeTreeUpdatePosSize(child_1, child_1_pos, child_1_size);
    }
}

private {
void DockNodeTreeUpdateSplitterFindTouchingNode(ImGuiDockNode* node, ImGuiAxis axis, i32 side, ImVector_ImGuiDockNode_ptr* touching_nodes) {
    if ImGuiDockNode_IsLeafNode(node) != 0 {
        ImVector_ImGuiDockNode_ptr_push_back(touching_nodes, node);
        return;
    }
    if node.ChildNodes[0].IsVisible != 0 {
        if node.SplitAxis != axis || side == 0 || !node.ChildNodes[1].IsVisible {
            DockNodeTreeUpdateSplitterFindTouchingNode(node.ChildNodes[0], axis, side, touching_nodes);
        }
    }
    if node.ChildNodes[1].IsVisible != 0 {
        if node.SplitAxis != axis || side == 1 || !node.ChildNodes[0].IsVisible {
            DockNodeTreeUpdateSplitterFindTouchingNode(node.ChildNodes[1], axis, side, touching_nodes);
        }
    }
}
}

// (Depth-First, Pre-Order)
void ImGui_DockNodeTreeUpdateSplitter(ImGuiDockNode* node) {
    if ImGuiDockNode_IsLeafNode(node) != 0 {
        return;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiDockNode* child_0 = node.ChildNodes[0];
    ImGuiDockNode* child_1 = node.ChildNodes[1];
    if child_0.IsVisible && child_1.IsVisible {
        var axis = node.SplitAxis;
        assert(axis != ImGuiAxis_None);
        ImRect bb;
        bb.Min = child_0.Pos;
        bb.Max = child_1.Pos;
        cast(f32*, &bb.Min)[axis] += cast(f32*, &child_0.Size)[axis];
        cast(f32*, &bb.Max)[axis ^ 1] += cast(f32*, &child_1.Size)[axis ^ 1];
        ImGuiDockNodeFlags merged_flags = child_0.MergedFlags | child_1.MergedFlags;
        ImGuiDockNodeFlags no_resize_axis_flag = axis == ImGuiAxis_X ? ImGuiDockNodeFlags_NoResizeX : ImGuiDockNodeFlags_NoResizeY;
        if merged_flags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_NoResize || merged_flags & no_resize_axis_flag {
            ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
            ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(window.DrawList, bb.Min, bb.Max, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Separator), g.Style.FrameRounding, 0);
        } else {
            ImGui_PushID(cast(i32, node.ID));
            ImVector_ImGuiDockNode_ptr[2] touching_nodes;
            f32 min_size = cast(f32*, &g.Style.WindowMinSize)[axis];
            f32[2] resize_limits;
            resize_limits[0] = cast(f32*, &node.ChildNodes[0].Pos)[axis] + min_size;
            resize_limits[1] = cast(f32*, &node.ChildNodes[1].Pos)[axis] + cast(f32*, &node.ChildNodes[1].Size)[axis] - min_size;
            ImGuiID splitter_id = ImGui_GetID("##Splitter");
            if g.ActiveId == splitter_id {
                DockNodeTreeUpdateSplitterFindTouchingNode(child_0, axis, 1, &touching_nodes[0]);
                DockNodeTreeUpdateSplitterFindTouchingNode(child_1, axis, 0, &touching_nodes[1]);
                for i32 touching_node_n = 0; touching_node_n < touching_nodes[0].Size; touching_node_n++ {
                    resize_limits[0] = ImMax(resize_limits[0], cast(f32, cast(f32*, &ImGuiDockNode_Rect(touching_nodes[0].Data[touching_node_n]).Min)[axis]) + min_size);
                }
                for i32 touching_node_n = 0; touching_node_n < touching_nodes[1].Size; touching_node_n++ {
                    resize_limits[1] = ImMin(resize_limits[1], cast(f32, cast(f32*, &ImGuiDockNode_Rect(touching_nodes[1].Data[touching_node_n]).Max)[axis]) - min_size);
                }
            }
            f32 cur_size_0 = cast(f32*, &child_0.Size)[axis];
            f32 cur_size_1 = cast(f32*, &child_1.Size)[axis];
            f32 min_size_0 = resize_limits[0] - cast(f32*, &child_0.Pos)[axis];
            f32 min_size_1 = cast(f32*, &child_1.Pos)[axis] + cast(f32*, &child_1.Size)[axis] - resize_limits[1];
            ImU32 bg_col = ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_WindowBg);
            if ImGui_SplitterBehavior(bb, ImGui_GetID("##Splitter"), axis, &cur_size_0, &cur_size_1, min_size_0, min_size_1, g.WindowsBorderHoverPadding, WINDOWS_RESIZE_FROM_EDGES_FEEDBACK_TIMER, bg_col) != 0 {
                if touching_nodes[0].Size > 0 && touching_nodes[1].Size > 0 {
                    cast(f32*, &child_0.SizeRef)[axis] = cur_size_0;
                    cast(f32*, &child_0.Size)[axis] = cast(f32*, &child_0.SizeRef)[axis];
                    cast(f32*, &child_1.Pos)[axis] -= cur_size_1 - cast(f32*, &child_1.Size)[axis];
                    cast(f32*, &child_1.SizeRef)[axis] = cur_size_1;
                    cast(f32*, &child_1.Size)[axis] = cast(f32*, &child_1.SizeRef)[axis];
                    for i32 side_n = 0; side_n < 2; side_n++ {
                        for i32 touching_node_n = 0; touching_node_n < touching_nodes[side_n].Size; touching_node_n++ {
                            ImGuiDockNode* touching_node = touching_nodes[side_n].Data[touching_node_n];
                            while touching_node.ParentNode != node {
                                if touching_node.ParentNode.SplitAxis == axis {
                                    ImGuiDockNode* node_to_preserve = touching_node.ParentNode.ChildNodes[side_n];
                                    node_to_preserve.WantLockSizeOnce = true;
                                }
                                touching_node = touching_node.ParentNode;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    ImGui_DockNodeTreeUpdatePosSize(child_0, child_0.Pos, child_0.Size);
                    ImGui_DockNodeTreeUpdatePosSize(child_1, child_1.Pos, child_1.Size);
                    ImGui_MarkIniSettingsDirty();
                }
            }
            ImGui_PopID();
        }
    }
    if child_0.IsVisible != 0 {
        ImGui_DockNodeTreeUpdateSplitter(child_0);
    }
    if child_1.IsVisible != 0 {
        ImGui_DockNodeTreeUpdateSplitter(child_1);
    }
}

ImGuiDockNode* ImGui_DockNodeTreeFindFallbackLeafNode(ImGuiDockNode* node) {
    if ImGuiDockNode_IsLeafNode(node) != 0 {
        return node;
    }
    {
        ImGuiDockNode* leaf_node = ImGui_DockNodeTreeFindFallbackLeafNode(node.ChildNodes[0]);
        if leaf_node != null {
            return leaf_node;
        }
    }
    {
        ImGuiDockNode* leaf_node = ImGui_DockNodeTreeFindFallbackLeafNode(node.ChildNodes[1]);
        if leaf_node != null {
            return leaf_node;
        }
    }
    return null;
}

ImGuiDockNode* ImGui_DockNodeTreeFindVisibleNodeByPos(ImGuiDockNode* node, ImVec2 pos) {
    if node.IsVisible == 0 {
        return null;
    }
    f32 dock_spacing = 0.0f;
    ImRect r;
    ImRect_init(&r, node.Pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(node.Pos, node.Size));
    ImRect_Expand(&r, dock_spacing * 0.5f);
    bool inside = ImRect_Contains(&r, pos);
    if inside == 0 {
        return null;
    }
    if ImGuiDockNode_IsLeafNode(node) != 0 {
        return node;
    }
    {
        ImGuiDockNode* hovered_node = ImGui_DockNodeTreeFindVisibleNodeByPos(node.ChildNodes[0], pos);
        if hovered_node != null {
            return hovered_node;
        }
    }
    {
        ImGuiDockNode* hovered_node = ImGui_DockNodeTreeFindVisibleNodeByPos(node.ChildNodes[1], pos);
        if hovered_node != null {
            return hovered_node;
        }
    }
    return node;
}

// - DockSpaceOverViewport()

// [Internal] Called via SetNextWindowDockID()
void ImGui_SetWindowDock(ImGuiWindow* window, ImGuiID dock_id, ImGuiCond cond) {
    if cond && (window.SetWindowDockAllowFlags & cond) == 0 {
        return;
    }
    window.SetWindowDockAllowFlags &= ~(ImGuiCond_Once | ImGuiCond_FirstUseEver | ImGuiCond_Appearing);
    if window.DockId == dock_id {
        return;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    {
        ImGuiDockNode* new_node = ImGui_DockContextFindNodeByID(g, dock_id);
        if new_node != null {
            if ImGuiDockNode_IsSplitNode(new_node) != 0 {
                new_node = ImGui_DockNodeGetRootNode(new_node);
                if new_node.CentralNode != null {
                    assert(cast(i64, ImGuiDockNode_IsCentralNode(new_node.CentralNode)));
                    dock_id = new_node.CentralNode.ID;
                } else {
                    dock_id = new_node.LastFocusedNodeId;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if window.DockId == dock_id {
        return;
    }
    if window.DockNode != null {
        ImGui_DockNodeRemoveWindow(window.DockNode, window, 0);
    }
    window.DockId = dock_id;
}

// Create an explicit dockspace node within an existing window. Also expose dock node flags and creates a CentralNode by default.
// The Central Node is always displayed even when empty and shrink/extend according to the requested size of its neighbors.
// DockSpace() needs to be submitted _before_ any window they can host. If you use a dockspace, submit it early in your app.
// When ImGuiDockNodeFlags_KeepAliveOnly is set, nothing is submitted in the current window (function may be called from any location).
ImGuiID ImGui_DockSpace(ImGuiID dockspace_id, ImVec2 size_arg, ImGuiDockNodeFlags flags, ImGuiWindowClass* window_class) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindowRead();
    if (g.IO.ConfigFlags & ImGuiConfigFlags_DockingEnable) == 0 {
        return 0;
    }
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        flags |= ImGuiDockNodeFlags_KeepAliveOnly;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_KeepAliveOnly) == 0 {
        window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    }
    assert((flags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_DockSpace) == 0);
    assert((flags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_CentralNode) == 0);
    assert(dockspace_id != 0);
    ImGuiDockNode* node = ImGui_DockContextFindNodeByID(g, dockspace_id);
    if node == null {
        while true {
            if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventDocking) != 0 {
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
        node = ImGui_DockContextAddNode(g, dockspace_id);
        ImGuiDockNode_SetLocalFlags(node, ImGuiDockNodeFlags_CentralNode);
    }
    if window_class && window_class.ClassId != node.WindowClass.ClassId {
        while true {
            if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventDocking) != 0 {
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
    }
    node.SharedFlags = flags;
    node.WindowClass = window_class != null ? *window_class : __cxx_make_ImGuiWindowClass();
    if node.LastFrameActive == g.FrameCount && !(flags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_KeepAliveOnly) {
        assert(ImGuiDockNode_IsDockSpace(node) == false && "Cannot call DockSpace() twice a frame with the same ID");
        ImGuiDockNode_SetLocalFlags(node, node.LocalFlags | ImGuiDockNodeFlags_DockSpace);
        return dockspace_id;
    }
    ImGuiDockNode_SetLocalFlags(node, node.LocalFlags | ImGuiDockNodeFlags_DockSpace);
    if (flags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_KeepAliveOnly) != 0 {
        node.LastFrameAlive = g.FrameCount;
        return dockspace_id;
    }
    ImVec2 content_avail = ImGui_GetContentRegionAvail();
    ImVec2 size = ImTrunc(size_arg);
    if size.x <= 0.0f {
        size.x = ImMax(content_avail.x + size.x, 4.0f);
    }
    if size.y <= 0.0f {
        size.y = ImMax(content_avail.y + size.y, 4.0f);
    }
    assert(size.x > 0.0f && size.y > 0.0f);
    node.Pos = window.DC.CursorPos;
    node.SizeRef = size;
    node.Size = node.SizeRef;
    ImGui_SetNextWindowPos(node.Pos);
    ImGui_SetNextWindowSize(node.Size);
    g.NextWindowData.PosUndock = false;
    ImGuiWindowFlags window_flags = ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow | ImGuiWindowFlags_DockNodeHost;
    window_flags |= ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoCollapse | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar;
    window_flags |= ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollbar | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoScrollWithMouse;
    window_flags |= ImGuiWindowFlags_NoBackground;
    u8[256] title;
    ImFormatString(title, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(title) / sizeof(*title))), "%s/DockSpace_%08X", window.Name, dockspace_id);
    ImGui_PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_ChildBorderSize, 0.0f);
    ImGui_Begin(title, null, window_flags);
    ImGui_PopStyleVar();
    ImGuiWindow* host_window = g.CurrentWindow;
    DockNodeSetupHostWindow(node, host_window);
    host_window.ChildId = ImGuiWindow_GetID(window, title, null);
    node.OnlyNodeWithWindows = null;
    assert(cast(i64, ImGuiDockNode_IsRootNode(node)));
    if ImGuiDockNode_IsLeafNode(node) && !ImGuiDockNode_IsCentralNode(node) {
        ImGuiDockNode_SetLocalFlags(node, node.LocalFlags | ImGuiDockNodeFlags_CentralNode);
    }
    ImGui_DockNodeUpdate(node);
    ImGui_End();
    ImRect bb;
    ImRect_init(&bb, node.Pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(node.Pos, size));
    ImGui_ItemSize(size);
    ImGui_ItemAdd(bb, dockspace_id, null, ImGuiItemFlags_NoNav);
    if g.LastItemData.StatusFlags & ImGuiItemStatusFlags_HoveredRect && ImGui_IsWindowChildOf(g.HoveredWindow, host_window, false, true) {
        g.LastItemData.StatusFlags |= ImGuiItemStatusFlags_HoveredWindow;
    }
    return dockspace_id;
}

// Tips: Use with ImGuiDockNodeFlags_PassthruCentralNode!
// The limitation with this call is that your window won't have a local menu bar, but you can also use BeginMainMenuBar().
// Even though we could pass window flags, it would also require the user to be able to call BeginMenuBar() somehow meaning we can't Begin/End in a single function.
// If you really want a menu bar inside the same window as the one hosting the dockspace, you will need to copy this code somewhere and tweak it.
ImGuiID ImGui_DockSpaceOverViewport(ImGuiID dockspace_id, ImGuiViewport* viewport, ImGuiDockNodeFlags dockspace_flags, ImGuiWindowClass* window_class) {
    if viewport == null {
        viewport = ImGui_GetMainViewport();
    }
    ImGui_SetNextWindowPos(viewport.WorkPos);
    ImGui_SetNextWindowSize(viewport.WorkSize);
    ImGui_SetNextWindowViewport(viewport.ID);
    ImGuiWindowFlags host_window_flags = 0;
    host_window_flags |= ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoCollapse | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDocking;
    host_window_flags |= ImGuiWindowFlags_NoBringToFrontOnFocus | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoNavFocus;
    if (dockspace_flags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_PassthruCentralNode) != 0 {
        host_window_flags |= ImGuiWindowFlags_NoBackground;
    }
    if (dockspace_flags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_KeepAliveOnly) != 0 {
        host_window_flags |= ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMouseInputs;
    }
    u8[32] label;
    ImFormatString(label, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(label) / sizeof(*label))), "WindowOverViewport_%08X", viewport.ID);
    ImGui_PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowRounding, 0.0f);
    ImGui_PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowBorderSize, 0.0f);
    ImGui_PushStyleVar(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f});
    ImGui_Begin(label, null, host_window_flags);
    ImGui_PopStyleVar(3);
    if dockspace_id == 0 {
        dockspace_id = ImGui_GetID("DockSpace");
    }
    ImGui_DockSpace(dockspace_id, ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f}, dockspace_flags, window_class);
    ImGui_End();
    return dockspace_id;
}

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Docking: Builder Functions
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Very early end-user API to manipulate dock nodes.
// Only available in imgui_internal.h. Expect this API to change/break!
// It is expected that those functions are all called _before_ the dockspace node submission.
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// - DockBuilderDockWindow()
// - DockBuilderGetNode()
// - DockBuilderSetNodePos()
// - DockBuilderSetNodeSize()
// - DockBuilderAddNode()
// - DockBuilderRemoveNode()
// - DockBuilderRemoveNodeChildNodes()
// - DockBuilderRemoveNodeDockedWindows()
// - DockBuilderSplitNode()
// - DockBuilderCopyNodeRec()
// - DockBuilderCopyNode()
// - DockBuilderCopyWindowSettings()
// - DockBuilderCopyDockSpace()
// - DockBuilderFinish()
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
void ImGui_DockBuilderDockWindow(u8* window_name, ImGuiID node_id) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ignore *g;
    while true {
        if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventDocking) != 0 {
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    ImGuiID window_id = ImHashStr(window_name);
    {
        ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_FindWindowByID(window_id);
        if window != null {
            ImGuiID prev_node_id = window.DockId;
            ImGui_SetWindowDock(window, node_id, ImGuiCond_Always);
            if window.DockId != prev_node_id {
                window.DockOrder = -1;
            }
        } else {
            ImGuiWindowSettings* settings = ImGui_FindWindowSettingsByID(window_id);
            if settings == null {
                settings = ImGui_CreateNewWindowSettings(window_name);
            }
            if settings.DockId != node_id {
                settings.DockOrder = -1;
            }
            settings.DockId = node_id;
        }
    }
}

ImGuiDockNode* ImGui_DockBuilderGetNode(ImGuiID node_id) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    return ImGui_DockContextFindNodeByID(g, node_id);
}

void ImGui_DockBuilderSetNodePos(ImGuiID node_id, ImVec2 pos) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiDockNode* node = ImGui_DockContextFindNodeByID(g, node_id);
    if node == null {
        return;
    }
    node.Pos = pos;
    node.AuthorityForPos = cast(ImU8, ImGuiDataAuthority_DockNode);
}

void ImGui_DockBuilderSetNodeSize(ImGuiID node_id, ImVec2 size) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiDockNode* node = ImGui_DockContextFindNodeByID(g, node_id);
    if node == null {
        return;
    }
    assert(size.x > 0.0f && size.y > 0.0f);
    node.SizeRef = size;
    node.Size = node.SizeRef;
    node.AuthorityForSize = cast(ImU8, ImGuiDataAuthority_DockNode);
}

// Make sure to use the ImGuiDockNodeFlags_DockSpace flag to create a dockspace node! Otherwise this will create a floating node!
// - Floating node: you can then call DockBuilderSetNodePos()/DockBuilderSetNodeSize() to position and size the floating node.
// - Dockspace node: calling DockBuilderSetNodePos() is unnecessary.
// - If you intend to split a node immediately after creation using DockBuilderSplitNode(), make sure to call DockBuilderSetNodeSize() beforehand!
//   For various reason, the splitting code currently needs a base size otherwise space may not be allocated as precisely as you would expect.
// - Use (id == 0) to let the system allocate a node identifier.
// - Existing node with a same id will be removed.
ImGuiID ImGui_DockBuilderAddNode(ImGuiID node_id, ImGuiDockNodeFlags flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ignore *g;
    while true {
        if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventDocking) != 0 {
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    if node_id != 0 {
        ImGui_DockBuilderRemoveNode(node_id);
    }
    ImGuiDockNode* node = null;
    if (flags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_DockSpace) != 0 {
        ImGui_DockSpace(node_id, ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f}, flags & ~ImGuiDockNodeFlags_DockSpace | ImGuiDockNodeFlags_KeepAliveOnly);
        node = ImGui_DockContextFindNodeByID(g, node_id);
    } else {
        node = ImGui_DockContextAddNode(g, node_id);
        ImGuiDockNode_SetLocalFlags(node, flags);
    }
    node.LastFrameAlive = g.FrameCount;
    return node.ID;
}

void ImGui_DockBuilderRemoveNode(ImGuiID node_id) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ignore *g;
    while true {
        if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventDocking) != 0 {
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    ImGuiDockNode* node = ImGui_DockContextFindNodeByID(g, node_id);
    if node == null {
        return;
    }
    ImGui_DockBuilderRemoveNodeDockedWindows(node_id, true);
    ImGui_DockBuilderRemoveNodeChildNodes(node_id);
    node = ImGui_DockContextFindNodeByID(g, node_id);
    if node == null {
        return;
    }
    if ImGuiDockNode_IsCentralNode(node) && node.ParentNode {
        ImGuiDockNode_SetLocalFlags(node.ParentNode, node.ParentNode.LocalFlags | ImGuiDockNodeFlags_CentralNode);
    }
    ImGui_DockContextRemoveNode(g, node, true);
}

// root_id = 0 to remove all, root_id != 0 to remove child of given node.
void ImGui_DockBuilderRemoveNodeChildNodes(ImGuiID root_id) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiDockContext* dc = &g.DockContext;
    ImGuiDockNode* root_node = root_id != 0 ? ImGui_DockContextFindNodeByID(g, root_id) : null;
    if root_id && root_node == null {
        return;
    }
    bool has_central_node = false;
    var backup_root_node_authority_for_pos = cast(ImGuiDataAuthority, root_node != null ? cast(ImGuiDataAuthority_, root_node.AuthorityForPos) : ImGuiDataAuthority_Auto);
    var backup_root_node_authority_for_size = cast(ImGuiDataAuthority, root_node != null ? cast(ImGuiDataAuthority_, root_node.AuthorityForSize) : ImGuiDataAuthority_Auto);
    ImVector_ImGuiDockNode_ptr nodes_to_remove;
    for i32 n = 0; n < dc.Nodes.Data.Size; n++ {
        var node = cast(ImGuiDockNode*, dc.Nodes.Data.Data[n].val_p);
        if node != null {
            bool want_removal = root_id == 0 || node.ID != root_id && ImGui_DockNodeGetRootNode(node).ID == root_id;
            if want_removal != 0 {
                if ImGuiDockNode_IsCentralNode(node) != 0 {
                    has_central_node = true;
                }
                if root_id != 0 {
                    ImGui_DockContextQueueNotifyRemovedNode(g, node);
                }
                if root_node != null {
                    ImGui_DockNodeMoveWindows(root_node, node);
                    ImGui_DockSettingsRenameNodeReferences(node.ID, root_node.ID);
                }
                ImVector_ImGuiDockNode_ptr_push_back(&nodes_to_remove, node);
            }
        }
    }
    if root_node != null {
        root_node.AuthorityForPos = cast(ImU8, backup_root_node_authority_for_pos);
        root_node.AuthorityForSize = cast(ImU8, backup_root_node_authority_for_size);
    }
    for ImGuiWindowSettings* settings = ImChunkStream_ImGuiWindowSettings_begin(&g.SettingsWindows); settings != null; settings = ImChunkStream_ImGuiWindowSettings_next_chunk(&g.SettingsWindows, settings) {
        ImGuiID window_settings_dock_id = settings.DockId;
        if window_settings_dock_id != 0 {
            for i32 n = 0; n < nodes_to_remove.Size; n++ {
                if nodes_to_remove.Data[n].ID == window_settings_dock_id {
                    settings.DockId = root_id;
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    if nodes_to_remove.Size > 1 {
        ImQsort(nodes_to_remove.Data, cast(u64, nodes_to_remove.Size), cast(u64, sizeof(ImGuiDockNode*)), cast(fn(void*, void*): i32, DockNodeComparerDepthMostFirst));
    }
    for i32 n = 0; n < nodes_to_remove.Size; n++ {
        ImGui_DockContextRemoveNode(g, nodes_to_remove.Data[n], false);
    }
    if root_id == 0 {
        ImGuiStorage_Clear(&dc.Nodes);
        ImVector_ImGuiDockRequest_clear(&dc.Requests);
    } else if has_central_node != 0 {
        root_node.CentralNode = root_node;
        ImGuiDockNode_SetLocalFlags(root_node, root_node.LocalFlags | ImGuiDockNodeFlags_CentralNode);
    }
}

void ImGui_DockBuilderRemoveNodeDockedWindows(ImGuiID root_id, bool clear_settings_refs) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if clear_settings_refs != 0 {
        for ImGuiWindowSettings* settings = ImChunkStream_ImGuiWindowSettings_begin(&g.SettingsWindows); settings != null; settings = ImChunkStream_ImGuiWindowSettings_next_chunk(&g.SettingsWindows, settings) {
            bool want_removal = root_id == 0 || settings.DockId == root_id;
            if !want_removal && settings.DockId != 0 {
                ImGuiDockNode* node = ImGui_DockContextFindNodeByID(g, settings.DockId);
                if node != null {
                    if ImGui_DockNodeGetRootNode(node).ID == root_id {
                        want_removal = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            if want_removal != 0 {
                settings.DockId = 0;
            }
        }
    }
    for i32 n = 0; n < g.Windows.Size; n++ {
        ImGuiWindow* window = g.Windows.Data[n];
        bool want_removal = root_id == 0 || window.DockNode && ImGui_DockNodeGetRootNode(window.DockNode).ID == root_id || window.DockNodeAsHost && window.DockNodeAsHost.ID == root_id;
        if want_removal != 0 {
            ImGuiID backup_dock_id = window.DockId;
            ignore backup_dock_id;
            ImGui_DockContextProcessUndockWindow(g, window, clear_settings_refs);
            if clear_settings_refs == 0 {
                assert(window.DockId == backup_dock_id);
            }
        }
    }
}

// If 'out_id_at_dir' or 'out_id_at_opposite_dir' are non NULL, the function will write out the ID of the two new nodes created.
// Return value is ID of the node at the specified direction, so same as (*out_id_at_dir) if that pointer is set.
// FIXME-DOCK: We are not exposing nor using split_outer.
ImGuiID ImGui_DockBuilderSplitNode(ImGuiID id, ImGuiDir split_dir, f32 size_ratio_for_node_at_dir, ImGuiID* out_id_at_dir, ImGuiID* out_id_at_opposite_dir) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(split_dir != ImGuiDir_None);
    while true {
        if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventDocking) != 0 {
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    ImGuiDockNode* node = ImGui_DockContextFindNodeByID(g, id);
    if node == null {
        assert(node != null);
        return 0;
    }
    ImGuiDockRequest req;
    req.Type = ImGuiDockRequestType_Split;
    req.DockTargetWindow = null;
    req.DockTargetNode = node;
    req.DockPayload = null;
    req.DockSplitDir = split_dir;
    req.DockSplitRatio = ImSaturate(split_dir == ImGuiDir_Left || split_dir == ImGuiDir_Up ? size_ratio_for_node_at_dir : 1.0f - size_ratio_for_node_at_dir);
    req.DockSplitOuter = false;
    ImGui_DockContextProcessDock(g, &req);
    ImGuiID id_at_dir = node.ChildNodes[split_dir == ImGuiDir_Left || split_dir == ImGuiDir_Up ? 0 : 1].ID;
    ImGuiID id_at_opposite_dir = node.ChildNodes[split_dir == ImGuiDir_Left || split_dir == ImGuiDir_Up ? 1 : 0].ID;
    if out_id_at_dir != null {
        *out_id_at_dir = id_at_dir;
    }
    if out_id_at_opposite_dir != null {
        *out_id_at_opposite_dir = id_at_opposite_dir;
    }
    return id_at_dir;
}

private {
ImGuiDockNode* DockBuilderCopyNodeRec(ImGuiDockNode* src_node, ImGuiID dst_node_id_if_known, ImVector_ImGuiID* out_node_remap_pairs) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiDockNode* dst_node = ImGui_DockContextAddNode(g, dst_node_id_if_known);
    dst_node.SharedFlags = src_node.SharedFlags;
    dst_node.LocalFlags = src_node.LocalFlags;
    dst_node.LocalFlagsInWindows = ImGuiDockNodeFlags_None;
    dst_node.Pos = src_node.Pos;
    dst_node.Size = src_node.Size;
    dst_node.SizeRef = src_node.SizeRef;
    dst_node.SplitAxis = src_node.SplitAxis;
    ImGuiDockNode_UpdateMergedFlags(dst_node);
    ImVector_ImGuiID_push_back(out_node_remap_pairs, src_node.ID);
    ImVector_ImGuiID_push_back(out_node_remap_pairs, dst_node.ID);
    for i32 child_n = 0; child_n < cast(i32, sizeof(src_node.ChildNodes) / sizeof(*src_node.ChildNodes)); child_n++ {
        if src_node.ChildNodes[child_n] != null {
            dst_node.ChildNodes[child_n] = DockBuilderCopyNodeRec(src_node.ChildNodes[child_n], 0, out_node_remap_pairs);
            dst_node.ChildNodes[child_n].ParentNode = dst_node;
        }
    }
    while true {
        if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventDocking) != 0 {
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    return dst_node;
}
}
