bool ImGui_GetWindowAlwaysWantOwnTabBar(ImGuiWindow* window) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if g.IO.ConfigDockingAlwaysTabBar || window.WindowClass.DockingAlwaysTabBar {
        if (window.Flags & (ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDocking)) == 0 {
            if window.IsFallbackWindow == 0 {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

private {
ImGuiDockNode* ImGui_DockContextBindNodeToWindow(ImGuiContext* ctx, ImGuiWindow* window) {
    ImGuiContext* g = ctx;
    ImGuiDockNode* node = ImGui_DockContextFindNodeByID(ctx, window.DockId);
    assert(window.DockNode == null);
    if node && ImGuiDockNode_IsSplitNode(node) {
        ImGui_DockContextProcessUndockWindow(ctx, window);
        return null;
    }
    if node == null {
        node = ImGui_DockContextAddNode(ctx, window.DockId);
        node.AuthorityForViewport = cast(ImU8, ImGuiDataAuthority_Window);
        node.AuthorityForSize = node.AuthorityForViewport;
        node.AuthorityForPos = node.AuthorityForSize;
        node.LastFrameAlive = g.FrameCount;
    }
    if node.IsVisible == 0 {
        ImGuiDockNode* ancestor_node = node;
        while !ancestor_node.IsVisible && ancestor_node.ParentNode {
            ancestor_node = ancestor_node.ParentNode;
        }
        assert(ancestor_node.Size.x > 0.0f && ancestor_node.Size.y > 0.0f);
        ImGui_DockNodeUpdateHasCentralNodeChild(ImGui_DockNodeGetRootNode(ancestor_node));
        ImGui_DockNodeTreeUpdatePosSize(ancestor_node, ancestor_node.Pos, ancestor_node.Size, node);
    }
    bool node_was_visible = node.IsVisible;
    ImGui_DockNodeAddWindow(node, window, true);
    node.IsVisible = node_was_visible;
    assert(node == window.DockNode);
    return node;
}

void StoreDockStyleForWindow(ImGuiWindow* window) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    for i32 color_n = 0; color_n < ImGuiWindowDockStyleCol_COUNT; color_n++ {
        window.DockStyle.Colors[color_n] = ImGui_ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(g.Style.Colors[GWindowDockStyleColors[color_n]]);
    }
}
}

void ImGui_BeginDocked(ImGuiWindow* window, bool* p_open) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if window.IsFallbackWindow && !window.WasActive {
        DockNodeHideWindowDuringHostWindowCreation(window);
        return;
    }
    bool auto_dock_node = ImGui_GetWindowAlwaysWantOwnTabBar(window);
    if auto_dock_node != 0 {
        if window.DockId == 0 {
            assert(window.DockNode == null);
            window.DockId = ImGui_DockContextGenNodeID(g);
        }
    } else {
        bool want_undock = false;
        want_undock |= (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDocking) != 0;
        want_undock |= g.NextWindowData.HasFlags & ImGuiNextWindowDataFlags_HasPos && window.SetWindowPosAllowFlags & g.NextWindowData.PosCond && g.NextWindowData.PosUndock;
        if want_undock != 0 {
            ImGui_DockContextProcessUndockWindow(g, window);
            return;
        }
    }
    ImGuiDockNode* node = window.DockNode;
    if node != null {
        assert(window.DockId == node.ID);
    }
    if window.DockId != 0 && node == null {
        node = ImGui_DockContextBindNodeToWindow(g, window);
        if node == null {
            return;
        }
    }
    if node.LastFrameAlive < g.FrameCount {
        ImGuiDockNode* root_node = ImGui_DockNodeGetRootNode(node);
        if root_node.LastFrameAlive < g.FrameCount {
            ImGui_DockContextProcessUndockWindow(g, window);
        } else {
            window.DockIsActive = true;
        }
        return;
    }
    StoreDockStyleForWindow(window);
    if node.HostWindow == null {
        if node.State == ImGuiDockNodeState_HostWindowHiddenBecauseWindowsAreResizing {
            window.DockIsActive = true;
        }
        if node.Windows.Size > 1 && window.Appearing {
            DockNodeHideWindowDuringHostWindowCreation(window);
        }
        return;
    }
    assert(cast(i64, node.HostWindow));
    assert(cast(i64, ImGuiDockNode_IsLeafNode(node)));
    assert(node.Size.x >= 0.0f && node.Size.y >= 0.0f);
    node.State = ImGuiDockNodeState_HostWindowVisible;
    if !(node.MergedFlags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_KeepAliveOnly) && window.BeginOrderWithinContext < node.HostWindow.BeginOrderWithinContext {
        ImGui_DockContextProcessUndockWindow(g, window);
        return;
    }
    ImGui_SetNextWindowPos(node.Pos);
    ImGui_SetNextWindowSize(node.Size);
    g.NextWindowData.PosUndock = false;
    window.DockIsActive = true;
    window.DockNodeIsVisible = true;
    window.DockTabIsVisible = false;
    if (node.MergedFlags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_KeepAliveOnly) != 0 {
        return;
    }
    if node.VisibleWindow == window {
        window.DockTabIsVisible = true;
    }
    assert((window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow) == 0);
    window.Flags |= ImGuiWindowFlags_ChildWindow | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoResize;
    window.ChildFlags |= ImGuiChildFlags_AlwaysUseWindowPadding;
    if ImGuiDockNode_IsHiddenTabBar(node) || ImGuiDockNode_IsNoTabBar(node) {
        window.Flags |= ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar;
    } else {
        window.Flags &= ~ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar;
    }
    if node.TabBar && window.WasActive {
        window.DockOrder = cast(i16, ImGui_DockNodeGetTabOrder(window));
    }
    if (node.WantCloseAll || node.WantCloseTabId == window.TabId) && p_open != null {
        *p_open = false;
    }
    ImGuiWindow* parent_window = window.DockNode.HostWindow;
    window.ChildId = ImGuiWindow_GetID(parent_window, window.Name, null);
}

void ImGui_BeginDockableDragDropSource(ImGuiWindow* window) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(g.ActiveId == window.MoveId);
    assert(g.MovingWindow == window);
    assert(g.CurrentWindow == window);
    if g.IO.ConfigDockingWithShift != g.IO.KeyShift {
        assert(g.NextWindowData.HasFlags == 0);
        if g.IO.ConfigDockingWithShift && g.MouseStationaryTimer >= 1.0f && cast(f32, g.ActiveId) >= 1.0f {
            ImGui_SetTooltip("%s", ImGui_LocalizeGetMsg(ImGuiLocKey_DockingHoldShiftToDock));
        }
        return;
    }
    g.LastItemData.ID = window.MoveId;
    window = window.RootWindowDockTree;
    assert((window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDocking) == 0);
    bool is_drag_docking = g.IO.ConfigDockingWithShift || ImRect_Contains(&ImRect{
        ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f},
        ImVec2{window.SizeFull.x, ImGui_GetFrameHeight()},
    }, g.ActiveIdClickOffset);
    ImGuiDragDropFlags drag_drop_flags = ImGuiDragDropFlags_SourceNoPreviewTooltip | ImGuiDragDropFlags_SourceNoHoldToOpenOthers | ImGuiDragDropFlags_PayloadAutoExpire | ImGuiDragDropFlags_PayloadNoCrossContext | ImGuiDragDropFlags_PayloadNoCrossProcess;
    if is_drag_docking && ImGui_BeginDragDropSource(drag_drop_flags) {
        ImGui_SetDragDropPayload("_IMWINDOW", &window, cast(u64, sizeof(window)));
        ImGui_EndDragDropSource();
        StoreDockStyleForWindow(window);
    }
}

void ImGui_BeginDockableDragDropTarget(ImGuiWindow* window) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert((window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoDocking) == 0);
    if g.DragDropActive == 0 {
        return;
    }
    if ImGui_BeginDragDropTargetCustom(ImGuiWindow_Rect(window), window.ID) == 0 {
        return;
    }
    ImGuiPayload* payload = &g.DragDropPayload;
    if !ImGuiPayload_IsDataType(payload, "_IMWINDOW") || !ImGui_DockNodeIsDropAllowed(window, *cast(ImGuiWindow**, payload.Data)) {
        ImGui_EndDragDropTarget();
        return;
    }
    ImGuiWindow* payload_window = *cast(ImGuiWindow**, payload.Data);
    if ImGui_AcceptDragDropPayload("_IMWINDOW", ImGuiDragDropFlags_AcceptBeforeDelivery | ImGuiDragDropFlags_AcceptNoDrawDefaultRect) != null {
        bool dock_into_floating_window = false;
        ImGuiDockNode* node = null;
        if window.DockNodeAsHost != null {
            node = ImGui_DockNodeTreeFindVisibleNodeByPos(window.DockNodeAsHost, g.IO.MousePos);
            if node && ImGuiDockNode_IsDockSpace(node) && ImGuiDockNode_IsRootNode(node) {
                node = node.CentralNode && ImGuiDockNode_IsLeafNode(node) ? node.CentralNode : ImGui_DockNodeTreeFindFallbackLeafNode(node);
            }
        } else {
            if window.DockNode != null {
                node = window.DockNode;
            } else {
                dock_into_floating_window = true;
            }
        }
        ImRect explicit_target_rect = node && node.TabBar && !ImGuiDockNode_IsHiddenTabBar(node) && !ImGuiDockNode_IsNoTabBar(node) ? node.TabBar.BarRect : ImRect{
            window.Pos,
            op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.Pos, ImVec2{window.Size.x, ImGui_GetFrameHeight()}),
        };
        bool is_explicit_target = g.IO.ConfigDockingWithShift || ImGui_IsMouseHoveringRect(explicit_target_rect.Min, explicit_target_rect.Max);
        bool do_preview = ImGuiPayload_IsPreview(payload) || ImGuiPayload_IsDelivery(payload);
        if do_preview && (node != null || dock_into_floating_window) {
            ImGuiDockPreviewData split_inner;
            ImGuiDockPreviewData split_outer;
            ImGuiDockPreviewData* split_data = &split_inner;
            if node && (node.ParentNode || ImGuiDockNode_IsCentralNode(node) || !ImGuiDockNode_IsLeafNode(node)) {
                ImGuiDockNode* root_node = ImGui_DockNodeGetRootNode(node);
                if root_node != null {
                    ImGui_DockNodePreviewDockSetup(window, root_node, payload_window, null, &split_outer, is_explicit_target, true);
                    if split_outer.IsSplitDirExplicit != 0 {
                        split_data = &split_outer;
                    }
                }
            }
            if !node || ImGuiDockNode_IsLeafNode(node) {
                ImGui_DockNodePreviewDockSetup(window, node, payload_window, null, &split_inner, is_explicit_target, false);
            }
            if split_data == &split_outer {
                split_inner.IsDropAllowed = false;
            }
            ImGui_DockNodePreviewDockRender(window, node, payload_window, &split_inner);
            ImGui_DockNodePreviewDockRender(window, node, payload_window, &split_outer);
            if split_data.IsDropAllowed && ImGuiPayload_IsDelivery(payload) {
                ImGui_DockContextQueueDock(g, window, split_data.SplitNode, payload_window, split_data.SplitDir, split_data.SplitRatio, split_data == &split_outer);
            }
        }
    }
    ImGui_EndDragDropTarget();
}

private {
void ImGui_DockSettingsRenameNodeReferences(ImGuiID old_node_id, ImGuiID new_node_id) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    while true {
        if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventDocking) != 0 {
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    for i32 window_n = 0; window_n < g.Windows.Size; window_n++ {
        ImGuiWindow* window = g.Windows.Data[window_n];
        if window.DockId == old_node_id && window.DockNode == null {
            window.DockId = new_node_id;
        }
    }
    for ImGuiWindowSettings* settings = ImChunkStream_ImGuiWindowSettings_begin(&g.SettingsWindows); settings != null; settings = ImChunkStream_ImGuiWindowSettings_next_chunk(&g.SettingsWindows, settings) {
        if settings.DockId == old_node_id {
            settings.DockId = new_node_id;
        }
    }
}

// Remove references stored in ImGuiWindowSettings to the given ImGuiDockNodeSettings
void ImGui_DockSettingsRemoveNodeReferences(ImGuiID* node_ids, i32 node_ids_count) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    i32 found = 0;
    for ImGuiWindowSettings* settings = ImChunkStream_ImGuiWindowSettings_begin(&g.SettingsWindows); settings != null; settings = ImChunkStream_ImGuiWindowSettings_next_chunk(&g.SettingsWindows, settings) {
        for i32 node_n = 0; node_n < node_ids_count; node_n++ {
            if settings.DockId == node_ids[node_n] {
                settings.DockId = 0;
                settings.DockOrder = -1;
                if ++found < node_ids_count {
                    break;
                }
                return;
            }
        }
    }
}

void ImGui_DockSettingsHandler_ReadLine(ImGuiContext* ctx, ImGuiSettingsHandler* _1, void* _2, u8* line) {
    u8 c = 0;
    i32 x = 0;
    i32 y = 0;
    i32 r = 0;
    ImGuiDockNodeSettings node;
    line = ImStrSkipBlank(line);
    if strncmp(line, "DockNode", cast(u64, 8)) == 0 {
        line = ImStrSkipBlank(line + strlen("DockNode"));
    } else if strncmp(line, "DockSpace", cast(u64, 9)) == 0 {
        line = ImStrSkipBlank(line + strlen("DockSpace"));
        node.Flags |= ImGuiDockNodeFlags_DockSpace;
    } else {
        return;
    }
    if sscanf(line, "ID=0x%08X%n", &node.ID, &r) == 1 {
        line += r;
    } else {
        return;
    }
    if sscanf(line, " Parent=0x%08X%n", &node.ParentNodeId, &r) == 1 {
        line += r;
        if node.ParentNodeId == 0 {
            return;
        }
    }
    if sscanf(line, " Window=0x%08X%n", &node.ParentWindowId, &r) == 1 {
        line += r;
        if node.ParentWindowId == 0 {
            return;
        }
    }
    if node.ParentNodeId == 0 {
        if sscanf(line, " Pos=%i,%i%n", &x, &y, &r) == 2 {
            line += r;
            node.Pos = ImVec2ih{cast(i16, x), cast(i16, y)};
        } else {
            return;
        }
        if sscanf(line, " Size=%i,%i%n", &x, &y, &r) == 2 {
            line += r;
            node.Size = ImVec2ih{cast(i16, x), cast(i16, y)};
        } else {
            return;
        }
    } else {
        if sscanf(line, " SizeRef=%i,%i%n", &x, &y, &r) == 2 {
            line += r;
            node.SizeRef = ImVec2ih{cast(i16, x), cast(i16, y)};
        }
    }
    if sscanf(line, " Split=%c%n", &c, &r) == 1 {
        line += r;
        if c == 88 {
            node.SplitAxis = cast(i8, ImGuiAxis_X);
        } else if c == 89 {
            node.SplitAxis = cast(i8, ImGuiAxis_Y);
        }
    }
    if sscanf(line, " NoResize=%d%n", &x, &r) == 1 {
        line += r;
        if x != 0 {
            node.Flags |= ImGuiDockNodeFlags_NoResize;
        }
    }
    if sscanf(line, " CentralNode=%d%n", &x, &r) == 1 {
        line += r;
        if x != 0 {
            node.Flags |= ImGuiDockNodeFlags_CentralNode;
        }
    }
    if sscanf(line, " NoTabBar=%d%n", &x, &r) == 1 {
        line += r;
        if x != 0 {
            node.Flags |= ImGuiDockNodeFlags_NoTabBar;
        }
    }
    if sscanf(line, " HiddenTabBar=%d%n", &x, &r) == 1 {
        line += r;
        if x != 0 {
            node.Flags |= ImGuiDockNodeFlags_HiddenTabBar;
        }
    }
    if sscanf(line, " NoWindowMenuButton=%d%n", &x, &r) == 1 {
        line += r;
        if x != 0 {
            node.Flags |= ImGuiDockNodeFlags_NoWindowMenuButton;
        }
    }
    if sscanf(line, " NoCloseButton=%d%n", &x, &r) == 1 {
        line += r;
        if x != 0 {
            node.Flags |= ImGuiDockNodeFlags_NoCloseButton;
        }
    }
    if sscanf(line, " Selected=0x%08X%n", &node.SelectedTabId, &r) == 1 {
        line += r;
    }
    if node.ParentNodeId != 0 {
        ImGuiDockNodeSettings* parent_settings = ImGui_DockSettingsFindNodeSettings(ctx, node.ParentNodeId);
        if parent_settings != null {
            node.Depth = cast(u8, parent_settings.Depth + 1);
        }
    }
    ImVector_ImGuiDockNodeSettings_push_back(&ctx.DockContext.NodesSettings, node);
}

void ImGui_DockSettingsHandler_WriteAll(ImGuiContext* ctx, ImGuiSettingsHandler* handler, ImGuiTextBuffer* buf) {
    ImGuiContext* g = ctx;
    ImGuiDockContext* dc = &ctx.DockContext;

// [DEBUG] Compute mask of inputs with the same codepoint.
private {
i32 CalcFontGlyphSrcOverlapMask(ImFontAtlas* atlas, ImFont* font, u32 codepoint) {
    i32 mask = 0;
    i32 count = 0;
    for i32 src_n = 0; src_n < font.Sources.Size; src_n++ {
        ImFontConfig* src = font.Sources.Data[src_n];
        if (src.FontLoader != null ? src.FontLoader : atlas.FontLoader).FontSrcContainsGlyph(atlas, src, cast(ImWchar, codepoint)) == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        mask |= 1 << src_n;
        count++;
    }
    return count > 1 ? mask : 0;
}
}

// Update queries. The steps are: -1: query Stack, >= 0: query each stack item
// We can only perform 1 ID Info query every frame. This is designed so the GetID() tests are cheap and constant-time
private {
ImGuiID DebugItemPathQuery_UpdateAndGetHookId(ImGuiDebugItemPathQuery* query, ImGuiID id) {
    if query.MainID != id {
        query.MainID = id;
        query.Step = cast(ImS8, -1);
        query.Complete = false;
        ImVector_ImGuiStackLevelInfo_resize(&query.Results, 0);
        ImGuiTextBuffer_resize(&query.ResultsDescBuf, 0);
    }
    query.Active = false;
    if id == 0 {
        return 0;
    }
    if query.Step >= 0 && query.Step < query.Results.Size {
        if query.Results.Data[query.Step].QuerySuccess || query.Results.Data[query.Step].QueryFrameCount > 2 {
            query.Step++;
        }
    }
    query.Complete = query.Step == query.Results.Size;
    if query.Step == -1 {
        query.Active = true;
        return id;
    } else if query.Step >= 0 && query.Step < query.Results.Size {
        query.Results.Data[query.Step].QueryFrameCount++;
        query.Active = true;
        return query.Results.Data[query.Step].ID;
    }
    return 0;
}
}

u8* DebugItemPathQuery_GetResultAsPath(ImGuiDebugItemPathQuery* query, bool hex_encode_non_ascii_chars) {

    ImGuiTextBuffer_resize(buf, 0);
    for i32 stack_n = 0; stack_n < query.Results.Size; stack_n++ {
        u8[256] level_desc;
        DebugItemPathQuery_FormatLevelInfo(query, stack_n, false, level_desc, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(level_desc) / sizeof(*level_desc))));
        ImGuiTextBuffer_append(buf, stack_n == 0 ? "//" : "/", null);
        u8* p = level_desc;
        while *p != 0 {
            u32 c;
            u8* p_next = p + ImTextCharFromUtf8(&c, p, null);
            if c == 47 {
                ImGuiTextBuffer_append(buf, "\\", null);
            }
            if c < 256 || !hex_encode_non_ascii_chars {
                ImGuiTextBuffer_append(buf, p, p_next);
            } else {
                for ; p < p_next; p++ {
                    ImGuiTextBuffer_appendf(buf, "\\x%02x", cast(u8, *p));
                }
            }
            p = p_next;
        }
    }
    return ImGuiTextBuffer_c_str(buf);
}

    var count = cast(i64, it_last - it);
    var off = cast(i64, it - self.Data);
    memmove(self.Data + off, self.Data + off + count, (cast(u64, self.Size) - cast(u64, off) - cast(u64, count)) * cast(u64, sizeof(ImGuiDockContextPruneNodeData)));
    self.Size -= cast(i32, count);
    return self.Data + off;
}

ImGuiDockContextPruneNodeData* ImVector_ImGuiDockContextPruneNodeData_erase_unsorted(ImVector_ImGuiDockContextPruneNodeData* self, ImGuiDockContextPruneNodeData* it) {
    assert(it >= self.Data && it < self.Data + self.Size);
    var off = cast(i64, it - self.Data);
    if it < self.Data + self.Size - 1 {
        memcpy(self.Data + off, self.Data + self.Size - 1, cast(u64, sizeof(ImGuiDockContextPruneNodeData)));
    }
    self.Size--;
    return self.Data + off;
}

ImGuiDockContextPruneNodeData* ImVector_ImGuiDockContextPruneNodeData_insert(ImVector_ImGuiDockContextPruneNodeData* self, ImGuiDockContextPruneNodeData* it, ImGuiDockContextPruneNodeData v) {

    }
    if off < self.Size {
        memmove(self.Data + off + 1, self.Data + off, (cast(u64, self.Size) - cast(u64, off)) * cast(u64, sizeof(ImGuiDockContextPruneNodeData)));

    memcpy(&self.Data[off], &v, cast(u64, sizeof(v)));

// Assign packed locations to rectangles. The rectangles are of type
// 'stbrp_rect' defined below, stored in the array 'rects', and there
// are 'num_rects' many of them.
//
// Rectangles which are successfully packed have the 'was_packed' flag

// if you imagine y increasing downwards). Rectangles which do not fit
// have the 'was_packed' flag set to 0.
//
// You should not try to access the 'rects' array from another thread
// while this function is running, as the function temporarily reorders
// the array while it executes.
//
// To pack into another rectangle, you need to call stbrp_init_target
// again. To continue packing into the same rectangle, you can call
// this function again. Calling this multiple times with multiple rect
// arrays will probably produce worse packing results than calling it
// a single time with the full rectangle array, but the option is
// available.
//
// The function returns 1 if all of the rectangles were successfully
// packed and 0 otherwise.
struct stbrp_rect {
    i32 id;
    stbrp_coord w;
    stbrp_coord h;
    stbrp_coord x;
    stbrp_coord y;

private {
void stbrp_setup_heuristic(stbrp_context* context, i32 heuristic) {
    switch context.init_mode {
        case STBRP__INIT_skyline: {
            while true {
                assert(heuristic == STBRP_HEURISTIC_Skyline_BL_sortHeight || heuristic == STBRP_HEURISTIC_Skyline_BF_sortHeight);
                if !(0 != 0) { break; }
            }
            context.heuristic = heuristic;
        }
        default: {
            while true {
                assert(0);
                if !(0 != 0) { break; }
            }
        }
    }
}

void stbrp_setup_allow_out_of_mem(stbrp_context* context, i32 allow_out_of_mem) {
    if allow_out_of_mem != 0 {
        context.align = 1;
    } else {
        context.align = (context.width + context.num_nodes - 1) / context.num_nodes;
    }
}

void stbrp_init_target(stbrp_context* context, i32 width, i32 height, stbrp_node* nodes, i32 num_nodes) {
    i32 i;
    for i = 0; i < num_nodes - 1; ++i {
        nodes[i].next = &nodes[i + 1];
    }
    nodes[i].next = null;
    context.init_mode = STBRP__INIT_skyline;
    context.heuristic = STBRP_HEURISTIC_Skyline_default;
    context.free_head = &nodes[0];
    context.active_head = &context.extra[0];
    context.width = width;
    context.height = height;
    context.num_nodes = num_nodes;
    stbrp_setup_allow_out_of_mem(context, 0);
    context.extra[0].x = 0;
    context.extra[0].y = 0;
    context.extra[0].next = &context.extra[1];
    context.extra[1].x = cast(stbrp_coord, width);
    context.extra[1].y = 1 << 30;
    context.extra[1].next = null;
}

// find minimum y position if it starts at x1
i32 stbrp__skyline_find_min_y(stbrp_context* c, stbrp_node* first, i32 x0, i32 width, i32* pwaste) {
    stbrp_node* node = first;
    i32 x1 = x0 + width;
    i32 min_y;
    i32 visited_width;
    i32 waste_area;
    ignore sizeof(c);
    while true {
        assert(first.x <= x0);
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    while true {
        assert(node.next.x > x0);
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    while true {
        assert(node.x <= x0);
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    min_y = 0;
    waste_area = 0;
    visited_width = 0;
    while node.x < x1 {
        if node.y > min_y {
            waste_area += visited_width * (node.y - min_y);
            min_y = node.y;
            if node.x < x0 {
                visited_width += node.next.x - x0;
            } else {
                visited_width += node.next.x - node.x;
            }
        } else {
            i32 under_width = node.next.x - node.x;
            if under_width + visited_width > width {
                under_width = width - visited_width;
            }
            waste_area += under_width * (min_y - node.y);
            visited_width += under_width;
        }
        node = node.next;
    }
    *pwaste = waste_area;
    return min_y;
}

stbrp__findresult stbrp__skyline_find_best_pos(stbrp_context* c, i32 width, i32 height) {
    i32 best_waste = 1 << 30;
    i32 best_x;
    i32 best_y = 1 << 30;
    stbrp__findresult fr;
    stbrp_node** prev;
    stbrp_node* node;
    stbrp_node* tail;
    stbrp_node** best = null;
    width = width + c.align - 1;
    width -= width % c.align;
    while true {
        assert(width % c.align == 0);
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    if width > c.width || height > c.height {
        fr.prev_link = null;
        fr.y = 0;
        fr.x = fr.y;
        return fr;
    }
    node = c.active_head;
    prev = &c.active_head;
    while node.x + width <= c.width {
        i32 y;
        i32 waste;
        y = stbrp__skyline_find_min_y(c, node, node.x, width, &waste);
        if c.heuristic == STBRP_HEURISTIC_Skyline_BL_sortHeight {
            if y < best_y {
                best_y = y;
                best = prev;
            }
        } else {
            if y + height <= c.height {
                if y < best_y || y == best_y && waste < best_waste {
                    best_y = y;
                    best_waste = waste;
                    best = prev;
                }
            }
        }
        prev = &node.next;
        node = node.next;
    }
    best_x = best == null ? 0 : (*best).x;
    if c.heuristic == STBRP_HEURISTIC_Skyline_BF_sortHeight {
        tail = c.active_head;
        node = c.active_head;
        prev = &c.active_head;
        while tail.x < width {
            tail = tail.next;
        }
        while tail != null {
            i32 xpos = tail.x - width;
            i32 y;
            i32 waste;
            while true {
                assert(xpos >= 0);
                if !(0 != 0) { break; }
            }
            while node.next.x <= xpos {
                prev = &node.next;
                node = node.next;
            }
            while true {
                assert(node.next.x > xpos && node.x <= xpos);
                if !(0 != 0) { break; }
            }
            y = stbrp__skyline_find_min_y(c, node, xpos, width, &waste);
            if y + height <= c.height {
                if y <= best_y {
                    if y < best_y || waste < best_waste || waste == best_waste && xpos < best_x {
                        best_x = xpos;
                        best_y = y;
                        best_waste = waste;
                        best = prev;
                    }
                }
            }
            tail = tail.next;
        }
    }
    fr.prev_link = best;
    fr.x = best_x;
    fr.y = best_y;
    return fr;
}

stbrp__findresult stbrp__skyline_pack_rectangle(stbrp_context* context, i32 width, i32 height) {
    stbrp__findresult res = stbrp__skyline_find_best_pos(context, width, height);
    stbrp_node* node;
    stbrp_node* cur;
    if res.prev_link == null || res.y + height > context.height || context.free_head == null {
        res.prev_link = null;
        return res;
    }
    node = context.free_head;
    node.x = cast(stbrp_coord, res.x);
    node.y = cast(stbrp_coord, res.y + height);
    context.free_head = node.next;
    cur = *res.prev_link;
    if cur.x < res.x {
        stbrp_node* next = cur.next;
        cur.next = node;
        cur = next;
    } else {
        *res.prev_link = node;
    }
    while cur.next && cur.next.x <= res.x + width {
        stbrp_node* next = cur.next;
        cur.next = context.free_head;
        context.free_head = cur;
        cur = next;
    }
    node.next = cur;
    if cur.x < res.x + width {
        cur.x = cast(stbrp_coord, res.x + width);
    }
    return res;
}

i32 rect_height_compare(void* a, void* b) {
    var p = cast(stbrp_rect*, a);
    var q = cast(stbrp_rect*, b);
    if p.h > q.h {
        return -1;
    }
    if p.h < q.h {
        return 1;
    }
    return p.w > q.w ? -1 : p.w < q.w;
}

i32 rect_original_order(void* a, void* b) {
    var p = cast(stbrp_rect*, a);
    var q = cast(stbrp_rect*, b);
    return p.was_packed < q.was_packed ? -1 : p.was_packed > q.was_packed;
}

i32 stbrp_pack_rects(stbrp_context* context, stbrp_rect* rects, i32 num_rects) {
    i32 i;
    i32 all_rects_packed = 1;
    for i = 0; i < num_rects; ++i {
        rects[i].was_packed = i;
    }
    ImQsort(rects, cast(u64, num_rects), cast(u64, sizeof(rects[0])), cast(fn(void*, void*): i32, rect_height_compare));
    for i = 0; i < num_rects; ++i {
        if rects[i].w == 0 || rects[i].h == 0 {
            rects[i].y = 0;
            rects[i].x = rects[i].y;
        } else {
            stbrp__findresult fr = stbrp__skyline_pack_rectangle(context, rects[i].w, rects[i].h);
            if fr.prev_link != null {
                rects[i].x = cast(stbrp_coord, fr.x);
                rects[i].y = cast(stbrp_coord, fr.y);
            } else {
                rects[i].y = 0x7fffffff;
                rects[i].x = rects[i].y;
            }
        }
    }
    ImQsort(rects, cast(u64, num_rects), cast(u64, sizeof(rects[0])), cast(fn(void*, void*): i32, rect_original_order));
    for i = 0; i < num_rects; ++i {
        rects[i].was_packed = !(rects[i].x == 0x7fffffff && rects[i].y == 0x7fffffff);
        if rects[i].was_packed == 0 {
            all_rects_packed = 0;
        }
    }
    return all_rects_packed;
}
