void ImDrawListSharedData_init(ImDrawListSharedData* self) {
    memset(self, 0, cast(u64, sizeof(*self)));
    ImVec2_init(&self.TexUvWhitePixel);
    ImVec4_init(&self.ClipRectFullscreen);
    ImVector_ImVec2_init(&self.TempBuffer);
    ImVector_ImDrawList_ptr_init(&self.DrawLists);
    memset(cast(void*, self), 0, cast(u64, sizeof(*self)));
    self.InitialFringeScale = 1.0f;
    for i32 i = 0; i < cast(i32, sizeof(self.ArcFastVtx) / sizeof(*self.ArcFastVtx)); i++ {
        f32 a = cast(f32, i) * 2.0f * 3.141592653589793f / cast(f32, cast(i32, sizeof(self.ArcFastVtx) / sizeof(*self.ArcFastVtx)));
        self.ArcFastVtx[i] = ImVec2{cos(a), sin(a)};
    }
}

void ImDrawListSharedData_dtor(ImDrawListSharedData* self) {
    assert(self.DrawLists.Size == 0);
}

void ImDrawListSharedData_SetCircleTessellationMaxError(ImDrawListSharedData* self, f32 max_error) {
    if self.CircleTessellationMaxError == max_error {
        return;
    }
    assert(max_error > 0.0f);
    self.CircleTessellationMaxError = max_error;
    for i32 i = 0; i < cast(i32, sizeof(self.CircleSegmentCounts) / sizeof(*self.CircleSegmentCounts)); i++ {
        var radius = cast(f32, i);
        self.CircleSegmentCounts[i] = cast(ImU8, i > 0 ? ImClamp((cast(i32, ceil(3.141592653589793f / acos(1.0f - ImMin(self.CircleTessellationMaxError, radius) / radius))) + 1) / 2 * 2, 4, 512) : 48);
    }
    self.ArcFastRadiusCutoff = self.CircleTessellationMaxError / (1.0f - cos(3.141592653589793f / ImMax(cast(f32, 48), 3.141592653589793f)));
}

void ImDrawList_init(ImDrawList* self, ImDrawListSharedData* shared_data) {
    memset(self, 0, cast(u64, sizeof(*self)));
    ImVector_ImDrawCmd_init(&self.CmdBuffer);
    ImVector_ImDrawIdx_init(&self.IdxBuffer);
    ImVector_ImDrawVert_init(&self.VtxBuffer);
    ImVector_ImVec2_init(&self._Path);
    memset(&self._CmdHeader, 0, cast(u64, sizeof(ImDrawCmdHeader)));
    ImDrawListSplitter_init(&self._Splitter);
    ImVector_ImVec4_init(&self._ClipRectStack);
    ImVector_ImTextureRef_init(&self._TextureStack);
    ImVector_ImU8_init(&self._CallbacksDataBuf);
    memset(cast(void*, self), 0, cast(u64, sizeof(*self)));
    ImDrawList__SetDrawListSharedData(self, shared_data);
}

void ImDrawList_dtor(ImDrawList* self) {
    ImDrawList__ClearFreeMemory(self);
    ImDrawList__SetDrawListSharedData(self, null);
}

void ImDrawList__SetDrawListSharedData(ImDrawList* self, ImDrawListSharedData* data) {
    if self._Data != null {
        ImVector_ImDrawList_ptr_find_erase_unsorted(&self._Data.DrawLists, self);
    }
    self._Data = data;
    if self._Data != null {
        ImVector_ImDrawList_ptr_push_back(&self._Data.DrawLists, self);
    }
}

// Initialize before use in a new frame. We always have a command ready in the buffer.
// In the majority of cases, you would want to call PushClipRect() and PushTexture() after this.
void ImDrawList__ResetForNewFrame(ImDrawList* self) {
    if self._Splitter._Count > 1 {
        ImDrawListSplitter_Merge(&self._Splitter, self);
    }
    ImVector_ImDrawCmd_resize(&self.CmdBuffer, 0);
    ImVector_ImDrawIdx_resize(&self.IdxBuffer, 0);
    ImVector_ImDrawVert_resize(&self.VtxBuffer, 0);
    self.Flags = self._Data.InitialFlags;
    memset(&self._CmdHeader, 0, cast(u64, sizeof(self._CmdHeader)));
    self._VtxCurrentIdx = 0;
    self._VtxWritePtr = null;
    self._IdxWritePtr = null;
    ImVector_ImVec4_resize(&self._ClipRectStack, 0);
    ImVector_ImTextureRef_resize(&self._TextureStack, 0);
    ImVector_ImU8_resize(&self._CallbacksDataBuf, 0);
    ImVector_ImVec2_resize(&self._Path, 0);
    ImDrawListSplitter_Clear(&self._Splitter);
    ImVector_ImDrawCmd_push_back(&self.CmdBuffer, __cxx_make_ImDrawCmd());
    self._FringeScale = self._Data.InitialFringeScale;
}

void ImDrawList__ClearFreeMemory(ImDrawList* self) {
    ImVector_ImDrawCmd_clear(&self.CmdBuffer);
    ImVector_ImDrawIdx_clear(&self.IdxBuffer);
    ImVector_ImDrawVert_clear(&self.VtxBuffer);
    self.Flags = ImDrawListFlags_None;
    self._VtxCurrentIdx = 0;
    self._VtxWritePtr = null;
    self._IdxWritePtr = null;
    ImVector_ImVec4_clear(&self._ClipRectStack);
    ImVector_ImTextureRef_clear(&self._TextureStack);
    ImVector_ImU8_clear(&self._CallbacksDataBuf);
    ImVector_ImVec2_clear(&self._Path);
    ImDrawListSplitter_ClearFreeMemory(&self._Splitter);
}

// Note: For multi-threaded rendering, consider using `imgui_threaded_rendering` from https://github.com/ocornut/imgui_club
ImDrawList* ImDrawList_CloneOutput(ImDrawList* self) {
    var dst = cast(ImDrawList*, ImGui_MemAlloc(cast(u64, sizeof(ImDrawList))));
    ImDrawList_init(dst, null);
    dst.CmdBuffer = self.CmdBuffer;
    dst.IdxBuffer = self.IdxBuffer;
    dst.VtxBuffer = self.VtxBuffer;
    dst.Flags = self.Flags;
    return dst;
}

void ImDrawList_AddDrawCmd(ImDrawList* self) {
    ImDrawCmd draw_cmd;
    draw_cmd.ClipRect = self._CmdHeader.ClipRect;
    draw_cmd.TexRef = self._CmdHeader.TexRef;
    draw_cmd.VtxOffset = self._CmdHeader.VtxOffset;
    draw_cmd.IdxOffset = cast(u32, self.IdxBuffer.Size);
    assert(draw_cmd.ClipRect.x <= draw_cmd.ClipRect.z && draw_cmd.ClipRect.y <= draw_cmd.ClipRect.w);
    ImVector_ImDrawCmd_push_back(&self.CmdBuffer, draw_cmd);
}

// Pop trailing draw command (used before merging or presenting to user)
// Note that this leaves the ImDrawList in a state unfit for further commands, as most code assume that CmdBuffer.Size > 0 && CmdBuffer.back().UserCallback == NULL
void ImDrawList__PopUnusedDrawCmd(ImDrawList* self) {
    while self.CmdBuffer.Size > 0 {
        ImDrawCmd* curr_cmd = &self.CmdBuffer.Data[self.CmdBuffer.Size - 1];
        if curr_cmd.ElemCount != 0 || curr_cmd.UserCallback != null {
            return;
        }
        ImVector_ImDrawCmd_pop_back(&self.CmdBuffer);
    }
}

void ImDrawList_AddCallback(ImDrawList* self, ImDrawCallback callback, void* userdata, u64 userdata_size) {
    assert(callback != null);
    ImDrawCmd* curr_cmd = &self.CmdBuffer.Data[self.CmdBuffer.Size - 1];
    assert(curr_cmd.UserCallback == null);
    if curr_cmd.ElemCount != 0 {
        ImDrawList_AddDrawCmd(self);
        curr_cmd = &self.CmdBuffer.Data[self.CmdBuffer.Size - 1];
    }
    curr_cmd.UserCallback = callback;
    if userdata_size == 0 {
        curr_cmd.UserCallbackData = userdata;
        curr_cmd.UserCallbackDataSize = 0;
        curr_cmd.UserCallbackDataOffset = -1;
    } else {
        assert(userdata != null);
        assert(userdata_size < cast(u64, 1 << 31));
        curr_cmd.UserCallbackData = null;
        curr_cmd.UserCallbackDataSize = cast(i32, userdata_size);
        curr_cmd.UserCallbackDataOffset = self._CallbacksDataBuf.Size;
        ImVector_ImU8_resize(&self._CallbacksDataBuf, self._CallbacksDataBuf.Size + cast(i32, userdata_size));
        memcpy(self._CallbacksDataBuf.Data + cast(u64, curr_cmd.UserCallbackDataOffset), userdata, userdata_size);
    }
    ImDrawList_AddDrawCmd(self);
}

// Compare ClipRect, TexRef and VtxOffset with a single memcmp()
// Try to merge two last draw commands
void ImDrawList__TryMergeDrawCmds(ImDrawList* self) {
    ImDrawCmd* curr_cmd = &self.CmdBuffer.Data[self.CmdBuffer.Size - 1];
    ImDrawCmd* prev_cmd = curr_cmd - 1;
    if memcmp(curr_cmd, prev_cmd, cast(u64, cast(c_ulong, &cast(ImDrawCmd*, 0).VtxOffset) + cast(c_ulong, sizeof(u32)))) == 0 && prev_cmd.IdxOffset + prev_cmd.ElemCount == curr_cmd.IdxOffset && curr_cmd.UserCallback == null && prev_cmd.UserCallback == null {
        prev_cmd.ElemCount += curr_cmd.ElemCount;
        ImVector_ImDrawCmd_pop_back(&self.CmdBuffer);
    }
}

// Our scheme may appears a bit unusual, basically we want the most-common calls AddLine AddRect etc. to not have to perform any check so we always have a command ready in the stack.
// The cost of figuring out if a new command has to be added or if we can merge is paid in those Update** functions only.
void ImDrawList__OnChangedClipRect(ImDrawList* self) {
    ImDrawCmd* curr_cmd = &self.CmdBuffer.Data[self.CmdBuffer.Size - 1];
    if curr_cmd.ElemCount != 0 && memcmp(&curr_cmd.ClipRect, &self._CmdHeader.ClipRect, cast(u64, sizeof(ImVec4))) != 0 {
        ImDrawList_AddDrawCmd(self);
        return;
    }
    assert(curr_cmd.UserCallback == null);
    ImDrawCmd* prev_cmd = curr_cmd - 1;
    if curr_cmd.ElemCount == 0 && self.CmdBuffer.Size > 1 && memcmp(&self._CmdHeader, prev_cmd, cast(u64, cast(c_ulong, &cast(ImDrawCmd*, 0).VtxOffset) + cast(c_ulong, sizeof(u32)))) == 0 && prev_cmd.IdxOffset + prev_cmd.ElemCount == curr_cmd.IdxOffset && prev_cmd.UserCallback == null {
        ImVector_ImDrawCmd_pop_back(&self.CmdBuffer);
        return;
    }
    curr_cmd.ClipRect = self._CmdHeader.ClipRect;
}

void ImDrawList__OnChangedTexture(ImDrawList* self) {
    ImDrawCmd* curr_cmd = &self.CmdBuffer.Data[self.CmdBuffer.Size - 1];
    if curr_cmd.ElemCount != 0 && op_ne_ImTextureRef_ImTextureRef(curr_cmd.TexRef, self._CmdHeader.TexRef) {
        ImDrawList_AddDrawCmd(self);
        return;
    }
    if curr_cmd.UserCallback != null {
        return;
    }
    ImDrawCmd* prev_cmd = curr_cmd - 1;
    if curr_cmd.ElemCount == 0 && self.CmdBuffer.Size > 1 && memcmp(&self._CmdHeader, prev_cmd, cast(u64, cast(c_ulong, &cast(ImDrawCmd*, 0).VtxOffset) + cast(c_ulong, sizeof(u32)))) == 0 && prev_cmd.IdxOffset + prev_cmd.ElemCount == curr_cmd.IdxOffset && prev_cmd.UserCallback == null {
        ImVector_ImDrawCmd_pop_back(&self.CmdBuffer);
        return;
    }
    curr_cmd.TexRef = self._CmdHeader.TexRef;
}

void ImDrawList__OnChangedVtxOffset(ImDrawList* self) {
    self._VtxCurrentIdx = 0;
    ImDrawCmd* curr_cmd = &self.CmdBuffer.Data[self.CmdBuffer.Size - 1];
    if curr_cmd.ElemCount != 0 {
        ImDrawList_AddDrawCmd(self);
        return;
    }
    assert(curr_cmd.UserCallback == null);
    curr_cmd.VtxOffset = self._CmdHeader.VtxOffset;
}

i32 ImDrawList__CalcCircleAutoSegmentCount(ImDrawList* self, f32 radius) {
    var radius_idx = cast(i32, radius + 0.999f);
    if radius_idx >= 0 && radius_idx < cast(i32, sizeof(self._Data.CircleSegmentCounts) / sizeof(*self._Data.CircleSegmentCounts)) {
        return cast(i32, self._Data.CircleSegmentCounts[radius_idx]);
    } else {
        return ImClamp((cast(i32, ceil(3.141592653589793f / acos(1.0f - ImMin(self._Data.CircleTessellationMaxError, radius) / radius))) + 1) / 2 * 2, 4, 512);
    }
}

// Render-level scissoring. This is passed down to your render function but not used for CPU-side coarse clipping. Prefer using higher-level ImGui::PushClipRect() to affect logic (hit-testing and widget culling)
void ImDrawList_PushClipRect(ImDrawList* self, ImVec2 cr_min, ImVec2 cr_max, bool intersect_with_current_clip_rect) {
    ImVec4 cr;
    ImVec4_init(&cr, cr_min.x, cr_min.y, cr_max.x, cr_max.y);
    if intersect_with_current_clip_rect != 0 {
        ImVec4 current = self._CmdHeader.ClipRect;
        if cr.x < current.x {
            cr.x = current.x;
        }
        if cr.y < current.y {
            cr.y = current.y;
        }
        if cr.z > current.z {
            cr.z = current.z;
        }
        if cr.w > current.w {
            cr.w = current.w;
        }
    }
    cr.z = ImMax(cr.x, cr.z);
    cr.w = ImMax(cr.y, cr.w);
    ImVector_ImVec4_push_back(&self._ClipRectStack, cr);
    self._CmdHeader.ClipRect = cr;
    ImDrawList__OnChangedClipRect(self);
}

void ImDrawList_PushClipRectFullScreen(ImDrawList* self) {
    ImDrawList_PushClipRect(self, ImVec2{
        self._Data.ClipRectFullscreen.x, self._Data.ClipRectFullscreen.y,
    }, ImVec2{self._Data.ClipRectFullscreen.z, self._Data.ClipRectFullscreen.w}, false);
}

void ImDrawList_PopClipRect(ImDrawList* self) {
    ImVector_ImVec4_pop_back(&self._ClipRectStack);
    self._CmdHeader.ClipRect = self._ClipRectStack.Size == 0 ? self._Data.ClipRectFullscreen : self._ClipRectStack.Data[self._ClipRectStack.Size - 1];
    ImDrawList__OnChangedClipRect(self);
}

void ImDrawList_PushTexture(ImDrawList* self, ImTextureRef tex_ref) {
    ImVector_ImTextureRef_push_back(&self._TextureStack, tex_ref);
    self._CmdHeader.TexRef = tex_ref;
    if tex_ref._TexData != null {
        assert(tex_ref._TexData.WantDestroyNextFrame == false);
    }
    ImDrawList__OnChangedTexture(self);
}

void ImDrawList_PopTexture(ImDrawList* self) {
    ImVector_ImTextureRef_pop_back(&self._TextureStack);
    self._CmdHeader.TexRef = self._TextureStack.Size == 0 ? __cxx_make_ImTextureRef() : self._TextureStack.Data[self._TextureStack.Size - 1];
    ImDrawList__OnChangedTexture(self);
}

// This is used by ImGui::PushFont()/PopFont(). It works because we never use _TextureIdStack[] elsewhere than in PushTexture()/PopTexture().
void ImDrawList__SetTexture(ImDrawList* self, ImTextureRef tex_ref) {
    if op_eq_ImTextureRef_ImTextureRef(self._CmdHeader.TexRef, tex_ref) != 0 {
        return;
    }
    self._CmdHeader.TexRef = tex_ref;
    *ImVector_ImTextureRef_back(&self._TextureStack) = tex_ref;
    ImDrawList__OnChangedTexture(self);
}

// Reserve space for a number of vertices and indices.
// You must finish filling your reserved data before calling PrimReserve() again, as it may reallocate or
// submit the intermediate results. PrimUnreserve() can be used to release unused allocations.
void ImDrawList_PrimReserve(ImDrawList* self, i32 idx_count, i32 vtx_count) {
    if sizeof(ImDrawIdx) == 2 && self._VtxCurrentIdx + cast(u32, vtx_count) >= cast(u32, 1 << 16) && self.Flags & ImDrawListFlags_AllowVtxOffset {
        self._CmdHeader.VtxOffset = cast(u32, self.VtxBuffer.Size);
        ImDrawList__OnChangedVtxOffset(self);
    }
    ImDrawCmd* draw_cmd = &self.CmdBuffer.Data[self.CmdBuffer.Size - 1];
    draw_cmd.ElemCount += cast(u32, idx_count);
    i32 vtx_buffer_old_size = self.VtxBuffer.Size;
    ImVector_ImDrawVert_resize(&self.VtxBuffer, vtx_buffer_old_size + vtx_count);
    self._VtxWritePtr = self.VtxBuffer.Data + vtx_buffer_old_size;
    i32 idx_buffer_old_size = self.IdxBuffer.Size;
    ImVector_ImDrawIdx_resize(&self.IdxBuffer, idx_buffer_old_size + idx_count);
    self._IdxWritePtr = self.IdxBuffer.Data + idx_buffer_old_size;
}

// Release the number of reserved vertices/indices from the end of the last reservation made with PrimReserve().
void ImDrawList_PrimUnreserve(ImDrawList* self, i32 idx_count, i32 vtx_count) {
    ImDrawCmd* draw_cmd = &self.CmdBuffer.Data[self.CmdBuffer.Size - 1];
    draw_cmd.ElemCount -= cast(u32, idx_count);
    ImVector_ImDrawVert_shrink(&self.VtxBuffer, self.VtxBuffer.Size - vtx_count);
    ImVector_ImDrawIdx_shrink(&self.IdxBuffer, self.IdxBuffer.Size - idx_count);
}

// Fully unrolled with inline call to keep our debug builds decently fast.
void ImDrawList_PrimRect(ImDrawList* self, ImVec2 a, ImVec2 c, ImU32 col) {
    ImVec2 b;
    ImVec2_init(&b, c.x, a.y);
    ImVec2 d;
    ImVec2_init(&d, a.x, c.y);
    ImVec2 uv = self._Data.TexUvWhitePixel;
    var idx = cast(ImDrawIdx, self._VtxCurrentIdx);
    self._IdxWritePtr[0] = idx;
    self._IdxWritePtr[1] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx + 1);
    self._IdxWritePtr[2] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx + 2);
    self._IdxWritePtr[3] = idx;
    self._IdxWritePtr[4] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx + 2);
    self._IdxWritePtr[5] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx + 3);
    self._VtxWritePtr[0].pos = a;
    self._VtxWritePtr[0].uv = uv;
    self._VtxWritePtr[0].col = col;
    self._VtxWritePtr[1].pos = b;
    self._VtxWritePtr[1].uv = uv;
    self._VtxWritePtr[1].col = col;
    self._VtxWritePtr[2].pos = c;
    self._VtxWritePtr[2].uv = uv;
    self._VtxWritePtr[2].col = col;
    self._VtxWritePtr[3].pos = d;
    self._VtxWritePtr[3].uv = uv;
    self._VtxWritePtr[3].col = col;
    self._VtxWritePtr += 4;
    self._VtxCurrentIdx += 4;
    self._IdxWritePtr += 6;
}

// On AddPolyline() and AddConvexPolyFilled() we intentionally avoid using ImVec2 and superfluous function calls to optimize debug/non-inlined builds.
// - Those macros expects l-values and need to be used as their own statement.
// - Those macros are intentionally not surrounded by the 'do {} while (0)' idiom because even that translates to runtime with debug compilers.
// TODO: Thickness anti-aliased lines cap are missing their AA fringe.
// We avoid using the ImVec2 math operators here to reduce cost to a minimum for debug/non-inlined builds.
void ImDrawList_AddPolyline(ImDrawList* self, ImVec2* points, i32 points_count, ImU32 col, f32 thickness, ImDrawFlags flags) {
    if points_count < 2 || (col & 0xFF000000) == 0 {
        return;
    }
    bool closed = (flags & ImDrawFlags_Closed) != 0;
    ImVec2 opaque_uv = self._Data.TexUvWhitePixel;
    i32 count = closed != 0 ? points_count : points_count - 1;
    bool thick_line = thickness > self._FringeScale;
    while true {
        if (flags & ImDrawFlags_InvalidMask_) == 0 == 0 {
            if ImGui_ErrorLog("Incorrect parameter. Did you swap 'thickness' and 'flags'?") != 0 {
                assert((flags & ImDrawFlags_InvalidMask_) == 0 && "Incorrect parameter. Did you swap 'thickness' and 'flags'?");
            }
            return;
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    if (self.Flags & ImDrawListFlags_AntiAliasedLines) != 0 {
        f32 AA_SIZE = self._FringeScale;
        ImU32 col_trans = col & cast(u32, ~0xFF000000);
        thickness = ImMax(thickness, 1.0f);
        var integer_thickness = cast(i32, thickness);
        f32 fractional_thickness = thickness - cast(f32, integer_thickness);
        bool use_texture = self.Flags & ImDrawListFlags_AntiAliasedLinesUseTex && integer_thickness < 32 && fractional_thickness <= 1.0e-5f && AA_SIZE == 1.0f;
        i32 idx_count = use_texture != 0 ? count * 6 : thick_line != 0 ? count * 18 : count * 12;
        i32 vtx_count = use_texture != 0 ? points_count * 2 : thick_line != 0 ? points_count * 4 : points_count * 3;
        ImDrawList_PrimReserve(self, idx_count, vtx_count);
        ImVector_ImVec2_reserve_discard(&self._Data.TempBuffer, points_count * (use_texture || !thick_line ? 3 : 5));
        ImVec2* temp_normals = self._Data.TempBuffer.Data;
        ImVec2* temp_points = temp_normals + points_count;
        for i32 i1 = 0; i1 < count; i1++ {
            i32 i2 = i1 + 1 == points_count ? 0 : i1 + 1;
            f32 dx = points[i2].x - points[i1].x;
            f32 dy = points[i2].y - points[i1].y;
            {
                f32 d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
                if d2 > 0.0f {
                    f32 inv_len = ImRsqrt(d2);
                    dx *= inv_len;
                    dy *= inv_len;
                }
            }
            temp_normals[i1].x = dy;
            temp_normals[i1].y = -dx;
        }
        if closed == 0 {
            temp_normals[points_count - 1] = temp_normals[points_count - 2];
        }
        if use_texture || !thick_line {
            f32 half_draw_size = use_texture != 0 ? thickness * 0.5f + 1.0f : AA_SIZE;
            if closed == 0 {
                temp_points[0] = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(points[0], op_mul_ImVec2_float(temp_normals[0], half_draw_size));
                temp_points[1] = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(points[0], op_mul_ImVec2_float(temp_normals[0], half_draw_size));
                temp_points[(points_count - 1) * 2 + 0] = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(points[points_count - 1], op_mul_ImVec2_float(temp_normals[points_count - 1], half_draw_size));
                temp_points[(points_count - 1) * 2 + 1] = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(points[points_count - 1], op_mul_ImVec2_float(temp_normals[points_count - 1], half_draw_size));
            }
            u32 idx1 = self._VtxCurrentIdx;
            for i32 i1 = 0; i1 < count; i1++ {
                i32 i2 = i1 + 1 == points_count ? 0 : i1 + 1;
                u32 idx2 = i1 + 1 == points_count ? self._VtxCurrentIdx : idx1 + cast(u32, use_texture != 0 ? 2 : 3);
                f32 dm_x = (temp_normals[i1].x + temp_normals[i2].x) * 0.5f;
                f32 dm_y = (temp_normals[i1].y + temp_normals[i2].y) * 0.5f;
                {
                    f32 d2 = dm_x * dm_x + dm_y * dm_y;
                    if d2 > 1.0e-6f {
                        f32 inv_len2 = 1.0f / d2;
                        if inv_len2 > 100.0f {
                            inv_len2 = 100.0f;
                        }
                        dm_x *= inv_len2;
                        dm_y *= inv_len2;
                    }
                }
                dm_x *= half_draw_size;
                dm_y *= half_draw_size;
                ImVec2* out_vtx = &temp_points[i2 * 2];
                out_vtx[0].x = points[i2].x + dm_x;
                out_vtx[0].y = points[i2].y + dm_y;
                out_vtx[1].x = points[i2].x - dm_x;
                out_vtx[1].y = points[i2].y - dm_y;
                if use_texture != 0 {
                    self._IdxWritePtr[0] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx2 + 0);
                    self._IdxWritePtr[1] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx1 + 0);
                    self._IdxWritePtr[2] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx1 + 1);
                    self._IdxWritePtr[3] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx2 + 1);
                    self._IdxWritePtr[4] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx1 + 1);
                    self._IdxWritePtr[5] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx2 + 0);
                    self._IdxWritePtr += 6;
                } else {
                    self._IdxWritePtr[0] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx2 + 0);
                    self._IdxWritePtr[1] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx1 + 0);
                    self._IdxWritePtr[2] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx1 + 2);
                    self._IdxWritePtr[3] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx1 + 2);
                    self._IdxWritePtr[4] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx2 + 2);
                    self._IdxWritePtr[5] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx2 + 0);
                    self._IdxWritePtr[6] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx2 + 1);
                    self._IdxWritePtr[7] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx1 + 1);
                    self._IdxWritePtr[8] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx1 + 0);
                    self._IdxWritePtr[9] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx1 + 0);
                    self._IdxWritePtr[10] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx2 + 0);
                    self._IdxWritePtr[11] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx2 + 1);
                    self._IdxWritePtr += 12;
                }
                idx1 = idx2;
            }
            if use_texture != 0 {
                ImVec4 tex_uvs = self._Data.TexUvLines[integer_thickness];
                ImVec2 tex_uv0;
                ImVec2_init(&tex_uv0, tex_uvs.x, tex_uvs.y);
                ImVec2 tex_uv1;
                ImVec2_init(&tex_uv1, tex_uvs.z, tex_uvs.w);
                for i32 i = 0; i < points_count; i++ {
                    self._VtxWritePtr[0].pos = temp_points[i * 2 + 0];
                    self._VtxWritePtr[0].uv = tex_uv0;
                    self._VtxWritePtr[0].col = col;
                    self._VtxWritePtr[1].pos = temp_points[i * 2 + 1];
                    self._VtxWritePtr[1].uv = tex_uv1;
                    self._VtxWritePtr[1].col = col;
                    self._VtxWritePtr += 2;
                }
            } else {
                for i32 i = 0; i < points_count; i++ {
                    self._VtxWritePtr[0].pos = points[i];
                    self._VtxWritePtr[0].uv = opaque_uv;
                    self._VtxWritePtr[0].col = col;
                    self._VtxWritePtr[1].pos = temp_points[i * 2 + 0];
                    self._VtxWritePtr[1].uv = opaque_uv;
                    self._VtxWritePtr[1].col = col_trans;
                    self._VtxWritePtr[2].pos = temp_points[i * 2 + 1];
                    self._VtxWritePtr[2].uv = opaque_uv;
                    self._VtxWritePtr[2].col = col_trans;
                    self._VtxWritePtr += 3;
                }
            }
        } else {
            f32 half_inner_thickness = (thickness - AA_SIZE) * 0.5f;
            if closed == 0 {
                i32 points_last = points_count - 1;
                temp_points[0] = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(points[0], op_mul_ImVec2_float(temp_normals[0], half_inner_thickness + AA_SIZE));
                temp_points[1] = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(points[0], op_mul_ImVec2_float(temp_normals[0], half_inner_thickness));
                temp_points[2] = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(points[0], op_mul_ImVec2_float(temp_normals[0], half_inner_thickness));
                temp_points[3] = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(points[0], op_mul_ImVec2_float(temp_normals[0], half_inner_thickness + AA_SIZE));
                temp_points[points_last * 4 + 0] = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(points[points_last], op_mul_ImVec2_float(temp_normals[points_last], half_inner_thickness + AA_SIZE));
                temp_points[points_last * 4 + 1] = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(points[points_last], op_mul_ImVec2_float(temp_normals[points_last], half_inner_thickness));
                temp_points[points_last * 4 + 2] = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(points[points_last], op_mul_ImVec2_float(temp_normals[points_last], half_inner_thickness));
                temp_points[points_last * 4 + 3] = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(points[points_last], op_mul_ImVec2_float(temp_normals[points_last], half_inner_thickness + AA_SIZE));
            }
            u32 idx1 = self._VtxCurrentIdx;
            for i32 i1 = 0; i1 < count; i1++ {
                i32 i2 = i1 + 1 == points_count ? 0 : i1 + 1;
                u32 idx2 = i1 + 1 == points_count ? self._VtxCurrentIdx : idx1 + 4;
                f32 dm_x = (temp_normals[i1].x + temp_normals[i2].x) * 0.5f;
                f32 dm_y = (temp_normals[i1].y + temp_normals[i2].y) * 0.5f;
                {
                    f32 d2 = dm_x * dm_x + dm_y * dm_y;
                    if d2 > 1.0e-6f {
                        f32 inv_len2 = 1.0f / d2;
                        if inv_len2 > 100.0f {
                            inv_len2 = 100.0f;
                        }
                        dm_x *= inv_len2;
                        dm_y *= inv_len2;
                    }
                }
                f32 dm_out_x = dm_x * (half_inner_thickness + AA_SIZE);
                f32 dm_out_y = dm_y * (half_inner_thickness + AA_SIZE);
                f32 dm_in_x = dm_x * half_inner_thickness;
                f32 dm_in_y = dm_y * half_inner_thickness;
                ImVec2* out_vtx = &temp_points[i2 * 4];
                out_vtx[0].x = points[i2].x + dm_out_x;
                out_vtx[0].y = points[i2].y + dm_out_y;
                out_vtx[1].x = points[i2].x + dm_in_x;
                out_vtx[1].y = points[i2].y + dm_in_y;
                out_vtx[2].x = points[i2].x - dm_in_x;
                out_vtx[2].y = points[i2].y - dm_in_y;
                out_vtx[3].x = points[i2].x - dm_out_x;
                out_vtx[3].y = points[i2].y - dm_out_y;
                self._IdxWritePtr[0] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx2 + 1);
                self._IdxWritePtr[1] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx1 + 1);
                self._IdxWritePtr[2] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx1 + 2);
                self._IdxWritePtr[3] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx1 + 2);
                self._IdxWritePtr[4] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx2 + 2);
                self._IdxWritePtr[5] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx2 + 1);
                self._IdxWritePtr[6] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx2 + 1);
                self._IdxWritePtr[7] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx1 + 1);
                self._IdxWritePtr[8] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx1 + 0);
                self._IdxWritePtr[9] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx1 + 0);
                self._IdxWritePtr[10] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx2 + 0);
                self._IdxWritePtr[11] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx2 + 1);
                self._IdxWritePtr[12] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx2 + 2);
                self._IdxWritePtr[13] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx1 + 2);
                self._IdxWritePtr[14] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx1 + 3);
                self._IdxWritePtr[15] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx1 + 3);
                self._IdxWritePtr[16] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx2 + 3);
                self._IdxWritePtr[17] = cast(ImDrawIdx, idx2 + 2);
                self._IdxWritePtr += 18;
                idx1 = idx2;
            }
            for i32 i = 0; i < points_count; i++ {
                self._VtxWritePtr[0].pos = temp_points[i * 4 + 0];
                self._VtxWritePtr[0].uv = opaque_uv;
                self._VtxWritePtr[0].col = col_trans;
                self._VtxWritePtr[1].pos = temp_points[i * 4 + 1];
                self._VtxWritePtr[1].uv = opaque_uv;
                self._VtxWritePtr[1].col = col;
                self._VtxWritePtr[2].pos = temp_points[i * 4 + 2];
                self._VtxWritePtr[2].uv = opaque_uv;
                self._VtxWritePtr[2].col = col;
                self._VtxWritePtr[3].pos = temp_points[i * 4 + 3];
                self._VtxWritePtr[3].uv = opaque_uv;
                self._VtxWritePtr[3].col = col_trans;
                self._VtxWritePtr += 4;
            }
        }
        self._VtxCurrentIdx += cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_count);
    } else {
        i32 idx_count = count * 6;
        i32 vtx_count = count * 4;
        ImDrawList_PrimReserve(self, idx_count, vtx_count);
        for i32 i1 = 0; i1 < count; i1++ {
            i32 i2 = i1 + 1 == points_count ? 0 : i1 + 1;
            ImVec2 p1 = points[i1];
            ImVec2 p2 = points[i2];
            f32 dx = p2.x - p1.x;
            f32 dy = p2.y - p1.y;
            {
                f32 d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
                if d2 > 0.0f {
                    f32 inv_len = ImRsqrt(d2);
                    dx *= inv_len;
                    dy *= inv_len;
                }
            }
            dx *= thickness * 0.5f;
            dy *= thickness * 0.5f;
            self._VtxWritePtr[0].pos.x = p1.x + dy;
            self._VtxWritePtr[0].pos.y = p1.y - dx;
            self._VtxWritePtr[0].uv = opaque_uv;
            self._VtxWritePtr[0].col = col;
            self._VtxWritePtr[1].pos.x = p2.x + dy;
            self._VtxWritePtr[1].pos.y = p2.y - dx;
            self._VtxWritePtr[1].uv = opaque_uv;
            self._VtxWritePtr[1].col = col;
            self._VtxWritePtr[2].pos.x = p2.x - dy;
            self._VtxWritePtr[2].pos.y = p2.y + dx;
            self._VtxWritePtr[2].uv = opaque_uv;
            self._VtxWritePtr[2].col = col;
            self._VtxWritePtr[3].pos.x = p1.x - dy;
            self._VtxWritePtr[3].pos.y = p1.y + dx;
            self._VtxWritePtr[3].uv = opaque_uv;
            self._VtxWritePtr[3].col = col;
            self._VtxWritePtr += 4;
            self._IdxWritePtr[0] = cast(ImDrawIdx, self._VtxCurrentIdx);
            self._IdxWritePtr[1] = cast(ImDrawIdx, self._VtxCurrentIdx + 1);
            self._IdxWritePtr[2] = cast(ImDrawIdx, self._VtxCurrentIdx + 2);
            self._IdxWritePtr[3] = cast(ImDrawIdx, self._VtxCurrentIdx);
            self._IdxWritePtr[4] = cast(ImDrawIdx, self._VtxCurrentIdx + 2);
            self._IdxWritePtr[5] = cast(ImDrawIdx, self._VtxCurrentIdx + 3);
            self._IdxWritePtr += 6;
            self._VtxCurrentIdx += 4;
        }
    }
}

// - We intentionally avoid using ImVec2 and its math operators here to reduce cost to a minimum for debug/non-inlined builds.
// - Filled shapes must always use clockwise winding order. The anti-aliasing fringe depends on it. Counter-clockwise shapes will have "inward" anti-aliasing.
void ImDrawList_AddConvexPolyFilled(ImDrawList* self, ImVec2* points, i32 points_count, ImU32 col) {
    if points_count < 3 || (col & 0xFF000000) == 0 {
        return;
    }
    ImVec2 uv = self._Data.TexUvWhitePixel;
    if (self.Flags & ImDrawListFlags_AntiAliasedFill) != 0 {
        f32 AA_SIZE = self._FringeScale;
        ImU32 col_trans = col & cast(u32, ~0xFF000000);
        i32 idx_count = (points_count - 2) * 3 + points_count * 6;
        i32 vtx_count = points_count * 2;
        ImDrawList_PrimReserve(self, idx_count, vtx_count);
        u32 vtx_inner_idx = self._VtxCurrentIdx;
        u32 vtx_outer_idx = self._VtxCurrentIdx + 1;
        for i32 i = 2; i < points_count; i++ {
            self._IdxWritePtr[0] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_inner_idx);
            self._IdxWritePtr[1] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_inner_idx + cast(u32, i - 1 << 1));
            self._IdxWritePtr[2] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_inner_idx + cast(u32, i << 1));
            self._IdxWritePtr += 3;
        }
        ImVector_ImVec2_reserve_discard(&self._Data.TempBuffer, points_count);
        ImVec2* temp_normals = self._Data.TempBuffer.Data;
        {
            i32 i0 = points_count - 1;
            i32 i1 = 0;
            for ; i1 < points_count; i0 = i1++ {
                ImVec2 p0 = points[i0];
                ImVec2 p1 = points[i1];
                f32 dx = p1.x - p0.x;
                f32 dy = p1.y - p0.y;
                {
                    f32 d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
                    if d2 > 0.0f {
                        f32 inv_len = ImRsqrt(d2);
                        dx *= inv_len;
                        dy *= inv_len;
                    }
                }
                temp_normals[i0].x = dy;
                temp_normals[i0].y = -dx;
            }
        }
        {
            i32 i0 = points_count - 1;
            i32 i1 = 0;
            for ; i1 < points_count; i0 = i1++ {
                ImVec2 n0 = temp_normals[i0];
                ImVec2 n1 = temp_normals[i1];
                f32 dm_x = (n0.x + n1.x) * 0.5f;
                f32 dm_y = (n0.y + n1.y) * 0.5f;
                {
                    f32 d2 = dm_x * dm_x + dm_y * dm_y;
                    if d2 > 1.0e-6f {
                        f32 inv_len2 = 1.0f / d2;
                        if inv_len2 > 100.0f {
                            inv_len2 = 100.0f;
                        }
                        dm_x *= inv_len2;
                        dm_y *= inv_len2;
                    }
                }
                dm_x *= AA_SIZE * 0.5f;
                dm_y *= AA_SIZE * 0.5f;
                self._VtxWritePtr[0].pos.x = points[i1].x - dm_x;
                self._VtxWritePtr[0].pos.y = points[i1].y - dm_y;
                self._VtxWritePtr[0].uv = uv;
                self._VtxWritePtr[0].col = col;
                self._VtxWritePtr[1].pos.x = points[i1].x + dm_x;
                self._VtxWritePtr[1].pos.y = points[i1].y + dm_y;
                self._VtxWritePtr[1].uv = uv;
                self._VtxWritePtr[1].col = col_trans;
                self._VtxWritePtr += 2;
                self._IdxWritePtr[0] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_inner_idx + cast(u32, i1 << 1));
                self._IdxWritePtr[1] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_inner_idx + cast(u32, i0 << 1));
                self._IdxWritePtr[2] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_outer_idx + cast(u32, i0 << 1));
                self._IdxWritePtr[3] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_outer_idx + cast(u32, i0 << 1));
                self._IdxWritePtr[4] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_outer_idx + cast(u32, i1 << 1));
                self._IdxWritePtr[5] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_inner_idx + cast(u32, i1 << 1));
                self._IdxWritePtr += 6;
            }
        }
        self._VtxCurrentIdx += cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_count);
    } else {
        i32 idx_count = (points_count - 2) * 3;
        i32 vtx_count = points_count;
        ImDrawList_PrimReserve(self, idx_count, vtx_count);
        for i32 i = 0; i < vtx_count; i++ {
            self._VtxWritePtr[0].pos = points[i];
            self._VtxWritePtr[0].uv = uv;
            self._VtxWritePtr[0].col = col;
            self._VtxWritePtr++;
        }
        for i32 i = 2; i < points_count; i++ {
            self._IdxWritePtr[0] = cast(ImDrawIdx, self._VtxCurrentIdx);
            self._IdxWritePtr[1] = cast(ImDrawIdx, self._VtxCurrentIdx + cast(u32, i) - 1);
            self._IdxWritePtr[2] = cast(ImDrawIdx, self._VtxCurrentIdx + cast(u32, i));
            self._IdxWritePtr += 3;
        }
        self._VtxCurrentIdx += cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_count);
    }
}

void ImDrawList__PathArcToFastEx(ImDrawList* self, ImVec2 center, f32 radius, i32 a_min_sample, i32 a_max_sample, i32 a_step) {
    if radius < 0.5f {
        ImVector_ImVec2_push_back(&self._Path, center);
        return;
    }
    if a_step <= 0 {
        a_step = 48 / ImDrawList__CalcCircleAutoSegmentCount(self, radius);
    }
    a_step = ImClamp(a_step, 1, 48 / 4);
    i32 sample_range = ImAbs(a_max_sample - a_min_sample);
    i32 a_next_step = a_step;
    i32 samples = sample_range + 1;
    bool extra_max_sample = false;
    if a_step > 1 {
        samples = sample_range / a_step + 1;
        i32 overstep = sample_range % a_step;
        if overstep > 0 {
            extra_max_sample = true;
            samples++;
            if sample_range > 0 {
                a_step -= (a_step - overstep) / 2;
            }
        }
    }
    ImVector_ImVec2_resize(&self._Path, self._Path.Size + samples);
    ImVec2* out_ptr = self._Path.Data + (self._Path.Size - samples);
    i32 sample_index = a_min_sample;
    if sample_index < 0 || sample_index >= 48 {
        sample_index = sample_index % 48;
        if sample_index < 0 {
            sample_index += 48;
        }
    }
    if a_max_sample >= a_min_sample {
        for i32 a = a_min_sample; a <= a_max_sample; a += a_step {
            if sample_index >= 48 {
                sample_index -= 48;
            }
            ImVec2 s = self._Data.ArcFastVtx[sample_index];
            out_ptr.x = center.x + s.x * radius;
            out_ptr.y = center.y + s.y * radius;
            out_ptr++;
            sample_index += a_step;
            a_step = a_next_step;
        }
    } else {
        for i32 a = a_min_sample; a >= a_max_sample; a -= a_step {
            if sample_index < 0 {
                sample_index += 48;
            }
            ImVec2 s = self._Data.ArcFastVtx[sample_index];
            out_ptr.x = center.x + s.x * radius;
            out_ptr.y = center.y + s.y * radius;
            out_ptr++;
            sample_index -= a_step;
            a_step = a_next_step;
        }
    }
    if extra_max_sample != 0 {
        i32 normalized_max_sample = a_max_sample % 48;
        if normalized_max_sample < 0 {
            normalized_max_sample += 48;
        }
        ImVec2 s = self._Data.ArcFastVtx[normalized_max_sample];
        out_ptr.x = center.x + s.x * radius;
        out_ptr.y = center.y + s.y * radius;
        out_ptr++;
    }
}

void ImDrawList__PathArcToN(ImDrawList* self, ImVec2 center, f32 radius, f32 a_min, f32 a_max, i32 num_segments) {
    if radius < 0.5f {
        ImVector_ImVec2_push_back(&self._Path, center);
        return;
    }
    ImVector_ImVec2_reserve(&self._Path, self._Path.Size + (num_segments + 1));
    for i32 i = 0; i <= num_segments; i++ {
        f32 a = a_min + cast(f32, i) / cast(f32, num_segments) * (a_max - a_min);
        ImVector_ImVec2_push_back(&self._Path, ImVec2{center.x + cos(a) * radius, center.y + sin(a) * radius});
    }
}

// 0: East, 3: South, 6: West, 9: North, 12: East
void ImDrawList_PathArcToFast(ImDrawList* self, ImVec2 center, f32 radius, i32 a_min_of_12, i32 a_max_of_12) {
    if radius < 0.5f {
        ImVector_ImVec2_push_back(&self._Path, center);
        return;
    }
    ImDrawList__PathArcToFastEx(self, center, radius, a_min_of_12 * 48 / 12, a_max_of_12 * 48 / 12, 0);
}

void ImDrawList_PathArcTo(ImDrawList* self, ImVec2 center, f32 radius, f32 a_min, f32 a_max, i32 num_segments) {
    if radius < 0.5f {
        ImVector_ImVec2_push_back(&self._Path, center);
        return;
    }
    if num_segments > 0 {
        ImDrawList__PathArcToN(self, center, radius, a_min, a_max, num_segments);
        return;
    }
    if radius <= self._Data.ArcFastRadiusCutoff {
        bool a_is_reverse = a_max < a_min;
        f32 a_min_sample_f = 48.0f * a_min / (3.141592653589793f * 2.0f);
        f32 a_max_sample_f = 48.0f * a_max / (3.141592653589793f * 2.0f);
        i32 a_min_sample = a_is_reverse != 0 ? cast(i32, ImFloor(a_min_sample_f)) : cast(i32, ceil(a_min_sample_f));
        i32 a_max_sample = a_is_reverse != 0 ? cast(i32, ceil(a_max_sample_f)) : cast(i32, ImFloor(a_max_sample_f));
        i32 a_mid_samples = a_is_reverse != 0 ? ImMax(a_min_sample - a_max_sample, 0) : ImMax(a_max_sample - a_min_sample, 0);
        f32 a_min_segment_angle = cast(f32, a_min_sample) * 3.141592653589793f * 2.0f / 48.0f;
        f32 a_max_segment_angle = cast(f32, a_max_sample) * 3.141592653589793f * 2.0f / 48.0f;
        bool a_emit_start = ImAbs(a_min_segment_angle - a_min) >= 1.0e-5f;
        bool a_emit_end = ImAbs(a_max - a_max_segment_angle) >= 1.0e-5f;
        ImVector_ImVec2_reserve(&self._Path, self._Path.Size + (a_mid_samples + 1 + (a_emit_start != 0 ? 1 : 0) + (a_emit_end != 0 ? 1 : 0)));
        if a_emit_start != 0 {
            ImVector_ImVec2_push_back(&self._Path, ImVec2{
                center.x + cos(a_min) * radius, center.y + sin(a_min) * radius,
            });
        }
        if a_mid_samples > 0 {
            ImDrawList__PathArcToFastEx(self, center, radius, a_min_sample, a_max_sample, 0);
        }
        if a_emit_end != 0 {
            ImVector_ImVec2_push_back(&self._Path, ImVec2{
                center.x + cos(a_max) * radius, center.y + sin(a_max) * radius,
            });
        }
    } else {
        f32 arc_length = ImAbs(a_max - a_min);
        i32 circle_segment_count = ImDrawList__CalcCircleAutoSegmentCount(self, radius);
        i32 arc_segment_count = ImMax(cast(i32, ceil(cast(f32, circle_segment_count) * arc_length / (3.141592653589793f * 2.0f))), 1);
        ImDrawList__PathArcToN(self, center, radius, a_min, a_max, arc_segment_count);
    }
}

void ImDrawList_PathEllipticalArcTo(ImDrawList* self, ImVec2 center, ImVec2 radius, f32 rot, f32 a_min, f32 a_max, i32 num_segments) {
    if num_segments <= 0 {
        num_segments = ImDrawList__CalcCircleAutoSegmentCount(self, ImMax(radius.x, radius.y));
    }
    ImVector_ImVec2_reserve(&self._Path, self._Path.Size + (num_segments + 1));
    f32 cos_rot = cos(rot);
    f32 sin_rot = sin(rot);
    for i32 i = 0; i <= num_segments; i++ {
        f32 a = a_min + cast(f32, i) / cast(f32, num_segments) * (a_max - a_min);
        ImVec2 point;
        ImVec2_init(&point, cos(a) * radius.x, sin(a) * radius.y);
        ImVec2 rel;
        ImVec2_init(&rel, point.x * cos_rot - point.y * sin_rot, point.x * sin_rot + point.y * cos_rot);
        point.x = rel.x + center.x;
        point.y = rel.y + center.y;
        ImVector_ImVec2_push_back(&self._Path, point);
    }
}

ImVec2 ImBezierCubicCalc(ImVec2 p1, ImVec2 p2, ImVec2 p3, ImVec2 p4, f32 t) {
    f32 u = 1.0f - t;
    f32 w1 = u * u * u;
    f32 w2 = 3.0f * u * u * t;
    f32 w3 = 3.0f * u * t * t;
    f32 w4 = t * t * t;
    return ImVec2{
        w1 * p1.x + w2 * p2.x + w3 * p3.x + w4 * p4.x,
        w1 * p1.y + w2 * p2.y + w3 * p3.y + w4 * p4.y,
    };
}

ImVec2 ImBezierQuadraticCalc(ImVec2 p1, ImVec2 p2, ImVec2 p3, f32 t) {
    f32 u = 1.0f - t;
    f32 w1 = u * u;
    f32 w2 = 2.0f * u * t;
    f32 w3 = t * t;
    return ImVec2{w1 * p1.x + w2 * p2.x + w3 * p3.x, w1 * p1.y + w2 * p2.y + w3 * p3.y};
}

// Closely mimics ImBezierCubicClosestPointCasteljau() in imgui.cpp
private {
void PathBezierCubicCurveToCasteljau(ImVector_ImVec2* path, f32 x1, f32 y1, f32 x2, f32 y2, f32 x3, f32 y3, f32 x4, f32 y4, f32 tess_tol, i32 level) {
    f32 dx = x4 - x1;
    f32 dy = y4 - y1;
    f32 d2 = (x2 - x4) * dy - (y2 - y4) * dx;
    f32 d3 = (x3 - x4) * dy - (y3 - y4) * dx;
    d2 = d2 >= 0.0f ? d2 : -d2;
    d3 = d3 >= 0.0f ? d3 : -d3;
    if (d2 + d3) * (d2 + d3) < tess_tol * (dx * dx + dy * dy) {
        ImVector_ImVec2_push_back(path, ImVec2{x4, y4});
    } else if level < 10 {
        f32 x12 = (x1 + x2) * 0.5f;
        f32 y12 = (y1 + y2) * 0.5f;
        f32 x23 = (x2 + x3) * 0.5f;
        f32 y23 = (y2 + y3) * 0.5f;
        f32 x34 = (x3 + x4) * 0.5f;
        f32 y34 = (y3 + y4) * 0.5f;
        f32 x123 = (x12 + x23) * 0.5f;
        f32 y123 = (y12 + y23) * 0.5f;
        f32 x234 = (x23 + x34) * 0.5f;
        f32 y234 = (y23 + y34) * 0.5f;
        f32 x1234 = (x123 + x234) * 0.5f;
        f32 y1234 = (y123 + y234) * 0.5f;
        PathBezierCubicCurveToCasteljau(path, x1, y1, x12, y12, x123, y123, x1234, y1234, tess_tol, level + 1);
        PathBezierCubicCurveToCasteljau(path, x1234, y1234, x234, y234, x34, y34, x4, y4, tess_tol, level + 1);
    }
}

void PathBezierQuadraticCurveToCasteljau(ImVector_ImVec2* path, f32 x1, f32 y1, f32 x2, f32 y2, f32 x3, f32 y3, f32 tess_tol, i32 level) {
    f32 dx = x3 - x1;
    f32 dy = y3 - y1;
    f32 det = (x2 - x3) * dy - (y2 - y3) * dx;
    if det * det * 4.0f < tess_tol * (dx * dx + dy * dy) {
        ImVector_ImVec2_push_back(path, ImVec2{x3, y3});
    } else if level < 10 {
        f32 x12 = (x1 + x2) * 0.5f;
        f32 y12 = (y1 + y2) * 0.5f;
        f32 x23 = (x2 + x3) * 0.5f;
        f32 y23 = (y2 + y3) * 0.5f;
        f32 x123 = (x12 + x23) * 0.5f;
        f32 y123 = (y12 + y23) * 0.5f;
        PathBezierQuadraticCurveToCasteljau(path, x1, y1, x12, y12, x123, y123, tess_tol, level + 1);
        PathBezierQuadraticCurveToCasteljau(path, x123, y123, x23, y23, x3, y3, tess_tol, level + 1);
    }
}
}

void ImDrawList_PathBezierCubicCurveTo(ImDrawList* self, ImVec2 p2, ImVec2 p3, ImVec2 p4, i32 num_segments) {
    ImVec2 p1 = *ImVector_ImVec2_back(&self._Path);
    if num_segments == 0 {
        assert(self._Data.CurveTessellationTol > 0.0f);
        PathBezierCubicCurveToCasteljau(&self._Path, p1.x, p1.y, p2.x, p2.y, p3.x, p3.y, p4.x, p4.y, self._Data.CurveTessellationTol, 0);
    } else {
        f32 t_step = 1.0f / cast(f32, num_segments);
        for i32 i_step = 1; i_step <= num_segments; i_step++ {
            ImVector_ImVec2_push_back(&self._Path, ImBezierCubicCalc(p1, p2, p3, p4, t_step * cast(f32, i_step)));
        }
    }
}

void ImDrawList_PathBezierQuadraticCurveTo(ImDrawList* self, ImVec2 p2, ImVec2 p3, i32 num_segments) {
    ImVec2 p1 = *ImVector_ImVec2_back(&self._Path);
    if num_segments == 0 {
        assert(self._Data.CurveTessellationTol > 0.0f);
        PathBezierQuadraticCurveToCasteljau(&self._Path, p1.x, p1.y, p2.x, p2.y, p3.x, p3.y, self._Data.CurveTessellationTol, 0);
    } else {
        f32 t_step = 1.0f / cast(f32, num_segments);
        for i32 i_step = 1; i_step <= num_segments; i_step++ {
            ImVector_ImVec2_push_back(&self._Path, ImBezierQuadraticCalc(p1, p2, p3, t_step * cast(f32, i_step)));
        }
    }
}

void ImDrawList_PathRect(ImDrawList* self, ImVec2 a, ImVec2 b, f32 rounding, ImDrawFlags flags) {
    if rounding >= 0.5f {
        if (flags & ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersMask_) == 0 {
            flags |= ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersAll;
        }
        rounding = ImMin(rounding, fabs(b.x - a.x) * ((flags & ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersTop) == ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersTop || (flags & ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersBottom) == ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersBottom ? 0.5f : 1.0f) - 1.0f);
        rounding = ImMin(rounding, fabs(b.y - a.y) * ((flags & ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersLeft) == ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersLeft || (flags & ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersRight) == ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersRight ? 0.5f : 1.0f) - 1.0f);
    }
    if rounding < 0.5f || (flags & ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersMask_) == ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersNone {
        ImDrawList_PathLineTo(self, a);
        ImDrawList_PathLineTo(self, ImVec2{b.x, a.y});
        ImDrawList_PathLineTo(self, b);
        ImDrawList_PathLineTo(self, ImVec2{a.x, b.y});
    } else {
        f32 rounding_tl = (flags & ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersTopLeft) != 0 ? rounding : 0.0f;
        f32 rounding_tr = (flags & ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersTopRight) != 0 ? rounding : 0.0f;
        f32 rounding_br = (flags & ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersBottomRight) != 0 ? rounding : 0.0f;
        f32 rounding_bl = (flags & ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersBottomLeft) != 0 ? rounding : 0.0f;
        ImDrawList_PathArcToFast(self, ImVec2{a.x + rounding_tl, a.y + rounding_tl}, rounding_tl, 6, 9);
        ImDrawList_PathArcToFast(self, ImVec2{b.x - rounding_tr, a.y + rounding_tr}, rounding_tr, 9, 12);
        ImDrawList_PathArcToFast(self, ImVec2{b.x - rounding_br, b.y - rounding_br}, rounding_br, 0, 3);
        ImDrawList_PathArcToFast(self, ImVec2{a.x + rounding_bl, b.y - rounding_bl}, rounding_bl, 3, 6);
    }
}

void ImDrawList_AddLine(ImDrawList* self, ImVec2 p1, ImVec2 p2, ImU32 col, f32 thickness) {
    if (col & 0xFF000000) == 0 {
        return;
    }
    ImVec2[2] points = {ImVec2{p1.x + 0.5f, p1.y + 0.5f}, ImVec2{p2.x + 0.5f, p2.y + 0.5f}};
    ImDrawList_AddPolyline(self, points, 2, col, thickness, 0);
}

// p_min = upper-left, p_max = lower-right
// Note we don't render 1 pixels sized rectangles properly.
void ImDrawList_AddRect(ImDrawList* self, ImVec2 p_min, ImVec2 p_max, ImU32 col, f32 rounding, f32 thickness, ImDrawFlags flags) {
    while true {
        if (flags & ImDrawFlags_InvalidMask_) == 0 == 0 {
            if ImGui_ErrorLog("Incorrect parameter. Did you swap 'thickness' and 'flags'?") != 0 {
                assert((flags & ImDrawFlags_InvalidMask_) == 0 && "Incorrect parameter. Did you swap 'thickness' and 'flags'?");
            }
            return;
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    if (col & 0xFF000000) == 0 {
        return;
    }
    if (self.Flags & ImDrawListFlags_AntiAliasedLines) != 0 {
        ImDrawList_PathRect(self, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(p_min, ImVec2{0.5f, 0.5f}), op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(p_max, ImVec2{0.5f, 0.5f}), rounding, flags);
    } else {
        ImDrawList_PathRect(self, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(p_min, ImVec2{0.5f, 0.5f}), op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(p_max, ImVec2{0.49f, 0.49f}), rounding, flags);
    }
    ImDrawList_PathStroke(self, col, thickness, ImDrawFlags_Closed);
}

void ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(ImDrawList* self, ImVec2 p_min, ImVec2 p_max, ImU32 col, f32 rounding, ImDrawFlags flags) {
    if (col & 0xFF000000) == 0 {
        return;
    }
    if rounding < 0.5f || (flags & ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersMask_) == ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersNone {
        ImDrawList_PrimReserve(self, 6, 4);
        ImDrawList_PrimRect(self, p_min, p_max, col);
    } else {
        ImDrawList_PathRect(self, p_min, p_max, rounding, flags);
        ImDrawList_PathFillConvex(self, col);
    }
}

// p_min = upper-left, p_max = lower-right
void ImDrawList_AddRectFilledMultiColor(ImDrawList* self, ImVec2 p_min, ImVec2 p_max, ImU32 col_upr_left, ImU32 col_upr_right, ImU32 col_bot_right, ImU32 col_bot_left) {
    if ((col_upr_left | col_upr_right | col_bot_right | col_bot_left) & 0xFF000000) == 0 {
        return;
    }
    ImVec2 uv = self._Data.TexUvWhitePixel;
    ImDrawList_PrimReserve(self, 6, 4);
    ImDrawList_PrimWriteIdx(self, cast(ImDrawIdx, self._VtxCurrentIdx));
    ImDrawList_PrimWriteIdx(self, cast(ImDrawIdx, self._VtxCurrentIdx + 1));
    ImDrawList_PrimWriteIdx(self, cast(ImDrawIdx, self._VtxCurrentIdx + 2));
    ImDrawList_PrimWriteIdx(self, cast(ImDrawIdx, self._VtxCurrentIdx));
    ImDrawList_PrimWriteIdx(self, cast(ImDrawIdx, self._VtxCurrentIdx + 2));
    ImDrawList_PrimWriteIdx(self, cast(ImDrawIdx, self._VtxCurrentIdx + 3));
    ImDrawList_PrimWriteVtx(self, p_min, uv, col_upr_left);
    ImDrawList_PrimWriteVtx(self, ImVec2{p_max.x, p_min.y}, uv, col_upr_right);
    ImDrawList_PrimWriteVtx(self, p_max, uv, col_bot_right);
    ImDrawList_PrimWriteVtx(self, ImVec2{p_min.x, p_max.y}, uv, col_bot_left);
}

void ImDrawList_AddQuad(ImDrawList* self, ImVec2 p1, ImVec2 p2, ImVec2 p3, ImVec2 p4, ImU32 col, f32 thickness) {
    if (col & 0xFF000000) == 0 {
        return;
    }
    ImDrawList_PathLineTo(self, p1);
    ImDrawList_PathLineTo(self, p2);
    ImDrawList_PathLineTo(self, p3);
    ImDrawList_PathLineTo(self, p4);

        clip_rect.z = ImMin(clip_rect.z, cpu_fine_clip_rect.z);
        clip_rect.w = ImMin(clip_rect.w, cpu_fine_clip_rect.w);

    ImFont_RenderText(font, self, font_size, pos, col, clip_rect, text_begin, text_end, wrap_width, cpu_fine_clip_rect != null ? ImDrawTextFlags_CpuFineClip : ImDrawTextFlags_None);

void ImDrawList_AddImageRounded(ImDrawList* self, ImTextureRef tex_ref, ImVec2 p_min, ImVec2 p_max, ImVec2 uv_min, ImVec2 uv_max, ImU32 col, f32 rounding, ImDrawFlags flags) {
    if (col & 0xFF000000) == 0 {
        return;
    }
    assert((flags & 0x0F) == 0 && "Misuse of legacy hardcoded ImDrawCornerFlags values!");
    if (flags & ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersMask_) == 0 {
        flags |= ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersAll;
    }
    if rounding < 0.5f || (flags & ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersMask_) == ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersNone {
        ImDrawList_AddImage(self, tex_ref, p_min, p_max, uv_min, uv_max, col);
        return;
    }
    bool push_texture_id = op_ne_ImTextureRef_ImTextureRef(tex_ref, self._CmdHeader.TexRef);
    if push_texture_id != 0 {
        ImDrawList_PushTexture(self, tex_ref);
    }
    i32 vert_start_idx = self.VtxBuffer.Size;
    ImDrawList_PathRect(self, p_min, p_max, rounding, flags);
    ImDrawList_PathFillConvex(self, col);
    i32 vert_end_idx = self.VtxBuffer.Size;
    ImGui_ShadeVertsLinearUV(self, vert_start_idx, vert_end_idx, p_min, p_max, uv_min, uv_max, true);
    if push_texture_id != 0 {
        ImDrawList_PopTexture(self);
    }
}

void ImTriangulatorNode_Unlink(ImTriangulatorNode* self) {
    self.Next.Prev = self.Prev;
    self.Prev.Next = self.Next;
}

void ImTriangulatorNodeSpan_push_back(ImTriangulatorNodeSpan* self, ImTriangulatorNode* node) {
    self.Data[self.Size++] = node;
}

void ImTriangulatorNodeSpan_find_erase_unsorted(ImTriangulatorNodeSpan* self, i32 idx) {
    for i32 i = self.Size - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
        if self.Data[i].Index == idx {
            self.Data[i] = self.Data[self.Size - 1];
            self.Size--;
            return;
        }
    }
}

i32 ImTriangulator_EstimateTriangleCount(i32 points_count) {
    return points_count < 3 ? 0 : points_count - 2;
}

i32 ImTriangulator_EstimateScratchBufferSize(i32 points_count) {
    return cast(i32, sizeof(ImTriangulatorNode) * points_count + sizeof(ImTriangulatorNode*) * points_count * 2);
}

// Distribute storage for nodes, ears and reflexes.
// FIXME-OPT: if everything is convex, we could report it to caller and let it switch to an convex renderer
// (this would require first building reflexes to bail to convex if empty, without even building nodes)
void ImTriangulator_Init(ImTriangulator* self, ImVec2* points, i32 points_count, void* scratch_buffer) {
    assert(scratch_buffer != null && points_count >= 3);
    self._TrianglesLeft = ImTriangulator_EstimateTriangleCount(points_count);
    self._Nodes = cast(ImTriangulatorNode*, scratch_buffer);
    self._Ears.Data = cast(ImTriangulatorNode**, self._Nodes + points_count);
    self._Reflexes.Data = cast(ImTriangulatorNode**, self._Nodes + points_count) + points_count;
    ImTriangulator_BuildNodes(self, points, points_count);
    ImTriangulator_BuildReflexes(self);
    ImTriangulator_BuildEars(self);
}

void ImTriangulator_BuildNodes(ImTriangulator* self, ImVec2* points, i32 points_count) {
    for i32 i = 0; i < points_count; i++ {
        self._Nodes[i].Type = ImTriangulatorNodeType_Convex;
        self._Nodes[i].Index = i;
        self._Nodes[i].Pos = points[i];
        self._Nodes[i].Next = self._Nodes + i + 1;
        self._Nodes[i].Prev = self._Nodes + i - 1;
    }
    self._Nodes[0].Prev = self._Nodes + points_count - 1;
    self._Nodes[points_count - 1].Next = self._Nodes;
}

void ImTriangulator_BuildReflexes(ImTriangulator* self) {
    ImTriangulatorNode* n1 = self._Nodes;
    for i32 i = self._TrianglesLeft; i >= 0; i-- {
        if ImTriangleIsClockwise(n1.Prev.Pos, n1.Pos, n1.Next.Pos) != 0 {
            n1 = n1.Next;
            continue;
        }
        n1.Type = ImTriangulatorNodeType_Reflex;
        ImTriangulatorNodeSpan_push_back(&self._Reflexes, n1);
        n1 = n1.Next;
    }
}

void ImTriangulator_BuildEars(ImTriangulator* self) {
    ImTriangulatorNode* n1 = self._Nodes;
    for i32 i = self._TrianglesLeft; i >= 0; i-- {
        if n1.Type != ImTriangulatorNodeType_Convex {
            n1 = n1.Next;
            continue;
        }
        if ImTriangulator_IsEar(self, n1.Prev.Index, n1.Index, n1.Next.Index, n1.Prev.Pos, n1.Pos, n1.Next.Pos) == 0 {
            n1 = n1.Next;
            continue;
        }
        n1.Type = ImTriangulatorNodeType_Ear;
        ImTriangulatorNodeSpan_push_back(&self._Ears, n1);
        n1 = n1.Next;
    }
}

void ImTriangulator_GetNextTriangle(ImTriangulator* self, u32* out_triangle) {
    if self._Ears.Size == 0 {
        ImTriangulator_FlipNodeList(self);
        ImTriangulatorNode* node = self._Nodes;
        for i32 i = self._TrianglesLeft; i >= 0; i-- {
            node.Type = ImTriangulatorNodeType_Convex;
            node = node.Next;
        }
        self._Reflexes.Size = 0;
        ImTriangulator_BuildReflexes(self);
        ImTriangulator_BuildEars(self);
        if self._Ears.Size == 0 {
            assert(self._TrianglesLeft > 0);
            self._Ears.Data[0] = self._Nodes;
            self._Ears.Size = 1;
        }
    }
    ImTriangulatorNode* ear = self._Ears.Data[--self._Ears.Size];
    out_triangle[0] = cast(u32, ear.Prev.Index);
    out_triangle[1] = cast(u32, ear.Index);
    out_triangle[2] = cast(u32, ear.Next.Index);
    ImTriangulatorNode_Unlink(ear);
    if ear == self._Nodes {
        self._Nodes = ear.Next;
    }
    ImTriangulator_ReclassifyNode(self, ear.Prev);
    ImTriangulator_ReclassifyNode(self, ear.Next);
    self._TrianglesLeft--;
}

void ImTriangulator_FlipNodeList(ImTriangulator* self) {
    ImTriangulatorNode* prev = self._Nodes;
    ImTriangulatorNode* temp = self._Nodes;
    ImTriangulatorNode* current = self._Nodes.Next;
    prev.Next = prev;
    prev.Prev = prev;
    while current != self._Nodes {
        temp = current.Next;
        current.Next = prev;
        prev.Prev = current;
        self._Nodes.Next = current;
        current.Prev = self._Nodes;
        prev = current;
        current = temp;
    }
    self._Nodes = prev;
}

// A triangle is an ear is no other vertex is inside it. We can test reflexes vertices only (see reference algorithm)
bool ImTriangulator_IsEar(ImTriangulator* self, i32 i0, i32 i1, i32 i2, ImVec2 v0, ImVec2 v1, ImVec2 v2) {
    ImTriangulatorNode** p_end = self._Reflexes.Data + self._Reflexes.Size;
    for ImTriangulatorNode** p = self._Reflexes.Data; p < p_end; p++ {
        ImTriangulatorNode* reflex = *p;
        if reflex.Index != i0 && reflex.Index != i1 && reflex.Index != i2 {
            if ImTriangleContainsPoint(v0, v1, v2, reflex.Pos) != 0 {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    return true;
}

void ImTriangulator_ReclassifyNode(ImTriangulator* self, ImTriangulatorNode* n1) {
    ImTriangulatorNodeType type;
    ImTriangulatorNode* n0 = n1.Prev;
    ImTriangulatorNode* n2 = n1.Next;
    if ImTriangleIsClockwise(n0.Pos, n1.Pos, n2.Pos) == 0 {
        type = ImTriangulatorNodeType_Reflex;
    } else if ImTriangulator_IsEar(self, n0.Index, n1.Index, n2.Index, n0.Pos, n1.Pos, n2.Pos) != 0 {
        type = ImTriangulatorNodeType_Ear;
    } else {
        type = ImTriangulatorNodeType_Convex;
    }
    if type == n1.Type {
        return;
    }
    if n1.Type == ImTriangulatorNodeType_Reflex {
        ImTriangulatorNodeSpan_find_erase_unsorted(&self._Reflexes, n1.Index);
    } else if n1.Type == ImTriangulatorNodeType_Ear {
        ImTriangulatorNodeSpan_find_erase_unsorted(&self._Ears, n1.Index);
    }
    if type == ImTriangulatorNodeType_Reflex {
        ImTriangulatorNodeSpan_push_back(&self._Reflexes, n1);
    } else if type == ImTriangulatorNodeType_Ear {
        ImTriangulatorNodeSpan_push_back(&self._Ears, n1);
    }
    n1.Type = type;
}

// Use ear-clipping algorithm to triangulate a simple polygon (no self-interaction, no holes).
// (Reminder: we don't perform any coarse clipping/culling in ImDrawList layer!
// It is up to caller to ensure not making costly calls that will be outside of visible area.
// As concave fill is noticeably more expensive than other primitives, be mindful of this...
// Caller can build AABB of points, and avoid filling if 'draw_list->_CmdHeader.ClipRect.Overlays(points_bb) == false')
void ImDrawList_AddConcavePolyFilled(ImDrawList* self, ImVec2* points, i32 points_count, ImU32 col) {
    if points_count < 3 || (col & 0xFF000000) == 0 {
        return;
    }
    ImVec2 uv = self._Data.TexUvWhitePixel;
    ImTriangulator triangulator;
    u32[3] triangle;
    if (self.Flags & ImDrawListFlags_AntiAliasedFill) != 0 {
        f32 AA_SIZE = self._FringeScale;
        ImU32 col_trans = col & cast(u32, ~0xFF000000);
        i32 idx_count = (points_count - 2) * 3 + points_count * 6;
        i32 vtx_count = points_count * 2;
        ImDrawList_PrimReserve(self, idx_count, vtx_count);
        u32 vtx_inner_idx = self._VtxCurrentIdx;
        u32 vtx_outer_idx = self._VtxCurrentIdx + 1;
        ImVector_ImVec2_reserve_discard(&self._Data.TempBuffer, cast(i32, (ImTriangulator_EstimateScratchBufferSize(points_count) + sizeof(ImVec2)) / sizeof(ImVec2)));
        ImTriangulator_Init(&triangulator, points, points_count, self._Data.TempBuffer.Data);
        while triangulator._TrianglesLeft > 0 {
            ImTriangulator_GetNextTriangle(&triangulator, triangle);
            self._IdxWritePtr[0] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_inner_idx + (triangle[0] << 1));
            self._IdxWritePtr[1] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_inner_idx + (triangle[1] << 1));
            self._IdxWritePtr[2] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_inner_idx + (triangle[2] << 1));
            self._IdxWritePtr += 3;
        }
        ImVector_ImVec2_reserve_discard(&self._Data.TempBuffer, points_count);
        ImVec2* temp_normals = self._Data.TempBuffer.Data;
        {
            i32 i0 = points_count - 1;
            i32 i1 = 0;
            for ; i1 < points_count; i0 = i1++ {
                ImVec2 p0 = points[i0];
                ImVec2 p1 = points[i1];
                f32 dx = p1.x - p0.x;
                f32 dy = p1.y - p0.y;
                {
                    f32 d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
                    if d2 > 0.0f {
                        f32 inv_len = ImRsqrt(d2);
                        dx *= inv_len;
                        dy *= inv_len;
                    }
                }
                temp_normals[i0].x = dy;
                temp_normals[i0].y = -dx;
            }
        }
        {
            i32 i0 = points_count - 1;
            i32 i1 = 0;
            for ; i1 < points_count; i0 = i1++ {
                ImVec2 n0 = temp_normals[i0];
                ImVec2 n1 = temp_normals[i1];
                f32 dm_x = (n0.x + n1.x) * 0.5f;
                f32 dm_y = (n0.y + n1.y) * 0.5f;
                {
                    f32 d2 = dm_x * dm_x + dm_y * dm_y;
                    if d2 > 1.0e-6f {
                        f32 inv_len2 = 1.0f / d2;
                        if inv_len2 > 100.0f {
                            inv_len2 = 100.0f;
                        }
                        dm_x *= inv_len2;
                        dm_y *= inv_len2;
                    }
                }
                dm_x *= AA_SIZE * 0.5f;
                dm_y *= AA_SIZE * 0.5f;
                self._VtxWritePtr[0].pos.x = points[i1].x - dm_x;
                self._VtxWritePtr[0].pos.y = points[i1].y - dm_y;
                self._VtxWritePtr[0].uv = uv;
                self._VtxWritePtr[0].col = col;
                self._VtxWritePtr[1].pos.x = points[i1].x + dm_x;
                self._VtxWritePtr[1].pos.y = points[i1].y + dm_y;
                self._VtxWritePtr[1].uv = uv;
                self._VtxWritePtr[1].col = col_trans;
                self._VtxWritePtr += 2;
                self._IdxWritePtr[0] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_inner_idx + cast(u32, i1 << 1));
                self._IdxWritePtr[1] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_inner_idx + cast(u32, i0 << 1));
                self._IdxWritePtr[2] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_outer_idx + cast(u32, i0 << 1));
                self._IdxWritePtr[3] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_outer_idx + cast(u32, i0 << 1));
                self._IdxWritePtr[4] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_outer_idx + cast(u32, i1 << 1));
                self._IdxWritePtr[5] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_inner_idx + cast(u32, i1 << 1));
                self._IdxWritePtr += 6;
            }
        }
        self._VtxCurrentIdx += cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_count);
    } else {
        i32 idx_count = (points_count - 2) * 3;
        i32 vtx_count = points_count;
        ImDrawList_PrimReserve(self, idx_count, vtx_count);
        for i32 i = 0; i < vtx_count; i++ {
            self._VtxWritePtr[0].pos = points[i];
            self._VtxWritePtr[0].uv = uv;
            self._VtxWritePtr[0].col = col;
            self._VtxWritePtr++;
        }
        ImVector_ImVec2_reserve_discard(&self._Data.TempBuffer, cast(i32, (ImTriangulator_EstimateScratchBufferSize(points_count) + sizeof(ImVec2)) / sizeof(ImVec2)));
        ImTriangulator_Init(&triangulator, points, points_count, self._Data.TempBuffer.Data);
        while triangulator._TrianglesLeft > 0 {
            ImTriangulator_GetNextTriangle(&triangulator, triangle);
            self._IdxWritePtr[0] = cast(ImDrawIdx, self._VtxCurrentIdx + triangle[0]);
            self._IdxWritePtr[1] = cast(ImDrawIdx, self._VtxCurrentIdx + triangle[1]);
            self._IdxWritePtr[2] = cast(ImDrawIdx, self._VtxCurrentIdx + triangle[2]);
            self._IdxWritePtr += 3;
        }
        self._VtxCurrentIdx += cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_count);
    }
}

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// [SECTION] ImDrawListSplitter
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// FIXME: This may be a little confusing, trying to be a little too low-level/optimal instead of just doing vector swap..
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
void ImDrawListSplitter_ClearFreeMemory(ImDrawListSplitter* self) {
    for i32 i = 0; i < self._Channels.Size; i++ {
        if i == self._Current {
            memset(&self._Channels.Data[i], 0, cast(u64, sizeof(self._Channels.Data[i])));
        }
        ImVector_ImDrawCmd_clear(&self._Channels.Data[i]._CmdBuffer);
        ImVector_ImDrawIdx_clear(&self._Channels.Data[i]._IdxBuffer);
    }
    self._Current = 0;
    self._Count = 1;
    ImVector_ImDrawChannel_clear(&self._Channels);
}

void ImDrawListSplitter_Split(ImDrawListSplitter* self, ImDrawList* draw_list, i32 channels_count) {
    ignore draw_list;
    assert(self._Current == 0 && self._Count <= 1 && "Nested channel splitting is not supported. Please use separate instances of ImDrawListSplitter.");
    i32 old_channels_count = self._Channels.Size;
    if old_channels_count < channels_count {
        ImVector_ImDrawChannel_reserve(&self._Channels, channels_count);
        ImVector_ImDrawChannel_resize(&self._Channels, channels_count);
    }
    self._Count = channels_count;
    memset(&self._Channels.Data[0], 0, cast(u64, sizeof(ImDrawChannel)));
    for i32 i = 1; i < channels_count; i++ {
        if i >= old_channels_count {
            memset(&self._Channels.Data[i], 0, cast(u64, sizeof(ImDrawChannel)));
        } else {
            ImVector_ImDrawCmd_resize(&self._Channels.Data[i]._CmdBuffer, 0);
            ImVector_ImDrawIdx_resize(&self._Channels.Data[i]._IdxBuffer, 0);
        }
    }
}

void ImDrawListSplitter_Merge(ImDrawListSplitter* self, ImDrawList* draw_list) {
    if self._Count <= 1 {
        return;
    }
    ImDrawListSplitter_SetCurrentChannel(self, draw_list, 0);
    ImDrawList__PopUnusedDrawCmd(draw_list);
    i32 new_cmd_buffer_count = 0;
    i32 new_idx_buffer_count = 0;
    ImDrawCmd* last_cmd = self._Count > 0 && draw_list.CmdBuffer.Size > 0 ? ImVector_ImDrawCmd_back(&draw_list.CmdBuffer) : null;
    var idx_offset = cast(i32, last_cmd != null ? last_cmd.IdxOffset + last_cmd.ElemCount : 0);
    for i32 i = 1; i < self._Count; i++ {
        ImDrawChannel* ch = &self._Channels.Data[i];
        if ch._CmdBuffer.Size > 0 && ImVector_ImDrawCmd_back(&ch._CmdBuffer).ElemCount == 0 && ImVector_ImDrawCmd_back(&ch._CmdBuffer).UserCallback == null {
            ImVector_ImDrawCmd_pop_back(&ch._CmdBuffer);
        }
        if ch._CmdBuffer.Size > 0 && last_cmd != null {
            ImDrawCmd* next_cmd = &ch._CmdBuffer.Data[0];
            if memcmp(last_cmd, next_cmd, cast(u64, cast(c_ulong, &cast(ImDrawCmd*, 0).VtxOffset) + cast(c_ulong, sizeof(u32)))) == 0 && last_cmd.UserCallback == null && next_cmd.UserCallback == null {
                last_cmd.ElemCount += next_cmd.ElemCount;
                idx_offset += cast(i32, next_cmd.ElemCount);
                ImVector_ImDrawCmd_erase(&ch._CmdBuffer, ch._CmdBuffer.Data);
            }
        }
        if ch._CmdBuffer.Size > 0 {
            last_cmd = ImVector_ImDrawCmd_back(&ch._CmdBuffer);
        }
        new_cmd_buffer_count += ch._CmdBuffer.Size;
        new_idx_buffer_count += ch._IdxBuffer.Size;
        for i32 cmd_n = 0; cmd_n < ch._CmdBuffer.Size; cmd_n++ {
            ch._CmdBuffer.Data[cmd_n].IdxOffset = cast(u32, idx_offset);
            idx_offset += cast(i32, ch._CmdBuffer.Data[cmd_n].ElemCount);
        }
    }
    ImVector_ImDrawCmd_resize(&draw_list.CmdBuffer, draw_list.CmdBuffer.Size + new_cmd_buffer_count);
    ImVector_ImDrawIdx_resize(&draw_list.IdxBuffer, draw_list.IdxBuffer.Size + new_idx_buffer_count);
    ImDrawCmd* cmd_write = draw_list.CmdBuffer.Data + draw_list.CmdBuffer.Size - new_cmd_buffer_count;
    ImDrawIdx* idx_write = draw_list.IdxBuffer.Data + draw_list.IdxBuffer.Size - new_idx_buffer_count;
    for i32 i = 1; i < self._Count; i++ {
        ImDrawChannel* ch = &self._Channels.Data[i];
        {
            i32 sz = ch._CmdBuffer.Size;
            if sz != 0 {
                memcpy(cmd_write, ch._CmdBuffer.Data, cast(u64, sz * sizeof(ImDrawCmd)));
                cmd_write += sz;
            }
        }
        {
            i32 sz = ch._IdxBuffer.Size;
            if sz != 0 {
                memcpy(idx_write, ch._IdxBuffer.Data, cast(u64, sz * sizeof(ImDrawIdx)));
                idx_write += sz;
            }
        }
    }
    draw_list._IdxWritePtr = idx_write;
    if draw_list.CmdBuffer.Size == 0 || ImVector_ImDrawCmd_back(&draw_list.CmdBuffer).UserCallback != null {
        ImDrawList_AddDrawCmd(draw_list);
    }
    ImDrawCmd* curr_cmd = &draw_list.CmdBuffer.Data[draw_list.CmdBuffer.Size - 1];
    if curr_cmd.ElemCount == 0 {
        memcpy(curr_cmd, &draw_list._CmdHeader, cast(u64, cast(c_ulong, &cast(ImDrawCmd*, 0).VtxOffset) + cast(c_ulong, sizeof(u32))));
    } else if memcmp(curr_cmd, &draw_list._CmdHeader, cast(u64, cast(c_ulong, &cast(ImDrawCmd*, 0).VtxOffset) + cast(c_ulong, sizeof(u32)))) != 0 {
        ImDrawList_AddDrawCmd(draw_list);
    }
    self._Count = 1;
}

void ImDrawListSplitter_SetCurrentChannel(ImDrawListSplitter* self, ImDrawList* draw_list, i32 idx) {
    assert(idx >= 0 && idx < self._Count);
    if self._Current == idx {
        return;
    }
    memcpy(&self._Channels.Data[self._Current]._CmdBuffer, &draw_list.CmdBuffer, cast(u64, sizeof(draw_list.CmdBuffer)));
    memcpy(&self._Channels.Data[self._Current]._IdxBuffer, &draw_list.IdxBuffer, cast(u64, sizeof(draw_list.IdxBuffer)));
    self._Current = idx;
    memcpy(&draw_list.CmdBuffer, &self._Channels.Data[idx]._CmdBuffer, cast(u64, sizeof(draw_list.CmdBuffer)));
    memcpy(&draw_list.IdxBuffer, &self._Channels.Data[idx]._IdxBuffer, cast(u64, sizeof(draw_list.IdxBuffer)));
    draw_list._IdxWritePtr = draw_list.IdxBuffer.Data + draw_list.IdxBuffer.Size;
    ImDrawCmd* curr_cmd = draw_list.CmdBuffer.Size == 0 ? null : &draw_list.CmdBuffer.Data[draw_list.CmdBuffer.Size - 1];
    if curr_cmd == null {
        ImDrawList_AddDrawCmd(draw_list);
    } else if curr_cmd.ElemCount == 0 {
        memcpy(curr_cmd, &draw_list._CmdHeader, cast(u64, cast(c_ulong, &cast(ImDrawCmd*, 0).VtxOffset) + cast(c_ulong, sizeof(u32))));
    } else if memcmp(curr_cmd, &draw_list._CmdHeader, cast(u64, cast(c_ulong, &cast(ImDrawCmd*, 0).VtxOffset) + cast(c_ulong, sizeof(u32)))) != 0 {
        ImDrawList_AddDrawCmd(draw_list);
    }
}

// Important: 'out_list' is generally going to be draw_data->CmdLists, but may be another temporary list
// as long at it is expected that the result will be later merged into draw_data->CmdLists[].
void ImGui_AddDrawListToDrawDataEx(ImDrawData* draw_data, ImVector_ImDrawList_ptr* out_list, ImDrawList* draw_list) {
    if draw_list.CmdBuffer.Size == 0 {
        return;
    }
    if draw_list.CmdBuffer.Size == 1 && draw_list.CmdBuffer.Data[0].ElemCount == 0 && draw_list.CmdBuffer.Data[0].UserCallback == null {
        return;
    }
    assert(draw_list.VtxBuffer.Size == 0 || draw_list._VtxWritePtr == draw_list.VtxBuffer.Data + draw_list.VtxBuffer.Size);
    assert(draw_list.IdxBuffer.Size == 0 || draw_list._IdxWritePtr == draw_list.IdxBuffer.Data + draw_list.IdxBuffer.Size);
    if (draw_list.Flags & ImDrawListFlags_AllowVtxOffset) == 0 {
        assert(cast(i32, draw_list._VtxCurrentIdx) == draw_list.VtxBuffer.Size);
    }
    if sizeof(ImDrawIdx) == 2 {
        assert(draw_list._VtxCurrentIdx < cast(u32, 1 << 16) && "Too many vertices in ImDrawList using 16-bit indices. Read comment above");
    }
    if draw_list._CallbacksDataBuf.Size > 0 {
        ImDrawCmd* zz_rf_it_2 = ImVector_ImDrawCmd_begin(&draw_list.CmdBuffer);
        ImDrawCmd* zz_rf_end_2 = ImVector_ImDrawCmd_end(&draw_list.CmdBuffer);
        for ; zz_rf_it_2 != zz_rf_end_2; zz_rf_it_2++ {
            ImDrawCmd* cmd = zz_rf_it_2;
            if cmd.UserCallback != null && cmd.UserCallbackDataOffset != -1 && cmd.UserCallbackDataSize > 0 {
                cmd.UserCallbackData = draw_list._CallbacksDataBuf.Data + cmd.UserCallbackDataOffset;
            }
        }
    }
    ImVector_ImDrawList_ptr_push_back(out_list, draw_list);
    draw_data.TotalVtxCount += draw_list.VtxBuffer.Size;
    draw_data.TotalIdxCount += draw_list.IdxBuffer.Size;
}

void ImDrawData_AddDrawList(ImDrawData* self, ImDrawList* draw_list) {
    ImDrawList__PopUnusedDrawCmd(draw_list);
    ImGui_AddDrawListToDrawDataEx(self, &self.CmdLists, draw_list);
}

// For backward compatibility: convert all buffers from indexed to de-indexed, in case you cannot render indexed. Note: this is slow and most likely a waste of resources. Always prefer indexed rendering!
void ImDrawData_DeIndexAllBuffers(ImDrawData* self) {
    ImVector_ImDrawVert new_vtx_buffer;
    self.TotalIdxCount = 0;
    self.TotalVtxCount = self.TotalIdxCount;
    {
        ImDrawList** zz_rf_it_3 = ImVector_ImDrawList_ptr_begin(&self.CmdLists);
        ImDrawList** zz_rf_end_3 = ImVector_ImDrawList_ptr_end(&self.CmdLists);
        for ; zz_rf_it_3 != zz_rf_end_3; zz_rf_it_3++ {
            ImDrawList* draw_list = *zz_rf_it_3;
            if ImVector_ImDrawIdx_empty(&draw_list.IdxBuffer) != 0 {
                continue;
            }
            ImVector_ImDrawVert_resize(&new_vtx_buffer, draw_list.IdxBuffer.Size);
            for i32 j = 0; j < draw_list.IdxBuffer.Size; j++ {
                new_vtx_buffer.Data[j] = draw_list.VtxBuffer.Data[draw_list.IdxBuffer.Data[j]];
            }
            ImVector_ImDrawVert_swap(&draw_list.VtxBuffer, &new_vtx_buffer);
            ImVector_ImDrawIdx_resize(&draw_list.IdxBuffer, 0);
            self.TotalVtxCount += draw_list.VtxBuffer.Size;
        }
    }
}

// Helper to scale the ClipRect field of each ImDrawCmd.
// Use if your final output buffer is at a different scale than draw_data->DisplaySize,
// or if there is a difference between your window resolution and framebuffer resolution.
void ImDrawData_ScaleClipRects(ImDrawData* self, ImVec2 fb_scale) {
    {
        ImDrawList** zz_rf_it_5 = ImVector_ImDrawList_ptr_begin(&self.CmdLists);
        ImDrawList** zz_rf_end_5 = ImVector_ImDrawList_ptr_end(&self.CmdLists);
        for ; zz_rf_it_5 != zz_rf_end_5; zz_rf_it_5++ {
            ImDrawList* draw_list = *zz_rf_it_5;
            {
                ImDrawCmd* zz_rf_it_4 = ImVector_ImDrawCmd_begin(&draw_list.CmdBuffer);
                ImDrawCmd* zz_rf_end_4 = ImVector_ImDrawCmd_end(&draw_list.CmdBuffer);
                for ; zz_rf_it_4 != zz_rf_end_4; zz_rf_it_4++ {
                    ImDrawCmd* cmd = zz_rf_it_4;
                    cmd.ClipRect = ImVec4{
                        cmd.ClipRect.x * fb_scale.x, cmd.ClipRect.y * fb_scale.y,
                        cmd.ClipRect.z * fb_scale.x, cmd.ClipRect.w * fb_scale.y,
                    };
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

// Generic linear color gradient, write to RGB fields, leave A untouched.
void ImGui_ShadeVertsLinearColorGradientKeepAlpha(ImDrawList* draw_list, i32 vert_start_idx, i32 vert_end_idx, ImVec2 gradient_p0, ImVec2 gradient_p1, ImU32 col0, ImU32 col1) {
    ImVec2 gradient_extent = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(gradient_p1, gradient_p0);
    f32 gradient_inv_length2 = 1.0f / ImLengthSqr(gradient_extent);
    ImDrawVert* vert_start = draw_list.VtxBuffer.Data + vert_start_idx;
    ImDrawVert* vert_end = draw_list.VtxBuffer.Data + vert_end_idx;
    i32 col0_r = cast(i32, col0 >> 0) & 0xFF;
    i32 col0_g = cast(i32, col0 >> 8) & 0xFF;
    i32 col0_b = cast(i32, col0 >> 16) & 0xFF;
    i32 col_delta_r = (cast(i32, col1 >> 0) & 0xFF) - col0_r;
    i32 col_delta_g = (cast(i32, col1 >> 8) & 0xFF) - col0_g;
    i32 col_delta_b = (cast(i32, col1 >> 16) & 0xFF) - col0_b;
    for ImDrawVert* vert = vert_start; vert < vert_end; vert++ {
        f32 d = ImDot(op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(vert.pos, gradient_p0), gradient_extent);
        f32 t = ImClamp(d * gradient_inv_length2, 0.0f, 1.0f);
        var r = cast(i32, cast(f32, col0_r) + cast(f32, col_delta_r) * t);
        var g = cast(i32, cast(f32, col0_g) + cast(f32, col_delta_g) * t);
        var b = cast(i32, cast(f32, col0_b) + cast(f32, col_delta_b) * t);
        vert.col = cast(ImU32, cast(u32, r << 0 | g << 8 | b << 16) | vert.col & 0xFF000000);
    }
}

// Distribute UV over (a, b) rectangle
void ImGui_ShadeVertsLinearUV(ImDrawList* draw_list, i32 vert_start_idx, i32 vert_end_idx, ImVec2 a, ImVec2 b, ImVec2 uv_a, ImVec2 uv_b, bool clamp) {
    ImVec2 size = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(b, a);
    ImVec2 uv_size = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(uv_b, uv_a);
    var scale = ImVec2{
        size.x != 0.0f ? uv_size.x / size.x : 0.0f, size.y != 0.0f ? uv_size.y / size.y : 0.0f,
    };
    ImDrawVert* vert_start = draw_list.VtxBuffer.Data + vert_start_idx;
    ImDrawVert* vert_end = draw_list.VtxBuffer.Data + vert_end_idx;
    if clamp != 0 {
        ImVec2 min = ImMin(uv_a, uv_b);
        ImVec2 max = ImMax(uv_a, uv_b);
        for ImDrawVert* vertex = vert_start; vertex < vert_end; ++vertex {
            vertex.uv = ImClamp(op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(uv_a, ImMul(op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(ImVec2{vertex.pos.x, vertex.pos.y}, a), scale)), min, max);
        }
    } else {
        for ImDrawVert* vertex = vert_start; vertex < vert_end; ++vertex {
            vertex.uv = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(uv_a, ImMul(op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(ImVec2{vertex.pos.x, vertex.pos.y}, a), scale));
        }
    }
}

void ImGui_ShadeVertsTransformPos(ImDrawList* draw_list, i32 vert_start_idx, i32 vert_end_idx, ImVec2 pivot_in, f32 cos_a, f32 sin_a, ImVec2 pivot_out) {
    ImDrawVert* vert_start = draw_list.VtxBuffer.Data + vert_start_idx;
    ImDrawVert* vert_end = draw_list.VtxBuffer.Data + vert_end_idx;
    for ImDrawVert* vertex = vert_start; vertex < vert_end; ++vertex {
        vertex.pos = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(ImRotate(op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(vertex.pos, pivot_in), cos_a, sin_a), pivot_out);
    }
}
