void ImTextureData_Create(ImTextureData* self, ImTextureFormat format_var, i32 w, i32 h) {
    assert(self.Status == ImTextureStatus_Destroyed);
    ImTextureData_DestroyPixels(self);
    self.Format = format_var;
    self.Status = ImTextureStatus_WantCreate;
    self.Width = w;
    self.Height = h;
    self.BytesPerPixel = ImTextureDataGetFormatBytesPerPixel(format_var);
    self.UseColors = false;
    self.Pixels = cast(u8*, ImGui_MemAlloc(cast(u64, self.Width * self.Height * self.BytesPerPixel)));
    assert(self.Pixels != null);
    memset(self.Pixels, 0, cast(u64, self.Width * self.Height * self.BytesPerPixel));
    self.UsedRect.h = 0;
    self.UsedRect.w = self.UsedRect.h;
    self.UsedRect.y = self.UsedRect.w;
    self.UsedRect.x = self.UsedRect.y;
    self.UpdateRect.y = cast(u16, ~0);
    self.UpdateRect.x = self.UpdateRect.y;
    self.UpdateRect.h = 0;
    self.UpdateRect.w = self.UpdateRect.h;
}

void ImTextureData_DestroyPixels(ImTextureData* self) {
    if self.Pixels != null {
        ImGui_MemFree(self.Pixels);
    }
    self.Pixels = null;
    self.UseColors = false;
}

void ImFontAtlasTextureBlockConvert(u8* src_pixels, ImTextureFormat src_fmt, i32 src_pitch, u8* dst_pixels, ImTextureFormat dst_fmt, i32 dst_pitch, i32 w, i32 h) {
    assert(src_pixels != null && dst_pixels != null);
    if src_fmt == dst_fmt {
        i32 line_sz = w * ImTextureDataGetFormatBytesPerPixel(src_fmt);
        for i32 ny = h; ny > 0; ny-- {
            memcpy(dst_pixels, src_pixels, cast(u64, line_sz));
            src_pixels += src_pitch;
            dst_pixels += dst_pitch;
        }
    } else if src_fmt == ImTextureFormat_Alpha8 && dst_fmt == ImTextureFormat_RGBA32 {
        for i32 ny = h; ny > 0; ny-- {
            var src_p = cast(ImU8*, src_pixels);
            var dst_p = cast(ImU32*, cast(void*, dst_pixels));
            for i32 nx = w; nx > 0; nx-- {
                *dst_p++ = cast(ImU32, cast(u32, *src_p++)) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 0;
            }
            src_pixels += src_pitch;
            dst_pixels += dst_pitch;
        }
    } else if src_fmt == ImTextureFormat_RGBA32 && dst_fmt == ImTextureFormat_Alpha8 {
        for i32 ny = h; ny > 0; ny-- {
            var src_p = cast(ImU32*, cast(void*, src_pixels));
            var dst_p = cast(ImU8*, dst_pixels);
            for i32 nx = w; nx > 0; nx-- {
                *dst_p++ = cast(ImU8, *src_p++ >> 24 & 0xFF);
            }
            src_pixels += src_pitch;
            dst_pixels += dst_pitch;
        }
    } else {
        assert(0);
    }
}

// Source buffer may be written to (used for in-place mods).
// Post-process hooks may eventually be added here.
void ImFontAtlasTextureBlockPostProcess(ImFontAtlasPostProcessData* data) {
    if data.FontSrc.RasterizerMultiply != 1.0f {
        ImFontAtlasTextureBlockPostProcessMultiply(data, data.FontSrc.RasterizerMultiply);
    }
}

void ImFontAtlasTextureBlockPostProcessMultiply(ImFontAtlasPostProcessData* data, f32 multiply_factor) {
    var pixels = cast(u8*, data.Pixels);
    i32 pitch = data.Pitch;
    if data.Format == ImTextureFormat_Alpha8 {
        for i32 ny = data.Height; ny > 0; ny-- {
            var p = cast(ImU8*, pixels);
            for i32 nx = data.Width; nx > 0; nx-- {
                var v = cast(u32, ImMin(cast(i32, cast(u32, cast(f32, *p) * multiply_factor)), cast(i32, cast(u32, 255))));
                *p = cast(u8, v);
                p++;
            }
            pixels += pitch;
        }
    } else if data.Format == ImTextureFormat_RGBA32 {
        for i32 ny = data.Height; ny > 0; ny-- {
            var p = cast(ImU32*, cast(void*, pixels));
            for i32 nx = data.Width; nx > 0; nx-- {
                var a = cast(u32, ImMin(cast(i32, cast(u32, cast(f32, *p >> 24 & 0xFF) * multiply_factor)), cast(i32, cast(u32, 255))));
                *p = cast(ImU32, a) << 24 | cast(ImU32, *p >> 16 & 0xFF) << 16 | cast(ImU32, *p >> 8 & 0xFF) << 8 | cast(ImU32, *p >> 0 & 0xFF) << 0;
                p++;
            }
            pixels += pitch;
        }
    } else {
        assert(0);
    }
}

void ImFontAtlasTextureBlockCopy(ImTextureData* src_tex, i32 src_x, i32 src_y, ImTextureData* dst_tex, i32 dst_x, i32 dst_y, i32 w, i32 h) {
    assert(src_tex.Pixels != null && dst_tex.Pixels != null);

    assert(src_y >= 0 && src_y + h <= src_tex.Height);
    assert(dst_x >= 0 && dst_x + w <= dst_tex.Width);
    assert(dst_y >= 0 && dst_y + h <= dst_tex.Height);
    for i32 y = 0; y < h; y++ {
        memcpy(ImTextureData_GetPixelsAt(dst_tex, dst_x, dst_y + y), ImTextureData_GetPixelsAt(src_tex, src_x, src_y + y), cast(u64, w * dst_tex.BytesPerPixel));

}

// Queue texture block update for renderer backend
void ImTextureDataQueueUpload(ImTextureData* tex, i32 x, i32 y, i32 w, i32 h) {
    assert(tex.Status != ImTextureStatus_WantDestroy && tex.Status != ImTextureStatus_Destroyed);
    assert(x >= 0 && x <= 0xFFFF && y >= 0 && y <= 0xFFFF && w >= 0 && x + w <= 0x10000 && h >= 0 && y + h <= 0x10000);
    var req = ImTextureRect{cast(u16, x), cast(u16, y), cast(u16, w), cast(u16, h)};
    i32 new_x1 = ImMax(tex.UpdateRect.w == 0 ? 0 : tex.UpdateRect.x + tex.UpdateRect.w, cast(i32, req.x + req.w));
    i32 new_y1 = ImMax(tex.UpdateRect.h == 0 ? 0 : tex.UpdateRect.y + tex.UpdateRect.h, cast(i32, req.y + req.h));
    tex.UpdateRect.x = cast(u16, ImMin(cast(i32, tex.UpdateRect.x), cast(i32, req.x)));
    tex.UpdateRect.y = cast(u16, ImMin(cast(i32, tex.UpdateRect.y), cast(i32, req.y)));
    tex.UpdateRect.w = cast(u16, new_x1 - tex.UpdateRect.x);
    tex.UpdateRect.h = cast(u16, new_y1 - tex.UpdateRect.y);
    tex.UsedRect.x = cast(u16, ImMin(cast(i32, tex.UsedRect.x), cast(i32, req.x)));
    tex.UsedRect.y = cast(u16, ImMin(cast(i32, tex.UsedRect.y), cast(i32, req.y)));
    tex.UsedRect.w = cast(u16, ImMax(cast(i32, tex.UsedRect.x + tex.UsedRect.w), cast(i32, req.x + req.w)) - tex.UsedRect.x);
    tex.UsedRect.h = cast(u16, ImMax(cast(i32, tex.UsedRect.y + tex.UsedRect.h), cast(i32, req.y + req.h)) - tex.UsedRect.y);
    if tex.Status == ImTextureStatus_OK || tex.Status == ImTextureStatus_WantUpdates {
        tex.Status = ImTextureStatus_WantUpdates;
        ImVector_ImTextureRect_push_back(&tex.Updates, req);
    }
}

        if font_cfg.MergeMode == 0 {

    ImFontAtlasFontSourceAddToFont(self, font, font_cfg);

private {
u32 Decode85Byte(u8 c) {
    return c >= 92 ? c - 36 : c - 35;
}

void Decode85(u8* src, u8* dst) {
    while *src != 0 {
        u32 tmp = Decode85Byte(cast(u8, src[0])) + 85 * (Decode85Byte(cast(u8, src[1])) + 85 * (Decode85Byte(cast(u8, src[2])) + 85 * (Decode85Byte(cast(u8, src[3])) + 85 * Decode85Byte(cast(u8, src[4])))));
        dst[0] = cast(u8, tmp >> 0 & 0xFF);
        dst[1] = cast(u8, tmp >> 8 & 0xFF);
        dst[2] = cast(u8, tmp >> 16 & 0xFF);
        dst[3] = cast(u8, tmp >> 24 & 0xFF);
        src += 5;
        dst += 4;
    }
}
}

// This duplicates some of the logic in UpdateFontsNewFrame() which is a bit chicken-and-eggy/tricky to extract due to variety of codepaths and possible initialization ordering.

    return (ctx.Style.FontSizeBase > 0.0f ? ctx.Style.FontSizeBase : 13.0f) * ctx.Style.FontScaleMain * ctx.Style.FontScaleDpi;

// Legacy function with heuristic to select Pixel or Vector font.
// The selection is based on (style.FontSizeBase * style.FontScaleMain * style.FontScaleDpi) reaching a small threshold at the time of adding the default font.
// Prefer calling AddFontDefaultVector() or AddFontDefaultBitmap() based on your own logic.
ImFont* ImFontAtlas_AddFontDefault(ImFontAtlas* self, ImFontConfig* font_cfg) {
    if self.OwnerContext == null || GetExpectedContextFontSize(self.OwnerContext) >= 15.0f {

// At it is common to do an AddCustomRect() followed by a GetCustomRect(), we provide an optional 'ImFontAtlasRect* out_r = NULL' argument to retrieve the info straight away.
ImFontAtlasRectId ImFontAtlas_AddCustomRect(ImFontAtlas* self, i32 width, i32 height, ImFontAtlasRect* out_r) {
    assert(width > 0 && width <= 0xFFFF);
    assert(height > 0 && height <= 0xFFFF);
    if self.Builder == null {
        ImFontAtlasBuildInit(self);
    }
    ImFontAtlasRectId r_id = ImFontAtlasPackAddRect(self, width, height);
    if r_id == -1 {
        return -1;
    }
    if out_r != null {
        ImFontAtlas_GetCustomRect(self, r_id, out_r);
    }
    if self.RendererHasTextures != 0 {
        ImTextureRect* r = ImFontAtlasPackGetRect(self, r_id);
        ImFontAtlasTextureBlockQueueUpload(self, self.TexData, cast(i32, r.x), cast(i32, r.y), cast(i32, r.w), cast(i32, r.h));
    }
    return r_id;
}

void ImFontAtlas_RemoveCustomRect(ImFontAtlas* self, ImFontAtlasRectId id) {
    if ImFontAtlasPackGetRectSafe(self, id) == null {
        return;
    }
    ImFontAtlasPackDiscardRect(self, id);
}

bool ImFontAtlas_GetCustomRect(ImFontAtlas* self, ImFontAtlasRectId id, ImFontAtlasRect* out_r) {
    ImTextureRect* r = ImFontAtlasPackGetRectSafe(self, id);
    if r == null {
        return false;
    }
    assert(self.TexData.Width > 0 && self.TexData.Height > 0);
    if out_r == null {
        return true;
    }
    out_r.x = r.x;
    out_r.y = r.y;
    out_r.w = r.w;
    out_r.h = r.h;
    out_r.uv0 = op_mul_ImVec2_ImVec2(ImVec2{cast(f32, r.x), cast(f32, r.y)}, self.TexUvScale);
    out_r.uv1 = op_mul_ImVec2_ImVec2(ImVec2{cast(f32, r.x + r.w), cast(f32, r.y + r.h)}, self.TexUvScale);
    return true;
}

void ImFontAtlasBuildUpdateTexDataLines(ImFontAtlas* atlas) {

        i32 line_width = n;
        i32 pad_left = (r.w - line_width) / 2;

            }
            for i32 i = 0; i < line_width; i++ {
                *(write_ptr + pad_left + i) = 0xFF;
            }
            for i32 i = 0; i < pad_right; i++ {
                *(write_ptr + pad_left + line_width + i) = 0x00;
            }
        } else if add_and_draw && tex.Format == ImTextureFormat_RGBA32 {
            var write_ptr = cast(ImU32*, ImTextureData_GetPixelsAt(tex, cast(i32, r.x), r.y + y));
            for i32 i = 0; i < pad_left; i++ {
                *(write_ptr + i) = cast(ImU32, 0) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 0;
            }
            for i32 i = 0; i < line_width; i++ {
                *(write_ptr + pad_left + i) = cast(ImU32, 255) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 0;
            }
            for i32 i = 0; i < pad_right; i++ {
                *(write_ptr + pad_left + line_width + i) = cast(ImU32, 0) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 0;

            cast(f32, r.x + pad_left + line_width + 1), cast(f32, r.y + y + 1),
        }, atlas.TexUvScale);
        f32 half_v = (uv0.y + uv1.y) * 0.5f;
        atlas.TexUvLines[n] = ImVec4{uv0.x, half_v, uv1.x, half_v};
    }
}

void ImFontAtlasTextureGrow(ImFontAtlas* atlas, i32 old_tex_w, i32 old_tex_h) {
    ImFontAtlasBuilder* builder = atlas.Builder;
    if old_tex_w == -1 {
        old_tex_w = atlas.TexData.Width;
    }
    if old_tex_h == -1 {
        old_tex_h = atlas.TexData.Height;
    }
    assert(ImIsPowerOfTwo(old_tex_w) && ImIsPowerOfTwo(old_tex_h));
    assert(ImIsPowerOfTwo(atlas.TexMinWidth) && ImIsPowerOfTwo(atlas.TexMaxWidth) && ImIsPowerOfTwo(atlas.TexMinHeight) && ImIsPowerOfTwo(atlas.TexMaxHeight));
    i32 new_tex_w = old_tex_h <= old_tex_w ? old_tex_w : old_tex_w * 2;
    i32 new_tex_h = old_tex_h <= old_tex_w ? old_tex_h * 2 : old_tex_h;
    i32 pack_padding = atlas.TexGlyphPadding;
    new_tex_w = ImMax(new_tex_w, ImUpperPowerOfTwo(builder.MaxRectSize.x + pack_padding));
    new_tex_h = ImMax(new_tex_h, ImUpperPowerOfTwo(builder.MaxRectSize.y + pack_padding));
    new_tex_w = ImClamp(new_tex_w, atlas.TexMinWidth, atlas.TexMaxWidth);
    new_tex_h = ImClamp(new_tex_h, atlas.TexMinHeight, atlas.TexMaxHeight);
    if new_tex_w == old_tex_w && new_tex_h == old_tex_h {
        return;
    }
    ImFontAtlasTextureRepack(atlas, new_tex_w, new_tex_h);
}

void ImFontAtlasTextureMakeSpace(ImFontAtlas* atlas) {
    ImFontAtlasBuilder* builder = atlas.Builder;
    ImFontAtlasBuildDiscardBakes(atlas, 2);

}

ImVec2i ImFontAtlasTextureGetSizeEstimate(ImFontAtlas* atlas) {
    i32 min_w = ImUpperPowerOfTwo(atlas.TexMinWidth);
    i32 min_h = ImUpperPowerOfTwo(atlas.TexMinHeight);
    if atlas.Builder == null || atlas.TexData == null || atlas.TexData.Status == ImTextureStatus_WantDestroy {
        return ImVec2i{min_w, min_h};
    }
    ImFontAtlasBuilder* builder = atlas.Builder;
    min_w = ImMax(ImUpperPowerOfTwo(builder.MaxRectSize.x), min_w);
    min_h = ImMax(ImUpperPowerOfTwo(builder.MaxRectSize.y), min_h);
    i32 surface_approx = builder.RectsPackedSurface - builder.RectsDiscardedSurface;
    var surface_sqrt = cast(i32, sqrt(cast(f32, surface_approx)));
    i32 new_tex_w;
    i32 new_tex_h;
    if min_w >= min_h {
        new_tex_w = ImMax(min_w, ImUpperPowerOfTwo(surface_sqrt));
        new_tex_h = ImMax(min_h, (surface_approx + new_tex_w - 1) / new_tex_w);
        if (atlas.Flags & ImFontAtlasFlags_NoPowerOfTwoHeight) == 0 {
            new_tex_h = ImUpperPowerOfTwo(new_tex_h);
        }
    } else {
        new_tex_h = ImMax(min_h, ImUpperPowerOfTwo(surface_sqrt));
        if (atlas.Flags & ImFontAtlasFlags_NoPowerOfTwoHeight) == 0 {
            new_tex_h = ImUpperPowerOfTwo(new_tex_h);
        }
        new_tex_w = ImMax(min_w, (surface_approx + new_tex_h - 1) / new_tex_h);
    }
    assert(ImIsPowerOfTwo(new_tex_w) && ImIsPowerOfTwo(new_tex_h));
    return ImVec2i{new_tex_w, new_tex_h};
}

// This is essentially a free-list pattern, it may be nice to wrap it into a dedicated type.
private {
ImFontAtlasRectId ImFontAtlasPackAllocRectEntry(ImFontAtlas* atlas, i32 rect_idx) {
    var builder = atlas.Builder;
    i32 index_idx;
    ImFontAtlasRectEntry* index_entry;
    if builder.RectsIndexFreeListStart < 0 {
        ImVector_ImFontAtlasRectEntry_resize(&builder.RectsIndex, builder.RectsIndex.Size + 1);
        index_idx = builder.RectsIndex.Size - 1;
        index_entry = &builder.RectsIndex.Data[index_idx];
        memset(index_entry, 0, cast(u64, sizeof(*index_entry)));
    } else {
        index_idx = builder.RectsIndexFreeListStart;
        index_entry = &builder.RectsIndex.Data[index_idx];
        assert(index_entry.IsUsed == false && index_entry.Generation > 0);
        builder.RectsIndexFreeListStart = index_entry.TargetIndex;
    }
    index_entry.TargetIndex = rect_idx;
    index_entry.IsUsed = 1;
    return ImFontAtlasRectId_Make(index_idx, cast(i32, index_entry.Generation));
}

    assert(cast(i64, index_entry.IsUsed));
    index_entry.TargetIndex = atlas.Builder.Rects.Size - 1;
    i32 index_idx = ImVector_ImFontAtlasRectEntry_index_from_ptr(&atlas.Builder.RectsIndex, index_entry);

// This is expected to be called in batches and followed by a repack
void ImFontAtlasPackDiscardRect(ImFontAtlas* atlas, ImFontAtlasRectId id) {
    assert(id != -1);
    ImTextureRect* rect = ImFontAtlasPackGetRect(atlas, id);
    if rect == null {
        return;
    }
    ImFontAtlasBuilder* builder = atlas.Builder;
    i32 index_idx = ImFontAtlasRectId_GetIndex(id);
    ImFontAtlasRectEntry* index_entry = &builder.RectsIndex.Data[index_idx];
    assert(index_entry.IsUsed && index_entry.TargetIndex >= 0);
    index_entry.IsUsed = false;
    index_entry.TargetIndex = builder.RectsIndexFreeListStart;
    index_entry.Generation++;
    if index_entry.Generation == 0 {
        index_entry.Generation++;
    }
    i32 pack_padding = atlas.TexGlyphPadding;
    builder.RectsIndexFreeListStart = index_idx;
    builder.RectsDiscardedCount++;
    builder.RectsDiscardedSurface += (rect.w + pack_padding) * (rect.h + pack_padding);
    rect.h = 0;
    rect.w = rect.h;
}

// Important: Calling this may recreate a new texture and therefore change atlas->TexData
// FIXME-NEWFONTS: Expose other glyph padding settings for custom alteration (e.g. drop shadows). See #7962
ImFontAtlasRectId ImFontAtlasPackAddRect(ImFontAtlas* atlas, i32 w, i32 h, ImFontAtlasRectEntry* overwrite_entry) {
    assert(w > 0 && w <= 0xFFFF);
    assert(h > 0 && h <= 0xFFFF);
    var builder = atlas.Builder;
    i32 pack_padding = atlas.TexGlyphPadding;
    builder.MaxRectSize.x = ImMax(builder.MaxRectSize.x, w);
    builder.MaxRectSize.y = ImMax(builder.MaxRectSize.y, h);
    var r = ImTextureRect{0, 0, cast(u16, w), cast(u16, h)};
    for i32 attempts_remaining = 3; attempts_remaining >= 0; attempts_remaining-- {
        stbrp_rect pack_r;
        pack_r.w = w + pack_padding;
        pack_r.h = h + pack_padding;
        stbrp_pack_rects(cast(stbrp_context*, cast(void*, &builder.PackContext)), &pack_r, 1);
        r.x = cast(u16, pack_r.x);
        r.y = cast(u16, pack_r.y);
        if pack_r.was_packed != 0 {
            break;
        }
        if attempts_remaining == 0 || builder.LockDisableResize {
            while true {
                ImGuiContext* g2 = GImGui;
                if g2 && g2.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventFont {
                }
                if !(0 != 0) { break; }
            }
            return -1;
        }
        ImFontAtlasTextureMakeSpace(atlas);
    }
    builder.MaxRectBounds.x = ImMax(builder.MaxRectBounds.x, cast(i32, r.x + r.w + cast(u32, pack_padding)));
    builder.MaxRectBounds.y = ImMax(builder.MaxRectBounds.y, cast(i32, r.y + r.h + cast(u32, pack_padding)));
    builder.RectsPackedCount++;
    builder.RectsPackedSurface += (w + pack_padding) * (h + pack_padding);
    ImVector_ImTextureRect_push_back(&builder.Rects, r);
    if overwrite_entry != null {
        return ImFontAtlasPackReuseRectEntry(atlas, overwrite_entry);
    } else {
        return ImFontAtlasPackAllocRectEntry(atlas, builder.Rects.Size - 1);
    }
}

// For user-facing functions: return NULL on invalid ID.
// Important: return pointer is valid until next call to AddRect(), e.g. FindGlyph(), CalcTextSize() can all potentially invalidate previous pointers.
ImTextureRect* ImFontAtlasPackGetRectSafe(ImFontAtlas* atlas, ImFontAtlasRectId id) {
    if id == -1 {
        return null;
    }
    i32 index_idx = ImFontAtlasRectId_GetIndex(id);
    if atlas.Builder == null {
        ImFontAtlasBuildInit(atlas);
    }
    var builder = atlas.Builder;
    if index_idx >= builder.RectsIndex.Size {
        return null;
    }
    ImFontAtlasRectEntry* index_entry = &builder.RectsIndex.Data[index_idx];
    if index_entry.Generation != ImFontAtlasRectId_GetGeneration(id) || !index_entry.IsUsed {

    }
    return &builder.Rects.Data[index_entry.TargetIndex];
}

                if only_load_advance_x == null {
                    ImFontGlyph glyph_buf;
                    if loader.FontBakedLoadGlyph(atlas, src, baked, loader_user_data_p, codepoint, &glyph_buf, null) != 0 {
                        glyph_buf.Codepoint = src_codepoint;
                        glyph_buf.SourceIdx = cast(u32, src_n);
                        return ImFontAtlasBakedAddFontGlyph(atlas, baked, src, &glyph_buf);
                    }
                } else {
                    if loader.FontBakedLoadGlyph(atlas, src, baked, loader_user_data_p, codepoint, null, only_load_advance_x) != 0 {
                        ImFontAtlasBakedAddFontGlyphAdvancedX(atlas, baked, src, codepoint, *only_load_advance_x);
                        return null;
                    }
                }
            }
            loader_user_data_p += loader.FontBakedSrcLoaderDataSize;
            src_n++;
        }
    }
    if baked.LoadNoFallback != 0 {
        return null;
    }
    if baked.FallbackGlyphIndex == -1 {
        ImFontAtlasBuildSetupFontBakedFallback(baked);
    }
    ImFontBaked_BuildGrowIndex(baked, cast(i32, codepoint + 1));
    baked.IndexAdvanceX.Data[codepoint] = baked.FallbackAdvanceX;
    baked.IndexLookup.Data[codepoint] = cast(ImU16, -2);
    return null;
}

f32 ImFontBaked_BuildLoadGlyphAdvanceX(ImFontBaked* baked, ImWchar codepoint) {
    if baked.Size >= 128.0f || baked.LoadNoRenderOnLayout {
        f32 only_advance_x = 0.0f;
        ImFontGlyph* glyph = ImFontBaked_BuildLoadGlyph(baked, cast(ImWchar, codepoint), &only_advance_x);
        return glyph != null ? glyph.AdvanceX : only_advance_x;
    } else {
        ImFontGlyph* glyph = ImFontBaked_BuildLoadGlyph(baked, cast(ImWchar, codepoint), null);
        return glyph != null ? glyph.AdvanceX : baked.FallbackAdvanceX;
    }
}

// The point of this indirection is to not be inlined in debug mode in order to not bloat inner loop.b
f32 BuildLoadGlyphGetAdvanceOrFallback(ImFontBaked* baked, u32 codepoint) {
    return ImFontBaked_BuildLoadGlyphAdvanceX(baked, cast(ImWchar, codepoint));
}

bool ImGui_ImplStbTrueType_FontBakedInit(ImFontAtlas* atlas, ImFontConfig* src, ImFontBaked* baked, void* _3) {
    ignore atlas;
    var bd_font_data = cast(ImGui_ImplStbTrueType_FontSrcData*, src.FontLoaderData);
    if src.MergeMode == false {
        f32 scale_for_layout = bd_font_data.ScaleFactor * baked.Size / src.ExtraSizeScale;
        i32 unscaled_ascent;
        i32 unscaled_descent;
        i32 unscaled_line_gap;
        stbtt_GetFontVMetrics(&bd_font_data.FontInfo, &unscaled_ascent, &unscaled_descent, &unscaled_line_gap);
        baked.Ascent = ceil(cast(f32, unscaled_ascent) * scale_for_layout);
        baked.Descent = ImFloor(cast(f32, unscaled_descent) * scale_for_layout);
    }
    return true;
}

bool ImGui_ImplStbTrueType_FontBakedLoadGlyph(ImFontAtlas* atlas, ImFontConfig* src, ImFontBaked* baked, void* _3, ImWchar codepoint, ImFontGlyph* out_glyph, f32* out_advance_x) {
    var bd_font_data = cast(ImGui_ImplStbTrueType_FontSrcData*, src.FontLoaderData);
    assert(cast(i64, bd_font_data));
    i32 glyph_index = stbtt_FindGlyphIndex(&bd_font_data.FontInfo, cast(i32, codepoint));
    if glyph_index == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    i32 oversample_h;
    i32 oversample_v;
    ImFontAtlasBuildGetOversampleFactors(src, baked, &oversample_h, &oversample_v);
    f32 scale_for_layout = bd_font_data.ScaleFactor * baked.Size;
    f32 rasterizer_density = src.RasterizerDensity * baked.RasterizerDensity;
    f32 scale_for_raster_x = bd_font_data.ScaleFactor * baked.Size * rasterizer_density * cast(f32, oversample_h);
    f32 scale_for_raster_y = bd_font_data.ScaleFactor * baked.Size * rasterizer_density * cast(f32, oversample_v);
    i32 x0;
    i32 y0;
    i32 x1;
    i32 y1;
    i32 advance;
    i32 lsb;
    stbtt_GetGlyphBitmapBoxSubpixel(&bd_font_data.FontInfo, glyph_index, scale_for_raster_x, scale_for_raster_y, 0.0f, 0.0f, &x0, &y0, &x1, &y1);
    stbtt_GetGlyphHMetrics(&bd_font_data.FontInfo, glyph_index, &advance, &lsb);
    if out_advance_x != null {
        assert(out_glyph == null);
        *out_advance_x = cast(f32, advance) * scale_for_layout;
        return true;
    }
    out_glyph.Codepoint = codepoint;
    out_glyph.AdvanceX = cast(f32, advance) * scale_for_layout;
    bool is_visible = x0 != x1 && y0 != y1;
    if is_visible != 0 {
        i32 w = x1 - x0 + oversample_h - 1;
        i32 h = y1 - y0 + oversample_v - 1;
        ImFontAtlasRectId pack_id = ImFontAtlasPackAddRect(atlas, w, h);
        if pack_id == -1 {
            assert(pack_id != -1 && "Out of texture memory.");
            return false;
        }
        ImTextureRect* r = ImFontAtlasPackGetRect(atlas, pack_id);
        stbtt_GetGlyphBitmapBox(&bd_font_data.FontInfo, glyph_index, scale_for_raster_x, scale_for_raster_y, &x0, &y0, &x1, &y1);
        ImFontAtlasBuilder* builder = atlas.Builder;
        ImVector_unsigned_char_resize(&builder.TempBuffer, w * h * 1);
        u8* bitmap_pixels = builder.TempBuffer.Data;
        memset(bitmap_pixels, 0, cast(u64, w * h * 1));
        f32 sub_x;
        f32 sub_y;
        stbtt_MakeGlyphBitmapSubpixelPrefilter(&bd_font_data.FontInfo, bitmap_pixels, w, h, w, scale_for_raster_x, scale_for_raster_y, 0.0f, 0.0f, oversample_h, oversample_v, &sub_x, &sub_y, glyph_index);
        f32 ref_size = baked.OwnerFont.Sources.Data[0].SizePixels;
        f32 offsets_scale = ref_size != 0.0f ? baked.Size / ref_size : 1.0f;
        f32 font_off_x = ImFloor(src.GlyphOffset.x * offsets_scale + 0.5f);
        f32 font_off_y = ImFloor(src.GlyphOffset.y * offsets_scale + 0.5f);
        font_off_x += sub_x;
        font_off_y += sub_y + cast(f32, cast(i32, baked.Ascent + 0.5f));
        f32 recip_h = 1.0f / (cast(f32, oversample_h) * rasterizer_density);
        f32 recip_v = 1.0f / (cast(f32, oversample_v) * rasterizer_density);
        out_glyph.X0 = cast(f32, x0) * recip_h + font_off_x;
        out_glyph.Y0 = cast(f32, y0) * recip_v + font_off_y;
        out_glyph.X1 = cast(f32, x0 + cast(i32, r.w)) * recip_h + font_off_x;
        out_glyph.Y1 = cast(f32, y0 + cast(i32, r.h)) * recip_v + font_off_y;
        out_glyph.Visible = true;
        out_glyph.PackId = pack_id;
        ImFontAtlasBakedSetFontGlyphBitmap(atlas, baked, src, out_glyph, r, bitmap_pixels, ImTextureFormat_Alpha8, w);
    }
    return true;
}

void ImFontGlyphRangesBuilder_AddText(ImFontGlyphRangesBuilder* self, u8* text, u8* text_end) {
    if text_end == null {
        text_end = text + strlen(text);
    }
    while text < text_end {
        u32 c = 0;
        i32 c_len = ImTextCharFromUtf8(&c, text, text_end);
        text += c_len;
        if c_len == 0 {
            break;
        }
        ImFontGlyphRangesBuilder_AddChar(self, cast(ImWchar, c));
    }
}

void ImFontGlyphRangesBuilder_AddRanges(ImFontGlyphRangesBuilder* self, ImWchar* ranges) {
    for ; ranges[0] != 0; ranges += 2 {
        for u32 c = ranges[0]; c <= ranges[1] && c <= 0xFFFF; c++ {
            ImFontGlyphRangesBuilder_AddChar(self, cast(ImWchar, c));
        }
    }
}

void ImFontGlyphRangesBuilder_BuildRanges(ImFontGlyphRangesBuilder* self, ImVector_ImWchar* out_ranges) {
    i32 max_codepoint = 0xFFFF;
    for i32 n = 0; n <= max_codepoint; n++ {
        if ImFontGlyphRangesBuilder_GetBit(self, cast(u64, n)) != 0 {
            ImVector_ImWchar_push_back(out_ranges, cast(ImWchar, n));
            while n < max_codepoint && ImFontGlyphRangesBuilder_GetBit(self, cast(u64, n + 1)) {
                n++;
            }
            ImVector_ImWchar_push_back(out_ranges, cast(ImWchar, n));
        }
    }
    ImVector_ImWchar_push_back(out_ranges, 0);
}

// API is designed this way to avoid exposing the 8K page size
// e.g. use with IsGlyphRangeUnused(0, 255)
bool ImFont_IsGlyphRangeUnused(ImFont* self, u32 c_begin, u32 c_last) {
    u32 page_begin = c_begin / 8192;
    u32 page_last = c_last / 8192;
    for u32 page_n = page_begin; page_n <= page_last; page_n++ {
        if cast(i64, page_n >> 3) < sizeof(self.Used8kPagesMap) {
            if (self.Used8kPagesMap[page_n >> 3] & 1 << (page_n & 7)) != 0 {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }
    return true;
}

// x0/y0/x1/y1 are offset from the character upper-left layout position, in pixels. Therefore x0/y0 are often fairly close to zero.
// Not to be mistaken with texture coordinates, which are held by u0/v0/u1/v1 in normalized format (0.0..1.0 on each texture axis).
// - 'src' is not necessarily == 'this->Sources' because multiple source fonts+configs can be used to build one target font.
ImFontGlyph* ImFontAtlasBakedAddFontGlyph(ImFontAtlas* atlas, ImFontBaked* baked, ImFontConfig* src, ImFontGlyph* in_glyph) {
    i32 glyph_idx = baked.Glyphs.Size;
    ImVector_ImFontGlyph_push_back(&baked.Glyphs, *in_glyph);
    ImFontGlyph* glyph = &baked.Glyphs.Data[glyph_idx];
    assert(baked.Glyphs.Size < 0xFFFE);
    if glyph.PackId != -1 {
        ImTextureRect* r = ImFontAtlasPackGetRect(atlas, glyph.PackId);
        assert(glyph.U0 == 0.0f && glyph.V0 == 0.0f && glyph.U1 == 0.0f && glyph.V1 == 0.0f);
        glyph.U0 = cast(f32, r.x) * atlas.TexUvScale.x;
        glyph.V0 = cast(f32, r.y) * atlas.TexUvScale.y;
        glyph.U1 = cast(f32, r.x + r.w) * atlas.TexUvScale.x;
        glyph.V1 = cast(f32, r.y + r.h) * atlas.TexUvScale.y;
        baked.MetricsTotalSurface += r.w * r.h;
    }
    if src != null {
        f32 ref_size = baked.OwnerFont.Sources.Data[0].SizePixels;
        f32 offsets_scale = ref_size != 0.0f ? baked.Size / ref_size : 1.0f;
        f32 advance_x = ImClamp(glyph.AdvanceX, src.GlyphMinAdvanceX * offsets_scale, src.GlyphMaxAdvanceX * offsets_scale);
        if advance_x != glyph.AdvanceX {
            f32 char_off_x = src.PixelSnapH != 0 ? ImTrunc((advance_x - glyph.AdvanceX) * 0.5f) : (advance_x - glyph.AdvanceX) * 0.5f;
            glyph.X0 += char_off_x;
            glyph.X1 += char_off_x;
        }
        if src.PixelSnapH != 0 {
            advance_x = cast(f32, cast(i32, advance_x + 0.5f));
        }
        glyph.AdvanceX = advance_x + src.GlyphExtraAdvanceX;
    }
    if glyph.Colored != 0 {
        atlas.TexData.UseColors = true;
        atlas.TexPixelsUseColors = atlas.TexData.UseColors;
    }
    var codepoint = cast(i32, glyph.Codepoint);
    ImFontBaked_BuildGrowIndex(baked, codepoint + 1);
    baked.IndexAdvanceX.Data[codepoint] = glyph.AdvanceX;
    baked.IndexLookup.Data[codepoint] = cast(ImU16, glyph_idx);
    i32 page_n = codepoint / 8192;
    baked.OwnerFont.Used8kPagesMap[page_n >> 3] |= cast(ImU8, 1 << (page_n & 7));
    return glyph;
}

// FIXME: Code is duplicated with code above.
void ImFontAtlasBakedAddFontGlyphAdvancedX(ImFontAtlas* atlas, ImFontBaked* baked, ImFontConfig* src, ImWchar codepoint, f32 advance_x) {
    ignore atlas;
    if src != null {
        f32 ref_size = baked.OwnerFont.Sources.Data[0].SizePixels;
        f32 offsets_scale = ref_size != 0.0f ? baked.Size / ref_size : 1.0f;
        advance_x = ImClamp(advance_x, src.GlyphMinAdvanceX * offsets_scale, src.GlyphMaxAdvanceX * offsets_scale);
        if src.PixelSnapH != 0 {
            advance_x = cast(f32, cast(i32, advance_x + 0.5f));
        }
        advance_x += src.GlyphExtraAdvanceX;
    }
    ImFontBaked_BuildGrowIndex(baked, cast(i32, codepoint + 1));
    baked.IndexAdvanceX.Data[codepoint] = advance_x;
}

// Copy to texture, post-process and queue update for backend
void ImFontAtlasBakedSetFontGlyphBitmap(ImFontAtlas* atlas, ImFontBaked* baked, ImFontConfig* src, ImFontGlyph* glyph, ImTextureRect* r, u8* src_pixels, ImTextureFormat src_fmt, i32 src_pitch) {
    ImTextureData* tex = atlas.TexData;
    assert(r.x + r.w <= cast(u32, tex.Width) && r.y + r.h <= cast(u32, tex.Height));
    ImFontAtlasTextureBlockConvert(src_pixels, src_fmt, src_pitch, cast(u8*, ImTextureData_GetPixelsAt(tex, cast(i32, r.x), cast(i32, r.y))), tex.Format, ImTextureData_GetPitch(tex), cast(i32, r.w), cast(i32, r.h));
    var pp_data = ImFontAtlasPostProcessData{
        atlas, baked.OwnerFont, src, baked, glyph,
        ImTextureData_GetPixelsAt(tex, cast(i32, r.x), cast(i32, r.y)), tex.Format,
        ImTextureData_GetPitch(tex), r.w, r.h,
    };
    ImFontAtlasTextureBlockPostProcess(&pp_data);
    ImFontAtlasTextureBlockQueueUpload(atlas, tex, cast(i32, r.x), cast(i32, r.y), cast(i32, r.w), cast(i32, r.h));
}

void ImFont_AddRemapChar(ImFont* self, ImWchar from_codepoint, ImWchar to_codepoint) {

}

// Find glyph, load if necessary, return fallback if missing
ImFontGlyph* ImFontBaked_FindGlyph(ImFontBaked* self, ImWchar c) {
    if c < cast(u64, self.IndexLookup.Size) {
        var i = cast(i32, self.IndexLookup.Data[c]);
        if i == cast(i32, cast(ImU16, -2)) {
            return &self.Glyphs.Data[self.FallbackGlyphIndex];
        }
        if i != cast(i32, cast(ImU16, -1)) {
            return &self.Glyphs.Data[i];
        }
    }
    ImFontGlyph* glyph = ImFontBaked_BuildLoadGlyph(self, c, null);
    return glyph != null ? glyph : &self.Glyphs.Data[self.FallbackGlyphIndex];
}

// Attempt to load but when missing, return NULL instead of FallbackGlyph
ImFontGlyph* ImFontBaked_FindGlyphNoFallback(ImFontBaked* self, ImWchar c) {
    if c < cast(u64, self.IndexLookup.Size) {
        var i = cast(i32, self.IndexLookup.Data[c]);
        if i == cast(i32, cast(ImU16, -2)) {
            return null;
        }
        if i != cast(i32, cast(ImU16, -1)) {
            return &self.Glyphs.Data[i];
        }
    }
    self.LoadNoFallback = true;
    ImFontGlyph* glyph = ImFontBaked_BuildLoadGlyph(self, c, null);
    self.LoadNoFallback = false;
    return glyph;
}

bool ImFontBaked_IsGlyphLoaded(ImFontBaked* self, ImWchar c) {
    if c < cast(u64, self.IndexLookup.Size) {
        var i = cast(i32, self.IndexLookup.Data[c]);
        if i == cast(i32, cast(ImU16, -2)) {
            return false;
        }
        if i != cast(i32, cast(ImU16, -1)) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}

// This is not fast query
bool ImFont_IsGlyphInFont(ImFont* self, ImWchar c) {
    ImFontAtlas* atlas = self.OwnerAtlas;
    ImFontAtlas_FontHookRemapCodepoint(atlas, self, &c);
    {
        ImFontConfig** zz_rf_it_46 = ImVector_ImFontConfig_ptr_begin(&self.Sources);
        ImFontConfig** zz_rf_end_46 = ImVector_ImFontConfig_ptr_end(&self.Sources);
        for ; zz_rf_it_46 != zz_rf_end_46; zz_rf_it_46++ {
            ImFontConfig* src = *zz_rf_it_46;
            ImFontLoader* loader = src.FontLoader != null ? src.FontLoader : atlas.FontLoader;
            if loader.FontSrcContainsGlyph != null && loader.FontSrcContainsGlyph(atlas, src, c) {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}

// This is manually inlined in CalcTextSizeA() and CalcWordWrapPosition(), with a non-inline call to BuildLoadGlyphGetAdvanceOrFallback().
f32 ImFontBaked_GetCharAdvance(ImFontBaked* self, ImWchar c) {
    if cast(i32, c) < self.IndexAdvanceX.Size {
        f32 x = self.IndexAdvanceX.Data[c];
        if x >= 0.0f {
            return x;
        }
    }
    return ImFontBaked_BuildLoadGlyphAdvanceX(self, c);
}

ImGuiID ImFontAtlasBakedGetId(ImGuiID font_id, f32 baked_size, f32 rasterizer_density) {
    hashed_data_t hashed_data;
    hashed_data.FontId = font_id;
    hashed_data.BakedSize = baked_size;
    hashed_data.RasterizerDensity = rasterizer_density;
    return ImHashData(&hashed_data, cast(u64, sizeof(hashed_data)), 0);
}

// ImFontBaked pointers are valid for the entire frame but shall never be kept between frames.
ImFontBaked* ImFont_GetFontBaked(ImFont* self, f32 size, f32 density) {
    ImFontBaked* baked = self.LastBaked;
    size = ImGui_GetRoundedFontSize(size);
    if density < 0.0f {
        density = self.CurrentRasterizerDensity;
    }
    if baked && baked.Size == size && baked.RasterizerDensity == density {
        return baked;
    }
    ImFontAtlas* atlas = self.OwnerAtlas;
    ImFontAtlasBuilder* builder = atlas.Builder;
    baked = ImFontAtlasBakedGetOrAdd(atlas, self, size, density);
    if baked == null {
        return null;
    }
    baked.LastUsedFrame = builder.FrameCount;
    self.LastBaked = baked;
    return baked;
}

ImFontBaked* ImFontAtlasBakedGetOrAdd(ImFontAtlas* atlas, ImFont* font, f32 font_size, f32 font_rasterizer_density) {
    assert(font_size > 0.0f && font_rasterizer_density > 0.0f);
    ImGuiID baked_id = ImFontAtlasBakedGetId(font.FontId, font_size, font_rasterizer_density);
    ImFontAtlasBuilder* builder = atlas.Builder;
    var p_baked_in_map = cast(ImFontBaked**, ImGuiStorage_GetVoidPtrRef(&builder.BakedMap, baked_id, null));
    ImFontBaked* baked = *p_baked_in_map;
    if baked != null {
        assert(baked.Size == font_size && baked.OwnerFont == font && baked.BakedId == baked_id);
        return baked;
    }
    if font.Flags & ImFontFlags_LockBakedSizes || atlas.Locked {
        baked = ImFontAtlasBakedGetClosestMatch(atlas, font, font_size, font_rasterizer_density);
        if baked != null {
            return baked;
        }
        if atlas.Locked != 0 {
            assert(!atlas.Locked && "Cannot use dynamic font size with a locked ImFontAtlas!");
            return null;
        }
    }
    baked = ImFontAtlasBakedAdd(atlas, font, font_size, font_rasterizer_density, baked_id);
    *p_baked_in_map = baked;
    return baked;
}

// Trim trailing space and find beginning of next line
u8* ImTextCalcWordWrapNextLineStart(u8* text, u8* text_end, ImDrawTextFlags flags) {
    if (flags & ImDrawTextFlags_WrapKeepBlanks) == 0 {
        while text < text_end && ImCharIsBlankA(*text) {
            text++;
        }
    }
    if text < text_end && *text == 10 {
        text++;
    }
    return text;
}

void ImTextClassifierClear(ImU32* bits, u32 codepoint_min, u32 codepoint_end, ImWcharClass char_class) {
    for u32 c = codepoint_min; c < codepoint_end; c++ {
        ImTextClassifierSetCharClass(bits, codepoint_min, codepoint_end, char_class, c);
    }
}

void ImTextClassifierSetCharClass(ImU32* bits, u32 codepoint_min, u32 codepoint_end, ImWcharClass char_class, u32 c) {
    assert(c >= codepoint_min && c < codepoint_end);
    ignore codepoint_end;
    c -= codepoint_min;
    ImU32 shift = (c & 15) << 1;
    bits[c >> 4] = bits[c >> 4] & ~(0x03 << shift) | char_class << shift;
}

void ImTextClassifierSetCharClassFromStr(ImU32* bits, u32 codepoint_min, u32 codepoint_end, ImWcharClass char_class, u8* s) {
    u8* s_end = s + strlen(s);
    while *s != 0 {
        u32 c;
        s += ImTextCharFromUtf8(&c, s, s_end);
        ImTextClassifierSetCharClass(bits, codepoint_min, codepoint_end, char_class, c);
    }
}
// 2-bit per character
private {
ImU32[128 / 16] g_CharClassifierIsSeparator_0000_007f;
ImU32[16 / 16] g_CharClassifierIsSeparator_3000_300f;
}

void ImTextInitClassifiers() {
    if (g_CharClassifierIsSeparator_0000_007f[44 >> 4] >> cast(u32, (44 & 15) << 1) & 0x03) != 0 {
        return;
    }
    ImTextClassifierClear(g_CharClassifierIsSeparator_0000_007f, 0, 128, ImWcharClass_Other);
    ImTextClassifierSetCharClassFromStr(g_CharClassifierIsSeparator_0000_007f, 0, 128, ImWcharClass_Blank, " \t");
    ImTextClassifierSetCharClassFromStr(g_CharClassifierIsSeparator_0000_007f, 0, 128, ImWcharClass_Punct, ".,;!?\"");
    ImTextClassifierClear(g_CharClassifierIsSeparator_3000_300f, 0x3000, 0x300F, ImWcharClass_Other);
    ImTextClassifierSetCharClass(g_CharClassifierIsSeparator_3000_300f, 0x3000, 0x300F, ImWcharClass_Blank, 0x3000);
    ImTextClassifierSetCharClass(g_CharClassifierIsSeparator_3000_300f, 0x3000, 0x300F, ImWcharClass_Punct, 0x3001);
    ImTextClassifierSetCharClass(g_CharClassifierIsSeparator_3000_300f, 0x3000, 0x300F, ImWcharClass_Punct, 0x3002);
}

// Simple word-wrapping for English, not full-featured. Please submit failing cases!
// This will return the next location to wrap from. If no wrapping if necessary, this will fast-forward to e.g. text_end.
// Refer to imgui_test_suite's "drawlist_text_wordwrap_1" for tests.
u8* ImFontCalcWordWrapPositionEx(ImFont* font, f32 size, u8* text, u8* text_end, f32 wrap_width, ImDrawTextFlags flags) {
    ImFontBaked* baked = ImFont_GetFontBaked(font, size, -1.0f);
    f32 scale = size / baked.Size;
    f32 line_width = 0.0f;
    f32 blank_width = 0.0f;
    wrap_width /= scale;
    u8* s = text;
    assert(text_end != null);
    i32 prev_type = ImWcharClass_Other;
    bool keep_blanks = (flags & ImDrawTextFlags_WrapKeepBlanks) != 0;
    u8* span_end = s;
    f32 span_width = 0.0f;
    while s < text_end {
        var c = cast(u32, *s);
        u8* next_s;
        if c < 0x80 {
            next_s = s + 1;
        } else {
            next_s = s + ImTextCharFromUtf8(&c, s, text_end);
        }
        if c < 32 {
            if c == 10 {
                return s;
            }
            if c == 13 {
                s = next_s;
                continue;
            }
        }
        f32 char_width = c < cast(u32, baked.IndexAdvanceX.Size) ? baked.IndexAdvanceX.Data[c] : -1.0f;
        if char_width < 0.0f {
            char_width = BuildLoadGlyphGetAdvanceOrFallback(baked, c);
        }
        i32 curr_type;
        if c < 128 {
            curr_type = cast(i32, g_CharClassifierIsSeparator_0000_007f[c >> 4] >> ((c & 15) << 1) & 0x03);
        } else if c >= 0x3000 && c < 0x3010 {
            curr_type = cast(i32, g_CharClassifierIsSeparator_3000_300f[(c & 15) >> 4] >> ((c & 15 & 15) << 1) & 0x03);
        } else {
            curr_type = ImWcharClass_Other;
        }
        if curr_type == ImWcharClass_Blank {
            if prev_type != ImWcharClass_Blank && !keep_blanks {
                span_end = s;
                line_width += span_width;
                span_width = 0.0f;
            }
            blank_width += char_width;
        } else {
            if prev_type == ImWcharClass_Punct && curr_type != ImWcharClass_Punct && !(c >= 48 && c <= 57) {
                span_end = s;
                line_width += span_width + blank_width;
                blank_width = 0.0f;
                span_width = blank_width;
            } else if prev_type == ImWcharClass_Blank && keep_blanks {
                span_end = s;
                line_width += span_width + blank_width;
                blank_width = 0.0f;
                span_width = blank_width;
            }
            span_width += char_width;
        }
        if span_width + blank_width + line_width > wrap_width {
            if span_width + blank_width > wrap_width {
                break;
            }
            return span_end;
        }
        prev_type = curr_type;
        s = next_s;
    }
    if s == text && text < text_end {
        return s + ImTextCountUtf8BytesFromChar(s, text_end);
    }
    return s;
}

u8* ImFont_CalcWordWrapPosition(ImFont* self, f32 size, u8* text, u8* text_end, f32 wrap_width) {
    return ImFontCalcWordWrapPositionEx(self, size, text, text_end, wrap_width, ImDrawTextFlags_None);
}

ImVec2 ImFontCalcTextSizeEx(ImFont* font, f32 size, f32 max_width, f32 wrap_width, u8* text_begin, u8* text_end_display, u8* text_end, u8** out_remaining, ImVec2* out_offset, ImDrawTextFlags flags) {
    if text_end == null {
        text_end = text_begin + strlen(text_begin);
    }
    if text_end_display == null {
        text_end_display = text_end;
    }
    ImFontBaked* baked = ImFont_GetFontBaked(font, size, -1.0f);
    f32 line_height = size;
    f32 scale = line_height / baked.Size;
    var text_size = ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f};
    f32 line_width = 0.0f;
    bool word_wrap_enabled = wrap_width > 0.0f;
    u8* word_wrap_eol = null;
    u8* s = text_begin;
    while s < text_end_display {
        if word_wrap_enabled != 0 {
            if word_wrap_eol == null {
                word_wrap_eol = ImFontCalcWordWrapPositionEx(font, size, s, text_end, wrap_width - line_width, flags);
            }
            if s >= word_wrap_eol {
                if text_size.x < line_width {
                    text_size.x = line_width;
                }
                text_size.y += line_height;
                line_width = 0.0f;
                s = ImTextCalcWordWrapNextLineStart(s, text_end, flags);
                if (flags & ImDrawTextFlags_StopOnNewLine) != 0 {
                    break;
                }
                word_wrap_eol = null;
                continue;
            }
        }
        u8* prev_s = s;
        var c = cast(u32, *s);
        if c < 0x80 {
            s += 1;
        } else {
            s += ImTextCharFromUtf8(&c, s, text_end);
        }
        if c == 10 {
            text_size.x = ImMax(text_size.x, line_width);
            text_size.y += line_height;
            line_width = 0.0f;
            if (flags & ImDrawTextFlags_StopOnNewLine) != 0 {
                break;
            }
            continue;
        }
        if c == 13 {
            continue;
        }
        f32 char_width = c < cast(u32, baked.IndexAdvanceX.Size) ? baked.IndexAdvanceX.Data[c] : -1.0f;
        if char_width < 0.0f {
            char_width = BuildLoadGlyphGetAdvanceOrFallback(baked, c);
        }
        char_width *= scale;
        if line_width + char_width >= max_width {
            s = prev_s;
            break;
        }
        line_width += char_width;
    }
    if text_size.x < line_width {
        text_size.x = line_width;
    }
    if out_offset != null {
        *out_offset = ImVec2{line_width, text_size.y + line_height};
    }
    if line_width > 0.0f || text_size.y == 0.0f {
        text_size.y += line_height;
    }
    if out_remaining != null {
        *out_remaining = s;
    }
    return text_size;
}

ImVec2 ImFont_CalcTextSizeA(ImFont* self, f32 size, f32 max_width, f32 wrap_width, u8* text_begin, u8* text_end, u8** out_remaining) {
    return ImFontCalcTextSizeEx(self, size, max_width, wrap_width, text_begin, text_end, text_end, out_remaining, null, ImDrawTextFlags_None);
}

// Note: as with every ImDrawList drawing function, this expects that the font atlas texture is bound.
void ImFont_RenderChar(ImFont* self, ImDrawList* draw_list, f32 size, ImVec2 pos, ImU32 col, ImWchar c, ImVec4* cpu_fine_clip) {
    ImFontBaked* baked = ImFont_GetFontBaked(self, size, -1.0f);
    ImFontGlyph* glyph = ImFontBaked_FindGlyph(baked, c);
    if !glyph || !glyph.Visible {
        return;
    }
    if glyph.Colored != 0 {
        col |= cast(u32, ~0xFF000000);
    }
    f32 scale = size >= 0.0f ? size / baked.Size : 1.0f;
    f32 x = pos.x;
    f32 y = pos.y;
    if (draw_list.Flags & ImDrawListFlags_TextNoPixelSnap) == 0 {
        x = cast(f32, cast(i32, x));
        y = cast(f32, cast(i32, y));
    }
    f32 x1 = x + glyph.X0 * scale;
    f32 x2 = x + glyph.X1 * scale;
    if cpu_fine_clip && (x1 > cpu_fine_clip.z || x2 < cpu_fine_clip.x) {
        return;
    }
    f32 y1 = y + glyph.Y0 * scale;
    f32 y2 = y + glyph.Y1 * scale;
    f32 u1 = glyph.U0;
    f32 v1 = glyph.V0;
    f32 u2 = glyph.U1;
    f32 v2 = glyph.V1;
    if cpu_fine_clip != null {
        if x1 < cpu_fine_clip.x {
            u1 = u1 + (1.0f - (x2 - cpu_fine_clip.x) / (x2 - x1)) * (u2 - u1);
            x1 = cpu_fine_clip.x;
        }
        if y1 < cpu_fine_clip.y {
            v1 = v1 + (1.0f - (y2 - cpu_fine_clip.y) / (y2 - y1)) * (v2 - v1);
            y1 = cpu_fine_clip.y;
        }
        if x2 > cpu_fine_clip.z {
            u2 = u1 + (cpu_fine_clip.z - x1) / (x2 - x1) * (u2 - u1);
            x2 = cpu_fine_clip.z;
        }
        if y2 > cpu_fine_clip.w {
            v2 = v1 + (cpu_fine_clip.w - y1) / (y2 - y1) * (v2 - v1);
            y2 = cpu_fine_clip.w;
        }
        if y1 >= y2 {
            return;
        }
    }
    ImDrawList_PrimReserve(draw_list, 6, 4);
    ImDrawList_PrimRectUV(draw_list, ImVec2{x1, y1}, ImVec2{x2, y2}, ImVec2{u1, v1}, ImVec2{u2, v2}, col);
}

// Note: as with every ImDrawList drawing function, this expects that the font atlas texture is bound.
// DO NOT CALL DIRECTLY THIS WILL CHANGE WILDLY IN 2026. Use ImDrawList::AddText().
void ImFont_RenderText(ImFont* self, ImDrawList* draw_list, f32 size, ImVec2 pos, ImU32 col, ImVec4 clip_rect, u8* text_begin, u8* text_end, f32 wrap_width, ImDrawTextFlags flags) {
    while true {
        f32 x = pos.x;
        f32 y = pos.y;
        if y > clip_rect.w {
            return;
        }
        if (draw_list.Flags & ImDrawListFlags_TextNoPixelSnap) == 0 {
            x = cast(f32, cast(i32, x));
            y = cast(f32, cast(i32, y));
        }
        if text_end == null {
            text_end = text_begin + strlen(text_begin);
        }
        f32 line_height = size;
        ImFontBaked* baked = ImFont_GetFontBaked(self, size, -1.0f);
        f32 scale = size / baked.Size;
        f32 origin_x = x;
        bool word_wrap_enabled = wrap_width > 0.0f;
        u8* s = text_begin;
        if y + line_height < clip_rect.y {
            while y + line_height < clip_rect.y && s < text_end {
                var line_end = cast(u8*, memchr(s, 10, cast(i64, text_end - s)));
                if word_wrap_enabled != 0 {
                    s = ImFontCalcWordWrapPositionEx(self, size, s, line_end != null ? line_end : text_end, wrap_width, flags);
                    s = ImTextCalcWordWrapNextLineStart(s, text_end, flags);
                } else {
                    s = line_end != null ? line_end + 1 : text_end;
                }
                y += line_height;
            }
        }
        if cast(i64, text_end - s) > 10000 && !word_wrap_enabled {
            u8* s_end = s;
            f32 y_end = y;
            while y_end < clip_rect.w && s_end < text_end {
                s_end = cast(u8*, memchr(s_end, 10, cast(i64, text_end - s_end)));
                s_end = s_end != null ? s_end + 1 : text_end;
                y_end += line_height;
            }
            text_end = s_end;
        }
        if s == text_end {
            return;
        }
        i32 vtx_count_max = cast(i32, cast(i64, text_end - s)) * 4;
        i32 idx_count_max = cast(i32, cast(i64, text_end - s)) * 6;
        i32 idx_expected_size = draw_list.IdxBuffer.Size + idx_count_max;
        ImDrawList_PrimReserve(draw_list, idx_count_max, vtx_count_max);
        ImDrawVert* vtx_write = draw_list._VtxWritePtr;
        ImDrawIdx* idx_write = draw_list._IdxWritePtr;
        u32 vtx_index = draw_list._VtxCurrentIdx;
        i32 cmd_count = draw_list.CmdBuffer.Size;
        bool cpu_fine_clip = (flags & ImDrawTextFlags_CpuFineClip) != 0;
        ImU32 col_untinted = col | cast(u32, ~0xFF000000);
        u8* word_wrap_eol = null;
        while s < text_end {
            if word_wrap_enabled != 0 {
                if word_wrap_eol == null {
                    word_wrap_eol = ImFontCalcWordWrapPositionEx(self, size, s, text_end, wrap_width - (x - origin_x), flags);
                }
                if s >= word_wrap_eol {
                    x = origin_x;
                    y += line_height;
                    if y > clip_rect.w {
                        break;
                    }
                    word_wrap_eol = null;
                    s = ImTextCalcWordWrapNextLineStart(s, text_end, flags);
                    continue;
                }
            }
            var c = cast(u32, *s);
            if c < 0x80 {
                s += 1;
            } else {
                s += ImTextCharFromUtf8(&c, s, text_end);
            }
            if c < 32 {
                if c == 10 {
                    x = origin_x;
                    y += line_height;
                    if y > clip_rect.w {
                        break;
                    }
                    continue;
                }
                if c == 13 {
                    continue;
                }
            }
            ImFontGlyph* glyph = ImFontBaked_FindGlyph(baked, cast(ImWchar, c));
            f32 char_width = glyph.AdvanceX * scale;
            if glyph.Visible != 0 {
                f32 x1 = x + glyph.X0 * scale;
                f32 x2 = x + glyph.X1 * scale;
                f32 y1 = y + glyph.Y0 * scale;
                f32 y2 = y + glyph.Y1 * scale;
                if x1 <= clip_rect.z && x2 >= clip_rect.x {
                    f32 u1 = glyph.U0;
                    f32 v1 = glyph.V0;
                    f32 u2 = glyph.U1;
                    f32 v2 = glyph.V1;
                    if cpu_fine_clip != 0 {
                        if x1 < clip_rect.x {
                            u1 = u1 + (1.0f - (x2 - clip_rect.x) / (x2 - x1)) * (u2 - u1);
                            x1 = clip_rect.x;
                        }
                        if y1 < clip_rect.y {
                            v1 = v1 + (1.0f - (y2 - clip_rect.y) / (y2 - y1)) * (v2 - v1);
                            y1 = clip_rect.y;
                        }
                        if x2 > clip_rect.z {
                            u2 = u1 + (clip_rect.z - x1) / (x2 - x1) * (u2 - u1);
                            x2 = clip_rect.z;
                        }
                        if y2 > clip_rect.w {
                            v2 = v1 + (clip_rect.w - y1) / (y2 - y1) * (v2 - v1);
                            y2 = clip_rect.w;
                        }
                        if y1 >= y2 {
                            x += char_width;
                            continue;
                        }
                    }
                    ImU32 glyph_col = glyph.Colored != 0 ? col_untinted : col;
                    {
                        vtx_write[0].pos.x = x1;
                        vtx_write[0].pos.y = y1;
                        vtx_write[0].col = glyph_col;
                        vtx_write[0].uv.x = u1;
                        vtx_write[0].uv.y = v1;
                        vtx_write[1].pos.x = x2;
                        vtx_write[1].pos.y = y1;
                        vtx_write[1].col = glyph_col;
                        vtx_write[1].uv.x = u2;
                        vtx_write[1].uv.y = v1;
                        vtx_write[2].pos.x = x2;
                        vtx_write[2].pos.y = y2;
                        vtx_write[2].col = glyph_col;
                        vtx_write[2].uv.x = u2;
                        vtx_write[2].uv.y = v2;
                        vtx_write[3].pos.x = x1;
                        vtx_write[3].pos.y = y2;
                        vtx_write[3].col = glyph_col;
                        vtx_write[3].uv.x = u1;
                        vtx_write[3].uv.y = v2;
                        idx_write[0] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_index);
                        idx_write[1] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_index + 1);
                        idx_write[2] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_index + 2);
                        idx_write[3] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_index);
                        idx_write[4] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_index + 2);
                        idx_write[5] = cast(ImDrawIdx, vtx_index + 3);
                        vtx_write += 4;
                        vtx_index += 4;
                        idx_write += 6;
                    }
                }
            }
            x += char_width;
        }
        if cmd_count != draw_list.CmdBuffer.Size {
            assert(draw_list.CmdBuffer.Data[draw_list.CmdBuffer.Size - 1].ElemCount == 0);
            ImVector_ImDrawCmd_pop_back(&draw_list.CmdBuffer);
            ImDrawList_PrimUnreserve(draw_list, idx_count_max, vtx_count_max);
            ImDrawList_AddDrawCmd(draw_list);
            continue;
        }
        draw_list.VtxBuffer.Size = cast(i32, cast(i64, vtx_write - draw_list.VtxBuffer.Data));
        draw_list.IdxBuffer.Size = cast(i32, cast(i64, idx_write - draw_list.IdxBuffer.Data));
        draw_list.CmdBuffer.Data[draw_list.CmdBuffer.Size - 1].ElemCount -= cast(u32, idx_expected_size - draw_list.IdxBuffer.Size);
        draw_list._VtxWritePtr = vtx_write;
        draw_list._IdxWritePtr = idx_write;
        draw_list._VtxCurrentIdx = vtx_index;
        break;
    }
}

// Render an arrow aimed to be aligned with text (p_min is a position in the same space text would be positioned). To e.g. denote expanded/collapsed state
void ImGui_RenderArrow(ImDrawList* draw_list, ImVec2 pos, ImU32 col, ImGuiDir dir, f32 scale) {
    f32 h = draw_list._Data.FontSize * 1.0f;
    f32 r = h * 0.4f * scale;
    ImVec2 center = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(pos, ImVec2{h * 0.5f, h * 0.5f * scale});
    ImVec2 a;
    ImVec2 b;
    ImVec2 c;
    switch dir {
        case ImGuiDir_Up, ImGuiDir_Down: {
            if dir == ImGuiDir_Up {
                r = -r;
            }
            a = op_mul_ImVec2_float(ImVec2{0.0f, 0.75f}, r);
            b = op_mul_ImVec2_float(ImVec2{-0.866f, -0.75f}, r);
            c = op_mul_ImVec2_float(ImVec2{0.866f, -0.75f}, r);
        }
        case ImGuiDir_Left, ImGuiDir_Right: {
            if dir == ImGuiDir_Left {
                r = -r;
            }
            a = op_mul_ImVec2_float(ImVec2{0.75f, 0.0f}, r);
            b = op_mul_ImVec2_float(ImVec2{-0.75f, 0.866f}, r);
            c = op_mul_ImVec2_float(ImVec2{-0.75f, -0.866f}, r);
        }
        case ImGuiDir_None, ImGuiDir_COUNT: {
            assert(0);
        }
    }
    ImDrawList_AddTriangleFilled(draw_list, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(center, a), op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(center, b), op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(center, c), col);
}

void ImGui_RenderBullet(ImDrawList* draw_list, ImVec2 pos, ImU32 col) {
    f32 font_size = draw_list._Data.FontSize;
    ImDrawList_AddCircleFilled(draw_list, pos, font_size * 0.2f, col, font_size < 22.0f ? 8 : font_size < 40.0f ? 12 : 0);
}

void ImGui_RenderCheckMark(ImDrawList* draw_list, ImVec2 pos, ImU32 col, f32 sz) {
    f32 thickness = ImMax(sz / 5.0f, 1.0f);
    sz -= thickness * 0.5f;
    pos = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(pos, ImVec2{thickness * 0.25f, thickness * 0.25f});
    f32 third = sz / 3.0f;
    f32 bx = pos.x + third;
    f32 by = pos.y + sz - third * 0.5f;
    ImDrawList_PathLineTo(draw_list, ImVec2{bx - third, by - third});
    ImDrawList_PathLineTo(draw_list, ImVec2{bx, by});
    ImDrawList_PathLineTo(draw_list, ImVec2{bx + third * 2.0f, by - third * 2.0f});
    ImDrawList_PathStroke(draw_list, col, thickness, 0);
}

// Render an arrow. 'pos' is position of the arrow tip. half_sz.x is length from base to tip. half_sz.y is length on each side.
void ImGui_RenderArrowPointingAt(ImDrawList* draw_list, ImVec2 pos, ImVec2 half_sz, ImGuiDir direction, ImU32 col) {
    switch direction {
        case ImGuiDir_Left: {
            ImDrawList_AddTriangleFilled(draw_list, ImVec2{pos.x + half_sz.x, pos.y - half_sz.y}, ImVec2{pos.x + half_sz.x, pos.y + half_sz.y}, pos, col);
            return;
        }
        case ImGuiDir_Right: {
            ImDrawList_AddTriangleFilled(draw_list, ImVec2{pos.x - half_sz.x, pos.y + half_sz.y}, ImVec2{pos.x - half_sz.x, pos.y - half_sz.y}, pos, col);
            return;
        }
        case ImGuiDir_Up: {
            ImDrawList_AddTriangleFilled(draw_list, ImVec2{pos.x + half_sz.x, pos.y + half_sz.y}, ImVec2{pos.x - half_sz.x, pos.y + half_sz.y}, pos, col);
            return;
        }
        case ImGuiDir_Down: {
            ImDrawList_AddTriangleFilled(draw_list, ImVec2{pos.x - half_sz.x, pos.y - half_sz.y}, ImVec2{pos.x + half_sz.x, pos.y - half_sz.y}, pos, col);
            return;
        }
        case ImGuiDir_None, ImGuiDir_COUNT: {
        }
    }
}

// This is less wide than RenderArrow() and we use in dock nodes instead of the regular RenderArrow() to denote a change of functionality,
// and because the saved space means that the left-most tab label can stay at exactly the same position as the label of a loose window.
void ImGui_RenderArrowDockMenu(ImDrawList* draw_list, ImVec2 p_min, f32 sz, ImU32 col) {
    ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(draw_list, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(p_min, ImVec2{sz * 0.2f, sz * 0.15f}), op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(p_min, ImVec2{sz * 0.8f, sz * 0.3f}), col, 0.0f, 0);
    ImGui_RenderArrowPointingAt(draw_list, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(p_min, ImVec2{sz * 0.5f, sz * 0.85f}), ImVec2{sz * 0.3f, sz * 0.4f}, ImGuiDir_Down, col);
}

private {
f32 ImAcos01(f32 x) {
    if x <= 0.0f {
        return 3.141592653589793f * 0.5f;
    }
    if x >= 1.0f {
        return 0.0f;
    }
    return acos(x);
}
}

// FIXME: Cleanup and move code to ImDrawList.
// - Before 2025-12-04: RenderRectFilledRangeH()   with 'float x_start_norm, float x_end_norm` <- normalized
// - After  2025-12-04: RenderRectFilledInRangeH() with 'float x1, float x2'                   <- absolute coords!!
void ImGui_RenderRectFilledInRangeH(ImDrawList* draw_list, ImRect rect, ImU32 col, f32 fill_x0, f32 fill_x1, f32 rounding) {
    if fill_x0 > fill_x1 {
        return;
    }
    var p0 = ImVec2{fill_x0, rect.Min.y};
    var p1 = ImVec2{fill_x1, rect.Max.y};
    if rounding == 0.0f {
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(draw_list, p0, p1, col, 0.0f, 0);
        return;
    }
    rounding = ImClamp(ImMin((rect.Max.x - rect.Min.x) * 0.5f, (rect.Max.y - rect.Min.y) * 0.5f) - 1.0f, 0.0f, rounding);
    f32 inv_rounding = 1.0f / rounding;
    f32 arc0_b = ImAcos01(1.0f - (p0.x - rect.Min.x) * inv_rounding);
    f32 arc0_e = ImAcos01(1.0f - (p1.x - rect.Min.x) * inv_rounding);
    f32 half_pi = 3.141592653589793f * 0.5f;
    f32 x0 = ImMax(p0.x, rect.Min.x + rounding);
    if arc0_b == arc0_e {
        ImDrawList_PathLineTo(draw_list, ImVec2{x0, p1.y});
        ImDrawList_PathLineTo(draw_list, ImVec2{x0, p0.y});
    } else if arc0_b == 0.0f && arc0_e == half_pi {
        ImDrawList_PathArcToFast(draw_list, ImVec2{x0, p1.y - rounding}, rounding, 3, 6);
        ImDrawList_PathArcToFast(draw_list, ImVec2{x0, p0.y + rounding}, rounding, 6, 9);
    } else {
        ImDrawList_PathArcTo(draw_list, ImVec2{x0, p1.y - rounding}, rounding, 3.141592653589793f - arc0_e, 3.141592653589793f - arc0_b, 0);
        ImDrawList_PathArcTo(draw_list, ImVec2{x0, p0.y + rounding}, rounding, 3.141592653589793f + arc0_b, 3.141592653589793f + arc0_e, 0);
    }
    if p1.x > rect.Min.x + rounding {
        f32 arc1_b = ImAcos01(1.0f - (rect.Max.x - p1.x) * inv_rounding);
        f32 arc1_e = ImAcos01(1.0f - (rect.Max.x - p0.x) * inv_rounding);
        f32 x1 = ImMin(p1.x, rect.Max.x - rounding);
        if arc1_b == arc1_e {
            ImDrawList_PathLineTo(draw_list, ImVec2{x1, p0.y});
            ImDrawList_PathLineTo(draw_list, ImVec2{x1, p1.y});
        } else if arc1_b == 0.0f && arc1_e == half_pi {
            ImDrawList_PathArcToFast(draw_list, ImVec2{x1, p0.y + rounding}, rounding, 9, 12);
            ImDrawList_PathArcToFast(draw_list, ImVec2{x1, p1.y - rounding}, rounding, 0, 3);
        } else {
            ImDrawList_PathArcTo(draw_list, ImVec2{x1, p0.y + rounding}, rounding, -arc1_e, -arc1_b, 0);
            ImDrawList_PathArcTo(draw_list, ImVec2{x1, p1.y - rounding}, rounding, arc1_b, arc1_e, 0);
        }
    }
    ImDrawList_PathFillConvex(draw_list, col);
}

void ImGui_RenderRectFilledWithHole(ImDrawList* draw_list, ImRect outer, ImRect inner, ImU32 col, f32 rounding) {
    bool fill_L = inner.Min.x > outer.Min.x;
    bool fill_R = inner.Max.x < outer.Max.x;
    bool fill_U = inner.Min.y > outer.Min.y;
    bool fill_D = inner.Max.y < outer.Max.y;
    if fill_L != 0 {
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(draw_list, ImVec2{outer.Min.x, inner.Min.y}, ImVec2{inner.Min.x, inner.Max.y}, col, rounding, ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersNone | (fill_U != 0 ? 0 : ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersTopLeft) | (fill_D != 0 ? 0 : ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersBottomLeft));
    }
    if fill_R != 0 {
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(draw_list, ImVec2{inner.Max.x, inner.Min.y}, ImVec2{outer.Max.x, inner.Max.y}, col, rounding, ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersNone | (fill_U != 0 ? 0 : ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersTopRight) | (fill_D != 0 ? 0 : ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersBottomRight));
    }
    if fill_U != 0 {
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(draw_list, ImVec2{inner.Min.x, outer.Min.y}, ImVec2{inner.Max.x, inner.Min.y}, col, rounding, ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersNone | (fill_L != 0 ? 0 : ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersTopLeft) | (fill_R != 0 ? 0 : ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersTopRight));
    }
    if fill_D != 0 {
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(draw_list, ImVec2{inner.Min.x, inner.Max.y}, ImVec2{inner.Max.x, outer.Max.y}, col, rounding, ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersNone | (fill_L != 0 ? 0 : ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersBottomLeft) | (fill_R != 0 ? 0 : ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersBottomRight));
    }
    if fill_L && fill_U {
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(draw_list, ImVec2{outer.Min.x, outer.Min.y}, ImVec2{inner.Min.x, inner.Min.y}, col, rounding, ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersTopLeft);
    }
    if fill_R && fill_U {
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(draw_list, ImVec2{inner.Max.x, outer.Min.y}, ImVec2{outer.Max.x, inner.Min.y}, col, rounding, ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersTopRight);
    }
    if fill_L && fill_D {
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(draw_list, ImVec2{outer.Min.x, inner.Max.y}, ImVec2{inner.Min.x, outer.Max.y}, col, rounding, ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersBottomLeft);
    }
    if fill_R && fill_D {
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(draw_list, ImVec2{inner.Max.x, inner.Max.y}, ImVec2{outer.Max.x, outer.Max.y}, col, rounding, ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersBottomRight);
    }
}

ImDrawFlags ImGui_CalcRoundingFlagsForRectInRect(ImRect r_in, ImRect r_outer, f32 threshold) {
    bool round_l = r_in.Min.x <= r_outer.Min.x + threshold;
    bool round_r = r_in.Max.x >= r_outer.Max.x - threshold;
    bool round_t = r_in.Min.y <= r_outer.Min.y + threshold;
    bool round_b = r_in.Max.y >= r_outer.Max.y - threshold;
    return ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersNone | (round_t && round_l ? ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersTopLeft : 0) | (round_t && round_r ? ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersTopRight : 0) | (round_b && round_l ? ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersBottomLeft : 0) | (round_b && round_r ? ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersBottomRight : 0);
}

// Helper for ColorPicker4()
// NB: This is rather brittle and will show artifact when rounding this enabled if rounded corners overlap multiple cells. Caller currently responsible for avoiding that.
// Spent a non reasonable amount of time trying to getting this right for ColorButton with rounding+anti-aliasing+ImGuiColorEditFlags_HalfAlphaPreview flag + various grid sizes and offsets, and eventually gave up... probably more reasonable to disable rounding altogether.
// FIXME: uses ImGui::GetColorU32
void ImGui_RenderColorRectWithAlphaCheckerboard(ImDrawList* draw_list, ImVec2 p_min, ImVec2 p_max, ImU32 col, f32 grid_step, ImVec2 grid_off, f32 rounding, ImDrawFlags flags) {
    if (flags & ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersMask_) == 0 {
        flags = ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersDefault_;
    }
    if (col & 0xFF000000) >> 24 < 0xFF {
        ImU32 col_bg1 = ImGui_GetColorU32(ImAlphaBlendColors(cast(ImU32, 255) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 128) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 128) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 128) << 0, col));
        ImU32 col_bg2 = ImGui_GetColorU32(ImAlphaBlendColors(cast(ImU32, 255) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 204) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 204) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 204) << 0, col));
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(draw_list, p_min, p_max, col_bg1, rounding, flags);
        i32 yi = 0;
        for f32 y = p_min.y + grid_off.y; y < p_max.y; y += grid_step {
            f32 y1 = ImClamp(y, p_min.y, p_max.y);
            f32 y2 = ImMin(y + grid_step, p_max.y);
            if y2 <= y1 {
                yi++;
                continue;
            }
            for f32 x = p_min.x + grid_off.x + cast(f32, (yi ^ 1) & 1) * grid_step; x < p_max.x; x += grid_step * 2.0f {
                f32 x1 = ImClamp(x, p_min.x, p_max.x);
                f32 x2 = ImMin(x + grid_step, p_max.x);
                if x2 <= x1 {
                    continue;
                }
                ImDrawFlags cell_flags = ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersNone;
                if y1 <= p_min.y {
                    if x1 <= p_min.x {
                        cell_flags |= ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersTopLeft;
                    }
                    if x2 >= p_max.x {
                        cell_flags |= ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersTopRight;
                    }
                }
                if y2 >= p_max.y {
                    if x1 <= p_min.x {
                        cell_flags |= ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersBottomLeft;
                    }
                    if x2 >= p_max.x {
                        cell_flags |= ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersBottomRight;
                    }
                }
                cell_flags = flags == ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersNone || cell_flags == ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersNone ? ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersNone : cell_flags & flags;
                ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(draw_list, ImVec2{x1, y1}, ImVec2{x2, y2}, col_bg2, rounding, cell_flags);
            }
            yi++;
        }
    } else {
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(draw_list, p_min, p_max, col, rounding, flags);
    }
}

//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// [SECTION] Decompression code
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Compressed with stb_compress() then converted to a C array and encoded as base85.
// Use the program in misc/fonts/binary_to_compressed_c.cpp to create the array from a TTF file.
// The purpose of encoding as base85 instead of "0x00,0x01,..." style is only save on _source code_ size.
// Decompression from stb.h (public domain) by Sean Barrett https://github.com/nothings/stb/blob/master/stb.h
//-----------------------------------------------------------------------------
private {
u32 stb_decompress_length(u8* input) {
    return cast(u32, (cast(i32, input[8]) << 24) + (cast(i32, input[9]) << 16) + (cast(i32, input[10]) << 8) + input[11]);
}
}
private {
u8* stb__barrier_out_e;
u8* stb__barrier_out_b;
u8* stb__barrier_in_b;
u8* stb__dout;

void stb__match(u8* data, u32 length) {
    assert(stb__dout + length <= stb__barrier_out_e);
    if stb__dout + length > stb__barrier_out_e {
        stb__dout += length;
        return;
    }
    if data < stb__barrier_out_b {
        stb__dout = stb__barrier_out_e + 1;
        return;
    }
    while length-- != 0 {
        *stb__dout++ = *data++;
    }
}

void stb__lit(u8* data, u32 length) {
    assert(stb__dout + length <= stb__barrier_out_e);
    if stb__dout + length > stb__barrier_out_e {
        stb__dout += length;
        return;
    }
    if data < stb__barrier_in_b {
        stb__dout = stb__barrier_out_e + 1;
        return;
    }
    memcpy(stb__dout, data, cast(u64, length));
    stb__dout += length;
}

u8* stb_decompress_token(u8* i) {
    if *i >= 0x20 {
        if *i >= 0x80 {
            stb__match(stb__dout - i[1] - 1, i[0] - 0x80 + 1);
            i += 2;
        } else if *i >= 0x40 {
            stb__match(stb__dout - ((cast(i32, i[0]) << 8) + i[0 + 1] - 0x4000 + 1), i[2] + 1);
            i += 3;
        } else {
            stb__lit(i + 1, i[0] - 0x20 + 1);
            i += 1 + (i[0] - 0x20 + 1);
        }
    } else {
        if *i >= 0x18 {
            stb__match(stb__dout - ((cast(i32, i[0]) << 16) + ((cast(i32, i[0 + 1]) << 8) + i[0 + 1 + 1]) - 0x180000 + 1), i[3] + 1);
            i += 4;
        } else if *i >= 0x10 {
            stb__match(stb__dout - ((cast(i32, i[0]) << 16) + ((cast(i32, i[0 + 1]) << 8) + i[0 + 1 + 1]) - 0x100000 + 1), cast(u32, (cast(i32, i[3]) << 8) + i[3 + 1] + 1));
            i += 5;
        } else if *i >= 0x08 {
            stb__lit(i + 2, cast(u32, (cast(i32, i[0]) << 8) + i[0 + 1] - 0x0800 + 1));
            i += 2 + ((cast(i32, i[0]) << 8) + i[0 + 1] - 0x0800 + 1);
        } else if *i == 0x07 {
            stb__lit(i + 3, cast(u32, (cast(i32, i[1]) << 8) + i[1 + 1] + 1));
            i += 3 + ((cast(i32, i[1]) << 8) + i[1 + 1] + 1);
        } else if *i == 0x06 {
            stb__match(stb__dout - ((cast(i32, i[1]) << 16) + ((cast(i32, i[1 + 1]) << 8) + i[1 + 1 + 1]) + 1), i[4] + 1);
            i += 5;
        } else if *i == 0x04 {
            stb__match(stb__dout - ((cast(i32, i[1]) << 16) + ((cast(i32, i[1 + 1]) << 8) + i[1 + 1 + 1]) + 1), cast(u32, (cast(i32, i[4]) << 8) + i[4 + 1] + 1));
            i += 6;
        }
    }
    return i;
}

u32 stb_adler32(u32 adler32, u8* buffer, u32 buflen) {
    c_ulong ADLER_MOD = 65521;
    c_ulong s1 = adler32 & 0xffff;
    c_ulong s2 = adler32 >> 16;
    c_ulong blocklen = buflen % 5552;
    c_ulong i;
    while buflen != 0 {
        for i = 0; i + 7 < blocklen; i += 8 {
            s1 += buffer[0];
            s2 += s1;
            s1 += buffer[1];
            s2 += s1;
            s1 += buffer[2];
            s2 += s1;
            s1 += buffer[3];
            s2 += s1;
            s1 += buffer[4];
            s2 += s1;
            s1 += buffer[5];
            s2 += s1;
            s1 += buffer[6];
            s2 += s1;
            s1 += buffer[7];
            s2 += s1;
            buffer += 8;
        }
        for ; i < blocklen; ++i {
            s1 += *buffer++;
            s2 += s1;
        }
        s1 %= ADLER_MOD;
        s2 %= ADLER_MOD;
        buflen -= cast(u32, blocklen);
        blocklen = 5552;
    }
    return cast(u32, s2 << 16) + cast(u32, s1);
}

u32 stb_decompress(u8* output, u8* i, u32 _2) {
    if (cast(i32, i[0]) << 24) + ((cast(i32, i[0 + 1]) << 16) + ((cast(i32, i[0 + 1 + 1]) << 8) + i[0 + 1 + 1 + 1])) != 0x57bC0000 {
        return 0;
    }
    if (cast(i32, i[4]) << 24) + ((cast(i32, i[4 + 1]) << 16) + ((cast(i32, i[4 + 1 + 1]) << 8) + i[4 + 1 + 1 + 1])) != 0 {
        return 0;
    }
    u32 olen = stb_decompress_length(i);
    stb__barrier_in_b = i;
    stb__barrier_out_e = output + olen;
    stb__barrier_out_b = output;
    i += 16;
    stb__dout = output;
    while true {
        u8* old_i = i;
        i = stb_decompress_token(i);
        if i == old_i {
            if *i == 0x05 && i[1] == 0xfa {
                assert(stb__dout == output + olen);
                if stb__dout != output + olen {
                    return 0;
                }
                if stb_adler32(1, output, olen) != cast(u32, (cast(i32, i[2]) << 24) + ((cast(i32, i[2 + 1]) << 16) + ((cast(i32, i[2 + 1 + 1]) << 8) + i[2 + 1 + 1 + 1]))) {
                    return 0;
                }
                return olen;
            } else {
                assert(0);
                return 0;
            }
        }
        assert(stb__dout <= output + olen);
        if stb__dout > output + olen {
            return 0;
        }
    }
}

    ImVec2_init(&text_pos, window.DC.CursorPos.x, window.DC.CursorPos.y + window.DC.CurrLineTextBaseOffset);
    f32 wrap_pos_x = window.DC.TextWrapPos;
    bool wrap_enabled = wrap_pos_x >= 0.0f;

        f32 wrap_width = wrap_enabled != 0 ? ImGui_CalcWrapWidthForPos(window.DC.CursorPos, wrap_pos_x) : 0.0f;

            return;

                    var line_end = cast(u8*, memchr(line, 10, cast(i64, text_end - line)));
                    if line_end == null {
                        line_end = text_end;
                    }

                        text_size.x = ImMax(text_size.x, ImGui_CalcTextSize(line, line_end, false, -1.0f).x);
                    }

                }
                pos.y += cast(f32, lines_skipped) * line_height;
            }

                if ImGui_IsClippedEx(line_rect, 0) != 0 {
                    break;
                }
                var line_end = cast(u8*, memchr(line, 10, cast(i64, text_end - line)));
                if line_end == null {
                    line_end = text_end;
                }
                text_size.x = ImMax(text_size.x, ImGui_CalcTextSize(line, line_end, false, -1.0f).x);
                ImGui_RenderText(pos, line, line_end, false);
                line = line_end + 1;
                line_rect.Min.y += line_height;
                line_rect.Max.y += line_height;
                pos.y += line_height;
            }
            i32 lines_skipped = 0;
            while line < text_end {
                var line_end = cast(u8*, memchr(line, 10, cast(i64, text_end - line)));
                if line_end == null {
                    line_end = text_end;
                }
                if (flags & ImGuiTextFlags_NoWidthForLargeClippedText) == 0 {
                    text_size.x = ImMax(text_size.x, ImGui_CalcTextSize(line, line_end, false, -1.0f).x);
                }
                line = line_end + 1;
                lines_skipped++;
            }
            pos.y += cast(f32, lines_skipped) * line_height;
        }
        text_size.y = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(pos, text_pos).y;
        ImRect bb;
        ImRect_init(&bb, text_pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(text_pos, text_size));
        ImGui_ItemSize(text_size, 0.0f);
        ImGui_ItemAdd(bb, 0, null, 0);
    }
}

    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();

        return;
    }

    size_x = ImGui_CalcItemSize(ImVec2{size_x, 0.0f}, 0.0f, text_size.y).x;
    ImVec2 pos;
    ImVec2_init(&pos, window.DC.CursorPos.x, window.DC.CursorPos.y + window.DC.CurrLineTextBaseOffset);
    ImVec2 pos_max;
    ImVec2_init(&pos_max, pos.x + size_x, window.ClipRect.Max.y);
    ImVec2 size;
    ImVec2_init(&size, ImMin(size_x, text_size.x), text_size.y);
    window.DC.CursorMaxPos.x = ImMax(window.DC.CursorMaxPos.x, pos.x + text_size.x);
    window.DC.IdealMaxPos.x = ImMax(window.DC.IdealMaxPos.x, pos.x + text_size.x);
    if align_x > 0.0f && text_size.x < size_x {
        pos.x += ImTrunc((size_x - text_size.x) * align_x);
    }
    ImGui_RenderTextEllipsis(window.DrawList, pos, pos_max, pos_max.x, text, text_end, &text_size);
    ImVec2 backup_max_pos = window.DC.CursorMaxPos;
    ImGui_ItemSize(size);
    ImGui_ItemAdd(ImRect{pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(pos, size)}, 0, null, 0);

// - ButtonBehavior() [Internal]
// - Button()
// - SmallButton()
// - InvisibleButton()

// - CollapseButton() [Internal]
// - GetWindowScrollbarID() [Internal]
// - GetWindowScrollbarRect() [Internal]
// - Scrollbar() [Internal]

// - Image()
// - ImageButton()
