//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The ButtonBehavior() function is key to many interactions and used by many/most widgets.
// Because we handle so many cases (keyboard/gamepad navigation, drag and drop) and many specific behavior (via ImGuiButtonFlags_),
// this code is a little complex.
// By far the most common path is interacting with the Mouse using the default ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnClickRelease button behavior.
// See the series of events below and the corresponding state reported by dear imgui:
//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// with PressedOnClickRelease:             return-value  IsItemHovered()  IsItemActive()  IsItemActivated()  IsItemDeactivated()  IsItemClicked()
//   Frame N+0 (mouse is outside bb)        -             -                -               -                  -                    -
//   Frame N+1 (mouse moves inside bb)      -             true             -               -                  -                    -
//   Frame N+2 (mouse button is down)       -             true             true            true               -                    true
//   Frame N+3 (mouse button is down)       -             true             true            -                  -                    -
//   Frame N+4 (mouse moves outside bb)     -             -                true            -                  -                    -
//   Frame N+5 (mouse moves inside bb)      -             true             true            -                  -                    -
//   Frame N+6 (mouse button is released)   true          true             -               -                  true                 -
//   Frame N+7 (mouse button is released)   -             true             -               -                  -                    -
//   Frame N+8 (mouse moves outside bb)     -             -                -               -                  -                    -
//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// with PressedOnClick:                    return-value  IsItemHovered()  IsItemActive()  IsItemActivated()  IsItemDeactivated()  IsItemClicked()
//   Frame N+2 (mouse button is down)       true          true             true            true               -                    true
//   Frame N+3 (mouse button is down)       -             true             true            -                  -                    -
//   Frame N+6 (mouse button is released)   -             true             -               -                  true                 -
//   Frame N+7 (mouse button is released)   -             true             -               -                  -                    -
//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// with PressedOnRelease:                  return-value  IsItemHovered()  IsItemActive()  IsItemActivated()  IsItemDeactivated()  IsItemClicked()
//   Frame N+2 (mouse button is down)       -             true             -               -                  -                    true
//   Frame N+3 (mouse button is down)       -             true             -               -                  -                    -
//   Frame N+6 (mouse button is released)   true          true             -               -                  -                    -
//   Frame N+7 (mouse button is released)   -             true             -               -                  -                    -
//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// with PressedOnDoubleClick:              return-value  IsItemHovered()  IsItemActive()  IsItemActivated()  IsItemDeactivated()  IsItemClicked()
//   Frame N+0 (mouse button is down)       -             true             -               -                  -                    true
//   Frame N+1 (mouse button is down)       -             true             -               -                  -                    -
//   Frame N+2 (mouse button is released)   -             true             -               -                  -                    -
//   Frame N+3 (mouse button is released)   -             true             -               -                  -                    -
//   Frame N+4 (mouse button is down)       true          true             true            true               -                    true
//   Frame N+5 (mouse button is down)       -             true             true            -                  -                    -
//   Frame N+6 (mouse button is released)   -             true             -               -                  true                 -
//   Frame N+7 (mouse button is released)   -             true             -               -                  -                    -
//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Note that some combinations are supported,
// - PressedOnDragDropHold can generally be associated with any flag.
// - PressedOnDoubleClick can be associated by PressedOnClickRelease/PressedOnRelease, in which case the second release event won't be reported.
//------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// The behavior of the return-value changes when ImGuiItemFlags_ButtonRepeat is set:
//                                         Repeat+                  Repeat+           Repeat+             Repeat+
//                                         PressedOnClickRelease    PressedOnClick    PressedOnRelease    PressedOnDoubleClick
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
//   Frame N+0 (mouse button is down)       -                        true              -                   true
//   ...                                    -                        -                 -                   -
//   Frame N + RepeatDelay                  true                     true              -                   true
//   ...                                    -                        -                 -                   -
//   Frame N + RepeatDelay + RepeatRate*N   true                     true              -                   true
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
// - FIXME: For refactor we could output flags, incl mouse hovered vs nav keyboard vs nav triggered etc.
//   And better standardize how widgets use 'GetColor32((held && hovered) ? ... : hovered ? ...)' vs 'GetColor32(held ? ... : hovered ? ...);'
//   For mouse feedback we typically prefer the 'held && hovered' test, but for nav feedback not always. Outputting hovered=true on Activation may be misleading.
// - Since v1.91.2 (Sept 2024) we included io.ConfigDebugHighlightIdConflicts feature.
//   One idiom which was previously valid which will now emit a warning is when using multiple overlaid ButtonBehavior()
//   with same ID and different MouseButton (see #8030). You can fix it by:
//       (1) switching to use a single ButtonBehavior() with multiple _MouseButton flags.
//    or (2) surrounding those calls with PushItemFlag(ImGuiItemFlags_AllowDuplicateId, true); ... PopItemFlag()
bool ImGui_ButtonBehavior(ImRect bb, ImGuiID id, bool* out_hovered, bool* out_held, ImGuiButtonFlags flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    ImGuiItemFlags item_flags = g.LastItemData.ID == id ? g.LastItemData.ItemFlags : g.CurrentItemFlags;
    if (flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_AllowOverlap) != 0 {
        item_flags |= ImGuiItemFlags_AllowOverlap;
    }
    if (item_flags & ImGuiItemFlags_NoFocus) != 0 {
        flags |= ImGuiButtonFlags_NoFocus | ImGuiButtonFlags_NoNavFocus;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_MouseButtonMask_) == 0 {
        flags |= ImGuiButtonFlags_MouseButtonLeft;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnMask_) == 0 {
        flags |= (item_flags & ImGuiItemFlags_ButtonRepeat) != 0 ? ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnClick : ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnDefault_;
    }
    ImGuiWindow* backup_hovered_window = g.HoveredWindow;
    bool flatten_hovered_children = flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_FlattenChildren && g.HoveredWindow && g.HoveredWindow.RootWindowDockTree == window.RootWindowDockTree;
    if flatten_hovered_children != 0 {
        g.HoveredWindow = window;
    }
    if g.LastItemData.ID != id {
    }
    bool pressed = false;
    bool hovered = ImGui_ItemHoverable(bb, id, item_flags);
    if g.DragDropActive != 0 {
        if flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnDragDropHold && !(g.DragDropSourceFlags & ImGuiDragDropFlags_SourceNoHoldToOpenOthers) && ImGui_IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenBlockedByActiveItem) {
            hovered = true;
            ImGui_SetHoveredID(id);
            if g.HoveredIdTimer - g.IO.DeltaTime <= DRAGDROP_HOLD_TO_OPEN_TIMER && g.HoveredIdTimer >= DRAGDROP_HOLD_TO_OPEN_TIMER {
                pressed = true;
                g.DragDropHoldJustPressedId = id;
                ImGui_FocusWindow(window, 0);
            }
        }
        if g.DragDropAcceptIdPrev == id && g.DragDropAcceptFlagsPrev & ImGuiDragDropFlags_AcceptDrawAsHovered {
            hovered = true;
        }
    }
    if flatten_hovered_children != 0 {
        g.HoveredWindow = backup_hovered_window;
    }
    ImGuiID test_owner_id = (flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_NoTestKeyOwner) != 0 ? cast(ImGuiID, 0) : id;
    if hovered != 0 {
        assert(id != 0);
        i32 mouse_button_clicked = -1;
        i32 mouse_button_released = -1;
        for i32 button = 0; button < 3; button++ {
            if (flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_MouseButtonLeft << button) != 0 {
                if ImGui_IsMouseClicked(button, ImGuiInputFlags_None, test_owner_id) && mouse_button_clicked == -1 {
                    mouse_button_clicked = button;
                }
                if ImGui_IsMouseReleased(button, test_owner_id) && mouse_button_released == -1 {
                    mouse_button_released = button;
                }
            }
        }
        bool mods_ok = !(flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_NoKeyModsAllowed) || !g.IO.KeyCtrl && !g.IO.KeyShift && !g.IO.KeyAlt;
        if mods_ok != 0 {
            if mouse_button_clicked != -1 && g.ActiveId != id {
                if (flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_NoSetKeyOwner) == 0 {
                    ImGui_SetKeyOwner(ImGui_MouseButtonToKey(mouse_button_clicked), id, 0);
                }
                if (flags & (ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnClickRelease | ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnClickReleaseAnywhere)) != 0 {
                    ImGui_SetActiveID(id, window);
                    g.ActiveIdMouseButton = cast(ImS8, mouse_button_clicked);
                    if (flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_NoNavFocus) == 0 {
                        ImGui_SetFocusID(id, window);
                        ImGui_FocusWindow(window, 0);
                    } else if (flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_NoFocus) == 0 {
                        ImGui_FocusWindow(window, ImGuiFocusRequestFlags_RestoreFocusedChild);
                    }
                }
                if flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnClick || flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnDoubleClick && g.IO.MouseClickedCount[mouse_button_clicked] == 2 {
                    pressed = true;
                    if (flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_NoHoldingActiveId) != 0 {
                        ImGui_ClearActiveID();
                    } else {
                        ImGui_SetActiveID(id, window);
                    }
                    g.ActiveIdMouseButton = cast(ImS8, mouse_button_clicked);
                    if (flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_NoNavFocus) == 0 {
                        ImGui_SetFocusID(id, window);
                        ImGui_FocusWindow(window, 0);
                    } else if (flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_NoFocus) == 0 {
                        ImGui_FocusWindow(window, ImGuiFocusRequestFlags_RestoreFocusedChild);
                    }
                }
                if (flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnRelease) != 0 {
                    if (flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_NoHoldingActiveId) == 0 {
                        ImGui_SetActiveID(id, window);
                    }
                    g.ActiveIdMouseButton = cast(ImS8, mouse_button_clicked);
                }
            }
            if (flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnRelease) != 0 {
                if mouse_button_released != -1 {
                    bool has_repeated_at_least_once = item_flags & ImGuiItemFlags_ButtonRepeat && g.IO.MouseDownDurationPrev[mouse_button_released] >= g.IO.KeyRepeatDelay;
                    if has_repeated_at_least_once == 0 {
                        pressed = true;
                    }
                    if (flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_NoNavFocus) == 0 {
                        ImGui_SetFocusID(id, window);
                    }
                    ImGui_ClearActiveID();
                }
            }
            if g.ActiveId == id && item_flags & ImGuiItemFlags_ButtonRepeat {
                if g.IO.MouseDownDuration[g.ActiveIdMouseButton] > 0.0f && ImGui_IsMouseClicked(cast(ImGuiMouseButton, g.ActiveIdMouseButton), ImGuiInputFlags_Repeat, test_owner_id) {
                    pressed = true;
                }
            }
        }
        if pressed && g.IO.ConfigNavCursorVisibleAuto {
            g.NavCursorVisible = false;
        }
    }
    if (item_flags & ImGuiItemFlags_Disabled) == 0 {
        if g.NavId == id && g.NavCursorVisible && g.NavHighlightItemUnderNav {
            if (flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_NoHoveredOnFocus) == 0 {
                hovered = true;
            }
        }
        if g.NavActivateDownId == id {
            bool nav_activated_by_code = g.NavActivateId == id;
            bool nav_activated_by_inputs = g.NavActivatePressedId == id;
            if !nav_activated_by_inputs && item_flags & ImGuiItemFlags_ButtonRepeat {
                ImGuiKeyData* key1 = ImGui_GetKeyData(ImGuiKey_Space);
                ImGuiKeyData* key2 = ImGui_GetKeyData(ImGuiKey_Enter);
                ImGuiKeyData* key3 = ImGui_GetKeyData(g.IO.ConfigNavSwapGamepadButtons != 0 ? ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceRight : ImGuiKey_GamepadFaceDown);
                f32 t1 = ImMax(ImMax(key1.DownDuration, key2.DownDuration), key3.DownDuration);
                nav_activated_by_inputs = ImGui_CalcTypematicRepeatAmount(t1 - g.IO.DeltaTime, t1, g.IO.KeyRepeatDelay, g.IO.KeyRepeatRate) > 0;
            }
            if nav_activated_by_code || nav_activated_by_inputs {
                pressed = true;
                ImGui_SetActiveID(id, window);
                g.ActiveIdSource = g.NavInputSource;
                if !(flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_NoNavFocus) && !(g.NavActivateFlags & ImGuiActivateFlags_FromShortcut) {
                    ImGui_SetFocusID(id, window);
                }
                if (g.NavActivateFlags & ImGuiActivateFlags_FromShortcut) != 0 {
                    g.ActiveIdFromShortcut = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    bool held = false;
    if g.ActiveId == id {
        if g.ActiveIdSource == ImGuiInputSource_Mouse {
            if g.ActiveIdIsJustActivated != 0 {
                g.ActiveIdClickOffset = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(g.IO.MousePos, bb.Min);
            }
            i32 mouse_button = g.ActiveIdMouseButton;
            if mouse_button == -1 {
                ImGui_ClearActiveID();
            } else if ImGui_IsMouseDown(mouse_button, test_owner_id) != 0 {
                held = true;
            } else {
                bool release_in = hovered && (flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnClickRelease) != 0;
                bool release_anywhere = (flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnClickReleaseAnywhere) != 0;
                if (release_in || release_anywhere) && !g.DragDropActive {
                    bool is_double_click_release = flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnDoubleClick && g.IO.MouseReleased[mouse_button] && g.IO.MouseClickedLastCount[mouse_button] == 2;
                    bool is_repeating_already = item_flags & ImGuiItemFlags_ButtonRepeat && g.IO.MouseDownDurationPrev[mouse_button] >= g.IO.KeyRepeatDelay;
                    bool is_button_avail_or_owned = ImGui_TestKeyOwner(ImGui_MouseButtonToKey(mouse_button), test_owner_id);
                    if !is_double_click_release && !is_repeating_already && is_button_avail_or_owned {
                        pressed = true;
                    }
                }
                ImGui_ClearActiveID();
            }
            if !(flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_NoNavFocus) && g.IO.ConfigNavCursorVisibleAuto {
                g.NavCursorVisible = false;
            }
        } else if g.ActiveIdSource == ImGuiInputSource_Keyboard || g.ActiveIdSource == ImGuiInputSource_Gamepad {
            if g.NavActivateDownId == id {
                held = true;
            } else {
                ImGui_ClearActiveID();
            }
        }
        if pressed != 0 {
            g.ActiveIdHasBeenPressedBefore = true;
        }
    }
    if g.NavHighlightActivatedId == id && (item_flags & ImGuiItemFlags_Disabled) == 0 {
        hovered = true;
    }
    if out_hovered != null {
        *out_hovered = hovered;
    }
    if out_held != null {
        *out_held = held;
    }
    return pressed;
}

bool ImGui_ButtonEx(u8* label, ImVec2 size_arg, ImGuiButtonFlags flags) {
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiStyle style = g.Style;
    ImGuiID id = ImGuiWindow_GetID(window, label, null);
    u8* label_end = ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(label, null);
    ImVec2 label_size = ImGui_CalcTextSize(label, label_end, false, -1.0f);
    ImVec2 pos = window.DC.CursorPos;
    if flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_AlignTextBaseLine && style.FramePadding.y < window.DC.CurrLineTextBaseOffset {
        pos.y += window.DC.CurrLineTextBaseOffset - style.FramePadding.y;
    }
    ImVec2 size = ImGui_CalcItemSize(size_arg, label_size.x + style.FramePadding.x * 2.0f, label_size.y + style.FramePadding.y * 2.0f);
    ImRect bb;
    ImRect_init(&bb, pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(pos, size));
    ImGui_ItemSize(size, style.FramePadding.y);
    if ImGui_ItemAdd(bb, id, null, 0) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    bool hovered;
    bool held;
    bool pressed = ImGui_ButtonBehavior(bb, id, &hovered, &held, flags);
    ImU32 col = ImGui_GetColorU32(held && hovered ? ImGuiCol_ButtonActive : hovered != 0 ? ImGuiCol_ButtonHovered : ImGuiCol_Button);
    ImGui_RenderNavCursor(bb, id, ImGuiNavRenderCursorFlags_None, -1.0f);
    ImGui_RenderFrame(bb.Min, bb.Max, col, true, style.FrameRounding);
    if g.LogEnabled != 0 {
        ImGui_LogSetNextTextDecoration("[", "]");
    }
    ImGui_RenderTextClipped(op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(bb.Min, style.FramePadding), op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(bb.Max, style.FramePadding), label, label_end, &label_size, style.ButtonTextAlign, &bb);
    ignore *g;
    return pressed;
}

// Button to close a window
bool ImGui_CloseButton(ImGuiID id, ImVec2 pos) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    ImRect bb;
    ImRect_init(&bb, pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(pos, ImVec2{g.FontSize, g.FontSize}));
    ImRect bb_interact = bb;
    f32 area_to_visible_ratio = ImRect_GetArea(&window.OuterRectClipped) / ImRect_GetArea(&bb);
    if area_to_visible_ratio < 1.5f {
        ImRect_Expand(&bb_interact, ImTrunc(op_mul_ImVec2_float(ImRect_GetSize(&bb_interact), -0.25f)));
    }
    bool is_clipped = !ImGui_ItemAdd(bb_interact, id, null, 0);
    bool hovered;
    bool held;
    bool pressed = ImGui_ButtonBehavior(bb_interact, id, &hovered, &held);
    if is_clipped != 0 {
        return pressed;
    }
    ImU32 bg_col = ImGui_GetColorU32(held != 0 ? ImGuiCol_ButtonActive : ImGuiCol_ButtonHovered);
    if hovered != 0 {
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(window.DrawList, bb.Min, bb.Max, bg_col, 0.0f, 0);
    }
    ImGui_RenderNavCursor(bb, id, ImGuiNavRenderCursorFlags_Compact, -1.0f);
    ImU32 cross_col = ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Text);
    ImVec2 cross_center = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(ImRect_GetCenter(&bb), ImVec2{0.5f, 0.5f});
    f32 cross_extent = g.FontSize * 0.5f * 0.7071f - 1.0f;
    f32 cross_thickness = 1.0f * cast(f32, cast(i32, g.Style._MainScale));
    ImDrawList_AddLine(window.DrawList, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(cross_center, ImVec2{cross_extent, cross_extent}), op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(cross_center, ImVec2{-cross_extent, -cross_extent}), cross_col, cross_thickness);
    ImDrawList_AddLine(window.DrawList, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(cross_center, ImVec2{cross_extent, -cross_extent}), op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(cross_center, ImVec2{-cross_extent, cross_extent}), cross_col, cross_thickness);
    return pressed;
}

    bool held;

    if is_clipped != 0 {
        return pressed;
    }

    ImU32 text_col = ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Text);
    if hovered || held {
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(window.DrawList, bb.Min, bb.Max, bg_col, 0.0f, 0);

ImGuiID ImGui_GetWindowScrollbarID(ImGuiWindow* window, ImGuiAxis axis) {
    return ImGuiWindow_GetID(window, axis == ImGuiAxis_X ? "#SCROLLX" : "#SCROLLY", null);
}

// Return scrollbar rectangle, must only be called for corresponding axis if window->ScrollbarX/Y is set.
ImRect ImGui_GetWindowScrollbarRect(ImGuiWindow* window, ImGuiAxis axis) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImRect outer_rect = ImGuiWindow_Rect(window);
    ImRect inner_rect = window.InnerRect;
    f32 scrollbar_size = cast(f32*, &window.ScrollbarSizes)[axis ^ 1];
    assert(scrollbar_size >= 0.0f);
    var border_size = cast(f32, cast(i32, window.WindowBorderSize * 0.5f + 0.5f));
    f32 border_top = (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_MenuBar) != 0 ? cast(f32, cast(i32, g.Style.FrameBorderSize * 0.5f + 0.5f)) : (window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar) != 0 ? border_size : 0.0f;
    if axis == ImGuiAxis_X {
        return ImRect{
            ImVec2{
                inner_rect.Min.x + border_size,
                ImMax(outer_rect.Min.y + border_size, outer_rect.Max.y - border_size - scrollbar_size),
            },
            ImVec2{inner_rect.Max.x - border_size, outer_rect.Max.y - border_size},
        };
    } else {
        return ImRect{
            ImVec2{
                ImMax(outer_rect.Min.x, outer_rect.Max.x - border_size - scrollbar_size),
                inner_rect.Min.y + border_top,
            },
            ImVec2{outer_rect.Max.x - border_size, inner_rect.Max.y - border_size},
        };
    }
}

void ImGui_ExtendHitBoxWhenNearViewportEdge(ImGuiWindow* window, ImRect* bb, f32 threshold, ImGuiAxis axis) {
    ImRect window_rect = ImGuiWindow_Rect(window.RootWindow);
    ImRect viewport_rect = ImGuiViewportP_GetMainRect(window.Viewport);
    if cast(f32*, &window_rect.Min)[axis] == cast(f32*, &viewport_rect.Min)[axis] && cast(f32*, &bb.Min)[axis] > cast(f32*, &window_rect.Min)[axis] && cast(f32*, &bb.Min)[axis] - threshold <= cast(f32*, &window_rect.Min)[axis] {
        cast(f32*, &bb.Min)[axis] = cast(f32*, &window_rect.Min)[axis];
    }
    if cast(f32*, &window_rect.Max)[axis] == cast(f32*, &viewport_rect.Max)[axis] && cast(f32*, &bb.Max)[axis] < cast(f32*, &window_rect.Max)[axis] && cast(f32*, &bb.Max)[axis] + threshold >= cast(f32*, &window_rect.Max)[axis] {
        cast(f32*, &bb.Max)[axis] = cast(f32*, &window_rect.Max)[axis];
    }
}

void ImGui_Scrollbar(ImGuiAxis axis) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    ImGuiID id = ImGui_GetWindowScrollbarID(window, axis);
    ImRect bb = ImGui_GetWindowScrollbarRect(window, axis);
    ImGuiWindow* host_window = window.DockIsActive != 0 ? window.DockNode.HostWindow : window;
    ImRect host_rect = ImGuiWindow_Rect(host_window);
    ImDrawFlags rounding_corners = ImGui_CalcRoundingFlagsForRectInRect(bb, host_rect, g.Style.WindowBorderSize);
    f32 size_visible = cast(f32*, &window.InnerRect.Max)[axis] - cast(f32*, &window.InnerRect.Min)[axis];
    f32 size_contents = cast(f32*, &window.ContentSize)[axis] + cast(f32*, &window.WindowPadding)[axis] * 2.0f;
    var scroll = cast(ImS64, cast(f32*, &window.Scroll)[axis]);
    ImGui_ScrollbarEx(bb, id, axis, &scroll, cast(ImS64, size_visible), cast(ImS64, size_contents), rounding_corners);
    cast(f32*, &window.Scroll)[axis] = cast(f32, scroll);
}

// Vertical/Horizontal scrollbar
// The entire piece of code below is rather confusing because:
// - We handle absolute seeking (when first clicking outside the grab) and relative manipulation (afterward or when clicking inside the grab)
// - We store values as normalized ratio and in a form that allows the window content to change while we are holding on a scrollbar
// - We handle both horizontal and vertical scrollbars, which makes the terminology not ideal.
// Still, the code should probably be made simpler..
bool ImGui_ScrollbarEx(ImRect bb_frame, ImGuiID id, ImGuiAxis axis, ImS64* p_scroll_v, ImS64 size_visible_v, ImS64 size_contents_v, ImDrawFlags draw_rounding_flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    f32 bb_frame_width = ImRect_GetWidth(&bb_frame);
    f32 bb_frame_height = ImRect_GetHeight(&bb_frame);
    if bb_frame_width <= 0.0f || bb_frame_height <= 0.0f {
        return false;
    }
    f32 alpha = 1.0f;
    if axis == ImGuiAxis_Y && bb_frame_height < bb_frame_width {
        alpha = ImSaturate(bb_frame_height / ImMax(bb_frame_width * 2.0f, 1.0f));
    }
    if alpha <= 0.0f {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiStyle style = g.Style;
    bool allow_interaction = alpha >= 1.0f;
    ImRect bb = bb_frame;
    var padding = cast(f32, cast(i32, ImMin(style.ScrollbarPadding, ImMin(bb_frame_width, bb_frame_height) * 0.5f)));
    ImRect_Expand(&bb, -padding);
    f32 scrollbar_size_v = axis == ImGuiAxis_X ? ImRect_GetWidth(&bb) : ImRect_GetHeight(&bb);
    if scrollbar_size_v < 1.0f {
        return false;
    }
    assert(cast(f32, ImMax(cast(i32, size_contents_v), cast(i32, size_visible_v))) > 0.0f);
    ImS64 win_size_v = ImMax(ImMax(cast(i32, size_contents_v), cast(i32, size_visible_v)), cast(i32, cast(ImS64, 1)));
    f32 grab_h_minsize = ImMin(cast(f32*, &ImRect_GetSize(&bb))[axis], style.GrabMinSize);
    var grab_h_pixels = cast(f32, cast(i32, ImClamp(scrollbar_size_v * (cast(f32, size_visible_v) / cast(f32, win_size_v)), grab_h_minsize, scrollbar_size_v)));
    f32 grab_h_norm = grab_h_pixels / scrollbar_size_v;
    ImRect bb_hit = bb_frame;
    ImGui_ExtendHitBoxWhenNearViewportEdge(window, &bb_hit, g.Style.WindowBorderSize, cast(ImGuiAxis, axis ^ 1));
    bool held = false;
    bool hovered = false;
    ImGui_ItemAdd(bb_frame, id, null, ImGuiItemFlags_NoNav);
    ImGui_ButtonBehavior(bb_hit, id, &hovered, &held, ImGuiButtonFlags_NoNavFocus);
    ImS64 scroll_max = ImMax(cast(i32, cast(ImS64, 1)), cast(i32, size_contents_v - size_visible_v));
    f32 scroll_ratio = ImSaturate(cast(f32, *p_scroll_v) / cast(f32, scroll_max));
    f32 grab_v_norm = scroll_ratio * (scrollbar_size_v - grab_h_pixels) / scrollbar_size_v;
    if held && allow_interaction && grab_h_norm < 1.0f {
        f32 scrollbar_pos_v = cast(f32*, &bb.Min)[axis];
        f32 mouse_pos_v = cast(f32*, &g.IO.MousePos)[axis];
        f32 clicked_v_norm = ImSaturate((mouse_pos_v - scrollbar_pos_v) / scrollbar_size_v);
        i32 held_dir = clicked_v_norm < grab_v_norm ? -1 : clicked_v_norm > grab_v_norm + grab_h_norm ? 1 : 0;
        if g.ActiveIdIsJustActivated != 0 {
            bool scroll_to_clicked_location = g.IO.ConfigScrollbarScrollByPage == false || g.IO.KeyShift || held_dir == 0;
            g.ScrollbarSeekMode = cast(i16, scroll_to_clicked_location != 0 ? 0 : cast(i16, held_dir));
            g.ScrollbarClickDeltaToGrabCenter = held_dir == 0 && !g.IO.KeyShift ? clicked_v_norm - grab_v_norm - grab_h_norm * 0.5f : 0.0f;
        }
        if g.ScrollbarSeekMode == 0 {
            f32 scroll_v_norm = ImSaturate((clicked_v_norm - g.ScrollbarClickDeltaToGrabCenter - grab_h_norm * 0.5f) / (1.0f - grab_h_norm));
            *p_scroll_v = cast(ImS64, scroll_v_norm * cast(f32, scroll_max));
        } else {
            if ImGui_IsMouseClicked(ImGuiMouseButton_Left, ImGuiInputFlags_Repeat != 0) && held_dir == g.ScrollbarSeekMode {
                f32 page_dir = cast(f32, g.ScrollbarSeekMode) > 0.0f ? 1.0f : -1.0f;
                *p_scroll_v = ImClamp(cast(i32, *p_scroll_v + cast(ImS64, page_dir * cast(f32, size_visible_v))), cast(i32, cast(ImS64, 0)), cast(i32, scroll_max));
            }
        }
        scroll_ratio = ImSaturate(cast(f32, *p_scroll_v) / cast(f32, scroll_max));
        grab_v_norm = scroll_ratio * (scrollbar_size_v - grab_h_pixels) / scrollbar_size_v;
    }
    ImU32 bg_col = ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_ScrollbarBg);
    ImU32 grab_col = ImGui_GetColorU32(held != 0 ? ImGuiCol_ScrollbarGrabActive : hovered != 0 ? ImGuiCol_ScrollbarGrabHovered : ImGuiCol_ScrollbarGrab, alpha);
    ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(window.DrawList, bb_frame.Min, bb_frame.Max, bg_col, window.WindowRounding, draw_rounding_flags);
    ImRect grab_rect;
    if axis == ImGuiAxis_X {
        grab_rect = ImRect{
            ImVec2{ImLerp(bb.Min.x, bb.Max.x, grab_v_norm), bb.Min.y},
            ImVec2{ImLerp(bb.Min.x, bb.Max.x, grab_v_norm) + grab_h_pixels, bb.Max.y},
        };
    } else {
        grab_rect = ImRect{
            ImVec2{bb.Min.x, ImLerp(bb.Min.y, bb.Max.y, grab_v_norm)},
            ImVec2{bb.Max.x, ImLerp(bb.Min.y, bb.Max.y, grab_v_norm) + grab_h_pixels},
        };
    }
    ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(window.DrawList, grab_rect.Min, grab_rect.Max, grab_col, style.ScrollbarRounding, 0);
    return held;
}

// - Read about ImTextureID/ImTextureRef here: https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/wiki/Image-Loading-and-Displaying-Examples
// - 'uv0' and 'uv1' are texture coordinates. Read about them from the same link above.
void ImGui_ImageWithBg(ImTextureRef tex_ref, ImVec2 image_size, ImVec2 uv0, ImVec2 uv1, ImVec4 bg_col, ImVec4 tint_col) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return;
    }
    ImVec2 padding;
    ImVec2_init(&padding, g.Style.ImageBorderSize, g.Style.ImageBorderSize);
    ImRect bb;
    ImRect_init(&bb, window.DC.CursorPos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.DC.CursorPos, image_size), op_mul_ImVec2_float(padding, 2.0f)));
    ImGui_ItemSize(bb);
    if ImGui_ItemAdd(bb, 0, null, 0) == 0 {
        return;
    }
    f32 rounding = g.Style.ImageRounding;
    if bg_col.w > 0.0f {
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(window.DrawList, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(bb.Min, padding), op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(bb.Max, padding), ImGui_GetColorU32(bg_col), rounding, 0);
    }
    if rounding > 0.0f {
        ImDrawList_AddImageRounded(window.DrawList, tex_ref, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(bb.Min, padding), op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(bb.Max, padding), uv0, uv1, ImGui_GetColorU32(tint_col), rounding, 0);
    } else {
        ImDrawList_AddImage(window.DrawList, tex_ref, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(bb.Min, padding), op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(bb.Max, padding), uv0, uv1, ImGui_GetColorU32(tint_col));
    }
    if g.Style.ImageBorderSize > 0.0f {
        ImDrawList_AddRect(window.DrawList, bb.Min, bb.Max, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Border), rounding, g.Style.ImageBorderSize, 0);
    }
}

void ImGui_Image(ImTextureRef tex_ref, ImVec2 image_size, ImVec2 uv0, ImVec2 uv1) {
    ImGui_ImageWithBg(tex_ref, image_size, uv0, uv1);
}

// 1.91.9 (February 2025) removed 'tint_col' and 'border_col' parameters, made border size not depend on color value. (#8131, #8238)
bool ImGui_ImageButtonEx(ImGuiID id, ImTextureRef tex_ref, ImVec2 image_size, ImVec2 uv0, ImVec2 uv1, ImVec4 bg_col, ImVec4 tint_col, ImGuiButtonFlags flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImVec2 padding = g.Style.FramePadding;
    ImRect bb;
    ImRect_init(&bb, window.DC.CursorPos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.DC.CursorPos, image_size), op_mul_ImVec2_float(padding, 2.0f)));
    ImGui_ItemSize(bb);
    if ImGui_ItemAdd(bb, id, null, 0) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    bool hovered;
    bool held;
    bool pressed = ImGui_ButtonBehavior(bb, id, &hovered, &held, flags);
    ImU32 col = ImGui_GetColorU32(held && hovered ? ImGuiCol_ButtonActive : hovered != 0 ? ImGuiCol_ButtonHovered : ImGuiCol_Button);
    ImGui_RenderNavCursor(bb, id, ImGuiNavRenderCursorFlags_None, -1.0f);
    ImGui_RenderFrame(bb.Min, bb.Max, col, true, g.Style.FrameRounding);
    if bg_col.w > 0.0f {
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(window.DrawList, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(bb.Min, padding), op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(bb.Max, padding), ImGui_GetColorU32(bg_col), 0.0f, 0);
    }
    f32 image_rounding = ImMax(g.Style.FrameRounding - ImMax(padding.x, padding.y), g.Style.ImageRounding);
    if image_rounding > 0.0f {
        ImDrawList_AddImageRounded(window.DrawList, tex_ref, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(bb.Min, padding), op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(bb.Max, padding), uv0, uv1, ImGui_GetColorU32(tint_col), image_rounding, 0);
    } else {
        ImDrawList_AddImage(window.DrawList, tex_ref, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(bb.Min, padding), op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(bb.Max, padding), uv0, uv1, ImGui_GetColorU32(tint_col));
    }
    return pressed;
}

bool ImGui_Checkbox(u8* label, bool* v) {
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiStyle style = g.Style;
    ImGuiID id = ImGuiWindow_GetID(window, label, null);
    u8* label_end = ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(label, null);

        ImU32 check_col = ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_CheckMark);
        ImGui_RenderFrame(check_bb.Min, check_bb.Max, bg_col, true, style.FrameRounding);

            ImGui_RenderCheckMark(window.DrawList, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(check_bb.Min, ImVec2{pad, pad}), check_col, square_sz - pad * 2.0f);
        }
    }
    var label_pos = ImVec2{
        check_bb.Max.x + style.ItemInnerSpacing.x, check_bb.Min.y + style.FramePadding.y,
    };
    if g.LogEnabled != 0 {
        ImGui_LogRenderedText(&label_pos, mixed_value != 0 ? "[~]" : *v != 0 ? "[x]" : "[ ]", null);
    }
    if is_visible && label_size.x > 0.0f {
        ImGui_RenderText(label_pos, label, label_end, false);
    }
    ignore *g;
    return pressed;

// size_arg (for each axis) < 0.0f: align to end, 0.0f: auto, > 0.0f: specified size
void ImGui_ProgressBar(f32 fraction, ImVec2 size_arg, u8* overlay) {
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiStyle style = g.Style;
    ImVec2 pos = window.DC.CursorPos;
    ImVec2 size = ImGui_CalcItemSize(size_arg, ImGui_CalcItemWidth(), g.FontSize + style.FramePadding.y * 2.0f);
    ImRect bb;
    ImRect_init(&bb, pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(pos, size));
    ImGui_ItemSize(size, style.FramePadding.y);
    if ImGui_ItemAdd(bb, 0, null, 0) == 0 {
        return;
    }
    bool is_indeterminate = fraction < 0.0f;
    if is_indeterminate == 0 {
        fraction = ImSaturate(fraction);
    }
    f32 fill_n0 = 0.0f;
    f32 fill_n1 = fraction == fraction ? fraction : 0.0f;
    if is_indeterminate != 0 {
        f32 fill_width_n = 0.2f;
        fill_n0 = fmod(-fraction, 1.0f) * (1.0f + fill_width_n) - fill_width_n;
        fill_n1 = ImSaturate(fill_n0 + fill_width_n);
        fill_n0 = ImSaturate(fill_n0);
    }
    ImGui_RenderFrame(bb.Min, bb.Max, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_FrameBg), true, style.FrameRounding);
    ImRect_Expand(&bb, ImVec2{-style.FrameBorderSize, -style.FrameBorderSize});
    f32 fill_x0 = ImLerp(bb.Min.x, bb.Max.x, fill_n0);
    f32 fill_x1 = ImLerp(bb.Min.x, bb.Max.x, fill_n1);
    if fill_x0 < fill_x1 {
        ImGui_RenderRectFilledInRangeH(window.DrawList, bb, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_PlotHistogram), fill_x0, fill_x1, style.FrameRounding);
    }
    u8[32] overlay_buf;
    if !is_indeterminate || overlay != null {
        if overlay == null {
            ImFormatString(overlay_buf, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(overlay_buf) / sizeof(*overlay_buf))), "%.0f%%", fraction * 100.0f + 0.01f);
            overlay = overlay_buf;
        }
        ImVec2 overlay_size = ImGui_CalcTextSize(overlay, null, false, -1.0f);
        if overlay_size.x > 0.0f {
            f32 text_x = is_indeterminate != 0 ? (bb.Min.x + bb.Max.x - overlay_size.x) * 0.5f : fill_x1 + style.ItemSpacing.x;
            ImGui_RenderTextClipped(ImVec2{
                ImClamp(text_x, bb.Min.x, bb.Max.x - overlay_size.x - style.ItemInnerSpacing.x),
                bb.Min.y,
            }, bb.Max, overlay, null, &overlay_size, ImVec2{0.0f, 0.5f}, &bb);
        }
    }
}

// This is provided as a convenience for being an often requested feature.
// FIXME-STYLE: we delayed adding as there is a larger plan to revamp the styling system.
// Because of this we currently don't provide many styling options for this widget
// (e.g. hovered/active colors are automatically inferred from a single color).
bool ImGui_TextLink(u8* label) {
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiID id = ImGuiWindow_GetID(window, label, null);
    u8* label_end = ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(label, null);
    ImVec2 pos;
    ImVec2_init(&pos, window.DC.CursorPos.x, window.DC.CursorPos.y + window.DC.CurrLineTextBaseOffset);
    ImVec2 size = ImGui_CalcTextSize(label, label_end, false, -1.0f);
    ImRect bb;
    ImRect_init(&bb, pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(pos, size));
    ImGui_ItemSize(size, 0.0f);
    if ImGui_ItemAdd(bb, id, null, 0) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    bool hovered;
    bool held;
    bool pressed = ImGui_ButtonBehavior(bb, id, &hovered, &held);
    ImGui_RenderNavCursor(bb, id, ImGuiNavRenderCursorFlags_None, -1.0f);
    if hovered != 0 {
        ImGui_SetMouseCursor(ImGuiMouseCursor_Hand);
    }
    ImVec4 text_colf = g.Style.Colors[ImGuiCol_TextLink];
    ImVec4 line_colf = text_colf;
    {
        f32 h;
        f32 s;
        f32 v;
        ImGui_ColorConvertRGBtoHSV(text_colf.x, text_colf.y, text_colf.z, &h, &s, &v);
        if held || hovered {
            v = ImSaturate(v + (held != 0 ? 0.4f : 0.3f));
            h = fmod(h + 0.02f, 1.0f);
        }
        ImGui_ColorConvertHSVtoRGB(h, s, v, &text_colf.x, &text_colf.y, &text_colf.z);
        v = ImSaturate(v - 0.2f);
        ImGui_ColorConvertHSVtoRGB(h, s, v, &line_colf.x, &line_colf.y, &line_colf.z);
    }
    f32 line_y = bb.Max.y + ImFloor(g.FontBaked.Descent * g.FontBakedScale * 0.2f);
    ImDrawList_AddLineH(window.DrawList, bb.Min.x, bb.Max.x, line_y, ImGui_GetColorU32(line_colf), 1.0f * cast(f32, cast(i32, g.Style._MainScale)));
    ImGui_PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, ImGui_GetColorU32(text_colf));
    ImGui_RenderText(bb.Min, label, label_end, false);
    ImGui_PopStyleColor(1);
    ignore *g;
    return pressed;
}

// Horizontal/vertical separating line
// FIXME: Surprisingly, this seemingly trivial widget is a victim of many different legacy/tricky layout issues.
// Note how thickness == 1.0f is handled specifically as not moving CursorPos by 'thickness', but other values are.
void ImGui_SeparatorEx(ImGuiSeparatorFlags flags, f32 thickness) {
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(cast(i64, ImIsPowerOfTwo(flags & (ImGuiSeparatorFlags_Horizontal | ImGuiSeparatorFlags_Vertical))));
    assert(thickness > 0.0f);
    if (flags & ImGuiSeparatorFlags_Vertical) != 0 {
        f32 y1 = window.DC.CursorPos.y;
        f32 y2 = window.DC.CursorPos.y + window.DC.CurrLineSize.y;
        ImRect bb;
        ImRect_init(&bb, ImVec2{window.DC.CursorPos.x, y1}, ImVec2{window.DC.CursorPos.x + thickness, y2});
        ImGui_ItemSize(ImVec2{thickness, 0.0f});
        if ImGui_ItemAdd(bb, 0, null, 0) == 0 {
            return;
        }
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(window.DrawList, bb.Min, bb.Max, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Separator), 0.0f, 0);
        if g.LogEnabled != 0 {
            ImGui_LogText(" |");
        }
    } else if (flags & ImGuiSeparatorFlags_Horizontal) != 0 {
        f32 x1 = window.DC.CursorPos.x;
        f32 x2 = window.WorkRect.Max.x;
        ImGuiOldColumns* columns = (flags & ImGuiSeparatorFlags_SpanAllColumns) != 0 ? window.DC.CurrentColumns : null;
        if columns != null {
            x1 = window.Pos.x + window.DC.Indent.x;
            x2 = window.Pos.x + window.Size.x;
            ImGui_PushColumnsBackground();
        }
        ImRect bb;
        ImRect_init(&bb, ImVec2{x1, window.DC.CursorPos.y}, ImVec2{x2, window.DC.CursorPos.y + thickness});
        ImGui_ItemSize(ImVec2{0.0f, thickness});
        if ImGui_ItemAdd(bb, 0, null, 0) != 0 {
            ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(window.DrawList, bb.Min, bb.Max, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Separator), 0.0f, 0);
            if g.LogEnabled != 0 {
                ImGui_LogRenderedText(&bb.Min, "--------------------------------\n", null);
            }
        }
        if columns != null {
            ImGui_PopColumnsBackground();
            columns.LineMinY = window.DC.CursorPos.y;
        }
    }
}

void ImGui_SeparatorTextEx(ImGuiID id, u8* label, u8* label_end, f32 extra_w) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    ImGuiStyle* style = &g.Style;
    ImVec2 label_size = ImGui_CalcTextSize(label, label_end, false, -1.0f);
    ImVec2 pos = window.DC.CursorPos;
    ImVec2 padding = style.SeparatorTextPadding;
    f32 separator_thickness = style.SeparatorTextBorderSize;
    ImVec2 min_size;
    ImVec2_init(&min_size, label_size.x + extra_w + padding.x * 2.0f, ImMax(label_size.y + padding.y * 2.0f, separator_thickness));
    ImRect bb;
    ImRect_init(&bb, pos, ImVec2{window.WorkRect.Max.x, pos.y + min_size.y});
    f32 text_baseline_y = ImTrunc((ImRect_GetHeight(&bb) - label_size.y) * style.SeparatorTextAlign.y + 0.999f);
    ImGui_ItemSize(min_size, text_baseline_y);
    if ImGui_ItemAdd(bb, id, null, 0) == 0 {
        return;
    }
    f32 sep1_x1 = pos.x;
    f32 sep2_x2 = bb.Max.x;
    f32 seps_y = ImTrunc((bb.Min.y + bb.Max.y) * 0.5f + 0.999f);
    f32 label_avail_w = ImMax(0.0f, sep2_x2 - sep1_x1 - padding.x * 2.0f);
    ImVec2 label_pos;
    ImVec2_init(&label_pos, pos.x + padding.x + ImMax(0.0f, (label_avail_w - label_size.x - extra_w) * style.SeparatorTextAlign.x), pos.y + text_baseline_y);
    window.DC.CursorPosPrevLine.x = label_pos.x + label_size.x;
    ImU32 separator_col = ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Separator);
    if label_size.x > 0.0f {
        f32 sep1_x2 = label_pos.x - style.ItemSpacing.x;
        f32 sep2_x1 = label_pos.x + label_size.x + extra_w + style.ItemSpacing.x;
        if sep1_x2 > sep1_x1 && separator_thickness > 0.0f {
            ImDrawList_AddLineH(window.DrawList, sep1_x1, sep1_x2, seps_y, separator_col, separator_thickness);
        }
        if sep2_x2 > sep2_x1 && separator_thickness > 0.0f {
            ImDrawList_AddLineH(window.DrawList, sep2_x1, sep2_x2, seps_y, separator_col, separator_thickness);
        }
        if g.LogEnabled != 0 {
            ImGui_LogSetNextTextDecoration("---", null);
        }
        ImGui_RenderTextEllipsis(window.DrawList, label_pos, ImVec2{bb.Max.x, bb.Max.y + style.ItemSpacing.y}, bb.Max.x, label, label_end, &label_size);
    } else {
        if g.LogEnabled != 0 {
            ImGui_LogText("---");
        }
        if separator_thickness > 0.0f {
            ImDrawList_AddLineH(window.DrawList, sep1_x1, sep2_x2, seps_y, separator_col, separator_thickness);
        }
    }
}

// Using 'hover_visibility_delay' allows us to hide the highlight and mouse cursor for a short time, which can be convenient to reduce visual noise.
bool ImGui_SplitterBehavior(ImRect bb, ImGuiID id, ImGuiAxis axis, f32* size1, f32* size2, f32 min_size1, f32 min_size2, f32 hover_extend, f32 hover_visibility_delay, ImU32 bg_col) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    if ImGui_ItemAdd(bb, id, null, ImGuiItemFlags_NoNav) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiButtonFlags button_flags = ImGuiButtonFlags_FlattenChildren;
    bool hovered;
    bool held;
    ImRect bb_interact = bb;
    ImRect_Expand(&bb_interact, axis == ImGuiAxis_Y ? ImVec2{0.0f, hover_extend} : ImVec2{hover_extend, 0.0f});
    ImGui_ButtonBehavior(bb_interact, id, &hovered, &held, button_flags);
    if hovered != 0 {
        g.LastItemData.StatusFlags |= ImGuiItemStatusFlags_HoveredRect;
    }
    if held || hovered && g.HoveredIdPreviousFrame == id && g.HoveredIdTimer >= hover_visibility_delay {
        ImGui_SetMouseCursor(axis == ImGuiAxis_Y ? ImGuiMouseCursor_ResizeNS : ImGuiMouseCursor_ResizeEW);
    }
    ImRect bb_render = bb;
    if held != 0 {
        f32 mouse_delta = cast(f32*, &op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(g.IO.MousePos, g.ActiveIdClickOffset), bb_interact.Min))[axis];
        f32 size_1_maximum_delta = ImMax(0.0f, *size1 - min_size1);
        f32 size_2_maximum_delta = ImMax(0.0f, *size2 - min_size2);
        if mouse_delta < -size_1_maximum_delta {
            mouse_delta = -size_1_maximum_delta;
        }
        if mouse_delta > size_2_maximum_delta {
            mouse_delta = size_2_maximum_delta;
        }
        if mouse_delta != 0.0f {
            *size1 = ImMax(*size1 + mouse_delta, min_size1);
            *size2 = ImMax(*size2 - mouse_delta, min_size2);
            ImRect_Translate(&bb_render, axis == ImGuiAxis_X ? ImVec2{mouse_delta, 0.0f} : ImVec2{0.0f, mouse_delta});
            ImGui_MarkItemEdited(id);
        }
    }
    if (bg_col & 0xFF000000) != 0 {
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(window.DrawList, bb_render.Min, bb_render.Max, bg_col, 0.0f, 0);
    }
    ImU32 col = ImGui_GetColorU32(held != 0 ? ImGuiCol_SeparatorActive : hovered && g.HoveredIdTimer >= hover_visibility_delay ? ImGuiCol_SeparatorHovered : ImGuiCol_Separator);
    ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(window.DrawList, bb_render.Min, bb_render.Max, col, 0.0f, 0);
    return held;
}

private {
i32 ShrinkWidthItemComparer(void* lhs, void* rhs) {
    var a = cast(ImGuiShrinkWidthItem*, lhs);
    var b = cast(ImGuiShrinkWidthItem*, rhs);
    {
        var d = cast(i32, b.Width - a.Width);
        if d != 0 {
            return d;
        }
    }
    return b.Index - a.Index;
}
}

// Shrink excess width from a set of item, by removing width from the larger items first.
// Set items Width to -1.0f to disable shrinking this item.
void ImGui_ShrinkWidths(ImGuiShrinkWidthItem* items, i32 count, f32 width_excess, f32 width_min) {
    if count == 1 {
        if items[0].Width >= 0.0f {
            items[0].Width = ImMax(items[0].Width - width_excess, width_min);
        }
        return;
    }
    ImQsort(items, cast(u64, count), cast(u64, sizeof(ImGuiShrinkWidthItem)), cast(fn(void*, void*): i32, ShrinkWidthItemComparer));
    i32 count_same_width = 1;
    while width_excess > 0.001f && count_same_width < count {
        while count_same_width < count && items[0].Width <= items[count_same_width].Width {
            count_same_width++;
        }
        f32 max_width_to_remove_per_item = count_same_width < count && items[count_same_width].Width >= 0.0f ? items[0].Width - items[count_same_width].Width : items[0].Width - 1.0f;
        max_width_to_remove_per_item = ImMin(items[0].Width - width_min, max_width_to_remove_per_item);
        if max_width_to_remove_per_item <= 0.0f {
            break;
        }
        f32 base_width_to_remove_per_item = ImMin(width_excess / cast(f32, count_same_width), max_width_to_remove_per_item);
        for i32 item_n = 0; item_n < count_same_width; item_n++ {
            f32 width_to_remove_for_this_item = ImMin(base_width_to_remove_per_item, items[item_n].Width - width_min);
            items[item_n].Width -= width_to_remove_for_this_item;
            width_excess -= width_to_remove_for_this_item;
        }
    }
    width_excess = 0.0f;
    for i32 n = 0; n < count; n++ {
        f32 width_rounded = ImTrunc(items[n].Width);
        width_excess += items[n].Width - width_rounded;
        items[n].Width = width_rounded;
    }
    while width_excess > 0.0f {
        for i32 n = 0; n < count && width_excess > 0.0f; n++ {
            f32 width_to_add = ImMin(items[n].InitialWidth - items[n].Width, 1.0f);
            items[n].Width += width_to_add;
            width_excess -= width_to_add;
        }
    }
}

private {
f32 CalcMaxPopupHeightFromItemCount(i32 items_count) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if items_count <= 0 {
        return FLT_MAX;
    }
    return (g.FontSize + g.Style.ItemSpacing.y) * cast(f32, items_count) - g.Style.ItemSpacing.y + g.Style.WindowPadding.y * 2.0f;
}
}

bool ImGui_BeginCombo(u8* label, u8* preview_value, ImGuiComboFlags flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    ImGuiNextWindowDataFlags backup_next_window_data_flags = g.NextWindowData.HasFlags;
    ImGuiNextWindowData_ClearFlags(&g.NextWindowData);
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiStyle style = g.Style;
    ImGuiID id = ImGuiWindow_GetID(window, label, null);
    assert((flags & (ImGuiComboFlags_NoArrowButton | ImGuiComboFlags_NoPreview)) != (ImGuiComboFlags_NoArrowButton | ImGuiComboFlags_NoPreview));
    if (flags & ImGuiComboFlags_WidthFitPreview) != 0 {
        assert((flags & (ImGuiComboFlags_NoPreview | cast(ImGuiComboFlags, ImGuiComboFlags_CustomPreview))) == 0);
    }
    f32 arrow_size = (flags & ImGuiComboFlags_NoArrowButton) != 0 ? 0.0f : ImGui_GetFrameHeight();
    u8* label_end = ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(label, null);
    ImVec2 label_size = ImGui_CalcTextSize(label, label_end, false, -1.0f);
    f32 preview_width = flags & ImGuiComboFlags_WidthFitPreview && preview_value != null ? ImGui_CalcTextSize(preview_value, null, false, -1.0f).x : 0.0f;
    f32 w = (flags & ImGuiComboFlags_NoPreview) != 0 ? arrow_size : (flags & ImGuiComboFlags_WidthFitPreview) != 0 ? arrow_size + preview_width + style.FramePadding.x * 2.0f : ImGui_CalcItemWidth();
    ImRect bb;
    ImRect_init(&bb, window.DC.CursorPos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.DC.CursorPos, ImVec2{w, label_size.y + style.FramePadding.y * 2.0f}));
    ImRect total_bb;
    ImRect_init(&total_bb, bb.Min, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(bb.Max, ImVec2{
        label_size.x > 0.0f ? style.ItemInnerSpacing.x + label_size.x : 0.0f, 0.0f,
    }));
    ImGui_ItemSize(total_bb, style.FramePadding.y);
    if ImGui_ItemAdd(total_bb, id, &bb, 0) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    bool hovered;
    bool held;
    bool pressed = ImGui_ButtonBehavior(bb, id, &hovered, &held);
    ImGuiID popup_id = ImHashStr("##ComboPopup", 0, id);
    bool popup_open = ImGui_IsPopupOpen(popup_id, ImGuiPopupFlags_None);
    if pressed && !popup_open {
        ImGui_OpenPopupEx(popup_id, ImGuiPopupFlags_None);
        popup_open = true;
    }
    ImU32 frame_col = ImGui_GetColorU32(hovered != 0 ? ImGuiCol_FrameBgHovered : ImGuiCol_FrameBg);
    f32 value_x2 = ImMax(bb.Min.x, bb.Max.x - arrow_size);
    ImGui_RenderNavCursor(bb, id, ImGuiNavRenderCursorFlags_None, -1.0f);
    if (flags & ImGuiComboFlags_NoPreview) == 0 {
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(window.DrawList, bb.Min, ImVec2{value_x2, bb.Max.y}, frame_col, style.FrameRounding, (flags & ImGuiComboFlags_NoArrowButton) != 0 ? ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersAll : ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersLeft);
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiComboFlags_NoArrowButton) == 0 {
        ImU32 bg_col = ImGui_GetColorU32(popup_open || hovered ? ImGuiCol_ButtonHovered : ImGuiCol_Button);
        ImU32 text_col = ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Text);
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(window.DrawList, ImVec2{value_x2, bb.Min.y}, bb.Max, bg_col, style.FrameRounding, w <= arrow_size ? ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersAll : ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersRight);
        if value_x2 + arrow_size - style.FramePadding.x <= bb.Max.x {
            ImGui_RenderArrow(window.DrawList, ImVec2{
                value_x2 + style.FramePadding.y, bb.Min.y + style.FramePadding.y,
            }, text_col, ImGuiDir_Down, 1.0f);
        }
    }
    ImGui_RenderFrameBorder(bb.Min, bb.Max, style.FrameRounding);
    if (flags & ImGuiComboFlags_CustomPreview) != 0 {
        g.ComboPreviewData.PreviewRect = ImRect{ImVec2{bb.Min.x, bb.Min.y}, ImVec2{value_x2, bb.Max.y}};
        assert(preview_value == null || preview_value[0] == 0);
        preview_value = null;
    }
    if preview_value != null && !(flags & ImGuiComboFlags_NoPreview) {
        if g.LogEnabled != 0 {
            ImGui_LogSetNextTextDecoration("{", "}");
        }
        ImGui_RenderTextClipped(op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(bb.Min, style.FramePadding), ImVec2{value_x2, bb.Max.y}, preview_value, null, null, ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f}, null);
    }
    if label_size.x > 0.0f {
        ImGui_RenderText(ImVec2{
            bb.Max.x + style.ItemInnerSpacing.x, bb.Min.y + style.FramePadding.y,
        }, label, label_end, false);
    }
    if popup_open == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    g.NextWindowData.HasFlags = backup_next_window_data_flags;
    return ImGui_BeginComboPopup(popup_id, bb, flags);
}

bool ImGui_BeginComboPopup(ImGuiID popup_id, ImRect bb, ImGuiComboFlags flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if ImGui_IsPopupOpen(popup_id, ImGuiPopupFlags_None) == 0 {
        ImGuiNextWindowData_ClearFlags(&g.NextWindowData);
        return false;
    }
    f32 w = ImRect_GetWidth(&bb);
    if (g.NextWindowData.HasFlags & ImGuiNextWindowDataFlags_HasSizeConstraint) != 0 {
        g.NextWindowData.SizeConstraintRect.Min.x = ImMax(g.NextWindowData.SizeConstraintRect.Min.x, w);
    } else {
        if (flags & ImGuiComboFlags_HeightMask_) == 0 {
            flags |= ImGuiComboFlags_HeightRegular;
        }
        assert(cast(i64, ImIsPowerOfTwo(flags & ImGuiComboFlags_HeightMask_)));
        i32 popup_max_height_in_items = -1;
        if (flags & ImGuiComboFlags_HeightRegular) != 0 {
            popup_max_height_in_items = 8;
        } else if (flags & ImGuiComboFlags_HeightSmall) != 0 {
            popup_max_height_in_items = 4;
        } else if (flags & ImGuiComboFlags_HeightLarge) != 0 {
            popup_max_height_in_items = 20;
        }
        ImVec2 constraint_min;
        ImVec2_init(&constraint_min, 0.0f, 0.0f);
        ImVec2 constraint_max;
        ImVec2_init(&constraint_max, FLT_MAX, FLT_MAX);
        if (g.NextWindowData.HasFlags & ImGuiNextWindowDataFlags_HasSize) == 0 || g.NextWindowData.SizeVal.x <= 0.0f {
            constraint_min.x = w;
        }
        if (g.NextWindowData.HasFlags & ImGuiNextWindowDataFlags_HasSize) == 0 || g.NextWindowData.SizeVal.y <= 0.0f {
            constraint_max.y = CalcMaxPopupHeightFromItemCount(popup_max_height_in_items);
        }
        ImGui_SetNextWindowSizeConstraints(constraint_min, constraint_max, null, null);
    }
    u8[16] name;
    ImFormatString(name, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(name) / sizeof(*name))), "##Combo_%02d", g.BeginComboDepth);
    {
        ImGuiWindow* popup_window = ImGui_FindWindowByName(name);
        if popup_window != null {
            if popup_window.WasActive != 0 {
                ImVec2 size_expected = ImGui_CalcWindowNextAutoFitSize(popup_window);
                popup_window.AutoPosLastDirection = (flags & ImGuiComboFlags_PopupAlignLeft) != 0 ? ImGuiDir_Left : ImGuiDir_Down;
                ImRect r_outer = ImGui_GetPopupAllowedExtentRect(popup_window);
                ImVec2 pos = ImGui_FindBestWindowPosForPopupEx(ImRect_GetBL(&bb), size_expected, &popup_window.AutoPosLastDirection, r_outer, bb, ImGuiPopupPositionPolicy_ComboBox);
                ImGui_SetNextWindowPos(pos, 0, ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f});
            }
        }
    }
    ImGuiWindowFlags window_flags = ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove;
    ImGui_PushStyleVarX(ImGuiStyleVar_WindowPadding, g.Style.FramePadding.x);
    bool ret = ImGui_Begin(name, null, window_flags);
    ImGui_PopStyleVar(1);
    if ret == 0 {
        ImGui_EndPopup();
        if !g.IO.ConfigDebugBeginReturnValueOnce && !g.IO.ConfigDebugBeginReturnValueLoop {
            assert(0);
        }
        return false;
    }
    g.BeginComboDepth++;
    return true;
}

void ImGui_EndCombo() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    g.BeginComboDepth--;
    u8[16] name;
    ImFormatString(name, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(name) / sizeof(*name))), "##Combo_%02d", g.BeginComboDepth);
    if strcmp(g.CurrentWindow.Name, name) != 0 {
        while true {
            if 0 == 0 {
                if ImGui_ErrorLog("Calling EndCombo() in wrong window!") != 0 {
                    assert(0 && "Calling EndCombo() in wrong window!");
                }
                return;
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
    }
    ImGui_EndPopup();
}

// Call directly after the BeginCombo/EndCombo block. The preview is designed to only host non-interactive elements
// (Experimental, see GitHub issues: #1658, #4168)
bool ImGui_BeginComboPreview() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    ImGuiComboPreviewData* preview_data = &g.ComboPreviewData;
    if window.SkipItems || !(g.LastItemData.StatusFlags & ImGuiItemStatusFlags_Visible) {
        return false;
    }
    assert(g.LastItemData.Rect.Min.x == preview_data.PreviewRect.Min.x && g.LastItemData.Rect.Min.y == preview_data.PreviewRect.Min.y);
    if ImRect_Overlaps(&window.ClipRect, preview_data.PreviewRect) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    preview_data.BackupCursorPos = window.DC.CursorPos;
    preview_data.BackupCursorMaxPos = window.DC.CursorMaxPos;
    preview_data.BackupCursorPosPrevLine = window.DC.CursorPosPrevLine;
    preview_data.BackupPrevLineTextBaseOffset = window.DC.PrevLineTextBaseOffset;
    preview_data.BackupLayout = window.DC.LayoutType;
    window.DC.CursorPos = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(preview_data.PreviewRect.Min, g.Style.FramePadding);
    window.DC.CursorMaxPos = window.DC.CursorPos;
    window.DC.LayoutType = ImGuiLayoutType_Horizontal;
    window.DC.IsSameLine = false;
    ImGui_PushClipRect(preview_data.PreviewRect.Min, preview_data.PreviewRect.Max, true);
    return true;
}

void ImGui_EndComboPreview() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    ImGuiComboPreviewData* preview_data = &g.ComboPreviewData;
    ImDrawList* draw_list = window.DrawList;
    if window.DC.CursorMaxPos.x < preview_data.PreviewRect.Max.x && window.DC.CursorMaxPos.y < preview_data.PreviewRect.Max.y {
        if draw_list.CmdBuffer.Size > 1 {
            draw_list.CmdBuffer.Data[draw_list.CmdBuffer.Size - 1].ClipRect = draw_list.CmdBuffer.Data[draw_list.CmdBuffer.Size - 2].ClipRect;
            draw_list._CmdHeader.ClipRect = draw_list.CmdBuffer.Data[draw_list.CmdBuffer.Size - 1].ClipRect;
            ImDrawList__TryMergeDrawCmds(draw_list);
        }
    }
    ImGui_PopClipRect();
    window.DC.CursorPos = preview_data.BackupCursorPos;
    window.DC.CursorMaxPos = ImMax(window.DC.CursorMaxPos, preview_data.BackupCursorMaxPos);
    window.DC.CursorPosPrevLine = preview_data.BackupCursorPosPrevLine;
    window.DC.PrevLineTextBaseOffset = preview_data.BackupPrevLineTextBaseOffset;
    window.DC.LayoutType = preview_data.BackupLayout;
    window.DC.IsSameLine = false;
    preview_data.PreviewRect = __cxx_make_ImRect();
}

// Getter for the old Combo() API: const char*[]
private {
u8* Items_ArrayGetter(void* data, i32 idx) {
    var items = cast(u8**, data);
    return items[idx];
}

// Getter for the old Combo() API: "item1\0item2\0item3\0"
u8* Items_SingleStringGetter(void* data, i32 idx) {
    var items_separated_by_zeros = cast(u8*, data);
    i32 items_count = 0;
    u8* p = items_separated_by_zeros;
    while *p != 0 {
        if idx == items_count {
            break;
        }
        p += strlen(p) + 1;
        items_count++;
    }
    return *p != 0 ? p : null;
}
}

// Old API, prefer using BeginCombo() nowadays if you can.
bool ImGui_Combo(u8* label, i32* current_item, fn(void*, i32): u8* getter, void* user_data, i32 items_count, i32 popup_max_height_in_items) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    u8* preview_value = null;
    if *current_item >= 0 && *current_item < items_count {
        preview_value = getter(user_data, *current_item);
    }
    if popup_max_height_in_items != -1 && !(g.NextWindowData.HasFlags & ImGuiNextWindowDataFlags_HasSizeConstraint) {
        ImGui_SetNextWindowSizeConstraints(ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f}, ImVec2{
            FLT_MAX, CalcMaxPopupHeightFromItemCount(popup_max_height_in_items),
        }, null, null);
    }
    if ImGui_BeginCombo(label, preview_value, ImGuiComboFlags_None) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    bool value_changed = false;
    ImGuiListClipper clipper;
    ImGuiListClipper_Begin(&clipper, items_count, -1.0f);
    ImGuiListClipper_IncludeItemByIndex(&clipper, *current_item);
    while ImGuiListClipper_Step(&clipper) != 0 {
        for i32 i = clipper.DisplayStart; i < clipper.DisplayEnd; i++ {
            u8* item_text = getter(user_data, i);
            if item_text == null {
                item_text = "*Unknown item*";
            }
            ImGui_PushID(i);
            bool item_selected = i == *current_item;
            if ImGui_Selectable(item_text, item_selected) && *current_item != i {
                value_changed = true;
                *current_item = i;
            }
            if item_selected != 0 {
                ImGui_SetItemDefaultFocus();
            }
            ImGui_PopID();
        }
    }
    ImGui_EndCombo();
    if value_changed != 0 {
        ImGui_MarkItemEdited(g.LastItemData.ID);
    }
    return value_changed;
}

// Combo box helper allowing to pass an array of strings.
bool ImGui_Combo(u8* label, i32* current_item, u8** items, i32 items_count, i32 height_in_items) {
    bool value_changed = ImGui_Combo(label, current_item, cast(fn(void*, i32): u8*, Items_ArrayGetter), cast(void*, items), items_count, height_in_items);
    return value_changed;
}

// Combo box helper allowing to pass all items in a single string literal holding multiple zero-terminated items "item1\0item2\0"
bool ImGui_Combo(u8* label, i32* current_item, u8* items_separated_by_zeros, i32 height_in_items) {
    i32 items_count = 0;
    u8* p = items_separated_by_zeros;
    while *p != 0 {
        p += strlen(p) + 1;
        items_count++;
    }
    bool value_changed = ImGui_Combo(label, current_item, cast(fn(void*, i32): u8*, Items_SingleStringGetter), cast(void*, items_separated_by_zeros), items_count, height_in_items);
    return value_changed;
}

void ImGui_DataTypeApplyOp(ImGuiDataType data_type, i32 op, void* output, void* arg1, void* arg2) {
    assert(op == 43 || op == 45);
    switch data_type {
        case ImGuiDataType_S8: {
            if op == 43 {
                *cast(ImS8*, output) = cast(ImS8, ImAddClampOverflow(cast(i32, *cast(ImS8*, arg1)), cast(i32, *cast(ImS8*, arg2)), cast(i32, IM_S8_MIN), cast(i32, IM_S8_MAX)));
            }
            if op == 45 {
                *cast(ImS8*, output) = cast(ImS8, ImSubClampOverflow(cast(i32, *cast(ImS8*, arg1)), cast(i32, *cast(ImS8*, arg2)), cast(i32, IM_S8_MIN), cast(i32, IM_S8_MAX)));
            }
            return;
        }
        case ImGuiDataType_U8: {
            if op == 43 {
                *cast(ImU8*, output) = cast(ImU8, ImAddClampOverflow(cast(i32, *cast(ImU8*, arg1)), cast(i32, *cast(ImU8*, arg2)), cast(i32, IM_U8_MIN), cast(i32, IM_U8_MAX)));
            }
            if op == 45 {
                *cast(ImU8*, output) = cast(ImU8, ImSubClampOverflow(cast(i32, *cast(ImU8*, arg1)), cast(i32, *cast(ImU8*, arg2)), cast(i32, IM_U8_MIN), cast(i32, IM_U8_MAX)));

// User can input math operators (e.g. +100) to edit a numerical values.
// NB: This is _not_ a full expression evaluator. We should probably add one and replace this dumb mess..
bool ImGui_DataTypeApplyFromText(u8* buf, ImGuiDataType data_type, void* p_data, u8* format_var, void* p_data_when_empty) {
    ImGuiDataTypeInfo* type_info = ImGui_DataTypeGetInfo(data_type);
    ImGuiDataTypeStorage data_backup;
    memcpy(&data_backup, p_data, type_info.Size);
    while ImCharIsBlankA(*buf) != 0 {
        buf++;
    }
    if buf[0] == 0 {
        if p_data_when_empty != null {
            memcpy(p_data, p_data_when_empty, type_info.Size);
            return memcmp(&data_backup, p_data, type_info.Size) != 0;
        }
        return false;
    }
    u8[32] format_sanitized;
    if data_type == ImGuiDataType_Float || data_type == ImGuiDataType_Double {
        format_var = type_info.ScanFmt;
    } else {
        format_var = ImParseFormatSanitizeForScanning(format_var, format_sanitized, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(format_sanitized) / sizeof(*format_sanitized))));
        if format_var[0] == 0 {
            format_var = type_info.ScanFmt;
        }
    }
    i32 v32 = 0;
    if sscanf(buf, format_var, type_info.Size >= 4 ? p_data : &v32) < 1 {
        return false;
    }
    if type_info.Size < 4 {
        if data_type == ImGuiDataType_S8 {
            *cast(ImS8*, p_data) = cast(ImS8, ImClamp(v32, cast(i32, IM_S8_MIN), cast(i32, IM_S8_MAX)));
        } else if data_type == ImGuiDataType_U8 {
            *cast(ImU8*, p_data) = cast(ImU8, ImClamp(v32, cast(i32, IM_U8_MIN), cast(i32, IM_U8_MAX)));
        } else if data_type == ImGuiDataType_S16 {
            *cast(ImS16*, p_data) = cast(ImS16, ImClamp(v32, cast(i32, IM_S16_MIN), cast(i32, IM_S16_MAX)));
        } else if data_type == ImGuiDataType_U16 {
            *cast(ImU16*, p_data) = cast(ImU16, ImClamp(v32, cast(i32, IM_U16_MIN), cast(i32, IM_U16_MAX)));
        } else {
            assert(0);
        }
    }
    return memcmp(&data_backup, p_data, type_info.Size) != 0;
}

private {

    if decimal_precision < 0 {
        return FLT_MIN;
    }
    return decimal_precision < cast(i32, sizeof(GetMinimumStepAtDecimalPrecision__min_steps) / sizeof(*GetMinimumStepAtDecimalPrecision__min_steps)) ? GetMinimumStepAtDecimalPrecision__min_steps[decimal_precision] : ImPow(10.0f, cast(f32, -decimal_precision));
}

f32 ImGui_RoundScalarWithFormatT(u8* format_var, ImGuiDataType data_type, f32 v) {
    ignore data_type;
    assert(data_type == ImGuiDataType_Float || data_type == ImGuiDataType_Double);
    u8* fmt_start = ImParseFormatFindStart(format_var);
    if fmt_start[0] != 37 || fmt_start[1] == 37 {
        return v;
    }
    u8[32] fmt_sanitized;
    ImParseFormatSanitizeForPrinting(fmt_start, fmt_sanitized, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(fmt_sanitized) / sizeof(*fmt_sanitized))));
    fmt_start = fmt_sanitized;
    u8[64] v_str;
    ImFormatString(v_str, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(v_str) / sizeof(*v_str))), fmt_start, v);
    u8* p = v_str;
    while *p == 32 {
        p++;
    }
    v = cast(f32, atof(p));
    return v;
}

bool ImGui_DragBehaviorT_ImS32_ImS32_float(ImGuiDataType data_type, ImS32* v, f32 v_speed, ImS32 v_min, ImS32 v_max, u8* format_var, ImGuiSliderFlags flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiAxis axis = (flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_Vertical) != 0 ? ImGuiAxis_Y : ImGuiAxis_X;
    bool is_bounded = v_min < v_max || v_min == v_max && (cast(f32, v_min) != 0.0f || flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_ClampZeroRange);
    bool is_wrapped = is_bounded && flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_WrapAround;
    bool is_logarithmic = (flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_Logarithmic) != 0;
    bool is_floating_point = data_type == ImGuiDataType_Float || data_type == ImGuiDataType_Double;
    if v_speed == 0.0f && is_bounded && cast(f32, v_max - v_min) < FLT_MAX {
        v_speed = cast(f32, v_max - v_min) * g.DragSpeedDefaultRatio;
    }
    f32 adjust_delta = 0.0f;
    if g.ActiveIdSource == ImGuiInputSource_Mouse && ImGui_IsMousePosValid(null) && ImGui_IsMouseDragPastThreshold(0, g.IO.MouseDragThreshold * DRAG_MOUSE_THRESHOLD_FACTOR) {
        adjust_delta = cast(f32*, &g.IO.MouseDelta)[axis];
        if g.IO.KeyAlt && !(flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_NoSpeedTweaks) {
            adjust_delta *= 1.0f / 100.0f;
        }
        if g.IO.KeyShift && !(flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_NoSpeedTweaks) {
            adjust_delta *= 10.0f;
        }
    } else if g.ActiveIdSource == ImGuiInputSource_Keyboard || g.ActiveIdSource == ImGuiInputSource_Gamepad {
        i32 decimal_precision = is_floating_point != 0 ? ImParseFormatPrecision(format_var, 3) : 0;
        bool tweak_slow = ImGui_IsKeyDown(g.NavInputSource == ImGuiInputSource_Gamepad ? ImGuiKey_GamepadL1 : ImGuiMod_Ctrl);
        bool tweak_fast = ImGui_IsKeyDown(g.NavInputSource == ImGuiInputSource_Gamepad ? ImGuiKey_GamepadR1 : ImGuiMod_Shift);
        f32 tweak_factor = (flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_NoSpeedTweaks) != 0 ? 1.0f : tweak_slow != 0 ? 1.0f / 10.0f : tweak_fast != 0 ? 10.0f : 1.0f;
        adjust_delta = ImGui_GetNavTweakPressedAmount(axis) * tweak_factor;
        v_speed = ImMax(v_speed, GetMinimumStepAtDecimalPrecision(decimal_precision));
    }
    adjust_delta *= v_speed;
    if axis == ImGuiAxis_Y {
        adjust_delta = -adjust_delta;
    }
    if is_logarithmic && cast(f32, v_max - v_min) < FLT_MAX && cast(f32, v_max - v_min) > 1.0e-6f {
        adjust_delta /= cast(f32, v_max - v_min);
    }
    bool is_just_activated = g.ActiveIdIsJustActivated;
    bool is_already_past_limits_and_pushing_outward = is_bounded && !is_wrapped && (*v >= v_max && adjust_delta > 0.0f || *v <= v_min && adjust_delta < 0.0f);
    if is_just_activated || is_already_past_limits_and_pushing_outward {
        g.DragCurrentAccum = 0.0f;
        g.DragCurrentAccumDirty = false;
    } else if adjust_delta != 0.0f {
        g.DragCurrentAccum += adjust_delta;
        g.DragCurrentAccumDirty = true;
    }
    if g.DragCurrentAccumDirty == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImS32 v_cur = *v;
    var v_old_ref_for_accum_remainder = 0.0f;
    f32 logarithmic_zero_epsilon = 0.0f;
    f32 zero_deadzone_halfsize = 0.0f;
    if is_logarithmic != 0 {
        i32 decimal_precision = is_floating_point != 0 ? ImParseFormatPrecision(format_var, 3) : 1;
        logarithmic_zero_epsilon = ImPow(0.1f, cast(f32, decimal_precision));
        f32 v_old_parametric = ImGui_ScaleRatioFromValueT_ImS32_ImS32_float(data_type, v_cur, v_min, v_max, logarithmic_zero_epsilon, zero_deadzone_halfsize);
        f32 v_new_parametric = v_old_parametric + g.DragCurrentAccum;
        v_cur = ImGui_ScaleValueFromRatioT_ImS32_ImS32_float(data_type, v_new_parametric, v_min, v_max, logarithmic_zero_epsilon, zero_deadzone_halfsize);
        v_old_ref_for_accum_remainder = v_old_parametric;
    } else {
        v_cur += cast(ImS32, g.DragCurrentAccum);
    }
    if is_floating_point && !(flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_NoRoundToFormat) {
        v_cur = ImGui_RoundScalarWithFormatT_ImS32(format_var, data_type, v_cur);
    }
    g.DragCurrentAccumDirty = false;
    if is_logarithmic != 0 {
        f32 v_new_parametric = ImGui_ScaleRatioFromValueT_ImS32_ImS32_float(data_type, v_cur, v_min, v_max, logarithmic_zero_epsilon, zero_deadzone_halfsize);
        g.DragCurrentAccum -= v_new_parametric - v_old_ref_for_accum_remainder;
    } else {
        g.DragCurrentAccum -= cast(f32, cast(ImS32, v_cur) - *v);
    }
    if v_cur == cast(ImS32, -0) {
        v_cur = cast(ImS32, 0);
    }
    if *v != v_cur && is_bounded {
        if is_wrapped != 0 {
            if v_cur < v_min {
                v_cur += v_max - v_min + (is_floating_point != 0 ? 0 : 1);
            }
            if v_cur > v_max {
                v_cur -= v_max - v_min + (is_floating_point != 0 ? 0 : 1);
