    bool is_bounded = v_min < v_max || v_min == v_max && (v_min != 0.0f || flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_ClampZeroRange);
    bool is_wrapped = is_bounded && flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_WrapAround;
    bool is_logarithmic = (flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_Logarithmic) != 0;
    bool is_floating_point = data_type == ImGuiDataType_Float || data_type == ImGuiDataType_Double;
    if v_speed == 0.0f && is_bounded && v_max - v_min < FLT_MAX {
        v_speed = cast(f32, (v_max - v_min) * cast(f64, g.DragSpeedDefaultRatio));
    }
    f32 adjust_delta = 0.0f;
    if g.ActiveIdSource == ImGuiInputSource_Mouse && ImGui_IsMousePosValid(null) && ImGui_IsMouseDragPastThreshold(0, g.IO.MouseDragThreshold * DRAG_MOUSE_THRESHOLD_FACTOR) {
        adjust_delta = cast(f32*, &g.IO.MouseDelta)[axis];
        if g.IO.KeyAlt && !(flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_NoSpeedTweaks) {
            adjust_delta *= 1.0f / 100.0f;
        }
        if g.IO.KeyShift && !(flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_NoSpeedTweaks) {
            adjust_delta *= 10.0f;
        }
    } else if g.ActiveIdSource == ImGuiInputSource_Keyboard || g.ActiveIdSource == ImGuiInputSource_Gamepad {
        i32 decimal_precision = is_floating_point != 0 ? ImParseFormatPrecision(format_var, 3) : 0;
        bool tweak_slow = ImGui_IsKeyDown(g.NavInputSource == ImGuiInputSource_Gamepad ? ImGuiKey_GamepadL1 : ImGuiMod_Ctrl);
        bool tweak_fast = ImGui_IsKeyDown(g.NavInputSource == ImGuiInputSource_Gamepad ? ImGuiKey_GamepadR1 : ImGuiMod_Shift);
        f32 tweak_factor = (flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_NoSpeedTweaks) != 0 ? 1.0f : tweak_slow != 0 ? 1.0f / 10.0f : tweak_fast != 0 ? 10.0f : 1.0f;
        adjust_delta = ImGui_GetNavTweakPressedAmount(axis) * tweak_factor;
        v_speed = ImMax(v_speed, GetMinimumStepAtDecimalPrecision(decimal_precision));
    }
    adjust_delta *= v_speed;
    if axis == ImGuiAxis_Y {
        adjust_delta = -adjust_delta;
    }
    if is_logarithmic && v_max - v_min < FLT_MAX && v_max - v_min > 1.0e-6f {
        adjust_delta /= cast(f32, v_max - v_min);
    }
    bool is_just_activated = g.ActiveIdIsJustActivated;
    bool is_already_past_limits_and_pushing_outward = is_bounded && !is_wrapped && (*v >= v_max && adjust_delta > 0.0f || *v <= v_min && adjust_delta < 0.0f);
    if is_just_activated || is_already_past_limits_and_pushing_outward {
        g.DragCurrentAccum = 0.0f;
        g.DragCurrentAccumDirty = false;
    } else if adjust_delta != 0.0f {
        g.DragCurrentAccum += adjust_delta;
        g.DragCurrentAccumDirty = true;
    }
    if g.DragCurrentAccumDirty == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    f64 v_cur = *v;
    var v_old_ref_for_accum_remainder = cast(f64, 0.0f);
    f32 logarithmic_zero_epsilon = 0.0f;
    f32 zero_deadzone_halfsize = 0.0f;
    if is_logarithmic != 0 {
        i32 decimal_precision = is_floating_point != 0 ? ImParseFormatPrecision(format_var, 3) : 1;
        logarithmic_zero_epsilon = ImPow(0.1f, cast(f32, decimal_precision));
        f32 v_old_parametric = ImGui_ScaleRatioFromValueT_double_double_double(data_type, v_cur, v_min, v_max, logarithmic_zero_epsilon, zero_deadzone_halfsize);
        f32 v_new_parametric = v_old_parametric + g.DragCurrentAccum;
        v_cur = ImGui_ScaleValueFromRatioT_double_double_double(data_type, v_new_parametric, v_min, v_max, logarithmic_zero_epsilon, zero_deadzone_halfsize);
        v_old_ref_for_accum_remainder = v_old_parametric;
    } else {
        v_cur += cast(f64, g.DragCurrentAccum);
    }
    if is_floating_point && !(flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_NoRoundToFormat) {
        v_cur = ImGui_RoundScalarWithFormatT_double(format_var, data_type, v_cur);
    }
    g.DragCurrentAccumDirty = false;
    if is_logarithmic != 0 {
        f32 v_new_parametric = ImGui_ScaleRatioFromValueT_double_double_double(data_type, v_cur, v_min, v_max, logarithmic_zero_epsilon, zero_deadzone_halfsize);
        g.DragCurrentAccum -= cast(f32, v_new_parametric - v_old_ref_for_accum_remainder);
    } else {
        g.DragCurrentAccum -= cast(f32, v_cur - *v);
    }
    if v_cur == cast(f64, -0) {
        v_cur = cast(f64, 0);
    }
    if *v != v_cur && is_bounded {
        if is_wrapped != 0 {
            if v_cur < v_min {
                v_cur += v_max - v_min + cast(f64, is_floating_point != 0 ? 0 : 1);
            }
            if v_cur > v_max {
                v_cur -= v_max - v_min + cast(f64, is_floating_point != 0 ? 0 : 1);
            }
        } else {
            if v_cur < v_min || v_cur > *v && adjust_delta < 0.0f && !is_floating_point {
                v_cur = v_min;
            }
            if v_cur > v_max || v_cur < *v && adjust_delta > 0.0f && !is_floating_point {
                v_cur = v_max;
            }
        }
    }
    if *v == v_cur {
        return false;
    }
    *v = v_cur;
    return true;
}

bool ImGui_DragBehavior(ImGuiID id, ImGuiDataType data_type, void* p_v, f32 v_speed, void* p_min, void* p_max, u8* format_var, ImGuiSliderFlags flags) {
    assert((flags == 1 || (flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_InvalidMask_) == 0) && "Invalid ImGuiSliderFlags flags! Has the legacy 'float power' argument been mistakenly cast to flags? Call function with ImGuiSliderFlags_Logarithmic flags instead.");
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if g.ActiveId == id {
        if g.ActiveIdSource == ImGuiInputSource_Mouse && !g.IO.MouseDown[0] {
            ImGui_ClearActiveID();
        } else if (g.ActiveIdSource == ImGuiInputSource_Keyboard || g.ActiveIdSource == ImGuiInputSource_Gamepad) && g.NavActivatePressedId == id && !g.ActiveIdIsJustActivated {
            ImGui_ClearActiveID();
        }
    }
    if g.ActiveId != id {
        return false;
    }
    if g.LastItemData.ItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_ReadOnly || flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_ReadOnly {
        return false;
    }
    switch data_type {
        case ImGuiDataType_S8: {
            {
                var v32 = cast(ImS32, *cast(ImS8*, p_v));
                bool r = ImGui_DragBehaviorT_ImS32_ImS32_float(ImGuiDataType_S32, &v32, v_speed, cast(ImS32, p_min != null ? *cast(ImS8*, p_min) : IM_S8_MIN), cast(ImS32, p_max != null ? *cast(ImS8*, p_max) : IM_S8_MAX), format_var, flags);
                if r != 0 {
                    *cast(ImS8*, p_v) = cast(ImS8, v32);
                }
                return r;
            }
        }
        case ImGuiDataType_U8: {
            {
                var v32 = cast(ImU32, *cast(ImU8*, p_v));
                bool r = ImGui_DragBehaviorT_ImU32_ImS32_float(ImGuiDataType_U32, &v32, v_speed, cast(ImU32, p_min != null ? *cast(ImU8*, p_min) : IM_U8_MIN), cast(ImU32, p_max != null ? *cast(ImU8*, p_max) : IM_U8_MAX), format_var, flags);
                if r != 0 {
                    *cast(ImU8*, p_v) = cast(ImU8, v32);
                }
                return r;
            }
        }
        case ImGuiDataType_S16: {
            {
                var v32 = cast(ImS32, *cast(ImS16*, p_v));
                bool r = ImGui_DragBehaviorT_ImS32_ImS32_float(ImGuiDataType_S32, &v32, v_speed, cast(ImS32, p_min != null ? *cast(ImS16*, p_min) : IM_S16_MIN), cast(ImS32, p_max != null ? *cast(ImS16*, p_max) : IM_S16_MAX), format_var, flags);
                if r != 0 {
                    *cast(ImS16*, p_v) = cast(ImS16, v32);
                }
                return r;
            }
        }
        case ImGuiDataType_U16: {
            {
                var v32 = cast(ImU32, *cast(ImU16*, p_v));
                bool r = ImGui_DragBehaviorT_ImU32_ImS32_float(ImGuiDataType_U32, &v32, v_speed, cast(ImU32, p_min != null ? *cast(ImU16*, p_min) : IM_U16_MIN), cast(ImU32, p_max != null ? *cast(ImU16*, p_max) : IM_U16_MAX), format_var, flags);
                if r != 0 {
                    *cast(ImU16*, p_v) = cast(ImU16, v32);
                }
                return r;
            }
        }
        case ImGuiDataType_S32: {
            return ImGui_DragBehaviorT_ImS32_ImS32_float(data_type, cast(ImS32*, p_v), v_speed, p_min != null ? *cast(ImS32*, p_min) : IM_S32_MIN, p_max != null ? *cast(ImS32*, p_max) : IM_S32_MAX, format_var, flags);
        }
        case ImGuiDataType_U32: {
            return ImGui_DragBehaviorT_ImU32_ImS32_float(data_type, cast(ImU32*, p_v), v_speed, p_min != null ? *cast(ImU32*, p_min) : IM_U32_MIN, p_max != null ? *cast(ImU32*, p_max) : IM_U32_MAX, format_var, flags);
        }
        case ImGuiDataType_S64: {
            return ImGui_DragBehaviorT_ImS64_ImS64_double(data_type, cast(ImS64*, p_v), v_speed, p_min != null ? *cast(ImS64*, p_min) : IM_S64_MIN, p_max != null ? *cast(ImS64*, p_max) : IM_S64_MAX, format_var, flags);
        }
        case ImGuiDataType_U64: {
            return ImGui_DragBehaviorT_ImU64_ImS64_double(data_type, cast(ImU64*, p_v), v_speed, p_min != null ? *cast(ImU64*, p_min) : IM_U64_MIN, p_max != null ? *cast(ImU64*, p_max) : IM_U64_MAX, format_var, flags);
        }
        case ImGuiDataType_Float: {
            return ImGui_DragBehaviorT_float_float_float(data_type, cast(f32*, p_v), v_speed, p_min != null ? *cast(f32*, p_min) : cast(f32, -FLT_MAX), p_max != null ? *cast(f32*, p_max) : FLT_MAX, format_var, flags);
        }
        case ImGuiDataType_Double: {
            return ImGui_DragBehaviorT_double_double_double(data_type, cast(f64*, p_v), v_speed, p_min != null ? *cast(f64*, p_min) : cast(f64, -DBL_MAX), p_max != null ? *cast(f64*, p_max) : DBL_MAX, format_var, flags);
        }
        case ImGuiDataType_COUNT: {
        }
    }
    assert(0);
    return false;
}

// Only clamp Ctrl+Click input when ImGuiSliderFlags_ClampOnInput is set (generally via ImGuiSliderFlags_AlwaysClamp)
private {
bool TempInputIsClampEnabled(ImGuiSliderFlags flags, ImGuiDataType data_type, void* p_min, void* p_max) {
    if flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_ClampOnInput && (p_min != null || p_max != null) {
        i32 clamp_range_dir = p_min != null && p_max != null ? ImGui_DataTypeCompare(data_type, p_min, p_max) : 0;
        if p_min == null || p_max == null || clamp_range_dir < 0 {
            return true;
        }
        if clamp_range_dir == 0 {
            return ImGui_DataTypeIsZero(data_type, p_min) != 0 ? (flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_ClampZeroRange) != 0 : true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}
}

// Note: p_data, p_min and p_max are _pointers_ to a memory address holding the data. For a Drag widget, p_min and p_max are optional.
// Read code of e.g. DragFloat(), DragInt() etc. or examples in 'Demo->Widgets->Data Types' to understand how to use this function directly.
bool ImGui_DragScalar(u8* label, ImGuiDataType data_type, void* p_data, f32 v_speed, void* p_min, void* p_max, u8* format_var, ImGuiSliderFlags flags) {
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiStyle style = g.Style;
    ImGuiID id = ImGuiWindow_GetID(window, label, null);
    f32 w = ImGui_CalcItemWidth();
    ImU32 color_marker = (g.NextItemData.HasFlags & ImGuiNextItemDataFlags_HasColorMarker) != 0 ? g.NextItemData.ColorMarker : 0;
    u8* label_end = ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(label, null);
    ImVec2 label_size = ImGui_CalcTextSize(label, label_end, false, -1.0f);
    ImRect frame_bb;
    ImRect_init(&frame_bb, window.DC.CursorPos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.DC.CursorPos, ImVec2{w, label_size.y + style.FramePadding.y * 2.0f}));
    ImRect total_bb;
    ImRect_init(&total_bb, frame_bb.Min, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(frame_bb.Max, ImVec2{
        label_size.x > 0.0f ? style.ItemInnerSpacing.x + label_size.x : 0.0f, 0.0f,
    }));
    bool temp_input_allowed = (flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_NoInput) == 0;
    ImGui_ItemSize(total_bb, style.FramePadding.y);
    if ImGui_ItemAdd(total_bb, id, &frame_bb, temp_input_allowed != 0 ? ImGuiItemFlags_Inputable : 0) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    if format_var == null {
        format_var = ImGui_DataTypeGetInfo(data_type).PrintFmt;
    }
    bool hovered = ImGui_ItemHoverable(frame_bb, id, g.LastItemData.ItemFlags);
    bool temp_input_is_active = temp_input_allowed && ImGui_TempInputIsActive(id);
    if temp_input_is_active == 0 {
        bool clicked = hovered && ImGui_IsMouseClicked(0, ImGuiInputFlags_None, id);
        bool double_clicked = hovered && g.IO.MouseClickedCount[0] == 2 && ImGui_TestKeyOwner(ImGuiKey_MouseLeft, id);
        bool make_active = clicked || double_clicked || g.NavActivateId == id;
        if make_active && (clicked || double_clicked) {
            ImGui_SetKeyOwner(ImGuiKey_MouseLeft, id, 0);
        }
        if make_active && temp_input_allowed {
            if clicked && g.IO.KeyCtrl || double_clicked || g.NavActivateId == id && g.NavActivateFlags & ImGuiActivateFlags_PreferInput {
                temp_input_is_active = true;
            }
        }
        if g.IO.ConfigDragClickToInputText && temp_input_allowed && !temp_input_is_active {
            if g.ActiveId == id && hovered && g.IO.MouseReleased[0] && !ImGui_IsMouseDragPastThreshold(0, g.IO.MouseDragThreshold * DRAG_MOUSE_THRESHOLD_FACTOR) {
                g.NavActivateId = id;
                g.NavActivateFlags = ImGuiActivateFlags_PreferInput;
                temp_input_is_active = true;
            }
        }
        if make_active != 0 {
            memcpy(&g.ActiveIdValueOnActivation, p_data, ImGui_DataTypeGetInfo(data_type).Size);
        }
        if make_active && !temp_input_is_active {
            ImGui_SetActiveID(id, window);
            ImGui_SetFocusID(id, window);
            ImGui_FocusWindow(window, 0);
            g.ActiveIdUsingNavDirMask = cast(ImU32, 1 << ImGuiDir_Left | 1 << ImGuiDir_Right);
        }
    }
    if temp_input_is_active != 0 {
        bool clamp_enabled = TempInputIsClampEnabled(flags, data_type, p_min, p_max);
        return ImGui_TempInputScalar(frame_bb, id, label, data_type, p_data, format_var, clamp_enabled != 0 ? p_min : null, clamp_enabled != 0 ? p_max : null);
    }
    ImU32 frame_col = ImGui_GetColorU32(g.ActiveId == id ? ImGuiCol_FrameBgActive : hovered != 0 ? ImGuiCol_FrameBgHovered : ImGuiCol_FrameBg);
    ImGui_RenderNavCursor(frame_bb, id, ImGuiNavRenderCursorFlags_None, -1.0f);
    ImGui_RenderFrame(frame_bb.Min, frame_bb.Max, frame_col, false, style.FrameRounding);
    if color_marker != 0 && style.ColorMarkerSize > 0.0f {
        ImGui_RenderColorComponentMarker(frame_bb, ImGui_GetColorU32(color_marker), style.FrameRounding);
    }
    ImGui_RenderFrameBorder(frame_bb.Min, frame_bb.Max, g.Style.FrameRounding);
    bool value_changed = ImGui_DragBehavior(id, data_type, p_data, v_speed, p_min, p_max, format_var, flags);
    if value_changed != 0 {
        ImGui_MarkItemEdited(id);
    }
    u8[64] value_buf;
    u8* value_buf_end = value_buf + ImGui_DataTypeFormatString(value_buf, cast(i32, sizeof(value_buf) / sizeof(*value_buf)), data_type, p_data, format_var);
    if g.LogEnabled != 0 {
        ImGui_LogSetNextTextDecoration("{", "}");
    }
    ImGui_RenderTextClipped(frame_bb.Min, frame_bb.Max, value_buf, value_buf_end, null, ImVec2{0.5f, 0.5f}, null);
    if label_size.x > 0.0f {
        ImGui_RenderText(ImVec2{
            frame_bb.Max.x + style.ItemInnerSpacing.x, frame_bb.Min.y + style.FramePadding.y,
        }, label, label_end, false);
    }
    ignore *g;
    return value_changed;
}

bool ImGui_DragScalarN(u8* label, ImGuiDataType data_type, void* p_data, i32 components, f32 v_speed, void* p_min, void* p_max, u8* format_var, ImGuiSliderFlags flags) {
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    bool value_changed = false;
    ImGui_BeginGroup();
    ImGui_PushID(label);
    ImGui_PushMultiItemsWidths(components, ImGui_CalcItemWidth());
    u64 type_size = GDataTypeInfo[data_type].Size;
    for i32 i = 0; i < components; i++ {
        ImGui_PushID(i);
        if i > 0 {
            ImGui_SameLine(0.0f, g.Style.ItemInnerSpacing.x);
        }
        if (flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_ColorMarkers) != 0 {
            ImGui_SetNextItemColorMarker(GDefaultRgbaColorMarkers[i]);
        }
        value_changed |= ImGui_DragScalar("", data_type, p_data, v_speed, p_min, p_max, format_var, flags);
        ImGui_PopID();
        ImGui_PopItemWidth();
        p_data = cast(void*, cast(u8*, p_data) + type_size);
    }
    ImGui_PopID();
    u8* label_end = ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(label, null);
    if label != label_end {
        ImGui_SameLine(0.0f, g.Style.ItemInnerSpacing.x);
        ImGui_TextEx(label, label_end);
    }
    ImGui_EndGroup();
    return value_changed;
}

                ImVec2{grab_pos - grab_sz * 0.5f, bb.Min.y + grab_padding},
                ImVec2{grab_pos + grab_sz * 0.5f, bb.Max.y - grab_padding},
            };
        } else {
            *out_grab_bb = ImRect{
                ImVec2{bb.Min.x + grab_padding, grab_pos - grab_sz * 0.5f},
                ImVec2{bb.Max.x - grab_padding, grab_pos + grab_sz * 0.5f},
            };
        }
    }
    return value_changed;
}

// For 32-bit and larger types, slider bounds are limited to half the natural type range.
// So e.g. an integer Slider between INT_MAX-10 and INT_MAX will fail, but an integer Slider between INT_MAX/2-10 and INT_MAX/2 will be ok.
// It would be possible to lift that limitation with some work but it doesn't seem to be worth it for sliders.
bool ImGui_SliderBehavior(ImRect bb, ImGuiID id, ImGuiDataType data_type, void* p_v, void* p_min, void* p_max, u8* format_var, ImGuiSliderFlags flags, ImRect* out_grab_bb) {
    assert((flags == 1 || (flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_InvalidMask_) == 0) && "Invalid ImGuiSliderFlags flags! Has the legacy 'float power' argument been mistakenly cast to flags? Call function with ImGuiSliderFlags_Logarithmic flags instead.");
    assert((flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_WrapAround) == 0);
    switch data_type {
        case ImGuiDataType_S8: {
            {
                var v32 = cast(ImS32, *cast(ImS8*, p_v));
                bool r = ImGui_SliderBehaviorT_ImS32_ImS32_float(bb, id, ImGuiDataType_S32, &v32, cast(ImS32, *cast(ImS8*, p_min)), cast(ImS32, *cast(ImS8*, p_max)), format_var, flags, out_grab_bb);
                if r != 0 {
                    *cast(ImS8*, p_v) = cast(ImS8, v32);
                }
                return r;
            }
        }
        case ImGuiDataType_U8: {
            {
                var v32 = cast(ImU32, *cast(ImU8*, p_v));
                bool r = ImGui_SliderBehaviorT_ImU32_ImS32_float(bb, id, ImGuiDataType_U32, &v32, cast(ImU32, *cast(ImU8*, p_min)), cast(ImU32, *cast(ImU8*, p_max)), format_var, flags, out_grab_bb);
                if r != 0 {
                    *cast(ImU8*, p_v) = cast(ImU8, v32);
                }
                return r;
            }
        }
        case ImGuiDataType_S16: {
            {
                var v32 = cast(ImS32, *cast(ImS16*, p_v));
                bool r = ImGui_SliderBehaviorT_ImS32_ImS32_float(bb, id, ImGuiDataType_S32, &v32, cast(ImS32, *cast(ImS16*, p_min)), cast(ImS32, *cast(ImS16*, p_max)), format_var, flags, out_grab_bb);
                if r != 0 {
                    *cast(ImS16*, p_v) = cast(ImS16, v32);
                }
                return r;
            }
        }
        case ImGuiDataType_U16: {
            {
                var v32 = cast(ImU32, *cast(ImU16*, p_v));
                bool r = ImGui_SliderBehaviorT_ImU32_ImS32_float(bb, id, ImGuiDataType_U32, &v32, cast(ImU32, *cast(ImU16*, p_min)), cast(ImU32, *cast(ImU16*, p_max)), format_var, flags, out_grab_bb);
                if r != 0 {
                    *cast(ImU16*, p_v) = cast(ImU16, v32);
                }
                return r;
            }
        }
        case ImGuiDataType_S32: {
            assert(*cast(ImS32*, p_min) >= IM_S32_MIN / 2 && *cast(ImS32*, p_max) <= IM_S32_MAX / 2);
            return ImGui_SliderBehaviorT_ImS32_ImS32_float(bb, id, data_type, cast(ImS32*, p_v), *cast(ImS32*, p_min), *cast(ImS32*, p_max), format_var, flags, out_grab_bb);
        }
        case ImGuiDataType_U32: {
            assert(*cast(ImU32*, p_max) <= IM_U32_MAX / 2);
            return ImGui_SliderBehaviorT_ImU32_ImS32_float(bb, id, data_type, cast(ImU32*, p_v), *cast(ImU32*, p_min), *cast(ImU32*, p_max), format_var, flags, out_grab_bb);
        }
        case ImGuiDataType_S64: {
            assert(*cast(ImS64*, p_min) >= IM_S64_MIN / 2 && *cast(ImS64*, p_max) <= IM_S64_MAX / 2);
            return ImGui_SliderBehaviorT_ImS64_ImS64_double(bb, id, data_type, cast(ImS64*, p_v), *cast(ImS64*, p_min), *cast(ImS64*, p_max), format_var, flags, out_grab_bb);
        }
        case ImGuiDataType_U64: {
            assert(*cast(ImU64*, p_max) <= IM_U64_MAX / 2);
            return ImGui_SliderBehaviorT_ImU64_ImS64_double(bb, id, data_type, cast(ImU64*, p_v), *cast(ImU64*, p_min), *cast(ImU64*, p_max), format_var, flags, out_grab_bb);
        }
        case ImGuiDataType_Float: {
            assert(*cast(f32*, p_min) >= cast(f32, -FLT_MAX) / 2.0f && *cast(f32*, p_max) <= FLT_MAX / 2.0f);
            return ImGui_SliderBehaviorT_float_float_float(bb, id, data_type, cast(f32*, p_v), *cast(f32*, p_min), *cast(f32*, p_max), format_var, flags, out_grab_bb);
        }
        case ImGuiDataType_Double: {
            assert(*cast(f64*, p_min) >= cast(f32, -DBL_MAX) / 2.0f && *cast(f64*, p_max) <= DBL_MAX / 2.0f);
            return ImGui_SliderBehaviorT_double_double_double(bb, id, data_type, cast(f64*, p_v), *cast(f64*, p_min), *cast(f64*, p_max), format_var, flags, out_grab_bb);
        }
        case ImGuiDataType_COUNT: {
        }
    }
    assert(0);
    return false;
}

// Note: p_data, p_min and p_max are _pointers_ to a memory address holding the data. For a slider, they are all required.
// Read code of e.g. SliderFloat(), SliderInt() etc. or examples in 'Demo->Widgets->Data Types' to understand how to use this function directly.
bool ImGui_SliderScalar(u8* label, ImGuiDataType data_type, void* p_data, void* p_min, void* p_max, u8* format_var, ImGuiSliderFlags flags) {
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiStyle style = g.Style;
    ImGuiID id = ImGuiWindow_GetID(window, label, null);
    f32 w = ImGui_CalcItemWidth();
    ImU32 color_marker = (g.NextItemData.HasFlags & ImGuiNextItemDataFlags_HasColorMarker) != 0 ? g.NextItemData.ColorMarker : 0;
    u8* label_end = ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(label, null);
    ImVec2 label_size = ImGui_CalcTextSize(label, label_end, false, -1.0f);
    ImRect frame_bb;
    ImRect_init(&frame_bb, window.DC.CursorPos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.DC.CursorPos, ImVec2{w, label_size.y + style.FramePadding.y * 2.0f}));
    ImRect total_bb;
    ImRect_init(&total_bb, frame_bb.Min, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(frame_bb.Max, ImVec2{
        label_size.x > 0.0f ? style.ItemInnerSpacing.x + label_size.x : 0.0f, 0.0f,
    }));
    bool temp_input_allowed = (flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_NoInput) == 0;
    ImGui_ItemSize(total_bb, style.FramePadding.y);
    if ImGui_ItemAdd(total_bb, id, &frame_bb, temp_input_allowed != 0 ? ImGuiItemFlags_Inputable : 0) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    if format_var == null {
        format_var = ImGui_DataTypeGetInfo(data_type).PrintFmt;
    }
    bool hovered = ImGui_ItemHoverable(frame_bb, id, g.LastItemData.ItemFlags);
    bool temp_input_is_active = temp_input_allowed && ImGui_TempInputIsActive(id);
    if temp_input_is_active == 0 {
        bool clicked = hovered && ImGui_IsMouseClicked(0, ImGuiInputFlags_None, id);
        bool make_active = clicked || g.NavActivateId == id;
        if make_active && clicked {
            ImGui_SetKeyOwner(ImGuiKey_MouseLeft, id, 0);
        }
        if make_active && temp_input_allowed {
            if clicked && g.IO.KeyCtrl || g.NavActivateId == id && g.NavActivateFlags & ImGuiActivateFlags_PreferInput {
                temp_input_is_active = true;
            }
        }
        if make_active != 0 {
            memcpy(&g.ActiveIdValueOnActivation, p_data, ImGui_DataTypeGetInfo(data_type).Size);
        }
        if make_active && !temp_input_is_active {
            ImGui_SetActiveID(id, window);
            ImGui_SetFocusID(id, window);
            ImGui_FocusWindow(window, 0);
            g.ActiveIdUsingNavDirMask |= cast(ImU32, 1 << ImGuiDir_Left | 1 << ImGuiDir_Right);
        }
    }
    if temp_input_is_active != 0 {
        bool clamp_enabled = (flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_ClampOnInput) != 0;
        return ImGui_TempInputScalar(frame_bb, id, label, data_type, p_data, format_var, clamp_enabled != 0 ? p_min : null, clamp_enabled != 0 ? p_max : null);
    }
    ImU32 frame_col = ImGui_GetColorU32(g.ActiveId == id ? ImGuiCol_FrameBgActive : hovered != 0 ? ImGuiCol_FrameBgHovered : ImGuiCol_FrameBg);
    ImGui_RenderNavCursor(frame_bb, id, ImGuiNavRenderCursorFlags_None, -1.0f);
    ImGui_RenderFrame(frame_bb.Min, frame_bb.Max, frame_col, false, style.FrameRounding);
    if color_marker != 0 && style.ColorMarkerSize > 0.0f {
        ImGui_RenderColorComponentMarker(frame_bb, ImGui_GetColorU32(color_marker), style.FrameRounding);
    }
    ImGui_RenderFrameBorder(frame_bb.Min, frame_bb.Max, g.Style.FrameRounding);
    ImRect grab_bb;
    bool value_changed = ImGui_SliderBehavior(frame_bb, id, data_type, p_data, p_min, p_max, format_var, flags, &grab_bb);
    if value_changed != 0 {
        ImGui_MarkItemEdited(id);
    }
    if grab_bb.Max.x > grab_bb.Min.x {
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(window.DrawList, grab_bb.Min, grab_bb.Max, ImGui_GetColorU32(g.ActiveId == id ? ImGuiCol_SliderGrabActive : ImGuiCol_SliderGrab), style.GrabRounding, 0);
    }
    u8[64] value_buf;
    u8* value_buf_end = value_buf + ImGui_DataTypeFormatString(value_buf, cast(i32, sizeof(value_buf) / sizeof(*value_buf)), data_type, p_data, format_var);
    if g.LogEnabled != 0 {
        ImGui_LogSetNextTextDecoration("{", "}");
    }
    ImGui_RenderTextClipped(frame_bb.Min, frame_bb.Max, value_buf, value_buf_end, null, ImVec2{0.5f, 0.5f}, null);
    if label_size.x > 0.0f {
        ImGui_RenderText(ImVec2{
            frame_bb.Max.x + style.ItemInnerSpacing.x, frame_bb.Min.y + style.FramePadding.y,
        }, label, label_end, false);
    }
    ignore *g;
    return value_changed;
}

// Add multiple sliders on 1 line for compact edition of multiple components
bool ImGui_SliderScalarN(u8* label, ImGuiDataType data_type, void* v, i32 components, void* v_min, void* v_max, u8* format_var, ImGuiSliderFlags flags) {
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    bool value_changed = false;
    ImGui_BeginGroup();
    ImGui_PushID(label);
    ImGui_PushMultiItemsWidths(components, ImGui_CalcItemWidth());
    u64 type_size = GDataTypeInfo[data_type].Size;
    for i32 i = 0; i < components; i++ {
        ImGui_PushID(i);
        if i > 0 {
            ImGui_SameLine(0.0f, g.Style.ItemInnerSpacing.x);
        }
        if (flags & ImGuiSliderFlags_ColorMarkers) != 0 {
            ImGui_SetNextItemColorMarker(GDefaultRgbaColorMarkers[i]);
        }
        value_changed |= ImGui_SliderScalar("", data_type, v, v_min, v_max, format_var, flags);
        ImGui_PopID();
        ImGui_PopItemWidth();
        v = cast(void*, cast(u8*, v) + type_size);
    }
    ImGui_PopID();
    u8* label_end = ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(label, null);
    if label != label_end {
        ImGui_SameLine(0.0f, g.Style.ItemInnerSpacing.x);
        ImGui_TextEx(label, label_end);
    }
    ImGui_EndGroup();
    return value_changed;
}

// [SECTION] Widgets: InputScalar, InputFloat, InputInt, etc.
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
// - ImParseFormatFindStart() [Internal]
// - ImParseFormatFindEnd() [Internal]
// - ImParseFormatTrimDecorations() [Internal]
// - ImParseFormatSanitizeForPrinting() [Internal]
// - ImParseFormatSanitizeForScanning() [Internal]
// - ImParseFormatPrecision() [Internal]
// - TempInputText() [Internal]
// - TempInputScalar() [Internal]
// - InputScalar()
// - InputScalarN()
// - InputFloat()
// - InputFloat2()
// - InputFloat3()
// - InputFloat4()

// - InputInt4()
// - InputDouble()
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
// We don't use strchr() because our strings are usually very short and often start with '%'
u8* ImParseFormatFindStart(u8* fmt) {
    u8 c;
    while true {
        c = fmt[0];
        if c == 0 {
            break;
        }
        if c == 37 && fmt[1] != 37 {
            return fmt;
        } else if c == 37 {
            fmt++;
        }
        fmt++;
    }
    return fmt;
}

u8* ImParseFormatFindEnd(u8* fmt) {
    if fmt[0] != 37 {
        return fmt;
    }
    var ignored_uppercase_mask = cast(u32, 1 << 73 - 65 | 1 << 76 - 65);
    var ignored_lowercase_mask = cast(u32, 1 << 104 - 97 | 1 << 106 - 97 | 1 << 108 - 97 | 1 << 116 - 97 | 1 << 119 - 97 | 1 << 122 - 97);
    for u8 c; true; fmt++ {
        c = *fmt;
        if c != 0 == 0 {
            break;
        }
        if c >= 65 && c <= 90 && (1 << c - 65 & ignored_uppercase_mask) == 0 {
            return fmt + 1;
        }
        if c >= 97 && c <= 122 && (1 << c - 97 & ignored_lowercase_mask) == 0 {
            return fmt + 1;
        }
    }
    return fmt;
}

// Extract the format out of a format string with leading or trailing decorations
//  fmt = "blah blah"  -> return ""
//  fmt = "%.3f"       -> return fmt
//  fmt = "hello %.3f" -> return fmt + 6
//  fmt = "%.3f hello" -> return buf written with "%.3f"
u8* ImParseFormatTrimDecorations(u8* fmt, u8* buf, u64 buf_size) {
    u8* fmt_start = ImParseFormatFindStart(fmt);
    if fmt_start[0] != 37 {
        return "";
    }
    u8* fmt_end = ImParseFormatFindEnd(fmt_start);
    if fmt_end[0] == 0 {
        return fmt_start;
    }
    ImStrncpy(buf, fmt_start, cast(u64, ImMin(cast(i32, cast(u64, cast(i64, fmt_end - fmt_start)) + 1), cast(i32, buf_size))));
    return buf;
}

// Sanitize format
// - Zero terminate so extra characters after format (e.g. "%f123") don't confuse atof/atoi
// - stb_sprintf.h supports several new modifiers which format numbers in a way that also makes them incompatible atof/atoi.
void ImParseFormatSanitizeForPrinting(u8* fmt_in, u8* fmt_out, u64 fmt_out_size) {
    u8* fmt_end = ImParseFormatFindEnd(fmt_in);
    ignore fmt_out_size;
    assert(cast(u64, cast(i64, fmt_end - fmt_in) + 1) < fmt_out_size);
    while fmt_in < fmt_end {
        u8 c = *fmt_in++;
        if c != 39 && c != 36 && c != 95 {
            *fmt_out++ = c;
        }
    }
    *fmt_out = 0;
}

// - For scanning we need to remove all width and precision fields and flags "%+3.7f" -> "%f". BUT don't strip types like "%I64d" which includes digits. ! "%07I64d" -> "%I64d"
u8* ImParseFormatSanitizeForScanning(u8* fmt_in, u8* fmt_out, u64 fmt_out_size) {
    u8* fmt_end = ImParseFormatFindEnd(fmt_in);
    u8* fmt_out_begin = fmt_out;
    ignore fmt_out_size;
    assert(cast(u64, cast(i64, fmt_end - fmt_in) + 1) < fmt_out_size);
    bool has_type = false;
    while fmt_in < fmt_end {
        u8 c = *fmt_in++;
        if !has_type && (c >= 48 && c <= 57 || c == 46 || c == 43 || c == 35) {
            continue;
        }
        has_type |= c >= 97 && c <= 122 || c >= 65 && c <= 90;
        if c != 39 && c != 36 && c != 95 {
            *fmt_out++ = c;
        }
    }
    *fmt_out = 0;
    return fmt_out_begin;
}

private {
u8* ImAtoi_int(u8* src, i32* output) {
    i32 negative = 0;
    if *src == 45 {
        negative = 1;
        src++;
    }
    if *src == 43 {
        src++;
    }
    i32 v = 0;
    while *src >= 48 && *src <= 57 {
        v = cast(i32, cast(u32, v * 10) + (*src++ - 48));
    }
    *output = negative != 0 ? -v : v;
    return src;
}
}

// Parse display precision back from the display format string
// FIXME: This is still used by some navigation code path to infer a minimum tweak step, but we should aim to rework widgets so it isn't needed.
i32 ImParseFormatPrecision(u8* fmt, i32 default_precision) {
    fmt = ImParseFormatFindStart(fmt);
    if fmt[0] != 37 {
        return default_precision;
    }
    fmt++;
    while *fmt >= 48 && *fmt <= 57 {
        fmt++;
    }
    i32 precision = INT_MAX;
    if *fmt == 46 {
        fmt = ImAtoi_int(fmt + 1, &precision);
        if precision < 0 || precision > 99 {
            precision = default_precision;
        }
    }
    if *fmt == 101 || *fmt == 69 {
        precision = -1;
    }
    if (*fmt == 103 || *fmt == 71) && precision == INT_MAX {
        precision = -1;
    }
    return precision == INT_MAX ? default_precision : precision;
}

// Create text input in place of another active widget (e.g. used when doing a Ctrl+Click on drag/slider widgets)
// - This must be submitted right after the item it is overlaying.
// FIXME: Facilitate using this in variety of other situations.
bool ImGui_TempInputText(ImRect bb, ImGuiID id, u8* label, u8* buf, u64 buf_size, ImGuiInputTextFlags flags, ImGuiInputTextCallback callback, void* user_data) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    bool is_deactivated = g.InputTextDeactivatedState.ID == id;
    bool is_active = g.TempInputId == id;
    if !is_active && !is_deactivated {
        ImGui_ClearActiveID();
    }
    ImVec2 backup_pos = window.DC.CursorPos;
    window.DC.CursorPos = bb.Min;
    g.LastItemData.ItemFlags |= ImGuiItemFlags_AllowDuplicateId;
    bool value_changed = ImGui_InputTextEx(label, null, buf, cast(i32, buf_size), ImRect_GetSize(&bb), flags | ImGuiInputTextFlags_TempInput | ImGuiInputTextFlags_AutoSelectAll, callback, user_data);
    ImGui_KeepAliveID(id);
    if !is_active && !is_deactivated {
        assert(g.ActiveId == id);
        g.TempInputId = g.ActiveId;
    }
    if is_active && g.ActiveId != id {
        g.TempInputId = 0;
    }
    window.DC.CursorPos = backup_pos;
    return value_changed;
}

// Note that Drag/Slider functions are only forwarding the min/max values clamping values if the ImGuiSliderFlags_AlwaysClamp flag is set!
// This is intended: this way we allow Ctrl+Click manual input to set a value out of bounds, for maximum flexibility.
// However this may not be ideal for all uses, as some user code may break on out of bound values.
bool ImGui_TempInputScalar(ImRect bb, ImGuiID id, u8* label, ImGuiDataType data_type, void* p_data, u8* format_var, void* p_clamp_min, void* p_clamp_max) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiDataTypeInfo* type_info = ImGui_DataTypeGetInfo(data_type);
    u8[32] fmt_buf;
    u8[32] data_buf;
    format_var = ImParseFormatTrimDecorations(format_var, fmt_buf, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(fmt_buf) / sizeof(*fmt_buf))));
    if format_var[0] == 0 {
        format_var = type_info.PrintFmt;
    }
    ImGui_DataTypeFormatString(data_buf, cast(i32, sizeof(data_buf) / sizeof(*data_buf)), data_type, p_data, format_var);
    ImStrTrimBlanks(data_buf);
    ImGuiInputTextFlags flags = ImGuiInputTextFlags_AutoSelectAll | cast(ImGuiInputTextFlags, ImGuiInputTextFlags_LocalizeDecimalPoint);
    g.LastItemData.ItemFlags |= ImGuiItemFlags_NoMarkEdited;
    g.LastItemData.ItemFlags = (g.LastItemData.ItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_LiveEditOnInputScalar) != 0 ? g.LastItemData.ItemFlags | ImGuiItemFlags_LiveEditOnInputText : g.LastItemData.ItemFlags & ~ImGuiItemFlags_LiveEditOnInputText;
    if ImGui_TempInputText(bb, id, label, data_buf, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(data_buf) / sizeof(*data_buf))), flags) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    u64 data_type_size = type_info.Size;
    ImGuiDataTypeStorage data_backup;
    memcpy(&data_backup, p_data, data_type_size);
    ImGui_DataTypeApplyFromText(data_buf, data_type, p_data, format_var, null);
    if p_clamp_min || p_clamp_max {
        if p_clamp_min && p_clamp_max && ImGui_DataTypeCompare(data_type, p_clamp_min, p_clamp_max) > 0 {
            { void* tmp_clamp_swap = p_clamp_min; p_clamp_min = p_clamp_max; p_clamp_max = tmp_clamp_swap; }
        }
        ImGui_DataTypeClamp(data_type, p_data, p_clamp_min, p_clamp_max);
    }
    g.LastItemData.ItemFlags &= ~ImGuiItemFlags_NoMarkEdited;
    bool value_changed = memcmp(&data_backup, p_data, data_type_size) != 0;
    if value_changed != 0 {
        ImGui_MarkItemEdited(id);
    }
    return value_changed;
}

// Note: p_data, p_step, p_step_fast are _pointers_ to a memory address holding the data. For an Input widget, p_step and p_step_fast are optional.
// Read code of e.g. InputFloat(), InputInt() etc. or examples in 'Demo->Widgets->Data Types' to understand how to use this function directly.
bool ImGui_InputScalar(u8* label, ImGuiDataType data_type, void* p_data, void* p_step, void* p_step_fast, u8* format_var, ImGuiInputTextFlags flags) {
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiStyle* style = &g.Style;
    if format_var == null {
        format_var = ImGui_DataTypeGetInfo(data_type).PrintFmt;
    }
    void* p_data_default = (g.NextItemData.HasFlags & ImGuiNextItemDataFlags_HasRefVal) != 0 ? &g.NextItemData.RefVal : &g.DataTypeZeroValue;
    u8[64] buf;
    if flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_DisplayEmptyRefVal && ImGui_DataTypeCompare(data_type, p_data, p_data_default) == 0 {
        buf[0] = 0;
    } else {
        ImGui_DataTypeFormatString(buf, cast(i32, sizeof(buf) / sizeof(*buf)), data_type, p_data, format_var);
    }
    g.NextItemData.ItemFlagsSet |= ImGuiItemFlags_NoMarkEdited;
    flags |= ImGuiInputTextFlags_AutoSelectAll | cast(ImGuiInputTextFlags, ImGuiInputTextFlags_LocalizeDecimalPoint);
    bool has_step_buttons = p_step != null;
    f32 button_size = has_step_buttons != 0 ? ImGui_GetFrameHeight() : 0.0f;
    bool ret;
    if has_step_buttons != 0 {
        ImGui_BeginGroup();
        ImGui_PushID(label);
        ImGui_SetNextItemWidth(ImMax(1.0f, ImGui_CalcItemWidth() - (button_size + style.ItemInnerSpacing.x) * 2.0f));
        ret = ImGui_InputText("", buf, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(buf) / sizeof(*buf))), flags);
        ignore *g;
    } else {
        ret = ImGui_InputText(label, buf, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(buf) / sizeof(*buf))), flags);
    }
    bool value_changed = false;
    if (g.LastItemData.ItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_LiveEditOnInputScalar) != 0 {
        bool input_edited = (g.LastItemData.StatusFlags & ImGuiItemStatusFlags_EditedInternal) != 0;
        if input_edited != 0 {
            value_changed = ImGui_DataTypeApplyFromText(buf, data_type, p_data, format_var, (flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_ParseEmptyRefVal) != 0 ? p_data_default : null);
        }
    } else {
        if g.DeactivatedItemData.ID == g.LastItemData.ID {
            value_changed = ImGui_DataTypeApplyFromText(buf, data_type, p_data, format_var, (flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_ParseEmptyRefVal) != 0 ? p_data_default : null);
        }
    }
    if has_step_buttons != 0 {
        ImVec2 backup_frame_padding = style.FramePadding;
        style.FramePadding.x = style.FramePadding.y;
        if (flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_ReadOnly) != 0 {
            ImGui_BeginDisabled(true);
        }
        ImGui_PushItemFlag(ImGuiItemFlags_ButtonRepeat, true);
        ImGui_SameLine(0.0f, style.ItemInnerSpacing.x);
        if ImGui_ButtonEx("-", ImVec2{button_size, button_size}) != 0 {
            ImGui_DataTypeApplyOp(data_type, 45, p_data, p_data, g.IO.KeyCtrl && p_step_fast ? p_step_fast : p_step);
            ret = true;
            value_changed = ret;
        }
        ImGui_SameLine(0.0f, style.ItemInnerSpacing.x);
        if ImGui_ButtonEx("+", ImVec2{button_size, button_size}) != 0 {
            ImGui_DataTypeApplyOp(data_type, 43, p_data, p_data, g.IO.KeyCtrl && p_step_fast ? p_step_fast : p_step);
            ret = true;
            value_changed = ret;
        }
        ImGui_PopItemFlag();
        if (flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_ReadOnly) != 0 {
            ImGui_EndDisabled();
        }
        u8* label_end = ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(label, null);
        if label != label_end {
            ImGui_SameLine(0.0f, style.ItemInnerSpacing.x);
            ImGui_TextEx(label, label_end);
        }
        style.FramePadding = backup_frame_padding;
        ImGui_PopID();
        ImGui_EndGroup();
    }
    g.LastItemData.ItemFlags &= ~ImGuiItemFlags_NoMarkEdited;
    if value_changed != 0 {
        ImGui_MarkItemEdited(g.LastItemData.ID);
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_EnterReturnsTrue) != 0 {
        return ret;
    }
    return value_changed;
}

bool ImGui_InputScalarN(u8* label, ImGuiDataType data_type, void* p_data, i32 components, void* p_step, void* p_step_fast, u8* format_var, ImGuiInputTextFlags flags) {
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    bool value_changed = false;
    ImGui_BeginGroup();
    ImGui_PushID(label);
    ImGui_PushMultiItemsWidths(components, ImGui_CalcItemWidth());
    u64 type_size = GDataTypeInfo[data_type].Size;
    for i32 i = 0; i < components; i++ {
        ImGui_PushID(i);
        if i > 0 {
            ImGui_SameLine(0.0f, g.Style.ItemInnerSpacing.x);
        }
        value_changed |= ImGui_InputScalar("", data_type, p_data, p_step, p_step_fast, format_var, flags);
        ImGui_PopID();
        ImGui_PopItemWidth();
        p_data = cast(void*, cast(u8*, p_data) + type_size);
    }
    ImGui_PopID();
    u8* label_end = ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(label, null);
    if label != label_end {
        ImGui_SameLine(0.0f, g.Style.ItemInnerSpacing.x);
        ImGui_TextEx(label, label_end);
    }
    ImGui_EndGroup();
    return value_changed;
}

bool ImStb_ImCharIsSeparatorW(u32 c) {
    {
        u32* zz_rf_it_2 = &ImStb_ImCharIsSeparatorW__separator_list[0];
        u32* zz_rf_end_2 = &ImStb_ImCharIsSeparatorW__separator_list[0] + sizeof(ImStb_ImCharIsSeparatorW__separator_list) / sizeof(*ImStb_ImCharIsSeparatorW__separator_list);
        for ; zz_rf_it_2 != zz_rf_end_2; zz_rf_it_2++ {

i32 ImStb_is_word_boundary_from_right(ImGuiInputTextState* obj, i32 idx) {
    if obj.Flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_Password || idx <= 0 {
        return 0;
    }
    u8* curr_p = obj.TextSrc + idx;
    u8* prev_p = ImTextFindPreviousUtf8Codepoint(obj.TextSrc, curr_p);
    u32 curr_c;
    ImTextCharFromUtf8(&curr_c, curr_p, obj.TextSrc + obj.TextLen);
    u32 prev_c;
    ImTextCharFromUtf8(&prev_c, prev_p, obj.TextSrc + obj.TextLen);
    bool prev_white = ImCharIsBlankW(prev_c);
    bool prev_separ = ImStb_ImCharIsSeparatorW(prev_c);
    bool curr_white = ImCharIsBlankW(curr_c);
    bool curr_separ = ImStb_ImCharIsSeparatorW(curr_c);
    return (prev_white || prev_separ) && !(curr_separ || curr_white) || curr_separ && !prev_separ;
}

// Reimplementation of imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_move_line_start()/imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_move_line_end() which supports word-wrapping.
i32 imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_MOVELINESTART_IMPL(ImGuiInputTextState* obj, ImStb_STB_TexteditState* state, i32 cursor) {
    if state.single_line != 0 {
        return 0;
    }
    if obj.WrapWidth > 0.0f {
        ImGuiContext* g = obj.Ctx;
        u8* p_cursor = obj.TextSrc + cursor;
        u8* p_bol = ImStrbol(p_cursor, obj.TextSrc);
        u8* p = p_bol;
        u8* text_end = obj.TextSrc + obj.TextLen;
        while p >= p_bol {
            u8* p_eol = ImFontCalcWordWrapPositionEx(g.Font, g.FontSize, p, text_end, obj.WrapWidth, ImDrawTextFlags_WrapKeepBlanks);
            if p == p_cursor {
                return cast(i32, cast(i64, p_bol - obj.TextSrc));
            }
            if p_eol == p_cursor && obj.TextA.Data[cursor] != 10 && obj.LastMoveDirectionLR == ImGuiDir_Left {
                return cast(i32, cast(i64, p_bol - obj.TextSrc));
            }
            if p_eol >= p_cursor {
                return cast(i32, cast(i64, p - obj.TextSrc));
            }
            p = *p_eol == 10 ? p_eol + 1 : p_eol;
        }
    }
    while cursor > 0 {
        i32 prev_cursor = ImStb_IMSTB_TEXTEDIT_GETPREVCHARINDEX_IMPL(obj, cursor);
        if imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_GETCHAR(obj, prev_cursor) == STB_TEXTEDIT_NEWLINE {
            break;
        }
        cursor = prev_cursor;
    }
    return cursor;
}

i32 imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_MOVELINEEND_IMPL(ImGuiInputTextState* obj, ImStb_STB_TexteditState* state, i32 cursor) {
    i32 n = imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_STRINGLEN(obj);
    if state.single_line != 0 {
        return n;
    }
    if obj.WrapWidth > 0.0f {
        ImGuiContext* g = obj.Ctx;
        u8* p_cursor = obj.TextSrc + cursor;
        u8* p = ImStrbol(p_cursor, obj.TextSrc);
        u8* text_end = obj.TextSrc + obj.TextLen;
        while p < text_end {
            u8* p_eol = ImFontCalcWordWrapPositionEx(g.Font, g.FontSize, p, text_end, obj.WrapWidth, ImDrawTextFlags_WrapKeepBlanks);
            cursor = cast(i32, cast(i64, p_eol - obj.TextSrc));
            if p_eol == p_cursor && obj.LastMoveDirectionLR != ImGuiDir_Left {
                break;
            }
            if p_eol > p_cursor {
                return cursor;
            }
            p = *p_eol == 10 ? p_eol + 1 : p_eol;
        }
    }
    while cursor < n && imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_GETCHAR(obj, cursor) != STB_TEXTEDIT_NEWLINE {

void imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_DELETECHARS(ImGuiInputTextState* obj, i32 pos, i32 n) {
    assert(obj.TextSrc == obj.TextA.Data);
    u8* dst = obj.TextA.Data + pos;
    u8* src = obj.TextA.Data + pos + n;
    memmove(dst, src, cast(u64, obj.TextLen - n - pos + 1));

    obj.EditedBefore = obj.EditedThisFrame;
    obj.TextLen -= n;
}

i32 imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_INSERTCHARS(ImGuiInputTextState* obj, i32 pos, u8* new_text, i32 new_text_len) {
    bool is_resizable = (obj.Flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_CallbackResize) != 0;
    i32 text_len = obj.TextLen;
    assert(pos <= text_len);
    i32 avail = obj.BufCapacity - 1 - obj.TextLen;
    if !is_resizable && new_text_len > avail {
        new_text_len = cast(i32, cast(i64, ImTextFindValidUtf8CodepointEnd(new_text, new_text + new_text_len, new_text + avail) - new_text));
    }
    if new_text_len == 0 {
        return 0;
    }
    assert(obj.TextSrc == obj.TextA.Data);
    if text_len + new_text_len + 1 > obj.TextA.Size && is_resizable {
        ImVector_char_resize(&obj.TextA, text_len + ImClamp(new_text_len, 32, ImMax(256, new_text_len)) + 1);
        obj.TextSrc = obj.TextA.Data;
    }
    u8* text = obj.TextA.Data;
    if pos != text_len {
        memmove(text + pos + new_text_len, text + pos, cast(u64, text_len - pos));
    }
    memcpy(text + pos, new_text, cast(u64, new_text_len));
    obj.EditedThisFrame = true;
    obj.EditedBefore = obj.EditedThisFrame;
    obj.TextLen += new_text_len;
    obj.TextA.Data[obj.TextLen] = 0;
    return new_text_len;
}

// traverse the layout to locate the nearest character to a display position
i32 imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_text_locate_coord(ImGuiInputTextState* str_var, f32 x, f32 y, i32* out_side_on_line) {
    StbTexteditRow r;
    i32 n = imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_STRINGLEN(str_var);
    f32 base_y = 0.0f;
    f32 prev_x;
    i32 i = 0;
    i32 k;
    r.x1 = 0.0f;
    r.x0 = r.x1;
    r.ymax = 0.0f;
    r.ymin = r.ymax;
    r.num_chars = 0;
    *out_side_on_line = 0;
    while i < n {
        imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_LAYOUTROW(&r, str_var, i);
        if r.num_chars <= 0 {
            return n;
        }
        if i == 0 && y < base_y + r.ymin {
            return 0;
        }
        if y < base_y + r.ymax {
            break;
        }
        i += r.num_chars;
        base_y += r.baseline_y_delta;
    }
    if i >= n {
        *out_side_on_line = 1;
        return n;
    }
    if x < r.x0 {
        return i;
    }
    if x < r.x1 {
        prev_x = r.x0;
        for k = 0; k < r.num_chars; k = i + k + 1 - i {
            f32 w = imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_GETWIDTH(str_var, i, k);
            if x < prev_x + w {
                *out_side_on_line = k == 0 ? 0 : 1;
                if x < prev_x + w / 2.0f {
                    return k + i;
                } else {
                    return i + k + 1;
                }
            }
            prev_x += w;
        }
    }
    *out_side_on_line = 1;
    if imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_GETCHAR(str_var, i + r.num_chars - 1) == STB_TEXTEDIT_NEWLINE {
        return i + r.num_chars - 1;
    } else {
        return i + r.num_chars;
    }
}

// find the x/y location of a character, and remember info about the previous row in
// case we get a move-up event (for page up, we'll have to rescan)
private {
void imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_find_charpos(StbFindState* find, ImGuiInputTextState* str_var, i32 n, i32 single_line) {
    StbTexteditRow r;
    i32 prev_start = 0;
    i32 z = imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_STRINGLEN(str_var);
    i32 i = 0;
    i32 first;
    if n == z && single_line {
        imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_LAYOUTROW(&r, str_var, 0);
        find.y = 0.0f;
        find.first_char = 0;
        find.length = z;
        find.height = r.ymax - r.ymin;
        find.x = r.x1;
        return;
    }
    find.y = 0.0f;
    while true {
        imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_LAYOUTROW(&r, str_var, i);
        if n < i + r.num_chars {
            break;
        }
        if str_var.LastMoveDirectionLR == ImGuiDir_Right && str_var.Stb.cursor > 0 && str_var.Stb.cursor == i + r.num_chars && imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_GETCHAR(str_var, i + r.num_chars - 1) != STB_TEXTEDIT_NEWLINE {
            break;
        }
        if i + r.num_chars == z && z > 0 && imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_GETCHAR(str_var, z - 1) != STB_TEXTEDIT_NEWLINE {
            break;
        }
        prev_start = i;
        i += r.num_chars;
        find.y += r.baseline_y_delta;
        if i == z {
            r.num_chars = 0;
            break;
        }

    first = i;
    find.first_char = first;
    find.length = r.num_chars;
    find.height = r.ymax - r.ymin;
    find.prev_first = prev_start;
    find.x = r.x0;
    for i = 0; first + i < n; i = first + i + 1 - first {

}

                            str_var.LastMoveDirectionLR = cast(ImS8, ImGuiDir_Right);
                        } else if state.cursor == find.prev_first {
                            str_var.LastMoveDirectionLR = cast(ImS8, ImGuiDir_Left);
                        }
                        state.has_preferred_x = 1;
                        state.preferred_x = goal_x;
                        if sel != 0 {
                            state.select_end = state.cursor;
                        }
                        prev_scan = find.prev_first > 0 ? find.prev_first - 1 : 0;
                        while prev_scan > 0 {
                            i32 prev = prev_scan - 1;
                            if imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_GETCHAR(str_var, prev) == STB_TEXTEDIT_NEWLINE {
                                break;
                            }
                            prev_scan = prev;
                        }
                        find.first_char = find.prev_first;
                        find.prev_first = imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_MOVELINESTART_IMPL(str_var, state, prev_scan);
                    }
                    break case;
                }
            }
            case 0x200008, 0x200008 | 0x400000: {
                if state.select_start != state.select_end {
                    imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_delete_selection(str_var, state);
                } else {
                    i32 n = imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_STRINGLEN(str_var);
                    if state.cursor < n {
                        imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_delete(str_var, state, state.cursor, state.cursor + 1 - state.cursor);
                    }
                }
                state.has_preferred_x = 0;
            }
            case 0x200009, 0x200009 | 0x400000: {
                if state.select_start != state.select_end {
                    imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_delete_selection(str_var, state);
                } else {
                    imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_clamp(str_var, state);
                    if state.cursor > 0 {
                        i32 prev = state.cursor - 1;
                        imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_delete(str_var, state, prev, state.cursor - prev);
                        state.cursor = prev;
                    }
                }
                state.has_preferred_x = 0;
            }
            case 0x200006: {
                state.select_end = 0;
                state.select_start = state.select_end;
                state.cursor = state.select_start;
                state.has_preferred_x = 0;
            }
            case 0x200007: {
                state.cursor = imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_STRINGLEN(str_var);
                state.select_end = 0;
                state.select_start = state.select_end;
                state.has_preferred_x = 0;
            }
            case 0x200006 | 0x400000: {
                imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_prep_selection_at_cursor(state);
                state.select_end = 0;
                state.cursor = state.select_end;
                state.has_preferred_x = 0;
            }
            case 0x200007 | 0x400000: {
                imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_prep_selection_at_cursor(state);
                state.select_end = imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_STRINGLEN(str_var);
                state.cursor = state.select_end;
                state.has_preferred_x = 0;
            }
            case 0x200004: {
                imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_clamp(str_var, state);
                imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_move_to_first(state);
                state.cursor = imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_MOVELINESTART_IMPL(str_var, state, state.cursor);
                state.has_preferred_x = 0;
            }
            case 0x200005: {
                {
                    imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_clamp(str_var, state);
                    imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_move_to_last(str_var, state);
                    state.cursor = imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_MOVELINEEND_IMPL(str_var, state, state.cursor);
                    state.has_preferred_x = 0;
                    break case;
                }
            }
            case 0x200004 | 0x400000: {
                imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_clamp(str_var, state);
                imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_prep_selection_at_cursor(state);
                state.cursor = imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_MOVELINESTART_IMPL(str_var, state, state.cursor);
                state.select_end = state.cursor;
                state.has_preferred_x = 0;
            }
            case 0x200005 | 0x400000: {
                {
                    imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_clamp(str_var, state);
                    imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_prep_selection_at_cursor(state);
                    state.cursor = imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_MOVELINEEND_IMPL(str_var, state, state.cursor);
                    state.select_end = state.cursor;
                    state.has_preferred_x = 0;
                    break case;
                }
            }
        }
        break;
    }
}

/////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
//
//      Undo processing
//
// @OPTIMIZE: the undo/redo buffer should be circular
void imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_flush_redo(StbUndoState* state) {
    state.redo_point = 99;
    state.redo_char_point = 999;
}

// discard the oldest entry in the undo list
void imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_discard_undo(StbUndoState* state) {
    if state.undo_point > 0 {
        if state.undo_rec[0].char_storage >= 0 {
            i32 n = state.undo_rec[0].insert_length;
            i32 i;
            state.undo_char_point -= n;
            memmove(state.undo_char, state.undo_char + n, cast(u64, state.undo_char_point * sizeof(u8)));
            for i = 0; i < state.undo_point; ++i {
                if state.undo_rec[i].char_storage >= 0 {
                    state.undo_rec[i].char_storage -= n;
                }
            }
        }
        --state.undo_point;
        memmove(state.undo_rec, state.undo_rec + 1, cast(u64, state.undo_point * sizeof(state.undo_rec[0])));
    }
}

// discard the oldest entry in the redo list--it's bad if this
// ever happens, but because undo & redo have to store the actual
// characters in different cases, the redo character buffer can
// fill up even though the undo buffer didn't
void imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_discard_redo(StbUndoState* state) {
    i32 k = 99 - 1;
    if state.redo_point <= k {
        if state.undo_rec[k].char_storage >= 0 {
            i32 n = state.undo_rec[k].insert_length;
            i32 i;
            state.redo_char_point += n;
            memmove(state.undo_char + state.redo_char_point, state.undo_char + state.redo_char_point - n, cast(u64, (999 - state.redo_char_point) * sizeof(u8)));
            for i = state.redo_point; i < k; ++i {
                if state.undo_rec[i].char_storage >= 0 {
                    state.undo_rec[i].char_storage += n;
                }
            }
        }
        var move_size = cast(u64, (99 - state.redo_point - 1) * sizeof(state.undo_rec[0]));
        var buf_begin = cast(u8*, &state.undo_rec[0]);
        ignore buf_begin;
        u8* buf_end = cast(u8*, &state.undo_rec[0]) + sizeof(state.undo_rec);
        ignore buf_end;
        assert(cast(u8*, &(state.undo_rec + state.redo_point)[0]) >= buf_begin);
        assert(cast(u8*, &(state.undo_rec + state.redo_point + 1)[0]) + move_size <= buf_end);
        memmove(state.undo_rec + state.redo_point + 1, state.undo_rec + state.redo_point, move_size);
        ++state.redo_point;
    }
}

StbUndoRecord* imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_text_create_undo_record(StbUndoState* state, i32 numchars) {
    imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_flush_redo(state);
    if state.undo_point == 99 {
        imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_discard_undo(state);
    }
    if numchars > 999 {
        state.undo_point = 0;
        state.undo_char_point = 0;
        return null;
    }
    while state.undo_char_point + numchars > 999 {
        imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_discard_undo(state);
    }
    return &state.undo_rec[state.undo_point++];
}

u8* imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_text_createundo(StbUndoState* state, i32 pos, i32 insert_len, i32 delete_len) {
    StbUndoRecord* r = imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_text_create_undo_record(state, insert_len);
    if r == null {
        return null;
    }
    r.where = pos;
    r.insert_length = insert_len;
    r.delete_length = delete_len;
    if insert_len == 0 {
        r.char_storage = -1;
        return null;
    } else {
        r.char_storage = state.undo_char_point;
        state.undo_char_point += insert_len;
        return &state.undo_char[r.char_storage];
    }
}

void imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_text_undo(ImGuiInputTextState* str_var, ImStb_STB_TexteditState* state) {
    StbUndoState* s = &state.undostate;
    StbUndoRecord u;
    StbUndoRecord* r;
    if s.undo_point == 0 {
        return;
    }
    u = s.undo_rec[s.undo_point - 1];
    r = &s.undo_rec[s.redo_point - 1];
    r.char_storage = -1;
    r.insert_length = u.delete_length;
    r.delete_length = u.insert_length;
    r.where = u.where;
    if u.delete_length != 0 {
        if s.undo_char_point + u.delete_length >= 999 {
            r.insert_length = 0;
        } else {
            i32 i;
            while s.undo_char_point + u.delete_length > s.redo_char_point {
                if s.redo_point == 99 {
                    return;
                }
                imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_discard_redo(s);
            }
            r = &s.undo_rec[s.redo_point - 1];
            r.char_storage = s.redo_char_point - u.delete_length;
            s.redo_char_point = s.redo_char_point - u.delete_length;
            for i = 0; i < u.delete_length; ++i {
                s.undo_char[r.char_storage + i] = imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_GETCHAR(str_var, u.where + i);
            }
        }
        imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_DELETECHARS(str_var, u.where, u.delete_length);
    }
    if u.insert_length != 0 {
        u.insert_length = imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_INSERTCHARS(str_var, u.where, &s.undo_char[u.char_storage], u.insert_length);
        s.undo_char_point -= u.insert_length;
    }
    state.cursor = u.where + u.insert_length;
    s.undo_point--;
    s.redo_point--;
}

void imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_text_redo(ImGuiInputTextState* str_var, ImStb_STB_TexteditState* state) {
    StbUndoState* s = &state.undostate;
    StbUndoRecord* u;
    StbUndoRecord r;
    if s.redo_point == 99 {
        return;
    }
    u = &s.undo_rec[s.undo_point];
    r = s.undo_rec[s.redo_point];
    u.delete_length = r.insert_length;
    u.insert_length = r.delete_length;
    u.where = r.where;
    u.char_storage = -1;
    if r.delete_length != 0 {
        if s.undo_char_point + u.insert_length > s.redo_char_point {
            u.insert_length = 0;
            u.delete_length = 0;
        } else {
            i32 i;
            u.char_storage = s.undo_char_point;
            s.undo_char_point = s.undo_char_point + u.insert_length;
            for i = 0; i < u.insert_length; ++i {
                s.undo_char[u.char_storage + i] = imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_GETCHAR(str_var, u.where + i);
            }
        }
        imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_DELETECHARS(str_var, r.where, r.delete_length);
    }
    if r.insert_length != 0 {
        r.insert_length = imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_INSERTCHARS(str_var, r.where, &s.undo_char[r.char_storage], r.insert_length);
        s.redo_char_point += r.insert_length;
    }
    state.cursor = r.where + r.insert_length;
    s.undo_point++;
    s.redo_point++;
}

void imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_text_makeundo_insert(ImStb_STB_TexteditState* state, i32 where, i32 length) {
    imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_text_createundo(&state.undostate, where, 0, length);
}

void imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_text_makeundo_delete(ImGuiInputTextState* str_var, ImStb_STB_TexteditState* state, i32 where, i32 length) {
    i32 i;
    u8* p = imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_text_createundo(&state.undostate, where, length, 0);
    if p != null {
        for i = 0; i < length; ++i {
            p[i] = imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_GETCHAR(str_var, where + i);
        }
    }
}

void imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_text_makeundo_replace(ImGuiInputTextState* str_var, ImStb_STB_TexteditState* state, i32 where, i32 old_length, i32 new_length) {
    i32 i;
    u8* p = imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_text_createundo(&state.undostate, where, old_length, new_length);
    if p != null {
        for i = 0; i < old_length; ++i {
            p[i] = imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_GETCHAR(str_var, where + i);
        }
    }
}

// reset the state to default
void imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_clear_state(ImStb_STB_TexteditState* state, i32 is_single_line) {
    state.undostate.undo_point = 0;

i32 imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_paste(ImGuiInputTextState* str_var, ImStb_STB_TexteditState* state, u8* ctext, i32 len) {
    return imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_paste_internal(str_var, state, ctext, len);
}

// stb_textedit internally allows for a single undo record to do addition and deletion, but somehow, calling
// the imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_textedit_paste() function creates two separate records, so we perform it manually. (FIXME: Report to nothings/stb?)
void ImStb_stb_textedit_replace(ImGuiInputTextState* str_var, ImStb_STB_TexteditState* state, u8* text, i32 text_len) {
    imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_text_makeundo_replace(str_var, state, 0, str_var.TextLen, text_len);
    imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_DELETECHARS(str_var, 0, str_var.TextLen);
    state.select_end = 0;
    state.select_start = state.select_end;
    state.cursor = state.select_start;
    if text_len <= 0 {
        return;
    }
    i32 text_len_inserted = imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_INSERTCHARS(str_var, 0, text, text_len);
    if text_len_inserted > 0 {
        state.select_end = text_len;
        state.select_start = state.select_end;
        state.cursor = state.select_start;
        state.has_preferred_x = 0;
        return;
    }
    assert(0);
}

// Public API to manipulate UTF-8 text from within a callback.
// FIXME: The existence of this rarely exercised code path is a bit of a nuisance.
// Historically they existed because imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_TEXTEDIT_INSERTCHARS() etc. worked on our ImWchar
// buffer, but nowadays they both work on UTF-8 data. Should aim to merge both.
void ImGuiInputTextCallbackData_DeleteChars(ImGuiInputTextCallbackData* self, i32 pos, i32 bytes_count) {
    assert(pos + bytes_count <= self.BufTextLen);
    u8* dst = self.Buf + pos;
    u8* src = self.Buf + pos + bytes_count;
    memmove(dst, src, cast(u64, self.BufTextLen - bytes_count - pos + 1));
    if self.CursorPos >= pos + bytes_count {
        self.CursorPos -= bytes_count;
    } else if self.CursorPos >= pos {
        self.CursorPos = pos;
    }
    self.SelectionEnd = self.CursorPos;
    self.SelectionStart = self.SelectionEnd;
    self.BufDirty = true;
    self.BufTextLen -= bytes_count;
}

void ImGuiInputTextCallbackData_InsertChars(ImGuiInputTextCallbackData* self, i32 pos, u8* new_text, u8* new_text_end) {
    if new_text == new_text_end {
        return;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = self.Ctx;
    ImGuiInputTextState* obj = &g.InputTextState;
    assert(obj.ID != 0 && g.ActiveId == obj.ID);
    bool is_resizable = (self.Flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_CallbackResize) != 0;
    bool is_readonly = (self.Flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_ReadOnly) != 0;
    i32 new_text_len = new_text_end != null ? cast(i32, cast(i64, new_text_end - new_text)) : cast(i32, strlen(new_text));
    i32 avail = self.BufSize - 1 - self.BufTextLen;
    if !is_resizable && new_text_len > avail {
        new_text_len = cast(i32, cast(i64, ImTextFindValidUtf8CodepointEnd(new_text, new_text + new_text_len, new_text + avail) - new_text));
    }
    if new_text_len == 0 {
        return;
    }
    if new_text_len + self.BufTextLen + 1 > obj.TextA.Size && is_resizable && !is_readonly {
        assert(self.Buf == obj.TextA.Data);
        i32 new_buf_size = self.BufTextLen + ImClamp(new_text_len * 4, 32, ImMax(256, new_text_len)) + 1;
        ImVector_char_resize(&obj.TextA, new_buf_size + 1);
        obj.TextSrc = obj.TextA.Data;
        self.Buf = obj.TextA.Data;
        obj.BufCapacity = new_buf_size;
        self.BufSize = obj.BufCapacity;
    }
    if self.BufTextLen != pos {
        memmove(self.Buf + pos + new_text_len, self.Buf + pos, cast(u64, self.BufTextLen - pos));
    }
    memcpy(self.Buf + pos, new_text, cast(u64, new_text_len) * cast(u64, sizeof(u8)));
    self.Buf[self.BufTextLen + new_text_len] = 0;
    self.BufDirty = true;
    self.BufTextLen += new_text_len;
    if self.CursorPos >= pos {
        self.CursorPos += new_text_len;
    }
    self.CursorPos = ImClamp(self.CursorPos, 0, self.BufTextLen);
    self.SelectionEnd = self.CursorPos;
    self.SelectionStart = self.SelectionEnd;
}

// Return false to discard a character.
private {
bool InputTextFilterCharacter(ImGuiContext* ctx, ImGuiInputTextState* state, u32* p_char, ImGuiInputTextCallback callback, void* user_data, bool input_source_is_clipboard) {
    assert(state != null);
    u32 c = *p_char;
    ImGuiInputTextFlags flags = state.Flags;
    bool apply_named_filters = true;
    if c < 0x20 {
        bool pass = false;
        pass |= c == 10 && (flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_Multiline) != 0;
        if c == 10 && input_source_is_clipboard && (flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_Multiline) == 0 {
            *p_char = 32;
            c = *p_char;
            pass = true;
        }
        pass |= c == 10 && (flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_Multiline) != 0;
        pass |= c == 9 && (flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_AllowTabInput) != 0;
        if pass == 0 {
            return false;
        }
        apply_named_filters = false;
    }
    if input_source_is_clipboard == false {
        if c == 127 {
            return false;
        }
        if c >= 0xE000 && c <= 0xF8FF {
            return false;
        }
    }
    if c > 0xFFFF {
        return false;
    }
    if apply_named_filters && flags & (ImGuiInputTextFlags_CharsDecimal | ImGuiInputTextFlags_CharsHexadecimal | ImGuiInputTextFlags_CharsUppercase | ImGuiInputTextFlags_CharsNoBlank | ImGuiInputTextFlags_CharsScientific | cast(ImGuiInputTextFlags, ImGuiInputTextFlags_LocalizeDecimalPoint)) {
        ImGuiContext* g = ctx;
        var c_decimal_point = cast(u32, g.PlatformIO.Platform_LocaleDecimalPoint);
        if (flags & (ImGuiInputTextFlags_CharsDecimal | ImGuiInputTextFlags_CharsScientific | cast(ImGuiInputTextFlags, ImGuiInputTextFlags_LocalizeDecimalPoint))) != 0 {
            if c == 46 || c == 44 {
                c = c_decimal_point;
            }
        }
        if (flags & (ImGuiInputTextFlags_CharsDecimal | ImGuiInputTextFlags_CharsScientific | ImGuiInputTextFlags_CharsHexadecimal)) != 0 {
            if c >= 0xFF01 && c <= 0xFF5E {
                c = c - 0xFF01 + 0x21;
            }
        }
        if (flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_CharsDecimal) != 0 {
            if !(c >= 48 && c <= 57) && c != c_decimal_point && c != 45 && c != 43 && c != 42 && c != 47 {
                return false;
            }
        }
        if (flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_CharsScientific) != 0 {
            if !(c >= 48 && c <= 57) && c != c_decimal_point && c != 45 && c != 43 && c != 42 && c != 47 && c != 101 && c != 69 {
                return false;
            }
        }
        if (flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_CharsHexadecimal) != 0 {
            if !(c >= 48 && c <= 57) && !(c >= 97 && c <= 102) && !(c >= 65 && c <= 70) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        if (flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_CharsUppercase) != 0 {
            if c >= 97 && c <= 122 {
                c += cast(u32, 65 - 97);
            }
        }
        if (flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_CharsNoBlank) != 0 {
            if ImCharIsBlankW(c) != 0 {
                return false;
            }
        }
        *p_char = c;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_CallbackCharFilter) != 0 {
        ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
        ImGuiInputTextCallbackData callback_data;
        callback_data.Ctx = g;
        callback_data.ID = state.ID;
        callback_data.Flags = flags;
        callback_data.EventFlag = ImGuiInputTextFlags_CallbackCharFilter;
        callback_data.EventChar = cast(ImWchar, c);
        callback_data.EventActivated = g.ActiveId == state.ID && g.ActiveIdIsJustActivated;
        callback_data.CursorPos = state.Stb.cursor;
        callback_data.SelectionStart = state.Stb.select_start;
        callback_data.SelectionEnd = state.Stb.select_end;
        callback_data.UserData = user_data;
        if callback(&callback_data) != 0 {
            return false;
        }
        *p_char = callback_data.EventChar;
        if callback_data.EventChar == 0 {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

// Find the shortest single replacement we can make to get from old_buf to new_buf
// Note that this doesn't directly alter state->TextA, state->TextLen. They are expected to be made valid separately.
// FIXME: Ideally we should transition toward (1) making InsertChars()/DeleteChars() update undo-stack (2) discourage (and keep reconcile) or obsolete (and remove reconcile) accessing buffer directly.
void InputTextReconcileUndoState(ImGuiInputTextState* state, u8* old_buf, i32 old_length, u8* new_buf, i32 new_length) {
    i32 shorter_length = ImMin(old_length, new_length);
    i32 first_diff;
    for first_diff = 0; first_diff < shorter_length; first_diff++ {
        if old_buf[first_diff] != new_buf[first_diff] {
            break;
        }
    }
    if first_diff == old_length && first_diff == new_length {
        return;
    }
    i32 old_last_diff = old_length - 1;
    i32 new_last_diff = new_length - 1;
    for ; old_last_diff >= first_diff && new_last_diff >= first_diff; old_last_diff-- {
        if old_buf[old_last_diff] != new_buf[new_last_diff] {
            break;
        }
        new_last_diff--;
    }
    i32 insert_len = new_last_diff - first_diff + 1;
    i32 delete_len = old_last_diff - first_diff + 1;
    if insert_len > 0 || delete_len > 0 {
        u8* p = imstb_textedit__ImStb_stb_text_createundo(&state.Stb.undostate, first_diff, delete_len, insert_len);
        if p != null {
            for i32 i = 0; i < delete_len; i++ {
                p[i] = old_buf[first_diff + i];
            }
        }
    }
}
}

// As InputText() retain textual data and we currently provide a path for user to not retain it (via local variables)
// we need some form of hook to reapply data back to user buffer on deactivation frame. (#4714)
// It would be more desirable that we discourage users from taking advantage of the "user not retaining data" trick,
// but that more likely be attractive when we do have _NoLiveEdit flag available.
void ImGui_InputTextDeactivateHook(ImGuiID id) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiInputTextState* state = &g.InputTextState;
    if id == 0 || state.ID != id || g.ActiveId != id {
        return;
    }
    if state.EditedBefore == 0 {
        return;
    }
    state.EditedBefore = false;
    g.InputTextDeactivatedState.ID = state.ID;
    g.InputTextDeactivatedState.ElapseFrame = g.FrameCount + 1;
    if (state.Flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_ReadOnly) != 0 {
        ImVector_char_resize(&g.InputTextDeactivatedState.TextA, 0);
    } else {
        assert(state.TextA.Data != null);
        assert(state.TextA.Data[state.TextLen] == 0);
        ImVector_char_resize(&g.InputTextDeactivatedState.TextA, state.TextLen + 1);
        memcpy(g.InputTextDeactivatedState.TextA.Data, state.TextA.Data, cast(u64, state.TextLen + 1));
    }
}

private {
i32* ImLowerBound(i32* in_begin, i32* in_end, i32 v) {
    i32* in_p = in_begin;
    var count = cast(u64, cast(i64, in_end - in_p));
    while count > 0 {
        u64 count2 = count >> 1;
        i32* mid = in_p + count2;
        if *mid < v {
            in_p = ++mid;
            count -= count2 + 1;
        } else {
            count = count2;
        }
    }
    return in_p;
}

// FIXME-WORDWRAP: Bundle some of this into ImGuiTextIndex and/or extract as a different tool?
// 'max_output_buffer_size' happens to be a meaningful optimization to avoid writing the full line_index when not necessarily needed (e.g. very large buffer, scrolled up, inactive)
i32 InputTextLineIndexBuild(ImGuiInputTextFlags flags, ImGuiTextIndex* line_index, u8* buf, u8* buf_end, f32 wrap_width, i32 max_output_buffer_size, u8** out_buf_end) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    i32 size = 0;
    u8* s;
    bool trailing_line_already_counted = false;
    if (flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_WordWrap) != 0 {
        for s = buf; s < buf_end; s = *s == 10 ? s + 1 : s {
            if size++ <= max_output_buffer_size {
                ImVector_int_push_back(&line_index.Offsets, cast(i32, cast(i64, s - buf)));
            }
            s = ImFontCalcWordWrapPositionEx(g.Font, g.FontSize, s, buf_end, wrap_width, ImDrawTextFlags_WrapKeepBlanks);
        }
    } else if buf_end != null {
        for s = buf; s < buf_end; s = s != null ? s + 1 : buf_end {
            if size++ <= max_output_buffer_size {
                ImVector_int_push_back(&line_index.Offsets, cast(i32, cast(i64, s - buf)));
            }
            s = cast(u8*, memchr(s, 10, cast(i64, buf_end - s)));
        }
    } else {
        u8* s_eol;
        for s = buf; true; s = s_eol + 1 {
            if size++ <= max_output_buffer_size {
                ImVector_int_push_back(&line_index.Offsets, cast(i32, cast(i64, s - buf)));
            }
            s_eol = strchr(s, 10);
            if s_eol != null {
                continue;
            }
            s += strlen(s);
            trailing_line_already_counted = true;
            break;
        }
    }
    if out_buf_end != null {
        buf_end = s;
        *out_buf_end = buf_end;
    }
    if size == 0 {
        ImVector_int_push_back(&line_index.Offsets, 0);
        size++;
    }
    if buf_end > buf && buf_end[-1] == 10 && !trailing_line_already_counted && size++ <= max_output_buffer_size {
        ImVector_int_push_back(&line_index.Offsets, cast(i32, cast(i64, buf_end - buf)));
    }
    return size;
}

ImVec2 InputTextLineIndexGetPosOffset(ImGuiContext* g, ImGuiInputTextState* state, ImGuiTextIndex* line_index, u8* buf, u8* buf_end, i32 cursor_n) {
    u8* cursor_ptr = buf + cursor_n;
    i32* it_begin = ImVector_int_begin(&line_index.Offsets);
    i32* it_end = ImVector_int_end(&line_index.Offsets);
    i32* it = ImLowerBound(it_begin, it_end, cursor_n);
    if it > it_begin {
        if it == it_end || *it != cursor_n || state != null && state.WrapWidth > 0.0f && state.LastMoveDirectionLR == ImGuiDir_Right && cursor_ptr[-1] != 10 && cursor_ptr[-1] != 0 {
            it--;
        }
    }
    i32 line_no = it == it_begin ? 0 : ImVector_int_index_from_ptr(&line_index.Offsets, it);
    u8* line_start = ImGuiTextIndex_get_line_begin(line_index, buf, line_no);
    ImVec2 offset;
    offset.x = InputTextCalcTextSize(g, line_start, cursor_ptr, buf_end, null, null, ImDrawTextFlags_WrapKeepBlanks).x;
    offset.y = cast(f32, line_no + 1) * g.FontSize;
    return offset;
}
