        bool will_scroll_y = state && (state.CursorFollow && render_cursor || state.CursorCenterY && (render_cursor || render_selection));
        line_count = InputTextLineIndexBuild(flags, line_index, buf_display, buf_display_end, wrap_width, will_scroll_y != 0 ? INT_MAX : line_visible_n1 + 1, buf_display_end != null ? null : &buf_display_end);
    }
    line_index.EndOffset = cast(i32, cast(i64, buf_display_end - buf_display));
    line_visible_n1 = ImMin(line_visible_n1, line_count);
    f32 text_size_y = cast(f32, line_count) * g.FontSize;
    ImVec2 cursor_offset = render_cursor && state ? InputTextLineIndexGetPosOffset(g, state, line_index, buf_display, buf_display_end, state.Stb.cursor) : ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f};
    ImVec2 draw_scroll;
    ImU32 text_col = ImGui_GetColorU32(is_displaying_hint != 0 ? ImGuiCol_TextDisabled : ImGuiCol_Text);
    if render_cursor || render_selection {
        assert(state != null);
        state.LineCount = line_count;
        f32 new_scroll_y = scroll_y;
        if render_cursor && state.CursorFollow {
            if (flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_NoHorizontalScroll) == 0 {
                f32 scroll_increment_x = inner_size.x * 0.25f;
                f32 visible_width = inner_size.x - style.FramePadding.x;
                if cursor_offset.x < state.Scroll.x {
                    state.Scroll.x = cast(f32, cast(i32, ImMax(0.0f, cursor_offset.x - scroll_increment_x)));
                } else if cursor_offset.x - visible_width >= state.Scroll.x {
                    state.Scroll.x = cast(f32, cast(i32, cursor_offset.x - visible_width + scroll_increment_x));
                }
            } else {
                state.Scroll.x = 0.0f;
            }
            if is_multiline != 0 {
                if cursor_offset.y - g.FontSize < scroll_y {
                    new_scroll_y = ImMax(0.0f, cursor_offset.y - g.FontSize);
                } else if cursor_offset.y - (inner_size.y - style.FramePadding.y * 2.0f) >= scroll_y {
                    new_scroll_y = cursor_offset.y - inner_size.y + style.FramePadding.y * 2.0f;
                }
            }
            state.CursorFollow = false;
        }
        if state.CursorCenterY != 0 {
            if is_multiline != 0 {
                new_scroll_y = cursor_offset.y - g.FontSize - (inner_size.y * 0.5f - style.FramePadding.y);
            }
            state.CursorCenterY = false;
            render_cursor = false;
        }
        if new_scroll_y != scroll_y {
            f32 scroll_max_y = ImMax(text_size_y + style.FramePadding.y * 2.0f - inner_size.y, 0.0f);
            scroll_y = ImClamp(new_scroll_y, 0.0f, scroll_max_y);
            draw_pos.y += draw_window.Scroll.y - scroll_y;
            draw_window.Scroll.y = scroll_y;
            ImGui_CalcClipRectVisibleItemsY(clip_rect, draw_pos, g.FontSize, &line_visible_n0, &line_visible_n1);
            line_visible_n1 = ImMin(line_visible_n1, line_count);
        }
        draw_scroll.x = state.Scroll.x;
        if render_selection != 0 {
            ImU32 bg_color = ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_TextSelectedBg, render_cursor != 0 ? 1.0f : 0.6f);
            f32 bg_offy_up = is_multiline != 0 ? 0.0f : -1.0f;
            f32 bg_offy_dn = is_multiline != 0 ? 0.0f : 2.0f;
            var bg_eol_width = cast(f32, cast(i32, ImFontBaked_GetCharAdvance(g.FontBaked, cast(ImWchar, 32)) * 0.5f));
            u8* text_selected_begin = buf_display + ImMin(state.Stb.select_start, state.Stb.select_end);
            u8* text_selected_end = buf_display + ImMax(state.Stb.select_start, state.Stb.select_end);
            for i32 line_n = line_visible_n0; line_n < line_visible_n1; line_n++ {
                u8* p = ImGuiTextIndex_get_line_begin(line_index, buf_display, line_n);
                u8* p_eol = ImGuiTextIndex_get_line_end(line_index, buf_display, line_n);
                bool p_eol_is_wrap = p_eol < buf_display_end && *p_eol != 10;
                if p_eol_is_wrap != 0 {
                    p_eol++;
                }
                u8* line_selected_begin = text_selected_begin > p ? text_selected_begin : p;
                u8* line_selected_end = text_selected_end < p_eol ? text_selected_end : p_eol;
                f32 rect_width = 0.0f;
                if line_selected_begin < line_selected_end {
                    rect_width += ImGui_CalcTextSize(line_selected_begin, line_selected_end, false, -1.0f).x;
                }
                if text_selected_begin <= p_eol && text_selected_end > p_eol && !p_eol_is_wrap {
                    rect_width += bg_eol_width;
                }
                if rect_width == 0.0f {
                    continue;
                }
                ImRect rect;
                rect.Min.x = draw_pos.x - draw_scroll.x + ImGui_CalcTextSize(p, line_selected_begin, false, -1.0f).x;
                rect.Min.y = draw_pos.y - draw_scroll.y + cast(f32, line_n) * g.FontSize;
                rect.Max.x = rect.Min.x + rect_width;
                rect.Max.y = rect.Min.y + bg_offy_dn + g.FontSize;
                rect.Min.y += bg_offy_up;
                ImRect_ClipWith(&rect, clip_rect);
                ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(draw_window.DrawList, rect.Min, rect.Max, bg_color, 0.0f, 0);
            }
        }
    }
    if g.ActiveId != id && flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_ElideLeft && !render_cursor && !render_selection {
        draw_pos.x = ImMin(draw_pos.x, frame_bb.Max.x - ImGui_CalcTextSize(buf_display, null, false, -1.0f).x - style.FramePadding.x);
    }
    if (is_multiline || cast(i64, buf_display_end - buf_display) < buf_display_max_length) && text_col & 0xFF000000 && line_visible_n0 < line_visible_n1 {
        ImFont_RenderText(g.Font, draw_window.DrawList, g.FontSize, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(draw_pos, draw_scroll), ImVec2{0.0f, cast(f32, line_visible_n0) * g.FontSize}), text_col, *ImRect_AsVec4(&clip_rect), ImGuiTextIndex_get_line_begin(line_index, buf_display, line_visible_n0), ImGuiTextIndex_get_line_end(line_index, buf_display, line_visible_n1 - 1), wrap_width, ImDrawTextFlags_WrapKeepBlanks | ImDrawTextFlags_CpuFineClip);
    }
    if render_cursor != 0 {
        state.CursorAnim += io.DeltaTime;
        bool cursor_is_visible = !g.IO.ConfigInputTextCursorBlink || state.CursorAnim <= 0.0f || fmod(state.CursorAnim, 1.2f) <= 0.8f;
        ImVec2 cursor_screen_pos = ImTrunc(op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(draw_pos, cursor_offset), draw_scroll));
        ImRect cursor_screen_rect;
        ImRect_init(&cursor_screen_rect, cursor_screen_pos.x, cursor_screen_pos.y - g.FontSize + 0.5f, cursor_screen_pos.x + 1.0f, cursor_screen_pos.y - 1.5f);
        if cursor_is_visible && ImRect_Overlaps(&cursor_screen_rect, clip_rect) {
            ImDrawList_AddLineV(draw_window.DrawList, cursor_screen_rect.Min.x, cursor_screen_rect.Min.y, cursor_screen_rect.Max.y, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_InputTextCursor), style.InputTextCursorSize);
        }
        if !is_readonly && g.ActiveId == id {
            ImGuiPlatformImeData* ime_data = &g.PlatformImeData;
            ime_data.WantVisible = true;
            ime_data.WantTextInput = true;
            ime_data.InputPos = ImVec2{cursor_screen_pos.x - 1.0f, cursor_screen_pos.y - g.FontSize};
            ime_data.InputLineHeight = g.FontSize;
            ime_data.ViewportId = window.Viewport.ID;
        }
    }
    if is_password && !is_displaying_hint {
        ImGui_PopPasswordFont();
    }
    if is_multiline != 0 {
        ImGui_Dummy(ImVec2{0.0f, text_size_y + style.FramePadding.y});
        g.NextItemData.ItemFlagsSet |= cast(ImGuiItemFlags, ImGuiItemFlags_Inputable) | ImGuiItemFlags_NoTabStop;
        ImGui_EndChild();
        item_data_backup.StatusFlags |= g.LastItemData.StatusFlags & ImGuiItemStatusFlags_HoveredWindow;
        ImGui_EndGroup();
        if g.LastItemData.ID == 0 || g.LastItemData.ID != ImGui_GetWindowScrollbarID(draw_window, ImGuiAxis_Y) {
            g.LastItemData.ID = id;
            g.LastItemData.ItemFlags = item_data_backup.ItemFlags;
            g.LastItemData.StatusFlags = item_data_backup.StatusFlags;
        }
    }
    if state && is_readonly {
        state.TextSrc = null;
    }
    if g.LogEnabled && (!is_password || is_displaying_hint) {
        ImGui_LogSetNextTextDecoration("{", "}");
        ImGui_LogRenderedText(&draw_pos, buf_display, buf_display_end);
    }
    if label_size.x > 0.0f {
        ImGui_RenderText(ImVec2{
            frame_bb.Max.x + style.ItemInnerSpacing.x, frame_bb.Min.y + style.FramePadding.y,
        }, label, label_end, false);
    }
    if value_changed != 0 {
        ImGui_MarkItemEdited(id);
    }
    ignore *g;
    if (flags & ImGuiInputTextFlags_EnterReturnsTrue) != 0 {
        return validated;
    } else {
        return value_changed;
    }
}

//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
// [SECTION] Widgets: ColorEdit, ColorPicker, ColorButton, etc.
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
// - ColorEdit3()
// - ColorEdit4()
// - ColorPicker3()
// - RenderColorRectWithAlphaCheckerboard() [Internal]
// - ColorPicker4()
// - ColorButton()
// - ColorTooltip() [Internal]
// - ColorEditOptionsPopup() [Internal]
// - ColorPickerOptionsPopup() [Internal]
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
bool ImGui_ColorEdit3(u8* label, f32* col, ImGuiColorEditFlags flags) {
    return ImGui_ColorEdit4(label, col, flags | ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoAlpha);
}

private {
void ColorEditRestoreH(f32* col, f32* H) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(g.ColorEditCurrentID != 0);
    if g.ColorEditSavedID != g.ColorEditCurrentID || g.ColorEditSavedColor != ImGui_ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(ImVec4{col[0], col[1], col[2], 0.0f}) {
        return;
    }
    *H = g.ColorEditSavedHue;
}

// ColorEdit supports RGB and HSV inputs. In case of RGB input resulting color may have undefined hue and/or saturation.
// Since widget displays both RGB and HSV values we must preserve hue and saturation to prevent these values resetting.
void ColorEditRestoreHS(f32* col, f32* H, f32* S, f32* V) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(g.ColorEditCurrentID != 0);
    if g.ColorEditSavedID != g.ColorEditCurrentID || g.ColorEditSavedColor != ImGui_ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(ImVec4{col[0], col[1], col[2], 0.0f}) {
        return;
    }
    if *S == 0.0f || *H == 0.0f && g.ColorEditSavedHue == 1.0f {
        *H = g.ColorEditSavedHue;
    }
    if *V == 0.0f {
        *S = g.ColorEditSavedSat;
    }
}
}

// Edit colors components (each component in 0.0f..1.0f range).
// See enum ImGuiColorEditFlags_ for available options. e.g. Only access 3 floats if ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoAlpha flag is set.
// With typical options: Left-click on color square to open color picker. Right-click to open option menu. Ctrl+Click over input fields to edit them and TAB to go to next item.
bool ImGui_ColorEdit4(u8* label, f32* col, ImGuiColorEditFlags flags) {
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiStyle style = g.Style;
    f32 square_sz = ImGui_GetFrameHeight();
    u8* label_display_end = ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(label, null);
    f32 w_full = ImGui_CalcItemWidth();
    ImGuiNextItemData_ClearFlags(&g.NextItemData);
    ImGui_BeginGroup();
    ImGui_PushID(label);
    bool set_current_color_edit_id = g.ColorEditCurrentID == 0;
    if set_current_color_edit_id != 0 {
        g.ColorEditCurrentID = *ImVector_ImGuiID_back(&window.IDStack);
    }
    ImGuiColorEditFlags flags_untouched = flags;
    if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoInputs) != 0 {
        flags = flags & ~ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayMask_ | ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayRGB | ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoOptions;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoOptions) == 0 {
        ImGui_ColorEditOptionsPopup(col, flags);
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayMask_) == 0 {
        flags |= g.IO.ConfigColorEditFlags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayMask_;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_DataTypeMask_) == 0 {
        flags |= g.IO.ConfigColorEditFlags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_DataTypeMask_;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_PickerMask_) == 0 {
        flags |= g.IO.ConfigColorEditFlags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_PickerMask_;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputMask_) == 0 {
        flags |= g.IO.ConfigColorEditFlags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputMask_;
    }
    flags |= g.IO.ConfigColorEditFlags & ~(ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayMask_ | ImGuiColorEditFlags_DataTypeMask_ | ImGuiColorEditFlags_PickerMask_ | ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputMask_);
    assert(cast(i64, ImIsPowerOfTwo(flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayMask_)));
    assert(cast(i64, ImIsPowerOfTwo(flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputMask_)));
    bool alpha = (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoAlpha) == 0;
    bool hdr = (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_HDR) != 0;
    i32 components = alpha != 0 ? 4 : 3;
    f32 w_button = (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoSmallPreview) != 0 ? 0.0f : square_sz + style.ItemInnerSpacing.x;
    f32 w_inputs = ImMax(w_full - w_button, 1.0f);
    w_full = w_inputs + w_button;
    f32[4] f = {col[0], col[1], col[2], alpha != 0 ? col[3] : 1.0f};
    if flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputHSV && flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayRGB {
        ImGui_ColorConvertHSVtoRGB(f[0], f[1], f[2], &f[0], &f[1], &f[2]);
    } else if flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputRGB && flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayHSV {
        ImGui_ColorConvertRGBtoHSV(f[0], f[1], f[2], &f[0], &f[1], &f[2]);
        ColorEditRestoreHS(col, &f[0], &f[1], &f[2]);
    }
    i32[4] i = {
        cast(i32, f[0] * 255.0f + (f[0] >= 0.0f ? 0.5f : -0.5f)),
        cast(i32, f[1] * 255.0f + (f[1] >= 0.0f ? 0.5f : -0.5f)),
        cast(i32, f[2] * 255.0f + (f[2] >= 0.0f ? 0.5f : -0.5f)),
        cast(i32, f[3] * 255.0f + (f[3] >= 0.0f ? 0.5f : -0.5f)),
    };
    bool value_changed = false;
    bool value_changed_as_float = false;
    ImVec2 pos = window.DC.CursorPos;
    f32 inputs_offset_x = style.ColorButtonPosition == ImGuiDir_Left ? w_button : 0.0f;
    window.DC.CursorPos.x = pos.x + inputs_offset_x;
    if (flags & (ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayRGB | ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayHSV)) != 0 && (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoInputs) == 0 {
        f32 w_items = w_inputs - style.ItemInnerSpacing.x * cast(f32, components - 1);
        var w_per_component = cast(f32, cast(i32, w_items / cast(f32, components)));
        bool draw_color_marker = (flags & (ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayHSV | ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoColorMarkers)) == 0;
        bool hide_prefix = draw_color_marker || w_per_component <= ImGui_CalcTextSize((flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_Float) != 0 ? "M:0.000" : "M:000", null, false, -1.0f).x;
        i32 fmt_idx = hide_prefix != 0 ? 0 : (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayHSV) != 0 ? 2 : 1;
        ImGuiSliderFlags drag_flags = draw_color_marker != 0 ? ImGuiSliderFlags_ColorMarkers : ImGuiSliderFlags_None;
        f32 prev_split = 0.0f;
        for i32 n = 0; n < components; n++ {
            if n > 0 {
                ImGui_SameLine(0.0f, style.ItemInnerSpacing.x);
            }
            var next_split = cast(f32, cast(i32, w_items * cast(f32, n + 1) / cast(f32, components)));
            ImGui_SetNextItemWidth(ImMax(next_split - prev_split, 1.0f));
            prev_split = next_split;
            if draw_color_marker != 0 {
                ImGui_SetNextItemColorMarker(GDefaultRgbaColorMarkers[n]);
            }
            if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_Float) != 0 {
                value_changed |= ImGui_DragFloat(ImGui_ColorEdit4__ids[n], &f[n], 1.0f / 255.0f, 0.0f, hdr != 0 ? 0.0f : 1.0f, ImGui_ColorEdit4__fmt_table_float[fmt_idx][n], drag_flags);
                value_changed_as_float |= value_changed;
            } else {
                value_changed |= ImGui_DragInt(ImGui_ColorEdit4__ids[n], &i[n], 1.0f, 0, hdr != 0 ? 0 : 255, ImGui_ColorEdit4__fmt_table_int[fmt_idx][n], drag_flags);
            }
            if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoOptions) == 0 {
                ImGui_OpenPopupOnItemClick("context", ImGuiPopupFlags_MouseButtonRight);
            }
        }
    } else if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayHex) != 0 && (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoInputs) == 0 {
        u8[64] buf;
        if alpha != 0 {
            ImFormatString(buf, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(buf) / sizeof(*buf))), "#%02X%02X%02X%02X", ImClamp(i[0], 0, 255), ImClamp(i[1], 0, 255), ImClamp(i[2], 0, 255), ImClamp(i[3], 0, 255));
        } else {
            ImFormatString(buf, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(buf) / sizeof(*buf))), "#%02X%02X%02X", ImClamp(i[0], 0, 255), ImClamp(i[1], 0, 255), ImClamp(i[2], 0, 255));
        }
        ImGui_SetNextItemWidth(w_inputs);
        if ImGui_InputText("##Text", buf, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(buf) / sizeof(*buf))), ImGuiInputTextFlags_CharsUppercase) != 0 {
            value_changed = true;
            u8* p = buf;
            while *p == 35 || ImCharIsBlankA(*p) {
                p++;
            }
            i[2] = 0;
            i[1] = i[2];
            i[0] = i[1];
            i[3] = 0xFF;
            i32 r;
            if alpha != 0 {
                r = sscanf(p, "%02X%02X%02X%02X", cast(u32*, &i[0]), cast(u32*, &i[1]), cast(u32*, &i[2]), cast(u32*, &i[3]));
            } else {
                r = sscanf(p, "%02X%02X%02X", cast(u32*, &i[0]), cast(u32*, &i[1]), cast(u32*, &i[2]));
            }
            ignore r;
        }
        if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoOptions) == 0 {
            ImGui_OpenPopupOnItemClick("context", ImGuiPopupFlags_MouseButtonRight);
        }
    }
    ImGuiWindow* picker_active_window = null;
    if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoSmallPreview) == 0 {
        f32 button_offset_x = flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoInputs || style.ColorButtonPosition == ImGuiDir_Left ? 0.0f : w_inputs + style.ItemInnerSpacing.x;
        window.DC.CursorPos = ImVec2{pos.x + button_offset_x, pos.y};
        ImVec4 col_v4;
        ImVec4_init(&col_v4, col[0], col[1], col[2], alpha != 0 ? col[3] : 1.0f);
        if ImGui_ColorButton("##ColorButton", col_v4, flags) != 0 {
            if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoPicker) == 0 {
                g.ColorPickerRef = col_v4;
                ImGui_OpenPopup("picker", 0);
                ImGui_SetNextWindowPos(op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(ImRect_GetBL(&g.LastItemData.Rect), ImVec2{0.0f, style.ItemSpacing.y}), 0, ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f});
            }
        }
        if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoOptions) == 0 {
            ImGui_OpenPopupOnItemClick("context", ImGuiPopupFlags_MouseButtonRight);
        }
        if ImGui_BeginPopup("picker", 0) != 0 {
            if g.CurrentWindow.BeginCount == 1 {
                picker_active_window = g.CurrentWindow;
                if label != label_display_end {
                    ImGui_TextEx(label, label_display_end);
                    ImGui_Spacing();
                }
                ImGuiColorEditFlags picker_flags_to_forward = ImGuiColorEditFlags_DataTypeMask_ | ImGuiColorEditFlags_PickerMask_ | ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputMask_ | ImGuiColorEditFlags_HDR | ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoAlpha | ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaBar;
                ImGuiColorEditFlags picker_flags = flags_untouched & picker_flags_to_forward | ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayMask_ | ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoLabel | ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaPreviewHalf;
                ImGui_SetNextItemWidth(square_sz * 12.0f);
                value_changed |= ImGui_ColorPicker4("##picker", col, picker_flags, &g.ColorPickerRef.x);
            }
            ImGui_EndPopup();
        }
    }
    if label != label_display_end && !(flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoLabel) {
        ImGui_SameLine(0.0f, style.ItemInnerSpacing.x);
        window.DC.CursorPos.x = pos.x + ((flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoInputs) != 0 ? w_button : w_full + style.ItemInnerSpacing.x);
        ImGui_TextEx(label, label_display_end);
    }
    if value_changed && picker_active_window == null {
        if value_changed_as_float == 0 {
            for i32 n = 0; n < 4; n++ {
                f[n] = cast(f32, i[n]) / 255.0f;
            }
        }
        if flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayHSV && flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputRGB {
            g.ColorEditSavedHue = f[0];
            g.ColorEditSavedSat = f[1];
            ImGui_ColorConvertHSVtoRGB(f[0], f[1], f[2], &f[0], &f[1], &f[2]);
            g.ColorEditSavedID = g.ColorEditCurrentID;
            g.ColorEditSavedColor = ImGui_ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(ImVec4{f[0], f[1], f[2], 0.0f});
        }
        if flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayRGB && flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputHSV {
            ImGui_ColorConvertRGBtoHSV(f[0], f[1], f[2], &f[0], &f[1], &f[2]);
        }
        col[0] = f[0];
        col[1] = f[1];
        col[2] = f[2];
        if alpha != 0 {
            col[3] = f[3];
        }
    }
    if set_current_color_edit_id != 0 {
        g.ColorEditCurrentID = 0;
    }
    ImGui_PopID();
    ImGui_EndGroup();
    if g.LastItemData.StatusFlags & ImGuiItemStatusFlags_HoveredRect && !(g.LastItemData.ItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_ReadOnly) && !(flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoDragDrop) && ImGui_BeginDragDropTarget() {
        bool accepted_drag_drop = false;
        {
            ImGuiPayload* payload = ImGui_AcceptDragDropPayload("_COL3F", 0);
            if payload != null {
                memcpy(col, payload.Data, cast(u64, sizeof(f32) * 3));
                accepted_drag_drop = true;
                value_changed = accepted_drag_drop;
            }
        }
        {
            ImGuiPayload* payload = ImGui_AcceptDragDropPayload("_COL4F", 0);
            if payload != null {
                memcpy(col, payload.Data, cast(u64, sizeof(f32) * components));
                accepted_drag_drop = true;
                value_changed = accepted_drag_drop;
            }
        }
        if accepted_drag_drop && flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputHSV {
            ImGui_ColorConvertRGBtoHSV(col[0], col[1], col[2], &col[0], &col[1], &col[2]);
        }
        ImGui_EndDragDropTarget();
    }
    if picker_active_window && g.ActiveId != 0 && g.ActiveIdWindow == picker_active_window {
        g.LastItemData.ID = g.ActiveId;
    }
    if value_changed && g.LastItemData.ID != 0 {
        ImGui_MarkItemEdited(g.LastItemData.ID);
    }
    return value_changed;
}

bool ImGui_ColorPicker3(u8* label, f32* col, ImGuiColorEditFlags flags) {
    f32[4] col4 = {col[0], col[1], col[2], 1.0f};
    if ImGui_ColorPicker4(label, col4, flags | ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoAlpha, null) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    col[0] = col4[0];
    col[1] = col4[1];
    col[2] = col4[2];
    return true;
}

// Helper for ColorPicker4()
private {
void RenderArrowsForVerticalBar(ImDrawList* draw_list, ImVec2 pos, ImVec2 half_sz, f32 bar_w, f32 alpha) {
    var alpha8 = cast(ImU32, cast(i32, ImSaturate(alpha) * 255.0f + 0.5f));
    ImGui_RenderArrowPointingAt(draw_list, ImVec2{pos.x + half_sz.x + 1.0f, pos.y}, ImVec2{half_sz.x + 2.0f, half_sz.y + 1.0f}, ImGuiDir_Right, cast(ImU32, alpha8) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 0);
    ImGui_RenderArrowPointingAt(draw_list, ImVec2{pos.x + half_sz.x, pos.y}, half_sz, ImGuiDir_Right, cast(ImU32, alpha8) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 0);
    ImGui_RenderArrowPointingAt(draw_list, ImVec2{pos.x + bar_w - half_sz.x - 1.0f, pos.y}, ImVec2{half_sz.x + 2.0f, half_sz.y + 1.0f}, ImGuiDir_Left, cast(ImU32, alpha8) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 0);
    ImGui_RenderArrowPointingAt(draw_list, ImVec2{pos.x + bar_w - half_sz.x, pos.y}, half_sz, ImGuiDir_Left, cast(ImU32, alpha8) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 0);
}
}

// Note: ColorPicker4() only accesses 3 floats if ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoAlpha flag is set.
// (In C++ the 'float col[4]' notation for a function argument is equivalent to 'float* col', we only specify a size to facilitate understanding of the code.)
// FIXME: we adjust the big color square height based on item width, which may cause a flickering feedback loop (if automatic height makes a vertical scrollbar appears, affecting automatic width..)
// FIXME: this is trying to be aware of style.Alpha but not fully correct. Also, the color wheel will have overlapping glitches with (style.Alpha < 1.0)
bool ImGui_ColorPicker4(u8* label, f32* col, ImGuiColorEditFlags flags, f32* ref_col) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImDrawList* draw_list = window.DrawList;
    ImGuiStyle* style = &g.Style;
    ImGuiIO* io = &g.IO;
    f32 width = ImGui_CalcItemWidth();
    bool is_readonly = ((g.NextItemData.ItemFlagsSet | g.CurrentItemFlags) & ImGuiItemFlags_ReadOnly) != 0;
    ImGuiNextItemData_ClearFlags(&g.NextItemData);
    ImGui_PushID(label);
    bool set_current_color_edit_id = g.ColorEditCurrentID == 0;
    if set_current_color_edit_id != 0 {
        g.ColorEditCurrentID = *ImVector_ImGuiID_back(&window.IDStack);
    }
    ImGui_BeginGroup();
    if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoSidePreview) == 0 {
        flags |= ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoSmallPreview;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoOptions) == 0 {
        ImGui_ColorPickerOptionsPopup(col, flags);
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_PickerMask_) == 0 {
        flags |= ((g.IO.ConfigColorEditFlags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_PickerMask_) != 0 ? g.IO.ConfigColorEditFlags : ImGuiColorEditFlags_DefaultOptions_) & ImGuiColorEditFlags_PickerMask_;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputMask_) == 0 {
        flags |= ((g.IO.ConfigColorEditFlags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputMask_) != 0 ? g.IO.ConfigColorEditFlags : ImGuiColorEditFlags_DefaultOptions_) & ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputMask_;
    }
    assert(cast(i64, ImIsPowerOfTwo(flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_PickerMask_)));
    assert(cast(i64, ImIsPowerOfTwo(flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputMask_)));
    if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoOptions) == 0 {
        flags |= g.IO.ConfigColorEditFlags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaBar;
    }
    i32 components = (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoAlpha) != 0 ? 3 : 4;
    bool alpha_bar = flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaBar && !(flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoAlpha);
    ImVec2 picker_pos = window.DC.CursorPos;
    f32 square_sz = ImGui_GetFrameHeight();
    f32 bars_width = square_sz;
    f32 sv_picker_size = ImMax(bars_width * 1.0f, width - cast(f32, alpha_bar != 0 ? 2 : 1) * (bars_width + style.ItemInnerSpacing.x));
    f32 bar0_pos_x = picker_pos.x + sv_picker_size + style.ItemInnerSpacing.x;
    f32 bar1_pos_x = bar0_pos_x + bars_width + style.ItemInnerSpacing.x;
    var bars_triangles_half_sz = cast(f32, cast(i32, bars_width * 0.2f));
    f32[4] backup_initial_col;
    memcpy(backup_initial_col, col, cast(u64, components * sizeof(f32)));
    f32 wheel_thickness = sv_picker_size * 0.08f;
    f32 wheel_r_outer = sv_picker_size * 0.5f;
    f32 wheel_r_inner = wheel_r_outer - wheel_thickness;
    ImVec2 wheel_center;
    ImVec2_init(&wheel_center, picker_pos.x + (sv_picker_size + bars_width) * 0.5f, picker_pos.y + sv_picker_size * 0.5f);
    bool triangle_rotate = (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_PickerNoRotate) == 0;
    f32 triangle_r = wheel_r_inner - cast(f32, cast(i32, sv_picker_size * 0.027f));
    ImVec2 triangle_pa = triangle_rotate != 0 ? ImVec2{triangle_r, 0.0f} : ImVec2{triangle_r * 0.866f, triangle_r * 0.5f};
    ImVec2 triangle_pb = triangle_rotate != 0 ? ImVec2{triangle_r * -0.5f, triangle_r * -0.866f} : ImVec2{0.0f, -triangle_r};
    ImVec2 triangle_pc = triangle_rotate != 0 ? ImVec2{triangle_r * -0.5f, triangle_r * 0.866f} : ImVec2{triangle_r * -0.866f, triangle_r * 0.5f};
    f32 H = col[0];
    f32 S = col[1];
    f32 V = col[2];
    f32 R = col[0];
    f32 G = col[1];
    f32 B = col[2];
    if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputRGB) != 0 {
        ImGui_ColorConvertRGBtoHSV(R, G, B, &H, &S, &V);
        ColorEditRestoreHS(col, &H, &S, &V);
    } else if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputHSV) != 0 {
        ImGui_ColorConvertHSVtoRGB(H, S, V, &R, &G, &B);
    }
    bool value_changed = false;
    bool value_changed_h = false;
    bool value_changed_sv = false;
    ImGui_PushItemFlag(ImGuiItemFlags_NoNav, true);
    if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_PickerHueWheel) != 0 {
        ImGui_InvisibleButton("hsv", ImVec2{
            sv_picker_size + style.ItemInnerSpacing.x + bars_width, sv_picker_size,
        });
        if ImGui_IsItemActive() && !is_readonly {
            ImVec2 initial_off = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(g.IO.MouseClickedPos[0], wheel_center);
            ImVec2 current_off = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(g.IO.MousePos, wheel_center);
            f32 initial_dist2 = ImLengthSqr(initial_off);
            if initial_dist2 >= (wheel_r_inner - 1.0f) * (wheel_r_inner - 1.0f) && initial_dist2 <= (wheel_r_outer + 1.0f) * (wheel_r_outer + 1.0f) {
                H = atan2(current_off.y, current_off.x) / 3.141592653589793f * 0.5f;
                if H < 0.0f {
                    H += 1.0f;
                }
                value_changed_h = true;
                value_changed = value_changed_h;
            }
            f32 cos_hue_angle = triangle_rotate != 0 ? cos(-H * 2.0f * 3.141592653589793f) : 1.0f;
            f32 sin_hue_angle = triangle_rotate != 0 ? sin(-H * 2.0f * 3.141592653589793f) : 0.0f;
            if ImTriangleContainsPoint(triangle_pa, triangle_pb, triangle_pc, ImRotate(initial_off, cos_hue_angle, sin_hue_angle)) != 0 {
                ImVec2 current_off_unrotated = ImRotate(current_off, cos_hue_angle, sin_hue_angle);
                if ImTriangleContainsPoint(triangle_pa, triangle_pb, triangle_pc, current_off_unrotated) == 0 {
                    current_off_unrotated = ImTriangleClosestPoint(triangle_pa, triangle_pb, triangle_pc, current_off_unrotated);
                }
                f32 uu;
                f32 vv;
                f32 ww;
                ImTriangleBarycentricCoords(triangle_pa, triangle_pb, triangle_pc, current_off_unrotated, &uu, &vv, &ww);
                V = ImClamp(1.0f - vv, 0.0001f, 1.0f);
                S = ImClamp(uu / V, 0.0001f, 1.0f);
                value_changed_sv = true;
                value_changed = value_changed_sv;
            }
        }
        if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoOptions) == 0 {
            ImGui_OpenPopupOnItemClick("context", ImGuiPopupFlags_MouseButtonRight);
        }
    } else if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_PickerHueBar) != 0 {
        ImGui_InvisibleButton("sv", ImVec2{sv_picker_size, sv_picker_size});
        if ImGui_IsItemActive() && !is_readonly {
            S = ImSaturate((io.MousePos.x - picker_pos.x) / (sv_picker_size - 1.0f));
            V = 1.0f - ImSaturate((io.MousePos.y - picker_pos.y) / (sv_picker_size - 1.0f));
            ColorEditRestoreH(col, &H);
            value_changed_sv = true;
            value_changed = value_changed_sv;
        }
        if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoOptions) == 0 {
            ImGui_OpenPopupOnItemClick("context", ImGuiPopupFlags_MouseButtonRight);
        }
        ImGui_SetCursorScreenPos(ImVec2{bar0_pos_x, picker_pos.y});
        ImGui_InvisibleButton("hue", ImVec2{bars_width, sv_picker_size});
        if ImGui_IsItemActive() && !is_readonly {
            H = ImSaturate((io.MousePos.y - picker_pos.y) / (sv_picker_size - 1.0f));
            value_changed_h = true;
            value_changed = value_changed_h;
        }
    }
    if alpha_bar != 0 {
        ImGui_SetCursorScreenPos(ImVec2{bar1_pos_x, picker_pos.y});
        ImGui_InvisibleButton("alpha", ImVec2{bars_width, sv_picker_size});
        if ImGui_IsItemActive() != 0 {
            col[3] = 1.0f - ImSaturate((io.MousePos.y - picker_pos.y) / (sv_picker_size - 1.0f));
            value_changed = true;
        }
    }
    ImGui_PopItemFlag();
    if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoSidePreview) == 0 {
        ImGui_SameLine(0.0f, style.ItemInnerSpacing.x);
        ImGui_BeginGroup();
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoLabel) == 0 {
        u8* label_display_end = ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(label, null);
        if label != label_display_end {
            if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoSidePreview) != 0 {
                ImGui_SameLine(0.0f, style.ItemInnerSpacing.x);
            }
            ImGui_TextEx(label, label_display_end);
        }
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoSidePreview) == 0 {
        ImGui_PushItemFlag(ImGuiItemFlags_NoNavDefaultFocus, true);
        ImVec4 col_v4;
        ImVec4_init(&col_v4, col[0], col[1], col[2], (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoAlpha) != 0 ? 1.0f : col[3]);
        if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoLabel) != 0 {
            ImGui_Text("Current");
        }
        ImGuiColorEditFlags sub_flags_to_forward = ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputMask_ | ImGuiColorEditFlags_HDR | ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaMask_ | ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoTooltip;
        ImGui_ColorButton("##current", col_v4, flags & sub_flags_to_forward, ImVec2{square_sz * 3.0f, square_sz * 2.0f});
        if ref_col != null {
            ImGui_Text("Original");
            ImVec4 ref_col_v4;
            ImVec4_init(&ref_col_v4, ref_col[0], ref_col[1], ref_col[2], (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoAlpha) != 0 ? 1.0f : ref_col[3]);
            if ImGui_ColorButton("##original", ref_col_v4, flags & sub_flags_to_forward, ImVec2{square_sz * 3.0f, square_sz * 2.0f}) != 0 {
                memcpy(col, ref_col, cast(u64, components * sizeof(f32)));
                value_changed = true;
            }
        }
        ImGui_PopItemFlag();
        ImGui_EndGroup();
    }
    if value_changed_h || value_changed_sv {
        if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputRGB) != 0 {
            ImGui_ColorConvertHSVtoRGB(H, S, V, &col[0], &col[1], &col[2]);
            g.ColorEditSavedHue = H;
            g.ColorEditSavedSat = S;
            g.ColorEditSavedID = g.ColorEditCurrentID;
            g.ColorEditSavedColor = ImGui_ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(ImVec4{col[0], col[1], col[2], 0.0f});
        } else if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputHSV) != 0 {
            col[0] = H;
            col[1] = S;
            col[2] = V;
        }
    }
    bool value_changed_fix_hue_wrap = false;
    if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoInputs) == 0 {
        ImGui_PushItemWidth((alpha_bar != 0 ? bar1_pos_x : bar0_pos_x) + bars_width - picker_pos.x);
        ImGuiColorEditFlags sub_flags_to_forward = ImGuiColorEditFlags_DataTypeMask_ | ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputMask_ | ImGuiColorEditFlags_HDR | ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaMask_ | ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoOptions | ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoTooltip | ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoSmallPreview;
        ImGuiColorEditFlags sub_flags = flags & sub_flags_to_forward | ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoPicker;
        if flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayRGB || (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayMask_) == 0 {
            if ImGui_ColorEdit4("##rgb", col, sub_flags | ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayRGB) != 0 {
                value_changed_fix_hue_wrap = g.ActiveId != 0 && !g.ActiveIdAllowOverlap;
                value_changed = true;
            }
        }
        if flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayHSV || (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayMask_) == 0 {
            value_changed |= ImGui_ColorEdit4("##hsv", col, sub_flags | ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayHSV);
        }
        if flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayHex || (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayMask_) == 0 {
            value_changed |= ImGui_ColorEdit4("##hex", col, sub_flags | ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayHex);
        }
        ImGui_PopItemWidth();
    }
    if value_changed_fix_hue_wrap && flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputRGB {
        f32 new_H;
        f32 new_S;
        f32 new_V;
        ImGui_ColorConvertRGBtoHSV(col[0], col[1], col[2], &new_H, &new_S, &new_V);
        if new_H <= 0.0f && H > 0.0f {
            if new_V <= 0.0f && V != new_V {
                ImGui_ColorConvertHSVtoRGB(H, S, new_V <= 0.0f ? V * 0.5f : new_V, &col[0], &col[1], &col[2]);
            } else if new_S <= 0.0f {
                ImGui_ColorConvertHSVtoRGB(H, new_S <= 0.0f ? S * 0.5f : new_S, new_V, &col[0], &col[1], &col[2]);
            }
        }
    }
    if value_changed != 0 {
        if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputRGB) != 0 {
            R = col[0];
            G = col[1];
            B = col[2];
            ImGui_ColorConvertRGBtoHSV(R, G, B, &H, &S, &V);
            ColorEditRestoreHS(col, &H, &S, &V);
        } else if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputHSV) != 0 {
            H = col[0];
            S = col[1];
            V = col[2];
            ImGui_ColorConvertHSVtoRGB(H, S, V, &R, &G, &B);
        }
    }
    var style_alpha8 = cast(i32, ImSaturate(style.Alpha) * 255.0f + 0.5f);
    ImU32 col_black = cast(ImU32, style_alpha8) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 0;
    ImU32 col_white = cast(ImU32, style_alpha8) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 0;
    ImU32 col_midgrey = cast(ImU32, style_alpha8) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 128) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 128) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 128) << 0;
    ImU32[6 + 1] col_hues = {
        cast(ImU32, style_alpha8) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 0,
        cast(ImU32, style_alpha8) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 0,
        cast(ImU32, style_alpha8) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 0,
        cast(ImU32, style_alpha8) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 0,
        cast(ImU32, style_alpha8) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 0,
        cast(ImU32, style_alpha8) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 0,
        cast(ImU32, style_alpha8) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 0,
    };
    ImVec4 hue_color_f;
    ImVec4_init(&hue_color_f, 1.0f, 1.0f, 1.0f, style.Alpha);
    ImGui_ColorConvertHSVtoRGB(H, 1.0f, 1.0f, &hue_color_f.x, &hue_color_f.y, &hue_color_f.z);
    ImU32 hue_color32 = ImGui_ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(hue_color_f);
    ImU32 user_col32_striped_of_alpha = ImGui_ColorConvertFloat4ToU32(ImVec4{R, G, B, style.Alpha});
    ImVec2 sv_cursor_pos;
    if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_PickerHueWheel) != 0 {
        f32 aeps = 0.5f / wheel_r_outer;
        i32 segment_per_arc = ImMax(4, cast(i32, wheel_r_outer) / 12);
        for i32 n = 0; n < 6; n++ {
            f32 a0 = cast(f32, n) / 6.0f * 2.0f * 3.141592653589793f - aeps;
            f32 a1 = (cast(f32, n) + 1.0f) / 6.0f * 2.0f * 3.141592653589793f + aeps;
            i32 vert_start_idx = draw_list.VtxBuffer.Size;
            ImDrawList_PathArcTo(draw_list, wheel_center, (wheel_r_inner + wheel_r_outer) * 0.5f, a0, a1, segment_per_arc);
            ImDrawList_PathStroke(draw_list, col_white, wheel_thickness, 0);
            i32 vert_end_idx = draw_list.VtxBuffer.Size;
            ImVec2 gradient_p0;
            ImVec2_init(&gradient_p0, wheel_center.x + cos(a0) * wheel_r_inner, wheel_center.y + sin(a0) * wheel_r_inner);
            ImVec2 gradient_p1;
            ImVec2_init(&gradient_p1, wheel_center.x + cos(a1) * wheel_r_inner, wheel_center.y + sin(a1) * wheel_r_inner);
            ImGui_ShadeVertsLinearColorGradientKeepAlpha(draw_list, vert_start_idx, vert_end_idx, gradient_p0, gradient_p1, col_hues[n], col_hues[n + 1]);
        }
        f32 cos_hue_angle = cos(H * 2.0f * 3.141592653589793f);
        f32 sin_hue_angle = sin(H * 2.0f * 3.141592653589793f);
        ImVec2 hue_cursor_pos;
        ImVec2_init(&hue_cursor_pos, wheel_center.x + cos_hue_angle * (wheel_r_inner + wheel_r_outer) * 0.5f, wheel_center.y + sin_hue_angle * (wheel_r_inner + wheel_r_outer) * 0.5f);
        f32 hue_cursor_rad = value_changed_h != 0 ? wheel_thickness * 0.65f : wheel_thickness * 0.55f;
        i32 hue_cursor_segments = ImDrawList__CalcCircleAutoSegmentCount(draw_list, hue_cursor_rad);
        ImDrawList_AddCircleFilled(draw_list, hue_cursor_pos, hue_cursor_rad, hue_color32, hue_cursor_segments);
        ImDrawList_AddCircle(draw_list, hue_cursor_pos, hue_cursor_rad + 1.0f, col_midgrey, hue_cursor_segments, 1.0f);
        ImDrawList_AddCircle(draw_list, hue_cursor_pos, hue_cursor_rad, col_white, hue_cursor_segments, 1.0f);
        if triangle_rotate == false {
            cos_hue_angle = 1.0f;
            sin_hue_angle = 0.0f;
        }
        ImVec2 tra = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(wheel_center, ImRotate(triangle_pa, cos_hue_angle, sin_hue_angle));
        ImVec2 trb = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(wheel_center, ImRotate(triangle_pb, cos_hue_angle, sin_hue_angle));
        ImVec2 trc = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(wheel_center, ImRotate(triangle_pc, cos_hue_angle, sin_hue_angle));
        ImVec2 uv_white = ImGui_GetFontTexUvWhitePixel();
        ImDrawList_PrimReserve(draw_list, 3, 3);
        ImDrawList_PrimVtx(draw_list, tra, uv_white, hue_color32);
        ImDrawList_PrimVtx(draw_list, trb, uv_white, col_black);
        ImDrawList_PrimVtx(draw_list, trc, uv_white, col_white);
        ImDrawList_AddTriangle(draw_list, tra, trb, trc, col_midgrey, 1.5f);
        sv_cursor_pos = ImLerp(ImLerp(trc, tra, ImSaturate(S)), trb, ImSaturate(1.0f - V));
    } else if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_PickerHueBar) != 0 {
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilledMultiColor(draw_list, picker_pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(picker_pos, ImVec2{sv_picker_size, sv_picker_size}), col_white, hue_color32, hue_color32, col_white);
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilledMultiColor(draw_list, picker_pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(picker_pos, ImVec2{sv_picker_size, sv_picker_size}), 0, 0, col_black, col_black);
        ImGui_RenderFrameBorder(picker_pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(picker_pos, ImVec2{sv_picker_size, sv_picker_size}), 0.0f);
        sv_cursor_pos.x = ImClamp(cast(f32, cast(i32, picker_pos.x + ImSaturate(S) * sv_picker_size + 0.5f)), picker_pos.x + 2.0f, picker_pos.x + sv_picker_size - 2.0f);
        sv_cursor_pos.y = ImClamp(cast(f32, cast(i32, picker_pos.y + ImSaturate(1.0f - V) * sv_picker_size + 0.5f)), picker_pos.y + 2.0f, picker_pos.y + sv_picker_size - 2.0f);
        for i32 i = 0; i < 6; ++i {
            ImDrawList_AddRectFilledMultiColor(draw_list, ImVec2{
                bar0_pos_x, picker_pos.y + cast(f32, i) * (sv_picker_size / 6.0f),
            }, ImVec2{
                bar0_pos_x + bars_width, picker_pos.y + cast(f32, i + 1) * (sv_picker_size / 6.0f),
            }, col_hues[i], col_hues[i], col_hues[i + 1], col_hues[i + 1]);
        }
        var bar0_line_y = cast(f32, cast(i32, picker_pos.y + H * sv_picker_size + 0.5f));
        ImGui_RenderFrameBorder(ImVec2{bar0_pos_x, picker_pos.y}, ImVec2{bar0_pos_x + bars_width, picker_pos.y + sv_picker_size}, 0.0f);
        RenderArrowsForVerticalBar(draw_list, ImVec2{bar0_pos_x - 1.0f, bar0_line_y}, ImVec2{bars_triangles_half_sz + 1.0f, bars_triangles_half_sz}, bars_width + 2.0f, style.Alpha);
    }
    f32 sv_cursor_rad = value_changed_sv != 0 ? wheel_thickness * 0.55f : wheel_thickness * 0.4f;
    i32 sv_cursor_segments = ImDrawList__CalcCircleAutoSegmentCount(draw_list, sv_cursor_rad);
    ImDrawList_AddCircleFilled(draw_list, sv_cursor_pos, sv_cursor_rad, user_col32_striped_of_alpha, sv_cursor_segments);
    ImDrawList_AddCircle(draw_list, sv_cursor_pos, sv_cursor_rad + 1.0f, col_midgrey, sv_cursor_segments, 1.0f);
    ImDrawList_AddCircle(draw_list, sv_cursor_pos, sv_cursor_rad, col_white, sv_cursor_segments, 1.0f);
    if alpha_bar != 0 {
        f32 alpha = ImSaturate(col[3]);
        ImRect bar1_bb;
        ImRect_init(&bar1_bb, bar1_pos_x, picker_pos.y, bar1_pos_x + bars_width, picker_pos.y + sv_picker_size);
        ImGui_RenderColorRectWithAlphaCheckerboard(draw_list, bar1_bb.Min, bar1_bb.Max, 0, ImRect_GetWidth(&bar1_bb) / 2.0f, ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f}, 0.0f, 0);
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilledMultiColor(draw_list, bar1_bb.Min, bar1_bb.Max, user_col32_striped_of_alpha, user_col32_striped_of_alpha, user_col32_striped_of_alpha & cast(u32, ~0xFF000000), user_col32_striped_of_alpha & cast(u32, ~0xFF000000));
        var bar1_line_y = cast(f32, cast(i32, picker_pos.y + (1.0f - alpha) * sv_picker_size + 0.5f));
        ImGui_RenderFrameBorder(bar1_bb.Min, bar1_bb.Max, 0.0f);
        RenderArrowsForVerticalBar(draw_list, ImVec2{bar1_pos_x - 1.0f, bar1_line_y}, ImVec2{bars_triangles_half_sz + 1.0f, bars_triangles_half_sz}, bars_width + 2.0f, style.Alpha);
    }
    ImGui_EndGroup();
    if value_changed && memcmp(backup_initial_col, col, cast(u64, components * sizeof(f32))) == 0 {
        value_changed = false;
    }
    if value_changed && g.LastItemData.ID != 0 {
        ImGui_MarkItemEdited(g.LastItemData.ID);
    }
    if set_current_color_edit_id != 0 {
        g.ColorEditCurrentID = 0;
    }
    ImGui_PopID();
    return value_changed;
}

// A little color square. Return true when clicked.
// FIXME: May want to display/ignore the alpha component in the color display? Yet show it in the tooltip.
// 'desc_id' is not called 'label' because we don't display it next to the button, but only in the tooltip.
// Note that 'col' may be encoded in HSV if ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputHSV is set.
bool ImGui_ColorButton(u8* desc_id, ImVec4 col, ImGuiColorEditFlags flags, ImVec2 size_arg) {
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiID id = ImGuiWindow_GetID(window, desc_id, null);
    f32 default_size = ImGui_GetFrameHeight();
    ImVec2 size;
    ImVec2_init(&size, size_arg.x == 0.0f ? default_size : size_arg.x, size_arg.y == 0.0f ? default_size : size_arg.y);
    ImRect bb;
    ImRect_init(&bb, window.DC.CursorPos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.DC.CursorPos, size));
    ImGui_ItemSize(bb, size.y >= default_size ? g.Style.FramePadding.y : 0.0f);
    if ImGui_ItemAdd(bb, id, null, 0) == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    bool hovered;
    bool held;
    bool pressed = ImGui_ButtonBehavior(bb, id, &hovered, &held);
    if (flags & (ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoAlpha | ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaOpaque)) != 0 {
        flags &= ~(ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaNoBg | ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaPreviewHalf);
    }
    ImVec4 col_rgb = col;
    if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputHSV) != 0 {
        ImGui_ColorConvertHSVtoRGB(col_rgb.x, col_rgb.y, col_rgb.z, &col_rgb.x, &col_rgb.y, &col_rgb.z);
    }
    ImVec4 col_rgb_without_alpha;
    ImVec4_init(&col_rgb_without_alpha, col_rgb.x, col_rgb.y, col_rgb.z, 1.0f);
    f32 grid_step = ImMin(size.x, size.y) / 2.99f;
    f32 rounding = ImMin(g.Style.FrameRounding, grid_step * 0.5f);
    ImRect bb_inner = bb;
    f32 off = 0.0f;
    if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoBorder) == 0 {
        off = -0.75f;
        ImRect_Expand(&bb_inner, off);
    }
    if flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaPreviewHalf && col_rgb.w < 1.0f {
        var mid_x = cast(f32, cast(i32, (bb_inner.Min.x + bb_inner.Max.x) * 0.5f + 0.5f));
        if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaNoBg) == 0 {
            ImGui_RenderColorRectWithAlphaCheckerboard(window.DrawList, ImVec2{bb_inner.Min.x + grid_step, bb_inner.Min.y}, bb_inner.Max, ImGui_GetColorU32(col_rgb), grid_step, ImVec2{-grid_step + off, off}, rounding, ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersRight);
        } else {
            ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(window.DrawList, ImVec2{bb_inner.Min.x + grid_step, bb_inner.Min.y}, bb_inner.Max, ImGui_GetColorU32(col_rgb), rounding, ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersRight);
        }
        ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(window.DrawList, bb_inner.Min, ImVec2{mid_x, bb_inner.Max.y}, ImGui_GetColorU32(col_rgb_without_alpha), rounding, ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersLeft);
    } else {
        ImVec4 col_source = (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaOpaque) != 0 ? col_rgb_without_alpha : col_rgb;
        if col_source.w < 1.0f && (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaNoBg) == 0 {
            ImGui_RenderColorRectWithAlphaCheckerboard(window.DrawList, bb_inner.Min, bb_inner.Max, ImGui_GetColorU32(col_source), grid_step, ImVec2{off, off}, rounding, 0);
        } else {
            ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(window.DrawList, bb_inner.Min, bb_inner.Max, ImGui_GetColorU32(col_source), rounding, 0);
        }
    }
    ImGui_RenderNavCursor(bb, id, ImGuiNavRenderCursorFlags_None, -1.0f);
    if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoBorder) == 0 {
        if g.Style.FrameBorderSize > 0.0f {
            ImGui_RenderFrameBorder(bb.Min, bb.Max, rounding);
        } else {
            ImDrawList_AddRect(window.DrawList, bb.Min, bb.Max, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_FrameBg), rounding, 1.0f * cast(f32, cast(i32, g.Style._MainScale)), 0);
        }
    }
    if g.ActiveId == id && !(flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoDragDrop) && ImGui_BeginDragDropSource(0) {
        if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoAlpha) != 0 {
            ImGui_SetDragDropPayload("_COL3F", &col_rgb, cast(u64, sizeof(f32) * 3), ImGuiCond_Once);
        } else {
            ImGui_SetDragDropPayload("_COL4F", &col_rgb, cast(u64, sizeof(f32) * 4), ImGuiCond_Once);
        }
        ImGui_ColorButton(desc_id, col, flags);
        ImGui_SameLine(0.0f, -1.0f);
        ImGui_TextEx("Color");
        ImGui_EndDragDropSource();
    }
    if !(flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoTooltip) && hovered && ImGui_IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_ForTooltip) {
        ImGui_ColorTooltip(desc_id, &col.x, flags & (ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputMask_ | ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaMask_));
    }
    return pressed;
}

// Note: only access 3 floats if ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoAlpha flag is set.
void ImGui_ColorTooltip(u8* text, f32* col, ImGuiColorEditFlags flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if ImGui_BeginTooltipEx(ImGuiTooltipFlags_OverridePrevious, ImGuiWindowFlags_None) == 0 {
        return;
    }
    u8* text_end = text != null ? ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(text, null) : text;
    if text_end > text {
        ImGui_TextEx(text, text_end);
        ImGui_Separator();
    }
    ImVec2 sz;
    ImVec2_init(&sz, g.FontSize * 3.0f + g.Style.FramePadding.y * 2.0f, g.FontSize * 3.0f + g.Style.FramePadding.y * 2.0f);
    ImVec4 cf;
    ImVec4_init(&cf, col[0], col[1], col[2], (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoAlpha) != 0 ? 1.0f : col[3]);
    var cr = cast(i32, ImSaturate(col[0]) * 255.0f + 0.5f);
    var cg = cast(i32, ImSaturate(col[1]) * 255.0f + 0.5f);
    var cb = cast(i32, ImSaturate(col[2]) * 255.0f + 0.5f);
    i32 ca = (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoAlpha) != 0 ? 255 : cast(i32, ImSaturate(col[3]) * 255.0f + 0.5f);
    ImGuiColorEditFlags flags_to_forward = ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputMask_ | ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaMask_;
    ImGui_ColorButton("##preview", cf, flags & flags_to_forward | ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoTooltip, sz);
    ImGui_SameLine(0.0f, -1.0f);
    if flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputRGB || !(flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputMask_) {
        if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoAlpha) != 0 {
            ImGui_Text("#%02X%02X%02X\nR: %d, G: %d, B: %d\n(%.3f, %.3f, %.3f)", cr, cg, cb, cr, cg, cb, col[0], col[1], col[2]);
        } else {
            ImGui_Text("#%02X%02X%02X%02X\nR:%d, G:%d, B:%d, A:%d\n(%.3f, %.3f, %.3f, %.3f)", cr, cg, cb, ca, cr, cg, cb, ca, col[0], col[1], col[2], col[3]);
        }
    } else if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_InputHSV) != 0 {
        if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoAlpha) != 0 {
            ImGui_Text("H: %.3f, S: %.3f, V: %.3f", col[0], col[1], col[2]);
        } else {
            ImGui_Text("H: %.3f, S: %.3f, V: %.3f, A: %.3f", col[0], col[1], col[2], col[3]);
        }
    }
    ImGui_EndTooltip();
}

void ImGui_ColorEditOptionsPopup(f32* col, ImGuiColorEditFlags flags) {
    bool allow_opt_inputs = !(flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayMask_);
    bool allow_opt_datatype = !(flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_DataTypeMask_);
    if !allow_opt_inputs && !allow_opt_datatype || !ImGui_BeginPopup("context", 0) {
        return;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGui_PushItemFlag(ImGuiItemFlags_NoMarkEdited, true);
    ImGuiColorEditFlags opts = g.IO.ConfigColorEditFlags;
    if allow_opt_inputs != 0 {
        if ImGui_RadioButton("RGB", (opts & ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayRGB) != 0) != 0 {
            opts = opts & ~ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayMask_ | ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayRGB;
        }
        if ImGui_RadioButton("HSV", (opts & ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayHSV) != 0) != 0 {
            opts = opts & ~ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayMask_ | ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayHSV;
        }
        if ImGui_RadioButton("Hex", (opts & ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayHex) != 0) != 0 {
            opts = opts & ~ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayMask_ | ImGuiColorEditFlags_DisplayHex;
        }
    }
    if allow_opt_datatype != 0 {
        if allow_opt_inputs != 0 {
            ImGui_Separator();
        }
        if ImGui_RadioButton("0..255", (opts & ImGuiColorEditFlags_Uint8) != 0) != 0 {
            opts = opts & ~ImGuiColorEditFlags_DataTypeMask_ | ImGuiColorEditFlags_Uint8;
        }
        if ImGui_RadioButton("0.00..1.00", (opts & ImGuiColorEditFlags_Float) != 0) != 0 {
            opts = opts & ~ImGuiColorEditFlags_DataTypeMask_ | ImGuiColorEditFlags_Float;
        }
    }
    if allow_opt_inputs || allow_opt_datatype {
        ImGui_Separator();
    }
    if ImGui_Button("Copy as..", ImVec2{-1.0f, 0.0f}) != 0 {
        ImGui_OpenPopup("Copy", 0);
    }
    if ImGui_BeginPopup("Copy", 0) != 0 {
        var cr = cast(i32, ImSaturate(col[0]) * 255.0f + 0.5f);
        var cg = cast(i32, ImSaturate(col[1]) * 255.0f + 0.5f);
        var cb = cast(i32, ImSaturate(col[2]) * 255.0f + 0.5f);
        i32 ca = (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoAlpha) != 0 ? 255 : cast(i32, ImSaturate(col[3]) * 255.0f + 0.5f);
        u8[64] buf;
        ImFormatString(buf, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(buf) / sizeof(*buf))), "(%.3ff, %.3ff, %.3ff, %.3ff)", col[0], col[1], col[2], (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoAlpha) != 0 ? 1.0f : col[3]);
        if ImGui_Selectable(buf) != 0 {
            ImGui_SetClipboardText(buf);
        }
        ImFormatString(buf, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(buf) / sizeof(*buf))), "(%d,%d,%d,%d)", cr, cg, cb, ca);
        if ImGui_Selectable(buf) != 0 {
            ImGui_SetClipboardText(buf);
        }
        ImFormatString(buf, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(buf) / sizeof(*buf))), "#%02X%02X%02X", cr, cg, cb);
        if ImGui_Selectable(buf) != 0 {
            ImGui_SetClipboardText(buf);
        }
        if (flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoAlpha) == 0 {
            ImFormatString(buf, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(buf) / sizeof(*buf))), "#%02X%02X%02X%02X", cr, cg, cb, ca);
            if ImGui_Selectable(buf) != 0 {
                ImGui_SetClipboardText(buf);
            }
        }
        ImGui_EndPopup();
    }
    g.IO.ConfigColorEditFlags = opts;
    ImGui_PopItemFlag();
    ImGui_EndPopup();
}

void ImGui_ColorPickerOptionsPopup(f32* ref_col, ImGuiColorEditFlags flags) {
    bool allow_opt_picker = !(flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_PickerMask_);
    bool allow_opt_alpha_bar = !(flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoAlpha) && !(flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaBar);
    if !allow_opt_picker && !allow_opt_alpha_bar || !ImGui_BeginPopup("context", 0) {
        return;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGui_PushItemFlag(ImGuiItemFlags_NoMarkEdited, true);
    if allow_opt_picker != 0 {
        ImVec2 picker_size;
        ImVec2_init(&picker_size, g.FontSize * 8.0f, ImMax(g.FontSize * 8.0f - (ImGui_GetFrameHeight() + g.Style.ItemInnerSpacing.x), 1.0f));
        ImGui_PushItemWidth(picker_size.x);
        for i32 picker_type = 0; picker_type < 2; picker_type++ {
            if picker_type > 0 {
                ImGui_Separator();
            }
            ImGui_PushID(picker_type);
            ImGuiColorEditFlags picker_flags = ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoInputs | ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoOptions | ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoLabel | ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoSidePreview | flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoAlpha;
            if picker_type == 0 {
                picker_flags |= ImGuiColorEditFlags_PickerHueBar;
            }
            if picker_type == 1 {
                picker_flags |= ImGuiColorEditFlags_PickerHueWheel;
            }
            ImVec2 backup_pos = ImGui_GetCursorScreenPos();
            if ImGui_Selectable("##selectable", false, 0, picker_size) != 0 {
                g.IO.ConfigColorEditFlags = g.IO.ConfigColorEditFlags & ~ImGuiColorEditFlags_PickerMask_ | picker_flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_PickerMask_;
            }
            ImGui_SetCursorScreenPos(backup_pos);
            ImVec4 previewing_ref_col;
            memcpy(&previewing_ref_col, ref_col, cast(u64, sizeof(f32) * ((picker_flags & ImGuiColorEditFlags_NoAlpha) != 0 ? 3 : 4)));
            ImGui_ColorPicker4("##previewing_picker", &previewing_ref_col.x, picker_flags, null);
            ImGui_PopID();
        }
        ImGui_PopItemWidth();
    }
    if allow_opt_alpha_bar != 0 {
        if allow_opt_picker != 0 {
            ImGui_Separator();
        }
        ImGui_CheckboxFlags("Alpha Bar", &g.IO.ConfigColorEditFlags, ImGuiColorEditFlags_AlphaBar);
    }
    ImGui_PopItemFlag();
    ImGui_EndPopup();
}

    return ImGuiStorage_GetInt(storage, storage_id, 0) != 0;

    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
