bool ImGui_TreeNodeUpdateNextOpen(ImGuiID storage_id, ImGuiTreeNodeFlags flags) {
    if (flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_Leaf) != 0 {
        return true;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    ImGuiStorage* storage = window.DC.StateStorage;
    bool is_open;
    if (g.NextItemData.HasFlags & ImGuiNextItemDataFlags_HasOpen) != 0 {
        if (g.NextItemData.OpenCond & ImGuiCond_Always) != 0 {
            is_open = g.NextItemData.OpenVal;
            ImGui_TreeNodeSetOpen(storage_id, is_open);
        } else {
            i32 stored_value = ImGuiStorage_GetInt(storage, storage_id, -1);
            if stored_value == -1 {
                is_open = g.NextItemData.OpenVal;
                ImGui_TreeNodeSetOpen(storage_id, is_open);
            } else {
                is_open = stored_value != 0;
            }
        }
    } else {
        is_open = ImGuiStorage_GetInt(storage, storage_id, (flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DefaultOpen) != 0 ? 1 : 0) != 0;
    }
    if g.LogEnabled && !(flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_NoAutoOpenOnLog) && window.DC.TreeDepth - g.LogDepthRef < g.LogDepthToExpand {
        is_open = true;
    }
    return is_open;
}

// Store ImGuiTreeNodeStackData for just submitted node.
// Currently only supports 32 level deep and we are fine with (1 << Depth) overflowing into a zero, easy to increase.
private {
void TreeNodeStoreStackData(ImGuiTreeNodeFlags flags, f32 x1) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    ImVector_ImGuiTreeNodeStackData_resize(&g.TreeNodeStack, g.TreeNodeStack.Size + 1);
    ImGuiTreeNodeStackData* tree_node_data = &g.TreeNodeStack.Data[g.TreeNodeStack.Size - 1];
    tree_node_data.ID = g.LastItemData.ID;
    tree_node_data.TreeFlags = flags;
    tree_node_data.ItemFlags = g.LastItemData.ItemFlags;
    tree_node_data.NavRect = g.LastItemData.NavRect;
    bool draw_lines = (flags & (ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DrawLinesFull | ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DrawLinesToNodes)) != 0;
    tree_node_data.DrawLinesX1 = draw_lines != 0 ? x1 + g.FontSize * 0.5f + g.Style.FramePadding.x : FLT_MAX;
    tree_node_data.DrawLinesTableColumn = draw_lines && g.CurrentTable ? cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, g.CurrentTable.CurrentColumn) : -1;
    tree_node_data.DrawLinesToNodesY2 = -FLT_MAX;
    window.DC.TreeHasStackDataDepthMask |= cast(ImU32, 1 << window.DC.TreeDepth);
    if (flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DrawLinesToNodes) != 0 {
        window.DC.TreeRecordsClippedNodesY2Mask |= cast(ImU32, 1 << window.DC.TreeDepth);
    }
}
}

bool ImGui_TreeNodeBehavior(ImGuiID id, ImGuiTreeNodeFlags flags, u8* label, u8* label_end) {
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiStyle style = g.Style;
    bool display_frame = (flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_Framed) != 0;
    bool use_frame_padding = display_frame || flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_FramePadding;
    ImVec2 padding = use_frame_padding != 0 ? style.FramePadding : ImVec2{
        style.FramePadding.x, ImMin(window.DC.CurrLineTextBaseOffset, style.FramePadding.y),
    };
    if label_end == null {
        label_end = ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(label, null);
    }
    ImVec2 label_size = ImGui_CalcTextSize(label, label_end, false, -1.0f);
    f32 text_offset_x = g.FontSize + (display_frame != 0 ? padding.x * 3.0f : padding.x * 2.0f);
    f32 text_offset_y = use_frame_padding != 0 ? ImMax(style.FramePadding.y, window.DC.CurrLineTextBaseOffset) : window.DC.CurrLineTextBaseOffset;
    f32 text_width = g.FontSize + label_size.x + padding.x * 2.0f;
    f32 frame_height = label_size.y + padding.y * 2.0f;
    bool span_all_columns = (flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_SpanAllColumns) != 0 && g.CurrentTable != null;
    bool span_all_columns_label = (flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_LabelSpanAllColumns) != 0 && g.CurrentTable != null;
    ImRect frame_bb;
    frame_bb.Min.x = span_all_columns != 0 ? window.ParentWorkRect.Min.x : (flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_SpanFullWidth) != 0 ? window.WorkRect.Min.x : window.DC.CursorPos.x;
    frame_bb.Min.y = window.DC.CursorPos.y + (text_offset_y - padding.y);
    frame_bb.Max.x = span_all_columns != 0 ? window.ParentWorkRect.Max.x : (flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_SpanLabelWidth) != 0 ? window.DC.CursorPos.x + text_width + padding.x : window.WorkRect.Max.x;
    frame_bb.Max.y = window.DC.CursorPos.y + (text_offset_y - padding.y) + frame_height;
    if display_frame != 0 {
        var outer_extend = cast(f32, cast(i32, window.WindowPadding.x * 0.5f));
        frame_bb.Min.x -= outer_extend;
        frame_bb.Max.x += outer_extend;
    }
    ImVec2 text_pos;
    ImVec2_init(&text_pos, window.DC.CursorPos.x + text_offset_x, window.DC.CursorPos.y + text_offset_y);
    ImGui_ItemSize(ImVec2{text_width, frame_height}, padding.y);
    ImRect interact_bb = frame_bb;
    if (flags & (ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_Framed | ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_SpanAvailWidth | ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_SpanFullWidth | ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_SpanLabelWidth | ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_SpanAllColumns)) == 0 {
        interact_bb.Max.x = frame_bb.Min.x + text_width + (label_size.x > 0.0f ? style.ItemSpacing.x * 2.0f : 0.0f);
    }
    ImGuiID storage_id = (g.NextItemData.HasFlags & ImGuiNextItemDataFlags_HasStorageID) != 0 ? g.NextItemData.StorageId : id;
    bool is_open = ImGui_TreeNodeUpdateNextOpen(storage_id, flags);
    bool is_visible;
    if span_all_columns || span_all_columns_label {
        f32 backup_clip_rect_min_x = window.ClipRect.Min.x;
        f32 backup_clip_rect_max_x = window.ClipRect.Max.x;
        window.ClipRect.Min.x = window.ParentWorkRect.Min.x;
        window.ClipRect.Max.x = window.ParentWorkRect.Max.x;
        is_visible = ImGui_ItemAdd(interact_bb, id, null, 0);
        window.ClipRect.Min.x = backup_clip_rect_min_x;
        window.ClipRect.Max.x = backup_clip_rect_max_x;
    } else {
        is_visible = ImGui_ItemAdd(interact_bb, id, null, 0);
    }
    g.LastItemData.StatusFlags |= ImGuiItemStatusFlags_HasDisplayRect;
    g.LastItemData.DisplayRect = frame_bb;
    bool store_tree_node_stack_data = false;
    if (flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DrawLinesMask_) == 0 {
        flags |= g.Style.TreeLinesFlags;
    }
    bool draw_tree_lines = flags & (ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DrawLinesFull | ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DrawLinesToNodes) && frame_bb.Min.y < window.ClipRect.Max.y && g.Style.TreeLinesSize > 0.0f;
    if (flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_NoTreePushOnOpen) == 0 {
        store_tree_node_stack_data = draw_tree_lines;
        if flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_NavLeftJumpsToParent && !g.NavIdIsAlive {
            if g.NavMoveDir == ImGuiDir_Left && g.NavWindow == window && ImGui_NavMoveRequestButNoResultYet() {
                store_tree_node_stack_data = true;
            }
        }
    }
    bool is_leaf = (flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_Leaf) != 0;
    if is_visible == 0 {
        if flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DrawLinesToNodes && window.DC.TreeRecordsClippedNodesY2Mask & cast(u32, 1 << window.DC.TreeDepth - 1) {
            ImGuiTreeNodeStackData* parent_data = &g.TreeNodeStack.Data[g.TreeNodeStack.Size - 1];
            parent_data.DrawLinesToNodesY2 = ImMax(parent_data.DrawLinesToNodesY2, window.DC.CursorPos.y);
            if frame_bb.Min.y >= window.ClipRect.Max.y {
                window.DC.TreeRecordsClippedNodesY2Mask &= cast(ImU32, ~(1 << window.DC.TreeDepth - 1));
            }
        }
        if is_open && store_tree_node_stack_data {
            TreeNodeStoreStackData(flags, text_pos.x - text_offset_x);
        }
        if is_open && !(flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_NoTreePushOnOpen) {
            ImGui_TreePushOverrideID(id);
        }
        ignore *g;
        return is_open;
    }
    if span_all_columns || span_all_columns_label {
        ImGui_TablePushBackgroundChannel();
        g.LastItemData.StatusFlags |= ImGuiItemStatusFlags_HasClipRect;
        g.LastItemData.ClipRect = window.ClipRect;
    }
    ImGuiButtonFlags button_flags = ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_None;
    if flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_AllowOverlap || g.LastItemData.ItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_AllowOverlap {
        button_flags |= ImGuiButtonFlags_AllowOverlap;
    }
    if is_leaf == 0 {
        button_flags |= ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnDragDropHold;
    }
    f32 arrow_hit_x1 = text_pos.x - text_offset_x - style.TouchExtraPadding.x;
    f32 arrow_hit_x2 = text_pos.x - text_offset_x + (g.FontSize + padding.x * 2.0f) + style.TouchExtraPadding.x;
    bool is_mouse_x_over_arrow = g.IO.MousePos.x >= arrow_hit_x1 && g.IO.MousePos.x < arrow_hit_x2;
    bool is_multi_select = (g.LastItemData.ItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_IsMultiSelect) != 0;
    if is_multi_select != 0 {
        flags |= (flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_OpenOnMask_) == 0 ? ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_OpenOnArrow | ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_OpenOnDoubleClick : ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_OpenOnArrow;
    }
    if is_mouse_x_over_arrow != 0 {
        button_flags |= ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnClick;
    } else if (flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_OpenOnDoubleClick) != 0 {
        button_flags |= ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnClickRelease | ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnDoubleClick;
    } else {
        button_flags |= ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnClickRelease;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_NoNavFocus) != 0 {
        button_flags |= ImGuiButtonFlags_NoNavFocus;
    }
    bool selected = (flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_Selected) != 0;
    bool was_selected = selected;
    if is_multi_select != 0 {
        ImGui_MultiSelectItemHeader(id, &selected, &button_flags);
        if is_mouse_x_over_arrow != 0 {
            button_flags = (button_flags | ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnClick) & ~ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnClickRelease;
        }
    } else {
        if window != g.HoveredWindow || !is_mouse_x_over_arrow {
            button_flags |= ImGuiButtonFlags_NoKeyModsAllowed;
        }
    }
    bool hovered;
    bool held;
    bool pressed = ImGui_ButtonBehavior(interact_bb, id, &hovered, &held, button_flags);
    bool toggled = false;
    if is_leaf == 0 {
        if pressed && g.DragDropHoldJustPressedId != id {
            if (flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_OpenOnMask_) == 0 || g.NavActivateId == id && !is_multi_select {
                toggled = true;
            }
            if (flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_OpenOnArrow) != 0 {
                toggled |= is_mouse_x_over_arrow && !g.NavHighlightItemUnderNav;
            }
            if flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_OpenOnDoubleClick && g.IO.MouseClickedCount[0] == 2 {
                toggled = true;
            }
        } else if pressed && g.DragDropHoldJustPressedId == id {
            assert(button_flags & ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnDragDropHold);
            if is_open == 0 {
                toggled = true;
            } else {
                pressed = false;
            }
        }
        if g.NavId == id && g.NavMoveDir == ImGuiDir_Left && is_open {
            toggled = true;
            ImGui_NavClearPreferredPosForAxis(ImGuiAxis_X);
            ImGui_NavMoveRequestCancel();
        }
        if g.NavId == id && g.NavMoveDir == ImGuiDir_Right && !is_open {
            toggled = true;
            ImGui_NavClearPreferredPosForAxis(ImGuiAxis_X);
            ImGui_NavMoveRequestCancel();
        }
        if toggled != 0 {
            is_open = !is_open;
            ImGuiStorage_SetInt(window.DC.StateStorage, storage_id, is_open);
            g.LastItemData.StatusFlags |= ImGuiItemStatusFlags_ToggledOpen;
        }
    }
    if is_multi_select != 0 {
        bool pressed_copy = pressed && !toggled;
        ImGui_MultiSelectItemFooter(id, &selected, &pressed_copy);
        if pressed != 0 {
            ImGui_SetNavID(id, window.DC.NavLayerCurrent, g.CurrentFocusScopeId, interact_bb);
        }
    }
    if selected != was_selected {
        g.LastItemData.StatusFlags |= ImGuiItemStatusFlags_ToggledSelection;
    }
    {
        ImU32 text_col = ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Text);
        ImGuiNavRenderCursorFlags nav_render_cursor_flags = ImGuiNavRenderCursorFlags_Compact;
        if is_multi_select != 0 {
            nav_render_cursor_flags |= ImGuiNavRenderCursorFlags_AlwaysDraw;
        }
        if display_frame != 0 {
            ImU32 bg_col = ImGui_GetColorU32(held && hovered ? ImGuiCol_HeaderActive : hovered != 0 ? ImGuiCol_HeaderHovered : ImGuiCol_Header);
            ImGui_RenderFrame(frame_bb.Min, frame_bb.Max, bg_col, true, style.FrameRounding);
            ImGui_RenderNavCursor(frame_bb, id, nav_render_cursor_flags, -1.0f);
            if span_all_columns && !span_all_columns_label {
                ImGui_TablePopBackgroundChannel();
            }
            if (flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_Bullet) != 0 {
                ImGui_RenderBullet(window.DrawList, ImVec2{
                    text_pos.x - text_offset_x * 0.6f, text_pos.y + g.FontSize * 0.5f,
                }, text_col);
            } else if is_leaf == 0 {
                ImGui_RenderArrow(window.DrawList, ImVec2{text_pos.x - text_offset_x + padding.x, text_pos.y}, text_col, is_open != 0 ? (flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_UpsideDownArrow) != 0 ? ImGuiDir_Up : ImGuiDir_Down : ImGuiDir_Right, 1.0f);
            } else {
                text_pos.x -= text_offset_x - padding.x;
            }
            if (flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_ClipLabelForTrailingButton) != 0 {
                frame_bb.Max.x -= g.FontSize + style.FramePadding.x;
            }
            if g.LogEnabled != 0 {
                ImGui_LogSetNextTextDecoration("###", "###");
            }
        } else {
            if hovered || selected {
                ImU32 bg_col = ImGui_GetColorU32(held && hovered ? ImGuiCol_HeaderActive : hovered != 0 ? ImGuiCol_HeaderHovered : ImGuiCol_Header);
                ImGui_RenderFrame(frame_bb.Min, frame_bb.Max, bg_col, false, 0.0f);
            }
            ImGui_RenderNavCursor(frame_bb, id, nav_render_cursor_flags, 0.0f);
            if span_all_columns && !span_all_columns_label {
                ImGui_TablePopBackgroundChannel();
            }
            if (flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_Bullet) != 0 {
                ImGui_RenderBullet(window.DrawList, ImVec2{
                    text_pos.x - text_offset_x * 0.5f, text_pos.y + g.FontSize * 0.5f,
                }, text_col);
            } else if is_leaf == 0 {
                ImGui_RenderArrow(window.DrawList, ImVec2{
                    text_pos.x - text_offset_x + padding.x, text_pos.y + g.FontSize * 0.15f,
                }, text_col, is_open != 0 ? (flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_UpsideDownArrow) != 0 ? ImGuiDir_Up : ImGuiDir_Down : ImGuiDir_Right, 0.7f);
            }
            if g.LogEnabled != 0 {
                ImGui_LogSetNextTextDecoration(">", null);
            }
        }
        if draw_tree_lines != 0 {
            ImGui_TreeNodeDrawLineToChildNode(ImVec2{
                text_pos.x - text_offset_x + padding.x, text_pos.y + g.FontSize * 0.5f,
            });
        }
        if display_frame != 0 {
            ImGui_RenderTextClipped(text_pos, frame_bb.Max, label, label_end, &label_size, ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f}, null);
        } else {
            ImGui_RenderText(text_pos, label, label_end, false);
        }
        if span_all_columns_label != 0 {
            ImGui_TablePopBackgroundChannel();
        }
    }
    if is_open && store_tree_node_stack_data {
        TreeNodeStoreStackData(flags, text_pos.x - text_offset_x);
    }
    if is_open && !(flags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_NoTreePushOnOpen) {
        ImGui_TreePushOverrideID(id);
    }
    ignore *g;
    return is_open;
}

// Draw horizontal line from our parent node
// This is only called for visible child nodes so we are not too fussy anymore about performances
void ImGui_TreeNodeDrawLineToChildNode(ImVec2 target_pos) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    if window.DC.TreeDepth == 0 || (window.DC.TreeHasStackDataDepthMask & cast(u32, 1 << window.DC.TreeDepth - 1)) == 0 {
        return;
    }
    ImGuiTreeNodeStackData* parent_data = &g.TreeNodeStack.Data[g.TreeNodeStack.Size - 1];
    f32 x1 = ImTrunc(parent_data.DrawLinesX1);
    f32 x2 = ImTrunc(target_pos.x - g.Style.ItemInnerSpacing.x);
    f32 y = ImTrunc(target_pos.y);
    f32 rounding = g.Style.TreeLinesRounding > 0.0f ? ImMin(x2 - x1, g.Style.TreeLinesRounding) : 0.0f;
    parent_data.DrawLinesToNodesY2 = ImMax(parent_data.DrawLinesToNodesY2, y - rounding);
    if x1 >= x2 {
        return;
    }
    if rounding > 0.0f {
        x1 += 0.5f + rounding;
        ImDrawList_PathArcToFast(window.DrawList, ImVec2{x1, y - rounding}, rounding, 6, 3);
        if x1 < x2 {
            ImDrawList_PathLineTo(window.DrawList, ImVec2{x2, y});
        }
        ImDrawList_PathStroke(window.DrawList, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_TreeLines), g.Style.TreeLinesSize, 0);
    } else {
        ImDrawList_AddLineH(window.DrawList, x1, x2, y, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_TreeLines), g.Style.TreeLinesSize);
    }
}

// Draw vertical line of the hierarchy
void ImGui_TreeNodeDrawLineToTreePop(ImGuiTreeNodeStackData* data) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    f32 y1 = ImMax(data.NavRect.Max.y, window.ClipRect.Min.y);
    f32 y2 = data.DrawLinesToNodesY2;
    if (data.TreeFlags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DrawLinesFull) != 0 {
        f32 y2_full = window.DC.CursorPos.y;
        if g.CurrentTable != null {
            y2_full = ImMax(g.CurrentTable.RowPosY2, y2_full);
        }
        y2_full = ImTrunc(y2_full - g.Style.ItemSpacing.y - g.FontSize * 0.5f);
        if y2 + (g.Style.ItemSpacing.y + g.Style.TreeLinesRounding) < y2_full {
            y2 = y2_full;
        }
    }
    y2 = ImMin(y2, window.ClipRect.Max.y);
    if y2 <= y1 {
        return;
    }
    f32 x = ImTrunc(data.DrawLinesX1);
    if data.DrawLinesTableColumn != -1 {
        ImGui_TablePushColumnChannel(data.DrawLinesTableColumn);
    }
    ImDrawList_AddLineV(window.DrawList, x, y1, y2, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_TreeLines), g.Style.TreeLinesSize);
    if data.DrawLinesTableColumn != -1 {
        ImGui_TablePopColumnChannel();
    }
}

void ImGui_TreePush(u8* str_id) {
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    ImGui_Indent(0.0f);
    window.DC.TreeDepth++;
    ImGui_PushID(str_id);
}

void ImGui_TreePush(void* ptr_id) {
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    ImGui_Indent(0.0f);
    window.DC.TreeDepth++;
    ImGui_PushID(ptr_id);
}

void ImGui_TreePushOverrideID(ImGuiID id) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    ImGui_Indent(0.0f);
    window.DC.TreeDepth++;
    ImGui_PushOverrideID(id);
}

void ImGui_TreePop() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    ImGui_Unindent(0.0f);
    window.DC.TreeDepth--;
    var tree_depth_mask = cast(ImU32, 1 << window.DC.TreeDepth);
    if (window.DC.TreeHasStackDataDepthMask & tree_depth_mask) != 0 {
        ImGuiTreeNodeStackData* data = &g.TreeNodeStack.Data[g.TreeNodeStack.Size - 1];
        assert(data.ID == *ImVector_ImGuiID_back(&window.IDStack));
        if (data.TreeFlags & ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_NavLeftJumpsToParent) != 0 {
            if g.NavIdIsAlive && g.NavMoveDir == ImGuiDir_Left && g.NavWindow == window && ImGui_NavMoveRequestButNoResultYet() {
                ImGui_NavMoveRequestResolveWithPastTreeNode(&g.NavMoveResultLocal, data);
            }
        }
        if data.DrawLinesX1 != FLT_MAX && window.DC.CursorPos.y >= window.ClipRect.Min.y {
            ImGui_TreeNodeDrawLineToTreePop(data);
        }
        ImVector_ImGuiTreeNodeStackData_pop_back(&g.TreeNodeStack);
        window.DC.TreeHasStackDataDepthMask &= ~tree_depth_mask;
        window.DC.TreeRecordsClippedNodesY2Mask &= ~tree_depth_mask;
    }
    assert(window.IDStack.Size > 1);
    ImGui_PopID();
}

// Horizontal distance preceding label when using TreeNode() or Bullet()
f32 ImGui_GetTreeNodeToLabelSpacing() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    return g.FontSize + g.Style.FramePadding.x * 2.0f;
}

// Set next TreeNode/CollapsingHeader open state.
void ImGui_SetNextItemOpen(bool is_open, ImGuiCond cond) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if g.CurrentWindow.SkipItems != 0 {
        return;
    }
    g.NextItemData.HasFlags |= ImGuiNextItemDataFlags_HasOpen;
    g.NextItemData.OpenVal = is_open;
    g.NextItemData.OpenCond = cast(ImU8, cond != 0 ? cond : ImGuiCond_Always);
}

// Set next TreeNode/CollapsingHeader storage id.
void ImGui_SetNextItemStorageID(ImGuiID storage_id) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if g.CurrentWindow.SkipItems != 0 {
        return;
    }
    g.NextItemData.HasFlags |= ImGuiNextItemDataFlags_HasStorageID;
    g.NextItemData.StorageId = storage_id;
}

// CollapsingHeader returns true when opened but do not indent nor push into the ID stack (because of the ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_NoTreePushOnOpen flag).
// This is basically the same as calling TreeNodeEx(label, ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_CollapsingHeader). You can remove the _NoTreePushOnOpen flag if you want behavior closer to normal TreeNode().
bool ImGui_CollapsingHeader(u8* label, ImGuiTreeNodeFlags flags) {
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiID id = ImGuiWindow_GetID(window, label, null);
    return ImGui_TreeNodeBehavior(id, flags | ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_CollapsingHeader, label);
}

// p_visible == NULL                        : regular collapsing header
// p_visible != NULL && *p_visible == true  : show a small close button on the corner of the header, clicking the button will set *p_visible = false
// p_visible != NULL && *p_visible == false : do not show the header at all
// Do not mistake this with the Open state of the header itself, which you can adjust with SetNextItemOpen() or ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_DefaultOpen.
bool ImGui_CollapsingHeader(u8* label, bool* p_visible, ImGuiTreeNodeFlags flags) {
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    if p_visible && !*p_visible {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiID id = ImGuiWindow_GetID(window, label, null);
    flags |= ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_CollapsingHeader;
    if p_visible != null {
        flags |= ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_AllowOverlap | cast(ImGuiTreeNodeFlags, ImGuiTreeNodeFlags_ClipLabelForTrailingButton);
    }
    bool is_open = ImGui_TreeNodeBehavior(id, flags, label);
    if p_visible != null {
        ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
        ImGuiLastItemData last_item_backup = g.LastItemData;
        f32 button_size = g.FontSize;
        f32 button_x = ImMax(g.LastItemData.Rect.Min.x, g.LastItemData.Rect.Max.x - g.Style.FramePadding.x - button_size);
        f32 button_y = g.LastItemData.Rect.Min.y + g.Style.FramePadding.y;
        ImGuiID close_button_id = ImGui_GetIDWithSeed("#CLOSE", null, id);
        if ImGui_CloseButton(close_button_id, ImVec2{button_x, button_y}) != 0 {
            *p_visible = false;
        }
        g.LastItemData = last_item_backup;
    }
    return is_open;
}

//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
// [SECTION] Widgets: Selectable
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
// - Selectable()
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Tip: pass a non-visible label (e.g. "##hello") then you can use the space to draw other text or image.
// But you need to make sure the ID is unique, e.g. enclose calls in PushID/PopID or use ##unique_id.
// With this scheme, ImGuiSelectableFlags_SpanAllColumns and ImGuiSelectableFlags_AllowOverlap are also frequently used flags.
// FIXME: Selectable() with (size.x == 0.0f) and (SelectableTextAlign.x > 0.0f) followed by SameLine() is currently not supported.
bool ImGui_Selectable(u8* label, bool selected, ImGuiSelectableFlags flags, ImVec2 size_arg) {
    ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_GetCurrentWindow();
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiStyle style = g.Style;
    ImGuiID id = ImGuiWindow_GetID(window, label, null);
    u8* label_end = ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(label, null);
    ImVec2 label_size = ImGui_CalcTextSize(label, label_end, false, -1.0f);
    ImVec2 size;
    ImVec2_init(&size, size_arg.x != 0.0f ? size_arg.x : label_size.x, size_arg.y != 0.0f ? size_arg.y : label_size.y);
    ImVec2 pos = window.DC.CursorPos;
    pos.y += window.DC.CurrLineTextBaseOffset;
    ImGui_ItemSize(size, 0.0f);
    bool span_all_columns = (flags & ImGuiSelectableFlags_SpanAllColumns) != 0;
    f32 min_x = span_all_columns != 0 ? window.ParentWorkRect.Min.x : pos.x;
    f32 max_x = span_all_columns != 0 ? window.ParentWorkRect.Max.x : window.WorkRect.Max.x;
    if size_arg.x == 0.0f || flags & ImGuiSelectableFlags_SpanAvailWidth {
        size.x = ImMax(label_size.x, max_x - min_x);
    }
    ImRect bb;
    ImRect_init(&bb, min_x, pos.y, min_x + size.x, pos.y + size.y);
    if (flags & ImGuiSelectableFlags_NoPadWithHalfSpacing) == 0 {
        f32 spacing_x = span_all_columns != 0 ? 0.0f : style.ItemSpacing.x;
        f32 spacing_y = style.ItemSpacing.y;
        var spacing_L = cast(f32, cast(i32, spacing_x * 0.5f));
        var spacing_U = cast(f32, cast(i32, spacing_y * 0.5f));
        bb.Min.x -= spacing_L;
        bb.Min.y -= spacing_U;
        bb.Max.x += spacing_x - spacing_L;
        bb.Max.y += spacing_y - spacing_U;
    }
    bool disabled_item = (flags & ImGuiSelectableFlags_Disabled) != 0;
    ImGuiItemFlags extra_item_flags = disabled_item != 0 ? cast(ImGuiItemFlags, ImGuiItemFlags_Disabled) : ImGuiItemFlags_None;
    bool is_visible;
    if span_all_columns != 0 {
        f32 backup_clip_rect_min_x = window.ClipRect.Min.x;
        f32 backup_clip_rect_max_x = window.ClipRect.Max.x;
        window.ClipRect.Min.x = window.ParentWorkRect.Min.x;
        window.ClipRect.Max.x = window.ParentWorkRect.Max.x;
        is_visible = ImGui_ItemAdd(bb, id, null, extra_item_flags);
        window.ClipRect.Min.x = backup_clip_rect_min_x;
        window.ClipRect.Max.x = backup_clip_rect_max_x;
    } else {
        is_visible = ImGui_ItemAdd(bb, id, null, extra_item_flags);
    }
    bool is_multi_select = (g.LastItemData.ItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_IsMultiSelect) != 0;
    if is_visible == 0 {
        if !is_multi_select || !g.BoxSelectState.UnclipMode || !ImRect_Overlaps(&g.BoxSelectState.UnclipRect, bb) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    bool disabled_global = (g.CurrentItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_Disabled) != 0;
    if disabled_item && !disabled_global {
        ImGui_BeginDisabled(true);
    }
    if span_all_columns != 0 {
        if g.CurrentTable != null {
            ImGui_TablePushBackgroundChannel();
        } else if window.DC.CurrentColumns != null {
            ImGui_PushColumnsBackground();
        }
        g.LastItemData.StatusFlags |= ImGuiItemStatusFlags_HasClipRect;
        g.LastItemData.ClipRect = window.ClipRect;
    }
    ImGuiButtonFlags button_flags = 0;
    if (flags & ImGuiSelectableFlags_NoHoldingActiveID) != 0 {
        button_flags |= ImGuiButtonFlags_NoHoldingActiveId;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiSelectableFlags_NoSetKeyOwner) != 0 {
        button_flags |= ImGuiButtonFlags_NoSetKeyOwner;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiSelectableFlags_SelectOnClick) != 0 {
        button_flags |= ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnClick;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiSelectableFlags_SelectOnRelease) != 0 {
        button_flags |= ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnRelease;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiSelectableFlags_AllowDoubleClick) != 0 {
        button_flags |= ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnClickRelease | ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnDoubleClick;
    }
    if flags & ImGuiSelectableFlags_AllowOverlap || g.LastItemData.ItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_AllowOverlap {
        button_flags |= ImGuiButtonFlags_AllowOverlap;
    }
    bool was_selected = selected;
    if is_multi_select != 0 {
        ImGui_MultiSelectItemHeader(id, &selected, &button_flags);
    }
    bool hovered;
    bool held;
    bool pressed = ImGui_ButtonBehavior(bb, id, &hovered, &held, button_flags);
    bool auto_selected = false;
    if is_multi_select != 0 {
        ImGui_MultiSelectItemFooter(id, &selected, &pressed);
    } else {
        if flags & ImGuiSelectableFlags_SelectOnNav && g.NavJustMovedToId != 0 && g.NavJustMovedToFocusScopeId == g.CurrentFocusScopeId {
            if g.NavJustMovedToId == id && (g.NavJustMovedToKeyMods & ImGuiMod_Ctrl) == 0 {
                auto_selected = true;
                pressed = auto_selected;
                selected = pressed;
            }
        }
    }
    if pressed || hovered && flags & ImGuiSelectableFlags_SetNavIdOnHover {
        if !g.NavHighlightItemUnderNav && g.NavWindow == window && g.NavLayer == window.DC.NavLayerCurrent {
            ImGui_SetNavID(id, window.DC.NavLayerCurrent, g.CurrentFocusScopeId, ImGui_WindowRectAbsToRel(window, bb));
            if g.IO.ConfigNavCursorVisibleAuto != 0 {
                g.NavCursorVisible = false;
            }
        }
    }
    if pressed != 0 {
        ImGui_MarkItemEdited(id);
    }
    if selected != was_selected {
        g.LastItemData.StatusFlags |= ImGuiItemStatusFlags_ToggledSelection;
    }
    if g.ActiveId == id && g.ActiveIdIsJustActivated {
        g.ActiveIdWasSelected = was_selected;
        g.ActiveIdWasSoleSelected = was_selected && (!is_multi_select || g.CurrentMultiSelect.IsSoleOrUnknownSelectionSize);
    }
    if is_visible != 0 {
        bool highlighted = hovered || flags & ImGuiSelectableFlags_Highlight;
        if highlighted || selected {
            ImU32 col = ImGui_GetColorU32(held && highlighted ? ImGuiCol_HeaderActive : highlighted != 0 ? ImGuiCol_HeaderHovered : ImGuiCol_Header);
            ImGui_RenderFrame(bb.Min, bb.Max, col, false, style.SelectableRounding);
        }
        if g.NavId == id {
            ImGuiNavRenderCursorFlags nav_render_cursor_flags = ImGuiNavRenderCursorFlags_Compact;
            if is_multi_select != 0 {
                nav_render_cursor_flags |= ImGuiNavRenderCursorFlags_AlwaysDraw;
            }
            ImGui_RenderNavCursor(bb, id, nav_render_cursor_flags, style.SelectableRounding);
        }
    }
    if span_all_columns != 0 {
        if g.CurrentTable != null {
            ImGui_TablePopBackgroundChannel();
        } else if window.DC.CurrentColumns != null {
            ImGui_PopColumnsBackground();
        }
    }
    if is_visible != 0 {
        ImGui_RenderTextClipped(pos, ImVec2{
            ImMin(pos.x + size.x, window.WorkRect.Max.x), pos.y + size.y,
        }, label, label_end, &label_size, style.SelectableTextAlign, &bb);
    }
    when defined(IMGUI_DEBUG_BOXSELECT) {
        if g.BoxSelectState.UnclipMode != 0 {
            ImDrawList_AddText(ImGui_GetForegroundDrawList(cast(ImGuiViewport*, null)), pos, cast(ImU32, 200) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 0, label, label_end);
        }
    }
    if pressed && !auto_selected && window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_Popup && !(flags & ImGuiSelectableFlags_NoAutoClosePopups) && g.LastItemData.ItemFlags & ImGuiItemFlags_AutoClosePopups {
        ImGui_CloseCurrentPopup();
    }
    if disabled_item && !disabled_global {
        ImGui_EndDisabled();
    }
    ignore *g;
    return pressed;
}

// [SECTION] Widgets: Typing-Select support
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
// [Experimental] Currently not exposed in public API.
// Consume character inputs and return search request, if any.
// This would typically only be called on the focused window or location you want to grab inputs for, e.g.
//   if (ImGui::IsWindowFocused(...))
//       if (ImGuiTypingSelectRequest* req = ImGui::GetTypingSelectRequest())
//           focus_idx = ImGui::TypingSelectFindMatch(req, my_items.size(), [](void*, int n) { return my_items[n]->Name; }, &my_items, -1);
// However the code is written in a way where calling it from multiple locations is safe (e.g. to obtain buffer).
ImGuiTypingSelectRequest* ImGui_GetTypingSelectRequest(ImGuiTypingSelectFlags flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiTypingSelectState* data = &g.TypingSelectState;
    ImGuiTypingSelectRequest* out_request = &data.Request;
    f32 TYPING_SELECT_RESET_TIMER = 1.8f;
    i32 TYPING_SELECT_SINGLE_CHAR_COUNT_FOR_LOCK = 4;
    if data.SearchBuffer[0] != 0 {
        bool clear_buffer = false;
        clear_buffer |= g.NavFocusScopeId != data.FocusScope;
        clear_buffer |= data.LastRequestTime + TYPING_SELECT_RESET_TIMER < g.Time;
        clear_buffer |= g.NavAnyRequest;
        clear_buffer |= g.ActiveId != 0 && g.NavActivateId == 0;
        clear_buffer |= ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Escape, true) || ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Enter, true);
        clear_buffer |= ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Backspace, true) && (flags & ImGuiTypingSelectFlags_AllowBackspace) == 0;
        if clear_buffer != 0 {
            ImGuiTypingSelectState_Clear(data);
        }
    }
    i32 buffer_max_len = cast(i32, sizeof(data.SearchBuffer) / sizeof(*data.SearchBuffer)) - 1;
    var buffer_len = cast(i32, strlen(data.SearchBuffer));
    bool select_request = false;
    {
        ImWchar* zz_rf_it_4 = ImVector_ImWchar_begin(&g.IO.InputQueueCharacters);
        ImWchar* zz_rf_end_4 = ImVector_ImWchar_end(&g.IO.InputQueueCharacters);
        for ; zz_rf_it_4 != zz_rf_end_4; zz_rf_it_4++ {
            ImWchar w = *zz_rf_it_4;
            i32 w_len = ImTextCountUtf8BytesFromStr(&w, &w + 1);
            if w < 32 || buffer_len == 0 && ImCharIsBlankW(w) || buffer_len + w_len > buffer_max_len {
                continue;
            }
            u8[5] w_buf;
            ImTextCharToUtf8(w_buf, cast(u32, w));
            if data.SingleCharModeLock && w_len == out_request.SingleCharSize && memcmp(w_buf, data.SearchBuffer, cast(u64, w_len)) == 0 {
                select_request = true;
                continue;
            }
            if data.SingleCharModeLock != 0 {
                ImGuiTypingSelectState_Clear(data);
                buffer_len = 0;
            }
            memcpy(data.SearchBuffer + buffer_len, w_buf, cast(u64, w_len + 1));
            buffer_len += w_len;
            select_request = true;
        }
    }
    ImVector_ImWchar_resize(&g.IO.InputQueueCharacters, 0);
    if flags & ImGuiTypingSelectFlags_AllowBackspace && ImGui_IsKeyPressed(ImGuiKey_Backspace, ImGuiInputFlags_Repeat != 0) {
        var p = cast(u8*, cast(void*, ImTextFindPreviousUtf8Codepoint(data.SearchBuffer, data.SearchBuffer + buffer_len)));
        *p = 0;
        buffer_len = cast(i32, p - data.SearchBuffer);
    }
    if buffer_len == 0 {
        return null;
    }
    if select_request != 0 {
        data.FocusScope = g.NavFocusScopeId;
        data.LastRequestFrame = g.FrameCount;
        data.LastRequestTime = cast(f32, g.Time);
    }
    out_request.Flags = flags;
    out_request.SearchBufferLen = buffer_len;
    out_request.SearchBuffer = data.SearchBuffer;
    out_request.SelectRequest = data.LastRequestFrame == g.FrameCount;
    out_request.SingleCharMode = false;
    out_request.SingleCharSize = 0;
    if (flags & ImGuiTypingSelectFlags_AllowSingleCharMode) != 0 {
        u8* buf_begin = out_request.SearchBuffer;
        u8* buf_end = out_request.SearchBuffer + out_request.SearchBufferLen;
        i32 c0_len = ImTextCountUtf8BytesFromChar(buf_begin, buf_end);
        u8* p = buf_begin + c0_len;
        for ; p < buf_end; p += c0_len {
            if memcmp(buf_begin, p, cast(u64, c0_len)) != 0 {
                break;
            }
        }
        i32 single_char_count = p == buf_end ? out_request.SearchBufferLen / c0_len : 0;
        out_request.SingleCharMode = single_char_count > 0 || data.SingleCharModeLock;
        out_request.SingleCharSize = cast(ImS8, c0_len);
        data.SingleCharModeLock |= single_char_count >= TYPING_SELECT_SINGLE_CHAR_COUNT_FOR_LOCK;
    }
    return out_request;
}

private {
i32 ImStrimatchlen(u8* s1, u8* s1_end, u8* s2) {
    i32 match_len = 0;
    while s1 < s1_end && ImToUpper(*s1++) == ImToUpper(*s2++) {
        match_len++;
    }
    return match_len;
}
}

// Default handler for finding a result for typing-select. You may implement your own.
// You might want to display a tooltip to visualize the current request SearchBuffer
// When SingleCharMode is set:
// - it is better to NOT display a tooltip of other on-screen display indicator.
// - the index of the currently focused item is required.
//   if your SetNextItemSelectionUserData() values are indices, you can obtain it from ImGuiMultiSelectIO::NavIdItem, otherwise from g.NavLastValidSelectionUserData.
i32 ImGui_TypingSelectFindMatch(ImGuiTypingSelectRequest* req, i32 items_count, fn(void*, i32): u8* get_item_name_func, void* user_data, i32 nav_item_idx) {
    if req == null || req.SelectRequest == false {
        return -1;
    }
    i32 idx = -1;
    if req.SingleCharMode && req.Flags & ImGuiTypingSelectFlags_AllowSingleCharMode {
        idx = ImGui_TypingSelectFindNextSingleCharMatch(req, items_count, get_item_name_func, user_data, nav_item_idx);
    } else {
        idx = ImGui_TypingSelectFindBestLeadingMatch(req, items_count, get_item_name_func, user_data);
    }
    if idx != -1 {
        ImGui_SetNavCursorVisibleAfterMove();
    }
    return idx;
}

// Special handling when a single character is repeated: perform search on a single letter and goes to next.
i32 ImGui_TypingSelectFindNextSingleCharMatch(ImGuiTypingSelectRequest* req, i32 items_count, fn(void*, i32): u8* get_item_name_func, void* user_data, i32 nav_item_idx) {
    i32 first_match_idx = -1;
    bool return_next_match = false;
    for i32 idx = 0; idx < items_count; idx++ {
        u8* item_name = get_item_name_func(user_data, idx);
        if ImStrimatchlen(req.SearchBuffer, req.SearchBuffer + req.SingleCharSize, item_name) < req.SingleCharSize {
            continue;
        }
        if return_next_match != 0 {
            return idx;
        }
        if first_match_idx == -1 && nav_item_idx == -1 {
            return idx;
        }
        if first_match_idx == -1 {
            first_match_idx = idx;
        }
        if nav_item_idx == idx {
            return_next_match = true;
        }
    }
    return first_match_idx;
}

i32 ImGui_TypingSelectFindBestLeadingMatch(ImGuiTypingSelectRequest* req, i32 items_count, fn(void*, i32): u8* get_item_name_func, void* user_data) {
    i32 longest_match_idx = -1;
    i32 longest_match_len = 0;
    for i32 idx = 0; idx < items_count; idx++ {
        u8* item_name = get_item_name_func(user_data, idx);
        i32 match_len = ImStrimatchlen(req.SearchBuffer, req.SearchBuffer + req.SearchBufferLen, item_name);
        if match_len <= longest_match_len {
            continue;
        }
        longest_match_idx = idx;
        longest_match_len = match_len;
        if match_len == req.SearchBufferLen {
            break;
        }
    }
    return longest_match_idx;
}

// Call on the initial click.
private {
void BoxSelectPreStartDrag(ImGuiID id, ImGuiSelectionUserData clicked_item) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiBoxSelectState* bs = &g.BoxSelectState;
    bs.ID = id;
    bs.IsStarting = true;
    bs.IsStartedFromVoid = clicked_item == cast(ImGuiSelectionUserData, -1);
    bs.IsStartedSetNavIdOnce = bs.IsStartedFromVoid;
    bs.KeyMods = g.IO.KeyMods;
    bs.EndPosRel = ImGui_WindowPosAbsToRel(g.CurrentWindow, g.IO.MousePos);
    bs.StartPosRel = bs.EndPosRel;
    bs.ScrollAccum = ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f};
}

void BoxSelectActivateDrag(ImGuiBoxSelectState* bs, ImGuiWindow* window) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    while true {
        if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventSelection) != 0 {
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    bs.IsActive = true;
    bs.Window = window;
    bs.IsStarting = false;
    ImGui_SetActiveID(bs.ID, window);
    ImGui_SetActiveIdUsingAllKeyboardKeys();
    if bs.IsStartedFromVoid && (bs.KeyMods & (ImGuiMod_Ctrl | ImGuiMod_Shift)) == 0 {
        bs.RequestClear = true;
    }
}

void BoxSelectDeactivateDrag(ImGuiBoxSelectState* bs) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    bs.IsStarting = false;
    bs.IsActive = bs.IsStarting;
    if g.ActiveId == bs.ID {
        while true {
            if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventSelection) != 0 {
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
        ImGui_ClearActiveID();
    }
    bs.ID = 0;
}

void BoxSelectScrollWithMouseDrag(ImGuiBoxSelectState* bs, ImGuiWindow* window, ImRect inner_r) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(bs.Window == window);
    for i32 n = 0; n < 2; n++ {
        f32 mouse_pos = cast(f32*, &g.IO.MousePos)[n];
        f32 dist = mouse_pos > cast(f32*, &inner_r.Max)[n] ? mouse_pos - cast(f32*, &inner_r.Max)[n] : mouse_pos < cast(f32*, &inner_r.Min)[n] ? mouse_pos - cast(f32*, &inner_r.Min)[n] : 0.0f;
        f32 scroll_curr = cast(f32*, &window.Scroll)[n];
        if dist == 0.0f || dist < 0.0f && scroll_curr < 0.0f || dist > 0.0f && scroll_curr >= cast(f32*, &window.ScrollMax)[n] {
            continue;
        }
        f32 speed_multiplier = ImLinearRemapClamp(g.FontSize, g.FontSize * 5.0f, 1.0f, 4.0f, ImAbs(dist));
        f32 scroll_step = g.FontSize * 35.0f * speed_multiplier * ImSign(dist) * g.IO.DeltaTime;
        cast(f32*, &bs.ScrollAccum)[n] += scroll_step;
        f32 scroll_step_i = ImFloor(cast(f32*, &bs.ScrollAccum)[n]);
        if scroll_step_i == 0.0f {
            continue;
        }
        if n == 0 {
            ImGui_SetScrollX(window, scroll_curr + scroll_step_i);
        } else {
            ImGui_SetScrollY(window, scroll_curr + scroll_step_i);
        }
        cast(f32*, &bs.ScrollAccum)[n] -= scroll_step_i;
    }
}
}

bool ImGui_BeginBoxSelect(ImRect scope_rect, ImGuiWindow* window, ImGuiID box_select_id, ImGuiMultiSelectFlags ms_flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiBoxSelectState* bs = &g.BoxSelectState;
    ImGui_KeepAliveID(box_select_id);
    if bs.ID != box_select_id {
        return false;
    }
    bs.UnclipMode = false;
    bs.RequestClear = false;
    if bs.IsStarting && ImGui_IsMouseDragPastThreshold(0, -1.0f) {
        BoxSelectActivateDrag(bs, window);
    } else if (bs.IsStarting || bs.IsActive) && g.IO.MouseDown[0] == false {
        BoxSelectDeactivateDrag(bs);
    }
    if bs.IsActive == 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImVec2 start_pos_abs = ImGui_WindowPosRelToAbs(window, bs.StartPosRel);
    ImVec2 prev_end_pos_abs = ImGui_WindowPosRelToAbs(window, bs.EndPosRel);
    ImVec2 curr_end_pos_abs = g.IO.MousePos;
    if (ms_flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_ScopeWindow) != 0 {
        curr_end_pos_abs = ImClamp(curr_end_pos_abs, scope_rect.Min, scope_rect.Max);
    }
    bs.BoxSelectRectPrev.Min = ImMin(start_pos_abs, prev_end_pos_abs);
    bs.BoxSelectRectPrev.Max = ImMax(start_pos_abs, prev_end_pos_abs);
    bs.BoxSelectRectCurr.Min = ImMin(start_pos_abs, curr_end_pos_abs);
    bs.BoxSelectRectCurr.Max = ImMax(start_pos_abs, curr_end_pos_abs);
    if (ms_flags & (ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_BoxSelect1d | ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_BoxSelect2d)) != 0 {
        bs.UnclipRects[1] = ImRect{ImVec2{FLT_MAX, FLT_MAX}, ImVec2{-FLT_MAX, -FLT_MAX}};
        bs.UnclipRects[0] = bs.UnclipRects[1];
        for i32 side = 0; side < 2; side++ {
            ImVec2 d_min = side == 0 ? ImMin(bs.BoxSelectRectCurr.Min, bs.BoxSelectRectPrev.Min) : ImMin(bs.BoxSelectRectCurr.Max, bs.BoxSelectRectPrev.Max);
            ImVec2 d_max = side == 0 ? ImMax(bs.BoxSelectRectCurr.Min, bs.BoxSelectRectPrev.Min) : ImMax(bs.BoxSelectRectCurr.Max, bs.BoxSelectRectPrev.Max);
            if d_min.x != d_max.x {
                ImRect_AddX(&bs.UnclipRects[0], d_min.x);
                ImRect_AddX(&bs.UnclipRects[0], d_max.x);
            }
            if d_min.y != d_max.y {
                ImRect_AddY(&bs.UnclipRects[1], d_min.y);
                ImRect_AddY(&bs.UnclipRects[1], d_max.y);
            }
        }
        ImRect box_select_intersection = bs.BoxSelectRectPrev;
        ImRect_Add(&box_select_intersection, bs.BoxSelectRectCurr);
        if (ms_flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_BoxSelect2d) != 0 {
            if bs.BoxSelectRectPrev.Min.x != bs.BoxSelectRectCurr.Min.x || bs.BoxSelectRectPrev.Max.x != bs.BoxSelectRectCurr.Max.x {
                ImRect_AddY(&bs.UnclipRects[0], box_select_intersection.Min.y);
                ImRect_AddY(&bs.UnclipRects[0], box_select_intersection.Max.y);
            }
        }
        if (ms_flags & (ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_BoxSelect1d | ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_BoxSelect2d)) != 0 {
            if bs.BoxSelectRectPrev.Min.y != bs.BoxSelectRectCurr.Min.y || bs.BoxSelectRectPrev.Max.y != bs.BoxSelectRectCurr.Max.y {
                ImRect_AddX(&bs.UnclipRects[1], box_select_intersection.Min.x);
                ImRect_AddX(&bs.UnclipRects[1], box_select_intersection.Max.x);
            }
        }
        bs.UnclipRect = bs.UnclipRects[0];
        ImRect_Add(&bs.UnclipRect, bs.UnclipRects[1]);
        if !ImRect_IsInverted(&bs.UnclipRect) && (!ImRect_Contains(&window.ClipRect, bs.UnclipRect.Min) || !ImRect_Contains(&window.ClipRect, bs.UnclipRect.Max)) {
            bs.UnclipMode = true;
        }
        if bs.UnclipMode && g.CurrentTable != null {
            ImGui_TableApplyExternalUnclipRect(g.CurrentTable, &bs.UnclipRect);
        }
    }
    return true;
}

void ImGui_EndBoxSelect(ImRect scope_rect, ImGuiMultiSelectFlags ms_flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    ImGuiBoxSelectState* bs = &g.BoxSelectState;
    assert(cast(i64, bs.IsActive));
    bs.UnclipMode = false;
    bs.EndPosRel = ImGui_WindowPosAbsToRel(window, ImClamp(g.IO.MousePos, scope_rect.Min, scope_rect.Max));
    ImRect box_select_r = bs.BoxSelectRectCurr;
    ImRect_ClipWith(&box_select_r, scope_rect);
    ImGuiWindow* draw_window = ImGui_FindFrontMostVisibleChildWindow(window);
    ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(draw_window.DrawList, box_select_r.Min, box_select_r.Max, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_SeparatorHovered, 0.3f), 0.0f, 0);
    ImDrawList_AddRect(draw_window.DrawList, box_select_r.Min, box_select_r.Max, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_NavCursor), 0.0f, 1.0f, 0);
    bool enable_scroll = ms_flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_ScopeWindow && (ms_flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_BoxSelectNoScroll) == 0;
    if enable_scroll != 0 {
        ImRect scroll_r = scope_rect;
        ImRect_Expand(&scroll_r, -g.FontSize);
        if ImRect_Contains(&scroll_r, g.IO.MousePos) == 0 {
            BoxSelectScrollWithMouseDrag(bs, window, scroll_r);
        }
    }
}

// Return ImGuiMultiSelectIO structure.
// Lifetime: don't hold on ImGuiMultiSelectIO* pointers over multiple frames or past any subsequent call to BeginMultiSelect() or EndMultiSelect().
// Passing 'selection_size' and 'items_count' parameters is currently optional.
// - 'selection_size' is useful to disable some shortcut routing: e.g. ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_ClearOnEscape won't claim Escape key when selection_size 0,
//    allowing a first press to clear selection THEN the second press to leave child window and return to parent.
// - 'items_count' is stored in ImGuiMultiSelectIO which makes it a convenient way to pass the information to your ApplyRequest() handler (but you may pass it differently).
// - If they are costly for you to compute (e.g. external intrusive selection without maintaining size), you may avoid them and pass -1.
//   - If you can easily tell if your selection is empty or not, you may pass 0/1, or you may enable ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_ClearOnEscape flag dynamically.
ImGuiMultiSelectIO* ImGui_BeginMultiSelect(ImGuiMultiSelectFlags flags, i32 selection_size, i32 items_count) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    if ++g.MultiSelectTempDataStacked > g.MultiSelectTempData.Size {
        ImVector_ImGuiMultiSelectTempData_resize(&g.MultiSelectTempData, g.MultiSelectTempDataStacked, __cxx_make_ImGuiMultiSelectTempData());
    }
    ImGuiMultiSelectTempData* ms = &g.MultiSelectTempData.Data[g.MultiSelectTempDataStacked - 1];
    g.CurrentMultiSelect = ms;
    if (flags & (ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_ScopeWindow | ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_ScopeRect)) == 0 {
        flags |= ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_ScopeWindow;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_SingleSelect) != 0 {
        flags &= ~(ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_BoxSelect2d | ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_BoxSelect1d);
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_BoxSelect2d) != 0 {
        flags &= ~ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_BoxSelect1d;
    }
    {
        ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
        if table != null {
            if table.IsLayoutLocked == 0 {
                ImGui_TableUpdateLayout(table);
            } else if table.CurrentColumn != -1 {
                ImGui_TableEndCell(table);
            }
        }
    }
    ImGuiID id = *ImVector_ImGuiID_back(&window.IDStack);
    ImGuiMultiSelectTempData_Clear(ms);
    ms.FocusScopeId = id;
    ms.Flags = flags;
    ms.BackupCursorMaxPos = window.DC.CursorMaxPos;
    ms.ScopeRectMin = window.DC.CursorPos;
    if (flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_ScopeRect) != 0 {
        window.DC.CursorMaxPos = ms.ScopeRectMin;
    }
    ImGui_PushFocusScope(ms.FocusScopeId);
    ms.IsFocused = ImGui_IsInNavFocusRoute(g.CurrentFocusScopeId);
    if (flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_ScopeWindow) != 0 {
        window.DC.NavLayersActiveMask |= cast(i16, 1 << ImGuiNavLayer_Main);
    }
    ms.KeyMods = g.NavJustMovedToId != 0 ? g.NavJustMovedToIsTabbing != 0 ? 0 : g.NavJustMovedToKeyMods : g.IO.KeyMods;
    if (flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_NoRangeSelect) != 0 {
        ms.KeyMods &= ~ImGuiMod_Shift;
    }
    ImGuiMultiSelectState* storage = ImPool_ImGuiMultiSelectState_GetOrAddByKey(&g.MultiSelectStorage, id);
    storage.ID = id;
    storage.LastFrameActive = g.FrameCount;
    storage.LastSelectionSize = selection_size;
    storage.Window = window;
    ms.Storage = storage;
    ImVector_ImGuiSelectionRequest_resize(&ms.IO.Requests, 0);
    ms.IO.RangeSrcItem = storage.RangeSrcItem;
    ms.IO.NavIdItem = storage.NavIdItem;
    ms.IO.NavIdSelected = storage.NavIdSelected == 1 ? true : false;
    ms.IO.ItemsCount = items_count;
    bool request_clear = false;
    bool request_select_all = false;
    if g.NavJustMovedToId != 0 && g.NavJustMovedToFocusScopeId == ms.FocusScopeId && g.NavJustMovedToHasSelectionData {
        if (ms.KeyMods & ImGuiMod_Shift) != 0 {
            ms.IsKeyboardSetRange = true;
        }
        if ms.IsKeyboardSetRange != 0 {
            assert(storage.RangeSrcItem != cast(ImGuiSelectionUserData, -1));
        }
        if (ms.KeyMods & (ImGuiMod_Ctrl | ImGuiMod_Shift)) == 0 && (flags & (ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_NoAutoClear | ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_NoAutoSelect)) == 0 {
            request_clear = true;
        }
    } else if g.NavJustMovedFromFocusScopeId == ms.FocusScopeId {
        if (ms.KeyMods & (ImGuiMod_Ctrl | ImGuiMod_Shift)) == 0 && (flags & (ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_NoAutoClear | ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_NoAutoSelect)) == 0 {
            request_clear = true;
        }
    }
    ImGuiBoxSelectState* bs = &g.BoxSelectState;
    if (flags & (ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_BoxSelect1d | ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_BoxSelect2d)) != 0 {
        ms.BoxSelectId = ImGui_GetID("##BoxSelect");
        if ImGui_BeginBoxSelect(CalcScopeRect(ms, window), window, ms.BoxSelectId, flags) != 0 {
            request_clear |= bs.RequestClear;
        }
    }
    if ms.IsFocused != 0 {
        if (flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_ClearOnEscape) != 0 {
            if selection_size != 0 || bs.IsActive {
                if ImGui_Shortcut(ImGuiKey_Escape, ImGuiInputFlags_None, bs.IsActive != 0 ? bs.ID : 0) != 0 {
                    request_clear = true;
                    if bs.IsActive != 0 {
                        BoxSelectDeactivateDrag(bs);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if !(flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_SingleSelect) && !(flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_NoSelectAll) {
            if ImGui_Shortcut(ImGuiMod_Ctrl | ImGuiKey_A, 0) != 0 {
                request_select_all = true;
            }
        }
    }
    if request_clear || request_select_all {
        ImGui_MultiSelectAddSetAll(ms, request_select_all);
        if request_select_all == 0 {
            storage.LastSelectionSize = 0;
        }
    }
    ms.LoopRequestSetAll = cast(ImS8, request_select_all != 0 ? 1 : request_clear != 0 ? 0 : -1);
    ms.IsSoleOrUnknownSelectionSize = storage.LastSelectionSize == 1 || storage.LastSelectionSize == -1;
    if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventSelection) != 0 {
        DebugLogMultiSelectRequests("BeginMultiSelect", &ms.IO);
    }
    return &ms.IO;
}

// Return updated ImGuiMultiSelectIO structure.
// Lifetime: don't hold on ImGuiMultiSelectIO* pointers over multiple frames or past any subsequent call to BeginMultiSelect() or EndMultiSelect().
ImGuiMultiSelectIO* ImGui_EndMultiSelect() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiMultiSelectTempData* ms = g.CurrentMultiSelect;
    ImGuiMultiSelectState* storage = ms.Storage;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    while true {
        if ms.FocusScopeId == g.CurrentFocusScopeId == 0 {
            if ImGui_ErrorLog("EndMultiSelect() FocusScope mismatch!") != 0 {
                assert(ms.FocusScopeId == g.CurrentFocusScopeId && "EndMultiSelect() FocusScope mismatch!");
            }
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    assert(g.CurrentMultiSelect != null && storage.Window == g.CurrentWindow);
    assert(g.MultiSelectTempDataStacked > 0 && &g.MultiSelectTempData.Data[g.MultiSelectTempDataStacked - 1] == g.CurrentMultiSelect);
    ImRect scope_rect = CalcScopeRect(ms, window);
    if ms.IsFocused != 0 {
        if ms.IO.RangeSrcReset || ms.RangeSrcPassedBy == false && ms.IO.RangeSrcItem != cast(ImGuiSelectionUserData, -1) {
            while true {
                if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventSelection) != 0 {
                }
                if !(0 != 0) { break; }
            }
            storage.RangeSrcItem = cast(ImGuiSelectionUserData, -1);
        }
        if ms.NavIdPassedBy == false && storage.NavIdItem != cast(ImGuiSelectionUserData, -1) {
            while true {
                if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventSelection) != 0 {
                }
                if !(0 != 0) { break; }
            }
            storage.NavIdItem = cast(ImGuiSelectionUserData, -1);
            storage.NavIdSelected = cast(ImS8, -1);
        }
        if ms.Flags & (ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_BoxSelect1d | ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_BoxSelect2d) && ImGui_GetBoxSelectState(ms.BoxSelectId) {
            ImGui_EndBoxSelect(scope_rect, ms.Flags);
        }
    }
    if ms.IsEndIO == false {
        ImVector_ImGuiSelectionRequest_resize(&ms.IO.Requests, 0);
    }
    bool scope_hovered = ImRect_Contains(&window.InnerRect, g.IO.MousePos) && ImGui_IsWindowHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_ChildWindows);
    if scope_hovered && ms.Flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_ScopeRect {
        scope_hovered &= ImRect_Contains(&scope_rect, g.IO.MousePos);
    }
    if scope_hovered && g.HoveredId == 0 && g.ActiveId == 0 {
        if (ms.Flags & (ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_BoxSelect1d | ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_BoxSelect2d)) != 0 {
            if !g.BoxSelectState.IsActive && !g.BoxSelectState.IsStarting && g.IO.MouseClickedCount[0] == 1 {
                BoxSelectPreStartDrag(ms.BoxSelectId, cast(ImGuiSelectionUserData, -1));
                ImGui_FocusWindow(window, ImGuiFocusRequestFlags_UnlessBelowModal);
                ImGui_SetHoveredID(ms.BoxSelectId);
                if (ms.Flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_ScopeRect) != 0 {
                    ImGui_SetNavID(0, ImGuiNavLayer_Main, ms.FocusScopeId, ImRect{g.IO.MousePos, g.IO.MousePos});
                }
            }
        }
        if (ms.Flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_ClearOnClickVoid) != 0 {
            if ImGui_IsMouseReleased(0) && ImGui_IsMouseDragPastThreshold(0, -1.0f) == false && g.IO.KeyMods == ImGuiMod_None {
                ImGui_MultiSelectAddSetAll(ms, false);
            }
        }
    }
    if (ms.Flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_NavWrapX) != 0 {
        assert(ms.Flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_ScopeWindow);
        ImGui_NavMoveRequestTryWrapping(ImGui_GetCurrentWindow(), ImGuiNavMoveFlags_WrapX);
    }
    {
        ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
        if table != null {
            if table.IsInsideRow != 0 {
                ImGui_TableEndRow(table);
            }
        }
    }
    window.DC.CursorMaxPos = ImMax(ms.BackupCursorMaxPos, window.DC.CursorMaxPos);
    ImGui_PopFocusScope();
    if (g.DebugLogFlags & ImGuiDebugLogFlags_EventSelection) != 0 {
        DebugLogMultiSelectRequests("EndMultiSelect", &ms.IO);
    }
    ms.FocusScopeId = 0;
    ms.Flags = ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_None;
    g.CurrentMultiSelect = --g.MultiSelectTempDataStacked > 0 ? &g.MultiSelectTempData.Data[g.MultiSelectTempDataStacked - 1] : null;
    return &ms.IO;
}

void ImGui_SetNextItemSelectionUserData(ImGuiSelectionUserData selection_user_data) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    g.NextItemData.SelectionUserData = selection_user_data;
    g.NextItemData.FocusScopeId = g.CurrentFocusScopeId;
    {
        ImGuiMultiSelectTempData* ms = g.CurrentMultiSelect;
        if ms != null {
            g.NextItemData.ItemFlagsSet |= ImGuiItemFlags_HasSelectionUserData | ImGuiItemFlags_IsMultiSelect;
            if ms.IO.RangeSrcItem == selection_user_data {
                ms.RangeSrcPassedBy = true;
            }
        } else {
            g.NextItemData.ItemFlagsSet |= ImGuiItemFlags_HasSelectionUserData;
        }
    }
}

// In charge of:
// - Applying SetAll for submitted items.
// - Applying SetRange for submitted items and record end points.
// - Altering button behavior flags to facilitate use with drag and drop.
void ImGui_MultiSelectItemHeader(ImGuiID id, bool* p_selected, ImGuiButtonFlags* p_button_flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiMultiSelectTempData* ms = g.CurrentMultiSelect;
    bool selected = *p_selected;
    if ms.IsFocused != 0 {
        ImGuiMultiSelectState* storage = ms.Storage;
        ImGuiSelectionUserData item_data = g.NextItemData.SelectionUserData;
        assert(g.NextItemData.FocusScopeId == g.CurrentFocusScopeId && "Forgot to call SetNextItemSelectionUserData() prior to item, required in BeginMultiSelect()/EndMultiSelect() scope");
        if ms.LoopRequestSetAll != -1 {
            selected = ms.LoopRequestSetAll == 1;
        }
        if ms.IsKeyboardSetRange != 0 {
            assert(id != 0 && (ms.KeyMods & ImGuiMod_Shift) != 0);
            bool is_range_dst = ms.RangeDstPassedBy == false && g.NavJustMovedToId == id;
            if is_range_dst != 0 {
                ms.RangeDstPassedBy = true;
            }
            if is_range_dst && storage.RangeSrcItem == cast(ImGuiSelectionUserData, -1) {
                storage.RangeSrcItem = item_data;
                storage.RangeSelected = cast(ImS8, selected != 0 ? 1 : 0);
            }
            bool is_range_src = storage.RangeSrcItem == item_data;
            if is_range_src || is_range_dst || ms.RangeSrcPassedBy != ms.RangeDstPassedBy {
                assert(storage.RangeSrcItem != cast(ImGuiSelectionUserData, -1) && storage.RangeSelected != -1);
                selected = storage.RangeSelected != 0;
            } else if (ms.KeyMods & ImGuiMod_Ctrl) == 0 && (ms.Flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_NoAutoClear) == 0 {
                selected = false;
            }
        }
        *p_selected = selected;
    }
    if p_button_flags != null {
        ImGuiButtonFlags button_flags = *p_button_flags;
        button_flags |= ImGuiButtonFlags_NoHoveredOnFocus;
        button_flags &= ~(ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnClick | ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnClickRelease);
        if (ms.Flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_SelectOnClickAlways) != 0 {
            button_flags |= ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnClick;
        } else if (ms.Flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_SelectOnClickRelease) != 0 {
            button_flags |= ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnClickRelease;
        } else {
            button_flags |= !selected || g.ActiveId == id && g.ActiveIdHasBeenPressedBefore ? ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnClick : ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnClickRelease;
        }
        *p_button_flags = button_flags;
    }
}

// In charge of:
// - Auto-select on navigation.
// - Box-select toggle handling.
// - Right-click handling.
// - Altering selection based on Ctrl/Shift modifiers, both for keyboard and mouse.
// - Record current selection state for RangeSrc
// This is all rather complex, best to run and refer to "widgets_multiselect_xxx" tests in imgui_test_suite.
void ImGui_MultiSelectItemFooter(ImGuiID id, bool* p_selected, bool* p_pressed, ImGuiMultiSelectFlags extra_flags) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    bool selected = *p_selected;
    bool pressed = *p_pressed;
    ImGuiMultiSelectTempData* ms = g.CurrentMultiSelect;
    ImGuiMultiSelectState* storage = ms.Storage;
    if pressed != 0 {
        ms.IsFocused = true;
    }
    bool hovered = false;
    if (g.LastItemData.StatusFlags & ImGuiItemStatusFlags_HoveredRect) != 0 {
        hovered = ImGui_IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenBlockedByPopup);
    }
    if !ms.IsFocused && !hovered {
        return;
    }
    ImGuiSelectionUserData item_data = g.NextItemData.SelectionUserData;
    ImGuiMultiSelectFlags flags = ms.Flags | extra_flags;
    bool is_singleselect = (flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_SingleSelect) != 0;
    bool is_ctrl = (ms.KeyMods & ImGuiMod_Ctrl) != 0;
    bool is_shift = (ms.KeyMods & ImGuiMod_Shift) != 0;
    bool apply_to_range_src = false;
    if g.NavId == id && storage.RangeSrcItem == cast(ImGuiSelectionUserData, -1) {
        apply_to_range_src = true;
    }
    if ms.IsEndIO == false {
        ImVector_ImGuiSelectionRequest_resize(&ms.IO.Requests, 0);
        ms.IsEndIO = true;
    }
    if g.NavJustMovedToId == id {
        if (flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_NoAutoSelect) == 0 {
            if is_ctrl && is_shift {
                pressed = true;
            } else if is_ctrl == 0 {
                pressed = true;
                selected = pressed;
            }
        } else {
            if is_shift != 0 {
                pressed = true;
            } else if is_ctrl == 0 {
                apply_to_range_src = true;
            }
        }
    }
    if apply_to_range_src != 0 {
        storage.RangeSrcItem = item_data;
        storage.RangeSelected = selected;
    }
    if ms.BoxSelectId != 0 {
        ImGuiBoxSelectState* bs = ImGui_GetBoxSelectState(ms.BoxSelectId);
        if bs != null {
            ImRect item_rect = g.LastItemData.Rect;
            if window.DC.NavIsScrollPushableX == 0 {
                ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
                if table != null {
                    if table.CurrentColumn != -1 {
                        ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[table.CurrentColumn];
                        f32 clip_min_x = (g.LastItemData.ItemFlags & ImGuiItemStatusFlags_HasClipRect) != 0 ? g.LastItemData.ClipRect.Min.x : window.ClipRect.Min.x;
                        f32 clip_max_x = (g.LastItemData.ItemFlags & ImGuiItemStatusFlags_HasClipRect) != 0 ? g.LastItemData.ClipRect.Max.x : window.ClipRect.Max.x;
                        if clip_min_x != clip_max_x {
                            item_rect.Min.x = ImMax(item_rect.Min.x, ImMin(column.MinX, clip_min_x));
                            item_rect.Max.x = ImMin(item_rect.Max.x, ImMax(column.MaxX, clip_max_x));
                        } else {
                            item_rect.Min.x = ImMax(item_rect.Min.x, column.MinX);
                            item_rect.Max.x = ImMin(item_rect.Max.x, column.MaxX);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            bool rect_overlap_curr = ImRect_Overlaps(&bs.BoxSelectRectCurr, item_rect);
            bool rect_overlap_prev = ImRect_Overlaps(&bs.BoxSelectRectPrev, item_rect);
            if rect_overlap_curr && !rect_overlap_prev && !selected || rect_overlap_prev && !rect_overlap_curr {
                if storage.LastSelectionSize <= 0 && bs.IsStartedSetNavIdOnce {
                    pressed = true;
                    bs.IsStartedSetNavIdOnce = false;
                } else {
                    selected = !selected;
                    ImGui_MultiSelectAddSetRange(ms, selected, 1, item_data, item_data);
                    ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(ImGui_GetForegroundDrawList(cast(ImGuiViewport*, null)), g.LastItemData.Rect.Min, g.LastItemData.Rect.Max, selected != 0 ? cast(ImU32, 200) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 0 : cast(ImU32, 200) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 255) << 0, 0.0f, 0);
                }
                storage.LastSelectionSize = ImMax(storage.LastSelectionSize + 1, 1);
            }
        }
    }
    if hovered && ImGui_IsMouseClicked(1, false) && (flags & (ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_NoAutoSelect | ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_NoSelectOnRightClick)) == 0 {
        if g.ActiveId != 0 && g.ActiveId != id {
            ImGui_ClearActiveID();
        }
        ImGui_SetFocusID(id, window);
        if !pressed && !selected {
            pressed = true;
            is_shift = false;
            is_ctrl = is_shift;
        }
    }
    bool enter_pressed = pressed && g.NavActivateId == id && g.NavActivateFlags & ImGuiActivateFlags_PreferInput;
    if pressed && (!enter_pressed || !selected) {
        ImGuiInputSource input_source = g.NavJustMovedToId == id || g.NavActivateId == id ? g.NavInputSource : ImGuiInputSource_Mouse;
        if (flags & (ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_BoxSelect1d | ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_BoxSelect2d)) != 0 {
            if !g.BoxSelectState.IsActive && !g.BoxSelectState.IsStarting && input_source == ImGuiInputSource_Mouse && g.IO.MouseClickedCount[0] == 1 {
                BoxSelectPreStartDrag(ms.BoxSelectId, item_data);
            }
        }
        if (flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_NoAutoClear) == 0 {
            bool request_clear = false;
            if is_singleselect != 0 {
                request_clear = true;
            } else if (input_source == ImGuiInputSource_Mouse || g.NavActivateId == id) && !is_ctrl {
                request_clear = (flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_NoAutoClearOnReselect) != 0 ? !selected : true;
            } else if (input_source == ImGuiInputSource_Keyboard || input_source == ImGuiInputSource_Gamepad) && is_shift && !is_ctrl {
                request_clear = true;
            }
            if request_clear != 0 {
                ImGui_MultiSelectAddSetAll(ms, false);
            }
        }
        i32 range_direction;
        bool range_selected;
        if is_shift && !is_singleselect {
            if storage.RangeSrcItem == cast(ImGuiSelectionUserData, -1) {
                storage.RangeSrcItem = item_data;
            }
            if (flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_CheckboxMode_) == 0 {
                range_selected = is_ctrl && storage.RangeSelected != -1 ? storage.RangeSelected != 0 : true;
            } else {
                if ms.IsKeyboardSetRange != 0 {
                    range_selected = storage.RangeSelected != -1 ? storage.RangeSelected != 0 : true;
                } else {
                    range_selected = !selected;
                }
            }
            range_direction = ms.RangeSrcPassedBy != 0 ? 1 : -1;
        } else {
            if (flags & ImGuiMultiSelectFlags_CheckboxMode_) == 0 {
                selected = is_ctrl != 0 ? !selected : true;
            } else {
                selected = !selected;
            }
            storage.RangeSrcItem = item_data;
            range_selected = selected;
            range_direction = 1;
        }
        ImGui_MultiSelectAddSetRange(ms, range_selected, range_direction, storage.RangeSrcItem, item_data);
    }
    if storage.RangeSrcItem == item_data {
        storage.RangeSelected = cast(ImS8, selected != 0 ? 1 : 0);
    }
    if g.NavId == id {
        storage.NavIdItem = item_data;
        storage.NavIdSelected = cast(ImS8, selected != 0 ? 1 : 0);
    }
    if storage.NavIdItem == item_data {
        ms.NavIdPassedBy = true;
    }
    *p_selected = selected;
    *p_pressed = pressed;
}

void ImGui_MultiSelectAddSetAll(ImGuiMultiSelectTempData* ms, bool selected) {
    var req = ImGuiSelectionRequest{
        ImGuiSelectionRequestType_SetAll, selected, 0, cast(ImGuiSelectionUserData, -1),
        cast(ImGuiSelectionUserData, -1),
    };
    ImVector_ImGuiSelectionRequest_resize(&ms.IO.Requests, 0);
    ImVector_ImGuiSelectionRequest_push_back(&ms.IO.Requests, req);

void ImGui_MultiSelectAddSetRange(ImGuiMultiSelectTempData* ms, bool selected, i32 range_dir, ImGuiSelectionUserData first_item, ImGuiSelectionUserData last_item) {
    var req = ImGuiSelectionRequest{
        ImGuiSelectionRequestType_SetRange, selected, cast(ImS8, range_dir),
        range_dir > 0 ? first_item : last_item, range_dir > 0 ? last_item : first_item,
    };
    ImVector_ImGuiSelectionRequest_push_back(&ms.IO.Requests, req);
}

void ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage_init(ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage* self) {
    memset(self, 0, cast(u64, sizeof(*self)));
    memset(&self._Storage, 0, cast(u64, sizeof(ImGuiStorage)));
    self.Size = 0;
    self.PreserveOrder = false;
    self.UserData = null;
    self.AdapterIndexToStorageId = __cxx_lambda_1;
    self._SelectionOrder = 1;
}

void ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage_Clear(ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage* self) {
    self.Size = 0;
    self._SelectionOrder = 1;
    ImVector_ImGuiStoragePair_resize(&self._Storage.Data, 0);
}

void ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage_Swap(ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage* self, ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage* r) {
    { var zz_sw = self.Size; self.Size = r.Size; r.Size = zz_sw; }
    { var zz_sw = self._SelectionOrder; self._SelectionOrder = r._SelectionOrder; r._SelectionOrder = zz_sw; }
    ImVector_ImGuiStoragePair_swap(&self._Storage.Data, &r._Storage.Data);
}

bool ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage_Contains(ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage* self, ImGuiID id) {
    return ImGuiStorage_GetInt(&self._Storage, id, 0) != 0;
}

private {
i32 PairComparerByValueInt(void* lhs, void* rhs) {
    i32 lhs_v = cast(ImGuiStoragePair*, lhs).val_i;
    i32 rhs_v = cast(ImGuiStoragePair*, rhs).val_i;
    return lhs_v > rhs_v ? 1 : lhs_v < rhs_v ? -1 : 0;
}
}

// GetNextSelectedItem() is an abstraction allowing us to change our underlying actual storage system without impacting user.
// (e.g. store unselected vs compact down, compact down on demand, use raw ImVector<ImGuiID> instead of ImGuiStorage...)
bool ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage_GetNextSelectedItem(ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage* self, void** opaque_it, ImGuiID* out_id) {
    var it = cast(ImGuiStoragePair*, *opaque_it);
    ImGuiStoragePair* it_end = self._Storage.Data.Data + self._Storage.Data.Size;
    if self.PreserveOrder && it == null && it_end != null {
        ImQsort(self._Storage.Data.Data, cast(u64, self._Storage.Data.Size), cast(u64, sizeof(ImGuiStoragePair)), cast(fn(void*, void*): i32, PairComparerByValueInt));
    }
    if it == null {
        it = self._Storage.Data.Data;
    }
    assert(it >= self._Storage.Data.Data && it <= it_end);
    if it != it_end {
        while it.val_i == 0 && it < it_end {
            it++;
        }
    }
    bool has_more = it != it_end;
    *opaque_it = has_more != 0 ? cast(void**, it + 1) : cast(void**, it);
    *out_id = has_more != 0 ? it.key : 0;
    if self.PreserveOrder && !has_more {
        ImGuiStorage_BuildSortByKey(&self._Storage);
    }
    return has_more;
}

void ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage_SetItemSelected(ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage* self, ImGuiID id, bool selected) {
    i32* p_int = ImGuiStorage_GetIntRef(&self._Storage, id, 0);
    if selected && *p_int == 0 {
        *p_int = self._SelectionOrder++;
        self.Size++;
    } else if !selected && *p_int != 0 {
        *p_int = 0;
        self.Size--;
    }
}

// Optimized for batch edits (with same value of 'selected')
private {
void ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage_BatchSetItemSelected(ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage* selection, ImGuiID id, bool selected, i32 size_before_amends, i32 selection_order) {
    ImGuiStorage* storage = &selection._Storage;
    ImGuiStoragePair* it = ImLowerBound(storage.Data.Data, storage.Data.Data + size_before_amends, id);
    bool is_contained = it != storage.Data.Data + size_before_amends && it.key == id;
    if selected == (is_contained && it.val_i != 0) {
        return;
    }
    if selected && !is_contained {
        ImVector_ImGuiStoragePair_push_back(&storage.Data, __cxx_make_ImGuiStoragePair(id, selection_order));
    } else if is_contained != 0 {
        it.val_i = selected != 0 ? selection_order : 0;
    }
    selection.Size += selected != 0 ? 1 : -1;
}

void ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage_BatchFinish(ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage* selection, bool selected, i32 size_before_amends) {
    ImGuiStorage* storage = &selection._Storage;
    if selected && selection.Size != size_before_amends {
        ImGuiStorage_BuildSortByKey(storage);
    }
}
}

// Apply requests coming from BeginMultiSelect() and EndMultiSelect().
// - Enable 'Demo->Tools->Debug Log->Selection' to see selection requests as they happen.
// - Honoring SetRange requests requires that you can iterate/interpolate between RangeFirstItem and RangeLastItem.
//   - In this demo we often submit indices to SetNextItemSelectionUserData() + store the same indices in persistent selection.
//   - Your code may do differently. If you store pointers or objects ID in ImGuiSelectionUserData you may need to perform
//     a lookup in order to have some way to iterate/interpolate between two items.
// - A full-featured application is likely to allow search/filtering which is likely to lead to using indices
//   and constructing a view index <> object id/ptr data structure anyway.
// WHEN YOUR APPLICATION SETTLES ON A CHOICE, YOU WILL PROBABLY PREFER TO GET RID OF THIS UNNECESSARY 'ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage' INDIRECTION LOGIC.
// Notice that with the simplest adapter (using indices everywhere), all functions return their parameters.
// The most simple implementation (using indices everywhere) would look like:
//   for (ImGuiSelectionRequest& req : ms_io->Requests)
//   {
//      if (req.Type == ImGuiSelectionRequestType_SetAll)    { Clear(); if (req.Selected) { for (int n = 0; n < items_count; n++) { SetItemSelected(n, true); } }
//      if (req.Type == ImGuiSelectionRequestType_SetRange)  { for (int n = (int)ms_io->RangeFirstItem; n <= (int)ms_io->RangeLastItem; n++) { SetItemSelected(n, ms_io->Selected); } }
//   }
void ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage_ApplyRequests(ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage* self, ImGuiMultiSelectIO* ms_io) {
    assert(ms_io.ItemsCount != -1 && "Missing value for items_count in BeginMultiSelect() call!");
    assert(self.AdapterIndexToStorageId != null);
    {
        ImGuiSelectionRequest* zz_rf_it_7 = ImVector_ImGuiSelectionRequest_begin(&ms_io.Requests);
        ImGuiSelectionRequest* zz_rf_end_7 = ImVector_ImGuiSelectionRequest_end(&ms_io.Requests);
        for ; zz_rf_it_7 != zz_rf_end_7; zz_rf_it_7++ {
            ImGuiSelectionRequest* req = zz_rf_it_7;
            if req.Type == ImGuiSelectionRequestType_SetAll {
                ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage_Clear(self);
                if req.Selected != 0 {
                    ImVector_ImGuiStoragePair_reserve(&self._Storage.Data, ms_io.ItemsCount);
                    i32 size_before_amends = self._Storage.Data.Size;
                    for i32 idx = 0; idx < ms_io.ItemsCount; idx++ {
                        ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage_BatchSetItemSelected(self, ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage_GetStorageIdFromIndex(self, idx), req.Selected, size_before_amends, self._SelectionOrder);
                        self._SelectionOrder++;
                    }
                    ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage_BatchFinish(self, req.Selected, size_before_amends);
                }
            } else if req.Type == ImGuiSelectionRequestType_SetRange {
                i32 selection_changes = cast(i32, req.RangeLastItem) - cast(i32, req.RangeFirstItem) + 1;
                if selection_changes == 1 || selection_changes < self.Size / 100 {
                    for i32 idx = cast(i32, req.RangeFirstItem); idx <= cast(i32, req.RangeLastItem); idx++ {
                        ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage_SetItemSelected(self, ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage_GetStorageIdFromIndex(self, idx), req.Selected);
                    }
                } else {
                    i32 size_before_amends = self._Storage.Data.Size;
                    i32 selection_order = self._SelectionOrder + (req.RangeDirection < 0 ? selection_changes - 1 : 0);
                    for i32 idx = cast(i32, req.RangeFirstItem); idx <= cast(i32, req.RangeLastItem); idx++ {
                        ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage_BatchSetItemSelected(self, ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage_GetStorageIdFromIndex(self, idx), req.Selected, size_before_amends, selection_order);
                        selection_order += req.RangeDirection;
                    }
                    if req.Selected != 0 {
                        self._SelectionOrder += selection_changes;
                    }
                    ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage_BatchFinish(self, req.Selected, size_before_amends);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

void ImGuiSelectionExternalStorage_init(ImGuiSelectionExternalStorage* self) {

// Apply requests coming from BeginMultiSelect() and EndMultiSelect().
// We also pull 'ms_io->ItemsCount' as passed for BeginMultiSelect() for consistency with ImGuiSelectionBasicStorage
// This makes no assumption about underlying storage.
void ImGuiSelectionExternalStorage_ApplyRequests(ImGuiSelectionExternalStorage* self, ImGuiMultiSelectIO* ms_io) {
    assert(cast(i64, self.AdapterSetItemSelected));
    {
        ImGuiSelectionRequest* zz_rf_it_8 = ImVector_ImGuiSelectionRequest_begin(&ms_io.Requests);
        ImGuiSelectionRequest* zz_rf_end_8 = ImVector_ImGuiSelectionRequest_end(&ms_io.Requests);
        for ; zz_rf_it_8 != zz_rf_end_8; zz_rf_it_8++ {
            ImGuiSelectionRequest* req = zz_rf_it_8;
            if req.Type == ImGuiSelectionRequestType_SetAll {
                for i32 idx = 0; idx < ms_io.ItemsCount; idx++ {
                    self.AdapterSetItemSelected(self, idx, req.Selected);
                }
            }
            if req.Type == ImGuiSelectionRequestType_SetRange {
                for i32 idx = cast(i32, req.RangeFirstItem); idx <= cast(i32, req.RangeLastItem); idx++ {
                    self.AdapterSetItemSelected(self, idx, req.Selected);
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
