bool ImGui_TabItemEx(ImGuiTabBar* tab_bar, u8* label, bool* p_open, ImGuiTabItemFlags flags, ImGuiWindow* docked_window) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if tab_bar.WantLayout != 0 {
        ImGuiNextItemData backup_next_item_data = g.NextItemData;
        ImGui_TabBarLayout(tab_bar);
        g.NextItemData = backup_next_item_data;
    }
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiStyle style = g.Style;
    ImGuiID id = ImGui_TabBarCalcTabID(tab_bar, label, docked_window);
    ignore *g;
    if p_open && !*p_open {
        ImGui_ItemAdd(__cxx_make_ImRect(), id, null, ImGuiItemFlags_NoNav);
        return false;
    }
    assert(!p_open || !(flags & ImGuiTabItemFlags_Button));
    assert((flags & (ImGuiTabItemFlags_Leading | ImGuiTabItemFlags_Trailing)) != (ImGuiTabItemFlags_Leading | ImGuiTabItemFlags_Trailing));
    if (flags & ImGuiTabItemFlags_NoCloseButton) != 0 {
        p_open = null;
    } else if p_open == null {
        flags |= ImGuiTabItemFlags_NoCloseButton;
    }
    ImGuiTabItem* tab = ImGui_TabBarFindTabByID(tab_bar, id);
    bool tab_is_new = false;
    if tab == null {
        ImVector_ImGuiTabItem_push_back(&tab_bar.Tabs, __cxx_make_ImGuiTabItem());
        tab = ImVector_ImGuiTabItem_back(&tab_bar.Tabs);
        tab.ID = id;
        tab_is_new = true;
        tab_bar.TabsAddedNew = tab_is_new;
    }
    tab_bar.LastTabItemIdx = cast(ImS16, ImVector_ImGuiTabItem_index_from_ptr(&tab_bar.Tabs, tab));
    ImVec2 size = ImGui_TabItemCalcSize(label, p_open != null || flags & ImGuiTabItemFlags_UnsavedDocument);
    tab.RequestedWidth = -1.0f;
    if (g.NextItemData.HasFlags & ImGuiNextItemDataFlags_HasWidth) != 0 {
        tab.RequestedWidth = g.NextItemData.Width;
        size.x = tab.RequestedWidth;
    }
    if tab_is_new != 0 {
        tab.Width = ImMax(1.0f, size.x);
    }
    tab.ContentWidth = size.x;
    tab.BeginOrder = tab_bar.TabsActiveCount++;
    bool tab_bar_appearing = tab_bar.PrevFrameVisible + 1 < g.FrameCount;
    bool tab_bar_focused = (tab_bar.Flags & ImGuiTabBarFlags_IsFocused) != 0;
    bool tab_appearing = tab.LastFrameVisible + 1 < g.FrameCount;
    bool tab_just_unsaved = flags & ImGuiTabItemFlags_UnsavedDocument && !(tab.Flags & ImGuiTabItemFlags_UnsavedDocument);
    bool is_tab_button = (flags & ImGuiTabItemFlags_Button) != 0;
    tab.LastFrameVisible = g.FrameCount;
    tab.Flags = flags;
    tab.Window = docked_window;
    if docked_window != null {
        assert(tab_bar.Flags & ImGuiTabBarFlags_DockNode);
        tab.NameOffset = -1;
    } else {
        tab.NameOffset = cast(ImS32, ImGuiTextBuffer_size(&tab_bar.TabsNames));
        ImGuiTextBuffer_append(&tab_bar.TabsNames, label, label + strlen(label) + 1);
    }
    if is_tab_button == 0 {
        if tab_appearing && tab_bar.Flags & ImGuiTabBarFlags_AutoSelectNewTabs && tab_bar.NextSelectedTabId == 0 {
            if !tab_bar_appearing || tab_bar.SelectedTabId == 0 {
                ImGui_TabBarQueueFocus(tab_bar, tab);
            }
        }
        if flags & ImGuiTabItemFlags_SetSelected && tab_bar.SelectedTabId != id {
            ImGui_TabBarQueueFocus(tab_bar, tab);
        }
    }
    bool tab_contents_visible = tab_bar.VisibleTabId == id;
    if tab_contents_visible != 0 {
        tab_bar.VisibleTabWasSubmitted = true;
    }
    if !tab_contents_visible && tab_bar.SelectedTabId == 0 && tab_bar_appearing && docked_window == null {
        if tab_bar.Tabs.Size == 1 && !(tab_bar.Flags & ImGuiTabBarFlags_AutoSelectNewTabs) {
            tab_contents_visible = true;
        }
    }
    if tab_appearing && (!tab_bar_appearing || tab_is_new) {
        ImGui_ItemAdd(__cxx_make_ImRect(), id, null, ImGuiItemFlags_NoNav);
        if is_tab_button != 0 {
            return false;
        }
        return tab_contents_visible;
    }
    if tab_bar.SelectedTabId == id {
        tab.LastFrameSelected = g.FrameCount;
    }
    ImVec2 backup_main_cursor_pos = window.DC.CursorPos;
    bool is_central_section = (tab.Flags & ImGuiTabItemFlags_SectionMask_) == 0;
    size.x = tab.Width;
    if is_central_section != 0 {
        window.DC.CursorPos = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(tab_bar.BarRect.Min, ImVec2{
            cast(f32, cast(i32, tab.Offset - tab_bar.ScrollingAnim)), 0.0f,
        });
    } else {
        window.DC.CursorPos = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(tab_bar.BarRect.Min, ImVec2{tab.Offset, 0.0f});
    }
    ImVec2 pos = window.DC.CursorPos;
    ImRect bb;
    ImRect_init(&bb, pos, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(pos, size));
    bool want_clip_rect = is_central_section && (bb.Min.x < tab_bar.ScrollingRectMinX || bb.Max.x > tab_bar.ScrollingRectMaxX);
    if want_clip_rect != 0 {
        ImGui_PushClipRect(ImVec2{
            ImClamp(bb.Min.x, tab_bar.ScrollingRectMinX, tab_bar.ScrollingRectMaxX),
            bb.Min.y - 1.0f,
        }, ImVec2{tab_bar.ScrollingRectMaxX, bb.Max.y}, true);
    }
    ImVec2 backup_cursor_max_pos = window.DC.CursorMaxPos;
    ImGui_ItemSize(ImRect_GetSize(&bb), style.FramePadding.y);
    window.DC.CursorMaxPos = backup_cursor_max_pos;
    if ImGui_ItemAdd(bb, id, null, 0) == 0 {
        if want_clip_rect != 0 {
            ImGui_PopClipRect();
        }
        window.DC.CursorPos = backup_main_cursor_pos;
        return tab_contents_visible;
    }
    ImGuiButtonFlags button_flags = cast(ImGuiButtonFlags, is_tab_button != 0 ? ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnClickRelease : ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnClick) | ImGuiButtonFlags_AllowOverlap;
    if g.DragDropActive && !ImGuiPayload_IsDataType(&g.DragDropPayload, "_IMWINDOW") {
        button_flags |= ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnDragDropHold;
    }
    bool hovered;
    bool held;
    bool pressed;
    if (flags & ImGuiTabItemFlags_Invisible) != 0 {
        pressed = false;
        held = pressed;
        hovered = held;
    } else {
        pressed = ImGui_ButtonBehavior(bb, id, &hovered, &held, button_flags);
    }
    if pressed && !is_tab_button {
        ImGui_TabBarQueueFocus(tab_bar, tab);
    }
    if held && docked_window && g.ActiveId == id && g.ActiveIdIsJustActivated {
        g.ActiveIdWindow = docked_window;
    }
    ImGuiDockNode* node = docked_window != null ? docked_window.DockNode : null;
    bool single_floating_window_node = node && ImGuiDockNode_IsFloatingNode(node) && node.Windows.Size == 1;
    if held && single_floating_window_node && ImGui_IsMouseDragging(0, 0.0f) {
        ImGui_StartMouseMovingWindow(docked_window);
    } else if held && !tab_appearing && ImGui_IsMouseDragging(0, -1.0f) {
        i32 drag_dir = 0;
        f32 drag_distance_from_edge_x = 0.0f;
        if !g.DragDropActive && (tab_bar.Flags & ImGuiTabBarFlags_Reorderable || docked_window != null) {
            if g.IO.MouseDelta.x < 0.0f && g.IO.MousePos.x < bb.Min.x {
                drag_dir = -1;
                drag_distance_from_edge_x = bb.Min.x - g.IO.MousePos.x;
                ImGui_TabBarQueueReorderFromMousePos(tab_bar, tab, g.IO.MousePos);
            } else if g.IO.MouseDelta.x > 0.0f && g.IO.MousePos.x > bb.Max.x {
                drag_dir = 1;
                drag_distance_from_edge_x = g.IO.MousePos.x - bb.Max.x;
                ImGui_TabBarQueueReorderFromMousePos(tab_bar, tab, g.IO.MousePos);
            }
        }
        bool can_undock = docked_window != null && !(docked_window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoMove) && !(node.MergedFlags & ImGuiDockNodeFlags_NoUndocking);
        if can_undock != 0 {
            bool undocking_tab = g.DragDropActive && g.DragDropPayload.SourceId == id;
            if undocking_tab == 0 {
                f32 threshold_base = g.FontSize;
                f32 threshold_x = threshold_base * 2.2f;
                f32 threshold_y = threshold_base * 1.5f + ImClamp((fabs(g.IO.MouseDragMaxDistanceAbs[0].x) - threshold_base * 2.0f) * 0.2f, 0.0f, threshold_base * 4.0f);
                f32 distance_from_edge_y = ImMax(bb.Min.y - g.IO.MousePos.y, g.IO.MousePos.y - bb.Max.y);
                if distance_from_edge_y >= threshold_y {
                    undocking_tab = true;
                }
                if drag_distance_from_edge_x > threshold_x {
                    if drag_dir < 0 && ImGui_TabBarGetTabOrder(tab_bar, tab) == 0 || drag_dir > 0 && ImGui_TabBarGetTabOrder(tab_bar, tab) == tab_bar.Tabs.Size - 1 {
                        undocking_tab = true;
                    }
                }
            }
            if undocking_tab != 0 {
                ImGui_DockContextQueueUndockWindow(g, docked_window);
                g.MovingWindow = docked_window;
                ImGui_SetActiveID(g.MovingWindow.MoveId, g.MovingWindow);
                g.ActiveIdClickOffset = op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(g.ActiveIdClickOffset, op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(g.MovingWindow.Pos, bb.Min));
                g.ActiveIdNoClearOnFocusLoss = true;
                ImGui_SetActiveIdUsingAllKeyboardKeys();
            }
        }
    }
    bool is_visible = g.LastItemData.StatusFlags & ImGuiItemStatusFlags_Visible && !(flags & ImGuiTabItemFlags_Invisible);
    if is_visible != 0 {
        ImDrawList* display_draw_list = window.DrawList;
        ImU32 tab_col = ImGui_GetColorU32(held || hovered ? ImGuiCol_TabHovered : tab_contents_visible != 0 ? tab_bar_focused != 0 ? ImGuiCol_TabSelected : ImGuiCol_TabDimmedSelected : tab_bar_focused != 0 ? ImGuiCol_Tab : ImGuiCol_TabDimmed);
        ImGui_TabItemBackground(display_draw_list, bb, flags, tab_col);
        if tab_contents_visible && tab_bar.Flags & ImGuiTabBarFlags_DrawSelectedOverline && style.TabBarOverlineSize > 0.0f {
            ImVec2 tl = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(ImRect_GetTL(&bb), ImVec2{0.0f, 1.0f * g.CurrentDpiScale});
            ImVec2 tr = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(ImRect_GetTR(&bb), ImVec2{0.0f, 1.0f * g.CurrentDpiScale});
            ImU32 overline_col = ImGui_GetColorU32(tab_bar_focused != 0 ? ImGuiCol_TabSelectedOverline : ImGuiCol_TabDimmedSelectedOverline);
            if style.TabRounding > 0.0f {
                f32 rounding = style.TabRounding;
                ImDrawList_PathArcToFast(display_draw_list, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(tl, ImVec2{rounding, rounding}), rounding, 7, 9);
                ImDrawList_PathArcToFast(display_draw_list, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(tr, ImVec2{-rounding, rounding}), rounding, 9, 11);
                ImDrawList_PathStroke(display_draw_list, overline_col, style.TabBarOverlineSize, 0);
            } else {
                ImDrawList_AddLine(display_draw_list, op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(tl, ImVec2{0.5f, 0.5f}), op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(tr, ImVec2{0.5f, 0.5f}), overline_col, style.TabBarOverlineSize);
            }
        }
        ImGui_RenderNavCursor(bb, id, ImGuiNavRenderCursorFlags_None, -1.0f);
        bool hovered_unblocked = ImGui_IsItemHovered(ImGuiHoveredFlags_AllowWhenBlockedByPopup);
        if tab_bar.SelectedTabId != tab.ID && hovered_unblocked && (ImGui_IsMouseClicked(1, false) || ImGui_IsMouseReleased(1)) && !is_tab_button {
            ImGui_TabBarQueueFocus(tab_bar, tab);
        }
        if (tab_bar.Flags & ImGuiTabBarFlags_NoCloseWithMiddleMouseButton) != 0 {
            flags |= ImGuiTabItemFlags_NoCloseWithMiddleMouseButton;
        }
        ImGuiID close_button_id = p_open != null ? ImGui_GetIDWithSeed("#CLOSE", null, docked_window != null ? docked_window.ID : id) : 0;
        bool just_closed;
        bool text_clipped;
        ImGui_TabItemLabelAndCloseButton(display_draw_list, bb, tab_just_unsaved != 0 ? flags & ~ImGuiTabItemFlags_UnsavedDocument : flags, tab_bar.FramePadding, label, id, close_button_id, tab_contents_visible, &just_closed, &text_clipped);
        if just_closed && p_open != null {
            *p_open = false;
            ImGui_TabBarCloseTab(tab_bar, tab);
        }
        if docked_window && (hovered || g.HoveredId == close_button_id) {
            g.LastItemData.StatusFlags |= ImGuiItemStatusFlags_HoveredWindow;
        }
        if text_clipped && g.HoveredId == id && !held {
            if !(tab_bar.Flags & ImGuiTabBarFlags_NoTooltip) && !(tab.Flags & ImGuiTabItemFlags_NoTooltip) {
                ImGui_SetItemTooltip("%.*s", cast(i32, cast(i64, ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(label, null) - label)), label);
            }
        }
    }
    if want_clip_rect != 0 {
        ImGui_PopClipRect();
    }
    window.DC.CursorPos = backup_main_cursor_pos;
    assert(!is_tab_button || !(tab_bar.SelectedTabId == tab.ID && is_tab_button));
    if is_tab_button != 0 {
        return pressed;
    }
    return tab_contents_visible;
}

// [Public] This is call is 100% optional but it allows to remove some one-frame glitches when a tab has been unexpectedly removed.
// To use it to need to call the function SetTabItemClosed() between BeginTabBar() and EndTabBar().
// Tabs closed by the close button will automatically be flagged to avoid this issue.
void ImGui_SetTabItemClosed(u8* label) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    bool is_within_manual_tab_bar = g.CurrentTabBar && !(g.CurrentTabBar.Flags & ImGuiTabBarFlags_DockNode);
    if is_within_manual_tab_bar != 0 {
        ImGuiTabBar* tab_bar = g.CurrentTabBar;
        ImGuiID tab_id = ImGui_TabBarCalcTabID(tab_bar, label, null);
        {
            ImGuiTabItem* tab = ImGui_TabBarFindTabByID(tab_bar, tab_id);
            if tab != null {
                tab.WantClose = true;
            }
        }
    } else {
        ImGuiWindow* window = ImGui_FindWindowByName(label);
        if window != null {
            if window.DockIsActive != 0 {
                ImGuiDockNode* node = window.DockNode;
                if node != null {
                    ImGuiID tab_id = ImGui_TabBarCalcTabID(node.TabBar, label, window);
                    ImGui_TabBarRemoveTab(node.TabBar, tab_id);
                    window.DockTabWantClose = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

ImVec2 ImGui_TabItemCalcSize(u8* label, bool has_close_button_or_unsaved_marker) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImVec2 label_size = ImGui_CalcTextSize(label, null, true, -1.0f);
    var size = ImVec2{
        label_size.x + g.Style.FramePadding.x, label_size.y + g.Style.FramePadding.y * 2.0f,
    };
    if has_close_button_or_unsaved_marker != 0 {
        size.x += g.Style.FramePadding.x + (g.Style.ItemInnerSpacing.x + g.FontSize);
    } else {
        size.x += g.Style.FramePadding.x + 1.0f;
    }
    return ImVec2{ImMin(size.x, ImGui_TabBarCalcMaxTabWidth()), size.y};
}

ImVec2 ImGui_TabItemCalcSize(ImGuiWindow* window) {
    return ImGui_TabItemCalcSize(window.Name, window.HasCloseButton || window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_UnsavedDocument);
}

void ImGui_TabItemBackground(ImDrawList* draw_list, ImRect bb, ImGuiTabItemFlags flags, ImU32 col) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    f32 width = ImRect_GetWidth(&bb);
    ignore flags;
    assert(width > 0.0f);
    f32 rounding = ImMax(0.0f, ImMin((flags & ImGuiTabItemFlags_Button) != 0 ? g.Style.FrameRounding : g.Style.TabRounding, width * 0.5f - 1.0f));
    f32 y1 = bb.Min.y + 1.0f;
    f32 y2 = bb.Max.y - g.Style.TabBarBorderSize;
    ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(draw_list, bb.Min, ImVec2{bb.Max.x, y2}, col, rounding, ImDrawFlags_RoundCornersTop);
    if g.Style.TabBorderSize > 0.0f {
        ImDrawList_PathLineTo(draw_list, ImVec2{bb.Min.x + 0.5f, y2});
        ImDrawList_PathArcToFast(draw_list, ImVec2{bb.Min.x + rounding + 0.5f, y1 + rounding + 0.5f}, rounding, 6, 9);
        ImDrawList_PathArcToFast(draw_list, ImVec2{bb.Max.x - rounding - 0.5f, y1 + rounding + 0.5f}, rounding, 9, 12);
        ImDrawList_PathLineTo(draw_list, ImVec2{bb.Max.x - 0.5f, y2});
        ImDrawList_PathStroke(draw_list, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Border), g.Style.TabBorderSize, 0);
    }
}

// Render text label (with custom clipping) + Unsaved Document marker + Close Button logic
// We tend to lock style.FramePadding for a given tab-bar, hence the 'frame_padding' parameter.
void ImGui_TabItemLabelAndCloseButton(ImDrawList* draw_list, ImRect bb, ImGuiTabItemFlags flags, ImVec2 frame_padding, u8* label, ImGuiID tab_id, ImGuiID close_button_id, bool is_contents_visible, bool* out_just_closed, bool* out_text_clipped) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    u8* label_end = ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(label, null);
    ImVec2 label_size = ImGui_CalcTextSize(label, label_end, false, -1.0f);
    if out_just_closed != null {
        *out_just_closed = false;
    }
    if out_text_clipped != null {
        *out_text_clipped = false;
    }
    if ImRect_GetWidth(&bb) <= 1.0f {
        return;
    }
    ImRect text_ellipsis_clip_bb;
    ImRect_init(&text_ellipsis_clip_bb, bb.Min.x + frame_padding.x, bb.Min.y + frame_padding.y, bb.Max.x - frame_padding.x, bb.Max.y);
    if out_text_clipped != null {
        *out_text_clipped = text_ellipsis_clip_bb.Min.x + label_size.x > text_ellipsis_clip_bb.Max.x;
    }
    f32 button_sz = g.FontSize;
    ImVec2 button_pos;
    ImVec2_init(&button_pos, ImMax(bb.Min.x, bb.Max.x - frame_padding.x - button_sz), bb.Min.y + frame_padding.y);
    bool close_button_pressed = false;
    bool close_button_visible = false;
    bool is_hovered = g.HoveredId == tab_id || g.HoveredId == close_button_id || g.ActiveId == tab_id || g.ActiveId == close_button_id;
    if close_button_id != 0 {
        if is_contents_visible != 0 {
            close_button_visible = g.Style.TabCloseButtonMinWidthSelected < 0.0f ? true : is_hovered && ImRect_GetWidth(&bb) >= ImMax(button_sz, g.Style.TabCloseButtonMinWidthSelected);
        } else {
            close_button_visible = g.Style.TabCloseButtonMinWidthUnselected < 0.0f ? true : is_hovered && ImRect_GetWidth(&bb) >= ImMax(button_sz, g.Style.TabCloseButtonMinWidthUnselected);
        }
    }
    bool unsaved_marker_visible = (flags & ImGuiTabItemFlags_UnsavedDocument) != 0 && button_pos.x + button_sz <= bb.Max.x && (!close_button_visible || !is_hovered);
    if unsaved_marker_visible != 0 {
        ImVec2 bullet_pos = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(button_pos, op_mul_ImVec2_float(ImVec2{button_sz, button_sz}, 0.5f));
        ImGui_RenderBullet(draw_list, bullet_pos, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_UnsavedMarker));
    } else if close_button_visible != 0 {
        ImGuiLastItemData last_item_backup = g.LastItemData;
        if ImGui_CloseButton(close_button_id, button_pos) != 0 {
            close_button_pressed = true;
        }
        g.LastItemData = last_item_backup;
        if is_hovered && !(flags & ImGuiTabItemFlags_NoCloseWithMiddleMouseButton) && ImGui_IsMouseClicked(2, false) {
            close_button_pressed = true;
        }
    }
    f32 ellipsis_max_x = text_ellipsis_clip_bb.Max.x;
    if close_button_visible || unsaved_marker_visible {
        bool visible_without_hover = unsaved_marker_visible || (is_contents_visible != 0 ? g.Style.TabCloseButtonMinWidthSelected : g.Style.TabCloseButtonMinWidthUnselected) < 0.0f;
        if visible_without_hover != 0 {
            text_ellipsis_clip_bb.Max.x -= button_sz * 0.9f;
            ellipsis_max_x -= button_sz * 0.9f;
        } else {
            text_ellipsis_clip_bb.Max.x -= button_sz * 1.0f;
        }
    }
    ImGui_LogSetNextTextDecoration("/", "\\");
    ImGui_RenderTextEllipsis(draw_list, text_ellipsis_clip_bb.Min, text_ellipsis_clip_bb.Max, ellipsis_max_x, label, label_end, &label_size);
    if out_just_closed != null {
        *out_just_closed = close_button_pressed;
    }
}

f32 ImGui_ScaleRatioFromValueT_ImS32_ImS32_float(ImGuiDataType data_type, ImS32 v, ImS32 v_min, ImS32 v_max, f32 logarithmic_zero_epsilon, f32 zero_deadzone_halfsize) {
    if v_min == v_max {
        return 0.0f;
    }
    ignore data_type;
    ImS32 v_clamped = v_min < v_max ? ImClamp(v, v_min, v_max) : ImClamp(v, v_max, v_min);
    if logarithmic_zero_epsilon > 0.0f {
        bool flipped = v_max < v_min;
        if flipped != 0 {
            { var zz_sw = v_min; v_min = v_max; v_max = zz_sw; }
        }
        f32 v_min_fudged = ImAbs(cast(f32, v_min)) < logarithmic_zero_epsilon ? cast(f32, v_min) < 0.0f ? -logarithmic_zero_epsilon : logarithmic_zero_epsilon : cast(f32, v_min);
        f32 v_max_fudged = ImAbs(cast(f32, v_max)) < logarithmic_zero_epsilon ? cast(f32, v_max) < 0.0f ? -logarithmic_zero_epsilon : logarithmic_zero_epsilon : cast(f32, v_max);
        if cast(f32, v_min) == 0.0f && cast(f32, v_max) < 0.0f {
            v_min_fudged = -logarithmic_zero_epsilon;
        } else if cast(f32, v_max) == 0.0f && cast(f32, v_min) < 0.0f {
            v_max_fudged = -logarithmic_zero_epsilon;
        }
        f32 result;
        if cast(f32, v_clamped) <= v_min_fudged {
            result = 0.0f;
        } else if cast(f32, v_clamped) >= v_max_fudged {
            result = 1.0f;
        } else if cast(f32, v_min * v_max) < 0.0f {
            f32 zero_point_center = -cast(f32, v_min) / (cast(f32, v_max) - cast(f32, v_min));
            f32 zero_point_snap_L = zero_point_center - zero_deadzone_halfsize;
            f32 zero_point_snap_R = zero_point_center + zero_deadzone_halfsize;
            if cast(f32, v) == 0.0f {
                result = zero_point_center;
            } else if cast(f32, v) < 0.0f {
                result = (1.0f - ImLog(-cast(f32, v_clamped) / logarithmic_zero_epsilon) / ImLog(-v_min_fudged / logarithmic_zero_epsilon)) * zero_point_snap_L;
            } else {
                result = zero_point_snap_R + ImLog(cast(f32, v_clamped) / logarithmic_zero_epsilon) / ImLog(v_max_fudged / logarithmic_zero_epsilon) * (1.0f - zero_point_snap_R);
            }
        } else if cast(f32, v_min) < 0.0f || cast(f32, v_max) < 0.0f {
            result = 1.0f - ImLog(-cast(f32, v_clamped) / -v_max_fudged) / ImLog(-v_min_fudged / -v_max_fudged);
        } else {
            result = ImLog(cast(f32, v_clamped) / v_min_fudged) / ImLog(v_max_fudged / v_min_fudged);
        }
        return flipped != 0 ? 1.0f - result : result;
    } else {
        return cast(f32, cast(ImS32, v_clamped - v_min)) / cast(f32, cast(ImS32, v_max - v_min));
    }
}

ImS32 ImGui_ScaleValueFromRatioT_ImS32_ImS32_float(ImGuiDataType data_type, f32 t, ImS32 v_min, ImS32 v_max, f32 logarithmic_zero_epsilon, f32 zero_deadzone_halfsize) {
    if t <= 0.0f || v_min == v_max {
        return v_min;
    }
    if t >= 1.0f {
        return v_max;
    }
    var result = cast(ImS32, 0);
    if logarithmic_zero_epsilon > 0.0f {
        f32 v_min_fudged = ImAbs(cast(f32, v_min)) < logarithmic_zero_epsilon ? cast(f32, v_min) < 0.0f ? -logarithmic_zero_epsilon : logarithmic_zero_epsilon : cast(f32, v_min);
        f32 v_max_fudged = ImAbs(cast(f32, v_max)) < logarithmic_zero_epsilon ? cast(f32, v_max) < 0.0f ? -logarithmic_zero_epsilon : logarithmic_zero_epsilon : cast(f32, v_max);
        bool flipped = v_max < v_min;
        if flipped != 0 {
            { var zz_sw = v_min_fudged; v_min_fudged = v_max_fudged; v_max_fudged = zz_sw; }
        }
        if cast(f32, v_max) == 0.0f && cast(f32, v_min) < 0.0f {
            v_max_fudged = -logarithmic_zero_epsilon;
        }
        f32 t_with_flip = flipped != 0 ? 1.0f - t : t;
        if cast(f32, v_min * v_max) < 0.0f {
            f32 zero_point_center = -cast(f32, ImMin(v_min, v_max)) / ImAbs(cast(f32, v_max) - cast(f32, v_min));
            f32 zero_point_snap_L = zero_point_center - zero_deadzone_halfsize;
            f32 zero_point_snap_R = zero_point_center + zero_deadzone_halfsize;
            if t_with_flip >= zero_point_snap_L && t_with_flip <= zero_point_snap_R {
                result = cast(ImS32, 0.0f);
            } else if t_with_flip < zero_point_center {
                result = cast(ImS32, -(logarithmic_zero_epsilon * ImPow(-v_min_fudged / logarithmic_zero_epsilon, 1.0f - t_with_flip / zero_point_snap_L)));
            } else {
                result = cast(ImS32, logarithmic_zero_epsilon * ImPow(v_max_fudged / logarithmic_zero_epsilon, (t_with_flip - zero_point_snap_R) / (1.0f - zero_point_snap_R)));
            }
        } else if cast(f32, v_min) < 0.0f || cast(f32, v_max) < 0.0f {
            result = cast(ImS32, -(-v_max_fudged * ImPow(-v_min_fudged / -v_max_fudged, 1.0f - t_with_flip)));
        } else {
            result = cast(ImS32, v_min_fudged * ImPow(v_max_fudged / v_min_fudged, t_with_flip));
        }
    } else {
        bool is_floating_point = data_type == ImGuiDataType_Float || data_type == ImGuiDataType_Double;
        if is_floating_point != 0 {
            result = ImLerp(v_min, v_max, t);
        } else if t < 1.0 {
            f32 v_new_off_f = cast(f32, cast(ImS32, v_max - v_min)) * t;
            result = cast(ImS32, cast(ImS32, v_min) + cast(ImS32, v_new_off_f + cast(f32, v_min > v_max ? -0.5 : 0.5)));
        }
    }
    return result;
}

ImS32 ImGui_RoundScalarWithFormatT_ImS32(u8* format_var, ImGuiDataType data_type, ImS32 v) {
    ignore data_type;
    assert(data_type == ImGuiDataType_Float || data_type == ImGuiDataType_Double);
    u8* fmt_start = ImParseFormatFindStart(format_var);
    if fmt_start[0] != 37 || fmt_start[1] == 37 {
        return v;
    }
    u8[32] fmt_sanitized;
    ImParseFormatSanitizeForPrinting(fmt_start, fmt_sanitized, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(fmt_sanitized) / sizeof(*fmt_sanitized))));
    fmt_start = fmt_sanitized;
    u8[64] v_str;
    ImFormatString(v_str, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(v_str) / sizeof(*v_str))), fmt_start, v);
    u8* p = v_str;
    while *p == 32 {
        p++;
    }
    v = cast(ImS32, atof(p));
    return v;
}

f32 ImGui_ScaleRatioFromValueT_double_double_double(ImGuiDataType data_type, f64 v, f64 v_min, f64 v_max, f32 logarithmic_zero_epsilon, f32 zero_deadzone_halfsize) {
    if v_min == v_max {
        return 0.0f;
    }
    ignore data_type;
    f64 v_clamped = v_min < v_max ? ImClamp(cast(f32, v), cast(f32, v_min), cast(f32, v_max)) : ImClamp(cast(f32, v), cast(f32, v_max), cast(f32, v_min));
    if logarithmic_zero_epsilon > 0.0f {
        bool flipped = v_max < v_min;
        if flipped != 0 {
            { var zz_sw = v_min; v_min = v_max; v_max = zz_sw; }
        }
        f64 v_min_fudged = ImAbs(v_min) < logarithmic_zero_epsilon ? cast(f64, v_min < 0.0f ? -logarithmic_zero_epsilon : logarithmic_zero_epsilon) : v_min;
        f64 v_max_fudged = ImAbs(v_max) < logarithmic_zero_epsilon ? cast(f64, v_max < 0.0f ? -logarithmic_zero_epsilon : logarithmic_zero_epsilon) : v_max;
        if v_min == 0.0f && v_max < 0.0f {
            v_min_fudged = -logarithmic_zero_epsilon;
        } else if v_max == 0.0f && v_min < 0.0f {
            v_max_fudged = -logarithmic_zero_epsilon;
        }
        f32 result;
        if v_clamped <= v_min_fudged {
            result = 0.0f;
        } else if v_clamped >= v_max_fudged {
            result = 1.0f;
        } else if v_min * v_max < 0.0f {
            f32 zero_point_center = -cast(f32, v_min) / (cast(f32, v_max) - cast(f32, v_min));
            f32 zero_point_snap_L = zero_point_center - zero_deadzone_halfsize;
            f32 zero_point_snap_R = zero_point_center + zero_deadzone_halfsize;
            if v == 0.0f {
                result = zero_point_center;
            } else if v < 0.0f {
                result = (1.0f - cast(f32, ImLog(-v_clamped / logarithmic_zero_epsilon) / ImLog(-v_min_fudged / logarithmic_zero_epsilon))) * zero_point_snap_L;
            } else {
                result = zero_point_snap_R + cast(f32, ImLog(v_clamped / logarithmic_zero_epsilon) / ImLog(v_max_fudged / logarithmic_zero_epsilon)) * (1.0f - zero_point_snap_R);
            }
        } else if v_min < 0.0f || v_max < 0.0f {
            result = 1.0f - cast(f32, ImLog(-v_clamped / -v_max_fudged) / ImLog(-v_min_fudged / -v_max_fudged));
        } else {
            result = cast(f32, ImLog(v_clamped / v_min_fudged) / ImLog(v_max_fudged / v_min_fudged));
        }
        return flipped != 0 ? 1.0f - result : result;
    } else {

    }

        }
        if v_max == 0.0f && v_min < 0.0f {
            v_max_fudged = -logarithmic_zero_epsilon;
        }
        f32 t_with_flip = flipped != 0 ? 1.0f - t : t;
        if v_min * v_max < 0.0f {
            f32 zero_point_center = -ImMin(cast(f32, v_min), cast(f32, v_max)) / ImAbs(cast(f32, v_max) - cast(f32, v_min));

                result = cast(f64, 0.0f);
            } else if t_with_flip < zero_point_center {
                result = -(logarithmic_zero_epsilon * ImPow(-v_min_fudged / logarithmic_zero_epsilon, cast(f64, 1.0f - t_with_flip / zero_point_snap_L)));

                result = logarithmic_zero_epsilon * ImPow(v_max_fudged / logarithmic_zero_epsilon, cast(f64, (t_with_flip - zero_point_snap_R) / (1.0f - zero_point_snap_R)));

            result = -(-v_max_fudged * ImPow(-v_min_fudged / -v_max_fudged, cast(f64, 1.0f - t_with_flip)));
        } else {
            result = v_min_fudged * ImPow(v_max_fudged / v_min_fudged, cast(f64, t_with_flip));
        }
    } else {
        bool is_floating_point = data_type == ImGuiDataType_Float || data_type == ImGuiDataType_Double;

            result = ImLerp(v_min, v_max, t);

void ImSpanAllocator_6_init(ImSpanAllocator_6* self) {
    memset(self, 0, cast(u64, sizeof(*self)));
    memset(cast(void*, self), 0, cast(u64, sizeof(*self)));
}

ImSpanAllocator_6* __cxx_new_ImSpanAllocator_6(void* p) {
    ImSpanAllocator_6_init(cast(ImSpanAllocator_6*, p));
    return cast(ImSpanAllocator_6*, p);
}

ImSpanAllocator_6 __cxx_make_ImSpanAllocator_6() {
    ImSpanAllocator_6 zz_t;
    ImSpanAllocator_6_init(&zz_t);
    return zz_t;
}

void ImSpanAllocator_6_Reserve(ImSpanAllocator_6* self, i32 n, u64 sz, i32 a) {
    assert(n == self.CurrIdx && n < 6);
    self.CurrOff = self.CurrOff + (a - 1) & ~(a - 1);
    self.Offsets[n] = self.CurrOff;
    self.Sizes[n] = cast(i32, sz);
    self.CurrIdx++;
    self.CurrOff += cast(i32, sz);
}

i32 ImSpanAllocator_6_GetArenaSizeInBytes(ImSpanAllocator_6* self) {
    return self.CurrOff;
}

void ImSpanAllocator_6_SetArenaBasePtr(ImSpanAllocator_6* self, void* base_ptr) {
    self.BasePtr = cast(u8*, base_ptr);
}

void* ImSpanAllocator_6_GetSpanPtrBegin(ImSpanAllocator_6* self, i32 n) {
    assert(n >= 0 && n < 6 && self.CurrIdx == 6);
    return cast(void*, self.BasePtr + self.Offsets[n]);
}

void* ImSpanAllocator_6_GetSpanPtrEnd(ImSpanAllocator_6* self, i32 n) {
    assert(n >= 0 && n < 6 && self.CurrIdx == 6);
    return cast(void*, self.BasePtr + self.Offsets[n] + self.Sizes[n]);
}

ImGuiTableFlags TableFixFlags(ImGuiTableFlags flags, ImGuiWindow* outer_window) {
    if (flags & ImGuiTableFlags_SizingMask_) == 0 {
        flags |= flags & ImGuiTableFlags_ScrollX || outer_window.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize ? ImGuiTableFlags_SizingFixedFit : ImGuiTableFlags_SizingStretchSame;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiTableFlags_SizingMask_) == ImGuiTableFlags_SizingFixedSame {
        flags |= ImGuiTableFlags_NoKeepColumnsVisible;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiTableFlags_Resizable) != 0 {
        flags |= ImGuiTableFlags_BordersInnerV;
    }
    if (flags & (ImGuiTableFlags_ScrollX | ImGuiTableFlags_ScrollY)) != 0 {
        flags &= ~(ImGuiTableFlags_NoHostExtendX | ImGuiTableFlags_NoHostExtendY);
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiTableFlags_NoBordersInBodyUntilResize) != 0 {
        flags &= ~ImGuiTableFlags_NoBordersInBody;
    }
    if (flags & (ImGuiTableFlags_Resizable | ImGuiTableFlags_Hideable | ImGuiTableFlags_Reorderable | ImGuiTableFlags_Sortable)) == 0 {
        flags |= ImGuiTableFlags_NoSavedSettings;
    }
    if (outer_window.RootWindow.Flags & ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings) != 0 {
        flags |= ImGuiTableFlags_NoSavedSettings;
    }
    return flags;
}

// For reference, the average total _allocation count_ for a table is:
// + 0 (for ImGuiTable instance, we are pooling allocations in g.Tables[])
// + 1 (for table->RawData allocated below)
// + 1 (for table->ColumnsNames, if names are used)
// Shared allocations for the maximum number of simultaneously nested tables (generally a very small number)
// + 1 (for table->Splitter._Channels)
// + 2 * active_channels_count (for ImDrawCmd and ImDrawIdx buffers inside channels)
// Where active_channels_count is variable but often == columns_count or == columns_count + 1, see TableSetupDrawChannels() for details.
// Unused channels don't perform their +2 allocations.
void ImGui_TableBeginInitMemory(ImGuiTable* table, i32 columns_count) {
    var columns_bit_array_size = cast(i32, ImBitArrayGetStorageSizeInBytes(columns_count));
    ImSpanAllocator_6 span_allocator;
    ImSpanAllocator_6_Reserve(&span_allocator, 0, cast(u64, columns_count * sizeof(ImGuiTableColumn)), 4);
    ImSpanAllocator_6_Reserve(&span_allocator, 1, cast(u64, columns_count * sizeof(ImGuiTableColumnIdx)), 4);
    ImSpanAllocator_6_Reserve(&span_allocator, 2, cast(u64, columns_count * sizeof(ImGuiTableCellData)), 4);
    for i32 n = 3; n < 6; n++ {
        ImSpanAllocator_6_Reserve(&span_allocator, n, cast(u64, columns_bit_array_size), 4);
    }
    table.RawData = ImGui_MemAlloc(cast(u64, ImSpanAllocator_6_GetArenaSizeInBytes(&span_allocator)));
    memset(table.RawData, 0, cast(u64, ImSpanAllocator_6_GetArenaSizeInBytes(&span_allocator)));
    ImSpanAllocator_6_SetArenaBasePtr(&span_allocator, table.RawData);
    table.Columns.Data = cast(ImGuiTableColumn*, ImSpanAllocator_6_GetSpanPtrBegin(&span_allocator, 0)); table.Columns.DataEnd = cast(ImGuiTableColumn*, ImSpanAllocator_6_GetSpanPtrEnd(&span_allocator, 0));
    table.DisplayOrderToIndex.Data = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx*, ImSpanAllocator_6_GetSpanPtrBegin(&span_allocator, 1)); table.DisplayOrderToIndex.DataEnd = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx*, ImSpanAllocator_6_GetSpanPtrEnd(&span_allocator, 1));
    table.RowCellData.Data = cast(ImGuiTableCellData*, ImSpanAllocator_6_GetSpanPtrBegin(&span_allocator, 2)); table.RowCellData.DataEnd = cast(ImGuiTableCellData*, ImSpanAllocator_6_GetSpanPtrEnd(&span_allocator, 2));
    table.EnabledMaskByDisplayOrder = cast(ImU32*, ImSpanAllocator_6_GetSpanPtrBegin(&span_allocator, 3));
    table.EnabledMaskByIndex = cast(ImU32*, ImSpanAllocator_6_GetSpanPtrBegin(&span_allocator, 4));
    table.VisibleMaskByIndex = cast(ImU32*, ImSpanAllocator_6_GetSpanPtrBegin(&span_allocator, 5));
}

// Apply immediately. See TableQueueSetColumnDisplayOrder() for additional checks/constraints.
void ImGui_TableSetColumnDisplayOrder(ImGuiTable* table, i32 column_n, i32 dst_order) {
    assert(column_n >= 0 && column_n < table.ColumnsCount);
    assert(dst_order >= 0 && dst_order < table.ColumnsCount);
    ImGuiTableColumn* src_column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
    i32 src_order = src_column.DisplayOrder;
    if src_order == dst_order {
        return;
    }
    i32 reorder_dir = dst_order < src_order ? -1 : 1;
    src_column.DisplayOrder = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, dst_order);
    for i32 order_n = src_order + reorder_dir; order_n != dst_order + reorder_dir; order_n += reorder_dir {
        table.Columns.Data[table.DisplayOrderToIndex.Data[order_n]].DisplayOrder -= cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, reorder_dir);
    }
    for i32 n = 0; n < table.ColumnsCount; n++ {
        table.DisplayOrderToIndex.Data[table.Columns.Data[n].DisplayOrder] = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, n);
    }
    table.IsSettingsDirty = true;
}

private {
i32 TableGetMaxDisplayOrderAllowed(ImGuiTable* table, i32 src_order, i32 dst_order) {
    dst_order = ImClamp(dst_order, 0, table.ColumnsCount - 1);
    if src_order == dst_order {
        return dst_order;
    }
    if table.FreezeColumnsRequest > 0 {
        dst_order = src_order < table.FreezeColumnsRequest ? ImMin(dst_order, cast(i32, table.FreezeColumnsRequest) - 1) : ImMax(dst_order, cast(i32, table.FreezeColumnsRequest));
    }
    i32 reorder_dir = src_order < dst_order ? 1 : -1;
    for i32 order_n = src_order; src_order < dst_order && order_n <= dst_order || dst_order < src_order && order_n >= dst_order; order_n += reorder_dir {
        if (table.Columns.Data[table.DisplayOrderToIndex.Data[order_n]].Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoReorder) != 0 {
            dst_order = order_n == src_order ? src_order : order_n - reorder_dir;
            break;
        }
    }
    return dst_order;
}
}

// Reorder requested by user interaction.
void ImGui_TableQueueSetColumnDisplayOrder(ImGuiTable* table, i32 column_n, i32 dst_order) {
    i32 src_order = table.Columns.Data[column_n].DisplayOrder;
    table.ReorderColumn = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, column_n);
    table.ReorderColumnDstOrder = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, -1);
    dst_order = TableGetMaxDisplayOrderAllowed(table, src_order, dst_order);
    if table.IsLayoutLocked && dst_order == src_order {
        return;
    }
    table.ReorderColumnDstOrder = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, dst_order);
}

        }
        if column.SortOrder != -1 {
            column.Flags |= ImGuiTableColumnFlags_IsSorted;
        }
        if is_hovering_table && mouse_skewed_x >= column.ClipRect.Min.x && mouse_skewed_x < column.ClipRect.Max.x {
            column.Flags |= ImGuiTableColumnFlags_IsHovered;
            table.HoveredColumnBody = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, column_n);
        }
        if table.InstanceCurrent == 0 {
            column.ContentMaxXFrozen = column.WorkMinX;
            column.ContentMaxXUnfrozen = column.WorkMinX;
            column.ContentMaxXHeadersUsed = column.WorkMinX;
            column.ContentMaxXHeadersIdeal = column.WorkMinX;
        } else {
            f32 offset_from_previous_instance = column.WorkMinX - previous_instance_work_min_x;
            column.ContentMaxXFrozen += offset_from_previous_instance;
            column.ContentMaxXUnfrozen += offset_from_previous_instance;
            column.ContentMaxXHeadersUsed += offset_from_previous_instance;
            column.ContentMaxXHeadersIdeal += offset_from_previous_instance;
        }
        if table.HostSkipItems == false && table.InstanceCurrent == 0 {
            column.AutoFitQueue >>= 1;
            column.CannotSkipItemsQueue >>= 1;
        }
        if order_n < table.FreezeColumnsCount {
            host_clip_rect.Min.x = ImClamp(column.MaxX + TABLE_BORDER_SIZE, host_clip_rect.Min.x, host_clip_rect.Max.x);
        }
        offset_x += column.WidthGiven + table.CellSpacingX1 + table.CellSpacingX2 + table.CellPaddingX * 2.0f;
    }
    if has_at_least_one_column_requesting_output == false {
        table.Columns.Data[table.LeftMostEnabledColumn].IsRequestOutput = true;
        table.Columns.Data[table.LeftMostEnabledColumn].IsSkipItems = false;
    }
    f32 unused_x1 = ImMax(table.WorkRect.Min.x, table.Columns.Data[table.RightMostEnabledColumn].ClipRect.Max.x);
    if is_hovering_table && table.HoveredColumnBody == -1 {
        if mouse_skewed_x >= unused_x1 {
            table.HoveredColumnBody = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, columns_count);
        }
    }
    if has_resizable == false && table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_Resizable {
        table.Flags &= ~ImGuiTableFlags_Resizable;
    }
    table.IsActiveIdAliveBeforeTable = g.ActiveIdIsAlive != 0;
    if table.RightMostStretchedColumn != -1 {
        table.Flags &= ~ImGuiTableFlags_NoHostExtendX;
    }
    if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_NoHostExtendX) != 0 {
        table.WorkRect.Max.x = unused_x1;
        table.OuterRect.Max.x = table.WorkRect.Max.x;
        table.InnerClipRect.Max.x = ImMin(table.InnerClipRect.Max.x, unused_x1);
    }
    table.InnerWindow.ParentWorkRect = table.WorkRect;
    table.BorderX1 = table.InnerClipRect.Min.x;
    table.BorderX2 = table.InnerClipRect.Max.x;
    f32 window_content_max_y;
    if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_NoHostExtendY) != 0 {
        window_content_max_y = table.OuterRect.Max.y;
    } else {
        window_content_max_y = ImMax(table.InnerWindow.ContentRegionRect.Max.y, (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_ScrollY) != 0 ? 0.0f : table.OuterRect.Max.y);
    }
    table.InnerWindow.WorkRect.Max.y = ImClamp(window_content_max_y - g.Style.CellPadding.y, table.InnerWindow.WorkRect.Min.y, table.InnerWindow.WorkRect.Max.y);
    ImGui_TableSetupDrawChannels(table);
    if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_Resizable) != 0 {
        ImGui_TableUpdateBorders(table);
    }
    table_instance.LastTopHeadersRowHeight = 0.0f;
    table.IsLayoutLocked = true;
    table.IsUsingHeaders = false;
    table.HighlightColumnHeader = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, -1);
    if table.IsContextPopupOpen && table.ContextPopupColumn != -1 && table.InstanceInteracted == table.InstanceCurrent {
        table.HighlightColumnHeader = table.ContextPopupColumn;
    } else if table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_HighlightHoveredColumn && table.HoveredColumnBody != -1 && table.HoveredColumnBody != columns_count && table.HoveredColumnBorder == -1 {
        if g.ActiveId == 0 || (table.IsActiveIdInTable || g.DragDropActive) {
            table.HighlightColumnHeader = table.HoveredColumnBody;
        }
    }
    if table.DisableDefaultContextMenu == false && ImGui_TableBeginContextMenuPopup(table) {
        ImGui_TableDrawDefaultContextMenu(table, table.Flags);
        ImGui_EndPopup();
    }
    if table.IsSortSpecsDirty && table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_Sortable {
        ImGui_TableSortSpecsBuild(table);

    if table.FreezeColumnsRequest > 0 {
        table.InnerWindow.DecoInnerSizeX1 = table.Columns.Data[table.DisplayOrderToIndex.Data[table.FreezeColumnsRequest - 1]].MaxX - table.OuterRect.Min.x;
    }
    if table.FreezeRowsRequest > 0 {
        table.InnerWindow.DecoInnerSizeY1 = table_instance.LastFrozenHeight;
    }
    table_instance.LastFrozenHeight = 0.0f;
    ImGuiWindow* inner_window = table.InnerWindow;
    ImGuiBoxSelectState* bs = &g.BoxSelectState;
    if bs.Window == inner_window && bs.UnclipMode {

        ImDrawListSplitter_SetCurrentChannel(table.DrawSplitter, inner_window.DrawList, TABLE_DRAW_CHANNEL_NOCLIP);

        ImDrawList_PushClipRect(inner_window.DrawList, inner_window.InnerClipRect.Min, inner_window.InnerClipRect.Max, false);
    }
}

// When starting a BeginMultiSelect() after table has been layout we update IsRequestOutput fields.
void ImGui_TableApplyExternalUnclipRect(ImGuiTable* table, ImRect* rect) {
    if ImRect_IsInverted(rect) != 0 {
        return;
    }
    for i32 column_n = 0; column_n < table.ColumnsCount; column_n++ {
        ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
        if column.IsRequestOutput == 0 {
            if ImRect_Overlaps(rect, ImRect{
                ImVec2{column.MinX, table.WorkRect.Min.y},
                ImVec2{column.MaxX, FLT_MAX},
            }) != 0 {
                column.IsRequestOutput = true;
            }
        }
    }
}

// Process hit-testing on resizing borders. Actual size change will be applied in EndTable()
// - Set table->HoveredColumnBorder with a short delay/timer to reduce visual feedback noise.
void ImGui_TableUpdateBorders(ImGuiTable* table) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    assert(table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_Resizable);
    ImGuiTableInstanceData* table_instance = ImGui_TableGetInstanceData(table, table.InstanceCurrent);
    f32 hit_half_width = ImTrunc(TABLE_RESIZE_SEPARATOR_HALF_THICKNESS * g.CurrentDpiScale);
    f32 hit_y1 = (table.FreezeRowsCount >= 1 ? table.OuterRect.Min.y : table.WorkRect.Min.y) + table.AngledHeadersHeight;
    f32 hit_y2_body = ImMax(table.OuterRect.Max.y, hit_y1 + table_instance.LastOuterHeight - table.AngledHeadersHeight);
    f32 hit_y2_head = hit_y1 + table_instance.LastTopHeadersRowHeight;
    for i32 order_n = 0; order_n < table.ColumnsCount; order_n++ {
        if (table.EnabledMaskByDisplayOrder[order_n >> 5] & cast(ImU32, 1) << cast(u32, order_n & 31)) != 0 == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        i32 column_n = table.DisplayOrderToIndex.Data[order_n];
        ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
        if (column.Flags & (ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoResize | ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoDirectResize_)) != 0 {
            continue;
        }
        f32 border_y2_hit = (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_NoBordersInBody) != 0 ? hit_y2_head : hit_y2_body;
        if table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_NoBordersInBody && table.IsUsingHeaders == false {
            continue;
        }
        if !column.IsVisibleX && table.LastResizedColumn != column_n {
            continue;
        }
        ImGuiID column_id = ImGui_TableGetColumnResizeID(table, column_n, cast(i32, table.InstanceCurrent));
        ImRect hit_rect;
        ImRect_init(&hit_rect, column.MaxX - hit_half_width, hit_y1, column.MaxX + hit_half_width, border_y2_hit);
        ImGui_ItemAdd(hit_rect, column_id, null, ImGuiItemFlags_NoNav);
        bool hovered = false;
        bool held = false;
        bool pressed = ImGui_ButtonBehavior(hit_rect, column_id, &hovered, &held, ImGuiButtonFlags_FlattenChildren | ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnClick | ImGuiButtonFlags_PressedOnDoubleClick | ImGuiButtonFlags_NoNavFocus);
        if pressed && ImGui_IsMouseDoubleClicked(0) {
            ImGui_TableSetColumnWidthAutoSingle(table, column_n);
            ImGui_ClearActiveID();
            held = false;
        }
        if held != 0 {
            if table.LastResizedColumn == -1 {
                table.ResizeLockMinContentsX2 = table.RightMostEnabledColumn != -1 ? table.Columns.Data[table.RightMostEnabledColumn].MaxX : cast(f32, -FLT_MAX);
            }
            table.ResizedColumn = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, column_n);
            table.InstanceInteracted = table.InstanceCurrent;
        }
        if hovered && g.HoveredIdTimer > TABLE_RESIZE_SEPARATOR_FEEDBACK_TIMER || held {
            table.HoveredColumnBorder = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, column_n);
            ImGui_SetMouseCursor(ImGuiMouseCursor_ResizeEW);
        }
    }
}

void ImGui_EndTable() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
    while true {
        if table != null == 0 {
            if ImGui_ErrorLog("EndTable() call should only be done while in BeginTable() scope!") != 0 {
                assert(table != null && "EndTable() call should only be done while in BeginTable() scope!");
            }
            return;
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    if table.IsLayoutLocked == 0 {
        ImGui_TableUpdateLayout(table);
    }
    ImGuiTableFlags flags = table.Flags;
    ImGuiWindow* inner_window = table.InnerWindow;
    ImGuiWindow* outer_window = table.OuterWindow;
    ImGuiTableTempData* temp_data = table.TempData;
    assert(inner_window == g.CurrentWindow && inner_window.ID == temp_data.WindowID);
    assert(outer_window == inner_window || outer_window == inner_window.ParentWindow);
    if table.IsInsideRow != 0 {
        ImGui_TableEndRow(table);
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiTableFlags_ContextMenuInBody) != 0 {
        if table.HoveredColumnBody != -1 && !ImGui_IsAnyItemHovered() && ImGui_IsMouseReleased(ImGuiMouseButton_Right) {
            ImGui_TableOpenContextMenu(cast(i32, table.HoveredColumnBody));

    inner_window.DC.PrevLineSize = temp_data.HostBackupPrevLineSize;
    inner_window.DC.CurrLineSize = temp_data.HostBackupCurrLineSize;
    inner_window.DC.CursorMaxPos = temp_data.HostBackupCursorMaxPos;
    f32 inner_content_max_y = ceil(table.RowPosY2);
    assert(table.RowPosY2 == inner_window.DC.CursorPos.y);
    if inner_window != outer_window {
        inner_window.DC.CursorMaxPos.y = inner_content_max_y;
    } else if (flags & ImGuiTableFlags_NoHostExtendY) == 0 {
        table.InnerRect.Max.y = ImMax(table.OuterRect.Max.y, inner_content_max_y);
        table.OuterRect.Max.y = table.InnerRect.Max.y;
    }
    table.WorkRect.Max.y = ImMax(table.WorkRect.Max.y, table.OuterRect.Max.y);
    table_instance.LastOuterHeight = ImRect_GetHeight(&table.OuterRect);
    if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_ScrollX) != 0 {
        f32 outer_padding_for_border = (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_BordersOuterV) != 0 ? TABLE_BORDER_SIZE : 0.0f;
        f32 max_pos_x = inner_window.DC.CursorMaxPos.x;
        if table.RightMostEnabledColumn != -1 {
            max_pos_x = ImMax(max_pos_x, table.Columns.Data[table.RightMostEnabledColumn].WorkMaxX + table.CellPaddingX + table.OuterPaddingX - outer_padding_for_border);
        }
        if table.ResizedColumn != -1 {
            max_pos_x = ImMax(max_pos_x, table.ResizeLockMinContentsX2);
        }
        inner_window.DC.CursorMaxPos.x = max_pos_x + table.TempData.AngledHeadersExtraWidth;
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiTableFlags_NoClip) == 0 {
        ImDrawList_PopClipRect(inner_window.DrawList);
    }
    ImVec4 zz_cr = *ImVector_ImVec4_back(&inner_window.DrawList._ClipRectStack); inner_window.ClipRect = ImRect{ImVec2{zz_cr.x, zz_cr.y}, ImVec2{zz_cr.z, zz_cr.w}};
    if (flags & ImGuiTableFlags_Borders) != 0 {
        ImGui_TableDrawBorders(table);
    }
    ImDrawListSplitter* splitter = table.DrawSplitter;
    ImDrawListSplitter_SetCurrentChannel(splitter, inner_window.DrawList, 0);
    if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_NoClip) == 0 {
        ImGui_TableMergeDrawChannels(table);
    }
    ImDrawListSplitter_Merge(splitter, inner_window.DrawList);
    f32 auto_fit_width_for_fixed = 0.0f;
    f32 auto_fit_width_for_stretched = 0.0f;
    f32 auto_fit_width_for_stretched_min = 0.0f;
    for i32 column_n = 0; column_n < table.ColumnsCount; column_n++ {
        if (table.EnabledMaskByIndex[column_n >> 5] & cast(ImU32, 1) << cast(u32, column_n & 31)) != 0 {
            ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
            f32 column_width_request = column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthFixed && !(column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoResize) ? column.WidthRequest : ImGui_TableGetColumnWidthAuto(table, column);
            if (column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthFixed) != 0 {
                auto_fit_width_for_fixed += column_width_request;
            } else {
                auto_fit_width_for_stretched += column_width_request;
            }
            if column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthStretch && (column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoResize) != 0 {
                auto_fit_width_for_stretched_min = ImMax(auto_fit_width_for_stretched_min, column_width_request / (column.StretchWeight / table.ColumnsStretchSumWeights));
            }
        }
    }
    f32 width_spacings = table.OuterPaddingX * 2.0f + (table.CellSpacingX1 + table.CellSpacingX2) * cast(f32, table.ColumnsEnabledCount - 1);
    table.ColumnsAutoFitWidth = width_spacings + table.CellPaddingX * 2.0f * cast(f32, table.ColumnsEnabledCount) + auto_fit_width_for_fixed + ImMax(auto_fit_width_for_stretched, auto_fit_width_for_stretched_min);
    if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_ScrollX) == 0 && inner_window != outer_window {
        inner_window.Scroll.x = 0.0f;
    } else if table.LastResizedColumn != -1 && table.ResizedColumn == -1 && inner_window.ScrollbarX && table.InstanceInteracted == table.InstanceCurrent {
        f32 neighbor_width_to_keep_visible = table.MinColumnWidth + table.CellPaddingX * 2.0f;
        ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[table.LastResizedColumn];
        if column.MaxX < table.InnerClipRect.Min.x {
            ImGui_SetScrollFromPosX(inner_window, column.MaxX - inner_window.Pos.x - neighbor_width_to_keep_visible, 1.0f);
        } else if column.MaxX > table.InnerClipRect.Max.x {
            ImGui_SetScrollFromPosX(inner_window, column.MaxX - inner_window.Pos.x + neighbor_width_to_keep_visible, 1.0f);
        }
    }
    if table.ResizedColumn != -1 && table.InstanceCurrent == table.InstanceInteracted {
        ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[table.ResizedColumn];
        f32 new_x2 = g.IO.MousePos.x - g.ActiveIdClickOffset.x + ImTrunc(TABLE_RESIZE_SEPARATOR_HALF_THICKNESS * g.CurrentDpiScale);
        f32 new_width = ImTrunc(new_x2 - column.MinX - table.CellSpacingX1 - table.CellPaddingX * 2.0f);
        table.ResizedColumnNextWidth = new_width;
    }
    table.IsActiveIdInTable = g.ActiveIdIsAlive != 0 && table.IsActiveIdAliveBeforeTable == false;
    while true {
        if *ImVector_ImGuiID_back(&inner_window.IDStack) == table_instance.TableInstanceID == 0 {
            if ImGui_ErrorLog("Mismatching PushID/PopID!") != 0 {
                assert(*ImVector_ImGuiID_back(&inner_window.IDStack) == table_instance.TableInstanceID && "Mismatching PushID/PopID!");
            }
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    while true {
        if outer_window.DC.ItemWidthStack.Size >= temp_data.HostBackupItemWidthStackSize == 0 {
            if ImGui_ErrorLog("Too many PopItemWidth!") != 0 {
                assert(outer_window.DC.ItemWidthStack.Size >= temp_data.HostBackupItemWidthStackSize && "Too many PopItemWidth!");
            }
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    if table.InstanceCurrent > 0 {
        ImGui_PopID();
    }
    ImGui_PopID();
    ImVec2 backup_outer_max_pos = outer_window.DC.CursorMaxPos;
    inner_window.WorkRect = temp_data.HostBackupWorkRect;
    inner_window.ParentWorkRect = temp_data.HostBackupParentWorkRect;
    inner_window.SkipItems = table.HostSkipItems;
    outer_window.DC.CursorPos = table.OuterRect.Min;
    outer_window.DC.ItemWidth = temp_data.HostBackupItemWidth;
    outer_window.DC.ItemWidthStack.Size = temp_data.HostBackupItemWidthStackSize;
    outer_window.DC.ColumnsOffset = temp_data.HostBackupColumnsOffset;
    if inner_window != outer_window {
        i16 backup_nav_layers_active_mask = inner_window.DC.NavLayersActiveMask;
        inner_window.DC.NavLayersActiveMask |= cast(i16, 1 << cast(i32, table.NavLayer));
        g.CurrentTable = null;
        ImGui_EndChild();
        g.CurrentTable = table;
        inner_window.DC.NavLayersActiveMask = backup_nav_layers_active_mask;
    } else {
        inner_window.DC.TreeDepth--;
        ImGui_ItemSize(ImRect_GetSize(&table.OuterRect));
        ImGui_ItemAdd(table.OuterRect, 0, null, 0);
    }
    if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_NoHostExtendX) != 0 {
        assert((table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_ScrollX) == 0);
        outer_window.DC.CursorMaxPos.x = ImMax(backup_outer_max_pos.x, table.OuterRect.Min.x + table.ColumnsAutoFitWidth);
    } else if temp_data.UserOuterSize.x <= 0.0f {
        f32 outer_content_max_x = table.OuterRect.Min.x + table.ColumnsAutoFitWidth;
        f32 decoration_size = table.TempData.AngledHeadersExtraWidth + (inner_window != outer_window ? inner_window.ScrollbarSizes.x : 0.0f);
        outer_window.DC.IdealMaxPos.x = ImMax(outer_window.DC.IdealMaxPos.x, outer_content_max_x + decoration_size - temp_data.UserOuterSize.x);
        outer_window.DC.CursorMaxPos.x = ImMax(backup_outer_max_pos.x, ImMin(table.OuterRect.Max.x, outer_content_max_x + decoration_size));
    } else {
        outer_window.DC.CursorMaxPos.x = ImMax(backup_outer_max_pos.x, table.OuterRect.Max.x);
    }
    if temp_data.UserOuterSize.y <= 0.0f {
        f32 outer_content_size_y = inner_window == outer_window ? inner_content_max_y - table.InnerRect.Min.y : inner_content_max_y - inner_window.DC.CursorStartPos.y;
        f32 outer_content_max_y = table.OuterRect.Min.y + outer_content_size_y;
        f32 decoration_size = inner_window != outer_window ? inner_window.ScrollbarSizes.y : 0.0f;
        outer_window.DC.IdealMaxPos.y = ImMax(outer_window.DC.IdealMaxPos.y, outer_content_max_y + decoration_size - temp_data.UserOuterSize.y);
        outer_window.DC.CursorMaxPos.y = ImMax(backup_outer_max_pos.y, ImMin(table.OuterRect.Max.y, outer_content_max_y + decoration_size));
    } else {
        outer_window.DC.CursorMaxPos.y = ImMax(backup_outer_max_pos.y, table.OuterRect.Max.y);
    }
    if table.IsSettingsDirty != 0 {
        ImGui_TableSaveSettings(table);
    }
    table.IsInitializing = false;
    assert(g.CurrentWindow == outer_window && g.CurrentTable == table);
    assert(g.TablesTempDataStacked > 0);
    temp_data = --g.TablesTempDataStacked > 0 ? &g.TablesTempData.Data[g.TablesTempDataStacked - 1] : null;
    g.CurrentTable = temp_data && temp_data.WindowID == outer_window.ID ? ImPool_ImGuiTable_GetByIndex(&g.Tables, temp_data.TableIndex) : null;
    if g.CurrentTable != null {
        g.CurrentTable.TempData = temp_data;
        g.CurrentTable.DrawSplitter = &temp_data.DrawSplitter;
    }
    outer_window.DC.CurrentTableIdx = g.CurrentTable != null ? ImPool_ImGuiTable_GetIndex(&g.Tables, g.CurrentTable) : -1;
    ImGui_NavUpdateCurrentWindowIsScrollPushableX();
}

// Called in TableUpdateLayout() when initializing/after loading settings.

void ImGui_TableInitColumnDefaults(ImGuiTable* table, ImGuiTableColumn* column, ImGuiTableColumnFlags init_mask) {
    ImGuiTableColumnFlags flags = column.Flags;
    if (init_mask & ImGuiTableFlags_Resizable) != 0 {
        f32 init_width_or_weight = column.InitStretchWeightOrWidth;
        column.WidthRequest = flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthFixed && init_width_or_weight > 0.0f ? init_width_or_weight : -1.0f;
        column.StretchWeight = init_width_or_weight > 0.0f && flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthStretch ? init_width_or_weight : -1.0f;
        if init_width_or_weight > 0.0f {
            column.AutoFitQueue = 0x00;
        }
    }
    if (init_mask & ImGuiTableFlags_Reorderable) != 0 {
        column.DisplayOrder = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_Reorderable) != 0 ? -1 : ImSpan_ImGuiTableColumn_index_from_ptr(&table.Columns, column));
    }
    if (init_mask & ImGuiTableFlags_Hideable) != 0 {
        column.IsUserEnabledNextFrame = ((flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_DefaultHide) != 0 ? 0 : 1) != 0;
        column.IsUserEnabled = column.IsUserEnabledNextFrame;
    }
    if (init_mask & ImGuiTableFlags_Sortable) != 0 {
        column.SortOrder = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, (flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_DefaultSort) != 0 ? 0 : -1);
        column.SortDirection = cast(ImU8, (flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_DefaultSort) != 0 ? (flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_PreferSortDescending) != 0 ? cast(ImS8, ImGuiSortDirection_Descending) : cast(ImU8, ImGuiSortDirection_Ascending) : cast(ImS8, ImGuiSortDirection_None));
    }
}

// See "COLUMNS SIZING POLICIES" comments at the top of this file
// If (init_width_or_weight <= 0.0f) it is ignored
private {
void TableSetupColumnApply(ImGuiTable* table, i32 idx, ImGuiID id, ImS16 name_offset, ImGuiTableColumnFlags flags, f32 init_width_or_weight, ImGuiID user_data) {
    ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[idx];
    if table.IsDefaultSizingPolicy && (flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthMask_) == 0 && (flags & ImGuiTableFlags_ScrollX) == 0 {
        while true {
            if init_width_or_weight <= 0.0f == 0 {
                if ImGui_ErrorLog("TableSetupColumn(): can only specify width/weight if sizing policy is set explicitly in either Table or Column.") != 0 {
                    assert(init_width_or_weight <= 0.0f && "TableSetupColumn(): can only specify width/weight if sizing policy is set explicitly in either Table or Column.");
                }
                return;
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthMask_) == 0 && init_width_or_weight > 0.0f {
        if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_SizingMask_) == ImGuiTableFlags_SizingFixedFit || (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_SizingMask_) == ImGuiTableFlags_SizingFixedSame {
            flags |= ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthFixed;
        }
    }
    if (flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_AngledHeader) != 0 {
        flags |= ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoHeaderLabel;
        table.AngledHeadersCount++;
    }
    TableSetupColumnFlags(table, column, flags);
    column.ID = id;
    column.UserData = user_data;
    column.NameOffset = name_offset;
    column.InitStretchWeightOrWidth = init_width_or_weight;
}
}

void ImGui_TableSetupColumn(u8* label, ImGuiTableColumnFlags flags, f32 init_width_or_weight, ImGuiID user_data) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;

    while true {

                assert(table != null && "Call should only be done while in BeginTable() scope!");
            }

        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    while true {
        if table.DeclColumnsCount < table.ColumnsCount == 0 {

// [Public]
void ImGui_TableSetupScrollFreeze(i32 columns, i32 rows) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
    while true {
        if table != null == 0 {
            if ImGui_ErrorLog("Call should only be done while in BeginTable() scope!") != 0 {
                assert(table != null && "Call should only be done while in BeginTable() scope!");
            }
            return;
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    assert(table.IsLayoutLocked == false && "TableSetupColumn(): need to call before first row!");
    assert(columns >= 0 && columns < 512);
    assert(rows >= 0 && rows < 128);
    table.FreezeColumnsRequest = (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_ScrollX) != 0 ? cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, ImMin(columns, table.ColumnsCount)) : 0;
    table.FreezeColumnsCount = table.InnerWindow.Scroll.x != 0.0f ? table.FreezeColumnsRequest : 0;
    table.FreezeRowsRequest = (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_ScrollY) != 0 ? cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, rows) : 0;
    table.FreezeRowsCount = table.InnerWindow.Scroll.y != 0.0f ? table.FreezeRowsRequest : 0;
    table.IsUnfrozenRows = table.FreezeRowsCount == 0;
}

i32 ImGui_TableGetColumnCount() {

    return table != null ? table.ColumnsCount : 0;
}

u8* ImGui_TableGetColumnName(i32 column_n) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
    if table == null {
        return null;

    if column_n < 0 {
        column_n = table.CurrentColumn;
    }
    return ImGui_TableGetColumnName(table, column_n);
}

u8* ImGui_TableGetColumnName(ImGuiTable* table, i32 column_n) {
    if table.IsLayoutLocked == false && column_n >= table.DeclColumnsCount {
        return "";
    }
    ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
    if column.NameOffset == -1 {

}

// Change user accessible enabled/disabled state of a column (often perceived as "showing/hiding" from users point of view)
// Note that end-user can use the context menu to change this themselves (right-click in headers, or right-click in columns body with ImGuiTableFlags_ContextMenuInBody)
// - Require table to have the ImGuiTableFlags_Hideable flag because we are manipulating user accessible state.
// - Request will be applied during next layout, which happens on the first call to TableNextRow() after BeginTable().
// - For the getter you can test (TableGetColumnFlags() & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_IsEnabled) != 0.
// - Alternative: the ImGuiTableColumnFlags_Disabled is an overriding/master disable flag which will also hide the column from context menu.
void ImGui_TableSetColumnEnabled(i32 column_n, bool enabled) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
    while true {
        if table != null == 0 {
            if ImGui_ErrorLog("Call should only be done while in BeginTable() scope!") != 0 {
                assert(table != null && "Call should only be done while in BeginTable() scope!");
            }
            return;
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    assert(table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_Hideable);
    if column_n < 0 {
        column_n = table.CurrentColumn;
    }
    assert(column_n >= 0 && column_n < table.ColumnsCount);
    ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
    column.IsUserEnabledNextFrame = enabled;
}

// We allow querying for an extra column in order to poll the IsHovered state of the right-most section
ImGuiTableColumnFlags ImGui_TableGetColumnFlags(i32 column_n) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
    if table == null {
        return ImGuiTableColumnFlags_None;
    }
    if column_n < 0 {
        column_n = table.CurrentColumn;
    }
    if column_n == table.ColumnsCount {
        return table.HoveredColumnBody == column_n ? ImGuiTableColumnFlags_IsHovered : ImGuiTableColumnFlags_None;
    }
    return table.Columns.Data[column_n].Flags;
}

// Return the cell rectangle based on currently known height.
// - Important: we generally don't know our row height until the end of the row, so Max.y will be incorrect in many situations.
//   The only case where this is correct is if we provided a min_row_height to TableNextRow() and don't go below it, or in TableEndRow() when we locked that height.
// - Important: if ImGuiTableFlags_PadOuterX is set but ImGuiTableFlags_PadInnerX is not set, the outer-most left and right
//   columns report a small offset so their CellBgRect can extend up to the outer border.
//   FIXME: But the rendering code in TableEndRow() nullifies that with clamping required for scrolling.
ImRect ImGui_TableGetCellBgRect(ImGuiTable* table, i32 column_n) {
    ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
    f32 x1 = column.MinX;
    f32 x2 = column.MaxX;
    x1 = ImMax(x1, table.WorkRect.Min.x);
    x2 = ImMin(x2, table.WorkRect.Max.x);
    return ImRect{ImVec2{x1, table.RowPosY1}, ImVec2{x2, table.RowPosY2}};
}

// Return the resizing ID for the right-side of the given column.
ImGuiID ImGui_TableGetColumnResizeID(ImGuiTable* table, i32 column_n, i32 instance_no) {
    assert(column_n >= 0 && column_n < table.ColumnsCount);
    ImGuiID instance_id = ImGui_TableGetInstanceID(table, instance_no);
    return instance_id + 1 + cast(u32, column_n);
}

// Return -1 when table is not hovered. return columns_count if hovering the unused space at the right of the right-most visible column.
i32 ImGui_TableGetHoveredColumn() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
    if table == null {
        return -1;
    }
    return cast(i32, table.HoveredColumnBody);
}

// Return -1 when table is not hovered. Return maxrow+1 if in table but below last submitted row.
// *IMPORTANT* Unlike TableGetHoveredColumn(), this has a one frame latency in updating the value.
// This difference with is the reason why this is not public yet.
i32 ImGui_TableGetHoveredRow() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
    if table == null {
        return -1;
    }
    ImGuiTableInstanceData* table_instance = ImGui_TableGetInstanceData(table, table.InstanceCurrent);
    return table_instance.HoveredRowLast;
}

void ImGui_TableSetBgColor(ImGuiTableBgTarget target, ImU32 color, i32 column_n) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
    while true {
        if table != null == 0 {
            if ImGui_ErrorLog("Call should only be done while in BeginTable() scope!") != 0 {
                assert(table != null && "Call should only be done while in BeginTable() scope!");
            }
            return;
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    assert(target != ImGuiTableBgTarget_None);
    if color == (cast(ImU32, 1) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 0) {
        color = 0;
    }
    switch target {
        case ImGuiTableBgTarget_CellBg: {
            {
                if table.RowPosY1 > table.InnerClipRect.Max.y {
                    return;
                }
                if column_n == -1 {
                    column_n = table.CurrentColumn;
                }
                if (table.VisibleMaskByIndex[column_n >> 5] & cast(ImU32, 1) << cast(u32, column_n & 31)) != 0 == 0 {
                    return;
                }
                if table.RowCellDataCurrent < 0 || table.RowCellData.Data[table.RowCellDataCurrent].Column != column_n {
                    table.RowCellDataCurrent++;
                }
                ImGuiTableCellData* cell_data = &table.RowCellData.Data[table.RowCellDataCurrent];
                cell_data.BgColor = color;
                cell_data.Column = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, column_n);
                break case;
            }
        }
        case ImGuiTableBgTarget_RowBg0, ImGuiTableBgTarget_RowBg1: {
            {
                if table.RowPosY1 > table.InnerClipRect.Max.y {
                    return;
                }
                assert(column_n == -1);
                i32 bg_idx = target == ImGuiTableBgTarget_RowBg1 ? 1 : 0;
                table.RowBgColor[bg_idx] = color;
                break case;
            }
        }
        default: {
            assert(0);
        }
    }
}

// [Public] Starts into the first cell of a new row
void ImGui_TableNextRow(ImGuiTableRowFlags row_flags, f32 row_min_height) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
    if table.IsLayoutLocked == 0 {
        ImGui_TableUpdateLayout(table);
    }
    if table.IsInsideRow != 0 {
        ImGui_TableEndRow(table);
    }
    table.LastRowFlags = table.RowFlags;
    table.RowFlags = row_flags;
    table.RowCellPaddingY = g.Style.CellPadding.y;
    table.RowMinHeight = row_min_height;
    ImGui_TableBeginRow(table);
    table.RowPosY2 += table.RowCellPaddingY * 2.0f;
    table.RowPosY2 = ImMax(table.RowPosY2, table.RowPosY1 + row_min_height);
    table.InnerWindow.SkipItems = true;
}

// [Internal] Only called by TableNextRow()
void ImGui_TableBeginRow(ImGuiTable* table) {
    ImGuiWindow* window = table.InnerWindow;
    assert(cast(i64, !table.IsInsideRow));
    table.CurrentRow++;
    table.CurrentColumn = -1;
    table.RowBgColor[1] = cast(ImU32, 1) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 0;
    table.RowBgColor[0] = table.RowBgColor[1];
    table.RowCellDataCurrent = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, -1);
    table.IsInsideRow = true;
    f32 next_y1 = table.RowPosY2;
    if table.CurrentRow == 0 && table.FreezeRowsCount > 0 {
        window.DC.CursorPos.y = table.OuterRect.Min.y;
        next_y1 = window.DC.CursorPos.y;
    }
    table.RowPosY2 = next_y1;
    table.RowPosY1 = table.RowPosY2;
    table.RowTextBaseline = 0.0f;
    table.RowIndentOffsetX = window.DC.Indent.x - table.HostIndentX;
    window.DC.PrevLineTextBaseOffset = 0.0f;
    window.DC.CursorPosPrevLine = ImVec2{
        window.DC.CursorPos.x, window.DC.CursorPos.y + table.RowCellPaddingY,
    };
    window.DC.CurrLineSize = ImVec2{0.0f, 0.0f};
    window.DC.PrevLineSize = window.DC.CurrLineSize;
    window.DC.IsSetPos = false;
    window.DC.IsSameLine = window.DC.IsSetPos;
    window.DC.CursorMaxPos.y = next_y1;
    if (table.RowFlags & ImGuiTableRowFlags_Headers) != 0 {
        ImGui_TableSetBgColor(ImGuiTableBgTarget_RowBg0, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_TableHeaderBg));
        if table.CurrentRow == 0 {
            table.IsUsingHeaders = true;
        }
    }
}

// [Internal] Called by TableNextRow()
void ImGui_TableEndRow(ImGuiTable* table) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    assert(window == table.InnerWindow);
    assert(cast(i64, table.IsInsideRow));
    if table.CurrentColumn != -1 {
        ImGui_TableEndCell(table);
        table.CurrentColumn = -1;
    }
    if g.LogEnabled != 0 {
        ImGui_LogRenderedText(null, "|", null);
    }
    window.DC.CursorPos.y = table.RowPosY2;
    f32 bg_y1 = table.RowPosY1;
    f32 bg_y2 = table.RowPosY2;
    bool unfreeze_rows_actual = table.CurrentRow + 1 == table.FreezeRowsCount;
    bool unfreeze_rows_request = table.CurrentRow + 1 == table.FreezeRowsRequest;
    ImGuiTableInstanceData* table_instance = ImGui_TableGetInstanceData(table, table.InstanceCurrent);
    if table.RowFlags & ImGuiTableRowFlags_Headers && (table.CurrentRow == 0 || table.LastRowFlags & ImGuiTableRowFlags_Headers) {
        table_instance.LastTopHeadersRowHeight += bg_y2 - bg_y1;
    }
    bool is_visible = bg_y2 >= table.InnerClipRect.Min.y && bg_y1 <= table.InnerClipRect.Max.y;
    if is_visible != 0 {
        if table.HoveredColumnBody != -1 && g.IO.MousePos.y >= bg_y1 && g.IO.MousePos.y < bg_y2 && table_instance.HoveredRowNext < 0 {
            table_instance.HoveredRowNext = table.CurrentRow;
        }
        ImU32 bg_col0 = 0;
        ImU32 bg_col1 = 0;
        if table.RowBgColor[0] != (cast(ImU32, 1) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 0) {
            bg_col0 = table.RowBgColor[0];
        } else if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_RowBg) != 0 {
            bg_col0 = ImGui_GetColorU32((table.RowBgColorCounter & 1) != 0 ? ImGuiCol_TableRowBgAlt : ImGuiCol_TableRowBg);
        }
        if table.RowBgColor[1] != (cast(ImU32, 1) << 24 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 16 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 8 | cast(ImU32, 0) << 0) {
            bg_col1 = table.RowBgColor[1];
        }
        ImU32 top_border_col = 0;
        f32 border_size = TABLE_BORDER_SIZE;
        if table.CurrentRow > 0 && table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_BordersInnerH {
            top_border_col = (table.LastRowFlags & ImGuiTableRowFlags_Headers) != 0 ? table.BorderColorStrong : table.BorderColorLight;
        }
        bool draw_cell_bg_color = table.RowCellDataCurrent >= 0;
        bool draw_strong_bottom_border = unfreeze_rows_actual;
        if (bg_col0 | bg_col1 | top_border_col) != 0 || draw_strong_bottom_border || draw_cell_bg_color {
            if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_NoClip) == 0 {
                window.DrawList._CmdHeader.ClipRect = ImRect_ToVec4(&table.Bg0ClipRectForDrawCmd);
            }
            ImDrawListSplitter_SetCurrentChannel(table.DrawSplitter, window.DrawList, TABLE_DRAW_CHANNEL_BG0);
        }
        if bg_col0 || bg_col1 {
            ImRect row_rect;
            ImRect_init(&row_rect, table.WorkRect.Min.x, bg_y1, table.WorkRect.Max.x, bg_y2);
            ImRect_ClipWith(&row_rect, table.BgClipRect);
            if bg_col0 != 0 && row_rect.Min.y < row_rect.Max.y {
                ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(window.DrawList, row_rect.Min, row_rect.Max, bg_col0, 0.0f, 0);
            }
            if bg_col1 != 0 && row_rect.Min.y < row_rect.Max.y {
                ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(window.DrawList, row_rect.Min, row_rect.Max, bg_col1, 0.0f, 0);
            }
        }
        if draw_cell_bg_color != 0 {
            ImGuiTableCellData* cell_data_end = &table.RowCellData.Data[table.RowCellDataCurrent];
            for ImGuiTableCellData* cell_data = &table.RowCellData.Data[0]; cell_data <= cell_data_end; cell_data++ {
                ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[cell_data.Column];
                ImRect cell_bg_rect = ImGui_TableGetCellBgRect(table, cast(i32, cell_data.Column));
                ImRect_ClipWith(&cell_bg_rect, table.BgClipRect);
                cell_bg_rect.Min.x = ImMax(cell_bg_rect.Min.x, column.ClipRect.Min.x);
                cell_bg_rect.Max.x = ImMin(cell_bg_rect.Max.x, column.MaxX);
                if cell_bg_rect.Min.y < cell_bg_rect.Max.y {
                    ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(window.DrawList, cell_bg_rect.Min, cell_bg_rect.Max, cell_data.BgColor, 0.0f, 0);
                }
            }
        }
        if top_border_col && bg_y1 >= table.BgClipRect.Min.y && bg_y1 < table.BgClipRect.Max.y {
            ImDrawList_AddLineH(window.DrawList, table.BorderX1, table.BorderX2, bg_y1, top_border_col, border_size);
        }
        if draw_strong_bottom_border && bg_y2 >= table.BgClipRect.Min.y && bg_y2 < table.BgClipRect.Max.y {
            ImDrawList_AddLineH(window.DrawList, table.BorderX1, table.BorderX2, bg_y2, table.BorderColorStrong, border_size);
        }
    }
    if unfreeze_rows_request != 0 {
        assert(table.FreezeRowsRequest > 0);
        for i32 column_n = 0; column_n < table.ColumnsCount; column_n++ {
            table.Columns.Data[column_n].NavLayerCurrent = table.NavLayer;
        }
        f32 y0 = ImMax(table.RowPosY2 + 1.0f, table.InnerClipRect.Min.y);
        table_instance.LastFrozenHeight = y0 - table.OuterRect.Min.y;
        if unfreeze_rows_actual != 0 {
            assert(table.IsUnfrozenRows == false);
            table.IsUnfrozenRows = true;
            table.Bg2ClipRectForDrawCmd.Min.y = ImMin(y0, table.InnerClipRect.Max.y);
            table.BgClipRect.Min.y = table.Bg2ClipRectForDrawCmd.Min.y;
            table.Bg2ClipRectForDrawCmd.Max.y = table.InnerClipRect.Max.y;
            table.BgClipRect.Max.y = table.Bg2ClipRectForDrawCmd.Max.y;
            table.Bg2DrawChannelCurrent = table.Bg2DrawChannelUnfrozen;
            assert(table.Bg2ClipRectForDrawCmd.Min.y <= table.Bg2ClipRectForDrawCmd.Max.y);
            f32 row_height = table.RowPosY2 - table.RowPosY1;
            window.DC.CursorPos.y = table.WorkRect.Min.y + table.RowPosY2 - table.OuterRect.Min.y;
            table.RowPosY2 = window.DC.CursorPos.y;
            table.RowPosY1 = table.RowPosY2 - row_height;
            for i32 column_n = 0; column_n < table.ColumnsCount; column_n++ {
                ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
                column.DrawChannelCurrent = column.DrawChannelUnfrozen;
                column.ClipRect.Min.y = table.Bg2ClipRectForDrawCmd.Min.y;
            }
            ImGui_SetWindowClipRectBeforeSetChannel(window, table.Columns.Data[0].ClipRect);
            ImDrawListSplitter_SetCurrentChannel(table.DrawSplitter, window.DrawList, cast(i32, table.Columns.Data[0].DrawChannelCurrent));
        }
    }
    if (table.RowFlags & ImGuiTableRowFlags_Headers) == 0 {
        table.RowBgColorCounter++;
    }
    table.IsInsideRow = false;
}
