i32 ImGui_TableGetColumnIndex() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
    if table == null {
        return 0;
    }
    return table.CurrentColumn;
}

// [Public] Append into a specific column
bool ImGui_TableSetColumnIndex(i32 column_n) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
    if table == null {
        return false;
    }
    if table.CurrentColumn != column_n {
        if table.CurrentColumn != -1 {
            ImGui_TableEndCell(table);
        }
        while true {
            if (column_n >= 0 && column_n < table.ColumnsCount) == 0 {
                if ImGui_ErrorLog("TableSetColumnIndex() invalid column index!") != 0 {
                    assert(column_n >= 0 && column_n < table.ColumnsCount && "TableSetColumnIndex() invalid column index!");
                }
                return false;
            }
            if !(0 != 0) { break; }
        }
        ImGui_TableBeginCell(table, column_n);
    }
    return table.Columns.Data[column_n].IsRequestOutput;
}

// [Public] Append into the next column, wrap and create a new row when already on last column
bool ImGui_TableNextColumn() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
    if table == null {
        return false;
    }
    if table.IsInsideRow && table.CurrentColumn + 1 < table.ColumnsCount {
        if table.CurrentColumn != -1 {
            ImGui_TableEndCell(table);
        }
        ImGui_TableBeginCell(table, table.CurrentColumn + 1);
    } else {
        ImGui_TableNextRow();
        ImGui_TableBeginCell(table, 0);
    }
    return table.Columns.Data[table.CurrentColumn].IsRequestOutput;
}

// [Internal] Called by TableSetColumnIndex()/TableNextColumn()
// This is called very frequently, so we need to be mindful of unnecessary overhead.
// FIXME-TABLE FIXME-OPT: Could probably shortcut some things for non-active or clipped columns.
void ImGui_TableBeginCell(ImGuiTable* table, i32 column_n) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
    ImGuiWindow* window = table.InnerWindow;
    table.CurrentColumn = column_n;
    f32 start_x = column.WorkMinX;
    if (column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_IndentEnable) != 0 {
        start_x += table.RowIndentOffsetX;
    }
    window.DC.CursorPos.x = start_x;
    window.DC.CursorPos.y = table.RowPosY1 + table.RowCellPaddingY;
    window.DC.CursorMaxPos.x = window.DC.CursorPos.x;
    window.DC.ColumnsOffset.x = start_x - window.Pos.x - window.DC.Indent.x;
    window.DC.CursorPosPrevLine.x = window.DC.CursorPos.x;
    window.DC.CurrLineTextBaseOffset = table.RowTextBaseline;
    window.DC.NavLayerCurrent = cast(ImGuiNavLayer, column.NavLayerCurrent);
    window.WorkRect.Min.y = window.DC.CursorPos.y;
    window.WorkRect.Min.x = column.WorkMinX;
    window.WorkRect.Max.x = column.WorkMaxX;
    window.DC.ItemWidth = column.ItemWidth;
    window.SkipItems = column.IsSkipItems;
    if column.IsSkipItems != 0 {
        g.LastItemData.ID = 0;
        g.LastItemData.StatusFlags = 0;
    }
    if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_NoClip) != 0 {
        ImDrawListSplitter_SetCurrentChannel(table.DrawSplitter, window.DrawList, TABLE_DRAW_CHANNEL_NOCLIP);
    } else {
        ImGui_SetWindowClipRectBeforeSetChannel(window, column.ClipRect);
        ImDrawListSplitter_SetCurrentChannel(table.DrawSplitter, window.DrawList, cast(i32, column.DrawChannelCurrent));
    }
    if g.LogEnabled && !column.IsSkipItems {
        ImGui_LogRenderedText(&window.DC.CursorPos, "|", null);
        g.LogLinePosY = FLT_MAX;
    }
}

// [Internal] Called by TableNextRow()/TableSetColumnIndex()/TableNextColumn()
void ImGui_TableEndCell(ImGuiTable* table) {
    ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[table.CurrentColumn];
    ImGuiWindow* window = table.InnerWindow;
    if window.DC.IsSetPos != 0 {
        ImGui_ErrorCheckUsingSetCursorPosToExtendParentBoundaries();
    }
    f32* p_max_pos_x;
    if (table.RowFlags & ImGuiTableRowFlags_Headers) != 0 {
        p_max_pos_x = &column.ContentMaxXHeadersUsed;
    } else {
        p_max_pos_x = table.IsUnfrozenRows != 0 ? &column.ContentMaxXUnfrozen : &column.ContentMaxXFrozen;
    }
    *p_max_pos_x = ImMax(*p_max_pos_x, window.DC.CursorMaxPos.x);
    if column.IsEnabled != 0 {
        table.RowPosY2 = ImMax(table.RowPosY2, window.DC.CursorMaxPos.y + table.RowCellPaddingY);
    }
    column.ItemWidth = window.DC.ItemWidth;
    table.RowTextBaseline = ImMax(table.RowTextBaseline, window.DC.PrevLineTextBaseOffset);
}

// Note that actual columns widths are computed in TableUpdateLayout().
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Maximum column content width given current layout. Use column->MinX so this value differs on a per-column basis.
f32 ImGui_TableCalcMaxColumnWidth(ImGuiTable* table, i32 column_n) {
    ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
    f32 max_width = FLT_MAX;
    f32 min_column_distance = table.MinColumnWidth + table.CellPaddingX * 2.0f + table.CellSpacingX1 + table.CellSpacingX2;
    if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_ScrollX) != 0 {
        if column.DisplayOrder < table.FreezeColumnsRequest {
            max_width = table.InnerClipRect.Max.x - cast(f32, table.FreezeColumnsRequest - column.DisplayOrder) * min_column_distance - column.MinX;
            max_width = max_width - table.OuterPaddingX - table.CellPaddingX - table.CellSpacingX2;
        }
    } else if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_NoKeepColumnsVisible) == 0 {
        max_width = table.WorkRect.Max.x - cast(f32, table.ColumnsEnabledCount - column.IndexWithinEnabledSet - 1) * min_column_distance - column.MinX;
        max_width -= table.CellSpacingX2;
        max_width -= table.CellPaddingX * 2.0f;
        max_width -= table.OuterPaddingX;
    }
    return max_width;
}

// Note this is meant to be stored in column->WidthAuto, please generally use the WidthAuto field
f32 ImGui_TableGetColumnWidthAuto(ImGuiTable* table, ImGuiTableColumn* column) {
    f32 content_width_body = ImMax(column.ContentMaxXFrozen, column.ContentMaxXUnfrozen) - column.WorkMinX;
    f32 content_width_headers = column.ContentMaxXHeadersIdeal - column.WorkMinX;
    f32 width_auto = content_width_body;
    if (column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoHeaderWidth) == 0 {
        width_auto = ImMax(width_auto, content_width_headers);
    }
    if column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthFixed && column.InitStretchWeightOrWidth > 0.0f {
        if !(table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_Resizable) || column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoResize {
            width_auto = column.InitStretchWeightOrWidth;
        }
    }
    return ImMax(width_auto, table.MinColumnWidth);
}

// 'width' = inner column width, without padding
void ImGui_TableSetColumnWidth(i32 column_n, f32 width) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
    assert(table != null && table.IsLayoutLocked == false);
    assert(column_n >= 0 && column_n < table.ColumnsCount);
    ImGuiTableColumn* column_0 = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
    f32 column_0_width = width;
    assert(table.MinColumnWidth > 0.0f);
    f32 min_width = table.MinColumnWidth;
    f32 max_width = ImMax(min_width, column_0.WidthMax);
    column_0_width = ImClamp(column_0_width, min_width, max_width);
    if column_0.WidthGiven == column_0_width || column_0.WidthRequest == column_0_width {
        return;
    }
    ImGuiTableColumn* column_1 = column_0.NextEnabledColumn != -1 ? &table.Columns.Data[column_0.NextEnabledColumn] : null;
    if (column_0.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthFixed) != 0 {
        if !column_1 || table.LeftMostStretchedColumn == -1 || table.Columns.Data[table.LeftMostStretchedColumn].DisplayOrder >= column_0.DisplayOrder {
            column_0.WidthRequest = column_0_width;
            table.IsSettingsDirty = true;
            return;
        }
    }
    if column_1 == null {
        column_1 = column_0.PrevEnabledColumn != -1 ? &table.Columns.Data[column_0.PrevEnabledColumn] : null;
    }
    if column_1 == null {
        return;
    }
    f32 column_1_width = ImMax(column_1.WidthRequest - (column_0_width - column_0.WidthRequest), min_width);
    column_0_width = column_0.WidthRequest + column_1.WidthRequest - column_1_width;
    assert(column_0_width > 0.0f && column_1_width > 0.0f);
    column_0.WidthRequest = column_0_width;
    column_1.WidthRequest = column_1_width;
    if ((column_0.Flags | column_1.Flags) & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthStretch) != 0 {
        ImGui_TableUpdateColumnsWeightFromWidth(table);
    }
    table.IsSettingsDirty = true;
}

// Disable clipping then auto-fit, will take 2 frames
// (we don't take a shortcut for unclipped columns to reduce inconsistencies when e.g. resizing multiple columns)
void ImGui_TableSetColumnWidthAutoSingle(ImGuiTable* table, i32 column_n) {
    ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
    if column.IsEnabled == 0 {
        return;
    }
    column.CannotSkipItemsQueue = cast(ImU8, 1 << 0);
    table.AutoFitSingleColumn = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, column_n);
}

void ImGui_TableSetColumnWidthAutoAll(ImGuiTable* table) {
    for i32 column_n = 0; column_n < table.ColumnsCount; column_n++ {
        ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
        if !column.IsEnabled && !(column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthStretch) {
            continue;
        }
        column.CannotSkipItemsQueue = cast(ImU8, 1 << 0);
        column.AutoFitQueue = cast(ImU8, 1 << 1);
    }
}

void ImGui_TableUpdateColumnsWeightFromWidth(ImGuiTable* table) {
    assert(table.LeftMostStretchedColumn != -1 && table.RightMostStretchedColumn != -1);
    f32 visible_weight = 0.0f;
    f32 visible_width = 0.0f;
    for i32 column_n = 0; column_n < table.ColumnsCount; column_n++ {
        ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
        if !column.IsEnabled || !(column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthStretch) {
            continue;
        }
        assert(column.StretchWeight > 0.0f);
        visible_weight += column.StretchWeight;
        visible_width += column.WidthRequest;
    }
    assert(visible_weight > 0.0f && visible_width > 0.0f);
    for i32 column_n = 0; column_n < table.ColumnsCount; column_n++ {
        ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
        if !column.IsEnabled || !(column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthStretch) {
            continue;
        }
        column.StretchWeight = column.WidthRequest / visible_width * visible_weight;
        assert(column.StretchWeight > 0.0f);
    }
}

// Allocate draw channels. Called by TableUpdateLayout()
// - We allocate them following storage order instead of display order so reordering columns won't needlessly
//   increase overall dormant memory cost.
// - We isolate headers draw commands in their own channels instead of just altering clip rects.
//   This is in order to facilitate merging of draw commands.
// - After crossing FreezeRowsCount, all columns see their current draw channel changed to a second set of channels.
// - We only use the dummy draw channel so we can push a null clipping rectangle into it without affecting other
//   channels, while simplifying per-row/per-cell overhead. It will be empty and discarded when merged.
// - We allocate 1 or 2 background draw channels. This is because we know TablePushBackgroundChannel() is only used for
//   horizontal spanning. If we allowed vertical spanning we'd need one background draw channel per merge group (1-4).
// Draw channel allocation (before merging):
// - NoClip                       --> 2+D+1 channels: bg0/1 + bg2 + foreground (same clip rect == always 1 draw call)
// - Clip                         --> 2+D+N channels
// - FreezeRows                   --> 2+D+N*2 (unless scrolling value is zero)
// - FreezeRows || FreezeColumns  --> 3+D+N*2 (unless scrolling value is zero)
// Where D is 1 if any column is clipped or hidden (dummy channel) otherwise 0.
void ImGui_TableSetupDrawChannels(ImGuiTable* table) {
    i32 freeze_row_multiplier = table.FreezeRowsCount > 0 ? 2 : 1;
    i32 channels_for_row = (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_NoClip) != 0 ? 1 : table.ColumnsEnabledCount;
    i32 channels_for_bg = 1 + 1 * freeze_row_multiplier;
    i32 channels_for_dummy = table.ColumnsEnabledCount < table.ColumnsCount || memcmp(table.VisibleMaskByIndex, table.EnabledMaskByIndex, ImBitArrayGetStorageSizeInBytes(table.ColumnsCount)) != 0 ? 1 : 0;
    i32 channels_total = channels_for_bg + channels_for_row * freeze_row_multiplier + channels_for_dummy;
    ImDrawListSplitter_Split(table.DrawSplitter, table.InnerWindow.DrawList, channels_total);
    table.DummyDrawChannel = cast(ImGuiTableDrawChannelIdx, channels_for_dummy > 0 ? channels_total - 1 : -1);
    table.Bg2DrawChannelCurrent = cast(ImGuiTableDrawChannelIdx, TABLE_DRAW_CHANNEL_BG2_FROZEN);
    table.Bg2DrawChannelUnfrozen = cast(ImGuiTableDrawChannelIdx, table.FreezeRowsCount > 0 ? 2 + channels_for_row : TABLE_DRAW_CHANNEL_BG2_FROZEN);
    i32 draw_channel_current = 2;
    for i32 column_n = 0; column_n < table.ColumnsCount; column_n++ {
        ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
        if column.IsVisibleX && column.IsVisibleY {
            column.DrawChannelFrozen = cast(ImGuiTableDrawChannelIdx, draw_channel_current);
            column.DrawChannelUnfrozen = cast(ImGuiTableDrawChannelIdx, draw_channel_current + (table.FreezeRowsCount > 0 ? channels_for_row + 1 : 0));
            if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_NoClip) == 0 {
                draw_channel_current++;
            }
        } else {
            column.DrawChannelUnfrozen = table.DummyDrawChannel;
            column.DrawChannelFrozen = column.DrawChannelUnfrozen;
        }
        column.DrawChannelCurrent = column.DrawChannelFrozen;
    }
    table.BgClipRect = table.InnerClipRect;
    table.Bg0ClipRectForDrawCmd = table.OuterWindow.ClipRect;
    table.Bg2ClipRectForDrawCmd = table.HostClipRect;
    assert(table.BgClipRect.Min.y <= table.BgClipRect.Max.y);
}

// This function reorder draw channels based on matching clip rectangle, to facilitate merging them. Called by EndTable().
// For simplicity we call it TableMergeDrawChannels() but in fact it only reorder channels + overwrite ClipRect,
// actual merging is done by table->DrawSplitter.Merge() which is called right after TableMergeDrawChannels().
//
// Columns where the contents didn't stray off their local clip rectangle can be merged. To achieve
// this we merge their clip rect and make them contiguous in the channel list, so they can be merged
// by the call to DrawSplitter.Merge() following to the call to this function.
// We reorder draw commands by arranging them into a maximum of 4 distinct groups:
//
//   1 group:               2 groups:              2 groups:              4 groups:
//   [ 0. ] no freeze       [ 0. ] row freeze      [ 01 ] col freeze      [ 01 ] row+col freeze
//   [ .. ]  or no scroll   [ 2. ]  and v-scroll   [ .. ]  and h-scroll   [ 23 ]  and v+h-scroll
//
// Each column itself can use 1 channel (row freeze disabled) or 2 channels (row freeze enabled).
// When the contents of a column didn't stray off its limit, we move its channels into the corresponding group
// based on its position (within frozen rows/columns groups or not).
// At the end of the operation our 1-4 groups will each have a ImDrawCmd using the same ClipRect.
// This function assume that each column are pointing to a distinct draw channel,
// otherwise merge_group->ChannelsCount will not match set bit count of merge_group->ChannelsMask.
//
// Column channels will not be merged into one of the 1-4 groups in the following cases:
// - The contents stray off its clipping rectangle (we only compare the MaxX value, not the MinX value).
//   Direct ImDrawList calls won't be taken into account by default, if you use them make sure the ImGui:: bounds
//   matches, by e.g. calling SetCursorScreenPos().
// - The channel uses more than one draw command itself. We drop all our attempt at merging stuff here..
//   we could do better but it's going to be rare and probably not worth the hassle.
// Columns for which the draw channel(s) haven't been merged with other will use their own ImDrawCmd.
//
// This function is particularly tricky to understand.. take a breath.
void ImGui_TableMergeDrawChannels(ImGuiTable* table) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImDrawListSplitter* splitter = table.DrawSplitter;
    bool has_freeze_v = table.FreezeRowsCount > 0;
    bool has_freeze_h = table.FreezeColumnsCount > 0;
    assert(splitter._Current == 0);
    i32 merge_group_mask = 0x00;
    MergeGroup[4] merge_groups;
    i32 max_draw_channels = 4 + table.ColumnsCount * 2;
    var size_for_masks_bitarrays_one = cast(i32, ImBitArrayGetStorageSizeInBytes(max_draw_channels));
    ImVector_char_reserve(&g.TempBuffer, size_for_masks_bitarrays_one * 5);
    memset(g.TempBuffer.Data, 0, cast(u64, size_for_masks_bitarrays_one * 5));
    for i32 n = 0; n < cast(i32, sizeof(merge_groups) / sizeof(*merge_groups)); n++ {
        merge_groups[n].ChannelsMask = cast(ImBitArrayPtr, cast(void*, g.TempBuffer.Data + size_for_masks_bitarrays_one * n));
    }
    var remaining_mask = cast(ImBitArrayPtr, cast(void*, g.TempBuffer.Data + size_for_masks_bitarrays_one * 4));
    for i32 column_n = 0; column_n < table.ColumnsCount; column_n++ {
        if (table.VisibleMaskByIndex[column_n >> 5] & cast(ImU32, 1) << cast(u32, column_n & 31)) != 0 == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
        i32 merge_group_sub_count = has_freeze_v != 0 ? 2 : 1;
        for i32 merge_group_sub_n = 0; merge_group_sub_n < merge_group_sub_count; merge_group_sub_n++ {
            var channel_no = cast(i32, merge_group_sub_n == 0 ? column.DrawChannelFrozen : column.DrawChannelUnfrozen);
            ImDrawChannel* src_channel = &splitter._Channels.Data[channel_no];
            if src_channel._CmdBuffer.Size > 0 && ImVector_ImDrawCmd_back(&src_channel._CmdBuffer).ElemCount == 0 && ImVector_ImDrawCmd_back(&src_channel._CmdBuffer).UserCallback == null {
                ImVector_ImDrawCmd_pop_back(&src_channel._CmdBuffer);
            }
            if src_channel._CmdBuffer.Size != 1 {
                continue;
            }
            if (column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoClip) == 0 {
                f32 content_max_x;
                if has_freeze_v == 0 {
                    content_max_x = ImMax(column.ContentMaxXUnfrozen, column.ContentMaxXHeadersUsed);
                } else if merge_group_sub_n == 0 {
                    content_max_x = ImMax(column.ContentMaxXFrozen, column.ContentMaxXHeadersUsed);
                } else {
                    content_max_x = column.ContentMaxXUnfrozen;
                }
                if content_max_x > column.ClipRect.Max.x {
                    continue;
                }
            }
            i32 merge_group_n = (has_freeze_h && column_n < table.FreezeColumnsCount ? 0 : 1) + (has_freeze_v && merge_group_sub_n == 0 ? 0 : 2);
            assert(channel_no < max_draw_channels);
            MergeGroup* merge_group = &merge_groups[merge_group_n];
            if merge_group.ChannelsCount == 0 {
                merge_group.ClipRect = ImRect{ImVec2{FLT_MAX, FLT_MAX}, ImVec2{-FLT_MAX, -FLT_MAX}};
            }
            ImBitArraySetBit(merge_group.ChannelsMask, channel_no);
            merge_group.ChannelsCount++;
            { ImVec4 zz_c4 = src_channel._CmdBuffer.Data[0].ClipRect; ImRect_Add(&merge_group.ClipRect, ImRect{ImVec2{zz_c4.x, zz_c4.y}, ImVec2{zz_c4.z, zz_c4.w}}); }
            merge_group_mask |= 1 << merge_group_n;
        }
        column.DrawChannelCurrent = cast(ImGuiTableDrawChannelIdx, -1);
    }
    if merge_group_mask != 0 {
        i32 LEADING_DRAW_CHANNELS = 2;
        ImVector_ImDrawChannel_resize(&g.DrawChannelsTempMergeBuffer, splitter._Count - LEADING_DRAW_CHANNELS);
        ImDrawChannel* dst_tmp = g.DrawChannelsTempMergeBuffer.Data;
        ImBitArraySetBitRange(remaining_mask, LEADING_DRAW_CHANNELS, splitter._Count);
        ImBitArrayClearBit(remaining_mask, cast(i32, table.Bg2DrawChannelUnfrozen));
        assert(has_freeze_v == false || cast(i32, table.Bg2DrawChannelUnfrozen) != TABLE_DRAW_CHANNEL_BG2_FROZEN);
        i32 remaining_count = splitter._Count - (has_freeze_v != 0 ? LEADING_DRAW_CHANNELS + 1 : LEADING_DRAW_CHANNELS);
        ImRect host_rect = table.HostClipRect;
        for i32 merge_group_n = 0; merge_group_n < cast(i32, sizeof(merge_groups) / sizeof(*merge_groups)); merge_group_n++ {
            {
                i32 merge_channels_count = merge_groups[merge_group_n].ChannelsCount;
                if merge_channels_count != 0 {
                    MergeGroup* merge_group = &merge_groups[merge_group_n];
                    ImRect merge_clip_rect = merge_group.ClipRect;
                    if (merge_group_n & 1) == 0 || !has_freeze_h {
                        merge_clip_rect.Min.x = ImMin(merge_clip_rect.Min.x, host_rect.Min.x);
                    }
                    if (merge_group_n & 2) == 0 || !has_freeze_v {
                        merge_clip_rect.Min.y = ImMin(merge_clip_rect.Min.y, host_rect.Min.y);
                    }
                    if (merge_group_n & 1) != 0 {
                        merge_clip_rect.Max.x = ImMax(merge_clip_rect.Max.x, host_rect.Max.x);
                    }
                    if (merge_group_n & 2) != 0 && (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_NoHostExtendY) == 0 {
                        merge_clip_rect.Max.y = ImMax(merge_clip_rect.Max.y, host_rect.Max.y);
                    }
                    remaining_count -= merge_group.ChannelsCount;
                    for i32 n = 0; n < size_for_masks_bitarrays_one >> 2; n++ {
                        remaining_mask[n] &= ~merge_group.ChannelsMask[n];
                    }
                    for i32 n = 0; n < splitter._Count && merge_channels_count != 0; n++ {
                        if (merge_group.ChannelsMask[n >> 5] & cast(ImU32, 1) << cast(u32, n & 31)) != 0 == 0 {
                            continue;
                        }
                        merge_group.ChannelsMask[n >> 5] &= ~(cast(ImU32, 1) << cast(u32, n & 31));
                        merge_channels_count--;
                        ImDrawChannel* channel = &splitter._Channels.Data[n];
                        assert(channel._CmdBuffer.Size == 1 && ImRect_Contains(&merge_clip_rect, __cxx_make_ImRect(channel._CmdBuffer.Data[0].ClipRect)));
                        channel._CmdBuffer.Data[0].ClipRect = ImRect_ToVec4(&merge_clip_rect);
                        memcpy(dst_tmp++, channel, cast(u64, sizeof(ImDrawChannel)));
                    }
                }
            }
            if merge_group_n == 1 && has_freeze_v {
                memcpy(dst_tmp++, &splitter._Channels.Data[table.Bg2DrawChannelUnfrozen], cast(u64, sizeof(ImDrawChannel)));
            }
        }
        for i32 n = 0; n < splitter._Count && remaining_count != 0; n++ {
            if (remaining_mask[n >> 5] & cast(ImU32, 1) << cast(u32, n & 31)) != 0 == 0 {
                continue;
            }
            ImDrawChannel* channel = &splitter._Channels.Data[n];
            memcpy(dst_tmp++, channel, cast(u64, sizeof(ImDrawChannel)));
            remaining_count--;
        }
        assert(dst_tmp == g.DrawChannelsTempMergeBuffer.Data + g.DrawChannelsTempMergeBuffer.Size);
        memcpy(splitter._Channels.Data + LEADING_DRAW_CHANNELS, g.DrawChannelsTempMergeBuffer.Data, cast(u64, (splitter._Count - LEADING_DRAW_CHANNELS) * sizeof(ImDrawChannel)));
    }
}

private {
ImU32 TableGetColumnBorderCol(ImGuiTable* table, i32 order_n, i32 column_n) {
    bool is_hovered = table.HoveredColumnBorder == column_n;
    bool is_resized = table.ResizedColumn == column_n && table.InstanceInteracted == table.InstanceCurrent;
    bool is_frozen_separator = table.FreezeColumnsCount == order_n + 1;
    if is_resized || is_hovered {
        return ImGui_GetColorU32(is_resized != 0 ? ImGuiCol_SeparatorActive : ImGuiCol_SeparatorHovered);
    }
    if is_frozen_separator || table.Flags & (ImGuiTableFlags_NoBordersInBody | ImGuiTableFlags_NoBordersInBodyUntilResize) {
        return table.BorderColorStrong;
    }
    return table.BorderColorLight;
}
}

// FIXME-TABLE: This is a mess, need to redesign how we render borders (as some are also done in TableEndRow)
void ImGui_TableDrawBorders(ImGuiTable* table) {
    ImGuiWindow* inner_window = table.InnerWindow;
    if ImRect_Overlaps(&table.OuterWindow.ClipRect, table.OuterRect) == 0 {
        return;
    }
    ImDrawList* inner_drawlist = inner_window.DrawList;
    ImDrawListSplitter_SetCurrentChannel(table.DrawSplitter, inner_drawlist, TABLE_DRAW_CHANNEL_BG0);
    ImDrawList_PushClipRect(inner_drawlist, table.Bg0ClipRectForDrawCmd.Min, table.Bg0ClipRectForDrawCmd.Max, false);
    ImGuiTableInstanceData* table_instance = ImGui_TableGetInstanceData(table, table.InstanceCurrent);
    f32 border_size = TABLE_BORDER_SIZE;
    f32 draw_y1 = ImMax(table.InnerRect.Min.y, (table.FreezeRowsCount >= 1 ? table.InnerRect.Min.y : table.WorkRect.Min.y) + table.AngledHeadersHeight) + ((table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_BordersOuterH) != 0 ? 1.0f : 0.0f);
    f32 draw_y2_body = table.InnerRect.Max.y;
    f32 draw_y2_head = table.IsUsingHeaders != 0 ? ImMin(table.InnerRect.Max.y, (table.FreezeRowsCount >= 1 ? table.InnerRect.Min.y : table.WorkRect.Min.y) + table_instance.LastTopHeadersRowHeight) : draw_y1;
    if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_BordersInnerV) != 0 {
        for i32 order_n = 0; order_n < table.ColumnsCount; order_n++ {
            if (table.EnabledMaskByDisplayOrder[order_n >> 5] & cast(ImU32, 1) << cast(u32, order_n & 31)) != 0 == 0 {
                continue;
            }
            i32 column_n = table.DisplayOrderToIndex.Data[order_n];
            ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
            bool is_hovered = table.HoveredColumnBorder == column_n;
            bool is_resized = table.ResizedColumn == column_n && table.InstanceInteracted == table.InstanceCurrent;
            bool is_resizable = (column.Flags & (ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoResize | ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoDirectResize_)) == 0;
            bool is_frozen_separator = table.FreezeColumnsCount == order_n + 1;
            if column.MaxX > table.InnerClipRect.Max.x && !is_resized {
                continue;
            }
            if column.NextEnabledColumn == -1 && !is_resizable {
                if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_SizingMask_) != ImGuiTableFlags_SizingFixedSame || table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_NoHostExtendX {
                    continue;
                }
            }
            if column.MaxX <= column.ClipRect.Min.x {
                continue;
            }
            f32 draw_y2 = draw_y2_head;
            if is_frozen_separator != 0 {
                draw_y2 = draw_y2_body;
            } else if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_NoBordersInBodyUntilResize) != 0 && (is_hovered || is_resized) {
                draw_y2 = draw_y2_body;
            } else if (table.Flags & (ImGuiTableFlags_NoBordersInBodyUntilResize | ImGuiTableFlags_NoBordersInBody)) == 0 {
                draw_y2 = draw_y2_body;
            }
            if draw_y2 > draw_y1 {
                ImDrawList_AddLineV(inner_drawlist, column.MaxX, draw_y1, draw_y2, TableGetColumnBorderCol(table, order_n, column_n), border_size);
            }
        }
    }
    if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_BordersOuter) != 0 {
        ImRect outer_border = table.OuterRect;
        ImU32 outer_col = table.BorderColorStrong;
        if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_BordersOuter) == ImGuiTableFlags_BordersOuter {
            ImDrawList_AddRect(inner_drawlist, outer_border.Min, outer_border.Max, outer_col, 0.0f, border_size, 0);
        } else if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_BordersOuterV) != 0 {
            ImDrawList_AddLineV(inner_drawlist, outer_border.Min.x, outer_border.Min.y, outer_border.Max.y, outer_col, border_size);
            ImDrawList_AddLineV(inner_drawlist, outer_border.Max.x, outer_border.Min.y, outer_border.Max.y, outer_col, border_size);
        } else if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_BordersOuterH) != 0 {
            ImDrawList_AddLineH(inner_drawlist, outer_border.Min.x, outer_border.Max.x, outer_border.Min.y, outer_col, border_size);
            ImDrawList_AddLineH(inner_drawlist, outer_border.Min.x, outer_border.Max.x, outer_border.Max.y - border_size, outer_col, border_size);
        }
    }
    if table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_BordersInnerH && table.RowPosY2 < table.OuterRect.Max.y {
        f32 border_y = table.RowPosY2;
        if border_y >= table.BgClipRect.Min.y && border_y < table.BgClipRect.Max.y {
            ImDrawList_AddLineH(inner_drawlist, table.BorderX1, table.BorderX2, border_y, table.BorderColorLight, border_size);
        }
    }
    ImDrawList_PopClipRect(inner_drawlist);
}

// [SECTION] Tables: Sorting
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
// - TableGetSortSpecs()
// - TableFixColumnSortDirection() [Internal]
// - TableGetColumnNextSortDirection() [Internal]
// - TableSetColumnSortDirection() [Internal]
// - TableSortSpecsSanitize() [Internal]
// - TableSortSpecsBuild() [Internal]
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Return NULL if no sort specs (most often when ImGuiTableFlags_Sortable is not set)
// When 'sort_specs->SpecsDirty == true' you should sort your data. It will be true when sorting specs have
// changed since last call, or the first time. Make sure to set 'SpecsDirty = false' after sorting,
// else you may wastefully sort your data every frame!
// Lifetime: don't hold on this pointer over multiple frames or past any subsequent call to BeginTable()!
ImGuiTableSortSpecs* ImGui_TableGetSortSpecs() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
    if table == null || !(table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_Sortable) {
        return null;
    }
    if table.IsLayoutLocked == 0 {
        ImGui_TableUpdateLayout(table);
    }
    ImGui_TableSortSpecsBuild(table);
    return &table.SortSpecs;
}

private {
ImGuiSortDirection TableGetColumnAvailSortDirection(ImGuiTableColumn* column, i32 n) {
    assert(n < cast(i32, column.SortDirectionsAvailCount));
    return cast(ImGuiSortDirection, cast(i32, column.SortDirectionsAvailList) >> (n << 1) & 0x03);
}
}

// Fix sort direction if currently set on a value which is unavailable (e.g. activating NoSortAscending/NoSortDescending)
void ImGui_TableFixColumnSortDirection(ImGuiTable* table, ImGuiTableColumn* column) {
    if column.SortOrder == -1 || (column.SortDirectionsAvailMask & 1 << cast(i32, column.SortDirection)) != 0 {
        return;
    }
    column.SortDirection = cast(ImU8, TableGetColumnAvailSortDirection(column, 0));
    table.IsSortSpecsDirty = true;
}

ImGuiSortDirection ImGui_TableGetColumnNextSortDirection(ImGuiTableColumn* column) {
    assert(column.SortDirectionsAvailCount > 0);
    if column.SortOrder == -1 {
        return TableGetColumnAvailSortDirection(column, 0);
    }
    for i32 n = 0; n < 3; n++ {
        if column.SortDirection == TableGetColumnAvailSortDirection(column, n) {
            return TableGetColumnAvailSortDirection(column, (n + 1) % column.SortDirectionsAvailCount);
        }
    }
    assert(0);
    return cast(ImGuiSortDirection, ImGuiSortDirection_None);
}

// Note that the NoSortAscending/NoSortDescending flags are processed in TableSortSpecsSanitize(), and they may change/revert
// the value of SortDirection. We could technically also do it here but it would be unnecessary and duplicate code.
void ImGui_TableSetColumnSortDirection(i32 column_n, ImGuiSortDirection sort_direction, bool append_to_sort_specs) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
    if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_SortMulti) == 0 {
        append_to_sort_specs = false;
    }
    if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_SortTristate) == 0 {
        assert(cast(i32, sort_direction) != ImGuiSortDirection_None);
    }
    ImGuiTableColumnIdx sort_order_max = 0;
    if append_to_sort_specs != 0 {
        for i32 other_column_n = 0; other_column_n < table.ColumnsCount; other_column_n++ {
            sort_order_max = cast(i16, ImMax(cast(i32, sort_order_max), cast(i32, table.Columns.Data[other_column_n].SortOrder)));
        }
    }
    ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
    column.SortDirection = cast(ImU8, sort_direction);
    if cast(i32, column.SortDirection) == ImGuiSortDirection_None {
        column.SortOrder = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, -1);
    } else if column.SortOrder == -1 || !append_to_sort_specs {
        column.SortOrder = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, append_to_sort_specs != 0 ? sort_order_max + 1 : 0);
    }
    for i32 other_column_n = 0; other_column_n < table.ColumnsCount; other_column_n++ {
        ImGuiTableColumn* other_column = &table.Columns.Data[other_column_n];
        if other_column != column && !append_to_sort_specs {
            other_column.SortOrder = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, -1);
        }
        ImGui_TableFixColumnSortDirection(table, other_column);
    }
    table.IsSettingsDirty = true;
    table.IsSortSpecsDirty = true;
}

void ImGui_TableSortSpecsSanitize(ImGuiTable* table) {
    assert(table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_Sortable);
    i32 sort_order_count = 0;
    ImU64 sort_order_mask = 0x00;
    for i32 column_n = 0; column_n < table.ColumnsCount; column_n++ {
        ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
        if column.SortOrder != -1 && !column.IsEnabled {
            column.SortOrder = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, -1);
        }
        if column.SortOrder == -1 {
            continue;
        }
        sort_order_count++;
        sort_order_mask |= cast(ImU64, 1) << cast(u64, column.SortOrder);
        assert(sort_order_count < cast(i32, sizeof(sort_order_mask)) * 8);
    }
    bool need_fix_linearize = cast(ImU64, 1) << cast(u64, sort_order_count) != sort_order_mask + 1;
    bool need_fix_single_sort_order = sort_order_count > 1 && !(table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_SortMulti);
    if need_fix_linearize || need_fix_single_sort_order {
        ImU64 fixed_mask = 0x00;
        for i32 sort_n = 0; sort_n < sort_order_count; sort_n++ {
            i32 column_with_smallest_sort_order = -1;
            for i32 column_n = 0; column_n < table.ColumnsCount; column_n++ {
                if (fixed_mask & cast(ImU64, 1) << cast(ImU64, column_n)) == 0 && table.Columns.Data[column_n].SortOrder != -1 {
                    if column_with_smallest_sort_order == -1 || table.Columns.Data[column_n].SortOrder < table.Columns.Data[column_with_smallest_sort_order].SortOrder {
                        column_with_smallest_sort_order = column_n;
                    }
                }
            }
            assert(column_with_smallest_sort_order != -1);
            fixed_mask |= cast(ImU64, 1) << cast(u64, column_with_smallest_sort_order);
            table.Columns.Data[column_with_smallest_sort_order].SortOrder = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, sort_n);
            if need_fix_single_sort_order != 0 {
                sort_order_count = 1;
                for i32 column_n = 0; column_n < table.ColumnsCount; column_n++ {
                    if column_n != column_with_smallest_sort_order {
                        table.Columns.Data[column_n].SortOrder = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, -1);
                    }
                }
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    if sort_order_count == 0 && !(table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_SortTristate) {
        for i32 column_n = 0; column_n < table.ColumnsCount; column_n++ {
            ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
            if column.IsEnabled && !(column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoSort) {
                sort_order_count = 1;
                column.SortOrder = 0;
                column.SortDirection = cast(ImU8, TableGetColumnAvailSortDirection(column, 0));
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    table.SortSpecsCount = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, sort_order_count);
}

void ImGui_TableSortSpecsBuild(ImGuiTable* table) {
    bool dirty = table.IsSortSpecsDirty;
    if dirty != 0 {
        ImGui_TableSortSpecsSanitize(table);
        ImVector_ImGuiTableColumnSortSpecs_resize(&table.SortSpecsMulti, table.SortSpecsCount <= 1 ? 0 : table.SortSpecsCount);
        table.SortSpecs.SpecsDirty = true;
        table.IsSortSpecsDirty = false;
    }
    ImGuiTableColumnSortSpecs* sort_specs = table.SortSpecsCount == 0 ? null : table.SortSpecsCount == 1 ? &table.SortSpecsSingle : table.SortSpecsMulti.Data;
    if dirty && sort_specs != null {
        for i32 column_n = 0; column_n < table.ColumnsCount; column_n++ {
            ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
            if column.SortOrder == -1 {
                continue;
            }
            assert(column.SortOrder < table.SortSpecsCount);
            ImGuiTableColumnSortSpecs* sort_spec = &sort_specs[column.SortOrder];
            sort_spec.ColumnUserID = column.UserData;
            sort_spec.ColumnIndex = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, column_n);
            sort_spec.SortOrder = column.SortOrder;
            sort_spec.SortDirection = cast(ImGuiSortDirection, column.SortDirection);
        }
    }
    table.SortSpecs.Specs = sort_specs;
    table.SortSpecs.SpecsCount = table.SortSpecsCount;
}

f32 ImGui_TableGetHeaderRowHeight() {

    ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
    f32 row_height = g.FontSize;
    for i32 column_n = 0; column_n < table.ColumnsCount; column_n++ {
        if (table.EnabledMaskByIndex[column_n >> 5] & cast(ImU32, 1) << cast(u32, column_n & 31)) != 0 {
            if (table.Columns.Data[column_n].Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoHeaderLabel) == 0 {
                row_height = ImMax(row_height, ImGui_CalcTextSize(ImGui_TableGetColumnName(table, column_n), null, false, -1.0f).y);

    return row_height + g.Style.CellPadding.y * 2.0f;

f32 ImGui_TableGetHeaderAngledMaxLabelWidth() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;

            if (table.Columns.Data[column_n].Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_AngledHeader) != 0 {
                width = ImMax(width, ImGui_CalcTextSize(ImGui_TableGetColumnName(table, column_n), null, true, -1.0f).x);

// [Public] This is a helper to output TableHeader() calls based on the column names declared in TableSetupColumn().
// The intent is that advanced users willing to create customized headers would not need to use this helper
// and can create their own! For example: TableHeader() may be preceded by Checkbox() or other custom widgets.
// See 'Demo->Tables->Custom headers' for a demonstration of implementing a custom version of this.
// This code is intentionally written to not make much use of internal functions, to give you better direction
// if you need to write your own.
// FIXME-TABLE: TableOpenContextMenu() and TableGetHeaderRowHeight() are not public.
void ImGui_TableHeadersRow() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
    while true {
        if table != null == 0 {
            if ImGui_ErrorLog("Call should only be done while in BeginTable() scope!") != 0 {
                assert(table != null && "Call should only be done while in BeginTable() scope!");
            }
            return;
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    if table.IsLayoutLocked == 0 {
        ImGui_TableUpdateLayout(table);
    }
    f32 row_height = ImGui_TableGetHeaderRowHeight();
    ImGui_TableNextRow(ImGuiTableRowFlags_Headers, row_height);
    f32 row_y1 = ImGui_GetCursorScreenPos().y;
    if table.HostSkipItems != 0 {
        return;
    }
    i32 columns_count = ImGui_TableGetColumnCount();
    for i32 column_n = 0; column_n < columns_count; column_n++ {
        if !ImGui_TableSetColumnIndex(column_n) && table.LastHeldHeaderColumn != column_n {
            continue;
        }
        u8* name = (ImGui_TableGetColumnFlags(column_n) & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoHeaderLabel) != 0 ? "" : ImGui_TableGetColumnName(column_n);
        ImGui_PushID(column_n);
        ImGui_TableHeader(name);
        ImGui_PopID();
    }
    ImVec2 mouse_pos = ImGui_GetMousePos();
    if ImGui_IsMouseReleased(1) && ImGui_TableGetHoveredColumn() == columns_count {
        if mouse_pos.y >= row_y1 && mouse_pos.y < row_y1 + row_height {
            ImGui_TableOpenContextMenu(columns_count);
        }
    }
}

// Emit a column header (text + optional sort order)
// We cpu-clip text here so that all columns headers can be merged into a same draw call.
// Note that because of how we cpu-clip and display sorting indicators, you _cannot_ use SameLine() after a TableHeader()
void ImGui_TableHeader(u8* label) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return;
    }
    ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
    while true {
        if table != null == 0 {
            if ImGui_ErrorLog("Call should only be done while in BeginTable() scope!") != 0 {
                assert(table != null && "Call should only be done while in BeginTable() scope!");
            }
            return;
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    assert(table.CurrentColumn != -1);
    i32 column_n = table.CurrentColumn;
    ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
    if label == null {
        label = "";
    }
    u8* label_end = ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(label, null);
    ImVec2 label_size = ImGui_CalcTextSize(label, label_end, false, -1.0f);
    ImVec2 label_pos = window.DC.CursorPos;
    ImRect cell_r = ImGui_TableGetCellBgRect(table, column_n);
    f32 label_height = ImMax(label_size.y, table.RowMinHeight - table.RowCellPaddingY * 2.0f);
    f32 w_arrow = 0.0f;
    f32 w_sort_text = 0.0f;
    bool sort_arrow = false;
    u8[4] sort_order_suf;
    f32 ARROW_SCALE = 0.65f;
    if table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_Sortable && !(column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoSort) {
        w_arrow = ImTrunc(g.FontSize * ARROW_SCALE + g.Style.FramePadding.x);
        if column.SortOrder != -1 {
            sort_arrow = true;
        }
        if column.SortOrder > 0 {
            ImFormatString(sort_order_suf, cast(u64, cast(i32, sizeof(sort_order_suf) / sizeof(*sort_order_suf))), "%d", column.SortOrder + 1);
            w_sort_text = g.Style.ItemInnerSpacing.x + ImGui_CalcTextSize(sort_order_suf, null, false, -1.0f).x;
        }
    }
    f32 max_pos_x = label_pos.x + label_size.x + w_sort_text + w_arrow;
    column.ContentMaxXHeadersUsed = ImMax(column.ContentMaxXHeadersUsed, sort_arrow != 0 ? cell_r.Max.x : ImMin(max_pos_x, cell_r.Max.x));
    column.ContentMaxXHeadersIdeal = ImMax(column.ContentMaxXHeadersIdeal, max_pos_x);
    ImGuiID id = ImGuiWindow_GetID(window, label, null);
    ImRect bb;
    ImRect_init(&bb, cell_r.Min.x, cell_r.Min.y, cell_r.Max.x, ImMax(cell_r.Max.y, cell_r.Min.y + label_height + g.Style.CellPadding.y * 2.0f));
    ImGui_ItemSize(ImVec2{0.0f, label_height});
    if ImGui_ItemAdd(bb, id, null, 0) == 0 {
        return;
    }
    bool highlight = table.HighlightColumnHeader == column_n;
    bool hovered;
    bool held;
    bool pressed = ImGui_ButtonBehavior(bb, id, &hovered, &held, ImGuiButtonFlags_AllowOverlap);
    if held || hovered || highlight {
        ImU32 col = ImGui_GetColorU32(held != 0 ? ImGuiCol_HeaderActive : hovered != 0 ? ImGuiCol_HeaderHovered : ImGuiCol_Header);
        ImGui_TableSetBgColor(ImGuiTableBgTarget_CellBg, col, table.CurrentColumn);
    } else {
        if (table.RowFlags & ImGuiTableRowFlags_Headers) == 0 {
            ImGui_TableSetBgColor(ImGuiTableBgTarget_CellBg, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_TableHeaderBg), table.CurrentColumn);
        }
    }
    ImGui_RenderNavCursor(bb, id, ImGuiNavRenderCursorFlags_Compact, 0.0f);
    if held != 0 {
        table.HeldHeaderColumn = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, column_n);
    }
    window.DC.CursorPos.y -= g.Style.ItemSpacing.y * 0.5f;
    if held && table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_Reorderable && ImGui_IsMouseDragging(0, -1.0f) && !g.DragDropActive {
        table.InstanceInteracted = table.InstanceCurrent;
        if g.IO.MouseDelta.x < 0.0f && g.IO.MousePos.x < cell_r.Min.x {
            ImGuiTableColumn* prev_column = column.PrevEnabledColumn != -1 ? &table.Columns.Data[column.PrevEnabledColumn] : null;
            if prev_column != null {
                ImGui_TableQueueSetColumnDisplayOrder(table, column_n, cast(i32, prev_column.DisplayOrder));
            }
        }
        if g.IO.MouseDelta.x > 0.0f && g.IO.MousePos.x > cell_r.Max.x {
            ImGuiTableColumn* next_column = column.NextEnabledColumn != -1 ? &table.Columns.Data[column.NextEnabledColumn] : null;
            if next_column != null {
                ImGui_TableQueueSetColumnDisplayOrder(table, column_n, cast(i32, next_column.DisplayOrder));
            }
        }
    }
    f32 ellipsis_max = ImMax(cell_r.Max.x - (sort_arrow != 0 ? w_arrow + w_sort_text : 0.0f), label_pos.x);
    if table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_Sortable && !(column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoSort) {
        if column.SortOrder != -1 {
            f32 x = ImMax(cell_r.Min.x, cell_r.Max.x - w_arrow - w_sort_text);
            f32 y = label_pos.y;
            if column.SortOrder > 0 {
                ImGui_PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Text, 0.7f));
                ImGui_RenderText(ImVec2{x + g.Style.ItemInnerSpacing.x, y}, sort_order_suf, null, true);
                ImGui_PopStyleColor(1);
                x += w_sort_text;
            }
            ImGui_RenderArrow(window.DrawList, ImVec2{x, y}, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Text), cast(i32, column.SortDirection) == ImGuiSortDirection_Ascending ? ImGuiDir_Up : ImGuiDir_Down, ARROW_SCALE);
        }
        if pressed && table.ReorderColumn != column_n {
            ImGuiSortDirection sort_direction = ImGui_TableGetColumnNextSortDirection(column);
            ImGui_TableSetColumnSortDirection(column_n, sort_direction, g.IO.KeyShift);
        }
    }
    ImGui_RenderTextEllipsis(window.DrawList, label_pos, ImVec2{ellipsis_max, bb.Max.y}, ellipsis_max, label, label_end, &label_size);
    bool text_clipped = label_size.x > ellipsis_max - label_pos.x;
    if text_clipped && hovered && g.ActiveId == 0 {
        ImGui_SetItemTooltip("%.*s", cast(i32, cast(i64, label_end - label)), label);
    }
    if ImGui_IsPopupOpenRequestForItem(ImGuiPopupFlags_None, id) != 0 {
        ImGui_TableOpenContextMenu(column_n);
    }
    ignore *g;
}

// Unlike TableHeadersRow() it is not expected that you can reimplement or customize this with custom widgets.
// FIXME: No hit-testing/button on the angled header.
void ImGui_TableAngledHeadersRow() {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
    ImGuiTableTempData* temp_data = table.TempData;
    ImVector_ImGuiTableHeaderData_resize(&temp_data.AngledHeadersRequests, 0);
    ImVector_ImGuiTableHeaderData_reserve(&temp_data.AngledHeadersRequests, table.ColumnsEnabledCount);
    ImGuiID row_id = ImGui_GetID("##AngledHeaders");
    ImGuiTableInstanceData* table_instance = ImGui_TableGetInstanceData(table, table.InstanceCurrent);
    i32 highlight_column_n = table.LastHeldHeaderColumn != -1 ? table.LastHeldHeaderColumn : table.HighlightColumnHeader;
    if highlight_column_n == -1 && table.HoveredColumnBody != -1 {
        if table_instance.HoveredRowLast == 0 && table.HoveredColumnBorder == -1 && (g.ActiveId == 0 || g.ActiveId == row_id || (table.IsActiveIdInTable || g.DragDropActive)) {
            highlight_column_n = table.HoveredColumnBody;
        }
    }
    ImU32 col_header_bg = ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_TableHeaderBg);
    ImU32 col_text = ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Text);
    for i32 order_n = 0; order_n < table.ColumnsCount; order_n++ {
        if (table.EnabledMaskByDisplayOrder[order_n >> 5] & cast(ImU32, 1) << cast(u32, order_n & 31)) != 0 {
            i32 column_n = table.DisplayOrderToIndex.Data[order_n];
            ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
            if (column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_AngledHeader) == 0 {
                continue;
            }
            var request = ImGuiTableHeaderData{
                cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, column_n), col_text, col_header_bg,
                column_n == highlight_column_n ? ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Header) : 0,
            };
            ImVector_ImGuiTableHeaderData_push_back(&temp_data.AngledHeadersRequests, request);
        }
    }
    ImGui_TableAngledHeadersRowEx(row_id, g.Style.TableAngledHeadersAngle, 0.0f, temp_data.AngledHeadersRequests.Data, temp_data.AngledHeadersRequests.Size);
}

// Important: data must be fed left to right
void ImGui_TableAngledHeadersRowEx(ImGuiID row_id, f32 angle, f32 max_label_width, ImGuiTableHeaderData* data, i32 data_count) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    ImDrawList* draw_list = window.DrawList;
    while true {
        if table != null == 0 {
            if ImGui_ErrorLog("Call should only be done while in BeginTable() scope!") != 0 {
                assert(table != null && "Call should only be done while in BeginTable() scope!");
            }
            return;
        }
        if !(0 != 0) { break; }
    }
    assert(table.CurrentRow == -1 && "Must be first row");
    if max_label_width == 0.0f {
        max_label_width = ImGui_TableGetHeaderAngledMaxLabelWidth();
    }
    bool flip_label = angle < 0.0f;
    angle -= 3.141592653589793f * 0.5f;
    f32 cos_a = cos(angle);
    f32 sin_a = sin(angle);
    f32 label_cos_a = flip_label != 0 ? cos(angle + 3.141592653589793f) : cos_a;
    f32 label_sin_a = flip_label != 0 ? sin(angle + 3.141592653589793f) : sin_a;
    var unit_right = ImVec2{cos_a, sin_a};
    f32 header_height = g.FontSize + g.Style.CellPadding.x * 2.0f;
    f32 row_height = ImTrunc(fabs(ImRotate(ImVec2{
        max_label_width, flip_label != 0 ? header_height : -header_height,
    }, cos_a, sin_a).y));
    table.AngledHeadersHeight = row_height;
    table.AngledHeadersSlope = sin_a != 0.0f ? cos_a / sin_a : 0.0f;
    ImVec2 header_angled_vector = op_mul_ImVec2_float(unit_right, row_height / -sin_a);
    ImGui_TableNextRow(ImGuiTableRowFlags_Headers, row_height);
    ImGui_TableNextColumn();
    ImRect row_r;
    ImRect_init(&row_r, table.WorkRect.Min.x, table.BgClipRect.Min.y, table.WorkRect.Max.x, table.RowPosY2);
    ImDrawListSplitter_SetCurrentChannel(table.DrawSplitter, draw_list, TABLE_DRAW_CHANNEL_BG0);
    f32 clip_rect_min_x = table.BgClipRect.Min.x;
    if table.FreezeColumnsCount > 0 {
        clip_rect_min_x = ImMax(clip_rect_min_x, table.Columns.Data[table.DisplayOrderToIndex.Data[table.FreezeColumnsCount - 1]].MaxX);
    }
    ImGui_TableSetBgColor(ImGuiTableBgTarget_RowBg0, 0);
    ImGui_PushClipRect(table.BgClipRect.Min, table.BgClipRect.Max, false);
    ImDrawList_AddRectFilled(draw_list, ImVec2{table.BgClipRect.Min.x, row_r.Min.y}, ImVec2{table.BgClipRect.Max.x, row_r.Max.y}, ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_TableHeaderBg, 0.25f), 0.0f, 0);
    ImGui_PushClipRect(ImVec2{clip_rect_min_x, table.BgClipRect.Min.y}, table.BgClipRect.Max, true);
    ImGui_ButtonBehavior(row_r, row_id, null, null, 0);
    ImGui_KeepAliveID(row_id);
    f32 ascent_scaled = g.FontBaked.Ascent * g.FontBakedScale;
    f32 line_off_for_ascent_x = ImMax((g.FontSize - ascent_scaled) * 0.5f, 0.0f) / -sin_a * (flip_label != 0 ? -1.0f : 1.0f);
    ImVec2 padding = g.Style.CellPadding;
    ImVec2 align = g.Style.TableAngledHeadersTextAlign;
    f32 max_x = -FLT_MAX;
    for i32 pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++ {
        for i32 order_n = 0; order_n < data_count; order_n++ {
            ImGuiTableHeaderData* request = &data[order_n];
            i32 column_n = request.Index;
            ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
            ImVec2[4] bg_shape;
            bg_shape[0] = ImVec2{column.MaxX, row_r.Max.y};
            bg_shape[1] = ImVec2{column.MinX, row_r.Max.y};
            bg_shape[2] = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(bg_shape[1], header_angled_vector);
            bg_shape[3] = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(bg_shape[0], header_angled_vector);
            if pass == 0 {
                ImDrawList_AddQuadFilled(draw_list, bg_shape[0], bg_shape[1], bg_shape[2], bg_shape[3], request.BgColor0);
                ImDrawList_AddQuadFilled(draw_list, bg_shape[0], bg_shape[1], bg_shape[2], bg_shape[3], request.BgColor1);
                max_x = ImMax(max_x, bg_shape[3].x);
                u8* label_name = ImGui_TableGetColumnName(table, column_n);
                u8* label_name_end = ImGui_FindRenderedTextEnd(label_name, null);
                f32 line_off_step_x = g.FontSize / -sin_a;
                i32 label_lines = ImTextCountLines(label_name, label_name_end);
                f32 line_off_curr_x = flip_label != 0 ? cast(f32, label_lines - 1) * line_off_step_x : 0.0f;
                f32 line_off_for_align_x = ImFloor(ImMax(column.MaxX - column.MinX - padding.x * 2.0f - cast(f32, label_lines) * line_off_step_x, 0.0f) * align.x);
                line_off_curr_x += line_off_for_align_x - line_off_for_ascent_x;
                column.ContentMaxXHeadersIdeal = column.WorkMinX + ceil(cast(f32, label_lines) * line_off_step_x - line_off_for_align_x);
                column.ContentMaxXHeadersUsed = column.ContentMaxXHeadersIdeal;
                while label_name < label_name_end {
                    u8* label_name_eol = strchr(label_name, 10);
                    if label_name_eol == null {
                        label_name_eol = label_name_end;
                    }
                    ImVec2 label_size = ImGui_CalcTextSize(label_name, label_name_eol, false, -1.0f);
                    f32 clip_width = max_label_width - padding.y;
                    f32 clip_height = ImMin(label_size.y, column.ClipRect.Max.x - column.WorkMinX - line_off_curr_x);
                    ImRect clip_r;
                    ImRect_init(&clip_r, window.ClipRect.Min, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(window.ClipRect.Min, ImVec2{clip_width, clip_height}));
                    var vtx_idx_begin = cast(i32, draw_list._VtxCurrentIdx);
                    ImGui_PushStyleColor(ImGuiCol_Text, request.TextColor);
                    ImGui_RenderTextEllipsis(draw_list, clip_r.Min, clip_r.Max, clip_r.Max.x, label_name, label_name_eol, &label_size);
                    ImGui_PopStyleColor(1);
                    var vtx_idx_end = cast(i32, draw_list._VtxCurrentIdx);
                    f32 available_space = ImMax(clip_width - label_size.x + ImAbs(padding.x * cos_a) * 2.0f - ImAbs(padding.y * sin_a) * 2.0f, 0.0f);
                    f32 vertical_offset = available_space * align.y * (flip_label != 0 ? -1.0f : 1.0f);
                    var pivot_in = ImVec2{
                        window.ClipRect.Min.x - vertical_offset,
                        window.ClipRect.Min.y + label_size.y,
                    };
                    var pivot_out = ImVec2{column.WorkMinX, row_r.Max.y};
                    line_off_curr_x += flip_label != 0 ? -line_off_step_x : line_off_step_x;
                    pivot_out = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(pivot_out, op_mul_ImVec2_float(unit_right, padding.y));
                    if flip_label != 0 {
                        pivot_out = op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(pivot_out, op_mul_ImVec2_float(unit_right, clip_width - ImMax(0.0f, clip_width - label_size.x)));
                    }
                    pivot_out.x += flip_label != 0 ? line_off_curr_x + line_off_step_x : line_off_curr_x;
                    ImGui_ShadeVertsTransformPos(draw_list, vtx_idx_begin, vtx_idx_end, pivot_in, label_cos_a, label_sin_a, pivot_out);
                    label_name = label_name_eol + 1;
                }
            }
            if pass == 1 {
                ImDrawList_AddLine(draw_list, op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(bg_shape[0], ImVec2{TABLE_BORDER_SIZE * 0.5f, 0.0f}), op_sub_ImVec2_ImVec2(bg_shape[3], ImVec2{TABLE_BORDER_SIZE * 0.5f, 0.0f}), TableGetColumnBorderCol(table, order_n, column_n), TABLE_BORDER_SIZE);
            }
        }
    }
    ImGui_PopClipRect();
    ImGui_PopClipRect();
    table.TempData.AngledHeadersExtraWidth = ImMax(0.0f, max_x - table.Columns.Data[table.RightMostEnabledColumn].MaxX);
}

// Use -1 to open menu not specific to a given column.
void ImGui_TableOpenContextMenu(i32 column_n) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiTable* table = g.CurrentTable;
    if column_n == -1 && table.CurrentColumn != -1 {
        column_n = table.CurrentColumn;
    }
    if column_n == table.ColumnsCount {
        column_n = -1;
    }
    assert(column_n >= -1 && column_n < table.ColumnsCount);
    if (table.Flags & (ImGuiTableFlags_Resizable | ImGuiTableFlags_Reorderable | ImGuiTableFlags_Hideable)) != 0 {
        table.IsContextPopupOpen = true;
        table.ContextPopupColumn = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, column_n);
        table.InstanceInteracted = table.InstanceCurrent;
        ImGuiID context_menu_id = ImHashStr("##ContextMenu", 0, table.ID);
        ImGui_OpenPopupEx(context_menu_id, ImGuiPopupFlags_None);
    }
}

bool ImGui_TableBeginContextMenuPopup(ImGuiTable* table) {
    if !table.IsContextPopupOpen || table.InstanceCurrent != table.InstanceInteracted {
        return false;
    }
    ImGuiID context_menu_id = ImHashStr("##ContextMenu", 0, table.ID);
    if ImGui_BeginPopupEx(context_menu_id, ImGuiWindowFlags_AlwaysAutoResize | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoTitleBar | ImGuiWindowFlags_NoSavedSettings) != 0 {
        return true;
    }
    table.IsContextPopupOpen = false;
    return false;
}

// FIXME: Copied from MenuItem() for the purpose of being able to pass _SelectOnRelease (#9312)
private {
bool MenuItemForColumnReorder(u8* label, bool selected, bool enabled) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    ImVec2 label_size = ImGui_CalcTextSize(label, null, true, -1.0f);
    ImGuiMenuColumns* offsets = &window.DC.MenuColumns;
    var checkmark_w = cast(f32, cast(i32, g.FontSize * 1.2f));
    f32 min_w = ImGuiMenuColumns_DeclColumns(offsets, 0.0f, label_size.x, 0.0f, checkmark_w);
    f32 stretch_w = ImMax(0.0f, ImGui_GetContentRegionAvail().x - min_w);
    ImVec2 text_pos;
    ImVec2_init(&text_pos, window.DC.CursorPos.x, window.DC.CursorPos.y + window.DC.CurrLineTextBaseOffset);
    ImGuiID id = ImGui_GetID(label);
    ImGuiSelectableFlags selectable_flags = ImGuiSelectableFlags_SelectOnRelease | ImGuiSelectableFlags_SpanAvailWidth;
    if g.ActiveId == id {
        selectable_flags |= ImGuiSelectableFlags_Highlight;
    }
    bool has_been_moved = g.ActiveId == id && g.ActiveIdHasBeenEditedBefore;
    ImGui_BeginDisabled(!enabled);
    bool ret = ImGui_Selectable(label, false, selectable_flags, ImVec2{min_w, label_size.y}) && !has_been_moved;
    if g.LastItemData.StatusFlags & ImGuiItemStatusFlags_Visible && selected {
        ImGui_RenderCheckMark(window.DrawList, op_add_ImVec2_ImVec2(text_pos, ImVec2{
            cast(f32, offsets.OffsetMark) + stretch_w + g.FontSize * 0.4f,
            g.FontSize * 0.134f * 0.5f,
        }), ImGui_GetColorU32(ImGuiCol_Text), g.FontSize * 0.866f);
    }
    ImGui_EndDisabled();
    ignore *g;
    return ret;
}
}

// Output context menu into current window (generally a popup)
// FIXME-TABLE: Ideally this should be writable by the user. Full programmatic access to that data?
// Sections to display are pulled from 'flags_for_section_to_display', which is typically == table->Flags.
// - ImGuiTableFlags_Resizable   -> display Sizing menu items
// - ImGuiTableFlags_Reorderable -> display "Reset Order"
////- ImGuiTableFlags_Sortable   -> display sorting options (disabled)
// - ImGuiTableFlags_Hideable    -> display columns visibility menu items
// It means if you have a custom context menus you can call this section and omit some sections, and add your own.
void ImGui_TableDrawDefaultContextMenu(ImGuiTable* table, ImGuiTableFlags flags_for_section_to_display) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiWindow* window = g.CurrentWindow;
    if window.SkipItems != 0 {
        return;
    }
    bool want_separator = false;
    i32 context_column_n = table.ContextPopupColumn >= 0 && table.ContextPopupColumn < table.ColumnsCount ? table.ContextPopupColumn : -1;
    ImGuiTableColumn* context_column = context_column_n != -1 ? &table.Columns.Data[context_column_n] : null;
    if (flags_for_section_to_display & ImGuiTableFlags_Resizable) != 0 {
        if context_column != null {
            bool can_resize = !(context_column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoResize) && context_column.IsEnabled;
            if ImGui_MenuItem(ImGui_LocalizeGetMsg(ImGuiLocKey_TableSizeOne), null, false, can_resize) != 0 {
                ImGui_TableSetColumnWidthAutoSingle(table, context_column_n);
            }
        }
        u8* size_all_desc;
        if table.ColumnsEnabledFixedCount == table.ColumnsEnabledCount && (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_SizingMask_) != ImGuiTableFlags_SizingFixedSame {
            size_all_desc = ImGui_LocalizeGetMsg(ImGuiLocKey_TableSizeAllFit);
        } else {
            size_all_desc = ImGui_LocalizeGetMsg(ImGuiLocKey_TableSizeAllDefault);
        }
        if ImGui_MenuItem(size_all_desc, null, false, true) != 0 {
            ImGui_TableSetColumnWidthAutoAll(table);
        }
        want_separator = true;
    }
    if (flags_for_section_to_display & (ImGuiTableFlags_Reorderable | ImGuiTableFlags_Hideable)) != 0 {
        if ImGui_BeginMenu(ImGui_LocalizeGetMsg(ImGuiLocKey_TableReset), true) != 0 {
            if (flags_for_section_to_display & ImGuiTableFlags_Reorderable) != 0 {
                if ImGui_MenuItem(ImGui_LocalizeGetMsg(ImGuiLocKey_TableResetOrder), null, false, !table.IsDefaultDisplayOrder) != 0 {
                    table.IsResetDisplayOrderRequest = true;
                }
            }
            if (flags_for_section_to_display & ImGuiTableFlags_Hideable) != 0 {
                if ImGui_MenuItem(ImGui_LocalizeGetMsg(ImGuiLocKey_TableResetVisibility), null, false, !table.IsDefaultVisibility) != 0 {
                    table.IsResetVisibilityRequest = true;
                }
            }
            ImGui_EndMenu();
        }
    }
    if (flags_for_section_to_display & ImGuiTableFlags_Hideable) != 0 {
        if want_separator != 0 {
            ImGui_Separator();
        }
        want_separator = true;
        bool is_reordering = g.ActiveId != 0 && g.ActiveIdWindow == g.CurrentWindow && table.ReorderColumn != -1 && g.ActiveIdHasBeenEditedBefore;
        i32 reorder_src_order = is_reordering != 0 ? table.Columns.Data[table.ReorderColumn].DisplayOrder : -1;
        i32 reorder_min_order = is_reordering != 0 ? TableGetMaxDisplayOrderAllowed(table, reorder_src_order, 0) : 0;
        i32 reorder_max_order = is_reordering != 0 ? TableGetMaxDisplayOrderAllowed(table, reorder_src_order, table.ColumnsCount - 1) : table.ColumnsCount - 1;
        ImGui_PushItemFlag(ImGuiItemFlags_AutoClosePopups, false);
        for i32 order_n = 0; order_n < table.ColumnsCount; order_n++ {
            i32 column_n = table.DisplayOrderToIndex.Data[order_n];
            ImGuiTableColumn* column = &table.Columns.Data[column_n];
            if (column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_Disabled) != 0 {
                continue;
            }
            u8* name = ImGui_TableGetColumnName(table, column_n);
            if name == null || name[0] == 0 {
                name = "<Unknown>";
            }
            bool menu_item_enabled = ((column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_NoHide) != 0 ? false : true) != 0;
            if column.IsUserEnabled && table.ColumnsEnabledCount <= 1 {
                menu_item_enabled = false;
            }
            if is_reordering && (column.DisplayOrder < reorder_min_order || column.DisplayOrder > reorder_max_order) {
                menu_item_enabled = false;
            }
            if MenuItemForColumnReorder(name, column.IsUserEnabled, menu_item_enabled) != 0 {
                column.IsUserEnabledNextFrame = !column.IsUserEnabled;
            }
            if ImGui_IsItemActive() && ImGui_IsMouseDragging(0, -1.0f) && g.ActiveIdSource == ImGuiInputSource_Mouse && table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_Reorderable {
                g.ActiveIdHasBeenEditedBefore = true;
                table.ReorderColumn = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, column_n);
                if ImGui_IsItemHovered(0) == 0 {
                    i32 reorder_dir = g.IO.MousePos.y < (g.LastItemData.Rect.Min.y + g.LastItemData.Rect.Max.y) * 0.5f ? -1 : 1;
                    f32 reorder_amount = (reorder_dir < 0 ? g.LastItemData.Rect.Min.y - g.IO.MousePos.y : g.IO.MousePos.y - g.LastItemData.Rect.Max.y) / ImRect_GetHeight(&g.LastItemData.Rect);
                    i32 dst_order = column.DisplayOrder + cast(i32, ceil(reorder_amount)) * reorder_dir;
                    ImGui_TableQueueSetColumnDisplayOrder(table, column_n, dst_order);
                }
            }
        }
        ImGui_PopItemFlag();
    }
}

//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
// [SECTION] Tables: Settings (.ini data)
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
// FIXME: The binding/finding/creating flow are too confusing.
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
// - TableSettingsInit() [Internal]
// - TableSettingsCalcChunkSize() [Internal]
// - TableSettingsCreate() [Internal]
// - TableSettingsFindByID() [Internal]
// - TableGetBoundSettings() [Internal]
// - TableResetSettings()
// - TableSaveSettings() [Internal]
// - TableLoadSettings() [Internal]
// - TableLoadSettingsForColumns() [Internal]
// - TableSettingsHandler_ClearAll() [Internal]
// - TableSettingsHandler_ApplyAll() [Internal]
// - TableSettingsHandler_ReadOpen() [Internal]
// - TableSettingsHandler_ReadLine() [Internal]
// - TableSettingsHandler_WriteAll() [Internal]
// - TableSettingsInstallHandler() [Internal]
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
// [Init] 1: TableSettingsHandler_ReadXXXX()   Load and parse .ini file into TableSettings.
// [Main] 2: TableLoadSettings()               When table is created, bind Table to TableSettings, serialize TableSettings data into Table.
// [Main] 3: TableSaveSettings()               When table properties are modified, serialize Table data into bound or new TableSettings, mark .ini as dirty.
// [Main] 4: TableSettingsHandler_WriteAll()   When .ini file is dirty (which can come from other source), save TableSettings into .ini file.
//-------------------------------------------------------------------------
// Clear and initialize empty settings instance
private {
void TableSettingsInit(ImGuiTableSettings* settings, ImGuiID id, i32 columns_count, i32 columns_count_max) {
    ImGuiTableSettings_init(settings);
    ImGuiTableColumnSettings* settings_column = ImGuiTableSettings_GetColumnSettings(settings);
    for i32 n = 0; n < columns_count_max; n++ {
        ImGuiTableColumnSettings_init(settings_column);
        settings_column++;
    }
    settings.ID = id;
    settings.ColumnsCount = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, columns_count);
    settings.ColumnsCountMax = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, columns_count_max);
    settings.WantApply = true;
}

u64 TableSettingsCalcChunkSize(i32 columns_count) {
    return cast(u64, sizeof(ImGuiTableSettings)) + cast(u64, columns_count) * cast(u64, sizeof(ImGuiTableColumnSettings));
}
}

ImGuiTableSettings* ImGui_TableSettingsCreate(ImGuiID id, i32 columns_count) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    {
        ImGuiTableSettings* settings = ImGui_TableSettingsFindByID(id);
        if settings != null {
            if settings.ColumnsCountMax >= columns_count {
                TableSettingsInit(settings, id, columns_count, settings.ColumnsCountMax);
                return settings;
            }
            settings.ID = 0;
        }
    }
    ImGuiTableSettings* settings = ImChunkStream_ImGuiTableSettings_alloc_chunk(&g.SettingsTables, TableSettingsCalcChunkSize(columns_count));
    TableSettingsInit(settings, id, columns_count, columns_count);
    return settings;
}

// Find existing settings
ImGuiTableSettings* ImGui_TableSettingsFindByID(ImGuiID id) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;

    table.IsSettingsDirty = true;
    table.IsInitializing = table.IsSettingsDirty;
    table.IsResetAllRequest = false;
    table.IsSettingsRequestLoad = false;

void ImGui_TableSaveSettings(ImGuiTable* table) {
    table.IsSettingsDirty = false;
    if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_NoSavedSettings) != 0 {
        return;
    }
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImGuiTableSettings* settings = ImGui_TableGetBoundSettings(table);
    if settings != null && table.ColumnsCount > settings.ColumnsCountMax {
        settings.ID = 0;
        settings = null;
    }
    if settings == null {
        settings = ImGui_TableSettingsCreate(table.ID, table.ColumnsCount);
        table.SettingsOffset = ImChunkStream_ImGuiTableSettings_offset_from_ptr(&g.SettingsTables, settings);
    }
    settings.ColumnsCount = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, table.ColumnsCount);
    settings.LastUsedDate = g.SessionDate;
    assert(settings.ID == table.ID);
    assert(settings.ColumnsCount == table.ColumnsCount && settings.ColumnsCountMax >= settings.ColumnsCount);
    ImGuiTableColumn* column = table.Columns.Data;
    ImGuiTableColumnSettings* column_settings = ImGuiTableSettings_GetColumnSettings(settings);
    bool save_ref_scale = false;
    settings.SaveFlags = ImGuiTableFlags_None;
    for i32 n = 0; n < table.ColumnsCount; n++ {
        f32 width_or_weight = (column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthStretch) != 0 ? column.StretchWeight : column.WidthRequest;
        column_settings.ID = column.ID;
        column_settings.WidthOrWeight = width_or_weight;
        column_settings.Index = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, n);
        column_settings.DisplayOrder = column.DisplayOrder;
        column_settings.SortOrder = column.SortOrder;
        column_settings.SortDirection = column.SortDirection;
        column_settings.IsEnabled = column.IsUserEnabled;
        column_settings.IsStretch = cast(ImU8, (column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthStretch) != 0 ? 1 : 0);
        if (column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_WidthStretch) == 0 {
            save_ref_scale = true;
        }
        if width_or_weight != column.InitStretchWeightOrWidth {
            settings.SaveFlags |= ImGuiTableFlags_Resizable;
        }
        if column.DisplayOrder != n {
            settings.SaveFlags |= ImGuiTableFlags_Reorderable;
        }
        if column.SortOrder != -1 {
            settings.SaveFlags |= ImGuiTableFlags_Sortable;
        }
        if column.IsUserEnabled != ((column.Flags & ImGuiTableColumnFlags_DefaultHide) == 0) {
            settings.SaveFlags |= ImGuiTableFlags_Hideable;
        }
        column++;
        column_settings++;
    }
    settings.SaveFlags &= table.Flags;
    settings.RefScale = save_ref_scale != 0 ? table.RefScale : 0.0f;
    ImGui_MarkIniSettingsDirty();
}

void ImGui_TableLoadSettings(ImGuiTable* table) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    if (table.Flags & ImGuiTableFlags_NoSavedSettings) != 0 {
        table.IsSettingsRequestLoad = false;
        return;
    }
    ImGuiTableSettings* settings;
    if table.SettingsOffset == -1 {
        settings = ImGui_TableSettingsFindByID(table.ID);
        if settings == null {
            return;
        }
        if settings.ColumnsCount != table.ColumnsCount {
            table.IsSettingsDirty = true;
        }
        table.SettingsOffset = ImChunkStream_ImGuiTableSettings_offset_from_ptr(&g.SettingsTables, settings);
    } else {
        settings = ImGui_TableGetBoundSettings(table);
    }
    table.SettingsLoadedFlags = settings.SaveFlags;
    table.RefScale = settings.RefScale;
    settings.LastUsedDate = g.SessionDate;
}

// NB: This was written to be similar to the logic in TableReconcileColumns().
void ImGui_TableLoadSettingsForColumns(ImGuiTable* table) {
    {
        ImGuiTableColumn* zz_rf_it_9 = ImSpan_ImGuiTableColumn_begin(&table.Columns);
        ImGuiTableColumn* zz_rf_end_9 = ImSpan_ImGuiTableColumn_end(&table.Columns);
        for ; zz_rf_it_9 != zz_rf_end_9; zz_rf_it_9++ {
            ImGuiTableColumn* column = zz_rf_it_9;
            column.IsLoadedSettings = false;
        }
    }
    ImGuiTableSettings* settings = ImGui_TableGetBoundSettings(table);
    if settings == null {
        return;
    }
    table.SettingsLoadedFlags |= ImGuiTableFlags_Reorderable;
    ImGuiTableColumnSettings* column_settings = ImGuiTableSettings_GetColumnSettings(settings);
    i32 matches = 0;
    for i32 n = 0; n < table.ColumnsCount; n++ {
        if n >= settings.ColumnsCount || column_settings[n].ID != table.Columns.Data[n].ID {
            break;
        }
        ImGui_TableLoadSettingsForColumn(&table.Columns.Data[n], &column_settings[n], settings.SaveFlags);
        matches++;
    }
    if matches == settings.ColumnsCount {
        return;
    }
    i32 settings_start_n = matches;
    for i32 n = settings_start_n; n < settings.ColumnsCount; n++ {
        column_settings[n].IsLoaded = false;
    }
    {
        ImGuiTableColumn* zz_rf_it_10 = ImSpan_ImGuiTableColumn_begin(&table.Columns);
        ImGuiTableColumn* zz_rf_end_10 = ImSpan_ImGuiTableColumn_end(&table.Columns);
        for ; zz_rf_it_10 != zz_rf_end_10; zz_rf_it_10++ {
            ImGuiTableColumn* column = zz_rf_it_10;
            if column.ID != 0 && !column.IsLoadedSettings {
                for i32 n = settings_start_n; n < settings.ColumnsCount; n++ {
                    if column_settings[n].ID == column.ID && !column_settings[n].IsLoaded {
                        ImGui_TableLoadSettingsForColumn(column, &column_settings[n], settings.SaveFlags);
                        matches++;
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    i32 dst_idx = 0;
    for i32 n = settings_start_n; n < settings.ColumnsCount; n++ {
        if column_settings[n].IsLoaded == 0 {
            while dst_idx < table.ColumnsCount && table.Columns.Data[dst_idx].IsLoadedSettings {
                dst_idx++;
            }
            if dst_idx >= table.ColumnsCount {
                break;
            }
            ImGui_TableLoadSettingsForColumn(&table.Columns.Data[dst_idx], &column_settings[n], settings.SaveFlags);
            dst_idx++;
        }
    }
}

void ImGui_TableLoadSettingsForColumn(ImGuiTableColumn* column, ImGuiTableColumnSettings* column_settings, ImGuiTableFlags load_flags) {
    column.IsLoadedSettings = true;
    column_settings.IsLoaded = true;
    if (load_flags & ImGuiTableFlags_Resizable) != 0 {
        if column_settings.IsStretch != 0 {
            column.StretchWeight = column_settings.WidthOrWeight;
        } else {
            column.WidthRequest = column_settings.WidthOrWeight;
        }
        column.AutoFitQueue = 0x00;
    }
    if (load_flags & ImGuiTableFlags_Reorderable) != 0 {
        column.DisplayOrder = column_settings.DisplayOrder;
    } else {
        column.DisplayOrder = column_settings.Index;
    }
    if load_flags & ImGuiTableFlags_Hideable && column_settings.IsEnabled != -1 {
        column.IsUserEnabledNextFrame = column_settings.IsEnabled == 1;
        column.IsUserEnabled = column.IsUserEnabledNextFrame;
    }
    column.SortOrder = column_settings.SortOrder;
    column.SortDirection = column_settings.SortDirection;
}

// Sort by DisplayOrder and then Index
private {
i32 TableFixDisplayOrderComparer(void* lhs, void* rhs) {
    ImGuiTable* table = cast(ImGuiTableFixDisplayOrderColumnData*, lhs).Table;
    ImGuiTableColumnIdx lhs_idx = cast(ImGuiTableFixDisplayOrderColumnData*, lhs).Idx;
    ImGuiTableColumnIdx rhs_idx = cast(ImGuiTableFixDisplayOrderColumnData*, rhs).Idx;
    var order_delta = cast(i32, cast(u16, table.Columns.Data[lhs_idx].DisplayOrder) - cast(u16, table.Columns.Data[rhs_idx].DisplayOrder));
    return order_delta > 0 ? 1 : order_delta < 0 ? -1 : lhs_idx > rhs_idx ? 1 : -1;
}
}

// Fix invalid display order data: compact values (0,1,3 -> 0,1,2); preserve relative order (0,3,1 -> 0,2,1); deduplicate (0,4,1,1 -> 0,3,1,2)
void ImGui_TableFixDisplayOrder(ImGuiTable* table) {
    ImGuiContext* g = GImGui;
    ImVector_char_reserve(&g.TempBuffer, cast(i32, sizeof(ImGuiTableFixDisplayOrderColumnData) * table.ColumnsCount));
    var fdo_columns = cast(ImGuiTableFixDisplayOrderColumnData*, cast(void*, g.TempBuffer.Data));
    for i32 n = 0; n < table.ColumnsCount; n++ {
        fdo_columns[n].Idx = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, n);
        fdo_columns[n].Table = table;
    }
    ImQsort(fdo_columns, cast(u64, table.ColumnsCount), cast(u64, sizeof(ImGuiTableFixDisplayOrderColumnData)), cast(fn(void*, void*): i32, TableFixDisplayOrderComparer));
    for i32 n = 0; n < table.ColumnsCount; n++ {
        table.Columns.Data[fdo_columns[n].Idx].DisplayOrder = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, n);
    }
    for i32 n = 0; n < table.ColumnsCount; n++ {
        table.DisplayOrderToIndex.Data[table.Columns.Data[n].DisplayOrder] = cast(ImGuiTableColumnIdx, n);
    }
}

void TableSettingsHandler_Cleanup(ImGuiContext* ctx, ImGuiSettingsHandler* _1, ImGuiSettingsCleanupArgs* args) {
